## Correct Answer: C — Rolling with additional batch, batch size = 1

The RollingWithAdditionalBatch policy launches an extra batch of instances, before starting the deployment, to maintain full capacity. With a batch size of 1, Elastic Beanstalk launches **1 additional instance** (total = 6) before deploying. It then deploys to one instance at a time. At any moment, at least 5 instances are available to serve traffic (well above the 4-instance minimum).

Rolling with additional batch avoids any reduced availability, at a cost of an even longer deployment time compared to the Rolling method. It is suitable if you must maintain the same bandwidth throughout the deployment. With this method, Elastic Beanstalk launches an extra batch of instances, then performs a rolling deployment. Launching the extra batch takes time, and ensures that the same bandwidth is retained throughout the deployment.

This is the cheapest option that satisfies the requirement because only **1 extra instance** runs temporarily during deployment, and it is terminated when the deployment ends.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**A. Increase desired capacity to 6 permanently** — Wrong. This adds an EC2 instance running 24/7, incurring ongoing cost forever, not just during deployments. Far less cost-effective than option C, which adds the extra instance only during the deployment window.

**B. Traffic splitting with 1-hour evaluation** — Wrong. Traffic splitting is a canary testing deployment method. It performs an immutable-style deployment that launches a **full second set of instances** (5 more), then shifts a percentage of traffic. This is much more expensive than launching a single additional instance, and the 1-hour evaluation extends that cost. It is designed for canary regression testing, not for preserving capacity cheaply.

**D. Rolling, batch size = 2** — Wrong. Rolling avoids downtime and minimizes reduced availability, at a cost of a longer deployment time. With this method, your application is deployed to your environment one batch of instances at a time. Most bandwidth is retained throughout the deployment. Standard Rolling does **not** launch extra instances — it takes the batch out of service in place. With 5 instances and a batch of 2, only **3 instances** would serve traffic during each batch, which is below the 4-instance threshold and causes the performance degradation the company wants to avoid.

Note: Even a Rolling (not "with additional batch") with a batch size of 1 would leave 4 instances serving traffic — but option D specifies batch size 2, so D fails the capacity requirement regardless.

## References
- [Elastic Beanstalk Deployment policies and settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.rolling-version-deploy.html)
- [Deploying applications to Elastic Beanstalk environments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.deploy-existing-version.html)

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 上部署了一个应用程序。该公司已将与 Elastic Beanstalk 环境关联的自动扩展组配置为包含五个 Amazon EC2 实例。如果在部署期间容量少于四个 EC2 实例，应用程序性能就会下降。该公司采用的是一次性部署策略。解决此部署问题的最经济有效的方法是什么？

options.A: 将自动扩展组更改为六个所需的实例。
options.B: 将部署策略更改为流量拆分。指定评估时间为 1 小时。
options.C: 将部署策略更改为滚动部署，并增加批次大小。指定批次大小为 1。
options.D: 将部署策略更改为滚动部署。指定批处理大小为 2。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一个 Elastic Beanstalk 环境在 Auto Scaling 组中运行 5 个 EC2 实例。如果部署期间可用实例少于 4 个，应用性能会下降。当前的"全部一次"政策会同时将所有实例从服务中移除。我们需要**最具成本效益的**部署策略变更，以保持至少 4 个实例提供流量。

## 正确答案：C — 带额外批次的滚动部署，批次大小 = 1

RollingWithAdditionalBatch 政策在开始部署之前启动额外的实例批次，以维持完整容量。批次大小为 1 时，Elastic Beanstalk 在部署前启动**1 个额外实例**（总计 = 6 个），然后一次部署一个实例。任何时刻都至少有 5 个实例可用来服务流量（远高于 4 实例的最小值）。

带额外批次的滚动部署避免了任何可用性降低，代价是相比滚动方法部署时间更长。如果必须在整个部署期间保持相同带宽，这种方法很合适。使用此方法时，Elastic Beanstalk 启动额外的实例批次，然后执行滚动部署。启动额外批次需要时间，并确保在整个部署期间保留相同的带宽。

这是满足要求的最便宜选项，因为只有**1 个额外实例**在部署期间临时运行，部署结束后会被终止。

## 为什么其他选项错误

**A. 将所需容量永久增加到 6** — 错误。这会导致一个 EC2 实例全天候运行 24/7，永远产生持续成本，而不仅仅是在部署期间。远不如选项 C 具有成本效益，选项 C 只在部署窗口期间添加额外实例。

**B. 流量分割，1 小时评估** — 错误。流量分割是一种金丝雀测试部署方法。它执行不可变风格的部署，启动**完整的第二组实例**（5 个），然后转移一部分流量。这比启动单个额外实例的成本高得多，而且 1 小时的评估会延长该成本。它设计用于金丝雀回归测试，而不是廉价地保留容量。

**D. 滚动，批次大小 = 2** — 错误。滚动避免停机并最小化可用性降低，代价是部署时间更长。使用此方法，应用程序一次部署到环境中的一个实例批次。部署期间保留大部分带宽。标准滚动部署**不会**启动额外实例 — 它会就地移除批次。使用 5 个实例和批次大小 2，每个批次部署期间只有**3 个实例**会服务流量，低于 4 实例的阈值，会导致公司想避免的性能下降。

注：即使是滚动部署（非"带额外批次"）且批次大小为 1，也会保留 4 个实例服务流量 — 但选项 D 指定批次大小为 2，所以 D 无论如何都无法满足容量要求。

## 参考资源
- [Elastic Beanstalk 部署策略和设置](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.rolling-version-deploy.html)
- [向 Elastic Beanstalk 环境部署应用程序](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.deploy-existing-version.html)

en.question: A developer is incorporating AWS X-Ray into an application that handles personal identifiable information (PII). The application is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances. The application trace messages include encrypted PII and go to Amazon CloudWatch. The developer needs to ensure that no PII goes outside of the EC2 instances. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Manually instrument the X-Ray SDK in the application code.
options.B: Use the X-Ray auto-instrumentation agent.
options.C: Use Amazon Macie to detect and hide PII. Call the X-Ray API from AWS Lambda.
options.D: Use AWS Distro for Open Telemetry.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer is adding AWS X-Ray tracing to an EC2-hosted application that processes PII. Trace messages currently include encrypted PII and are sent to CloudWatch. The requirement is to ensure **no PII leaves the EC2 instances** via X-Ray traces.

## Correct Answer: A — Manually instrument the X-Ray SDK in the application code

Manual instrumentation gives the developer **fine-grained control** over exactly which fields, annotations, and metadata are captured in the trace segments. Per the AWS X-Ray developer guide, [Instrumenting your application for AWS X-Ray](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-instrumenting-your-app.html), "Manual instrumentation – add instrumentation code to your application at each location where you want to send trace information." This lets the developer deliberately exclude PII (or any sensitive payload) from the segment documents that the X-Ray daemon would otherwise upload to the X-Ray service.

The [AWS X-Ray concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-concepts.html) page also notes that "You choose the data to collect by modifying your application configuration or code to instrument incoming requests, downstream requests, and AWS SDK clients." Annotations and metadata are explicitly developer-controlled, so manual instrumentation is the only option that guarantees PII is not added to outgoing segments.

## Why the other options are wrong

**B. X-Ray auto-instrumentation agent** — The auto-instrumentation agent (currently only fully supported for Java; see [AWS X-Ray auto-instrumentation agent for Java](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/aws-x-ray-auto-instrumentation-agent-for-java.html)) automatically captures incoming servlet requests, downstream HTTP/AWS SDK/JDBC calls, request parameters, headers, and SQL queries. The developer cannot selectively exclude fields that may contain PII (e.g., query string parameters, request bodies, SQL bind variables). AWS docs even recommend that for use cases where the agent doesn't fit, "you might want to consider manual instrumentation with the X-Ray SDK instead." This makes it unsuitable for guaranteeing no PII leaves the instance.

**C. Use Amazon Macie + call X-Ray API from Lambda** — [Amazon Macie](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html) is designed to discover and classify sensitive data stored in **Amazon S3**, not to filter or redact in-flight trace data. It does not "hide" PII in real-time application traces. Routing X-Ray calls through Lambda adds complexity, latency, cost, and still doesn't address PII filtering at the source.

**D. AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry (ADOT)** — ADOT is a distribution of OpenTelemetry SDKs, auto-instrumentation agents, and collectors. Like the X-Ray auto-instrumentation agent, ADOT's auto-instrumentation captures request data automatically and does not, by itself, prevent PII from being sent to X-Ray/CloudWatch. While you *could* manually instrument with ADOT, the option as written ("Use AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry") implies the default behavior, which does not satisfy the requirement.

## Key takeaway

When trace data must exclude sensitive information, **manual instrumentation with the X-Ray SDK** is the AWS-recommended approach because the developer chooses precisely what is recorded in segments and subsegments.

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在将 AWS X-Ray 集成到处理个人身份信息 (PII) 的应用程序中。该应用程序托管在 Amazon EC2 实例上。应用程序跟踪消息包含加密的 PII，并发送到 Amazon CloudWatch。开发人员需要确保 PII 不会泄露到 EC2 实例之外。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 在应用程序代码中手动插入 X-Ray SDK。
options.B: 使用 X 射线自动仪器试剂。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Macie 检测和隐藏个人身份信息 (PII)。从 AWS Lambda 调用 X-Ray API。
options.D: 使用 AWS Distro 进行 Open Telemetry。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一位开发者正在为托管在 EC2 上的应用程序添加 AWS X-Ray 追踪功能，该应用程序处理 PII（个人身份信息）。追踪消息目前包含加密的 PII，并被发送到 CloudWatch。要求是**确保没有 PII 通过 X-Ray 追踪离开 EC2 实例**。

## 正确答案：A — 在应用程序代码中手动检测 X-Ray SDK

手动检测使开发者能够**精细控制**追踪段中捕获的确切字段、注解和元数据。根据 AWS X-Ray 开发者指南 [Instrumenting your application for AWS X-Ray](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-instrumenting-your-app.html)，"手动检测 – 在您想要发送追踪信息的每个位置向应用程序添加检测代码。"这使开发者能够从 X-Ray 守护进程可能上传到 X-Ray 服务的段文档中有意排除 PII（或任何敏感负载）。

[AWS X-Ray 概念](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-concepts.html)页面还指出"您通过修改应用程序配置或代码来选择要收集的数据，以对传入请求、下游请求和 AWS SDK 客户端进行检测。"注解和元数据由开发者显式控制，因此手动检测是唯一能保证 PII 不被添加到传出段中的选项。

## 其他选项为什么是错的

**B. X-Ray 自动检测代理** — 自动检测代理（目前仅对 Java 完全支持；见 [AWS X-Ray auto-instrumentation agent for Java](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/aws-x-ray-auto-instrumentation-agent-for-java.html)）自动捕获传入 servlet 请求、下游 HTTP/AWS SDK/JDBC 调用、请求参数、头部和 SQL 查询。开发者无法选择性地排除可能包含 PII 的字段（例如查询字符串参数、请求体、SQL 绑定变量）。AWS 文档甚至建议，对于代理不适用的用例，"您可能需要考虑改为使用 X-Ray SDK 进行手动检测。"这使其不适合保证没有 PII 离开实例。

**C. 使用 Amazon Macie + 从 Lambda 调用 X-Ray API** — [Amazon Macie](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html) 设计用于发现和分类存储在 **Amazon S3** 中的敏感数据，而不是筛选或编辑在途追踪数据。它不能在实时应用程序追踪中"隐藏" PII。通过 Lambda 路由 X-Ray 调用会增加复杂性、延迟、成本，并且仍未在源头解决 PII 筛选问题。

**D. AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry (ADOT)** — ADOT 是 OpenTelemetry SDK、自动检测代理和收集器的分发版。与 X-Ray 自动检测代理类似，ADOT 的自动检测会自动捕获请求数据，并且本身不会阻止 PII 被发送到 X-Ray/CloudWatch。虽然您*可以*手动使用 ADOT 进行检测，但选项的措辞（"使用 AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry"）意味着默认行为，这不满足要求。

## 关键要点

当追踪数据必须排除敏感信息时，**使用 X-Ray SDK 进行手动检测**是 AWS 推荐的方法，因为开发者可以精确选择在段和子段中记录的内容。

en.question: A developer is migrating some features from a legacy monolithic application to use AWS Lambda functions instead. The application currently stores data in an Amazon Aurora DB cluster that runs in private subnets in a VPC. The AWS account has one VPC deployed. The Lambda functions and the DB cluster are deployed in the same AWS Region in the same AWS account. The developer needs to ensure that the Lambda functions can securely access the DB cluster without crossing the public internet. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the DB cluster's public access setting to Yes.
options.B: Configure an Amazon RDS database proxy for he Lambda functions.
options.C: Configure a NAT gateway and a security group for the Lambda functions.
options.D: Configure the VPC, subnets, and a security group for the Lambda functions.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer is migrating features from a monolithic application to AWS Lambda. The Aurora DB cluster runs in **private subnets** of a VPC. Lambda functions and the DB cluster are in the **same Region and same AWS account**. The requirement: Lambda must access Aurora **securely without crossing the public internet**.

## Correct Answer: D — Configure the VPC, subnets, and a security group for the Lambda functions

By default, Lambda functions run in a Lambda-service-owned VPC and cannot reach resources in private subnets of your VPC. To privately connect to a database in private subnets, you must attach the Lambda function to your VPC by specifying subnet IDs and security group IDs. Once configured, Lambda creates Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs) in the chosen subnets, allowing the function to communicate with the Aurora cluster over private IP addresses inside the VPC — never traversing the public internet.

AWS documentation explicitly states that the Lambda function must exist in the same VPC as the DB cluster for native private connectivity, and that when you enable VPC access, Lambda creates Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs) in your specified subnets, and traffic from your function flows through these ENIs into your VPC.

The security group controls which traffic the Lambda ENIs can send; the corresponding DB security group must allow inbound traffic from the Lambda security group on the database port (e.g., 3306/5432).

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. Configure the DB cluster's public access setting to Yes.** This is the *opposite* of the requirement. Making the database publicly accessible exposes it to the internet, violating the "without crossing the public internet" and "securely" requirements. It also still wouldn't help Lambda (default Lambda has internet egress, but the goal is private access).

- **B. Configure an Amazon RDS database proxy for the Lambda functions.** RDS Proxy solves connection pooling/management for serverless workloads — it does not by itself give a Lambda function network access to a private VPC. The proxy itself lives in a VPC, and the Lambda function must still exist in the same VPC as the DB cluster (or the proxy) to reach it. Without VPC configuration on the Lambda, RDS Proxy cannot be reached either. Useful complement, but not the solution to the connectivity question asked.

- **C. Configure a NAT gateway and a security group for the Lambda functions.** A NAT gateway gives **outbound internet** access to resources in private subnets — it is used when a VPC-attached Lambda needs to reach the public internet, not to reach a private RDS endpoint. As confirmed by AWS docs, the private subnets can access the internet through the NAT gateway; connecting a function to a public subnet doesn't give it internet access. NAT routes traffic *toward* the internet, which is the opposite of the stated requirement.

## Reference Configuration

```bash
aws lambda update-function-configuration \
  --function-name my-function \
  --vpc-config SubnetIds=subnet-aaa,subnet-bbb,SecurityGroupIds=sg-lambda
```

The Lambda execution role needs the `AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole` managed policy to create the ENIs.

## References

- [Configuring VPC access for Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)
- [Automatically connecting a Lambda function and an Aurora DB cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/lambda-rds-connect.html)
- [Enable internet access for VPC-connected Lambda functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc-internet.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在将一些功能从传统的单体应用程序迁移到 AWS Lambda 函数。该应用程序目前将数据存储在运行于 VPC 私有子网中的 Amazon Aurora 数据库集群中。该 AWS 账户部署了一个 VPC。Lambda 函数和数据库集群部署在同一 AWS 账户的同一 AWS 区域中。开发人员需要确保 Lambda 函数能够安全地访问数据库集群，而无需通过公共互联网。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 将数据库集群的公共访问设置配置为“是”。
options.B: 为 Lambda 函数配置 Amazon RDS 数据库代理。
options.C: 为 Lambda 函数配置 NAT 网关和安全组。
options.D: 为 Lambda 函数配置 VPC、子网和安全组。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一名开发者正在将功能从单体应用迁移到 AWS Lambda。Aurora DB 集群运行在 VPC 的**私有子网**中。Lambda 函数和 DB 集群位于**同一区域和同一 AWS 账户**。要求：Lambda 必须以**安全的方式访问 Aurora，无需跨越公网**。

## 正确答案：D — 为 Lambda 函数配置 VPC、子网和安全组

默认情况下，Lambda 函数运行在 Lambda 服务拥有的 VPC 中，无法访问 VPC 中私有子网内的资源。要私密地连接到位于私有子网内的数据库，必须通过指定子网 ID 和安全组 ID 将 Lambda 函数附加到您的 VPC。配置完成后，Lambda 会在选定的子网中创建弹性网络接口（ENI），使得函数能够通过 VPC 内部的私有 IP 地址与 Aurora 集群通信 — 完全不会跨越公网。

AWS 文档明确指出 Lambda 函数必须与 DB 集群位于同一 VPC 以实现本机私密连接，并且 启用 VPC 访问时，Lambda 会在指定的子网中创建弹性网络接口（ENI），函数的流量通过这些 ENI 流入您的 VPC。

安全组控制 Lambda ENI 能够发送的流量；对应的数据库安全组必须允许来自 Lambda 安全组在数据库端口（例如 3306/5432）上的入站流量。

## 其他选项为什么错误

- **A. 配置 DB 集群的公共访问设置为 Yes。** 这与要求相反。将数据库设置为公开访问会将其暴露到互联网，违反了"无需跨越公网"和"安全"的要求。即使如此，也不会帮助 Lambda（默认 Lambda 有互联网出站流量，但目标是私密访问）。

- **B. 为 Lambda 函数配置 Amazon RDS 数据库代理。** RDS Proxy 解决了无服务器工作负载的连接池化/管理问题 — 但它本身不会给 Lambda 函数提供访问私有 VPC 内资源的网络访问权限。代理本身位于 VPC 中，Lambda 函数必须与 DB 集群位于同一 VPC（或与代理位于同一 VPC）才能访问它。如果 Lambda 没有进行 VPC 配置，也无法访问 RDS Proxy。虽然有用，但不是解决此连接问题的方案。

- **C. 为 Lambda 函数配置 NAT 网关和安全组。** NAT 网关为私有子网中的资源提供**出站互联网**访问 — 它用于当 VPC 附加的 Lambda 需要访问公网时，而不是访问私有 RDS 端点。如 AWS 文档所确认 私有子网可以通过 NAT 网关访问互联网；将函数连接到公有子网不会给它互联网访问权限。NAT 将流量路由**向互联网方向**，这与所述要求相反。

## 参考配置

```bash
aws lambda update-function-configuration \
  --function-name my-function \
  --vpc-config SubnetIds=subnet-aaa,subnet-bbb,SecurityGroupIds=sg-lambda
```

Lambda 执行角色需要 `AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole` 托管策略来创建 ENI。

## 参考资源

- [为 Lambda 配置 VPC 访问](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)
- [自动连接 Lambda 函数和 Aurora DB 集群](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/lambda-rds-connect.html)
- [为 VPC 连接的 Lambda 函数启用互联网访问](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc-internet.html)

en.question: A developer is building a new application on AWS. The application uses an AWS Lambda function that retrieves information from an Amazon DynamoDB table. The developer hard coded the DynamoDB table name into the Lambda function code. The table name might change over time. The developer does not want to modify the Lambda code if the table name changes. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST efficiently?

options.A: Create a Lambda environment variable to store the table name. Use the standard method for the programming language to retrieve the variable.
options.B: Store the table name in a file. Store the file in the /tmp folder. Use the SDK for the programming language to retrieve the table name.
options.C: Create a file to store the table name. Zip the file and upload the file to the Lambda layer. Use the SDK for the programming language to retrieve the table name.
options.D: Create a global variable that is outside the handler in the Lambda function to store the table name.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A Lambda function reads from a DynamoDB table whose name is currently **hard‑coded** in the source. The table name may change, and the developer wants a way to update it **without modifying or redeploying the Lambda code**. The question asks for the **most efficient** solution.

## Correct Answer: A — Use a Lambda environment variable

Lambda has built‑in support for environment variables that decouple configuration from code. You can use environment variables to adjust your function's behavior without updating code. An environment variable is a pair of strings that is stored in a function's version-specific configuration. The Lambda runtime makes environment variables available to your code and sets additional environment variables that contain information about the function and invocation request.

The function code simply reads the variable using the language’s standard mechanism (e.g., `os.environ['TABLE_NAME']` in Python, `process.env.TABLE_NAME` in Node.js, `System.getenv("TABLE_NAME")` in Java). When the table name changes, you update the environment variable in the function configuration — no code change, no redeploy of the package.

This pattern is explicitly recommended for things like DynamoDB table names: Often, your different functions rely on the same configuration values, e.g. the DynamoDB table they have to access. Generally, this should not be hardcoded in your function's code, but abstracted to environment variables.

```python
import os, boto3

TABLE_NAME = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']      # set in Lambda configuration
ddb = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(TABLE_NAME)

def lambda_handler(event, context):
    return ddb.get_item(Key={'id': event['id']})
```

## Why the other options are wrong

- **B. Store the table name in a file in `/tmp`.** The `/tmp` directory is **ephemeral, per‑execution‑environment scratch space**. It starts empty on a cold start, so there is nothing to read unless the code first writes the file — which means the value still has to come from somewhere (defeating the purpose). It is not a configuration store and provides no way to update the value externally without code changes.

- **C. Put the file in a Lambda layer.** A layer is a versioned `.zip` artifact bundled with the function. Changing the table name would require **building a new layer version, publishing it, and updating the function configuration to point at the new layer** — far more work than editing one environment variable. Layers are designed for shared libraries/runtimes, not for small mutable config values.

- **D. Use a global variable outside the handler.** A global is still **part of the source code**. Changing it requires editing the code and redeploying the function — exactly what the requirement forbids. (Module‑level globals are useful for caching reused clients across invocations, not for externalized configuration.)

## References
- [Working with Lambda environment variables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-envvars.html)
- [Lambda Environment API reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_Environment.html)
- [Securing Lambda environment variables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-envvars-encryption.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在 AWS 上构建一个新应用程序。该应用程序使用 AWS Lambda 函数从 Amazon DynamoDB 表中检索信息。开发人员将 DynamoDB 表名硬编码到 Lambda 函数代码中。表名可能会随时间而改变。开发人员不希望在表名更改时修改 Lambda 代码。哪种解决方案能够最有效地满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Lambda 环境变量来存储表名。使用编程语言的标准方法来检索该变量。
options.B: 将表名存储在文件中。将该文件存储在 /tmp 文件夹中。使用编程语言的 SDK 来检索表名。
options.C: 创建一个文件来存储表名。将文件压缩并上传到 Lambda 层。使用编程语言的 SDK 来检索表名。
options.D: 在 Lambda 函数的处理程序之外创建一个全局变量来存储表名。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一个 Lambda 函数从一个 DynamoDB 表读取数据，该表的名称目前是**硬编码**在源代码中的。表名可能会改变，开发者想要一种方式来更新它，**而无需修改或重新部署 Lambda 代码**。问题要求的是**最有效的**解决方案。

## 正确答案：A — 使用 Lambda 环境变量

Lambda 对环境变量有内置支持，可以将配置与代码解耦。您可以使用环境变量来调整函数的行为，而无需更新代码。环境变量是存储在函数的特定版本配置中的一对字符串。Lambda 运行时使环境变量对您的代码可用，并设置包含有关函数和调用请求信息的其他环境变量。

函数代码只需使用语言的标准机制读取该变量（例如，Python 中的 `os.environ['TABLE_NAME']`、Node.js 中的 `process.env.TABLE_NAME`、Java 中的 `System.getenv("TABLE_NAME")`）。当表名改变时，您只需在函数配置中更新环境变量 — 无需代码修改，无需重新部署包。

这种模式明确推荐用于类似 DynamoDB 表名这样的配置：通常，您的不同函数依赖于相同的配置值，例如它们必须访问的 DynamoDB 表。通常，这不应该硬编码在您函数的代码中，而应该抽象为环境变量。

```python
import os, boto3

TABLE_NAME = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']      # 在 Lambda 配置中设置
ddb = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(TABLE_NAME)

def lambda_handler(event, context):
    return ddb.get_item(Key={'id': event['id']})
```

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **B. 将表名存储在 `/tmp` 中的文件中。** `/tmp` 目录是**临时的、按执行环境的临时空间**。在冷启动时它是空的，所以除非代码首先写入该文件，否则没有任何内容可读 — 这意味着该值仍然必须来自某个地方（违反了目的）。它不是配置存储，也无法在不修改代码的情况下以外部方式更新该值。

- **C. 将文件放在 Lambda 层中。** 层是与函数捆绑的版本化 `.zip` 工件。更改表名需要**构建新的层版本、发布它，并更新函数配置以指向新层** — 这比编辑一个环境变量要复杂得多。层设计用于共享库/运行时，而不是用于小的可变配置值。

- **D. 使用处理程序外的全局变量。** 全局变量仍然是**源代码的一部分**。更改它需要编辑代码并重新部署函数 — 正好是要求禁止的做法。（模块级全局变量对于在调用间缓存重用的客户端很有用，但不适合外部化配置。）

## 参考资源
- [Working with Lambda environment variables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-envvars.html)
- [Lambda Environment API reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_Environment.html)
- [Securing Lambda environment variables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-envvars-encryption.html)

en.question: A company has a critical application on AWS. The application exposes an HTTP API by using Amazon API Gateway. The API is integrated with an AWS Lambda function. The application stores data in an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance with 2 virtual CPUs (vCPUs) and 64 GB of RAM. Customers have reported that some of the API calls return HTTP 500 Internal Server Error responses. Amazon CloudWatch Logs shows errors for “too many connections.” The errors occur during peak usage times that are unpredictable. The company needs to make the application resilient. The database cannot be down outside of scheduled maintenance hours. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Decrease the number of vCPUs for the DB instance. Increase the max_connections setting.
options.B: Use Amazon RDS Proxy to create a proxy that connects to the DB instance. Update the Lambda function to connect to the proxy.
options.C: Add a CloudWatch alarm that changes the DB instance class when the number of connections increases to more than 1,000.
options.D: Add an Amazon EventBridge rule that increases the max_connections setting of the DB instance when CPU utilization is above 75%.

en.explanation:
# Scenario Analysis

A critical application uses **API Gateway → Lambda → RDS for MySQL**. During unpredictable peak traffic, Lambda scales out and creates many concurrent database connections, exhausting MySQL's `max_connections` limit and causing **"too many connections"** errors that surface as HTTP 500 responses. The fix must:

1. Make the application resilient to connection bursts.
2. Avoid taking the database down outside of scheduled maintenance windows.

# Correct Answer: B — Use Amazon RDS Proxy

This is the canonical AWS-recommended solution for the Lambda + RDS connection-exhaustion problem.

RDS Proxy acts as an intermediary between your application and an RDS database. RDS Proxy establishes and manages the necessary connection pools to your database so that your application creates fewer database connections.

For Lambda specifically, it handles the connection pooling necessary for scaling many simultaneous connections created by concurrent Lambda functions. This allows your Lambda applications to reuse existing connections, rather than creating new connections for every function invocation. The RDS Proxy scales automatically so that your database instance needs less memory and CPU resources for connection management.

AWS explicitly identifies this scenario as a top use case for RDS Proxy: Any DB instance that encounters "too many connections" errors is a good candidate for associating with a proxy. This is often characterized by a high value of the ConnectionAttempts CloudWatch metric. The proxy enables applications to open many client connections, while the proxy manages a smaller number of long-lived connections to the DB instance.

It also satisfies the no-downtime requirement because the infrastructure for RDS Proxy is highly available and deployed over multiple Availability Zones (AZs). Deployment of RDS Proxy in front of an existing instance does not require the database to be taken offline.

Implementation: create the proxy targeting the RDS for MySQL instance, store DB credentials in Secrets Manager, attach an IAM role allowing the proxy to read them, and update the Lambda to connect to the **proxy endpoint** instead of the DB endpoint.

# Why the other options are wrong

### A. Decrease vCPUs and increase `max_connections`
- Reducing vCPUs **reduces** the database's processing capacity, making the problem worse, not better.
- In MySQL on RDS, the default `max_connections` formula is tied to instance memory; raising it manually can cause out-of-memory conditions because each connection consumes RAM/CPU. The number of maximum concurrent connections for a relational database depends on how it is sized. This is because each connection consumes memory and CPU resources on the database server.
- Modifying the parameter group value alone does not solve Lambda's bursty connection behavior.

### C. CloudWatch alarm that changes the DB instance class when connections > 1,000
- Modifying the DB instance class **causes a reboot** of the RDS instance, violating the requirement that the database not be down outside scheduled maintenance windows.
- Scaling the instance reactively is slow (minutes), so it cannot absorb sudden, unpredictable spikes from Lambda concurrency.
- It also incurs unnecessary cost; the root cause is connection management, not compute capacity.

### D. EventBridge rule that increases `max_connections` when CPU > 75%
- Wrong trigger metric: the symptom is **connection exhaustion**, not CPU pressure. CPU may be low while the connection limit is hit.
- `max_connections` lives in a **DB parameter group**. Changing static parameters typically requires a **DB instance reboot** to take effect, which violates the no-downtime requirement.
- Even if applied, raising `max_connections` beyond what the 64 GB instance can support leads to memory exhaustion and instability.
- Reactive parameter changes cannot keep up with sub-second Lambda scaling spikes.

# References

- [Using Amazon RDS Proxy with AWS Lambda (AWS Compute Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/using-amazon-rds-proxy-with-aws-lambda/)
- [Planning where to use RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-planning.html)
- [RDS Proxy concepts and terminology](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.howitworks.html)
- [RDS Proxy connection considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-connections.html)

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行着一个关键应用程序。该应用程序通过 Amazon API Gateway 公开一个 HTTP API，并与一个 AWS Lambda 函数集成。应用程序将数据存储在一个配备 2 个虚拟 CPU (vCPU) 和 64 GB 内存的 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例中。客户报告称，部分 API 调用返回 HTTP 500 内部服务器错误响应。Amazon CloudWatch Logs 显示“连接数过多” 的错误。这些错误发生在不可预测的高峰使用时段。该公司需要确保应用程序的弹性，数据库在计划维护时间之外不能出现任何故障。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 减少数据库实例的虚拟CPU数量。增加max_connections设置。
options.B: 使用 Amazon RDS Proxy 创建一个连接到数据库实例的代理。更新 Lambda 函数以连接到该代理。
options.C: 添加一个 CloudWatch 警报，当连接数增加到 1,000 以上时，更改数据库实例类。
options.D: 添加一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则，当 CPU 利用率超过 75% 时，增加数据库实例的 max_connections 设置。

zh.explanation:
# 场景分析

一个关键应用使用 **API Gateway → Lambda → RDS for MySQL**。在不可预测的流量峰值期间，Lambda 扩展并创建许多并发数据库连接，导致 MySQL 的 `max_connections` 限制耗尽，产生**"too many connections"**错误，并显示为 HTTP 500 响应。修复必须：

1. 使应用程序对连接突发具有弹性。
2. 避免在计划维护窗口外关闭数据库。

# 正确答案：B — 使用 Amazon RDS Proxy

这是 AWS 推荐的 Lambda + RDS 连接耗尽问题的规范解决方案。

RDS Proxy 充当应用程序和 RDS 数据库之间的中介。RDS Proxy 建立并管理到您的数据库的必要连接池，以便您的应用程序创建较少的数据库连接。

对于 Lambda 特别是，它处理 Lambda 并发函数创建的许多同时连接所需的连接池。这允许您的 Lambda 应用程序重用现有连接，而不是为每个函数调用创建新连接。RDS Proxy 自动扩展，以便您的数据库实例为连接管理需要更少的内存和 CPU 资源。

AWS 明确将此场景指定为 RDS Proxy 的顶级用例：任何遇到"too many connections"错误的 DB 实例都是与代理关联的良好候选。这通常以 ConnectionAttempts CloudWatch 指标的高值为特征。代理使应用程序能够打开许多客户端连接，同时代理管理到 DB 实例的较少数量的长期存在连接。

它还满足无停机要求，因为 RDS Proxy 的基础架构高度可用，部署在多个可用区 (AZ) 上。在现有实例前部署 RDS Proxy 不需要数据库离线。

实现：创建代理以目标 RDS for MySQL 实例，在 Secrets Manager 中存储数据库凭证，附加允许代理读取凭证的 IAM 角色，并更新 Lambda 以连接到**代理端点**而不是数据库端点。

# 为什么其他选项是错误的

### A. 减少 vCPU 并增加 `max_connections`
- 减少 vCPU **降低**数据库的处理能力，使问题恶化而不是改善。
- 在 RDS 上的 MySQL 中，默认 `max_connections` 公式与实例内存相关；手动提高它可能导致内存不足条件，因为每个连接消耗 RAM/CPU。关系数据库的最大并发连接数取决于其大小。这是因为每个连接消耗数据库服务器上的内存和 CPU 资源。
- 单独修改参数组值不能解决 Lambda 的突发连接行为。

### C. CloudWatch 告警，当连接 > 1,000 时更改 DB 实例类
- 修改 DB 实例类**导致 RDS 实例重启**，违反数据库在计划维护窗口外不能停机的要求。
- 被动扩展实例速度缓慢（数分钟），无法吸收来自 Lambda 并发的突然、不可预测的尖峰。
- 它还会产生不必要的成本；根本原因是连接管理，而不是计算能力。

### D. EventBridge 规则，当 CPU > 75% 时增加 `max_connections`
- 错误的触发指标：症状是**连接耗尽**，而不是 CPU 压力。CPU 可能很低，而连接限制已被触及。
- `max_connections` 存在于**数据库参数组**中。更改静态参数通常需要**数据库实例重启**才能生效，这违反了无停机要求。
- 即使应用，提高 `max_connections` 超过 64 GB 实例支持的范围会导致内存耗尽和不稳定。
- 被动参数更改无法跟上次秒级 Lambda 缩放尖峰。

# 参考资源

- [将 Amazon RDS Proxy 与 AWS Lambda 配合使用（AWS Compute 博客）](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/using-amazon-rds-proxy-with-aws-lambda/)
- [规划 RDS Proxy 使用位置](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-planning.html)
- [RDS Proxy 概念和术语](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.howitworks.html)
- [RDS Proxy 连接注意事项](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-connections.html)

en.question: A company has installed smart meters in all its customer locations. The smart meters measure power usage at 1-minute intervals and send the usage readings to a remote endpoint for collection. The company needs to create an endpoint that will receive the smart meter readings and store the readings in a database. The company wants to store the location ID and timestamp information. The company wants to give its customers low-latency access to their current usage and historical usage on demand. The company expects demand to increase significantly. The solution must not impact performance or include downtime while scaling. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Store the smart meter readings in an Amazon RDS database. Create an index on the location ID and timestamp columns. Use the columns to filter on the customers' data.
options.B: Store the smart meter readings in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Create a composite key by using the location ID and timestamp columns. Use the columns to filter on the customers' data.
options.C: Store the smart meter readings in Amazon ElastiCache for Redis. Create a SortedSet key by using the location ID and timestamp columns. Use the columns to filter on the customers' data.
options.D: Store the smart meter readings in Amazon S3. Partition the data by using the location ID and timestamp columns. Use Amazon Athena to filter on the customers' data.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

Smart meters generate readings every minute, sent to a remote endpoint. The solution must:
- Store location ID and timestamp
- Provide low-latency access to current and historical usage
- Scale seamlessly without downtime or performance impact as demand grows
- Be the **most cost-effective**

## Correct Answer: B — DynamoDB with composite key (location ID + timestamp)

DynamoDB is purpose-built for this kind of high-volume, time-series IoT workload. DynamoDB is a popular choice for storing time-series data due to its scalability, high availability, and low latency. It is designed for applications that require consistent, single-digit millisecond response times regardless of the volume of data stored.

A composite primary key matches the access pattern perfectly: A common approach is to use a composite primary key consisting of a partition key and a sort key. The partition key could be the device ID or sensor ID, and the sort key could be a timestamp indicating when the data was collected. This design allows for efficient querying of sensor data by device ID over a specific time range.

In this question, **location ID** serves as the partition key and **timestamp** as the sort key, enabling efficient `Query` operations like "get all readings for location X between time T1 and T2" — exactly what the customer-facing dashboard needs for current and historical usage.

DynamoDB also satisfies the no-downtime scaling requirement: with **on-demand capacity mode**, the table automatically scales reads/writes to match traffic spikes without provisioning or downtime — making it cost-effective because you pay only for what you use.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. Amazon RDS** — A relational database does not seamlessly scale horizontally. Vertical scaling (instance class change) typically incurs downtime, and storage/IOPS scaling can degrade performance. Traditional relational databases struggle with the write-heavy, high-cardinality nature of time-series workloads. RDS would also be more expensive at high write volumes from millions of meters reporting every minute.

- **C. ElastiCache for Redis** — Redis is an in-memory store, which is expensive per GB compared to DynamoDB and not designed as a system of record for years of historical data. Although Redis SortedSets support range queries, persisting massive historical data in RAM is cost-prohibitive, and cluster scaling can require resharding. It would not be the **most cost-effective** durable store.

- **D. S3 + Athena** — S3 is cheap for storage, but Athena is a query-on-read analytics service charged per TB scanned. Per-customer interactive queries for "current usage" would have **high latency** (seconds to minutes) and growing per-query cost as data scales. This violates the low-latency on-demand access requirement.

## References

- [Best practices for handling time series data in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-time-series.html)
- [Best practices for using sort keys to organize data](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-sort-keys.html)
- [Create a composite key for your DynamoDB table](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/dynamodb-create-composite-key)
- [DynamoDB on-demand capacity mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/HowItWorks.ReadWriteCapacityMode.html)

zh.question: 一家公司已在其所有客户场所安装了智能电表。这些智能电表每分钟测量一次用电量，并将读数发送到远程终端进行收集。该公司需要创建一个终端来接收智能电表读数并将其存储在数据库中。该公司希望存储位置 ID 和时间戳信息。该公司希望为客户提供按需访问当前和历史用电量的低延迟服务。该公司预计需求将显著增长。该解决方案在扩展过程中不得影响性能或造成停机。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 将智能电表读数存储在 Amazon RDS 数据库中。在位置 ID 和时间戳列上创建索引。使用这些列来筛选客户数据。
options.B: 将智能电表读数存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。使用位置 ID 和时间戳列创建复合键。使用这些列来筛选客户数据。
options.C: 将智能电表读数存储在 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 中。使用位置 ID 和时间戳列创建一个 SortedSet 键。使用这些列对客户数据进行筛选。
options.D: 将智能电表读数存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用位置 ID 和时间戳列对数据进行分区。使用 Amazon Athena 对客户数据进行筛选。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

智能电表每分钟生成一次读数，发送到远程端点。该解决方案必须：
- 存储位置 ID 和时间戳
- 提供低延迟的当前和历史用量访问
- 随着需求增长无缝扩展，无需停机或性能影响
- 具有**最具成本效益**的特点

## 正确答案：B — DynamoDB 带复合键（位置 ID + 时间戳）

DynamoDB 是为这类高容量时间序列 IoT 工作负载量身定制的。DynamoDB 因其可扩展性、高可用性和低延迟而成为存储时间序列数据的流行选择。它为需要一致的个位数毫秒级响应时间的应用程序而设计，无论存储的数据量如何。

复合主键完全匹配访问模式：一种常见的方法是使用由分区键和排序键组成的复合主键。分区键可以是设备 ID 或传感器 ID，排序键可以是指示数据收集时间的时间戳。这种设计允许通过设备 ID 在特定时间范围内高效查询传感器数据。

在此问题中，**位置 ID** 充当分区键，**时间戳**充当排序键，可以实现高效的 `Query` 操作，例如"获取位置 X 在时间 T1 到 T2 之间的所有读数"——这正是客户面向的仪表板所需的当前和历史用量功能。

DynamoDB 还满足无停机扩展要求：使用**按需容量模式**，表会自动扩展读写以匹配流量峰值，无需配置或停机——这具有成本效益，因为您只需为使用的内容付费。

## 其他选项为何错误

- **A. Amazon RDS** — 关系数据库无法无缝水平扩展。垂直扩展（更改实例类）通常需要停机，存储/IOPS 扩展可能会降低性能。传统关系数据库很难应对时间序列工作负载的写入密集、高基数特性。RDS 在数百万个电表每分钟报告的高写入量下成本也会更高。

- **C. ElastiCache for Redis** — Redis 是内存存储，与 DynamoDB 相比每 GB 成本更高，并且不是多年历史数据的记录系统。虽然 Redis SortedSets 支持范围查询，但在 RAM 中持久化海量历史数据成本高昂，集群扩展可能需要重新分片。它不会是**最具成本效益**的持久存储。

- **D. S3 + Athena** — S3 存储成本低廉，但 Athena 是按扫描的 TB 数收费的查询分析服务。针对"当前用量"的每个客户交互式查询会产生**高延迟**（秒到分钟），随着数据扩展，每次查询的成本也会增加。这违反了低延迟按需访问要求。

## 参考资源

- [在 DynamoDB 中处理时间序列数据的最佳实践](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-time-series.html)
- [使用排序键组织数据的最佳实践](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-sort-keys.html)
- [为 DynamoDB 表创建复合键](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/dynamodb-create-composite-key)
- [DynamoDB 按需容量模式](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/HowItWorks.ReadWriteCapacityMode.html)

en.question: A company is building a serverless application that uses AWS Lambda functions. The company needs to create a set of test events to test Lambda functions in a development environment. The test events will be created once and then will be used by all the developers in an IAM developer group. The test events must be editable by any of the IAM users in the IAM developer group. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create and store the test events in Amazon S3 as JSON objects. Allow S3 bucket access to all IAM users.
options.B: Create the test events. Configure the event sharing settings to make the test events shareable.
options.C: Create and store the test events in Amazon DynamoDB. Allow access to DynamoDB by using IAM roles.
options.D: Create the test events. Configure the event sharing settings to make the test events private.

en.explanation:
# Lambda Shareable Test Events

## Scenario
A team of developers in an IAM developer group needs to create a set of Lambda test events **once** and then have all developers in the group be able to **use and edit** them. The question asks for the simplest, native AWS solution.

## Correct Answer: B — Create the test events and configure the event sharing settings to make them shareable

Since March 2022, AWS Lambda natively supports **shareable test events** in the console. Developers can now share test events with other developers in their AWS account. Test events provide developers the ability to define a sample event in the Lambda console, and then invoke a Lambda function using that event to test their code. Previously, test events were only available to the developers who created them. With this launch, developers can make test events available to other team members in their AWS account using granular IAM permissions.

Crucially for this scenario, shareable test events are test events that you can share with other users in the same AWS account. You can edit other users' shareable test events and invoke your function with them. This directly satisfies the "must be editable by any IAM user in the developer group" requirement.

Behind the scenes, Lambda saves shareable test events as schemas in an Amazon EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) schema registry named lambda-testevent-schemas, and access is governed by IAM permissions on the EventBridge Schemas API operations — so the developer group can be granted exactly the right permissions.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. Store test events in S3 as JSON objects** — This works mechanically but reinvents functionality that Lambda already provides natively. It introduces extra infrastructure (a bucket, bucket policy, retrieval code, lifecycle management) and the events would not be invokable directly from the Lambda console's Test tab. The question asks specifically about Lambda test events, for which a built-in, purpose-designed feature exists.

- **C. Store events in DynamoDB with IAM roles** — Same problem as A, plus more complexity (table design, item schema, SDK calls). Test events stored in DynamoDB cannot be invoked from the Lambda console's Test tab. IAM roles are also typically assumed by services/EC2/Lambda, not directly by individual IAM users in a developer group, making this awkward for human developer access.

- **D. Configure event sharing settings to make events private** — This is the *opposite* of what is needed. Private test events are visible only to the IAM user who created them, so other developers in the group could neither view nor edit them.

## References
- [AWS Lambda console now supports the option to share test events between developers](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2022/03/aws-lambda-console-test-events/)
- [Testing Lambda functions in the console — Shareable test events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/testing-functions.html)

zh.question: 一家公司正在构建一个使用 AWS Lambda 函数的无服务器应用程序。该公司需要创建一组测试事件，以便在开发环境中测试 Lambda 函数。这些测试事件只需创建一次，即可供 IAM 开发人员组中的所有开发人员使用。IAM 开发人员组中的任何 IAM 用户都必须能够编辑这些测试事件。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 将测试事件以 JSON 对象的形式创建并存储在 Amazon S3 中。允许所有 IAM 用户访问 S3 存储桶。
options.B: 创建测试事件。配置事件共享设置，使测试事件可共享。
options.C: 在 Amazon DynamoDB 中创建和存储测试事件。使用 IAM 角色允许访问 DynamoDB。
options.D: 创建测试事件。配置事件共享设置，使测试事件私有。

zh.explanation:
# Lambda 可共享测试事件

## 场景
一个 IAM 开发者组中的开发团队需要创建一组 Lambda 测试事件**一次**，然后所有组内的开发者都能**使用和编辑**这些事件。问题要求最简单的原生 AWS 解决方案。

## 正确答案：B — 创建测试事件并配置事件共享设置以使其可共享

自 2022 年 3 月起，AWS Lambda 在控制台中原生支持**可共享测试事件**。开发者现在可以与同一 AWS 账户中的其他开发者共享测试事件。测试事件使开发者能够在 Lambda 控制台中定义示例事件，然后使用该事件调用 Lambda 函数来测试其代码。以前，测试事件仅对创建它们的开发者可用。通过此次发布，开发者可以使用粒度 IAM 权限与账户中的其他团队成员共享测试事件。

对于此场景至关重要的是，可共享测试事件是可以与同一 AWS 账户中的其他用户共享的测试事件。您可以编辑其他用户的可共享测试事件并使用它们调用函数。这直接满足了"必须可由开发者组中任何 IAM 用户编辑"的要求。

在后台，Lambda 将可共享测试事件保存为 Amazon EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) 架构注册表中的架构，名为 lambda-testevent-schemas，访问由 EventBridge Schemas API 操作的 IAM 权限控制——因此可以向开发者组授予恰好合适的权限。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. 将测试事件作为 JSON 对象存储在 S3 中** — 这在机制上有效，但重新发明了 Lambda 已提供的原生功能。它引入了额外的基础设施（存储桶、桶策略、检索代码、生命周期管理），并且这些事件无法直接从 Lambda 控制台的"测试"选项卡调用。问题专门询问 Lambda 测试事件，为此存在内置的专用功能。

- **C. 将事件存储在 DynamoDB 中并使用 IAM 角色** — 与 A 相同的问题，加上更高的复杂性（表设计、项目架构、SDK 调用）。存储在 DynamoDB 中的测试事件无法从 Lambda 控制台的"测试"选项卡调用。IAM 角色也通常由服务/EC2/Lambda 承担，而不是由开发者组中的单个 IAM 用户直接承担，这使得人类开发者的访问很困难。

- **D. 配置事件共享设置以使事件为私有** — 这与需要的**相反**。私有测试事件仅对创建它们的 IAM 用户可见，因此组中的其他开发者既无法查看也无法编辑它们。

## 参考资源
- [AWS Lambda 控制台现在支持在开发者之间共享测试事件](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2022/03/aws-lambda-console-test-events/)
- [在控制台中测试 Lambda 函数 — 可共享测试事件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/testing-functions.html)

en.question: A developer is configuring an application's deployment environment in AWS CodePipeline. The application code is stored in a GitHub repository. The developer wants to ensure that the repository package's unit tests run in the new deployment environment. The developer has already set the pipeline's source provider to GitHub and has specified the repository and branch to use in the deployment. Which combination of steps should the developer take next to meet these requirements with the LEAST overhead? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an AWS CodeCommit project. Add the repository package's build and test commands to the project's buildspec.
options.B: Create an AWS CodeBuild project. Add the repository package's build and test commands to the project's buildspec.
options.C: Create an AWS CodeDeploy project. Add the repository package's build and test commands to the project's buildspec.
options.D: Add an action to the source stage. Specify the newly created project as the action provider. Specify the build artifact as the action's input artifact.
options.E: Add a new stage to the pipeline after the source stage. Add an action to the new stage. Specify the newly created project as the action provider. Specify the source artifact as the action's input artifact.

en.explanation:
# CodePipeline: Adding Unit Tests for a GitHub-Sourced Application

## Scenario
The pipeline already has a Source stage configured against a GitHub repository and branch. The developer now needs to execute the repository's unit tests as part of the pipeline with the **least operational overhead**.

## Correct Answers: B and E

### Why B is correct
AWS CodeBuild is the managed build/test service in the AWS developer tools suite. CodeBuild allows you to run builds and tests as part of your pipeline. When you run a CodeBuild build or test action, commands specified in the buildspec are run inside of a CodeBuild container. All artifacts that are specified as input artifacts to a CodeBuild action are available inside of the container.

A `buildspec.yml` file lets you declare the unit-test commands declaratively, e.g.:

```yaml
version: 0.2
phases:
  install:
    runtime-versions:
      nodejs: 18
  pre_build:
    commands:
      - npm install
  build:
    commands:
      - npm test
```

### Why E is correct
The unit tests must run **after** the source has been fetched, and the test action needs the GitHub source artifact as its input. The AWS documentation explicitly walks through adding a CodeBuild test stage immediately after the Source stage: Immediately after the Source stage, choose Add stage. The new stage contains an action whose provider is the CodeBuild project (B) and whose input artifact is the source artifact produced by the Source stage. If your pipeline tests your app directly from the Source stage, choose SourceArtifact.

A CodePipeline stage requires at least one action; you cannot simply "drop" a test action into the pipeline without placing it in a stage. Adding a dedicated stage after Source is the documented, low-overhead approach.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. CodeCommit project** – CodeCommit is a Git source-code hosting service (now in maintenance for new customers); it does **not** execute build or test commands and has no concept of a buildspec. The source is already on GitHub, so CodeCommit is irrelevant.
- **C. CodeDeploy project** – CodePipeline supports deployment targets such as AWS Lambda, Amazon EC2 (via CodeDeploy), Elastic Beanstalk, ECS, and CloudFormation stacks. CodeDeploy deploys application revisions to compute targets; it does not execute unit tests and uses an `appspec.yml`, not a buildspec.
- **D. Add the action to the existing Source stage with the build artifact as input** – Two problems: (1) a Source stage in CodePipeline can only contain source actions (the source action category cannot be mixed with build/test actions in the same stage in the typical Source stage), and (2) the input would be the **source artifact**, not a "build artifact" (no build has run yet). The AWS docs show that the test action must be in a new stage placed after Source, taking the source artifact as input.

## References
- [Add a CodeBuild test action to a pipeline](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/how-to-create-pipeline-add-test.html)
- [AWS CodeBuild build and test action reference (CodePipeline)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeBuild.html)
- [Use CodeBuild with CodePipeline to test code and run builds](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/how-to-create-pipeline.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在 AWS CodePipeline 中配置应用程序的部署环境。应用程序代码存储在 GitHub 代码库中。开发人员希望确保代码库中的单元测试能够在新的部署环境中运行。开发人员已将管道的源提供程序设置为 GitHub，并指定了部署中使用的代码库和分支。为了以最小的开销满足这些要求，开发人员接下来应该采取哪些步骤组合？（选择两项。）

options.A: 创建一个 AWS CodeCommit 项目。将存储库包的构建和测试命令添加到项目的构建规范中。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS CodeBuild 项目。将存储库包的构建和测试命令添加到项目的构建规范中。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS CodeDeploy 项目。将存储库包的构建和测试命令添加到项目的构建规范中。
options.D: 向源阶段添加一个操作。将新建的项目指定为操作提供程序。将构建工件指定为操作的输入工件。
options.E: 在源阶段之后向管道添加一个新阶段。向新阶段添加一个操作。将新创建的项目指定为操作提供程序。将源工件指定为操作的输入工件。

zh.explanation:
# CodePipeline：为 GitHub 源应用程序添加单元测试

## 场景
该管道已针对 GitHub 存储库和分支配置了 Source 阶段。开发人员现在需要在管道中执行存储库的单元测试，并且**操作开销最少**。

## 正确答案：B 和 E

### 为什么 B 是正确的
AWS CodeBuild 是 AWS 开发者工具套件中的托管构建/测试服务。CodeBuild 允许您运行构建和测试作为管道的一部分。当您运行 CodeBuild 构建或测试操作时，buildspec 中指定的命令会在 CodeBuild 容器内运行。指定为 CodeBuild 操作的输入工件的所有工件都可在容器内使用。

`buildspec.yml` 文件允许您声明式地声明单元测试命令，例如：

```yaml
version: 0.2
phases:
  install:
    runtime-versions:
      nodejs: 18
  pre_build:
    commands:
      - npm install
  build:
    commands:
      - npm test
```

### 为什么 E 是正确的
单元测试必须在源代码被获取后运行，并且测试操作需要 GitHub 源工件作为其输入。AWS 文档明确介绍了如何在 Source 阶段之后立即添加 CodeBuild 测试阶段：在 Source 阶段之后，选择 Add stage。新阶段包含一个操作，其提供者是 CodeBuild 项目 (B)，其输入工件是 Source 阶段生成的源工件。如果您的管道直接从 Source 阶段测试您的应用程序，请选择 SourceArtifact。

CodePipeline 阶段至少需要一个操作；您不能简单地将测试操作"放入"管道而不将其放在阶段中。在 Source 之后添加专用阶段是有文档记录的、低开销的方法。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. CodeCommit 项目** – CodeCommit 是一个 Git 源代码托管服务（现已进入维护状态，不接受新客户）；它**不会**执行构建或测试命令，并且没有 buildspec 的概念。源已经在 GitHub 上，所以 CodeCommit 无关。
- **C. CodeDeploy 项目** – CodePipeline 支持部署目标，例如 AWS Lambda、Amazon EC2（通过 CodeDeploy）、Elastic Beanstalk、ECS 和 CloudFormation 堆栈。CodeDeploy 将应用程序修订版本部署到计算目标；它不执行单元测试，并使用 `appspec.yml` 而非 buildspec。
- **D. 将操作添加到现有 Source 阶段，以构建工件作为输入** – 有两个问题：(1) CodePipeline 中的 Source 阶段只能包含源操作（源操作类别不能在同一阶段中与构建/测试操作混合，特别是在典型的 Source 阶段中），以及 (2) 输入将是**源工件**，而不是"构建工件"（还没有运行过构建）。AWS 文档显示测试操作必须位于 Source 之后放置的新阶段中，将源工件作为输入。

## 参考资源
- [将 CodeBuild 测试操作添加到管道](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/how-to-create-pipeline-add-test.html)
- [AWS CodeBuild 构建和测试操作参考 (CodePipeline)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeBuild.html)
- [使用 CodeBuild 与 CodePipeline 来测试代码和运行构建](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/how-to-create-pipeline.html)

en.question: An engineer created an A/B test of a new feature on an Amazon CloudWatch Evidently project. The engineer configured two variations of the feature (Variation A and Variation B) for the test. The engineer wants to work exclusively with Variation A. The engineer needs to make updates so that Variation A is the only variation that appears when the engineer hits the application's endpoint. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Add an override to the feature. Set the identifier of the override to the engineer's user ID. Set the variation to Variation A.
options.B: Add an override to the feature. Set the identifier of the override to Variation A. Set the variation to 100%.
options.C: Add an experiment to the project. Set the identifier of the experiment to Variation B. Set the variation to 0%.
options.D: Add an experiment to the project. Set the identifier of the experiment to the AWS account's account ISet the variation to Variation A.

en.explanation:
# CloudWatch Evidently — Forcing a Specific Variation for One User

## Scenario
The engineer set up an A/B test with two variations (A and B) in a CloudWatch Evidently feature, but wants to ensure that **their own** requests against the application endpoint always return Variation A. The other test traffic should not be affected.

## Correct Answer: A
Add an **override** to the feature, set the override **identifier** to the engineer's **user ID**, and set the **variation** to Variation A.

CloudWatch Evidently overrides are designed exactly for this purpose. You specify users that should always be served a specific variation of a feature. Each user is specified by a key-value pair. For each key, specify a user by entering their user ID, account ID, or some other identifier. For the value, specify the name of the variation that they are to be served.

When `EvaluateFeature` runs, the first rules that are evaluated are the override rules. If the user's entityID matches an override, that user is served the specified variation — bypassing launch and experiment traffic allocation. The AWS launch blog confirms this pattern: overrides let you pre-define the variation for selected users, e.g. so that a beta tester always receives the editable variation.

So setting an override with `key = engineer's user ID` and `value = Variation A` causes Evidently to always serve Variation A to that engineer's session, while leaving the A/B experiment intact for everyone else.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **B. Override with identifier = "Variation A" and variation = 100%.** The override identifier must be a **user/entity ID** (matched against the `entityId` passed to `EvaluateFeature`), not a variation name. The override value must be a **variation name**, not a percentage. This configuration is structurally invalid.

- **C. Add an experiment with identifier = Variation B and variation = 0%.** "Experiment" is not the right construct, and an experiment doesn't take a "Variation B" identifier. Setting variation allocation to 0% on an experiment doesn't guarantee the engineer always sees Variation A — it would just exclude users from that experiment branch and fall back to default/other rules. Experiments allocate audience by percentages, not by individual user identity.

- **D. Add an experiment with identifier = AWS account ID, variation = Variation A.** Experiments are not configured by AWS account ID, and they target audience percentages rather than a single individual. The construct designed to force a specific variation for a specific identity is an **override** on the feature, not an experiment.

## Key takeaway
To force one specific user to always see one specific variation in CloudWatch Evidently, use **feature-level Overrides** keyed by that user's `entityId`. Overrides are evaluated **before** launches and experiments and bypass the percentage-based traffic allocation.

## References
- CreateFeature API – entityOverrides
- EvaluateFeature API – evaluation order
- [Add a feature to a project](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch-Evidently-newfeature.html)
- [AWS News Blog – CloudWatch Evidently launch](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/cloudwatch-evidently/)

zh.question: 一位工程师在 Amazon CloudWatch Evidently 项目中创建了一个新功能的 A/B 测试。他为测试配置了该功能的两个版本（版本 A 和版本 B）。现在，他只想测试版本 A。因此，他需要进行一些修改，以确保当他访问应用程序的端点时，只显示版本 A。请问哪种解决方案能够满足此要求？

options.A: 为该功能添加一个替代项。将替代项的标识符设置为工程师的用户 ID。将变体设置为变体 A。
options.B: 为该特征添加一个替代项。将替代项的标识符设置为变体 A。将变体设置为 100%。
options.C: 向项目中添加一个实验。将实验的标识符设置为“变体 B”。将变体设置为 0%。
options.D: 向项目中添加一个实验。将实验的标识符设置为 AWS 账户的账户 I。将变体设置为变体 A。

zh.explanation:
# CloudWatch Evidently — 为单个用户强制指定特定变体

## 场景
工程师在 CloudWatch Evidently 功能中设置了一个包含两个变体（A 和 B）的 A/B 测试，但希望确保**自己**对应用端点的请求始终返回变体 A。其他测试流量不应受到影响。

## 正确答案：A
为该功能添加一个**覆盖规则**，将覆盖规则的**标识符**设置为工程师的**用户 ID**，并将**变体**设置为变体 A。

CloudWatch Evidently 覆盖规则的设计目的正是为此。你指定应始终获得特定功能变体的用户。每个用户由一个键值对指定。对于每个键，通过输入其用户 ID、账户 ID 或其他标识符来指定用户。对于值，指定要提供给他们的变体名称。

当 `EvaluateFeature` 运行时，首先评估的规则是覆盖规则。如果用户的 entityID 匹配某个覆盖规则，该用户将获得指定的变体 — 绕过启动和实验流量分配。AWS 启动博客确认了这一模式：覆盖规则允许你为选定用户预定义变体，例如确保 Beta 测试人员始终获得可编辑的变体。

因此，使用 `key = 工程师的用户 ID` 和 `value = 变体 A` 设置覆盖规则会导致 Evidently 始终向该工程师的会话提供变体 A，同时为所有其他人保持 A/B 实验的完整性。

## 其他选项为什么是错的

- **B. 覆盖规则，标识符 = "Variation A"，变体 = 100%。** 覆盖规则的标识符必须是**用户/实体 ID**（与传递给 `EvaluateFeature` 的 `entityId` 匹配），而不是变体名称。覆盖规则的值必须是**变体名称**，而不是百分比。此配置在结构上无效。

- **C. 添加标识符 = Variation B、变体 = 0% 的实验。** "Experiment"不是正确的构造，实验不采用"Variation B"标识符。将实验的变体分配设置为 0% 不保证工程师始终看到变体 A — 它只会将用户排除在该实验分支之外并回退到默认/其他规则。实验按百分比分配受众，而不是按单个用户身份分配。

- **D. 添加标识符 = AWS 账户 ID、变体 = Variation A 的实验。** 实验不按 AWS 账户 ID 配置，它们针对的是按百分比的受众，而不是单个个体。为特定身份强制指定特定变体的构造是功能级别的**覆盖规则**，而不是实验。

## 关键要点
要在 CloudWatch Evidently 中强制让一个特定用户始终看到一个特定变体，请使用以该用户 `entityId` 为键的**功能级覆盖规则**。覆盖规则在启动和实验**之前**进行评估，并绕过基于百分比的流量分配。

## 参考资源
- CreateFeature API – entityOverrides
- EvaluateFeature API – 评估顺序
- [向项目添加功能](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch-Evidently-newfeature.html)
- [AWS 新闻博客 – CloudWatch Evidently 启动](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/cloudwatch-evidently/)

en.question: A developer is working on an existing application that uses Amazon DynamoDB as its data store. The DynamoDB table has the following attributes: partNumber (partition key), vendor (sort key), description, productFamily, and productType. When the developer analyzes the usage patterns, the developer notices that there are application modules that frequently look for a list of products based on the productFamily and productType attributes. The developer wants to make changes to the application to improve performance of the query operations. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a global secondary index (GSI) with productFamily as the partition key and productType as the sort key.
options.B: Create a local secondary index (LSI) with productFamily as the partition key and productType as the sort key.
options.C: Recreate the table. Add partNumber as the partition key and vendor as the sort key. During table creation, add a local secondary index (LSI) with productFamily as the partition key and productType as the sort key.
options.D: Update the queries to use Scan operations with productFamily as the partition key and productType as the sort key.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The DynamoDB table uses `partNumber` (PK) and `vendor` (SK). The application frequently queries by `productFamily` and `productType` — neither of which are part of the base table's primary key. The developer needs efficient query operations on these alternate attributes without disrupting the existing table.

## Correct Answer: A — Create a GSI with `productFamily` (PK) and `productType` (SK)

A Global Secondary Index allows querying using a completely different key schema than the base table. The index key schema can be different from the base table schema. You could have a table with a simple primary key (partition key), and create a global secondary index with a composite primary key (partition key and sort key)—or vice versa.

Critically, GSIs can be added to an **existing** table without recreating it: Unlike LSI, you can add a GSI to an existing DynamoDB table. Amazon DynamoDB backfills the index from pre-existing data; it can be inserted after the table is created.

This makes A the only option that satisfies the requirement (improve query performance on `productFamily`/`productType`) without rebuilding the table.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**B. Create an LSI with `productFamily` as the partition key.** This is invalid for two reasons:
1. The LSI's partition key is required to be the same as the base table, and the sort key attribute must be different from that of the table. An LSI cannot have `productFamily` as its partition key — it must reuse `partNumber`.
2. Because LSIs require a composite primary key, they must be declared when the table is created; they cannot be added later.

**C. Recreate the table with the same keys and add an LSI on `productFamily`/`productType`.** Same partition-key constraint issue as B — A local secondary index has the same partition key as the base table but a different sort key. Since the new table still has `partNumber` as the PK, an LSI cannot use `productFamily` as its partition key. Additionally, recreating a table and migrating data is unnecessary effort when a GSI on the existing table satisfies the requirement.

**D. Use Scan operations.** Scan reads every item in the table and is the **opposite** of an optimization. The goal is to *improve* query performance, not degrade it. Scans do not even use partition/sort keys — they have no concept of "Scan with productFamily as the partition key."

## References

- [Using Global Secondary Indexes in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GSI.html)
- [General guidelines for secondary indexes in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-indexes-general.html)
- [Difference between GSI and LSI (AWS re:Post)](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/dynamodb-gsi-lsi-difference)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在开发一个使用 Amazon DynamoDB 作为数据存储的现有应用程序。DynamoDB 表包含以下属性：partNumber（分区键）、vendor（排序键）、description、productFamily 和 productType。开发人员在分析使用模式时发现，某些应用程序模块会频繁地根据 productFamily 和 productType 属性查找产品列表。开发人员希望修改应用程序以提高查询操作的性能。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个全局二级索引 (GSI)，以 productFamily 作为分区键，productType 作为排序键。
options.B: 创建一个本地二级索引 (LSI)，以 productFamily 作为分区键，productType 作为排序键。
options.C: 重新创建表。添加 partNumber 作为分区键，vendor 作为排序键。在创建表时，添加一个本地二级索引 (LSI)，以 productFamily 作为分区键，productType 作为排序键。
options.D: 更新查询，使用以 productFamily 为分区键、productType 为排序键的 Scan 操作。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

DynamoDB 表使用 `partNumber`（PK）和 `vendor`（SK）。应用程序频繁按 `productFamily` 和 `productType` 进行查询——这两个属性都不是基础表主键的一部分。开发人员需要在这些备用属性上进行高效的查询操作，而不会中断现有表。

## 正确答案：A — 创建一个 GSI，其中 `productFamily`（PK）和 `productType`（SK）

Global Secondary Index 允许使用完全不同于基础表的键架构进行查询。索引键架构可以与基础表架构不同。您可以拥有一个具有简单主键（分区键）的表，并创建具有复合主键（分区键和排序键）的全局二级索引——或相反。

关键是，GSI 可以添加到**现有**表中，而无需重新创建它：与 LSI 不同，您可以将 GSI 添加到现有的 DynamoDB 表。 Amazon DynamoDB 从预先存在的数据中对索引进行回填；它可以在创建表后插入。

这使得 A 是唯一满足要求（改进 `productFamily`/`productType` 的查询性能）且无需重建表的选项。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**B. 创建一个 LSI，其中 `productFamily` 作为分区键。** 这有两个原因是无效的：
1. LSI 的分区键必须与基础表相同，排序键属性必须与表的不同。 LSI 不能将 `productFamily` 作为其分区键——它必须重新使用 `partNumber`。
2. 由于 LSI 需要复合主键，它们必须在创建表时声明；之后无法添加。

**C. 使用相同的键重新创建表并在 `productFamily`/`productType` 上添加 LSI。** 与 B 相同的分区键约束问题——本地二级索引与基础表具有相同的分区键，但具有不同的排序键。 由于新表仍然将 `partNumber` 作为 PK，LSI 不能使用 `productFamily` 作为其分区键。此外，重新创建表和迁移数据是不必要的努力，因为现有表上的 GSI 满足要求。

**D. 使用 Scan 操作。** Scan 读取表中的每个项，与优化相反。目标是**改进**查询性能，而不是降低它。Scan 甚至不使用分区/排序键——它们没有"以 productFamily 作为分区键进行 Scan"的概念。

## 参考资源

- [Using Global Secondary Indexes in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GSI.html)
- [General guidelines for secondary indexes in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-indexes-general.html)
- [Difference between GSI and LSI (AWS re:Post)](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/dynamodb-gsi-lsi-difference)

en.question: A developer creates a VPC named VPC-A that has public and private subnets. The developer also creates an Amazon RDS database inside the private subnet of VPC-A. To perform some queries, the developer creates an AWS Lambda function in the default VPC. The Lambda function has code to access the RDS database. When the Lambda function runs, an error message indicates that the function cannot connect to the RDS database. How can the developer solve this problem?

options.A: Modify the RDS security group. Add a rule to allow traffic from all the ports from the VPC CIDR block.
options.B: Redeploy the Lambda function in the same subnet as the RDS instance. Ensure that the RDS security group allows traffic from the Lambda function.
options.C: Create a security group for the Lambda function. Add a new rule in the RDS security group to allow traffic from the new Lambda security group.
options.D: Create an IAM role. Attach a policy that allows access to the RDS database. Attach the role to the Lambda function.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer has an RDS database in a private subnet of **VPC-A**, and a Lambda function deployed in the **default VPC**. The Lambda cannot connect to the RDS instance. The question asks how to fix the connectivity problem.

## Why this fails

The Lambda function is in a *different VPC* than the RDS instance. By default, two VPCs cannot communicate with each other unless connected via VPC peering, Transit Gateway, or PrivateLink. Per AWS documentation, a Lambda function that's outside of a VPC can't access an RDS instance that's inside a VPC, and the Lambda function must exist in the same VPC as the DB instance in order for the simplified RDS-Lambda connection setup to work. Additionally, to access an RDS database in your Lambda function you have to run your function in the same VPC or in a VPC that has a peering connection to the VPC of your RDS instance.

## Correct Answer: B

**Redeploy the Lambda function in the same subnet as the RDS instance (VPC-A) and ensure that the RDS security group allows traffic from the Lambda function.** This places both resources in the same VPC, where the local route table allows them to communicate, and configuring the RDS security group to allow inbound traffic from the Lambda's security group enables connectivity.

This matches the AWS-recommended pattern: on the RDS side, you need an inbound rule allowing traffic from the Lambda security group on port 5432 (or 3306 for MySQL).

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. Add a rule to allow traffic from all the ports from the VPC CIDR block.** The Lambda is in a *different* VPC (the default VPC), so allowing the VPC-A CIDR (or even default VPC CIDR) does not solve the cross-VPC routing problem — there is no route between the two VPCs. It also violates least-privilege (opening all ports).

- **C. Create a security group for the Lambda function and add a rule on the RDS SG to allow that SG.** Security group references only work *within the same VPC* (or across peered VPCs with specific configuration). Since the Lambda is in the default VPC and RDS is in VPC-A, you cannot reference a security group from another VPC, and there is no peering. Even if SGs allowed it, packets still have nowhere to route. This option would only be valid if both were already in the same VPC.

- **D. Attach an IAM role allowing access to the RDS database.** The connectivity error is a *network/VPC* problem, not an authorization one. IAM roles do not establish network reachability between a Lambda and an RDS instance. (IAM database authentication is a separate, optional feature and still requires network connectivity first.)

## References

- [Configure a Lambda function to connect to an RDS instance (AWS re:Post)](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/connect-lambda-to-an-rds-instance)
- [Automatically connecting a Lambda function and a DB instance (RDS User Guide)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/lambda-rds-connect.html)
- [Tutorial: Using a Lambda function to access an Amazon RDS database](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-rds-tutorial.html)

zh.question: 开发人员创建了一个名为 VPC-A 的虚拟私有云 (VPC)，其中包含公有子网和私有子网。开发人员还在 VPC-A 的私有子网内创建了一个 Amazon RDS 数据库。为了执行一些查询，开发人员在默认 VPC 中创建了一个 AWS Lambda 函数。该 Lambda 函数包含访问 RDS 数据库的代码。Lambda 函数运行时，出现错误消息，提示该函数无法连接到 RDS 数据库。开发人员该如何解决这个问题？

options.A: 修改 RDS 安全组。添加一条规则，允许来自 VPC CIDR 块中所有端口的流量。
options.B: 将 Lambda 函数重新部署到与 RDS 实例相同的子网中。确保 RDS 安全组允许来自 Lambda 函数的流量。
options.C: 为 Lambda 函数创建一个安全组。在 RDS 安全组中添加一条新规则，允许来自新 Lambda 安全组的流量。
options.D: 创建 IAM 角色。附加允许访问 RDS 数据库的策略。将该角色附加到 Lambda 函数。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一个开发者在 **VPC-A** 的私有子网中有一个 RDS 数据库，并在**默认 VPC** 中部署了一个 Lambda 函数。Lambda 无法连接到 RDS 实例。问题要求如何解决连接问题。

## 为什么会失败

Lambda 函数与 RDS 实例位于*不同的 VPC* 中。默认情况下，除非通过 VPC 对等互连、Transit Gateway 或 PrivateLink 连接，否则两个 VPC 无法相互通信。根据 AWS 文档，位于 VPC 外的 Lambda 函数无法访问位于 VPC 内的 RDS 实例，并且Lambda 函数必须与数据库实例位于同一 VPC 中，才能使用简化的 RDS-Lambda 连接设置。此外，要在 Lambda 函数中访问 RDS 数据库，必须在与 RDS 实例相同的 VPC 中或在与 RDS 实例的 VPC 具有对等互连的 VPC 中运行该函数。

## 正确答案：B

**在与 RDS 实例相同的子网（VPC-A）中重新部署 Lambda 函数，并确保 RDS 安全组允许来自 Lambda 函数的流量。** 这将两个资源放在同一 VPC 中，其中本地路由表允许它们通信，并配置 RDS 安全组以允许来自 Lambda 安全组的入站流量可以实现连接。

这与 AWS 推荐的模式相符：在 RDS 端，需要一条入站规则，允许来自 Lambda 安全组的流量通过端口 5432（或 MySQL 的 3306）。

## 为什么其他选项是错的

- **A. 添加规则以允许来自 VPC CIDR 块的所有端口的流量。** Lambda 在*不同的* VPC（默认 VPC）中，所以允许 VPC-A CIDR（甚至默认 VPC CIDR）无法解决跨 VPC 路由问题——两个 VPC 之间没有路由。它也违反了最小权限原则（开放所有端口）。

- **C. 为 Lambda 函数创建安全组，并在 RDS SG 上添加规则以允许该 SG。** 安全组引用仅在*同一 VPC 内*（或跨对等互连的 VPC，需要特定配置）有效。由于 Lambda 在默认 VPC 中，RDS 在 VPC-A 中，你无法引用另一个 VPC 中的安全组，并且没有对等互连。即使安全组允许，数据包仍然无处可路由。仅当两者已在同一 VPC 中时，此选项才有效。

- **D. 附加允许访问 RDS 数据库的 IAM 角色。** 连接性错误是*网络/VPC* 问题，而不是授权问题。IAM 角色无法在 Lambda 和 RDS 实例之间建立网络可达性。（IAM 数据库身份验证是一项独立的可选功能，仍需要首先建立网络连接。）

## 参考资源

- [Configure a Lambda function to connect to an RDS instance (AWS re:Post)](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/connect-lambda-to-an-rds-instance)
- [Automatically connecting a Lambda function and a DB instance (RDS User Guide)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/lambda-rds-connect.html)
- [Tutorial: Using a Lambda function to access an Amazon RDS database](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-rds-tutorial.html)

en.question: A company runs an application on AWS. The company deployed the application on Amazon EC2 instances. The application stores data on Amazon Aurora. The application recently logged multiple application-specific custom DECRYP_ERROR errors to Amazon CloudWatch logs. The company did not detect the issue until the automated tests that run every 30 minutes failed. A developer must implement a solution that will monitor for the custom errors and alert a development team in real time when these errors occur in the production environment. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure the application to create a custom metric and to push the metric to CloudWatch. Create an AWS CloudTrail alarm. Configure the CloudTrail alarm to use an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to send notifications.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function to run every 5 minutes to scan the CloudWatch logs for the keyword DECRYP_ERROR. Configure the Lambda function to use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to send a notification.
options.C: Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs to create a metric filter that has a filter pattern for DECRYP_ERROR. Create a CloudWatch alarm on this metric for a threshold >=1. Configure the alarm to send Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notifications.
options.D: Install the CloudWatch unified agent on the EC2 instance. Configure the application to generate a metric for the keyword DECRYP_ERROR errors. Configure the agent to send Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notifications.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The application running on EC2 writes custom `DECRYP_ERROR` messages to CloudWatch Logs. The team needs **real-time** alerts when this error appears, with the **least operational overhead**.

## Correct Answer: C

Use a **CloudWatch Logs metric filter** with a filter pattern matching `DECRYP_ERROR`, attach a **CloudWatch alarm** with threshold `>= 1`, and configure the alarm action to publish to an **SNS topic** subscribed by the development team.

This is the canonical AWS-native pattern for log-based alerting. The procedure to create CloudWatch alarms on logs is based on a log group-metric filter. With metric filters, you can look for terms and patterns in log data as the data is sent to CloudWatch. The alarm can then directly notify an SNS topic — for Notification, specify an Amazon SNS topic to notify when your alarm is in the ALARM, OK, or INSUFFICIENT_DATA state.

There is no custom code, no agent to install, and no scheduled scanning job — CloudWatch evaluates the metric continuously as logs arrive, providing near real-time alerting. By leveraging metric filters in Amazon CloudWatch Logs and configuring SNS notifications, users can streamline log analysis, extract valuable insights, and receive real-time alerts about critical events.

Example metric filter pattern: `"DECRYP_ERROR"` with metric value `1`, alarm threshold `>= 1`, alarm action = SNS topic ARN.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. Application-pushed custom metric + "CloudTrail alarm":** Requires modifying application code to call `PutMetricData` (extra dev/operational overhead). Worse, **CloudTrail does not have alarms** — CloudTrail records API activity; there is no such thing as a "CloudTrail alarm" that fires on application errors. Alarms come from CloudWatch, not CloudTrail.

- **B. Lambda scanning CloudWatch Logs every 5 minutes:** Not real-time — it introduces up to a 5-minute detection delay, plus you must build, deploy, monitor and maintain the Lambda function and its IAM role, which is more operational overhead than a built-in metric filter.

- **D. CloudWatch unified agent generates a metric and "sends SNS notifications":** The CloudWatch unified agent collects metrics and logs from EC2/on-prem hosts; it **cannot send SNS notifications directly**. You would still need a CloudWatch alarm to trigger SNS. Installing and managing the agent for this purpose is unnecessary overhead since the logs are already in CloudWatch Logs.

## References

- [Alarming on logs – Amazon CloudWatch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Alarm-On-Logs.html)
- [Create metrics from log events using filters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/MonitoringLogData.html)
- [Create a metric filter for a log group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CreateMetricFilterProcedure.html)

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行一个应用程序。该公司将该应用程序部署在 Amazon EC2 实例上，并将数据存储在 Amazon Aurora 上。该应用程序最近向 Amazon CloudWatch 日志记录了多个特定于应用程序的自定义 DECRYP_ERROR 错误。该公司直到每 30 分钟运行一次的自动化测试失败后才发现此问题。开发人员必须实现一个解决方案，用于监控这些自定义错误，并在生产环境中出现这些错误时实时向开发团队发出警报。哪种解决方案能够以最小的运维开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置应用程序以创建自定义指标并将该指标推送至 CloudWatch。创建 AWS CloudTrail 警报。配置 CloudTrail 警报以使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题发送通知。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，每 5 分钟运行一次，扫描 CloudWatch 日志中关键字 DECRYP_ERROR。配置 Lambda 函数使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 发送通知。
options.C: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 创建一个指标过滤器，该过滤器包含 DECRYP_ERROR 的过滤模式。针对此指标创建一个 CloudWatch 警报，阈值设置为 >=1。配置该警报以发送 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 通知。
options.D: 在 EC2 实例上安装 CloudWatch 统一代理。配置应用程序以生成关键字 DECRYP_ERROR 错误的指标。配置代理以发送 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 通知。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

在 EC2 上运行的应用程序向 CloudWatch Logs 写入自定义 `DECRYP_ERROR` 消息。团队需要在出现此错误时获得**实时**警报，并且**操作开销最小**。

## 正确答案：C

使用**CloudWatch Logs 指标过滤器**配合与 `DECRYP_ERROR` 匹配的过滤模式，关联**CloudWatch 警报**，设置阈值为 `>= 1`，并配置警报操作以发布到由开发团队订阅的 **SNS 主题**。

这是基于日志的警报的规范 AWS 原生模式。在日志上创建 CloudWatch 警报的过程基于日志组的指标过滤器。使用指标过滤器，您可以在日志数据发送到 CloudWatch 时查找日志数据中的术语和模式。然后警报可以直接通知 SNS 主题 — 对于通知，请指定一个 Amazon SNS 主题，以在您的警报处于 ALARM、OK 或 INSUFFICIENT_DATA 状态时进行通知。

没有自定义代码、无需安装代理，也无需计划扫描任务 — CloudWatch 在日志到达时持续评估指标，提供近实时的警报。通过利用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中的指标过滤器并配置 SNS 通知，用户可以简化日志分析、提取有价值的见解，并接收关于关键事件的实时警报。

示例指标过滤器模式：`"DECRYP_ERROR"` 且指标值为 `1`，警报阈值 `>= 1`，警报操作 = SNS 主题 ARN。

## 其他选项为何错误

- **A. 应用程序推送的自定义指标 + "CloudTrail 警报"：** 需要修改应用程序代码以调用 `PutMetricData`（增加开发/运维开销）。更糟的是，**CloudTrail 没有警报功能** — CloudTrail 记录 API 活动；不存在"CloudTrail 警报"这样的东西来触发应用程序错误。警报来自 CloudWatch，而不是 CloudTrail。

- **B. Lambda 每 5 分钟扫描一次 CloudWatch Logs：** 不是实时的 — 它会引入高达 5 分钟的检测延迟，而且您必须构建、部署、监控和维护 Lambda 函数及其 IAM 角色，这比内置指标过滤器的操作开销更多。

- **D. CloudWatch 统一代理生成指标并"发送 SNS 通知"：** CloudWatch 统一代理从 EC2/本地主机收集指标和日志；它**无法直接发送 SNS 通知**。您仍然需要一个 CloudWatch 警报来触发 SNS。为了此目的安装和管理代理是不必要的开销，因为日志已经在 CloudWatch Logs 中。

## 参考资源

- [Alarming on logs – Amazon CloudWatch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Alarm-On-Logs.html)
- [Create metrics from log events using filters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/MonitoringLogData.html)
- [Create a metric filter for a log group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CreateMetricFilterProcedure.html)

en.question: A developer created an AWS Lambda function that accesses resources in a VPC. The Lambda function polls an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue for new messages through a VPC endpoint. Then the function calculates a rolling average of the numeric values that are contained in the messages. After initial tests of the Lambda function, the developer found that the value of the rolling average that the function returned was not accurate. How can the developer ensure that the function calculates an accurate rolling average?

options.A: Set the function's reserved concurrency to 1. Calculate the rolling average in the function. Store the calculated rolling average in Amazon ElastiCache.
options.B: Modify the function to store the values in Amazon ElastiCache. When the function initializes, use the previous values from the cache to calculate the rolling average.
options.C: Set the function's provisioned concurrency to 1. Calculate the rolling average in the function. Store the calculated rolling average in Amazon ElastiCache.
options.D: Modify the function to store the values in the function's layers. When the function initializes, use the previously stored values to calculate the rolling average.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A Lambda function polls SQS for messages, computes a **rolling average** of numeric values across messages, and stores it. The developer observes inaccurate results. The question asks how to make the rolling average accurate.

The root cause of the inaccuracy is **Lambda's automatic scaling and concurrent execution behavior** when polling SQS. By default, when messages accumulate in the queue, Lambda starts processing five batches at a time with five concurrent invocations of your function, and if messages are still available, Lambda increases the number of processes that are reading batches by up to 300 more concurrent invokes per minute. Multiple concurrent function instances would each read different messages and compute their own partial averages, producing a race condition on any shared state and an incorrect aggregate.

## Correct Answer: A

Setting **reserved concurrency to 1** ensures only one Lambda instance runs at a time, so messages are processed serially and the running aggregate state in ElastiCache is updated atomically (no concurrent writers). Reserved concurrency sets both the maximum and minimum number of concurrent instances allocated to your function. When a function has reserved concurrency, no other function can use that concurrency. Storing the rolling average value in **Amazon ElastiCache** is necessary because Lambda is stateless — execution environments can be recycled at any time, so the running aggregate must persist across invocations in an external low-latency store.

Together, reserved concurrency = 1 (serialization) + ElastiCache (durable cross-invocation state) yields a correct, reproducible rolling average.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **B. Store values in ElastiCache and recompute on init.** This option does NOT control concurrency. Multiple Lambda instances would still read messages from SQS in parallel and write to ElastiCache simultaneously, producing race conditions (lost updates, double counting). Without serializing access, the rolling average remains inaccurate. As one commenter correctly noted, ElastiCache itself does not enforce single-writer semantics for an arbitrary read-modify-write workflow.
