When a paid subscriber requests a download, the application (which has authenticated the user as a paid subscriber against its own subscription database) generates an S3 pre-signed URL on the fly and returns it to the user. A presigned URL allows you to share or upload objects in Amazon S3 without requiring AWS security credentials or permissions, granting time-limited download access to objects in a private bucket.

Key properties that make this the correct fit:

- A presigned URL uses security credentials to grant time-limited permission to download objects, and the URL can be entered in a browser or used by a program to download the object.
- Presigned URLs allow you to keep your bucket private while granting temporary read or upload permissions for specific objects to users or applications, ensuring secure, controlled access without compromising the bucket's privacy.
- The URL is generated only after the application's own subscription/payment check, so non-paying visitors never receive a URL. The application can also keep the expiration short (e.g., a few minutes), which mitigates URL sharing.

This pattern is exactly the use case AWS calls out for paid-content distribution — for example, an App store platform where users who have purchased a license for a given software can download the installer binary.

## Why the other options are wrong

**A. Bucket policy allowing anonymous downloads** — This would make the premier content publicly downloadable by anyone on the internet, which is the exact opposite of the requirement. There is no way for a public bucket policy to distinguish paying vs. non-paying website visitors, because anonymous (unauthenticated) requests carry no identity.

**C. Bucket policy requiring MFA (`aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent`)** — MFA-protected access is intended for AWS IAM principals (IAM users/roles) performing sensitive API actions. Website subscribers are not IAM users; they don't have AWS credentials or MFA devices tied to AWS. This control cannot be used to gate access for end-user subscribers of a website. It is designed for things like protecting `s3:DeleteBucket` or versioned-object deletion by privileged IAM users — not for end-customer authorization.

**D. Server-side encryption** — SSE only protects data at rest on AWS-managed disks. It does not influence who can call `GetObject`. Anyone authorized to read the object (e.g., via a public bucket policy) would receive automatically decrypted content. SSE is an at-rest data-protection control, not an access-control mechanism.

## Note on the dissenting comment

One commenter argues that B is wrong because a paid subscriber could share the URL with non-payers. While URL leakage is a real consideration, AWS itself documents this exact pattern as the recommended way to deliver private content to authorized end users, and the risk is mitigated by short expirations, IP/VPC restrictions, or signing per-request. In essence, presigned URLs are bearer tokens that grant access to those who possess them, so AWS recommends protecting them appropriately, and there are methods to restrict their use. Option C (MFA) simply cannot solve the stated problem at all, because website visitors aren't AWS IAM principals. So B remains the only viable answer among the four.

## References

- [Download and upload objects with presigned URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/using-presigned-url.html)
- [Sharing objects with presigned URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/ShareObjectPreSignedURL.html)

zh.question: 一家公司拥有一个 Amazon S3 存储桶，其中包含一些优质内容，该公司计划仅向其网站的付费订阅用户提供这些内容。目前，该 S3 存储桶的所有对象默认权限均为私有，以防止非付费网站访问者意外访问这些优质内容。该公司如何才能限制只有付费订阅用户才能下载 S3 存储桶中的优质内容文件？

options.A: 应用存储桶策略，允许匿名用户从 S3 存储桶下载内容。
options.B: 当付费用户请求下载时，为主要内容文件生成预签名对象 URL。
options.C: 添加存储桶策略，要求对访问 S3 存储桶对象的请求进行多因素身份验证。
options.D: 对 S3 存储桶启用服务器端加密，以保护数据免受非付费网站访问者的侵害。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一家公司将付费内容存储在私有 S3 存储桶中，希望仅允许付费订阅者下载特定文件，同时对公众保持存储桶及其对象的私密性。

## 正确答案：B — 按需生成预签名对象 URL

当付费订阅者请求下载时，应用程序（已根据自身订阅数据库对该用户进行了付费订阅者身份验证）即时生成 S3 预签名 URL 并将其返回给用户。预签名 URL 允许您在不需要 AWS 安全凭证或权限的情况下共享或上传 Amazon S3 中的对象，向私有存储桶中的对象授予时间限制的下载访问权限。

使这个答案正确的关键特性：

- 预签名 URL 使用安全凭证授予时间限制的对象下载权限，该 URL 可以在浏览器中输入或由程序使用以下载对象。
- 预签名 URL 允许您保持存储桶为私有，同时为用户或应用程序授予对特定对象的临时读取或上传权限，确保安全、可控的访问而不影响存储桶的隐私。
- 该 URL 仅在应用程序完成自身订阅/支付检查后才生成，因此非付费访问者永远无法获得 URL。应用程序还可以设置较短的过期时间（例如几分钟），这可以减轻 URL 共享的风险。

这种模式正是 AWS 针对付费内容分发的推荐用例——例如，应用商店平台，其中已购买给定软件许可证的用户可以下载安装程序二进制文件。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

**A. 允许匿名下载的存储桶策略** — 这会使付费内容对互联网上的任何人都可以公开下载，这正好与要求相反。没有办法通过公开存储桶策略来区分付费用户和非付费网站访问者，因为匿名（未认证）请求不携带身份信息。

**C. 需要 MFA 的存储桶策略（`aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent`）** — MFA 保护的访问用于 AWS IAM 主体（IAM 用户/角色）执行敏感 API 操作。网站订阅者不是 IAM 用户；他们没有与 AWS 关联的 AWS 凭证或 MFA 设备。此控制无法用于对网站最终用户订阅者的访问进行门控。它设计用于保护 `s3:DeleteBucket` 或由特权 IAM 用户的版本化对象删除等操作——而不是用于最终客户授权。

**D. 服务器端加密** — SSE 仅保护 AWS 管理磁盘上的静止数据。它不影响谁可以调用 `GetObject`。任何被授权读取对象的人（例如通过公开存储桶策略）都会收到自动解密的内容。SSE 是一个静止数据保护控制，而不是访问控制机制。

## 关于反对意见的说明

一位评论者辩称 B 是错误的，因为付费订阅者可能会与非付费用户共享 URL。虽然 URL 泄露是一个真实的考虑因素，但 AWS 本身将这个确切的模式记录为向授权最终用户交付私有内容的推荐方式，该风险可以通过短过期时间、IP/VPC 限制或按请求签名来缓解。本质上，预签名 URL 是授予拥有它们的人访问权限的持有者令牌，因此 AWS 建议适当保护它们，并且有方法可以限制它们的使用。选项 C（MFA）根本无法解决所述问题，因为网站访问者不是 AWS IAM 主体。因此 B 仍然是四个选项中唯一可行的答案。

## 参考

- [Download and upload objects with presigned URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/using-presigned-url.html)
- [Sharing objects with presigned URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/ShareObjectPreSignedURL.html)

en.question: A developer is creating an AWS Lambda function that searches for items from an Amazon DynamoDB table that contains customer contact information. The DynamoDB table items have the customer’s email_address as the partition key and additional properties such as customer_type, name and job_title. The Lambda function runs whenever a user types a new character into the customer_type text input. The developer wants the search to return partial matches of all the email_address property of a particular customer_type. The developer does not want to recreate the DynamoDB table. What should the developer do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Add a global secondary index (GSI) to the DynamoDB table with customer_type as the partition key and email_address as the sort key. Perform a query operation on the GSI by using the begins_with key condition expression with the email_address property.
options.B: Add a global secondary index (GSI) to the DynamoDB table with email_address as the partition key and customer_type as the sort key. Perform a query operation on the GSI by using the begins_with key condition expression with the email_address property.
options.C: Add a local secondary index (LSI) to the DynamoDB table with customer_type as the partition key and email_address as the sort key. Perform a query operation on the LSI by using the begins_with key condition expression with the email_address property.
options.D: Add a local secondary index (LSI) to the DynamoDB table with job_title as the partition key and email_address as the sort key. Perform a query operation on the LSI by using the begins_with key condition expression with the email_address property.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A Lambda function queries a DynamoDB customer table whose partition key is `email_address`. As the user types into a `customer_type` input, the function should return all items matching that `customer_type` whose `email_address` starts with the typed prefix. The table cannot be recreated.

Two requirements drive the answer:
1. The query must filter by **customer_type** (equality) and return **partial matches on email_address** (prefix search).
2. The index must be addable to an **existing** table.

## Correct Answer: A

Create a **Global Secondary Index (GSI)** with `customer_type` as the partition key and `email_address` as the sort key. Then run a `Query` using a `KeyConditionExpression` like:

```
customer_type = :ct AND begins_with(email_address, :prefix)
```

Why this works:
- A `Query` requires an equality condition on the partition key, and supports `begins_with()` on the sort key — exactly the access pattern needed. When you query a global secondary index with multi-attribute keys, you must specify all partition key attributes using equality conditions. For sort key attributes, you can query them left-to-right... Inequality conditions such as >, <, BETWEEN, or begins_with() must be the last condition in your query.
- A GSI can be added **after** the table is created, satisfying the "do not recreate the table" constraint. GSI: Amazon DynamoDB backfills the index from pre-existing data; it can be inserted after the table is created. LSI: An LSI cannot be added or removed after the table has been created; it must be defined at the time of table creation.
- A GSI lets you choose a partition key different from the base table's key. Global secondary index (GSI)— An index with a partition key and a sort key that can be different from those on the base table.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**B. GSI with `email_address` as partition key and `customer_type` as sort key.**
A `Query` requires an exact-match equality condition on the partition key. When you query a global secondary index with multi-attribute keys, you must specify all partition key attributes using equality conditions. You cannot do `begins_with()` on a partition key, so prefix matching on `email_address` is impossible with this schema. You'd be forced into a Scan.

**C. LSI with `customer_type` as partition key and `email_address` as sort key.**
An LSI must share the **same** partition key as the base table (here `email_address`), so an LSI with `customer_type` as the partition key is structurally invalid. Local secondary index (LSI)—An index that has the same partition key as the base table, but a different sort key. A local secondary index is "local" in the sense that every partition of a local secondary index is scoped to a base table partition that has the same partition key value. Additionally, LSIs cannot be added to an existing table. LSI: An LSI cannot be added or removed after the table has been created; it must be defined at the time of table creation.

**D. LSI with `job_title` as partition key and `email_address` as sort key.**
Same two problems as C: an LSI cannot use a partition key other than the base table's `email_address`, and LSIs cannot be added after table creation. The partition key also doesn't match the requested filter (`customer_type`).

## Key DynamoDB Documentation
- [Using Global Secondary Indexes in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GSI.html)
- [General guidelines for secondary indexes in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-indexes-general.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于搜索包含客户联系信息的 Amazon DynamoDB 表中的项目。DynamoDB 表中的项目以客户的 email_address 作为分区键，并包含 customer_type、name 和 job_title 等其他属性。每当用户在 customer_type 文本输入框中输入新字符时，Lambda 函数就会运行。开发人员希望搜索结果能够返回特定 customer_type 的所有 email_address 属性的部分匹配项。开发人员不想重新创建 DynamoDB 表。为了满足这些要求，开发人员应该怎么做？

options.A: 向 DynamoDB 表添加一个全局二级索引 (GSI)，以 customer_type 作为分区键，email_address 作为排序键。使用带有 email_address 属性的 begins_with 键条件表达式对该 GSI 执行查询操作。
options.B: 向 DynamoDB 表中添加一个全局二级索引 (GSI)，以 email_address 作为分区键，customer_type 作为排序键。使用带有 email_address 属性的 begins_with 键条件表达式对该 GSI 执行查询操作。
options.C: 向 DynamoDB 表中添加一个本地二级索引 (LSI)，以 customer_type 作为分区键，email_address 作为排序键。使用带有 email_address 属性的 begins_with 键条件表达式对该 LSI 执行查询操作。
options.D: 向 DynamoDB 表中添加一个本地二级索引 (LSI)，以 job_title 作为分区键，email_address 作为排序键。使用带有 email_address 属性的 begins_with 键条件表达式对该 LSI 执行查询操作。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一个 Lambda 函数查询 DynamoDB 客户表，其分区键为 `email_address`。当用户在 `customer_type` 输入框中输入内容时，函数应返回所有匹配该 `customer_type` 且 `email_address` 以输入前缀开头的项目。该表无法重新创建。

两个需求驱动答案：
1. 查询必须按 **customer_type**（精确匹配）进行过滤，并在 **email_address**（前缀搜索）上返回部分匹配项。
2. 索引必须能够添加到**现有**表。

## 正确答案：A

创建一个 **Global Secondary Index (GSI)**，以 `customer_type` 作为分区键，`email_address` 作为排序键。然后使用 `KeyConditionExpression` 运行 `Query`，如：

```
customer_type = :ct AND begins_with(email_address, :prefix)
```

为什么这样做有效：
- `Query` 需要对分区键进行精确匹配条件，并支持对排序键进行 `begins_with()` 操作——这正是所需的访问模式。使用多属性键查询全局二级索引时，必须使用精确条件指定所有分区键属性。对于排序键属性，可以从左到右查询...不等条件（如 >、<、BETWEEN 或 begins_with()）必须是查询中的最后一个条件。
- GSI 可以在表创建后添加，满足"不重新创建表"的约束。GSI：Amazon DynamoDB 从现有数据回填索引；可以在表创建后插入。LSI：LSI 创建后无法添加或删除；必须在表创建时定义。
- GSI 允许选择与基表键不同的分区键。Global Secondary Index (GSI)——具有分区键和排序键的索引，可以与基表上的键不同。

## 为什么其他选项错误

**B. GSI 的分区键为 `email_address`，排序键为 `customer_type`。**
`Query` 需要对分区键进行精确匹配条件。使用多属性键查询全局二级索引时，必须使用精确条件指定所有分区键属性。无法对分区键执行 `begins_with()`，因此使用此架构无法进行 `email_address` 前缀匹配。您将被迫使用 Scan。

**C. LSI 的分区键为 `customer_type`，排序键为 `email_address`。**
LSI 必须与基表共享**相同**的分区键（此处为 `email_address`），因此以 `customer_type` 作为分区键的 LSI 在结构上无效。Local Secondary Index (LSI)——具有与基表相同分区键但排序键不同的索引。LSI 之所以"本地"，是因为 LSI 的每个分区都限定在具有相同分区键值的基表分区范围内。此外，LSI 无法添加到现有表。LSI：LSI 创建后无法添加或删除；必须在表创建时定义。

**D. LSI 的分区键为 `job_title`，排序键为 `email_address`。**
与选项 C 相同的两个问题：LSI 无法使用基表的 `email_address` 以外的分区键，且 LSI 无法在表创建后添加。分区键也不匹配请求的过滤条件（`customer_type`）。

## DynamoDB 关键文档
- [在 DynamoDB 中使用全局二级索引](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GSI.html)
- [DynamoDB 中二级索引的通用指南](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-indexes-general.html)

en.question: A developer is building an application that uses AWS API Gateway APIs, AWS Lambda functions, and AWS DynamoDB tables. The developer uses the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) to build and run serverless applications on AWS. Each time the developer pushes changes for only to the Lambda functions, all the artifacts in the application are rebuilt. The developer wants to implement AWS SAM Accelerate by running a command to only redeploy the Lambda functions that have changed. Which command will meet these requirements?

options.A: sam deploy --force-upload
options.B: sam deploy --no-execute-changeset
options.C: sam package
options.D: sam sync --watch

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The developer is using AWS SAM to develop a serverless app (API Gateway + Lambda + DynamoDB). When only Lambda code changes, a full rebuild/redeploy of all resources is wasteful. The developer wants to use **AWS SAM Accelerate** to redeploy only the changed Lambda functions.

## Correct Answer: D — `sam sync --watch`

The `sam sync` command is a part of AWS SAM Accelerate, which provides tools to speed up the experience of developing and testing serverless applications in the AWS Cloud.

Using the `sam sync --watch` capability lets SAM CLI monitor for any changes to AWS resources defined in your application and automatically sync them in your developer account in AWS cloud so you don't have to run manual deployments.

When only code (e.g., Lambda functions) changes, AWS SAM synchronises the code with the equivalent of the `sam sync --code` command, which uses AWS service APIs directly, instead of deploying through AWS CloudFormation. This bypasses the slow CloudFormation changeset process and updates only the changed Lambda functions in seconds.

```bash
sam sync --watch --stack-name my-app
```

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. `sam deploy --force-upload`** — This flag does the opposite of what's wanted: it forces SAM to upload artifacts even when they haven't changed. It still goes through a full CloudFormation deployment of the whole stack and is not part of SAM Accelerate.

- **B. `sam deploy --no-execute-changeset`** — This creates a CloudFormation change set but does **not** execute it. It is used for previewing changes, not for fast iterative deployments. It does not selectively redeploy only Lambda functions, and it is not part of SAM Accelerate.

- **C. `sam package`** — This command only packages local artifacts and uploads them to S3, producing a deployment-ready template. It does not deploy anything to AWS and has nothing to do with SAM Accelerate's selective sync of Lambda code.

## References
- [sam sync - AWS SAM Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/sam-cli-command-reference-sam-sync.html)
- [Introduction to using sam sync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/using-sam-cli-sync.html)
- [Accelerating serverless development with AWS SAM Accelerate](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/accelerating-serverless-development-with-aws-sam-accelerate/)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在构建一个使用 AWS API Gateway API、AWS Lambda 函数和 AWS DynamoDB 表的应用程序。该开发人员使用 AWS 无服务器应用程序模型 (AWS SAM) 在 AWS 上构建和运行无服务器应用程序。每次开发人员仅推送对 Lambda 函数的更改时，应用程序中的所有工件都会被重新构建。该开发人员希望通过运行命令来实现 AWS SAM Accelerate，从而仅重新部署已更改的 Lambda 函数。哪个命令可以满足这些要求？

options.A: sam deploy --force-upload
options.B: sam deploy --no-execute-changeset
options.C: sam 包
options.D: sam sync --watch

zh.explanation:
## 场景

开发人员使用 AWS SAM 开发无服务器应用（API Gateway + Lambda + DynamoDB）。当仅 Lambda 代码变更时，对所有资源进行完整重建/重新部署是浪费的。开发人员想要使用 **AWS SAM Accelerate** 来仅重新部署更改的 Lambda 函数。

## 正确答案：D — `sam sync --watch`

`sam sync` 命令是 AWS SAM Accelerate 的一部分，它提供了加速在 AWS 云中开发和测试无服务器应用体验的工具。

使用 `sam sync --watch` 功能让 SAM CLI 监控应用中定义的任何 AWS 资源的变更，并自动在你的 AWS 云开发者账户中同步这些变更，因此你不必运行手动部署。

当仅代码（例如 Lambda 函数）变更时，AWS SAM 使用 `sam sync --code` 命令的等效功能来同步代码，其直接使用 AWS 服务 API，而不是通过 AWS CloudFormation 部署。这绕过了缓慢的 CloudFormation changeset 过程，在几秒内仅更新更改的 Lambda 函数。

```bash
sam sync --watch --stack-name my-app
```

## 其他选项为什么是错误的

- **A. `sam deploy --force-upload`** — 此标志的作用与所需的相反：它强制 SAM 上传工件，即使它们未变更。它仍然通过完整的 CloudFormation 部署整个堆栈，并且不属于 SAM Accelerate 的一部分。

- **B. `sam deploy --no-execute-changeset`** — 这会创建 CloudFormation 变更集但**不**执行它。它用于预览变更，而不是快速迭代部署。它不会选择性地重新部署仅 Lambda 函数，并且不属于 SAM Accelerate 的一部分。

- **C. `sam package`** — 此命令仅打包本地工件并将它们上传到 S3，生成部署就绪模板。它不会部署任何内容到 AWS，与 SAM Accelerate 的 Lambda 代码选择性同步无关。

## 参考资源
- [sam sync - AWS SAM 开发者指南](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/sam-cli-command-reference-sam-sync.html)
- [sam sync 使用简介](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/using-sam-cli-sync.html)
- [使用 AWS SAM Accelerate 加速无服务器开发](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/accelerating-serverless-development-with-aws-sam-accelerate/)

en.question: A developer is building an application that gives users the ability to view bank accounts from multiple sources in a single dashboard. The developer has automated the process to retrieve API credentials for these sources. The process invokes an AWS Lambda function that is associated with an AWS CloudFormation custom resource. The developer wants a solution that will store the API credentials with minimal operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST secure way?

options.A: Add an AWS Secrets Manager GenerateSecretString resource to the CloudFormation template. Set the value to reference new credentials for the CloudFormation resource.
options.B: Use the AWS SDK ssm:PutParameter operation in the Lambda function from the existing custom resource to store the credentials as a parameter. Set the parameter value to reference the new credentials. Set the parameter type to SecureString.
options.C: Add an AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store resource to the CloudFormation template. Set the CloudFormation resource value to reference the new credentials. Set the resource NoEcho attribute to true.
options.D: Use the AWS SDK ssm:PutParameter operation in the Lambda function from the existing custom resource to store the credentials as a parameter. Set the parameter value to reference the new credentials. Set the parameter NoEcho attribute to true.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer has a Lambda function (invoked by a CloudFormation custom resource) that already retrieves API credentials for several bank account sources. The developer needs the Lambda to **store** those retrieved credentials securely with **minimal operational overhead**.

The question is essentially: from inside the Lambda, what is the most secure way to persist these credentials?

## Correct Answer: B

Inside the Lambda, call the `ssm:PutParameter` API with `Type=SecureString`. SSM Parameter Store is a managed, no-extra-cost service, and SecureString parameters are encrypted at rest with AWS KMS, satisfying both the security and minimal-overhead requirements.

- The value of a SecureString parameter is any sensitive data that needs to be stored and referenced in a secure manner. If you have data that you don't want users to alter or reference in plaintext, such as passwords or license keys, create those parameters using the SecureString data type.
- For all sensitive data that must remain encrypted, use only the SecureString parameter type. We recommend using SecureString parameters for the following scenarios: You want to use data/parameters across AWS services without exposing the values as plaintext in commands, functions, agent logs, or CloudTrail logs.

Example call from Lambda (boto3):

```python
import boto3
ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
ssm.put_parameter(
    Name='/banking/source1/apiKey',
    Value=retrieved_credential,
    Type='SecureString',
    Overwrite=True
)
```

## Why the other options are wrong

**A. CloudFormation `AWS::SecretsManager::Secret` with `GenerateSecretString`** – This generates a *new* random secret value at stack-creation time. The requirement is to store credentials that the Lambda has already **retrieved from external sources**, not to generate new ones. `GenerateSecretString` cannot accept a runtime value produced by the custom-resource Lambda; it produces a random string based on length/character rules. It does not match the workflow.

**C. Add an `AWS::SSM::Parameter` resource in the CloudFormation template with `NoEcho: true`** – The credentials are obtained dynamically by the Lambda at runtime, so they are not available when the template is authored or even when the stack is created. Putting them as a static template resource is impossible. Additionally, Parameter Store created via CloudFormation does **not** support the `SecureString` type for resource creation in the template ([AWS::SSM::Parameter docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-resource-ssm-parameter.html)) – CloudFormation can only *reference* SecureStrings through `ssm-secure` dynamic references, it cannot create them. During stack creation or updates, CloudFormation accesses the secure string value as needed, without exposing the actual value. Secure strings can only be used for resource properties that support the ssm-secure dynamic reference pattern.

**D. `ssm:PutParameter` with `NoEcho: true`** – `NoEcho` is **not** an attribute of the SSM `PutParameter` API; it is a CloudFormation template attribute used to mask values in stack events/console output. Without specifying `Type=SecureString`, the credentials would be stored as a plaintext `String` parameter, which is explicitly discouraged for sensitive data. Don't store sensitive data in a String or StringList parameter. For all sensitive data that must remain encrypted, use only the SecureString parameter type.

## References
- [AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store – SecureString](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html)
- [SSM PutParameter API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/APIReference/API_PutParameter.html)
- [CloudFormation ssm-secure dynamic references](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/dynamic-references-ssm-secure-strings.html)
- [CloudFormation NoEcho property](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/parameters-section-structure.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在构建一个应用程序，使用户能够在单个仪表板中查看来自多个来源的银行账户。开发人员已将获取这些来源的 API 凭证的过程自动化。该过程调用了一个与 AWS CloudFormation 自定义资源关联的 AWS Lambda 函数。开发人员希望找到一种能够以最小的运维开销存储 API 凭证的解决方案。哪种解决方案能够以最安全的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 AWS Secrets Manager GenerateSecretString 资源添加到 CloudFormation 模板中。设置该值以引用 CloudFormation 资源的新凭证。
options.B: 在现有自定义资源的 Lambda 函数中使用 AWS SDK 的 ssm:PutParameter 操作，将凭证存储为参数。将参数值设置为引用新凭证。将参数类型设置为 SecureString。
options.C: 将 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 资源添加到 CloudFormation 模板。将 CloudFormation 资源值设置为引用新凭证。将资源的 NoEcho 属性设置为 true。
options.D: 在现有自定义资源的 Lambda 函数中使用 AWS SDK 的 ssm:PutParameter 操作，将凭证存储为参数。将参数值设置为引用新凭证。将参数的 NoEcho 属性设置为 true。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一位开发人员有一个 Lambda 函数（由 CloudFormation 自定义资源调用），已经从多个银行账户源检索 API 凭证。开发人员需要该 Lambda **安全地存储**这些检索到的凭证，同时**最小化运营开销**。

问题本质上是：从 Lambda 内部，持久化这些凭证最安全的方式是什么？

## 正确答案：B

从 Lambda 内部调用 `ssm:PutParameter` API，使用 `Type=SecureString`。SSM Parameter Store 是一项托管的、无额外成本的服务，SecureString 参数在静态时使用 AWS KMS 加密，既满足安全要求又满足最小化开销的需求。

- SecureString 参数的值是任何需要以安全方式存储和引用的敏感数据。如果您有不希望用户修改或以明文形式引用的数据（例如密码或许可证密钥），请使用 SecureString 数据类型创建这些参数。
- 对于所有必须保持加密的敏感数据，仅使用 SecureString 参数类型。我们建议在以下场景中使用 SecureString 参数：您想在 AWS 服务之间使用数据/参数，而无需在命令、函数、代理日志或 CloudTrail 日志中以明文形式公开这些值。

来自 Lambda 的示例调用（boto3）：

```python
import boto3
ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
ssm.put_parameter(
    Name='/banking/source1/apiKey',
    Value=retrieved_credential,
    Type='SecureString',
    Overwrite=True
)
```

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**A. CloudFormation `AWS::SecretsManager::Secret`，使用 `GenerateSecretString`** – 这会在堆栈创建时生成一个**新的**随机密钥值。要求是存储 Lambda **已从外部源检索**的凭证，而不是生成新的凭证。`GenerateSecretString` 无法接受自定义资源 Lambda 生成的运行时值；它基于长度/字符规则生成随机字符串。这与工作流不匹配。

**C. 在 CloudFormation 模板中添加 `AWS::SSM::Parameter` 资源，使用 `NoEcho: true`** – 凭证是由 Lambda 在运行时动态获得的，所以在模板编写时甚至堆栈创建时都不可用。将其作为静态模板资源放置是不可能的。此外，通过 CloudFormation 创建的 Parameter Store **不**支持用于资源创建的 `SecureString` 类型（[AWS::SSM::Parameter 文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-resource-ssm-parameter.html)） – CloudFormation 只能通过 `ssm-secure` 动态引用来**引用** SecureString，不能创建它们。在堆栈创建或更新期间，CloudFormation 根据需要访问安全字符串值，而不暴露实际值。安全字符串只能用于支持 ssm-secure 动态引用模式的资源属性。

**D. `ssm:PutParameter`，使用 `NoEcho: true`** – `NoEcho` **不是** SSM `PutParameter` API 的属性；它是 CloudFormation 模板属性，用于在堆栈事件/控制台输出中屏蔽值。如果不指定 `Type=SecureString`，凭证将以明文 `String` 参数形式存储，这对敏感数据明确不建议。不要在 String 或 StringList 参数中存储敏感数据。对于所有必须保持加密的敏感数据，仅使用 SecureString 参数类型。

## 参考资源
- [AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store – SecureString](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html)
- [SSM PutParameter API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/APIReference/API_PutParameter.html)
- [CloudFormation ssm-secure 动态引用](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/dynamic-references-ssm-secure-strings.html)
- [CloudFormation NoEcho 属性](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/parameters-section-structure.html)

en.question: A developer is trying to get data from an Amazon DynamoDB table called demoman-table. The developer configured the AWS CLI to use a specific IAM user’s credentials and ran the following command: aws dynamodb get-item --table-name demoman-table --key '{"id": {"N":"1993"}}' The command returned errors and no rows were returned. What is the MOST likely cause of these issues?

options.A: The command is incorrect; it should be rewritten to use put-item with a string argument.
options.B: The developer needs to log a ticket with AWS Support to enable access to the demoman-table.
options.C: Amazon DynamoDB cannot be accessed from the AWS CLI and needs to be called via the REST API.
options.D: The IAM user needs an associated policy with read access to demoman-table.

en.explanation:
# DynamoDB GetItem from CLI – IAM Permission Required

## Scenario
A developer configured the AWS CLI with an IAM user's credentials and ran:

```bash
aws dynamodb get-item --table-name demoman-table --key '{"id": {"N":"1993"}}'
```

The command returned errors and no rows were returned. The question asks for the MOST likely cause.

## Correct Answer: D — The IAM user needs an associated policy with read access to demoman-table

By default, IAM users have **no permissions**. To call `GetItem` on a DynamoDB table, the IAM user (or a group/role they assume) must have an identity-based policy granting the `dynamodb:GetItem` action on the target table's ARN. When setting up IAM for DynamoDB and writing a permissions policy, you can use the list of Actions, resources, and condition keys for DynamoDB as a reference. The page lists each DynamoDB API operation, the corresponding actions for which you can grant permissions to perform the action, and the AWS resource for which you can grant the permissions. You specify the actions in the policy's Action field, and you specify the resource value in the policy's Resource field.

A minimal policy that fixes the issue would be:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "dynamodb:GetItem",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:123456789012:table/demoman-table"
    }
  ]
}
```

Alternatively, AWS provides a managed policy for read-only access. AmazonDynamoDBReadOnlyAccess grants read-only access to DynamoDB resources through the AWS Management Console.

Without such a policy, the API call returns an `AccessDeniedException`, which matches the symptom described ("returned errors and no rows were returned").

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Use `put-item` with a string argument** — `put-item` is for *writing* items, not retrieving them. The developer wants to read data; `get-item` is the correct API. The key is also correctly typed as a number (`"N":"1993"`), matching the table's likely numeric primary key. Switching to `put-item` would not retrieve data.

- **B. Log a ticket with AWS Support to enable table access** — DynamoDB tables don't require AWS Support intervention to enable access. Access is controlled entirely by the customer through IAM identity-based policies (or DynamoDB resource-based policies). The best practice is to create custom IAM policies that grant least-privilege to the users, roles, or groups that require them. In this section, you can find policy examples that grant permissions for various DynamoDB actions. These policies work when you use AWS SDKs or the AWS CLI.

- **C. DynamoDB cannot be accessed from the AWS CLI** — This is factually false. DynamoDB is fully supported by the AWS CLI (`aws dynamodb …`) and SDKs, which call the same underlying HTTPS API. You don't need to allow minimum console permissions for users who are making calls only to the AWS CLI or the Amazon DynamoDB API.

## Key Takeaway
For a DVA-C02 question where an AWS CLI / SDK call against DynamoDB fails with errors and the command syntax is valid, the default cause is **missing IAM permissions** on the calling identity. Attach a policy granting `dynamodb:GetItem` (or `AmazonDynamoDBReadOnlyAccess`) scoped to the table ARN.

## References
- [Using identity-based policies with Amazon DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/using-identity-based-policies.html)
- [DynamoDB API permissions reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/api-permissions-reference.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员尝试从名为 demoman-table 的 Amazon DynamoDB 表中获取数据。他已将 AWS CLI 配置为使用特定 IAM 用户的凭证，并运行了以下命令： `aws dynamodb get-item --table-name demoman-table --key '{"id": {"N":"1993"}}'`。该命令返回了错误，并且没有返回任何行。最可能导致这些问题的原因是什么？

options.A: 该命令不正确；应该重写为使用带有字符串参数的 put-item 命令。
options.B: 开发人员需要向 AWS 支持部门提交工单，以启用对 demoman-table 的访问权限。
options.C: Amazon DynamoDB 无法通过 AWS CLI 访问，需要通过 REST API 调用。
options.D: IAM 用户需要具有对 demoman-table 的读取权限的相关策略。

zh.explanation:
# DynamoDB GetItem from CLI – IAM Permission Required

## Scenario
一位开发者使用 IAM 用户的凭证配置了 AWS CLI，并运行了以下命令：

```bash
aws dynamodb get-item --table-name demoman-table --key '{"id": {"N":"1993"}}'
```

该命令返回错误且没有返回任何行。问题要求找出最可能的原因。

## 正确答案：D — IAM 用户需要关联具有对 demoman-table 读取权限的策略

默认情况下，IAM 用户**没有任何权限**。要在 DynamoDB 表上调用 `GetItem`，IAM 用户（或他们所关联的组/角色）必须拥有一个身份策略，该策略授予目标表 ARN 上的 `dynamodb:GetItem` 操作权限。在为 DynamoDB 设置 IAM 和编写权限策略时，可以参考 DynamoDB 的操作、资源和条件键列表。该页面列出了每个 DynamoDB API 操作、可以授予权限执行该操作对应的操作，以及可以授予权限的 AWS 资源。在策略的 Action 字段中指定操作，在策略的 Resource 字段中指定资源值。

解决此问题的最小策略如下：

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "dynamodb:GetItem",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:123456789012:table/demoman-table"
    }
  ]
}
```

或者，AWS 提供了一个托管策略用于只读访问。AmazonDynamoDBReadOnlyAccess 通过 AWS 管理控制台授予对 DynamoDB 资源的只读访问权限。

如果没有此类策略，API 调用会返回 `AccessDeniedException`，这与所述症状相符（"返回错误且没有返回行"）。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **A. 使用 `put-item` 和字符串参数** — `put-item` 用于*写入*项，而不是检索项。开发者想要读取数据；`get-item` 是正确的 API。该键也被正确地类型化为数字（`"N":"1993"`），与表的可能的数字主键匹配。切换到 `put-item` 不会检索数据。

- **B. 向 AWS Support 提交工单以启用表访问** — DynamoDB 表不需要 AWS Support 干预来启用访问。访问完全由客户通过 IAM 身份策略（或 DynamoDB 基于资源的策略）控制。最佳实践是创建自定义 IAM 策略，为需要这些策略的用户、角色或组授予最小权限。在本节中，可以找到授予各种 DynamoDB 操作权限的策略示例。这些策略在使用 AWS SDK 或 AWS CLI 时有效。

- **C. 无法从 AWS CLI 访问 DynamoDB** — 这在事实上是错误的。DynamoDB 由 AWS CLI（`aws dynamodb …`）和 SDK 完全支持，这些调用相同的底层 HTTPS API。对于仅调用 AWS CLI 或 Amazon DynamoDB API 的用户，不需要允许最少的控制台权限。

## 关键要点
在 DVA-C02 考试中，如果针对 DynamoDB 的 AWS CLI/SDK 调用失败并出现错误，而命令语法有效，默认原因是调用身份**缺少 IAM 权限**。附加一个策略授予 `dynamodb:GetItem`（或 `AmazonDynamoDBReadOnlyAccess`）并将其范围限定为表 ARN。

## 参考资源
- [Using identity-based policies with Amazon DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/using-identity-based-policies.html)
- [DynamoDB API permissions reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/api-permissions-reference.html)

en.question: An organization is using Amazon CloudFront to ensure that its users experience low-latency access to its web application. The organization has identified a need to encrypt all traffic between users and CloudFront, and all traffic between CloudFront and the web application. How can these requirements be met? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS KMS to encrypt traffic between CloudFront and the web application.
options.B: Set the Origin Protocol Policy to “HTTPS Only”.
options.C: Set the Origin’s HTTP Port to 443.
options.D: Set the Viewer Protocol Policy to “HTTPS Only” or “Redirect HTTP to HTTPS”.
options.E: Enable the CloudFront option Restrict Viewer Access.

en.explanation:
# CloudFront End-to-End HTTPS Encryption

## Scenario
The organization needs to encrypt **two distinct traffic legs**:
1. **Viewer ↔ CloudFront** (users to the edge)
2. **CloudFront ↔ Origin** (edge to the web application)

Each leg has a separate CloudFront setting that controls the protocol used.

## Correct Answers: B and D

### B. Set the Origin Protocol Policy to "HTTPS Only"
This controls the connection between CloudFront and the custom origin. HTTPS Only – CloudFront uses only HTTPS to communicate with your custom origin. If you want to ensure that the objects that viewers get from CloudFront were encrypted when CloudFront got them from your origin, always use HTTPS between CloudFront and your origin.

### D. Set the Viewer Protocol Policy to "HTTPS Only" or "Redirect HTTP to HTTPS"
This controls the connection between viewers (end users) and CloudFront. With **HTTPS Only**, viewers can access your content only if they're using HTTPS. If a viewer sends an HTTP request instead of an HTTPS request, CloudFront returns HTTP status code 403 (Forbidden) and does not return the object. With **Redirect HTTP to HTTPS**, HTTP GET and HEAD requests are automatically redirected to HTTPS requests. CloudFront returns HTTP status code 301 (Moved Permanently) along with the new HTTPS URL. The viewer then resubmits the request to CloudFront using the HTTPS URL.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

### A. Use AWS KMS to encrypt traffic between CloudFront and the web application
**Incorrect.** AWS KMS is a key management service used to encrypt **data at rest** (e.g., S3 objects, EBS volumes, RDS data) — it does not encrypt traffic in transit. Transport-layer encryption between CloudFront and an origin is achieved with TLS/HTTPS via the Origin Protocol Policy, not KMS.

### C. Set the Origin's HTTP Port to 443
**Incorrect.** Changing the HTTP port number does **not** enable encryption — it only changes which TCP port CloudFront uses for plain HTTP. Encryption requires using the HTTPS protocol (TLS), which is configured via the **Origin Protocol Policy**, not the port number. You can specify the HTTP port on which the custom origin listens. Valid values include ports 80, 443, and 1024 to 65535. The default value is port 80. Sending HTTP to port 443 still leaves traffic unencrypted.

### E. Enable the CloudFront option Restrict Viewer Access
**Incorrect.** "Restrict Viewer Access" enforces the use of **signed URLs or signed cookies** for access control/authorization — it does not encrypt traffic. It controls *who* can access content, not *how* the content is transmitted.

## References
- [Require HTTPS for communication between viewers and CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/using-https-viewers-to-cloudfront.html)
- [Require HTTPS for communication between CloudFront and your custom origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/using-https-cloudfront-to-custom-origin.html)
- [Origin settings - Amazon CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesOrigin.html)

zh.question: 某组织使用 Amazon CloudFront 来确保用户能够低延迟地访问其 Web 应用程序。该组织发现需要加密用户与 CloudFront 之间的所有流量，以及 CloudFront 与 Web 应用程序之间的所有流量。如何满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 AWS KMS 加密 CloudFront 和 Web 应用程序之间的流量。
options.B: 将源协议策略设置为“仅限 HTTPS”。
options.C: 将源服务器的 HTTP 端口设置为 443。
options.D: 将查看器协议策略设置为“仅限 HTTPS”或“将 HTTP 重定向到 HTTPS”。
options.E: 启用 CloudFront 选项“限制查看者访问”。

zh.explanation:
# CloudFront 端到端 HTTPS 加密

## 场景
组织需要加密**两条不同的流量路径**：
1. **Viewer ↔ CloudFront**（用户到边缘节点）
2. **CloudFront ↔ Origin**（边缘节点到 Web 应用程序）

每条路径都有独立的 CloudFront 设置来控制所使用的协议。

## 正确答案：B 和 D

### B. 将 Origin Protocol Policy 设置为"HTTPS Only"
这控制 CloudFront 和自定义源之间的连接。HTTPS Only – CloudFront 仅使用 HTTPS 与您的自定义源通信。 如果要确保查看者从 CloudFront 获取的对象在 CloudFront 从您的源获取时已加密，请始终在 CloudFront 和源之间使用 HTTPS。

### D. 将 Viewer Protocol Policy 设置为"HTTPS Only"或"Redirect HTTP to HTTPS"
这控制查看者（最终用户）和 CloudFront 之间的连接。使用 **HTTPS Only** 时，查看者只有在使用 HTTPS 时才能访问您的内容。如果查看者发送 HTTP 请求而不是 HTTPS 请求，CloudFront 将返回 HTTP 状态代码 403（禁止），并且不会返回该对象。 使用 **Redirect HTTP to HTTPS** 时，HTTP GET 和 HEAD 请求会自动重定向到 HTTPS 请求。CloudFront 返回 HTTP 状态代码 301（永久移动）以及新的 HTTPS URL。查看者随后使用 HTTPS URL 向 CloudFront 重新提交请求。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

### A. 使用 AWS KMS 对 CloudFront 和 Web 应用程序之间的流量进行加密
**不正确。** AWS KMS 是用于加密**静态数据**（例如 S3 对象、EBS 卷、RDS 数据）的密钥管理服务 — 它不会加密传输中的流量。CloudFront 和源之间的传输层加密是通过 Origin Protocol Policy 使用 TLS/HTTPS 实现的，而不是 KMS。

### C. 将 Origin 的 HTTP 端口设置为 443
**不正确。** 更改 HTTP 端口号**不会**启用加密 — 它只是更改 CloudFront 用于纯 HTTP 的 TCP 端口。加密需要使用 HTTPS 协议 (TLS)，该协议通过 **Origin Protocol Policy** 配置，而不是端口号。您可以指定自定义源监听的 HTTP 端口。有效值包括端口 80、443 和 1024 到 65535。默认值是端口 80。 向端口 443 发送 HTTP 仍然会让流量保持未加密状态。

### E. 启用 CloudFront 选项 Restrict Viewer Access
**不正确。** "Restrict Viewer Access"强制使用**签名 URL 或签名 Cookie** 进行访问控制/授权 — 它不会加密流量。它控制*谁*可以访问内容，而不是内容*如何*传输。

## 参考资源
- [Require HTTPS for communication between viewers and CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/using-https-viewers-to-cloudfront.html)
- [Require HTTPS for communication between CloudFront and your custom origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/using-https-cloudfront-to-custom-origin.html)
- [Origin settings - Amazon CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesOrigin.html)

en.question: A developer is planning to migrate on-premises company data to Amazon S3. The data must be encrypted, and the encryption keys must support automatic annual rotation. The company must use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to encrypt the data. Which type of keys should the developer use to meet these requirements?

options.A: Amazon S3 managed keys
options.B: Symmetric customer managed keys with key material that is generated by AWS
options.C: Asymmetric customer managed keys with key material that is generated by AWS
options.D: Symmetric customer managed keys with imported key material

en.explanation:
## Scenario
The developer must migrate on-premises data to S3 with encryption that:
1. Uses **AWS KMS** to encrypt the data, and
2. Supports **automatic annual key rotation**.

## Correct Answer: B — Symmetric customer managed keys with key material generated by AWS

AWS KMS only supports automatic rotation for a very specific kind of key. Automatic key rotation is supported only on symmetric encryption KMS keys with key material that AWS KMS generates (AWS_KMS origin). By default, when you enable automatic rotation of a customer managed KMS key, AWS KMS rotates the key material of the KMS key one year (approximately 365 days) from the enable date and every year thereafter — exactly matching the "automatic annual rotation" requirement.

You enable it with a single API call:
```bash
aws kms enable-key-rotation --key-id <key-id-or-arn>
```

## Why the other options are wrong

**A. Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3)** — This is server-side encryption with keys managed by S3, **not by AWS KMS**. The question explicitly states "The company must use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to encrypt the data," so SSE-S3 fails the requirement. Although S3 rotates its internal keys, the customer cannot configure or manage rotation, and SSE-S3 is not a KMS-based encryption option.

**C. Asymmetric customer managed keys with AWS-generated material** — Asymmetric KMS keys cannot be automatically rotated. Automatic key rotation is supported only on symmetric encryption KMS keys. You cannot enable automatic rotation of asymmetric KMS keys, HMAC KMS keys, KMS keys with imported key material, or KMS keys in a custom key store. Asymmetric keys are intended for digital signatures or public-key encryption, not bulk data encryption like S3 object encryption (S3 SSE-KMS requires symmetric KMS keys).

**D. Symmetric customer managed keys with imported key material (BYOK / EXTERNAL origin)** — KMS cannot automatically rotate keys whose material was imported, because AWS does not have the means to generate replacement key material that matches what you imported. You cannot enable automatic rotation of asymmetric KMS keys, HMAC KMS keys, KMS keys with imported key material, or KMS keys in a custom key store. With imported keys you must perform manual rotation by importing new material into a new KMS key.

## References
- [Rotating AWS KMS keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotate-keys.html)
- [EnableKeyRotation API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/APIReference/API_EnableKeyRotation.html)
- [Enable automatic key rotation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotating-keys-enable.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员计划将公司本地数据迁移到 Amazon S3。数据必须加密，并且加密密钥必须支持自动年度轮换。公司必须使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 来加密数据。开发人员应该使用哪种类型的密钥才能满足这些要求？

options.A: Amazon S3 管理密钥
options.B: 对称的客户管理密钥，密钥材料由 AWS 生成。
options.C: 非对称客户管理密钥，密钥材料由 AWS 生成。
options.D: 采用进口钥匙材料的对称式客户管理钥匙

zh.explanation:
## 场景
开发人员必须将本地数据迁移到 S3，使用满足以下条件的加密：
1. 使用 **AWS KMS** 加密数据，以及
2. 支持**自动年度密钥轮换**。

## 正确答案：B — 对称客户托管密钥，密钥材料由 AWS 生成

AWS KMS 仅支持特定类型密钥的自动轮换。自动密钥轮换仅在对称加密 KMS 密钥上受支持，其密钥材料由 AWS KMS 生成（AWS_KMS 源）。默认情况下，当您启用客户托管 KMS 密钥的自动轮换时，AWS KMS 会在启用日期后约一年（大约 365 天）内轮换 KMS 密钥的密钥材料，之后每年轮换一次 — 完全符合"自动年度轮换"的要求。

您可以通过单个 API 调用启用它：
```bash
aws kms enable-key-rotation --key-id <key-id-or-arn>
```

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**A. Amazon S3 托管密钥（SSE-S3）** — 这是由 S3 管理的密钥的服务器端加密，**不是由 AWS KMS 管理**。问题明确指出"公司必须使用 AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）加密数据"，所以 SSE-S3 不满足要求。虽然 S3 轮换其内部密钥，但客户无法配置或管理轮换，而且 SSE-S3 不是基于 KMS 的加密选项。

**C. 非对称客户托管密钥，使用 AWS 生成的材料** — 非对称 KMS 密钥无法自动轮换。自动密钥轮换仅在对称加密 KMS 密钥上受支持。您无法启用非对称 KMS 密钥、HMAC KMS 密钥、导入密钥材料的 KMS 密钥或自定义密钥存储中的 KMS 密钥的自动轮换。非对称密钥用于数字签名或公钥加密，不用于批量数据加密，例如 S3 对象加密（S3 SSE-KMS 需要对称 KMS 密钥）。

**D. 对称客户托管密钥，使用导入的密钥材料（BYOK / EXTERNAL 源）** — KMS 无法自动轮换材料已导入的密钥，因为 AWS 没有办法生成与您导入的密钥材料相匹配的替换密钥材料。您无法启用非对称 KMS 密钥、HMAC KMS 密钥、导入密钥材料的 KMS 密钥或自定义密钥存储中的 KMS 密钥的自动轮换。对于导入的密钥，您必须通过将新材料导入新 KMS 密钥来执行手动轮换。

## 参考资源
- [轮换 AWS KMS 密钥](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotate-keys.html)
- [EnableKeyRotation API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/APIReference/API_EnableKeyRotation.html)
- [启用自动密钥轮换](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotating-keys-enable.html)

en.question: A team of developers is using an AWS CodePipeline pipeline as a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) mechanism for a web application. A developer has written unit tests to programmatically test the functionality of the application code. The unit tests produce a test report that shows the results of each individual check. The developer now wants to run these tests automatically during the CI/CD process. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Write a Git pre-commit hook that runs the tests before every commit. Ensure that each developer who is working on the project has the pre-commit hook installed locally. Review the test report and resolve any issues before pushing changes to AWS CodeCommit.
options.B: Add a new stage to the pipeline. Use AWS CodeBuild as the provider. Add the new stage after the stage that deploys code revisions to the test environment. Write a buildspec that fails the CodeBuild stage if any test does not pass. Use the test reports feature of CodeBuild to integrate the report with the CodeBuild console. View the test results in CodeBuild. Resolve any issues.
options.C: Add a new stage to the pipeline. Use AWS CodeBuild as the provider. Add the new stage before the stage that deploys code revisions to the test environment. Write a buildspec that fails the CodeBuild stage if any test does not pass. Use the test reports feature of CodeBuild to integrate the report with the CodeBuild console. View the test results in CodeBuild. Resolve any issues.
options.D: Add a new stage to the pipeline. Use Jenkins as the provider. Configure CodePipeline to use Jenkins to run the unit tests. Write a Jenkinsfile that fails the stage if any test does not pass. Use the test report plugin for Jenkins to integrate the report with the Jenkins dashboard. View the test results in Jenkins. Resolve any issues.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A team uses AWS CodePipeline for CI/CD. Developers have unit tests that produce a test report. They want to run these tests automatically as part of the pipeline with the **least operational effort**, and they need to view the test report.

## Correct Answer: C

The optimal solution is to add a new CodeBuild stage to the pipeline **before** the deployment stage, write a buildspec that runs the unit tests (failing the stage on test failure), and use CodeBuild's native test reports feature to view results in the CodeBuild console.

**Why this is best:**

- CodeBuild is natively integrated with CodePipeline as an action provider, so adding a CodeBuild stage requires minimal configuration.
- CodeBuild has a built-in **Test Reports** feature: you add a report group name to the buildspec file of a build project with information about your test cases. When you run the build project, the test cases are run and a test report is created.
- Reports support standard formats: For test reports, CodeBuild supports the following formats: Cucumber JSON, JUnit XML, NUnit XML, NUnit3 XML, TestNG XML, and Visual Studio TRX.
- Results are viewable directly in the CodeBuild console: You can view metrics such as Pass Rate %, Test Run Duration, and number of Passed versus Failed/Error test cases in one location.
- Running the tests **before** the deploy stage ensures broken code never reaches the test environment — this is the standard CI/CD best practice (build → test → deploy).

Example buildspec snippet:

```yaml
version: 0.2
phases:
  install:
    runtime-versions:
      java: openjdk8
  build:
    commands:
      - mvn test     # Non-zero exit fails the CodeBuild stage
reports:
  unit-test-reports:
    files:
      - 'target/surefire-reports/*.xml'
    file-format: JunitXml
```

If any test fails, the test command exits non-zero, the CodeBuild action fails, and the pipeline stops before deployment.

## Why the other options are wrong

**A. Git pre-commit hooks locally** – This relies on every developer correctly installing and maintaining the hook on each workstation. It is not part of the CI/CD pipeline (the requirement explicitly says "during the CI/CD process"). It also produces no centralized test report and can be bypassed with `git commit --no-verify`. High operational overhead to standardize across the team.

**B. CodeBuild stage AFTER the deploy-to-test stage** – Technically works, but logically wrong: it deploys broken code to the test environment first, then discovers the failure. This wastes deployment cycles and can leave a broken application running in the test environment. It does not reduce operational effort vs. C; it actually increases it because failed deployments must be cleaned up. The pipeline best practice is to gate the deploy with tests, not the other way around.

**D. Jenkins as the provider** – Requires provisioning, securing, patching, and maintaining a Jenkins server (or Jenkins controller/agents), installing the test report plugin, and configuring CodePipeline-Jenkins integration. This is significantly more operational effort than using the fully managed, natively integrated CodeBuild service.

## References

- [Test reports in AWS CodeBuild](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/test-reporting.html)
- [Test report using the AWS CLI sample](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/sample-test-report-cli.html)
- [Test Reports with AWS CodeBuild – AWS DevOps Blog](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/devops/test-reports-with-aws-codebuild/)
- [AWS CodeBuild action in CodePipeline](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeBuild.html)

zh.question: 一个开发团队使用 AWS CodePipeline 流水线作为 Web 应用程序的持续集成和持续交付 (CI/CD) 机制。一位开发人员编写了单元测试，以编程方式测试应用程序代码的功能。这些单元测试会生成一份测试报告，其中显示了每个测试的结果。现在，该开发人员希望在 CI/CD 过程中自动运行这些测试。哪种解决方案能够以最小的运维工作量满足此需求？

options.A: 编写一个 Git pre-commit hook，在每次提交之前运行测试。确保参与项目的每位开发人员都在本地安装了该 pre-commit hook。在将更改推送到 AWS CodeCommit 之前，检查测试报告并解决所有问题。
options.B: 向流水线添加一个新阶段。使用 AWS CodeBuild 作为提供程序。将新阶段添加到将代码版本部署到测试环境的阶段之后。编写一个构建规范，如果任何测试未通过，则使 CodeBuild 阶段失败。使用 CodeBuild 的测试报告功能将报告集成到 CodeBuild 控制台中。在 CodeBuild 中查看测试结果。解决所有问题。
options.C: 向流水线添加一个新阶段。使用 AWS CodeBuild 作为提供程序。将新阶段添加到将代码版本部署到测试环境的阶段之前。编写一个构建规范，如果任何测试未通过，则使 CodeBuild 阶段失败。使用 CodeBuild 的测试报告功能将报告集成到 CodeBuild 控制台中。在 CodeBuild 中查看测试结果。解决所有问题。
options.D: 向流水线添加一个新阶段。使用 Jenkins 作为提供程序。配置 CodePipeline 以使用 Jenkins 运行单元测试。编写一个 Jenkinsfile，如果任何测试未通过，则该阶段失败。使用 Jenkins 的测试报告插件将报告集成到 Jenkins 控制面板中。在 Jenkins 中查看测试结果。解决所有问题。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一个团队使用 AWS CodePipeline 进行 CI/CD。开发者有产生测试报告的单元测试。他们希望在管道中自动运行这些测试，**操作工作量最少**，并且需要查看测试报告。

## 正确答案：C

最优解决方案是在部署阶段**之前**向管道添加新的 CodeBuild 阶段，编写一个运行单元测试的 buildspec（测试失败时使该阶段失败），并使用 CodeBuild 的原生测试报告功能在 CodeBuild 控制台中查看结果。

**为什么这是最好的：**

- CodeBuild 与 CodePipeline 原生集成作为一个操作提供者，因此添加 CodeBuild 阶段只需最少的配置。
- CodeBuild 具有内置的**测试报告**功能：你在构建项目的 buildspec 文件中添加报告组名称以及有关测试用例的信息。当你运行构建项目时，测试用例被执行，测试报告被创建。
- 报告支持标准格式：对于测试报告，CodeBuild 支持以下格式：Cucumber JSON、JUnit XML、NUnit XML、NUnit3 XML、TestNG XML 和 Visual Studio TRX。
- 结果可直接在 CodeBuild 控制台中查看：你可以在一个位置查看指标，例如通过率 %、测试运行持续时间以及通过与失败/错误测试用例的数量。
- 在部署阶段**之前**运行测试可确保破损的代码永远不会到达测试环境——这是标准的 CI/CD 最佳实践（构建 → 测试 → 部署）。

buildspec 片段示例：

```yaml
version: 0.2
phases:
  install:
    runtime-versions:
      java: openjdk8
  build:
    commands:
      - mvn test     # 非零退出使 CodeBuild 阶段失败
reports:
  unit-test-reports:
    files:
      - 'target/surefire-reports/*.xml'
    file-format: JunitXml
```

如果任何测试失败，测试命令以非零状态退出，CodeBuild 操作失败，管道在部署前停止。

## 为什么其他选项错误

**A. 本地 Git pre-commit 钩子** – 这依赖于每个开发者正确安装和维护每个工作站上的钩子。它不是 CI/CD 管道的一部分（要求明确说明"在 CI/CD 过程中"）。它也不会生成集中的测试报告，可以用 `git commit --no-verify` 绕过。在团队中标准化的操作开销很高。

**B. 部署到测试阶段后的 CodeBuild 阶段** – 从技术上讲可行，但逻辑错误：它首先将破损的代码部署到测试环境，然后才发现故障。这会浪费部署周期，可能在测试环境中留下破损的应用程序。相比 C，它不会减少操作工作量；实际上会增加，因为失败的部署必须被清理。管道最佳实践是用测试来限制部署，而不是相反。

**D. Jenkins 作为提供者** – 需要预配、保护、修补和维护 Jenkins 服务器（或 Jenkins 控制器/代理），安装测试报告插件，并配置 CodePipeline-Jenkins 集成。这比使用完全托管、原生集成的 CodeBuild 服务的操作工作量要多得多。

## 参考资源

- [Test reports in AWS CodeBuild](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/test-reporting.html)
- [Test report using the AWS CLI sample](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/sample-test-report-cli.html)
- [Test Reports with AWS CodeBuild – AWS DevOps Blog](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/devops/test-reports-with-aws-codebuild/)
- [AWS CodeBuild action in CodePipeline](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeBuild.html)

en.question: A company has multiple Amazon VPC endpoints in the same VPC. A developer needs to configure an Amazon S3 bucket policy so users can access an S3 bucket only by using these VPC endpoints. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create multiple S3 bucket polices by using each VPC endpoint ID that have the aws:SourceVpce value in the StringNotEquals condition.
options.B: Create a single S3 bucket policy that has the aws:SourceVpc value and in the StringNotEquals condition to use VPC ID.
options.C: Create a single S3 bucket policy that has the aws:SourceVpce value and in the StringNotEquals condition to use vpce*.
options.D: Create a single S3 bucket policy that has multiple aws:sourceVpce value in the StringNotEquals condition. Repeat for all the VPC endpoint IDs.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer needs an S3 bucket policy that restricts access so users can ONLY reach the bucket through a specific set of VPC endpoints (multiple endpoints in the same VPC).

The standard AWS pattern is a **Deny** statement with `StringNotEquals` on `aws:SourceVpce` — i.e., "deny if the request did NOT originate from one of these VPC endpoints." The `aws:SourceVpce` condition key accepts an array of VPC endpoint IDs, so a single statement can list all of them.

## Correct Answer: D

A single bucket policy statement with `Effect: Deny` and a `StringNotEquals` condition that lists all allowed VPC endpoint IDs in the `aws:SourceVpce` array is the AWS-recommended pattern. To allow traffic from only the VPC endpoints that you specify, use the aws:SourceVpce key in your bucket policy. The example bucket policy denies upload permissions unless the upload request comes from the vpce-1111111 or vpce-2222222 VPC endpoints, using StringNotEquals with an array of VPC endpoint IDs.

Example policy (matching option D):

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Sid": "Access-to-specific-VPCEs-only",
    "Effect": "Deny",
    "Principal": "*",
    "Action": "s3:*",
    "Resource": [
      "arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket",
      "arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/*"
    ],
    "Condition": {
      "StringNotEquals": {
        "aws:SourceVpce": ["vpce-1111111", "vpce-2222222", "vpce-3333333"]
      }
    }
  }]
}
```

The logic: if the source VPC endpoint is NOT one of the listed IDs, deny access. Requests coming through the listed endpoints fall outside the deny condition and are allowed (assuming an Allow exists in IAM or another statement). The aws:SourceVpce condition doesn't require an ARN for the VPC endpoint resource, only the VPC endpoint ID.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Multiple bucket policies, one per VPC endpoint** — An S3 bucket can only have **one** bucket policy attached. You cannot create "multiple S3 bucket policies." This option is structurally invalid.

- **B. Single policy with `aws:SourceVpc` (VPC ID) in StringNotEquals** — `aws:SourceVpc` filters by the entire VPC, not by specific VPC endpoints. The requirement is to restrict to *these specific endpoints*; using the VPC ID would allow ANY endpoint in that VPC (including ones added later) and does not meet the stated requirement of limiting access to *these* endpoints. aws:sourceVpc restricts access based on the VPC ID, not the endpoint.

- **C. Single policy using a wildcard `vpce*`** — `StringNotEquals` performs exact string matching and does not support wildcards. To use wildcards you must use `StringNotLike`. Even if it did work, `vpce*` would match every VPC endpoint in AWS, defeating the purpose of restricting access to *specific* endpoints. See [IAM string condition operators](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/UserGuide/reference_policies_elements_condition_operators.html#Conditions_String).

## Note on the StringNotEquals + Deny Pattern

Several commenters questioned why `StringNotEquals` is used instead of `StringEquals`. The answer: AWS's official example uses `Effect: Deny` combined with `StringNotEquals` — meaning "deny everything except requests from these endpoints." This is the documented pattern in [Controlling access from VPC endpoints with bucket policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-bucket-policies-vpc-endpoint.html). Using `StringEquals` with `Allow` is also possible but is not what option D describes; D directly mirrors the AWS reference policy, which is why it is correct.

## References

- [Controlling access from VPC endpoints with bucket policies (AWS S3 User Guide)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-bucket-policies-vpc-endpoint.html)
- [Limit Amazon S3 bucket access to certain IPs or VPCs (AWS re:Post)](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/block-s3-traffic-vpc-ip)
- [Use VPC endpoints to access Amazon S3 buckets from EC2 instances](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/s3-vpc-endpoints)

zh.question: 一家公司在同一个 Amazon VPC 中拥有多个 VPC 端点。开发人员需要配置 Amazon S3 存储桶策略，以便用户只能通过这些 VPC 端点访问 S3 存储桶。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 StringNotEquals 条件中具有 aws:SourceVpce 值的每个 VPC 端点 ID 创建多个 S3 存储桶策略。
options.B: 创建一个 S3 存储桶策略，其值为 aws:SourceVpc，并且在 StringNotEquals 条件中使用 VPC ID。
options.C: 创建一个 S3 存储桶策略，其值为 aws:SourceVpce，并且在 StringNotEquals 条件中使用 vpce*。
options.D: 创建一个 S3 存储桶策略，该策略的 StringNotEquals 条件包含多个 aws:sourceVpce 值。对所有 VPC 端点 ID 重复此操作。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

开发人员需要一个 S3 桶策略来限制访问权限，使用户只能通过特定的 VPC 端点集（同一 VPC 中的多个端点）来访问桶。

标准的 AWS 模式是一个 **Deny** 语句，使用 `StringNotEquals` 条件针对 `aws:SourceVpce` — 即"如果请求不是来自这些 VPC 端点之一，则拒绝"。`aws:SourceVpce` 条件键接受 VPC 端点 ID 数组，因此单个语句可以列出所有这些端点。

## 正确答案：D

使用 `Effect: Deny` 和 `StringNotEquals` 条件的单个桶策略语句，该条件在 `aws:SourceVpce` 数组中列出所有允许的 VPC 端点 ID，这是 AWS 推荐的模式。要仅允许来自指定 VPC 端点的流量，请在桶策略中使用 aws:SourceVpce 键。示例桶策略拒绝上传权限，除非上传请求来自 vpce-1111111 或 vpce-2222222 VPC 端点，使用 StringNotEquals 与 VPC 端点 ID 数组。

示例策略（与选项 D 匹配）：

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Sid": "Access-to-specific-VPCEs-only",
    "Effect": "Deny",
    "Principal": "*",
    "Action": "s3:*",
    "Resource": [
      "arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket",
      "arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/*"
    ],
    "Condition": {
      "StringNotEquals": {
        "aws:SourceVpce": ["vpce-1111111", "vpce-2222222", "vpce-3333333"]
      }
    }
  }]
}
```

逻辑是：如果源 VPC 端点不在列出的 ID 之中，则拒绝访问。来自列出端点的请求不在拒绝条件范围内，因此被允许（假设 IAM 或其他语句中存在 Allow）。aws:SourceVpce 条件不需要 VPC 端点资源的 ARN，只需要 VPC 端点 ID。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. 多个桶策略，每个 VPC 端点一个** — 一个 S3 桶只能附加**一个**桶策略。您无法创建"多个 S3 桶策略"。此选项在结构上是无效的。

- **B. 单个策略，在 StringNotEquals 中使用 `aws:SourceVpc`（VPC ID）** — `aws:SourceVpc` 按整个 VPC 进行过滤，而不是按特定 VPC 端点进行过滤。要求是限制访问到*这些特定端点*；使用 VPC ID 会允许该 VPC 中的任何端点（包括稍后添加的端点），不符合限制访问到*这些*端点的要求。aws:sourceVpc 基于 VPC ID（而不是端点）限制访问。

- **C. 单个策略，使用通配符 `vpce*`** — `StringNotEquals` 执行精确字符串匹配，不支持通配符。要使用通配符，必须使用 `StringNotLike`。即使它能工作，`vpce*` 也会匹配 AWS 中的每个 VPC 端点，违反了限制访问到*特定*端点的目的。请参阅 [IAM 字符串条件运算符](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/UserGuide/reference_policies_elements_condition_operators.html#Conditions_String)。

## 关于 StringNotEquals + Deny 模式的说明

一些评论者质疑为什么使用 `StringNotEquals` 而不是 `StringEquals`。答案是：AWS 官方示例使用 `Effect: Deny` 结合 `StringNotEquals` — 意思是"拒绝除来自这些端点的请求外的所有请求"。这是 [使用桶策略控制 VPC 端点的访问](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-bucket-policies-vpc-endpoint.html) 中记录的模式。使用 `StringEquals` 与 `Allow` 也是可能的，但不是选项 D 所描述的；D 直接镜像 AWS 参考策略，这就是为什么它是正确的。

## 参考资源

- [使用桶策略控制 VPC 端点的访问（AWS S3 用户指南）](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-bucket-policies-vpc-endpoint.html)
- [限制 Amazon S3 桶访问到特定 IP 或 VPC（AWS re:Post）](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/block-s3-traffic-vpc-ip)
- [使用 VPC 端点从 EC2 实例访问 Amazon S3 桶](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/s3-vpc-endpoints)

en.question: A company uses a custom root certificate authority certificate chain (Root CA Cert) that is 10 KB in size to generate SSL certificates for its on-premises HTTPS endpoints. One of the company’s cloud-based applications has hundreds of AWS Lambda functions that pull data from these endpoints. A developer updated the trust store of the Lambda execution environment to use the Root CA Cert when the Lambda execution environment is initialized. The developer bundled the Root CA Cert as a text file in the Lambda deployment bundle. After 3 months of development, the Root CA Cert is no longer valid and must be updated. The developer needs a more efficient solution to update the Root CA Cert for all deployed Lambda functions. The solution must not include rebuilding or updating all Lambda functions that use the Root CA Cert. The solution must also work for all development, testing, and production environments. Each environment is managed in a separate AWS account. Which combination of steps should the developer take to meet these requirements MOST cost- effectively? (Choose two.)

options.A: Store the Root CA Cert as a secret in AWS Secrets Manager. Create a resource-based policy. Add IAM users to allow access to the secret.
options.B: Store the Root CA Cert as a SecureString parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Create a resource-based policy. Add IAM users to allow access to the policy.
options.C: Store the Root CA Cert in an Amazon S3 bucket. Create a resource-based policy to allow access to the bucket.
options.D: Refactor the Lambda code to load the Root CA Cert from the Root CA Cert’s location. Modify the runtime trust store inside the Lambda function handler.
options.E: Refactor the Lambda code to load the Root CA Cert from the Root CA Cert’s location. Modify the runtime trust store outside the Lambda function handler.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A company has hundreds of Lambda functions across multiple AWS accounts (dev/test/prod) that pull data from on-premises HTTPS endpoints using a custom **10 KB Root CA Cert**. Currently the cert is bundled in each Lambda deployment package, which means every cert renewal requires rebuilding/redeploying every function. The developer needs a centralized, externalized storage location for the cert so it can be updated once and consumed by all Lambda functions without redeployment.

## Correct Answer: A and E

### A — Store the Root CA Cert as a secret in AWS Secrets Manager with a resource-based policy

The cert is **10 KB**, which exceeds Parameter Store limits but fits comfortably in Secrets Manager. AWS explicitly increased the secret size to handle this exact use case: [AWS announcement](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2019/10/aws-secrets-manager-supports-increased-secret-size-api-request-rate/) — "AWS Secrets Manager now supports larger secret size of up to 10 Kb, making it easier for customers to manage secrets such as certificates with a long chain of trust." Secrets Manager later increased the limit to 64 KB. Resource-based policies on the secret allow **cross-account access** from Lambda execution roles in dev/test/prod accounts.

### E — Refactor the Lambda code to load the Root CA Cert and modify the runtime trust store **outside** the function handler

Code outside the handler runs once per execution environment (cold start / init phase) and is reused across many invocations on a warm container. Modifying the trust store outside the handler:
- Avoids re-fetching the cert on every invocation (lower API/KMS costs and latency)
- Ensures the trust store is configured before the handler runs
- Is the AWS-recommended pattern for initialization logic ([Lambda best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/best-practices.html))

## Why the other options are wrong

### B — SSM Parameter Store SecureString
Parameter Store has hard size limits: **Standard = 4 KB, Advanced = 8 KB**. The cert is **10 KB and will not fit in either tier**. From the [Parameter Store docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html): Standard parameters max 4 KB; Advanced parameters max 8 KB. Additionally, Parameter Store does **not support resource-based policies** for cross-account sharing in the way the option describes — cross-account access requires IAM role assumption. The option's wording "Add IAM users to allow access to the policy" is also semantically wrong (access should be to the parameter).

### C — S3 bucket
While S3 is technically cheaper for raw storage, this option is incomplete. A Root CA private cert is sensitive material and should be stored in a service designed for secrets with built-in encryption, versioning, audit, and rotation capabilities. More importantly, AWS recommends Secrets Manager specifically for managing certificate chains ([Use Secrets Manager for private certificates](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/security/use-aws-secrets-manager-to-simplify-the-management-of-private-certificates/)). The "MOST cost-effective" wording is balanced against the security/operational requirements of certificate management — Secrets Manager is the AWS-recommended service for this scenario. (Note: a sizable minority of community votes select C for pure cost reasons; the official answer favors Secrets Manager for security best practice.)

### D — Modify the trust store **inside** the handler
This causes the cert to be fetched and the trust store rebuilt on **every invocation**, dramatically increasing Secrets Manager API calls, KMS decrypt calls, latency, and cost. It also means each invocation pays the modification overhead. This contradicts Lambda performance best practices and is less cost-effective.

## Summary
- **A** — Secrets Manager fits the 10 KB cert and provides cross-account resource-based policies
- **E** — Initialize the trust store outside the handler so it's loaded once per execution environment

## Code Pattern (Python, illustrative)

```python
import boto3, ssl, tempfile, os

# Runs once per execution environment (init phase) — Option E
_secrets = boto3.client("secretsmanager")
_cert = _secrets.get_secret_value(SecretId="prod/RootCACert")["SecretString"]

_ca_path = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "rootCA.pem")
with open(_ca_path, "w") as f:
    f.write(_cert)

# Update the runtime trust store
os.environ["AWS_CA_BUNDLE"] = _ca_path
ssl_context = ssl.create_default_context(cafile=_ca_path)

def lambda_handler(event, context):
    # use ssl_context for HTTPS calls to on-prem endpoints
    ...
```

zh.question: 一家公司使用一个大小为 10 KB 的自定义根证书颁发机构证书链（根 CA 证书）为其本地 HTTPS 端点生成 SSL 证书。该公司的一个云应用程序包含数百个 AWS Lambda 函数，这些函数会从这些端点提取数据。开发人员在 Lambda 执行环境初始化时更新了其信任存储区，使其使用根 CA 证书。开发人员将根 CA 证书作为文本文件打包到 Lambda 部署包中。经过 3 个月的开发，根 CA 证书已失效，必须进行更新。开发人员需要一个更高效的解决方案来更新所有已部署 Lambda 函数的根 CA 证书。该解决方案不得包含重建或更新所有使用根 CA 证书的 Lambda 函数。此外，该解决方案必须适用于所有开发、测试和生产环境。每个环境都在单独的 AWS 账户中进行管理。开发人员应采取哪些步骤组合才能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将根 CA 证书作为密钥存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。创建基于资源的策略。添加 IAM 用户以允许访问该密钥。
options.B: 将根 CA 证书作为 SecureString 参数存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。创建基于资源的策略。添加 IAM 用户以允许访问该策略。
options.C: 将根 CA 证书存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。创建基于资源的策略以允许访问该存储桶。
options.D: 重构 Lambda 代码，使其从根 CA 证书所在位置加载根 CA 证书。修改 Lambda 函数处理程序内部的运行时信任存储。
options.E: 重构 Lambda 代码，使其从根 CA 证书所在位置加载根 CA 证书。在 Lambda 函数处理程序之外修改运行时信任存储。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一家公司在多个AWS账户（开发/测试/生产）中有数百个Lambda函数，这些函数从本地HTTPS端点拉取数据，使用一个自定义的**10 KB根CA证书**。目前，该证书被打包在每个Lambda部署包中，这意味着每次证书更新都需要重建/重新部署每个函数。开发人员需要一个集中的、外部化的存储位置来存储该证书，以便可以一次性更新并被所有Lambda函数使用，而无需重新部署。

## 正确答案：A和E

### A — 将根CA证书作为密钥存储在AWS Secrets Manager中，并配置基于资源的策略

该证书为**10 KB**，超过了Parameter Store的限制，但完全适合Secrets Manager。AWS明确增加了密钥大小以处理这个确切的用例：[AWS公告](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2019/10/aws-secrets-manager-supports-increased-secret-size-api-request-rate/) — "AWS Secrets Manager现在支持更大的密钥大小，最大10 Kb，使客户更容易管理诸如具有长信任链的证书等密钥。" Secrets Manager后来将限制增加到64 KB。密钥上的基于资源的策略允许来自开发/测试/生产账户中Lambda执行角色的**跨账户访问**。

### E — 重构Lambda代码以在函数处理程序**外部**加载根CA证书并修改运行时信任存储

处理程序外部的代码在每个执行环境运行一次（冷启动/初始化阶段），并在一个预热容器中跨多次调用重复使用。在处理程序外部修改信任存储：
- 避免在每次调用时重新获取证书（降低API/KMS成本和延迟）
- 确保在处理程序运行之前配置信任存储
- 是AWS推荐的初始化逻辑模式（[Lambda最佳实践](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/best-practices.html)）

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

### B — SSM Parameter Store SecureString
Parameter Store有严格的大小限制：**标准 = 4 KB，高级 = 8 KB**。该证书为**10 KB，无法适配任何一层**。根据[Parameter Store文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html)：标准参数最大4 KB；高级参数最大8 KB。此外，Parameter Store**不支持基于资源的策略**来实现选项所描述的跨账户共享方式 — 跨账户访问需要IAM角色假设。该选项的措辞"添加IAM用户以允许访问策略"在语义上也是错误的（访问应该是针对参数的）。

### C — S3桶
虽然S3在原始存储方面成本较低，但此选项不完整。根CA私钥证书是敏感材料，应该存储在为密钥设计的服务中，该服务具有内置加密、版本控制、审计和轮换功能。更重要的是，AWS特别推荐使用Secrets Manager来管理证书链（[使用Secrets Manager管理私有证书](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/security/use-aws-secrets-manager-to-simplify-the-management-of-private-certificates/)）。"最具成本效益"的措辞需要与证书管理的安全/运营要求进行权衡 — Secrets Manager是此场景中AWS推荐的服务。（注：社区投票中相当一部分人出于纯粹的成本考虑选择C；官方答案倾向于使用Secrets Manager作为安全最佳实践。）

### D — 在处理程序**内部**修改信任存储
这会导致证书在**每次调用时**被获取并重建信任存储，大幅增加Secrets Manager API调用、KMS解密调用、延迟和成本。这也意味着每次调用都要支付修改开销。这违反了Lambda性能最佳实践，成本效益较低。

## 总结
- **A** — Secrets Manager适配10 KB证书，并提供跨账户基于资源的策略
- **E** — 在处理程序外部初始化信任存储，使其每个执行环境加载一次

## 代码模式（Python，示例）

```python
import boto3, ssl, tempfile, os

# 每个执行环境运行一次（初始化阶段） — 选项E
_secrets = boto3.client("secretsmanager")
_cert = _secrets.get_secret_value(SecretId="prod/RootCACert")["SecretString"]

_ca_path = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "rootCA.pem")
with open(_ca_path, "w") as f:
    f.write(_cert)

# 更新运行时信任存储
os.environ["AWS_CA_BUNDLE"] = _ca_path
ssl_context = ssl.create_default_context(cafile=_ca_path)

def lambda_handler(event, context):
    # 使用ssl_context对本地端点进行HTTPS调用
    ...
```

en.question: A developer maintains applications that store several secrets in AWS Secrets Manager. The applications use secrets that have changed over time. The developer needs to identify required secrets that are still in use. The developer does not want to cause any application downtime. What should the developer do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure an AWS CloudTrail log file delivery to an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for the GetSecretValue Secrets Manager API operation requests.
options.B: Create a secretsmanager-secret-unused AWS Config managed rule. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to initiate notifications when the AWS Config managed rule is met.
options.C: Deactivate the applications secrets and monitor the applications error logs temporarily.
options.D: Configure AWS X-Ray for the applications. Create a sampling rule to match the GetSecretValue Secrets Manager API operation requests.

en.explanation:
# Identifying secrets still in use without causing downtime

## Scenario
A developer manages many secrets in AWS Secrets Manager. Over time, some secrets are no longer used by applications. The developer needs to determine which secrets are *still in use* and must do so **without causing application downtime**.

## Correct answer: B
Create the AWS Config managed rule **`secretsmanager-secret-unused`** and use an Amazon EventBridge rule to deliver notifications when the rule changes compliance state.

The secretsmanager-secret-unused rule checks if AWS Secrets Manager secrets have been accessed within a specified number of days. The rule is NON_COMPLIANT if a secret has not been accessed in 'unusedForDays' number of days. The default value is 90 days.

This is purely an observational/compliance check — it doesn't disable, rotate, or delete the secrets, so there is **zero risk of application downtime**. By inverting the result (any secret that does NOT trigger the rule has been accessed within the period) the developer easily identifies the secrets still in use. EventBridge can then react to the AWS Config compliance-change events and send notifications (e.g., to SNS or a Lambda function).

This is exactly the pattern AWS recommends. See [secretsmanager-secret-unused - AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/secretsmanager-secret-unused.html) and [Monitor Secrets Manager secrets for compliance using AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/configuring-awsconfig-rules.html).

## Why the other options are wrong

### A. CloudTrail logs to S3 + CloudWatch alarm on `GetSecretValue`
This *can* technically work but it requires significant additional engineering:
- The developer would have to enable a CloudTrail data event/management trail, ship logs to S3, then query (e.g., Athena) to aggregate `GetSecretValue` events per secret over a long observation window (e.g., 90 days) to know what is *not* being called.
- A single CloudWatch alarm on `GetSecretValue` only tells you that *some* secret was retrieved — it does not break out usage **per secret name/ARN**, which is what the developer needs.
- AWS Config already provides a purpose-built managed rule for exactly this question, making A an unnecessarily heavy and incomplete solution.

### C. Deactivate secrets and watch for application errors
This is exactly what the requirement forbids. Disabling a secret that is actually in use will cause the application calling `GetSecretValue` to fail, leading to **application downtime** — a direct violation of the stated constraint.

### D. AWS X-Ray with a sampling rule for `GetSecretValue`
X-Ray provides distributed tracing of requests through instrumented applications. It is not designed to enumerate which Secrets Manager secrets are accessed across all applications, and a sampling rule only controls **which traces are recorded**, not which secrets are tracked. It also requires every application to be instrumented with the X-Ray SDK, which is far more invasive than the AWS Config approach. See [AWS X-Ray sampling rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-console-sampling.html).

## Key takeaway
For "is this resource being used?" compliance/governance questions in AWS Secrets Manager, reach for the **`secretsmanager-secret-unused` AWS Config managed rule** combined with EventBridge for notifications — it's the native, low-effort, no-downtime solution.

zh.question: 一位开发人员维护着一些应用程序，这些应用程序在 AWS Secrets Manager 中存储了多个密钥。这些应用程序使用的密钥会随着时间推移而发生变化。开发人员需要识别出仍在使用的必要密钥，并且不希望造成任何应用程序停机。为了满足这些要求，开发人员应该怎么做？

options.A: 配置 AWS CloudTrail 日志文件传输到 Amazon S3 存储桶。为 GetSecretValue Secrets Manager API 操作请求创建 Amazon CloudWatch 警报。
options.B: 创建一个名为 secretsmanager-secret-unused 的 AWS Config 托管规则。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，以便在满足 AWS Config 托管规则时启动通知。
options.C: 暂时停用应用程序密钥并监控应用程序错误日志。
options.D: 为应用程序配置 AWS X-Ray。创建抽样规则以匹配 GetSecretValue Secrets Manager API 操作请求。

zh.explanation:
# 识别仍在使用的密钥而不造成停机

## 场景
开发者在 AWS Secrets Manager 中管理许多密钥。随着时间推移，某些密钥不再被应用程序使用。开发者需要确定哪些密钥*仍在使用*，并且必须**不能造成应用程序停机**。

## 正确答案：B
创建 AWS Config 托管规则 **`secretsmanager-secret-unused`** 并使用 Amazon EventBridge 规则在规则更改合规状态时发送通知。

secretsmanager-secret-unused 规则检查 AWS Secrets Manager 密钥是否在指定天数内被访问过。如果密钥在"unusedForDays"天数内未被访问，规则则为 NON_COMPLIANT。默认值为 90 天。

这纯粹是一种观察/合规性检查 — 它不会禁用、轮转或删除密钥，因此**完全没有应用程序停机的风险**。通过反转结果（任何不触发规则的密钥都是在该期间内被访问过的），开发者可以轻松识别仍在使用的密钥。EventBridge 可以对 AWS Config 合规状态变化事件做出反应，并发送通知（例如，发送到 SNS 或 Lambda 函数）。

这正是 AWS 推荐的模式。参见 [secretsmanager-secret-unused - AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/secretsmanager-secret-unused.html) 和 [Monitor Secrets Manager secrets for compliance using AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/configuring-awsconfig-rules.html)。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

### A. CloudTrail 日志到 S3 + CloudWatch 告警用于 `GetSecretValue`
这在技术上*可以*工作，但需要大量额外的工程工作：
- 开发者必须启用 CloudTrail 数据事件/管理事件追踪，将日志发送到 S3，然后查询（例如使用 Athena）来汇总在较长观察窗口（例如 90 天）内每个密钥的 `GetSecretValue` 事件，以了解*哪些*密钥未被调用。
- 单个 `GetSecretValue` CloudWatch 告警只能告诉你*某个*密钥被检索了 — 它无法按密钥名称/ARN 分解使用情况，这正是开发者需要的。
- AWS Config 已经为这个问题提供了一个专门设计的托管规则，这使得选项 A 是一个不必要的重型且不完整的解决方案。

### C. 停用密钥并观察应用程序错误
这正是需求所禁止的。禁用实际上正在使用的密钥将导致调用 `GetSecretValue` 的应用程序失败，从而造成**应用程序停机** — 直接违反了规定的约束条件。

### D. AWS X-Ray 与用于 `GetSecretValue` 的采样规则
X-Ray 提供通过被检测的应用程序的请求的分布式追踪。它不是为了枚举跨所有应用程序访问了哪些 Secrets Manager 密钥而设计的，采样规则只控制**哪些追踪被记录**，而不是哪些密钥被追踪。它还要求每个应用程序都使用 X-Ray SDK 进行检测，这比 AWS Config 方法的侵入性要大得多。参见 [AWS X-Ray sampling rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-console-sampling.html)。

## 关键要点
对于 AWS Secrets Manager 中的"此资源是否被使用？"合规性/治理问题，应该使用 **`secretsmanager-secret-unused` AWS Config 托管规则**与 EventBridge 相结合来发送通知 — 这是原生的、低成本的、无停机的解决方案。

en.question: A developer is writing a serverless application that requires an AWS Lambda function to be invoked every 10 minutes. What is an automated and serverless way to invoke the function?

options.A: Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance based on Linux, and edit its /etc/crontab file by adding a command to periodically invoke the Lambda function.
options.B: Configure an environment variable named PERIOD for the Lambda function. Set the value to 600.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that runs on a regular schedule to invoke the Lambda function.
options.D: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic that has a subscription to the Lambda function with a 600-second timer.

en.explanation:
# Scheduled Lambda Invocation Every 10 Minutes

## Scenario
The developer needs to invoke a Lambda function on a fixed schedule (every 10 minutes) using a fully **automated** and **serverless** approach — no servers to manage, no manual triggers.

## Correct Answer: C — Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule

Amazon EventBridge (formerly CloudWatch Events) supports scheduled rules that fire on either a `rate(...)` or `cron(...)` expression and deliver an event to a target such as an AWS Lambda function. In EventBridge, you can create scheduled rules that run at regular intervals; to specify the rate you define a rate expression, and to specify time and dates you define a cron expression. You choose a schedule that runs at a regular rate, such as every 10 minutes, and specify the value and unit fields to define the rate.

For "every 10 minutes," you would use:

```text
rate(10 minutes)
```

This solution is fully serverless: AWS EventBridge is a fully managed serverless event bus that lets you create custom events like cron expressions or capture events from AWS services and external applications. When configured via the console, EventBridge must have permission to invoke the Lambda function, and if you use the EventBridge console to create the rule the console automatically adds the required permissions to the function's resource-based policy.

(Note: AWS now also recommends EventBridge Scheduler as an alternative — AWS recommends using Amazon EventBridge Scheduler instead, because it offers improved scalability, a wider set of target API operations, flexible time windows, and built-in retry and dead-letter queue support. Both EventBridge scheduled rules and EventBridge Scheduler satisfy option C.)

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. EC2 + cron in `/etc/crontab`** — This is **not serverless**. You must provision, patch, monitor, and pay for a continuously running EC2 instance just to fire a cron job. It also introduces a single point of failure and operational overhead, the opposite of the serverless requirement.

- **B. Lambda environment variable `PERIOD=600`** — Environment variables are simply key/value configuration data passed to the function at runtime. They do not trigger or schedule invocations.
