Signed URLs that are valid for such a short period are good for distributing content on-the-fly to a user for a specific purpose, such as distributing movie rentals or music downloads to customers on demand. This is exactly the pattern needed for firmware downloads — only entitled customers receive a valid signed URL, and the URL expires after a defined window.

This combination delivers the lowest cost because:
- A **single** CloudFront distribution serves all customers worldwide.
- Edge caching reduces repeated S3 GET requests and S3-to-internet egress.
- Signed URLs are a built-in feature — no extra compute (Lambda, API Gateway) is required.

[Serve private content with signed URLs and signed cookies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/PrivateContent.html)
[Use signed URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-signed-urls.html)

## Why the other options are wrong

**B. Create a dedicated CloudFront Distribution for each customer.**
CloudFront pricing is largely usage-based (data transfer + requests), but operationally creating one distribution per customer is unnecessary and adds management overhead. AWS accounts also have soft limits on the number of distributions per account (default 200), so this does not scale to "customers around the world." A single distribution with signed URLs already provides per-customer access control, so per-customer distributions add complexity and cost without benefit.

**C. Use Amazon CloudFront with AWS Lambda@Edge.**
Lambda@Edge is intended for request/response customization at edge locations (header manipulation, A/B routing, auth token validation against custom IdPs, etc.). It adds Lambda@Edge invocation and compute charges on every request. Since CloudFront natively supports signed URLs for access control, adding Lambda@Edge is unnecessary and increases cost — failing the "lowest cost" requirement.

**D. Use Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda to control access to an S3 bucket.**
This routes every firmware download through API Gateway + Lambda, which:
- Bypasses CloudFront edge caching, so each global download hits the origin region (high latency, higher S3 egress costs).
- Adds API Gateway request charges and Lambda invocation/duration charges.
- API Gateway has a 10 MB payload limit and Lambda has a 6 MB synchronous response limit — firmware images frequently exceed these sizes, making this approach technically unsuitable in addition to being more expensive.

[CloudFront Pricing](https://aws.amazon.com/cloudfront/pricing/)
[API Gateway Quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/limits.html)

zh.question: 一家公司需要向全球客户分发固件更新。哪种服务能够以最低的成本实现对下载访问权限的便捷安全控制？

options.A: 使用带有签名 URL 的 Amazon CloudFront 访问 Amazon S3。
options.B: 为每个客户创建一个专用的 Amazon CloudFront 分发。
options.C: 将 Amazon CloudFront 与 AWS Lambda@Edge 结合使用。
options.D: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 来控制对 S3 存储桶的访问。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一家公司需要向全球客户分发固件更新。该解决方案必须提供：
- **简单且安全的访问控制**来进行下载
- **最低成本**
- **全球覆盖**

## 正确答案：A — 对 Amazon S3 使用 Amazon CloudFront 和签名 URL

CloudFront 是一个全球 CDN，在靠近客户的边缘位置缓存内容，降低延迟和源站（S3）数据传输成本。许多通过互联网分发内容的公司希望限制对文档、业务数据、媒体流或仅供特定用户访问的内容的访问；要使用 CloudFront 安全地为此私有内容提供服务，您可以要求用户使用特殊的 CloudFront 签名 URL 或签名 Cookie 来访问您的私有内容。

签名 URL 提供受控的、有时间限制的访问：您可以使用仅在很短时间内有效的签名 URL 来分发私有内容——可能短至几分钟。有效期如此之短的签名 URL 适合于为特定目的动态分发内容给用户，例如按需向客户分发电影租赁或音乐下载。这正是固件下载所需的模式——只有有权限的客户才会收到有效的签名 URL，且该 URL 会在定义的时间窗口后过期。

这种组合提供最低成本，因为：
- **单个** CloudFront 分配为全球所有客户服务。
- 边缘缓存减少重复的 S3 GET 请求和 S3 到互联网的出口流量。
- 签名 URL 是内置功能——不需要额外的计算（Lambda、API Gateway）。

[使用签名 URL 和签名 Cookie 提供私有内容](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/PrivateContent.html)
[使用签名 URL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-signed-urls.html)

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**B. 为每个客户创建一个专用的 CloudFront 分配。**
CloudFront 定价主要基于使用量（数据传输 + 请求），但从运营角度来看，为每个客户创建一个分配是不必要的，会增加管理开销。AWS 账户对每个账户的分配数量也有软限制（默认为 200），因此无法扩展到"全球各地的客户"。单个分配加上签名 URL 已经提供了按客户的访问控制，因此按客户分配会增加复杂性和成本而没有任何好处。

**C. 使用 Amazon CloudFront 和 AWS Lambda@Edge。**
Lambda@Edge 旨在用于边缘位置的请求/响应自定义（标头操作、A/B 路由、针对自定义 IdP 的身份验证令牌验证等）。它在每个请求中都会增加 Lambda@Edge 调用和计算费用。由于 CloudFront 原生支持用于访问控制的签名 URL，添加 Lambda@Edge 是不必要的，并会增加成本——不符合"最低成本"的要求。

**D. 使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 来控制对 S3 存储桶的访问。**
这将每个固件下载都路由通过 API Gateway + Lambda，这样做会：
- 绕过 CloudFront 边缘缓存，因此每个全球下载都会命中源区域（高延迟、更高的 S3 出口成本）。
- 增加 API Gateway 请求费用和 Lambda 调用/持续时间费用。
- API Gateway 的最大有效负载限制为 10 MB，Lambda 的同步响应限制为 6 MB——固件映像经常超过这些大小，这使得此方法在技术上不适合，除了成本更高。

[CloudFront 定价](https://aws.amazon.com/cloudfront/pricing/)
[API Gateway 配额](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/limits.html)

en.question: A developer is testing an application that invokes an AWS Lambda function asynchronously. During the testing phase, the Lambda function fails to process after two retries. How can the developer troubleshoot the failure?

options.A: Configure AWS CloudTrail logging to investigate the invocation failures.
options.B: Configure Dead Letter Queues by sending events to Amazon SQS for investigation.
options.C: Configure Amazon Simple Workflow Service to process any direct unprocessed events.
options.D: Configure AWS Config to process any direct unprocessed events.

en.explanation:
# Lambda Async Invocation Failure Troubleshooting

## Scenario
A developer is testing an application that invokes a Lambda function **asynchronously**. After two failed retries, the developer needs a way to capture and investigate the failed events.

## Correct Answer: B — Configure a Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) sending events to Amazon SQS

When Lambda is invoked asynchronously, AWS Lambda automatically retries failed invocations (by default, twice) with exponential backoff. When your Lambda is invoked asynchronously and encounters errors, AWS Lambda automatically retries the invocation a predetermined number of times. If the function continues to fail, the event is forwarded to an Amazon SQS queue that acts as the dead letter queue. This setup enables you to analyze and troubleshoot problematic events effectively.

You can configure a DLQ on the Lambda function itself: You can choose an Amazon SQS standard queue or Amazon SNS standard topic for your dead-letter queue. FIFO queues and Amazon SNS FIFO topics are not supported.

The DLQ message includes useful debugging metadata: Lambda sends the event to the dead-letter queue as-is, with additional information in attributes. You can use this information to identify the error that the function returned, or to correlate the event with logs or an AWS X-Ray trace. RequestID (String) – The ID of the invocation request. This is exactly what the developer needs to investigate the failures.

CLI example to configure a DLQ:

```bash
aws lambda update-function-configuration \
  --function-name my-function \
  --dead-letter-config TargetArn=arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:123456789012:my-dlq
```

The Lambda execution role must have `sqs:SendMessage` permission on the DLQ.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. CloudTrail** — CloudTrail records AWS API management events (the *control plane* — e.g., who called `UpdateFunctionConfiguration`). It does **not** capture the runtime payload of failed asynchronous invocations or function execution errors. Function execution logs go to CloudWatch Logs, not CloudTrail, and the failed event payloads are only preserved via DLQ or Lambda Destinations.

- **C. Amazon Simple Workflow Service (SWF)** — SWF is a workflow-orchestration service for coordinating long-running, stateful tasks. It is not a mechanism for capturing failed Lambda async events; Lambda has no native integration that routes unprocessed async events to SWF.

- **D. AWS Config** — AWS Config tracks resource configuration changes and compliance against rules. It has no role in capturing failed Lambda invocation payloads or runtime processing errors.

## Note on modern alternative
Lambda Destinations is now the AWS-preferred mechanism for new projects, providing richer failure context. Dead Letter Queues (DLQ) have been available since 2016 and are a great way to handle asynchronous failure situations. Destinations provide more useful capabilities by passing additional function execution information, including code exception stack traces, to more destination services. Destinations and DLQs can be used together and at the same time although Destinations should be considered a more preferred solution. However, among the options offered, DLQ via SQS (B) is the correct answer.

## References
- [Capturing records of Lambda asynchronous invocations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-async-retain-records.html)
- [Introducing AWS Lambda Destinations](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/introducing-aws-lambda-destinations/)

zh.question: 开发人员正在测试一个异步调用 AWS Lambda 函数的应用程序。在测试阶段，Lambda 函数在两次重试后仍然处理失败。开发人员该如何排查故障？

options.A: 配置 AWS CloudTrail 日志记录，以调查调用失败的原因。
options.B: 通过向 Amazon SQS 发送事件进行调查来配置死信队列。
options.C: 配置 Amazon Simple Workflow Service 以处理任何直接的未处理事件。
options.D: 配置 AWS Config 以处理任何直接未处理的事件。

zh.explanation:
# Lambda 异步调用失败排查

## 场景
开发人员正在测试一个异步调用 Lambda 函数的应用程序。在两次失败重试后，开发人员需要一种方式来捕获和调查失败的事件。

## 正确答案：B — 配置一个将事件发送到 Amazon SQS 的死信队列 (DLQ)

当 Lambda 被异步调用时，AWS Lambda 会自动重试失败的调用（默认情况下重试两次），并采用指数退避策略。当您的 Lambda 被异步调用并遇到错误时，AWS Lambda 会自动重试调用预定义的次数。如果函数继续失败，事件将被转发到充当死信队列的 Amazon SQS 队列。此设置使您能够有效地分析和排查有问题的事件。

您可以在 Lambda 函数本身上配置 DLQ：您可以为死信队列选择 Amazon SQS 标准队列或 Amazon SNS 标准主题。不支持 FIFO 队列和 Amazon SNS FIFO 主题。

DLQ 消息包含有用的调试元数据：Lambda 按原样将事件发送到死信队列，并在属性中包含额外信息。您可以使用此信息来识别函数返回的错误，或将事件与日志或 AWS X-Ray 跟踪关联起来。RequestID（字符串）– 调用请求的 ID。 这正是开发人员调查失败所需的。

配置 DLQ 的 CLI 示例：

```bash
aws lambda update-function-configuration \
  --function-name my-function \
  --dead-letter-config TargetArn=arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:123456789012:my-dlq
```

Lambda 执行角色必须对 DLQ 具有 `sqs:SendMessage` 权限。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. CloudTrail** — CloudTrail 记录 AWS API 管理事件（控制平面 — 例如，谁调用了 `UpdateFunctionConfiguration`）。它**不会**捕获失败的异步调用的运行时有效负载或函数执行错误。函数执行日志转到 CloudWatch Logs，而不是 CloudTrail，失败的事件有效负载只能通过 DLQ 或 Lambda Destinations 保留。

- **C. Amazon Simple Workflow Service (SWF)** — SWF 是用于协调长期运行、有状态任务的工作流编排服务。它不是捕获失败的 Lambda 异步事件的机制；Lambda 没有将未处理的异步事件路由到 SWF 的本机集成。

- **D. AWS Config** — AWS Config 跟踪资源配置更改以及对规则的合规性。它在捕获失败的 Lambda 调用有效负载或运行时处理错误方面没有任何作用。

## 关于现代替代方案的说明
Lambda Destinations 现在是 AWS 推荐的新项目机制，提供更丰富的失败上下文。死信队列 (DLQ) 自 2016 年以来一直可用，是处理异步失败情况的好方法。Destinations 通过将代码异常堆栈跟踪等其他函数执行信息传递到更多目标服务，提供更有用的功能。Destinations 和 DLQ 可以同时一起使用，尽管应将 Destinations 视为更优选的解决方案。 但是，在提供的选项中，通过 SQS (B) 的 DLQ 是正确答案。

## 参考资源
- [捕获 Lambda 异步调用的记录](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-async-retain-records.html)
- [介绍 AWS Lambda Destinations](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/introducing-aws-lambda-destinations/)

en.question: A company is migrating its PostgreSQL database into the AWS Cloud. The company wants to use a database that will secure and regularly rotate database credentials. The company wants a solution that does not require additional programming overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL for the database. Store the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Turn on rotation.
options.B: Use Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL for the database. Store the database credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Turn on rotation.
options.C: Use Amazon DynamoDB for the database. Store the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Turn on rotation.
options.D: Use Amazon DynamoDB for the database. Store the database credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Turn on rotation.

en.explanation:
# Analysis

## Scenario
The company is migrating a **PostgreSQL** database to AWS and needs:
1. A database that secures and **regularly rotates database credentials**
2. **No additional programming overhead**

## Correct Answer: B

**Use Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL + AWS Secrets Manager with rotation enabled.**

- Aurora PostgreSQL is the natural target for migrating a PostgreSQL workload (it's a managed, PostgreSQL-compatible relational engine).
- Some services offer managed rotation, where the service configures and manages rotation for you. With managed rotation, you don't use an AWS Lambda function to update the secret and the credentials in the database. Amazon Aurora offers managed rotation for master user credentials.
- Aurora automatically generates database credentials. Aurora automatically stores and manages database credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Aurora rotates database credentials regularly, without requiring application changes.
- Secrets Manager offers built-in integrations for rotating credentials for all Amazon RDS databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, MariaDB, and Amazon Aurora.)

This combination satisfies both requirements with **no programming overhead** — Aurora's managed rotation eliminates the need to write or maintain a Lambda rotation function.

## Why the other options are wrong

### A. Aurora PostgreSQL + Systems Manager Parameter Store
**Wrong because Parameter Store does not support automatic rotation of secrets.** Parameter Store is a configuration/parameter store; it has no built-in rotation engine for database credentials. Rotation is a feature of **Secrets Manager**, not SSM Parameter Store. You would have to build custom rotation logic (e.g., your own Lambda + EventBridge schedule), which violates the "no additional programming overhead" requirement.

### C. DynamoDB + Systems Manager Parameter Store
**Wrong on two counts:**
1. DynamoDB is a NoSQL key-value/document database — it is **not a PostgreSQL replacement**. The requirement is to migrate an existing PostgreSQL database, which would require complete re-architecting.
2. DynamoDB uses IAM authentication, not username/password credentials, so the concept of "rotating database credentials" doesn't apply. Also, Parameter Store doesn't natively rotate secrets.

### D. DynamoDB + Secrets Manager
**Wrong** because DynamoDB is a NoSQL service and is not compatible with PostgreSQL. The migration target must be PostgreSQL-compatible (Aurora PostgreSQL or RDS for PostgreSQL). Additionally, DynamoDB does not use database username/password credentials that Secrets Manager would rotate — it uses IAM-based access.

## References
- [Password management with Amazon Aurora and AWS Secrets Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-secrets-manager.html)
- [Managed rotation for AWS Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotate-secrets_managed.html)
- [Set up automatic rotation for Amazon RDS, Amazon Aurora secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotate-secrets_turn-on-for-db.html)

zh.question: 一家公司正在将其 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移到 AWS 云。该公司希望使用一个能够确保数据库凭证安全并定期轮换的数据库。该公司还希望找到一个无需额外编程开销的解决方案。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 作为数据库。将数据库凭证存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。启用轮播功能。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 作为数据库。将数据库凭证存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。启用轮播功能。
options.C: 使用 Amazon DynamoDB 作为数据库。将数据库凭证存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。启用旋转功能。
options.D: 使用 Amazon DynamoDB 作为数据库。将数据库凭证存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。启用轮播功能。

zh.explanation:
# 分析

## 场景
公司正在迁移 **PostgreSQL** 数据库到 AWS，需要：
1. 一个数据库能够保护并**定期轮换数据库凭证**
2. **无需额外的编程开销**

## 正确答案：B

**使用 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL + AWS Secrets Manager 并启用轮换。**

- Aurora PostgreSQL 是迁移 PostgreSQL 工作负载的自然目标（它是一个托管的、与 PostgreSQL 兼容的关系型数据库引擎）。
- 某些服务提供托管轮换功能，其中服务为您配置和管理轮换。使用托管轮换，您无需使用 AWS Lambda 函数来更新密钥和数据库中的凭证。Amazon Aurora 为主用户凭证提供托管轮换。
- Aurora 自动生成数据库凭证。Aurora 自动在 AWS Secrets Manager 中存储和管理数据库凭证。Aurora 定期轮换数据库凭证，无需更改应用程序。
- Secrets Manager 为所有 Amazon RDS 数据库（MySQL、PostgreSQL、Oracle、Microsoft SQL Server、MariaDB 和 Amazon Aurora）的凭证轮换提供内置集成。

这种组合满足两个需求，**无需编程开销** — Aurora 的托管轮换消除了编写或维护 Lambda 轮换函数的需要。

## 为什么其他选项错误

### A. Aurora PostgreSQL + Systems Manager Parameter Store
**错误，因为 Parameter Store 不支持密钥的自动轮换。** Parameter Store 是一个配置/参数存储；它没有内置的数据库凭证轮换引擎。轮换是 **Secrets Manager** 的功能，而不是 SSM Parameter Store 的功能。您必须构建自定义轮换逻辑（例如，您自己的 Lambda + EventBridge 计划），这违反了"无需额外编程开销"的要求。

### C. DynamoDB + Systems Manager Parameter Store
**错误，原因有两点：**
1. DynamoDB 是一个 NoSQL 键值/文档数据库 — 它**不是 PostgreSQL 的替代品**。需求是迁移现有的 PostgreSQL 数据库，这需要完全重新架构。
2. DynamoDB 使用 IAM 身份验证，而不是用户名/密码凭证，因此"轮换数据库凭证"的概念不适用。另外，Parameter Store 不能原生轮换密钥。

### D. DynamoDB + Secrets Manager
**错误**，因为 DynamoDB 是 NoSQL 服务，与 PostgreSQL 不兼容。迁移目标必须与 PostgreSQL 兼容（Aurora PostgreSQL 或 RDS for PostgreSQL）。此外，DynamoDB 不使用 Secrets Manager 会轮换的数据库用户名/密码凭证 — 它使用基于 IAM 的访问。

## 参考资源
- [Password management with Amazon Aurora and AWS Secrets Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-secrets-manager.html)
- [Managed rotation for AWS Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotate-secrets_managed.html)
- [Set up automatic rotation for Amazon RDS, Amazon Aurora secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotate-secrets_turn-on-for-db.html)

en.question: A developer is creating a mobile application that will not require users to log in. What is the MOST efficient method to grant users access to AWS resources?

options.A: Use an identity provider to securely authenticate with the application.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function to create an IAM user when a user accesses the application.
options.C: Create credentials using AWS KMS and apply these credentials to users when using the application.
options.D: Use Amazon Cognito to associate unauthenticated users with an IAM role that has limited access to resources.

en.explanation:
# Cognito Unauthenticated Identities for Guest Mobile App Access

## Scenario
A mobile application does NOT require users to log in, but still needs to grant the app access to AWS resources (e.g., S3, DynamoDB, etc.). The question asks for the MOST efficient way to provide AWS credentials to anonymous/guest users.

## Correct Answer: D — Amazon Cognito unauthenticated identities + IAM role

Amazon Cognito identity pools are purpose-built for this use case. Amazon Cognito identity pools guest access (unauthenticated identities) provides a unique identifier and AWS credentials for users who do not authenticate with an identity provider.

You activate guest access on an identity pool and associate an IAM role with limited permissions for unauthenticated users. You can specify different roles for authenticated and unauthenticated users. When a guest opens the app, when a user logs in to your app, Amazon Cognito generates temporary AWS credentials for the user. These temporary credentials are associated with a specific IAM role. With the IAM role, you can define a set of permissions to access your AWS resources.

This is exactly what option D describes — associating unauthenticated users with an IAM role that has limited access. Unauthenticated identities are used for guest users in a mobile or web application who want to use the app without signing in. Unauthenticated users are granted only those permissions specified in the IAM policy associated with the identity pool.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. Use an identity provider to authenticate** — The requirement explicitly states users will NOT log in. Forcing authentication via an IdP contradicts the requirement and is unnecessary work for guest access.

- **B. Lambda to create an IAM user per app user** — IAM users are intended for long-lived AWS principals (humans/services in your account), not application end users. There is a hard limit of 5,000 IAM users per account, and managing long‑term access keys per mobile user is a major security anti-pattern. AWS explicitly recommends using federation/Cognito (temporary credentials) for mobile app users instead of IAM users.

- **C. Use AWS KMS to create credentials** — KMS is a key management service for cryptographic keys (encryption/decryption, signing). It does not issue AWS access credentials or sign-in identities. This option misrepresents what KMS does.

## Key takeaway
For anonymous/guest mobile users needing AWS access, use a **Cognito Identity Pool** with **unauthenticated identities** mapped to an **IAM role** that follows least privilege. Cognito brokers temporary credentials via STS automatically — no per-user IAM users, no custom credential plumbing.

## References
- [Identity pools console overview – Amazon Cognito](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/identity-pools.html)
- [IAM roles – Amazon Cognito](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/iam-roles.html)
- [Amazon Cognito identities – AWS IoT Core](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/cognito-identities.html)
- [Security best practices for Amazon Cognito identity pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/identity-pools-security-best-practices.html)

zh.question: 一位开发者正在创建一个无需用户登录的移动应用程序。授予用户访问 AWS 资源的权限，最有效的方法是什么？

options.A: 使用身份提供商安全地对应用程序进行身份验证。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，当用户访问应用程序时创建 IAM 用户。
options.C: 使用 AWS KMS 创建凭证，并在用户使用应用程序时将这些凭证应用于用户。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Cognito 将未经身份验证的用户与具有有限资源访问权限的 IAM 角色关联起来。

zh.explanation:
# Cognito 未认证身份用于客户端移动应用访问

## 场景
移动应用程序**不需要**用户登录，但仍然需要授予应用访问 AWS 资源的权限（例如 S3、DynamoDB 等）。问题要求找到向匿名/客户端用户提供 AWS 凭证的**最有效**方式。

## 正确答案：D — Amazon Cognito 未认证身份 + IAM 角色

Amazon Cognito 身份池专门为此用例而设计。Amazon Cognito 身份池客户端访问（未认证身份）为不通过身份提供程序进行身份验证的用户提供唯一标识符和 AWS 凭证。

在身份池上启用客户端访问，并为未认证用户关联具有有限权限的 IAM 角色。您可以为已认证和未认证用户指定不同的角色。当客户端打开应用时，当用户登录到您的应用时，Amazon Cognito 为用户生成临时 AWS 凭证。这些临时凭证与特定的 IAM 角色关联。使用该 IAM 角色，您可以定义一组权限来访问 AWS 资源。

这正是选项 D 所描述的——将未认证用户与具有有限访问权限的 IAM 角色关联。未认证身份用于想要使用应用但不登录的移动或网络应用的客户端用户。未认证用户仅被授予身份池关联的 IAM 策略中指定的权限。

## 其他选项为什么是错误的

- **A. 使用身份提供程序进行身份验证** — 要求明确指出用户**不会**登录。强制通过 IdP 进行身份验证违反了需求，对于客户端访问是不必要的工作。

- **B. 使用 Lambda 为每个应用用户创建 IAM 用户** — IAM 用户适用于长期存在的 AWS 主体（您账户中的人员/服务），不适用于应用终端用户。每个账户的 IAM 用户有 5,000 个的硬限制，且为每个移动应用用户管理长期访问密钥是一个重大的安全反模式。AWS 明确建议使用联合身份验证/Cognito（临时凭证）替代为移动应用用户创建 IAM 用户。

- **C. 使用 AWS KMS 创建凭证** — KMS 是密钥管理服务，用于管理加密密钥（加密/解密、签名）。它不会发布 AWS 访问凭证或登录身份。此选项误解了 KMS 的功能。

## 关键要点
对于需要 AWS 访问的匿名/客户端移动用户，使用**Cognito 身份池**与**未认证身份**映射到遵循最小权限原则的 **IAM 角色**。Cognito 通过 STS 自动代理临时凭证——无需为每个用户创建 IAM 用户，无需自定义凭证管理。

## 参考资源
- [身份池控制台概述 – Amazon Cognito](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/identity-pools.html)
- [IAM 角色 – Amazon Cognito](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/iam-roles.html)
- [Amazon Cognito 身份 – AWS IoT Core](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iot/latest/developerguide/cognito-identities.html)
- [Amazon Cognito 身份池的安全最佳实践](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/identity-pools-security-best-practices.html)

en.question: A company has developed a new serverless application using AWS Lambda functions that will be deployed using the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) CLI. Which step should the developer complete prior to deploying the application?

options.A: Compress the application to a .zip file and upload it into AWS Lambda.
options.B: Test the new AWS Lambda function by first tracing it in AWS X-Ray.
options.C: Bundle the serverless application using a SAM package.
options.D: Create the application environment using the eb create my-env command.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The developer is using the AWS SAM CLI to deploy a serverless application built with Lambda. The question asks what step must be completed **prior to deploying** the application.

## Correct Answer: C — Bundle the serverless application using a SAM package

In the traditional AWS SAM deployment workflow, before running `sam deploy`, the developer runs `sam package` (or `aws cloudformation package`). To package an AWS SAM application, use the sam package command from the AWS SAM CLI. This command uploads local artifacts (Lambda function code, dependencies) to an S3 bucket and produces a packaged template that references the uploaded artifacts.

You are now ready to use the AWS SAM sam package command to create and package artifacts for your Lambda functions and CodeDeploy application. The artifacts are uploaded to an S3 bucket. The output of the command is a new file called package.yml. This file is used by the AWS SAM sam deploy command in the next step.

Example command:

```bash
sam package \
  --template-file template.yaml \
  --output-template-file packaged.yaml \
  --s3-bucket my-deployment-bucket
```

Then deploy with:

```bash
sam deploy --template-file packaged.yaml --stack-name my-stack --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM
```

Note: In newer SAM CLI versions, sam deploy now implicitly performs the functionality of sam package. You can use the sam deploy command directly to package and ... However, packaging is still the conceptual prerequisite step before deployment, and the `sam package` command remains supported.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. Compress the application to a .zip file and upload it into AWS Lambda.** This is the manual Lambda deployment path, completely bypassing SAM. The whole purpose of using SAM CLI is to avoid manually zipping and uploading code to Lambda — SAM/CloudFormation handles artifact upload to S3 via `sam package`/`sam deploy`.

- **B. Test the new AWS Lambda function by first tracing it in AWS X-Ray.** X-Ray tracing is for observability of a deployed function. You cannot trace a function in X-Ray before it has been deployed, and tracing is not a prerequisite for SAM deployment. Local testing in SAM is done with `sam local invoke`, not X-Ray.

- **D. Create the application environment using the `eb create my-env` command.** `eb create` is an AWS Elastic Beanstalk CLI command, used to create a Beanstalk environment for traditional web applications. It has nothing to do with SAM or Lambda serverless deployments.

## References

- [sam package - AWS Serverless Application Model](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/sam-cli-command-reference-sam-package.html)
- [sam deploy - AWS Serverless Application Model](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/sam-cli-command-reference-sam-deploy.html)
- [Package the AWS SAM application - AWS CodeDeploy tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/tutorial-lambda-sam-package.html)
- [Introduction to deploying with AWS SAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/using-sam-cli-deploy.html)

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Lambda 函数开发了一个新的无服务器应用程序，该应用程序将使用 AWS 无服务器应用程序模型 (AWS SAM) CLI 进行部署。开发人员在部署应用程序之前应该完成哪个步骤？

options.A: 将应用程序压缩成 .zip 文件并将其上传到 AWS Lambda。
options.B: 首先在 AWS X-Ray 中跟踪新的 AWS Lambda 函数，以此来测试它。
options.C: 使用 SAM 包打包无服务器应用程序。
options.D: 使用 eb create my-env 命令创建应用程序环境。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

开发人员正在使用 AWS SAM CLI 部署使用 Lambda 构建的无服务器应用程序。问题询问在**部署应用程序之前**必须完成的步骤。

## 正确答案：C — 使用 SAM package 打包无服务器应用程序

在传统的 AWS SAM 部署工作流中，在运行 `sam deploy` 之前，开发人员会运行 `sam package`（或 `aws cloudformation package`）。要打包 AWS SAM 应用程序，请从 AWS SAM CLI 使用 sam package 命令。此命令将本地构件（Lambda 函数代码、依赖项）上传到 S3 存储桶，并生成引用已上传构件的打包模板。

现在您可以使用 AWS SAM sam package 命令创建和打包 Lambda 函数和 CodeDeploy 应用程序的构件。构件会上传到 S3 存储桶。该命令的输出是一个名为 package.yml 的新文件。此文件由下一步中的 AWS SAM sam deploy 命令使用。

示例命令：

```bash
sam package \
  --template-file template.yaml \
  --output-template-file packaged.yaml \
  --s3-bucket my-deployment-bucket
```

然后使用以下命令部署：

```bash
sam deploy --template-file packaged.yaml --stack-name my-stack --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM
```

注意：在较新的 SAM CLI 版本中，sam deploy 现在隐式执行 sam package 的功能。您可以直接使用 sam deploy 命令来打包和...不过，打包仍然是部署之前的概念前置步骤，`sam package` 命令仍然受支持。

## 其他选项为什么错误

- **A. 将应用程序压缩为 .zip 文件并将其上传到 AWS Lambda。** 这是手动 Lambda 部署路径，完全绕过了 SAM。使用 SAM CLI 的目的是避免手动压缩和上传代码到 Lambda — SAM/CloudFormation 通过 `sam package`/`sam deploy` 处理构件上传到 S3。

- **B. 通过首先在 AWS X-Ray 中追踪来测试新的 AWS Lambda 函数。** X-Ray 追踪用于已部署函数的可观测性。在函数部署之前无法在 X-Ray 中追踪它，追踪也不是 SAM 部署的前置条件。SAM 中的本地测试使用 `sam local invoke` 完成，而不是 X-Ray。

- **D. 使用 `eb create my-env` 命令创建应用程序环境。** `eb create` 是 AWS Elastic Beanstalk CLI 命令，用于为传统 Web 应用程序创建 Beanstalk 环境。它与 SAM 或 Lambda 无服务器部署无关。

## 参考资源

en.question: A company built a new application in the AWS Cloud. The company automated the bootstrapping of new resources with an Auto Scaling group by using AWS CloudFormation templates. The bootstrap scripts contain sensitive data. The company needs a solution that is integrated with CloudFormation to manage the sensitive data in the bootstrap scripts. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST secure way?

options.A: Put the sensitive data into a CloudFormation parameter. Encrypt the CloudFormation templates by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key.
options.B: Put the sensitive data into an Amazon S3 bucket. Update the CloudFormation templates to download the object from Amazon S3 during bootstrap.
options.C: Put the sensitive data into AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as a secure string parameter. Update the CloudFormation templates to use dynamic references to specify template values.
options.D: Put the sensitive data into Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Enforce EFS encryption after file system creation. Update the CloudFormation templates to retrieve data from Amazon EFS.

en.explanation:
# Securely Managing Sensitive Data in CloudFormation Bootstrap Scripts

## Scenario
A company uses CloudFormation templates with Auto Scaling group bootstrap scripts that contain sensitive data. They need a CloudFormation-integrated solution to manage this sensitive data **in the most secure way**.

## Correct Answer: C

**Store the sensitive data in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as a SecureString parameter, and use CloudFormation dynamic references (`{{resolve:ssm-secure:...}}`) to reference the values from the template.**

### Why C is correct
- SecureString parameters in SSM Parameter Store are encrypted at rest using a KMS key, providing strong protection of sensitive data.
- CloudFormation natively integrates with Parameter Store via the **`ssm-secure` dynamic reference** pattern. According to AWS docs, "In CloudFormation, you can use sensitive data like passwords or license keys without exposing them directly in your templates by storing the sensitive data as a secure string in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store."
- Crucially, **CloudFormation never stores the actual secure string value** — it only stores the literal dynamic reference (the parameter name). During stack create/update operations, CloudFormation retrieves the value as needed, and it is **not returned in any API calls**.
- AWS explicitly recommends this approach: "For sensitive data, always use secure string parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store or secrets in AWS Secrets Manager to ensure your data is encrypted at rest."

Example dynamic reference syntax:
```yaml
MasterUserPassword: '{{resolve:ssm-secure:/myapp/db/password:1}}'
```

## Why the other options are wrong

### A. CloudFormation parameter + KMS-encrypted template
- CloudFormation does **not** natively encrypt/decrypt template files with KMS — there is no built-in feature to "encrypt the CloudFormation template by using a KMS key" that CloudFormation will automatically decrypt during stack operations. You'd have to manually decrypt before submission, which exposes the data.
- Sensitive values passed as CloudFormation parameters (even with `NoEcho: true`) are still visible in the stack's processed template, events, and API outputs unless `NoEcho` is properly used, and they are not encrypted at rest in Parameter Store.
- This approach is documented by AWS as "not the most secure method," which is precisely why secure string dynamic references were introduced.

### B. Sensitive data in S3, downloaded during bootstrap
- This is not "integrated with CloudFormation" — the template would need custom UserData logic to fetch and decrypt the object.
- Although S3 supports SSE encryption, granting EC2 instances access to a sensitive object in S3 is more complex and less secure than using a purpose-built secrets store. There is no native CloudFormation dynamic reference for S3 object content.

### D. Sensitive data in Amazon EFS with encryption
- EFS is a shared file system service, not a secrets management service. EFS encryption can only be enabled at file system creation, not "after creation" as the option states — that statement is technically incorrect.
- There is no CloudFormation dynamic reference for EFS contents; the bootstrap would need to mount EFS and read files, adding complexity and a wider attack surface (network mount, file permissions).

## References
- [Get a secure string value from Systems Manager Parameter Store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/dynamic-references-ssm-secure-strings.html)
- [Get values stored in other services using dynamic references](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/dynamic-references.html)
- [Using AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store Secure String parameters in AWS CloudFormation templates](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/mt/using-aws-systems-manager-parameter-store-secure-string-parameters-in-aws-cloudformation-templates/)

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 云平台上构建了一个新应用程序。该公司使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板，通过 Auto Scaling 组自动启动新资源。启动脚本包含敏感数据。该公司需要一个与 CloudFormation 集成的解决方案来管理启动脚本中的敏感数据。哪种解决方案能够以最安全的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 将敏感数据放入 CloudFormation 参数中。使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 密钥加密 CloudFormation 模板。
options.B: 将敏感数据放入 Amazon S3 存储桶。更新 CloudFormation 模板，以便在启动过程中从 Amazon S3 下载对象。
options.C: 将敏感数据作为安全字符串参数放入 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。更新 CloudFormation 模板，使用动态引用来指定模板值。
options.D: 将敏感数据放入 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)。文件系统创建后，强制执行 EFS 加密。更新 CloudFormation 模板以从 Amazon EFS 检索数据。

zh.explanation:
# 在 CloudFormation 引导脚本中安全管理敏感数据

## 场景
一家公司使用包含敏感数据的 CloudFormation 模板和 Auto Scaling 组引导脚本。他们需要一个与 CloudFormation 集成的解决方案来以**最安全的方式**管理此敏感数据。

## 正确答案：C

**将敏感数据存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中作为 SecureString 参数，并使用 CloudFormation 动态引用 (`{{resolve:ssm-secure:...}}`) 从模板中引用这些值。**

### 为什么 C 是正确的
- SSM Parameter Store 中的 SecureString 参数使用 KMS 密钥在静态时加密，提供了对敏感数据的强大保护。
- CloudFormation 通过 **`ssm-secure` 动态引用**模式与 Parameter Store 进行本地集成。根据 AWS 文档，"在 CloudFormation 中，您可以使用敏感数据（如密码或许可证密钥），而无需在模板中直接暴露这些数据，方法是将敏感数据存储为 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中的安全字符串。"
- 关键是，**CloudFormation 永远不会存储实际的安全字符串值** — 它仅存储字面的动态引用（参数名称）。在堆栈创建/更新操作期间，CloudFormation 根据需要检索该值，并且它**不会在任何 API 调用中返回**。
- AWS 明确推荐这种方法："对于敏感数据，始终在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中使用安全字符串参数或在 AWS Secrets Manager 中使用密钥，以确保您的数据在静态时加密。"

动态引用语法示例：
```yaml
MasterUserPassword: '{{resolve:ssm-secure:/myapp/db/password:1}}'
```

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

### A. CloudFormation 参数 + KMS 加密模板
- CloudFormation **不**原生支持用 KMS 密钥加密/解密模板文件 — 没有内置功能来"使用 KMS 密钥加密 CloudFormation 模板"且 CloudFormation 会在堆栈操作期间自动解密。您必须在提交前手动解密，这会暴露数据。
- 作为 CloudFormation 参数传递的敏感值（即使使用了 `NoEcho: true`）在堆栈的处理模板、事件和 API 输出中仍然可见，除非正确使用 `NoEcho`，且它们不会在 Parameter Store 中静态加密。
- AWS 将这种方法记录为"不是最安全的方法"，这正是引入安全字符串动态引用的原因。

### B. S3 中的敏感数据，在引导期间下载
- 这不是"与 CloudFormation 集成" — 模板需要自定义 UserData 逻辑来获取和解密对象。
- 虽然 S3 支持 SSE 加密，但授予 EC2 实例对 S3 中敏感对象的访问权限比使用专用密钥管理服务更复杂且不太安全。没有用于 S3 对象内容的本地 CloudFormation 动态引用。

### D. Amazon EFS 中的敏感数据与加密
- EFS 是共享文件系统服务，不是密钥管理服务。EFS 加密只能在文件系统创建时启用，不能"在创建后"启用，如该选项所述 — 该陈述在技术上是不正确的。
- 没有用于 EFS 内容的 CloudFormation 动态引用；引导脚本需要挂载 EFS 并读取文件，这增加了复杂性和更大的攻击面（网络挂载、文件权限）。

## 参考资源
- [从 Systems Manager Parameter Store 获取安全字符串值](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/dynamic-references-ssm-secure-strings.html)
- [使用动态引用从其他服务获取值](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/dynamic-references.html)
- [在 AWS CloudFormation 模板中使用 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 安全字符串参数](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/mt/using-aws-systems-manager-parameter-store-secure-string-parameters-in-aws-cloudformation-templates/)

en.question: A company needs to set up secure database credentials for all its AWS Cloud resources. The company’s resources include Amazon RDS DB instances, Amazon DocumentDB clusters, and Amazon Aurora DB instances. The company’s security policy mandates that database credentials be encrypted at rest and rotated at a regular interval. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST securely?

options.A: Set up IAM database authentication for token-based access. Generate user tokens to provide centralized access to RDS DB instances, Amazon DocumentDB clusters, and Aurora DB instances.
options.B: Create parameters for the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Set the Type parameter to SecureString. Set up automatic rotation on the parameters.
options.C: Store the database access credentials as an encrypted Amazon S3 object in an S3 bucket. Block all public access on the S3 bucket. Use S3 server-side encryption to set up automatic rotation on the encryption key.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function by using the SecretsManagerRotationTemplate template in the AWS Secrets Manager console. Create secrets for the database credentials in Secrets Manager. Set up secrets rotation on a schedule.

en.explanation:
## Scenario
The company needs a centralized way to store database credentials for Amazon RDS, Amazon DocumentDB, and Amazon Aurora that satisfies two security requirements:
1. **Encryption at rest** of the credentials
2. **Automatic rotation** at a regular interval

The most secure managed solution must address both requirements with native AWS integration.

## Correct Answer: D

**AWS Secrets Manager** is purpose-built for this use case. AWS Secrets Manager provides a set of rotation function templates that help automate the secure management of credentials for various database systems and services. The templates are ready-to-use Lambda functions that implement best practices for credential rotation, helping you maintain your security posture without manual intervention.

Secrets Manager provides built‑in rotation Lambda templates for **all three** databases mentioned in the question:
- Secrets Manager provides templates for Amazon RDS, Amazon Aurora, Amazon Redshift, and Amazon DocumentDB database secrets in Rotation function templates.

When rotation is enabled: When you enable rotation, Secrets Manager creates a Lambda function and attaches an IAM role to this function to execute rotations on a schedule you define.

Encryption at rest is handled automatically: By default, Secrets Manager encrypts these secrets with encryption keys that you own and control. Secrets Manager uses AWS KMS to encrypt the secret value at rest (with `aws/secretsmanager` or a customer‑managed CMK).

This satisfies both requirements (encryption at rest via KMS + scheduled automatic rotation) using a managed pattern designed exactly for RDS, Aurora, and DocumentDB.

## Why the other options are wrong

### A. IAM database authentication
- IAM DB authentication is **not supported by Amazon DocumentDB**. It is only available for RDS MySQL/PostgreSQL and Aurora MySQL/PostgreSQL — not DocumentDB clusters. So it cannot serve as a centralized solution for all three engines listed.
- It also generates short‑lived (15‑minute) tokens for connection auth, but it does not store/rotate the underlying database master credentials, which is what the question is about.
- See [IAM database authentication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/UsingWithRDS.IAMDBAuth.html).

### B. Systems Manager Parameter Store SecureString with "automatic rotation"
- Parameter Store **does not natively rotate SecureString parameters**. There is no built‑in "automatic rotation" feature for SecureString parameters as described in the option. Rotation for database credentials is a Secrets Manager feature; Parameter Store can reference Secrets Manager secrets but cannot rotate them itself.
- See [AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html) and [Choosing between Secrets Manager and Parameter Store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html).

### C. Encrypted S3 object with SSE rotation
- Storing database credentials as a file in S3 is an **anti‑pattern**. There is no integrated mechanism to rotate the database password and synchronize it back into the database engine.
- "S3 server-side encryption to set up automatic rotation on the encryption key" rotates the **KMS key**, not the credentials themselves. Rotating a KMS key does not change the database password — it only re-wraps the data key. This does not meet the credential rotation requirement.
- See [Rotating AWS KMS keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotate-keys.html).

## Summary
Option **D** is the only solution that natively supports all three database engines (RDS, Aurora, DocumentDB), encrypts secrets at rest with KMS, and provides automated, scheduled credential rotation through a Lambda function generated from the `SecretsManagerRotationTemplate`.

zh.question: 一家公司需要为其所有 AWS 云资源设置安全的数据库凭证。该公司的资源包括 Amazon RDS 数据库实例、 Amazon DocumentDB 集群和 Amazon Aurora 数据库实例。该公司的安全策略要求数据库凭证在静态存储时必须加密，并定期轮换。哪种解决方案能够最安全地满足这些要求？

options.A: 设置基于令牌的访问的 IAM 数据库身份验证。生成用户令牌，以提供对 RDS 数据库实例、Amazon DocumentDB 集群和 Aurora 数据库实例的集中访问。
options.B: 在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中创建数据库凭证的参数。将 Type 参数设置为 SecureString。设置参数的自动轮换。
options.C: 将数据库访问凭证作为加密的 Amazon S3 对象存储在 S3 存储桶中。阻止对该 S3 存储桶的所有公共访问。使用 S3 服务器端加密设置加密密钥的自动轮换。
options.D: 使用 AWS Secrets Manager 控制台中的 SecretsManagerRotationTemplate 模板创建 AWS Lambda 函数。在 Secrets Manager 中为数据库凭证创建密钥。设置密钥轮换计划。

zh.explanation:
## 场景
公司需要一个集中方式存储 Amazon RDS、Amazon DocumentDB 和 Amazon Aurora 的数据库凭证，并满足两项安全要求：
1. **凭证的静态加密**
2. **定期自动轮换**

最安全的托管解决方案必须使用本机 AWS 集成来解决两项要求。

## 正确答案：D

**AWS Secrets Manager** 就是为此用例专门设计的。AWS Secrets Manager 提供一套轮换函数模板，可帮助自动安全地管理各种数据库系统和服务的凭证。这些模板是现成的 Lambda 函数，实现了凭证轮换的最佳实践，帮助您在无需手动干预的情况下维护安全态势。

Secrets Manager 为**所有三个**问题中提到的数据库提供了内置的轮换 Lambda 模板：
- Secrets Manager 在轮换函数模板中为 Amazon RDS、Amazon Aurora、Amazon Redshift 和 Amazon DocumentDB 数据库凭证提供模板。

启用轮换时：启用轮换后，Secrets Manager 会创建一个 Lambda 函数并将 IAM 角色附加到此函数，以按您定义的计划执行轮换。

静态加密会自动处理：默认情况下，Secrets Manager 使用您拥有和控制的加密密钥来加密这些凭证。Secrets Manager 使用 AWS KMS 来加密静态的凭证值（使用 `aws/secretsmanager` 或客户托管的 CMK）。

这满足两项要求（通过 KMS 进行静态加密 + 计划的自动轮换），使用专为 RDS、Aurora 和 DocumentDB 设计的托管模式。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

### A. IAM 数据库身份验证
- Amazon DocumentDB **不支持** IAM 数据库身份验证。它仅适用于 RDS MySQL/PostgreSQL 和 Aurora MySQL/PostgreSQL — 不支持 DocumentDB 集群。因此无法作为所有三个引擎的集中解决方案。
- 它还为连接身份验证生成短期的（15 分钟）令牌，但不存储/轮换底层数据库主凭证，而这正是问题所要求的。
- 参考 [IAM database authentication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/UsingWithRDS.IAMDBAuth.html)。

### B. Systems Manager Parameter Store SecureString，带有"自动轮换"
- Parameter Store **不本地轮换 SecureString 参数**。对于 SecureString 参数没有如选项中所述的内置"自动轮换"功能。数据库凭证轮换是 Secrets Manager 的功能；Parameter Store 可以引用 Secrets Manager 凭证但无法轮换它们。
- 参考 [AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html) 和 [在 Secrets Manager 和 Parameter Store 之间选择](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)。

### C. 使用 SSE 轮换的加密 S3 对象
- 将数据库凭证作为文件存储在 S3 中是一种**反模式**。没有集成机制来轮换数据库密码并将其同步回数据库引擎。
- "S3 服务器端加密以在加密密钥上设置自动轮换"轮换的是 **KMS 密钥**，而不是凭证本身。轮换 KMS 密钥不会改变数据库密码 — 它只是重新包装数据密钥。这不符合凭证轮换要求。
- 参考 [轮换 AWS KMS 密钥](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotate-keys.html)。

## 总结
选项 **D** 是唯一本地支持所有三个数据库引擎（RDS、Aurora、DocumentDB）的解决方案，使用 KMS 在静态加密凭证，并通过从 `SecretsManagerRotationTemplate` 生成的 Lambda 函数提供自动的、计划的凭证轮换。

en.question: A developer has created an AWS Lambda function that makes queries to an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance. When the developer performs a test, the DB instance shows an error for too many connections. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Create a read replica for the DB instance. Query the replica DB instance instead of the primary DB instance.
options.B: Migrate the data to an Amazon DynamoDB database.
options.C: Configure the Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance for Multi-AZ deployment.
options.D: Create a proxy in Amazon RDS Proxy. Query the proxy instead of the DB instance.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A Lambda function queries an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance. Because Lambda can scale out rapidly to many concurrent execution environments, each environment opens its own DB connection. This quickly exhausts the database's `max_connections` limit, producing the "too many connections" error. The developer needs the **least-effort** fix.

## Correct Answer: D — Use Amazon RDS Proxy

RDS Proxy is a fully managed, highly available database proxy that maintains a pool of long-lived connections to the database. Applications (including Lambda) connect to the proxy endpoint instead of the DB, and the proxy multiplexes many client connections onto far fewer backend connections.

- Any DB cluster that encounters "too many connections" errors is a good candidate for associating with a proxy. This is often characterized by a high value of the ConnectionAttempts CloudWatch metric. The proxy enables applications to open many client connections, while the proxy manages a smaller number of long-lived connections to the DB cluster.
- AWS Lambda functions can also be good candidates for using a proxy. These functions make frequent short database connections that benefit from connection pooling offered by RDS Proxy.
- You can open many simultaneous connections to the proxy, and the proxy keeps a smaller number of connections open to the DB instance or cluster. Doing so further minimizes the memory overhead for connections on the database server. This technique also reduces the chance of "too many connections" errors.

The change is minimal — point the Lambda function at the proxy endpoint instead of the DB endpoint. This is the **lowest operational effort** option.

## Why the other options are wrong

**A. Create a read replica and query the replica.**
A read replica only helps spread *read* workload across instances; it does not solve connection exhaustion caused by Lambda concurrency. Each replica still has its own `max_connections` limit, and Lambda would still open one connection per execution environment. The application would also need code changes to route reads to the replica endpoint, and writes still hit the primary. It does not address the root cause (lack of connection pooling).

**B. Migrate to DynamoDB.**
A full data-store migration is the *highest* operational effort imaginable: schema redesign, code rewrite (no SQL), access-pattern modeling, and data migration. It also changes the database technology entirely, which is far beyond what the question asks.

**C. Configure Multi-AZ deployment for Aurora MySQL.**
Multi-AZ provides high availability via a standby in another AZ; it does not increase available connections for the application. The standby is not used for serving application traffic in the same way, and connection exhaustion on the writer remains. This addresses HA, not connection limits.

## References

- [Planning where to use RDS Proxy (AWS docs)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-proxy-planning.html)
- [RDS Proxy concepts and terminology](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-proxy.howitworks.html)
- [RDS Proxy connection considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-proxy-connections.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员创建了一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数会向 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库实例发出查询。当开发人员执行测试时，数据库实例显示连接数过多的错误。哪种解决方案能够以最小的运维工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 为数据库实例创建只读副本。查询副本数据库实例，而不是主数据库实例。
options.B: 将数据迁移到 Amazon DynamoDB 数据库。
options.C: 配置 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库实例以进行多可用区部署。
options.D: 在 Amazon RDS Proxy 中创建代理。查询代理而不是数据库实例。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

Lambda 函数查询 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库实例。由于 Lambda 可以快速扩展到许多并发执行环境，每个环境都会打开自己的数据库连接。这会迅速耗尽数据库的 `max_connections` 限制，产生"too many connections"错误。开发人员需要**最少工作量**的解决方案。

## 正确答案：D — 使用 Amazon RDS Proxy

RDS Proxy 是一个完全托管的、高可用的数据库代理，它维护一个到数据库的长期连接池。应用程序（包括 Lambda）连接到代理端点而不是数据库，代理将许多客户端连接多路复用到较少数量的后端连接。

- 任何遇到"too many connections"错误的数据库集群都是与代理关联的良好候选者。这通常以 ConnectionAttempts CloudWatch 指标的高值为特征。代理使应用程序能够打开许多客户端连接，同时代理管理到数据库集群的较少数量的长期连接。
- AWS Lambda 函数也可能是很好的代理使用候选者。这些函数进行频繁的短数据库连接，从 RDS Proxy 提供的连接池中受益。
- 您可以向代理打开许多同时连接，代理保持较少数量的连接打开到数据库实例或集群。这样做进一步最小化了数据库服务器上连接的内存开销。这种技术还降低了"too many connections"错误的风险。

更改很小——只需将 Lambda 函数指向代理端点而不是数据库端点。这是**最低运维工作量**的选项。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**A. 创建读副本并查询该副本。**
读副本仅帮助分散*读取*工作负载到多个实例；它不能解决由 Lambda 并发引起的连接耗尽。每个副本仍然有自己的 `max_connections` 限制，Lambda 仍然会为每个执行环境打开一个连接。应用程序还需要代码更改来将读取路由到副本端点，而写入仍然命中主实例。它没有解决根本原因（缺乏连接池）。

**B. 迁移到 DynamoDB。**
完整的数据存储迁移是可以想象的**最高**运维工作量：架构重新设计、代码重写（无 SQL）、访问模式建模和数据迁移。它还会完全改变数据库技术，远远超出了问题所要求的范围。

**C. 为 Aurora MySQL 配置多可用区部署。**
多可用区通过另一个 AZ 中的备用实例提供高可用性；它不会增加应用程序可用的连接数。备用实例不用于以相同方式为应用程序流量提供服务，写入者上的连接耗尽仍然存在。这解决了高可用性问题，而不是连接限制。

## 参考资源

- [规划 RDS Proxy 的使用位置（AWS 文档）](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-proxy-planning.html)
- [RDS Proxy 概念和术语](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-proxy.howitworks.html)
- [RDS Proxy 连接考虑](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-proxy-connections.html)

en.question: A developer is creating a new REST API by using Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. The development team tests the API and validates responses for the known use cases before deploying the API to the production environment. The developer wants to make the REST API available for testing by using API Gateway locally. Which AWS Serverless Application Model Command Line Interface (AWS SAM CLI) subcommand will meet these requirements?

options.A: Sam local invoke
options.B: Sam local generate-event
options.C: Sam local start-lambda
options.D: Sam local start-api

en.explanation:
# Question Analysis

The developer wants to **locally test a REST API** built with API Gateway + Lambda before deploying to production. The question asks which AWS SAM CLI subcommand emulates API Gateway locally.

## Correct Answer: D — `sam local start-api`

`sam local start-api` starts a local instance of API Gateway that you can use to test HTTP request/response functionality. This subcommand runs your AWS Lambda functions locally and tests through a local HTTP server host, which is helpful for Lambda functions that are invoked by an Amazon API Gateway endpoint.

By default it listens on `http://127.0.0.1:3000`, allowing the team to invoke API routes via curl or a browser exactly like the deployed API Gateway endpoint — which is precisely the requirement here.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. `sam local invoke`** — Invokes a single Lambda function once with a given event payload (or stdin). It does **not** start an HTTP server emulating API Gateway, so it can't be used to test the REST API surface end-to-end.

- **B. `sam local generate-event`** — Generates sample event JSON payloads (e.g., S3, SNS, API Gateway events) used as input for `sam local invoke`. It does not run any Lambda or API Gateway service locally.

- **C. `sam local start-lambda`** — Starts a local endpoint that emulates the Lambda service so you can invoke your Lambda function through the AWS CLI and SDKs. It exposes the **Lambda Invoke API**, not an HTTP REST API Gateway. Clients would have to call it via the AWS SDK's `Invoke` operation, which doesn't simulate the API Gateway request/response model the developer needs to validate.

## References

- [sam local start-api — AWS SAM Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/sam-cli-command-reference-sam-local-start-api.html)
- [Locally run API Gateway with AWS SAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/serverless-sam-cli-using-start-api.html)
- [Introduction to testing with sam local start-api](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/using-sam-cli-local-start-api.html)
- [Introduction to testing with sam local start-lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/using-sam-cli-local-start-lambda.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 创建一个新的 REST API。开发团队在将 API 部署到生产环境之前，会针对已知用例测试 API 并验证其响应。开发人员希望通过 API Gateway 在本地提供 REST API 以供测试。哪个 AWS 无服务器应用程序模型命令行界面 (AWS SAM CLI) 子命令可以满足这些要求？

options.A: Sam 本地调用
options.B: Sam 本地生成事件
options.C: Sam 本地起始 lambda
options.D: Sam 本地启动 API

zh.explanation:
# 问题分析

开发人员想要**在本地测试使用 API Gateway + Lambda 构建的 REST API**，然后再部署到生产环境。问题询问哪个 AWS SAM CLI 子命令在本地模拟 API Gateway。

## 正确答案：D — `sam local start-api`

`sam local start-api` 启动 API Gateway 的本地实例，您可以使用它来测试 HTTP 请求/响应功能。 此子命令在本地运行您的 AWS Lambda 函数，并通过本地 HTTP 服务器主机进行测试，这对由 Amazon API Gateway 端点调用的 Lambda 函数很有帮助。

默认情况下，它监听 `http://127.0.0.1:3000`，允许团队通过 curl 或浏览器调用 API 路由，就像使用已部署的 API Gateway 端点一样 — 这正是这里的需求。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. `sam local invoke`** — 使用给定的事件负载（或 stdin）调用单个 Lambda 函数一次。它**不会**启动 HTTP 服务器来模拟 API Gateway，因此无法用于端到端测试 REST API 表面。

- **B. `sam local generate-event`** — 生成示例事件 JSON 负载（例如 S3、SNS、API Gateway 事件），用作 `sam local invoke` 的输入。它不运行任何 Lambda 或 API Gateway 服务。

- **C. `sam local start-lambda`** — 启动本地端点来模拟 Lambda 服务，以便您可以通过 AWS CLI 和 SDK 调用 Lambda 函数。它公开 **Lambda Invoke API**，而不是 HTTP REST API Gateway。客户端必须通过 AWS SDK 的 `Invoke` 操作调用它，这不能模拟开发人员需要验证的 API Gateway 请求/响应模型。

## 参考资源

- [sam local start-api — AWS SAM 开发人员指南](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/sam-cli-command-reference-sam-local-start-api.html)
- [使用 AWS SAM 在本地运行 API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/serverless-sam-cli-using-start-api.html)
- [使用 sam local start-api 进行测试简介](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/using-sam-cli-local-start-api.html)
- [使用 sam local start-lambda 进行测试简介](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/using-sam-cli-local-start-lambda.html)

en.question: A company has a serverless application on AWS that uses a fleet of AWS Lambda functions that have aliases. The company regularly publishes new Lambda function by using an in-house deployment solution. The company wants to improve the release process and to use traffic shifting. A newly published function version should initially make available only to a fixed percentage of production users. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure routing on the alias of the new function by using a weighted alias.
options.B: Configure a canary deployment type for Lambda.
options.C: Configure routing on the new versions by using environment variables.
options.D: Configure a linear deployment type for Lambda.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The company already uses an **in-house deployment solution** (i.e., not AWS CodeDeploy) and wants to add traffic shifting so that when a new Lambda version is published, only a fixed percentage of production traffic is routed to it.

## Correct Answer: A — Configure routing on the alias of the new function by using a weighted alias

Lambda aliases natively support **weighted routing** (alias traffic shifting). Previously, when you pointed a Lambda function alias to a new function version, all traffic would be routed to the new version immediately. Now, you can point a Lambda alias to two function versions and configure the percentage of traffic that is routed to each version.

This is exactly the requirement: send a fixed percentage of production traffic to the newly published version. With the introduction of alias traffic shifting, it is now possible to trivially implement canary deployments of Lambda functions. By updating additional version weights on an alias, invocation traffic is routed to the new function versions.

Example CLI:

```bash
aws lambda update-alias \
  --name prod \
  --function-name my-function \
  --function-version 1 \
  --routing-config AdditionalVersionWeights={"2"=0.10}
```

This routes 10% of traffic to version 2 and keeps 90% on version 1, fitting the in-house deployment pipeline (no CodeDeploy required).

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **B. Configure a canary deployment type for Lambda.** "Canary" and "Linear" are predefined **AWS CodeDeploy** deployment configurations (e.g., `Canary10Percent5Minutes`, `Linear10PercentEvery1Minute`), not native Lambda settings. AWS CodeDeploy provides an intuitive turn-key implementation of this functionality integrated directly into the Serverless Application Model. Traffic-shifted deployments can be declared in a SAM template, and CodeDeploy manages the function rollout as part of the CloudFormation stack update. Since the company uses an **in-house** deployment solution (not CodeDeploy/SAM), canary deployment types do not apply.

- **C. Configure routing on the new versions by using environment variables.** Lambda environment variables are key/value config inputs to the function code; they have no role in invocation routing or traffic splitting between versions.

- **D. Configure a linear deployment type for Lambda.** Like "Canary," "Linear" is a CodeDeploy deployment configuration that **gradually increases** traffic in steps over time. The requirement is a **fixed percentage** of users on the new version, and the company is not using CodeDeploy.

## References

- [Implement Lambda canary deployments using a weighted alias](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html)
- [Create an alias for a Lambda function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-aliases.html)
- [AWS Lambda Supports Traffic Shifting and AWS CodeDeploy Deployments](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2017/11/aws-lambda-supports-traffic-shifting-and-phased-deployments-with-aws-codedeploy/)
- [Implementing Canary Deployments of AWS Lambda Functions with Alias Traffic Shifting](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/implementing-canary-deployments-of-aws-lambda-functions-with-alias-traffic-shifting/)

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上有一个无服务器应用程序，该应用程序使用一组带有别名的 AWS Lambda 函数。该公司定期使用内部部署解决方案发布新的 Lambda 函数。该公司希望改进发布流程并采用流量转移技术。新发布的函数版本最初应该只对固定比例的生产用户可用。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用加权别名配置新函数别名的路由。
options.B: 为 Lambda 配置金丝雀部署类型。
options.C: 在新版本中，使用环境变量配置路由。
options.D: 为 Lambda 配置线性部署类型。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

该公司已经使用了**自建部署解决方案**（即不是 AWS CodeDeploy），希望添加流量转移功能，以便在发布新的 Lambda 版本时，只有固定百分比的生产流量路由到该版本。

## 正确答案：A — 使用加权别名在新函数别名上配置路由

Lambda 别名原生支持**加权路由**（别名流量转移）。以前，当你将 Lambda 函数别名指向新函数版本时，所有流量都会立即路由到新版本。现在，你可以将 Lambda 别名指向两个函数版本，并配置路由到每个版本的流量百分比。

这正好满足需求：将固定百分比的生产流量发送到新发布的版本。随着别名流量转移的推出，现在可以轻松实现 Lambda 函数的金丝雀部署。通过更新别名上的其他版本权重，调用流量会路由到新函数版本。

示例 CLI：

```bash
aws lambda update-alias \
  --name prod \
  --function-name my-function \
  --function-version 1 \
  --routing-config AdditionalVersionWeights={"2"=0.10}
```

这会将 10% 的流量路由到版本 2，保持 90% 在版本 1 上，适配自建部署管道（无需 CodeDeploy）。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **B. 为 Lambda 配置金丝雀部署类型。** "Canary"和"Linear"是预定义的 **AWS CodeDeploy** 部署配置（例如 `Canary10Percent5Minutes`、`Linear10PercentEvery1Minute`），不是原生 Lambda 设置。AWS CodeDeploy 提供了一个直观的开箱即用实现，直接集成到无服务器应用模型中。流量转移部署可以在 SAM 模板中声明，CodeDeploy 作为 CloudFormation 堆栈更新的一部分管理函数的推出。由于该公司使用**自建**部署解决方案（不是 CodeDeploy/SAM），金丝雀部署类型不适用。

- **C. 使用环境变量在新版本上配置路由。** Lambda 环境变量是函数代码的键值对配置输入；它们与调用路由或版本间的流量分割无关。

- **D. 为 Lambda 配置线性部署类型。** 与"Canary"类似，"Linear"是 CodeDeploy 部署配置，**逐步增加**一段时间内的流量。而需求是在新版本上保持**固定百分比**的用户，且该公司未使用 CodeDeploy。

## 参考资源

- [使用加权别名实现 Lambda 金丝雀部署](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html)
- [为 Lambda 函数创建别名](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-aliases.html)
- [AWS Lambda 支持流量转移和 AWS CodeDeploy 部署](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2017/11/aws-lambda-supports-traffic-shifting-and-phased-deployments-with-aws-codedeploy/)
- [使用别名流量转移实现 AWS Lambda 函数的金丝雀部署](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/implementing-canary-deployments-of-aws-lambda-functions-with-alias-traffic-shifting/)

en.question: A company has an application that stores data in Amazon RDS instances. The application periodically experiences surges of high traffic that cause performance problems. During periods of peak traffic, a developer notices a reduction in query speed in all database queries. The team’s technical lead determines that a multi-threaded and scalable caching solution should be used to offload the heavy read traffic. The solution needs to improve performance. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST complexity?

options.A: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached to offload read requests from the main database.
options.B: Replicate the data to Amazon DynamoDSet up a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster.
options.C: Configure the Amazon RDS instances to use Multi-AZ deployment with one standby instance. Offload read requests from the main database to the standby instance.
options.D: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis to offload read requests from the main database.

en.explanation:
# Caching Solution for RDS Read Surges - Memcached vs Redis

## Scenario Analysis
The application uses Amazon RDS and experiences read-heavy traffic surges that degrade query performance. The technical lead wants:
- A **multi-threaded** caching solution
- **Scalable** to handle traffic surges
- Offload **heavy read traffic** from RDS
- **LEAST complexity**

## Correct Answer: A — Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached

The two key requirements that drive this answer are **multi-threaded** and **least complexity**:

- **Multi-threaded:** Since Memcached is multithreaded, it can make use of multiple processing cores. This means that you can handle more operations by scaling up compute capacity. Redis, by contrast, executes commands single-threaded.
- **Simplest model / least complexity:** Per the AWS guidance, Memcached is ideal if you need to operate the simplest model, run large nodes with multiple cores or threads, scale out and in by adding and removing nodes based on workload demands, and/or cache objects.
- **Scalability:** Memcached supports horizontal scaling by adding/removing nodes, ideal for absorbing traffic surges.

This perfectly matches the scenario: a simple object cache in front of RDS to offload heavy reads, with multi-threading and easy scale-out.

Reference: [Comparing Valkey, Memcached, and Redis OSS – Amazon ElastiCache](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/SelectEngine.html)

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

### B. Replicate to DynamoDB and use DAX
- DAX is a cache **only for DynamoDB**, not for RDS. The data lives in RDS, so this requires migrating/replicating data to DynamoDB — a major architectural change. This is the **highest** complexity option, the opposite of the requirement. It also doesn't address the existing RDS workload directly. See [DAX overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html).

### C. RDS Multi-AZ with standby for reads
- **Multi-AZ standby instances cannot serve read traffic.** The standby is only for failover/HA. To offload reads from RDS, you would need **read replicas**, not Multi-AZ. This option is technically incorrect. Also, it doesn't provide a caching layer — it just shifts the load to another RDS database, which still has the same disk/query bottlenecks. See [High availability (Multi-AZ) for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.html).

### D. ElastiCache for Redis
- Redis would work functionally, but it does **not satisfy the multi-threaded requirement** — Redis executes commands single-threaded on a per-node basis. Additionally, Redis adds complexity with replication, persistence, failover, complex data types, and cluster mode features that are unneeded here. Memcached is designed to handle straightforward caching needs with minimal complexity, making it an excellent choice for developers looking for performance and scalability without overhead. Since the requirement is explicitly multi-threaded + least complexity, Memcached wins over Redis.

## Summary
ElastiCache for Memcached is the textbook AWS choice when the requirements are: simple object caching, multi-threaded, horizontal scalability, and minimal operational complexity to offload reads from a relational database.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个应用程序，它将数据存储在 Amazon RDS 实例中。该应用程序会周期性地遇到高流量高峰，导致性能问题。在流量高峰期，开发人员注意到所有数据库查询的查询速度都会下降。团队的技术负责人决定使用多线程、可扩展的缓存解决方案来分担大量的读取流量。该解决方案需要提升性能。哪种解决方案能够以最低的复杂度满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached 将读取请求从主数据库卸载。
options.B: 将数据复制到 Amazon DynamoDB 设置 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 集群。
options.C: 配置 Amazon RDS 实例以使用多可用区部署，并配备一个备用实例。将读取请求从主数据库卸载到备用实例。
options.D: 使用 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 将读取请求从主数据库卸载。

zh.explanation:
# RDS 读取激增的缓存解决方案 - Memcached vs Redis

## 场景分析
应用程序使用 Amazon RDS，并在读取流量激增期间遭遇查询性能下降。技术负责人需要：
- 一个**多线程**缓存解决方案
- **可扩展**以处理流量激增
- 从 RDS 卸载**大量读取流量**
- **最低复杂度**

## 正确答案：A — Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached

两个关键需求驱动此答案：**多线程**和**最低复杂度**：

- **多线程：** 由于 Memcached 是多线程的，它可以利用多个处理核心。这意味着您可以通过扩展计算容量来处理更多操作。 相比之下，Redis 采用单线程执行命令。
- **最简单的模型 / 最低复杂度：** 根据 AWS 指南，如果您需要操作最简单的模型、运行具有多个核心或线程的大型节点、通过添加和删除节点根据工作负载需求进行扩展，和/或缓存对象，Memcached 是理想的选择。
- **可扩展性：** Memcached 支持通过添加/删除节点进行水平扩展，非常适合吸收流量激增。

这完全符合场景：在 RDS 前面放置一个简单的对象缓存以卸载大量读取，具有多线程和易于扩展的特性。

参考：[比较 Valkey、Memcached 和 Redis OSS – Amazon ElastiCache](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/SelectEngine.html)

## 其他选项为何错误

### B. 复制到 DynamoDB 并使用 DAX
- DAX 是**仅针对 DynamoDB 的缓存**，不适用于 RDS。数据存储在 RDS 中，因此这需要将数据迁移/复制到 DynamoDB — 这是重大的架构变更。这是**最高**复杂度的选项，与需求相反。它也不直接解决现有的 RDS 工作负载。请参阅 [DAX 概述](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)。

### C. RDS Multi-AZ 与待机实例用于读取
- **Multi-AZ 待机实例无法提供读取流量。** 待机仅用于故障转移/高可用性。要从 RDS 卸载读取，您需要**读取副本**，而不是 Multi-AZ。此选项在技术上不正确。此外，它不提供缓存层 — 它只是将负载转移到另一个 RDS 数据库，该数据库仍然具有相同的磁盘/查询瓶颈。请参阅 [Amazon RDS 高可用性 (Multi-AZ)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.html)。

### D. ElastiCache for Redis
- Redis 在功能上可行，但它**不满足多线程需求** — Redis 在每个节点基础上以单线程方式执行命令。此外，Redis 增加了复制、持久化、故障转移、复杂数据类型和不必要的集群模式功能的复杂性。Memcached 被设计用来以最小的复杂性处理直接的缓存需求，使其成为寻求性能和可扩展性而无开销的开发人员的绝佳选择。 由于需求明确要求多线程 + 最低复杂度，Memcached 在 Redis 上胜出。

## 总结
当需求是以下条件时，ElastiCache for Memcached 是教科书式的 AWS 选择：简单对象缓存、多线程、水平可扩展性，以及最小化运营复杂性以从关系数据库卸载读取。

en.question: A developer must provide an API key to an AWS Lambda function to authenticate with a third-party system. The Lambda function will run on a schedule. The developer needs to ensure that the API key remains encrypted at rest. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Store the API key as a Lambda environment variable by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key.
options.B: Configure the application to prompt the user to provide the password to the Lambda function on the first run.
options.C: Store the API key as a value in the application code.
options.D: Use Lambda@Edge and only communicate over the HTTPS protocol.

en.explanation:
# API Key Storage for Scheduled Lambda Function

## Scenario
A Lambda function runs on a schedule and needs to authenticate with a third-party system using an API key. The requirement is that the API key must remain **encrypted at rest**.

## Correct Answer: A — Store the API key as a Lambda environment variable encrypted with an AWS KMS customer managed key

Lambda natively supports encrypting environment variables at rest using AWS KMS. Lambda always provides server-side encryption at rest with an AWS KMS key. By default, Lambda uses an AWS managed key, but you can provide an AWS KMS customer managed key instead — for example, to have control over rotation of the KMS key or to meet organizational requirements.

Using a customer managed key (CMK) provides additional control: when you use a customer managed key, only users in your account with access to the KMS key can view or manage environment variables on the function. AWS prescriptive guidance also recommends this approach: use a customer managed key because you have full control over the key, including management, rotation, and auditing.

The Lambda execution role needs `kms:Decrypt` permissions to retrieve and use the API key at runtime. kms:CreateGrant and kms:Encrypt are needed to configure a customer managed key on a function, and kms:Decrypt is needed to view and manage environment variables that are encrypted with a customer managed key.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **B. Prompt the user for the password on first run** — A scheduled Lambda function runs unattended in response to an EventBridge schedule; there is no interactive user available to type a password. Lambda also has no persistent local storage between invocations, so any value entered would not survive (and would not be encrypted at rest in any case). This option fails both the operational and the security requirement.

- **C. Store the API key in the application code** — Hardcoding secrets in source code is an explicit anti-pattern. The deployment package is not a secure secret store, the secret would appear in source-control history, in CloudWatch logs if printed, and could be read by anyone with `lambda:GetFunction`. It does **not** satisfy "encrypted at rest" with a managed key.

- **D. Use Lambda@Edge and only communicate over HTTPS** — Lambda@Edge runs functions at CloudFront edge locations for content customization; it has nothing to do with secret storage. HTTPS protects data **in transit**, not **at rest**, which is the explicit requirement in the question.

## References
- [Securing Lambda environment variables (AWS Lambda Developer Guide)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-envvars-encryption.html)
- [Data encryption at rest for AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/security-encryption-at-rest.html)
- [Encryption best practices for AWS Lambda (Prescriptive Guidance)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/encryption-best-practices/lambda.html)

zh.question: 开发人员必须向 AWS Lambda 函数提供 API 密钥，以便与第三方系统进行身份验证。Lambda 函数将按计划运行。开发人员需要确保 API 密钥在静态存储时保持加密状态。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户管理的密钥，将 API 密钥存储为 Lambda 环境变量。
options.B: 配置应用程序，使其在首次运行时提示用户向 Lambda 函数提供密码。
options.C: 将 API 密钥作为值存储在应用程序代码中。
options.D: 使用 Lambda@Edge，并且仅通过 HTTPS 协议进行通信。

zh.explanation:
# 计划的 Lambda 函数的 API 密钥存储

## 场景
Lambda 函数按计划运行，需要使用 API 密钥对第三方系统进行身份验证。要求是 API 密钥必须保持**加密存储**。

## 正确答案：A — 将 API 密钥存储为使用 AWS KMS 客户托管密钥加密的 Lambda 环境变量

Lambda 原生支持使用 AWS KMS 对环境变量进行静态加密。Lambda 始终使用 AWS KMS 密钥提供服务器端静态加密。默认情况下，Lambda 使用 AWS 托管密钥，但你可以改为提供 AWS KMS 客户托管密钥 — 例如，为了控制 KMS 密钥的轮换或满足组织要求。

使用客户托管密钥 (CMK) 提供额外的控制：当你使用客户托管密钥时，只有账户中有权访问 KMS 密钥的用户才能查看或管理函数上的环境变量。AWS 规范指导也推荐这种方法：使用客户托管密钥，因为你对密钥拥有完全控制，包括管理、轮换和审计。

Lambda 执行角色需要 `kms:Decrypt` 权限才能在运行时检索和使用 API 密钥。需要 kms:CreateGrant 和 kms:Encrypt 来在函数上配置客户托管密钥，需要 kms:Decrypt 来查看和管理使用客户托管密钥加密的环境变量。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **B. 在首次运行时提示用户输入密码** — 计划的 Lambda 函数根据 EventBridge 计划无人值守地运行；没有可用的交互式用户来输入密码。Lambda 也没有跨调用的持久本地存储，所以任何输入的值都不会保留（而且无论如何都不会使用托管密钥进行静态加密）。此选项在操作和安全要求上都失败。

- **C. 在应用程序代码中存储 API 密钥** — 在源代码中硬编码机密是明确的反模式。部署包不是安全的机密存储，机密会出现在源代码控制历史中、CloudWatch 日志中（如果被打印出来）并且可以被任何拥有 `lambda:GetFunction` 的人读取。它**不**满足"使用托管密钥加密存储"的要求。

- **D. 使用 Lambda@Edge，仅通过 HTTPS 通信** — Lambda@Edge 在 CloudFront 边缘位置运行函数以进行内容定制；它与机密存储无关。HTTPS 保护**传输中**的数据，不是**静态**数据，这是问题中的明确要求。

## 参考资源
- [Securing Lambda environment variables (AWS Lambda Developer Guide)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-envvars-encryption.html)
- [Data encryption at rest for AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/security-encryption-at-rest.html)
- [Encryption best practices for AWS Lambda (Prescriptive Guidance)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/encryption-best-practices/lambda.html)

en.question: An IT department uses Amazon S3 to store sensitive images. After more than 1 year, the company moves the images into archival storage. The company rarely accesses the images, but the company wants a storage solution that maximizes resiliency. The IT department needs access to the images that have been moved to archival storage within 24 hours. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) to store the images. Use S3 Glacier Deep Archive with standard retrieval to store and retrieve archived images.
options.B: Use S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) to store the images. Use S3 Glacier Deep Archive with bulk retrieval to store and retrieve archived images.
options.C: Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering to store the images. Use S3 Glacier Deep Archive with standard retrieval to store and retrieve archived images.
options.D: Use S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) to store the images. Use S3 Glacier Deep Archive with bulk retrieval to store and retrieve archived images.

en.explanation:
## Scenario Analysis

The company needs to:
1. Store sensitive images for ~1 year (initial storage), then move to **archival** storage.
2. Maximize **resiliency** (durability + multi-AZ availability).
3. Retrieve archived data **within 24 hours**.
4. Achieve this **most cost-effectively**.

The key constraints are the 24-hour retrieval SLA and the "maximizes resiliency" requirement (which rules out One Zone storage classes that store data in a single AZ).

## Correct Answer: A

**S3 Standard-IA** (for ~1 year of infrequent access) → **S3 Glacier Deep Archive with Standard retrieval** (for archival).

- S3 Standard-IA stores data redundantly across multiple Availability Zones (multi-AZ) — meeting "maximize resiliency."
- S3 Glacier Deep Archive is the **lowest-cost** AWS storage class, ideal for data accessed less than once a year, and is also designed for 99.999999999% (11 9s) durability across multiple AZs.
- Per AWS docs, **Standard retrieval** from Glacier Deep Archive "Typically restores the object within 12 hours" — well within the 24-hour requirement.
- **Bulk retrieval** from Glacier Deep Archive "Typically restores the object within 48 hours" — this **violates** the 24-hour SLA.

See [Understanding S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html) and [Understanding archive retrieval options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/restoring-objects-retrieval-options.html).

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**B. Standard-IA + Deep Archive (Bulk retrieval)** — Bulk retrieval from Glacier Deep Archive typically takes **up to 48 hours**, which exceeds the strict 24-hour retrieval requirement. Although it would be cheaper than Standard, it fails the functional SLA, so it cannot be considered "most cost-effective" because it doesn't meet the requirements at all.

**C. S3 Intelligent-Tiering + Deep Archive (Standard)** — S3 Intelligent-Tiering charges a per-object monitoring/automation fee and is designed for data with **unknown or changing access patterns**. Here the access pattern is known and explicit ("after 1 year, move to archive"), so a deterministic Lifecycle rule from S3 Standard-IA → Deep Archive is more cost-effective than paying Intelligent-Tiering's monitoring overhead. Also, Intelligent-Tiering Deep Archive Access tier transitions only after 180 days of no access — not after a fixed 1-year business policy.

**D. S3 One Zone-IA + Deep Archive (Bulk)** — Two failures:
1. One Zone-IA stores data in a **single AZ**, meaning data could be lost if that AZ is destroyed. This directly contradicts "maximizes resiliency."
2. Bulk retrieval from Deep Archive takes up to 48 hours, exceeding the 24-hour SLA.

## Summary Table

| Option | Resilient? | Meets 24h SLA? | Cost-effective? |
|--------|-----------|----------------|-----------------|
| A | ✅ multi-AZ | ✅ ~12 hr | ✅ Best valid choice |
| B | ✅ multi-AZ | ❌ ~48 hr | ❌ Fails SLA |
| C | ✅ multi-AZ | ✅ ~12 hr | ❌ Extra IT monitoring fees |
| D | ❌ single AZ | ❌ ~48 hr | ❌ Fails both |

zh.question: 某IT部门使用Amazon S3存储敏感图像。一年多后，该公司将这些图像迁移到归档存储中。该公司很少访问这些图像，但希望找到一种能够最大限度提高数据弹性的存储解决方案。IT部门需要在24小时内访问已迁移到归档存储中的图像。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 S3 标准版（不频繁访问）（S3 Standard-IA）存储图像。使用 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 的标准检索功能存储和检索已归档的图像。
options.B: 使用 S3 标准版（不频繁访问）（S3 Standard-IA）存储图像。使用 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 的批量检索功能来存储和检索已归档的图像。
options.C: 使用 S3 智能分层存储镜像。使用 S3 Glacier 深度归档标准检索功能来存储和检索已归档的镜像。
options.D: 使用 S3 单区低频访问 (S3 One Zone-IA) 存储图像。使用 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 的批量检索功能来存储和检索已归档的图像。

zh.explanation:
## 场景分析

该公司需要：
1. 存储敏感图像约 1 年（初始存储），然后转移到**存档**存储。
2. 最大化**弹性**（耐久性 + 多可用区可用性）。
3. 在 **24 小时内**检索存档数据。
4. 以**最具成本效益**的方式实现此目标。

关键限制是 24 小时检索 SLA 和"最大化弹性"要求（排除只在单个可用区存储数据的单可用区存储类）。

## 正确答案：A

**S3 Standard-IA**（约 1 年不频繁访问）→ **S3 Glacier Deep Archive with Standard retrieval**（用于存档）。

- S3 Standard-IA 在多个可用区冗余存储数据（多可用区）— 满足"最大化弹性"。
- S3 Glacier Deep Archive 是 **AWS 成本最低**的存储类，非常适合一年内访问少于一次的数据，也设计为跨多个可用区提供 99.999999999%（11 个 9）耐久性。
- 根据 AWS 文档，Glacier Deep Archive 的 **Standard retrieval** "通常在 12 小时内恢复对象" — 远在 24 小时要求内。
- Glacier Deep Archive 的 **Bulk retrieval** "通常在 48 小时内恢复对象" — 这**违反了** 24 小时 SLA。

参见 [Understanding S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html) 和 [Understanding archive retrieval options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/restoring-objects-retrieval-options.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

**B. Standard-IA + Deep Archive（Bulk retrieval）** — Glacier Deep Archive 的 Bulk retrieval 通常需要**最多 48 小时**，超过了严格的 24 小时检索要求。虽然成本会比 Standard 低，但它无法满足功能 SLA，因此不能被视为"最具成本效益"，因为它根本不满足要求。

**C. S3 Intelligent-Tiering + Deep Archive（Standard）** — S3 Intelligent-Tiering 收取每个对象的监控/自动化费用，设计用于**访问模式未知或变化**的数据。这里访问模式是已知且明确的（"1 年后转移到存档"），所以从 S3 Standard-IA → Deep Archive 的确定性生命周期规则比支付 Intelligent-Tiering 的监控开销更具成本效益。另外，Intelligent-Tiering Deep Archive Access 层仅在 180 天无访问后转换 — 而不是固定的 1 年业务政策。

**D. S3 One Zone-IA + Deep Archive（Bulk）** — 两个失败：
1. One Zone-IA 在**单个可用区**存储数据，意味着如果该可用区被摧毁，数据可能会丢失。这直接违反了"最大化弹性"。
2. Deep Archive 的 Bulk retrieval 需要最多 48 小时，超过 24 小时 SLA。

## 摘要表

| 选项 | 弹性? | 满足 24 小时 SLA? | 成本效益? |
|--------|-----------|----------------|-----------------|
| A | ✅ 多可用区 | ✅ ~12 小时 | ✅ 最佳有效选择 |
| B | ✅ 多可用区 | ❌ ~48 小时 | ❌ 不满足 SLA |
| C | ✅ 多可用区 | ✅ ~12 小时 | ❌ 额外 IT 监控费用 |
| D | ❌ 单可用区 | ❌ ~48 小时 | ❌ 两项均不满足 |

en.question: A developer is building a serverless application by using the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM). The developer is currently testing the application in a development environment. When the application is nearly finished, the developer will need to set up additional testing and staging environments for a quality assurance team. The developer wants to use a feature of the AWS SAM to set up deployments to multiple environments. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Add a configuration file in TOML format to group configuration entries to every environment. Add a table for each testing and staging environment. Deploy updates to the environments by using the sam deploy command and the --config-env flag that corresponds to each environment.
options.B: Create additional AWS SAM templates for each testing and staging environment. Write a custom shell script that uses the sam deploy command and the --template-file flag to deploy updates to the environments.
options.C: Create one AWS SAM configuration file that has default parameters. Perform updates to the testing and staging environments by using the --parameter-overrides flag in the AWS SAM CLI and the parameters that the updates will override.
options.D: Use the existing AWS SAM template. Add additional parameters to configure specific attributes for the serverless function and database table resources that are in each environment. Deploy updates to the testing and staging environments by using the sam deploy command.

en.explanation:
