- [解决 DynamoDB 表限流问题](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/dynamodb-table-throttled)
- [读写容量模式](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/HowItWorks.ReadWriteCapacityMode.html)

en.question: A company is hosting a workshop for external users and wants to share the reference documents with the external users for 7 days. The company stores the reference documents in an Amazon S3 bucket that the company owns. What is the MOST secure way to share the documents with the external users?

options.A: Use S3 presigned URLs to share the documents with the external users. Set an expiration time of 7 days.
options.B: Move the documents to an Amazon WorkDocs folder. Share the links of the WorkDocs folder with the external users.
options.C: Create temporary IAM users that have read-only access to the S3 bucket. Share the access keys with the external users. Expire the credentials after 7 days.
options.D: Create a role that has read-only access to the S3 bucket. Share the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of this role with the external users.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A company needs to share reference documents stored in an S3 bucket with external users for a 7-day workshop. The goal is the **most secure** sharing method.

## Correct Answer: A — S3 Presigned URLs with 7-day expiration

S3 presigned URLs grant time-limited access to specific S3 objects without requiring external users to have AWS credentials or modifying the bucket/object permissions. A presigned URL remains valid for the period of time specified when the URL is generated. If you create a presigned URL with the Amazon S3 console, the expiration time can be set between 1 minute and 12 hours. If you use the AWS CLI or AWS SDKs, the expiration time can be set as high as 7 days.

So the 7-day requirement is achievable when the URL is generated programmatically using the AWS CLI or SDKs with long-lived IAM user credentials (Signature Version 4). IAM user credentials are valid up to 7 days when using AWS Signature Version 4; you delegate the IAM user access key/secret key to the method generating the presigned URL.

This is the most secure option because:
- No new IAM identities need to be created for external users
- Access is scoped to specific objects only
- Access automatically expires
- No long-lived credentials are distributed

> Note on the comment claiming "12 hours max": That limit only applies to URLs generated via the **S3 console**. CLI/SDK-generated URLs support up to 7 days, which exactly satisfies the requirement.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**B. Amazon WorkDocs folder sharing** — WorkDocs is a content collaboration service, not the typical mechanism for sharing documents that already live in an S3 bucket. It would require migrating documents out of S3, provisioning WorkDocs users/sites, and managing external user access there. It is not the most secure or appropriate solution for objects stored in an S3 bucket the company already owns. (Note: AWS announced WorkDocs end-of-life in April 2025, further making this option non-viable.)

**C. Temporary IAM users with access keys** — IAM is designed for AWS principals, not external/end users. Distributing access keys to external users is an explicit AWS anti-pattern. Long-term access keys can be copied, leaked, and abused beyond the intended files; revoking them depends on manual cleanup. This violates the principle of least privilege and AWS security best practices.

**D. Sharing a role ARN with external users** — External users without their own AWS accounts and trust relationships configured cannot simply assume a role by knowing its ARN. An IAM role requires `sts:AssumeRole` permission from a trusted principal — sharing an ARN provides no access mechanism for arbitrary external users.

## References

- [Sharing objects with presigned URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/ShareObjectPreSignedURL.html)
- [Download and upload objects with presigned URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/using-presigned-url.html)

zh.question: 一家公司要举办面向外部用户的研讨会，并希望与外部用户共享参考文档，为期7天。该公司将参考文档存储在其拥有的Amazon S3存储桶中。与外部用户共享文档最安全的方式是什么？

options.A: 使用 S3 预签名 URL 与外部用户共享文档。设置 7 天的过期时间。
options.B: 将文档移动到 Amazon WorkDocs 文件夹。与外部用户共享 WorkDocs 文件夹的链接。
options.C: 创建对 S3 存储桶具有只读权限的临时 IAM 用户。将访问密钥共享给外部用户。凭据在 7 天后过期。
options.D: 创建一个对 S3 存储桶具有只读权限的角色。将此角色的 Amazon 资源名称 (ARN) 共享给外部用户。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一家公司需要与外部用户共享存储在 S3 桶中的参考文档，用于为期 7 天的工作坊。目标是采用**最安全的**共享方法。

## 正确答案：A — 具有 7 天过期时间的 S3 预签名 URL

S3 预签名 URL 在无需外部用户拥有 AWS 凭证或修改桶/对象权限的情况下，授予对特定 S3 对象的时间受限访问。预签名 URL 在生成时指定的时间段内保持有效。如果使用 Amazon S3 控制台创建预签名 URL，过期时间可设置为 1 分钟至 12 小时。如果使用 AWS CLI 或 AWS SDK，过期时间最长可设置为 7 天。

因此，当使用 AWS CLI 或 SDK 通过长期有效的 IAM 用户凭证（签名版本 4）以编程方式生成 URL 时，7 天的需求是可以实现的。使用 AWS Signature Version 4 时，IAM 用户凭证有效期最长为 7 天；您将 IAM 用户访问密钥/秘密密钥委派给生成预签名 URL 的方法。

这是最安全的选项，因为：
- 无需为外部用户创建新的 IAM 身份
- 访问仅限于特定对象
- 访问自动过期
- 无需分发长期有效的凭证

> 注意关于"最多 12 小时"的评论：该限制仅适用于通过 **S3 控制台**生成的 URL。CLI/SDK 生成的 URL 支持最长 7 天，完全满足需求。

## 其他选项为何错误

**B. Amazon WorkDocs 文件夹共享** — WorkDocs 是内容协作服务，不是共享已存储在 S3 桶中的文档的典型机制。它需要将文档从 S3 迁移出去、配置 WorkDocs 用户/站点，并在那里管理外部用户访问。对于公司已拥有的存储在 S3 桶中的对象来说，这不是最安全或最合适的解决方案。（注意：AWS 在 2025 年 4 月宣布 WorkDocs 停用，进一步使此选项不可行。）

**C. 具有访问密钥的临时 IAM 用户** — IAM 旨在为 AWS 主体设计，而非外部/终端用户。将访问密钥分发给外部用户是明确的 AWS 反模式。长期访问密钥可能被复制、泄露并被滥用于超出预期文件的范围；撤销它们取决于手动清理。这违反了最小权限原则和 AWS 安全最佳实践。

**D. 与外部用户共享角色 ARN** — 没有自己的 AWS 账户且未配置信任关系的外部用户无法仅通过了解 ARN 来简单地假设角色。IAM 角色需要来自受信任主体的 `sts:AssumeRole` 权限 — 共享 ARN 为任意外部用户提供了无访问机制。

## 参考资源

- [使用预签名 URL 共享对象](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/ShareObjectPreSignedURL.html)
- [使用预签名 URL 下载和上传对象](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/using-presigned-url.html)

en.question: A developer is planning to use an Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda to provide a REST API. The developer will have three distinct environments to manage: development, test, and production. How should the application be deployed while minimizing the number of resources to manage?

options.A: Create a separate API Gateway and separate Lambda function for each environment in the same Region.
options.B: Assign a Region for each environment and deploy API Gateway and Lambda to each Region.
options.C: Create one API Gateway with multiple stages with one Lambda function with multiple aliases.
options.D: Create one API Gateway and one Lambda function, and use a REST parameter to identify the environment.

en.explanation:
# Question Analysis

A developer needs to deploy a REST API using API Gateway + Lambda across three environments (development, test, production), while **minimizing the number of resources to manage**.

## Correct Answer: C — One API Gateway with multiple stages, one Lambda function with multiple aliases

API Gateway natively supports the concept of **stages** to represent different deployments (dev/test/prod) of the same API, and Lambda natively supports **versions and aliases** to point to different code snapshots. By combining the two with **stage variables**, you can have a single API Gateway and a single Lambda function serve all three environments.

AWS API Gateway uses "stages" to help you manage multiple environments or versions of your API. Stages are essentially snapshots of your API at a given point in time. To create a stage, give it a meaningful name like dev, staging, or prod. Each stage can have its own configuration, such as logging, caching, and throttling settings, which allows for fine-tuning based on the environment.

On the Lambda side, an alias represents a snapshot of the function and its configuration, including environment-specific variables, allowing you to control versions between development and production environments effectively.

The two are tied together with **stage variables**: Stage variables act like environment variables and can be used to change the behavior of your API Gateway methods for each deployment stage; for example, making it possible to reach a different back end depending on which stage the API is running on. In the integration setup you reference the Lambda function ARN with `:${stageVariables.lambdaAlias}` so each stage routes to the corresponding Lambda alias. This can be done by using API Gateway stage variables and Lambda function alias without creating environment-wise redundant Lambda functions.

A typical mapping:
- API Gateway stage `dev` → stage variable `lambdaAlias=dev` → Lambda alias `dev` (points to `$LATEST` or a dev version)
- API Gateway stage `test` → stage variable `lambdaAlias=test` → Lambda alias `test`
- API Gateway stage `prod` → stage variable `lambdaAlias=prod` → Lambda alias `prod` (points to a stable, immutable version)

This gives full environment isolation with the minimum number of managed resources.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. Separate API Gateway and separate Lambda for each environment in the same Region** — Functionally works, but explicitly creates 3 APIs + 3 Lambda functions. This is the opposite of "minimizing the number of resources to manage." It also makes promoting code between environments harder (no single artifact promoted via aliases).

- **B. Assign a Region for each environment and deploy API Gateway and Lambda to each Region** — Even more wasteful: it triples the resources *and* spreads them across Regions, adding cross-Region complexity, additional IAM/networking overhead, and potential latency/cost. Region separation is not required for environment separation.

- **D. One API Gateway and one Lambda function, using a REST parameter to identify the environment** — A single Lambda version cannot represent three environments simultaneously; there is no isolation between dev/test/prod code or configuration. A bug or deploy in dev would immediately impact prod, since they all share the same `$LATEST` code. This violates the basic separation-of-environments principle and is not a supported AWS pattern.

## Reference Documentation
- [Set up stages in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/set-up-stages.html)
- [Lambda function versions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-versions.html)
- [Lambda function aliases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-aliases.html)
- [Using API Gateway stage variables to manage Lambda functions (AWS Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/using-api-gateway-stage-variables-to-manage-lambda-functions/)

zh.question: 一位开发人员计划使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 提供 REST API。该开发人员需要管理三个不同的环境：开发环境、测试环境和生产环境。如何在尽可能减少需要管理的资源的情况下部署该应用程序？

options.A: 为同一区域中的每个环境创建单独的 API 网关和单独的 Lambda 函数。
options.B: 为每个环境分配一个区域，并将 API 网关和 Lambda 部署到每个区域。
options.C: 创建一个具有多个阶段的 API 网关，使用一个具有多个别名的 Lambda 函数。
options.D: 创建一个 API 网关和一个 Lambda 函数，并使用 REST 参数来标识环境。

zh.explanation:
# 问题分析

开发人员需要跨三个环境（开发、测试、生产）部署 REST API（API Gateway + Lambda），同时**最小化要管理的资源数量**。

## 正确答案：C — 一个 API Gateway 具有多个阶段，一个 Lambda 函数具有多个别名

API Gateway 原生支持**阶段**的概念来表示同一 API 的不同部署（开发/测试/生产），Lambda 原生支持**版本和别名**来指向不同的代码快照。通过将两者与 **stage variables** 结合，您可以使用单个 API Gateway 和单个 Lambda 函数为所有三个环境提供服务。

AWS API Gateway 使用"阶段"来帮助您管理 API 的多个环境或版本。阶段本质上是 API 在给定时间点的快照。要创建阶段，请为其指定一个有意义的名称，例如 dev、staging 或 prod。每个阶段都可以有自己的配置，例如日志记录、缓存和限制设置，这允许根据环境进行微调。

在 Lambda 方面，别名表示函数及其配置的快照，包括环境特定的变量，允许您有效控制开发和生产环境之间的版本。

两者通过 **stage variables** 绑定在一起：Stage variables 的作用类似于环境变量，可用于改变 API Gateway 方法在每个部署阶段的行为；例如，使得 API 能够根据其运行的阶段而到达不同的后端。在集成设置中，您使用 `:${stageVariables.lambdaAlias}` 引用 Lambda 函数 ARN，以便每个阶段路由到相应的 Lambda 别名。这可以通过使用 API Gateway stage variables 和 Lambda 函数别名来完成，而无需创建环境级别的冗余 Lambda 函数。

一个典型的映射：
- API Gateway 阶段 `dev` → stage variable `lambdaAlias=dev` → Lambda 别名 `dev`（指向 `$LATEST` 或开发版本）
- API Gateway 阶段 `test` → stage variable `lambdaAlias=test` → Lambda 别名 `test`
- API Gateway 阶段 `prod` → stage variable `lambdaAlias=prod` → Lambda 别名 `prod`（指向稳定的不可变版本）

这以最少的托管资源数量提供完整的环境隔离。

## 其他选项为什么错误

- **A. 为每个环境分别在同一区域中部署 API Gateway 和 Lambda** — 功能上有效，但明确创建了 3 个 API + 3 个 Lambda 函数。这与"最小化要管理的资源数量"相反。它还使环境之间的代码推广更加困难（没有通过别名推广的单个工件）。

- **B. 为每个环境分配一个区域，并将 API Gateway 和 Lambda 部署到每个区域** — 更加浪费：它将资源增加了三倍，*并且*将它们分散到多个区域，增加了跨区域复杂性、额外的 IAM/网络开销以及潜在的延迟/成本。区域分离对环境分离不是必需的。

- **D. 一个 API Gateway 和一个 Lambda 函数，使用 REST 参数来标识环境** — 单个 Lambda 版本不能同时表示三个环境；开发/测试/生产代码或配置之间没有隔离。开发中的错误或部署会立即影响生产，因为它们都共享相同的 `$LATEST` 代码。这违反了基本的环境分离原则，不是支持的 AWS 模式。

## 参考文档
- [在 API Gateway 中设置阶段](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/set-up-stages.html)
- [Lambda 函数版本](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-versions.html)
- [Lambda 函数别名](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-aliases.html)
- [使用 API Gateway stage variables 管理 Lambda 函数（AWS 博客）](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/using-api-gateway-stage-variables-to-manage-lambda-functions/)

en.question: A developer registered an AWS Lambda function as a target for an Application Load Balancer (ALB) using a CLI command. However, the Lambda function is not being invoked when the client sends requests through the ALB. Why is the Lambda function not being invoked?

options.A: A Lambda function cannot be registered as a target for an ALB.
options.B: A Lambda function can be registered with an ALB using AWS Management Console only.
options.C: The permissions to invoke the Lambda function are missing.
options.D: Cross-zone is not enabled on the ALB.

en.explanation:
# ALB Lambda Target — Missing Invoke Permissions

## Scenario
A developer used the AWS CLI to register a Lambda function as a target for an Application Load Balancer (ALB). When clients hit the ALB, the Lambda is never invoked. The question asks why.

## Correct Answer: C — The permissions to invoke the Lambda function are missing

When registering a Lambda function as an ALB target via the **CLI**, AWS does **not** automatically attach a resource-based policy to the Lambda function. The ALB therefore lacks `lambda:InvokeFunction` permission and cannot trigger the function.

If you create the target group and register the Lambda function using the AWS Management Console, the console adds the required permissions to your Lambda function policy on your behalf. Otherwise, after you create the target group and register the function using the AWS CLI, you must use the add-permission command to grant Elastic Load Balancing permission to invoke your Lambda function.

The fix is to add a resource-based policy to the Lambda function granting the `elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com` service principal `lambda:InvokeFunction`:

```bash
aws lambda add-permission \
  --function-name lambda-function-arn-with-alias-name \
  --statement-id elb1 \
  --principal elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com \
  --action lambda:InvokeFunction \
  --source-arn target-group-arn \
  --source-account target-group-account-id
```

It is recommended to use the aws:SourceAccount and aws:SourceArn condition keys to restrict function invocation to the specified target group, to avoid the confused deputy problem.

If you skip this step, RegisterTargets itself can fail with: "elasticloadbalancing principal does not have permission to invoke arn <Lambda ARN> from target group <Target Group ARN>"

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. "A Lambda function cannot be registered as a target for an ALB."** — False. You can register your Lambda functions as targets and configure a listener rule to forward requests to the target group for your Lambda function. When the load balancer forwards the request to a target group with a Lambda function as a target, it invokes your Lambda function and passes the content of the request to the Lambda function in JSON format.

- **B. "A Lambda function can be registered with an ALB using AWS Management Console only."** — False. The CLI fully supports this via `aws elbv2 register-targets` (and AWS provides explicit guidance for the CLI workflow). You run `aws lambda add-permission` to authorize ELB, and then `aws elbv2 register-targets --target-group-arn ... --targets Id=<lambda function ARN>` to register the Lambda as the target.

- **D. "Cross-zone is not enabled on the ALB."** — Irrelevant. Cross-zone load balancing is always enabled on ALBs and concerns distribution of requests across registered targets in different AZs; it has nothing to do with whether ALB has IAM permission to invoke a Lambda function. The symptom (Lambda never invoked at all) is caused by the missing resource-based policy, not zonal distribution.

## Key Takeaway
**Console registration → permissions added automatically. CLI/CloudFormation/SDK registration → you must manually call `lambda:add-permission` to grant `elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com` invoke rights on the function.**

## References
- [Use Lambda functions as targets of an Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/lambda-functions.html)
- [Process Application Load Balancer requests with Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-alb.html)
- [Register a Lambda function as a target behind an ALB with the AWS CLI](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/elb-register-lambda-as-target-behind-alb)
- [Troubleshoot Lambda functions as targets for ALBs](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/lambda-troubleshoot-targets-for-albs)

zh.question: 开发人员使用 CLI 命令将一个 AWS Lambda 函数注册为应用程序负载均衡器 (ALB) 的目标。但是，当客户端通过 ALB 发送请求时，该 Lambda 函数并未被调用。为什么 Lambda 函数没有被调用？

options.A: Lambda 函数不能注册为 ALB 的目标。
options.B: Lambda 函数只能通过 AWS 管理控制台注册到 ALB。
options.C: 缺少调用 Lambda 函数的权限。
options.D: ALB 上未启用跨区功能。

zh.explanation:
# ALB Lambda 目标 — 缺少调用权限

## 场景
开发者使用 AWS CLI 将 Lambda 函数注册为应用负载均衡器 (ALB) 的目标。当客户端访问 ALB 时，Lambda 从未被调用。问题询问原因。

## 正确答案：C — 缺少调用 Lambda 函数的权限

通过 **CLI** 注册 Lambda 函数作为 ALB 目标时，AWS **不会**自动将基于资源的策略附加到 Lambda 函数。因此 ALB 缺少 `lambda:InvokeFunction` 权限，无法触发该函数。

如果使用 AWS 管理控制台创建目标组并注册 Lambda 函数，控制台会代表您将所需权限添加到 Lambda 函数策略中。否则，使用 AWS CLI 创建目标组并注册函数后，您必须使用 add-permission 命令授予弹性负载均衡权限来调用您的 Lambda 函数。

解决方案是向 Lambda 函数添加基于资源的策略，授予 `elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com` 服务主体 `lambda:InvokeFunction` 权限：

```bash
aws lambda add-permission \
  --function-name lambda-function-arn-with-alias-name \
  --statement-id elb1 \
  --principal elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com \
  --action lambda:InvokeFunction \
  --source-arn target-group-arn \
  --source-account target-group-account-id
```

建议使用 aws:SourceAccount 和 aws:SourceArn 条件键来限制函数调用仅限指定目标组，以避免混淆委托人问题。

如果跳过此步骤，RegisterTargets 本身可能会失败，显示错误："elasticloadbalancing principal does not have permission to invoke arn <Lambda ARN> from target group <Target Group ARN>"

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. "Lambda 函数无法注册为 ALB 的目标。"** — 错误。您可以将 Lambda 函数注册为目标，并配置侦听器规则以将请求转发到 Lambda 函数的目标组。当负载均衡器将请求转发到以 Lambda 函数作为目标的目标组时，它会调用您的 Lambda 函数，并以 JSON 格式将请求内容传递给 Lambda 函数。

- **B. "Lambda 函数只能使用 AWS 管理控制台向 ALB 注册。"** — 错误。CLI 通过 `aws elbv2 register-targets` 完全支持此操作（AWS 为 CLI 工作流提供了明确的指导）。您运行 `aws lambda add-permission` 来授权 ELB，然后运行 `aws elbv2 register-targets --target-group-arn ... --targets Id=<lambda function ARN>` 来将 Lambda 注册为目标。

- **D. "未在 ALB 上启用跨区域。"** — 无关。跨区域负载均衡始终在 ALB 上启用，涉及在不同可用区中的已注册目标间分配请求；与 ALB 是否拥有调用 Lambda 函数的 IAM 权限无关。症状（Lambda 完全未被调用）是由缺失的基于资源的策略引起的，而不是区域分配问题。

## 关键要点
**控制台注册 → 权限自动添加。CLI/CloudFormation/SDK 注册 → 您必须手动调用 `lambda:add-permission` 以授予 `elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com` 对函数的调用权限。**

## 参考资源
- [使用 Lambda 函数作为应用负载均衡器的目标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/lambda-functions.html)
- [使用 Lambda 处理应用负载均衡器请求](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-alb.html)
- [使用 AWS CLI 将 Lambda 函数注册为 ALB 后面的目标](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/elb-register-lambda-as-target-behind-alb)
- [ALB Lambda 函数目标故障排除](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/lambda-troubleshoot-targets-for-albs)

en.question: A developer is creating an AWS Lambda function that will connect to an Amazon RDS for MySQL instance. The developer wants to store the database credentials. The database credentials need to be encrypted and the database password needs to be automatically rotated. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Store the database credentials as environment variables for the Lambda function. Set the environment variables to rotate automatically.
options.B: Store the database credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Set up managed rotation on the database credentials.
options.C: Store the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as secure string parameters. Set up managed rotation on the parameters.
options.D: Store the database credentials in the X-Amz-Security-Token parameter. Set up managed rotation on the parameter.

en.explanation:
# RDS for MySQL Credentials with Encryption + Automatic Rotation

## Scenario
A Lambda function needs to connect to an RDS for MySQL instance. The credentials must be:
1. **Encrypted at rest**
2. **Automatically rotated** (the password)

## Correct Answer: B — AWS Secrets Manager with managed rotation

AWS Secrets Manager is purpose-built for this use case. Secrets are encrypted at rest using AWS KMS, and Secrets Manager natively supports automatic rotation for RDS databases. Secrets Manager makes it easier to rotate, manage, and retrieve database credentials throughout their lifecycle. You can configure Secrets Manager to rotate secrets automatically, and it offers built-in integrations for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Amazon Aurora on Amazon RDS.

With **managed rotation**, the RDS service itself manages the rotation of the master credential on your behalf — no Lambda rotation function needs to be authored. For most managed secrets, you use managed rotation, where the service configures and manages rotation for you. Managed rotation doesn't use a Lambda function. When creating an RDS database you can choose "Manage master credentials in AWS Secrets Manager", after which Amazon RDS automatically manages rotation of the admin secret for you (managed rotation).

The Lambda function would retrieve the current secret value at runtime via the Secrets Manager API (`GetSecretValue`), so it always uses the current rotated password.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Lambda environment variables** — Environment variables are static configuration values. They are encrypted at rest with KMS, but Lambda has **no native mechanism to "rotate" environment variables automatically**. You would have to redeploy or update the function configuration via custom code. This violates the automatic-rotation requirement.

- **C. SSM Parameter Store SecureString** — Parameter Store SecureString parameters are encrypted via KMS, but **Parameter Store does not provide built-in/managed rotation for database credentials**. There is no "managed rotation" feature on SSM parameters. Rotation must be done with custom code/Lambda outside of the service. The AWS recommendation for rotating RDS credentials is Secrets Manager.

- **D. X-Amz-Security-Token** — This is **not a credential storage option**. `X-Amz-Security-Token` is an HTTP header used to pass temporary STS session tokens with signed AWS API requests. It cannot be used to "store" RDS credentials and has no rotation feature. This option is nonsensical.

## References
- [Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)
- [Set up automatic rotation for RDS, Aurora, Redshift, DocumentDB secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotate-secrets_turn-on-for-db.html)
- [Rotate Amazon RDS database credentials with Secrets Manager (AWS Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/security/rotate-amazon-rds-database-credentials-automatically-with-aws-secrets-manager/)
- [Set up alternating users rotation tutorial (managed rotation)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/tutorials_rotation-alternating.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数将连接到 Amazon RDS for MySQL 实例。开发人员希望存储数据库凭证。数据库凭证需要加密，并且数据库密码需要自动轮换。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 将数据库凭据存储为 Lambda 函数的环境变量。设置环境变量自动轮换。
options.B: 将数据库凭证存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。设置数据库凭证的托管轮换。
options.C: 将数据库凭证作为安全字符串参数存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。设置参数的托管轮换。
options.D: 将数据库凭据存储在 X-Amz-Security-Token 参数中。设置该参数的托管轮换。

zh.explanation:
# RDS for MySQL 凭证加密与自动轮换

## 场景
Lambda 函数需要连接到 RDS for MySQL 实例。凭证必须满足以下条件：
1. **静态加密**
2. **自动轮换**（密码）

## 正确答案：B — AWS Secrets Manager 与托管轮换

AWS Secrets Manager 是为此用例专门构建的服务。凭证在静态时使用 AWS KMS 加密，Secrets Manager 原生支持 RDS 数据库的自动轮换。Secrets Manager 使轮换、管理和检索数据库凭证在其整个生命周期内变得更加简单。您可以配置 Secrets Manager 自动轮换凭证，并且它为 MySQL、PostgreSQL 和 Amazon RDS 上的 Amazon Aurora 提供了内置集成。

使用**托管轮换**时，RDS 服务本身代表您管理主凭证的轮换——无需编写 Lambda 轮换函数。对于大多数托管凭证，您使用托管轮换，其中服务为您配置和管理轮换。托管轮换不使用 Lambda 函数。创建 RDS 数据库时，您可以选择"在 AWS Secrets Manager 中管理主凭证"，此后Amazon RDS 自动为您管理管理员凭证的轮换（托管轮换）。

Lambda 函数会在运行时通过 Secrets Manager API（`GetSecretValue`）检索当前凭证值，因此始终使用最新轮换的密码。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. Lambda 环境变量** — 环境变量是静态配置值。它们在静态时使用 KMS 加密，但 Lambda **没有本机机制来"自动轮换"环境变量**。您必须通过自定义代码重新部署或更新函数配置。这违反了自动轮换要求。

- **C. SSM Parameter Store SecureString** — Parameter Store SecureString 参数通过 KMS 加密，但 **Parameter Store 不提供数据库凭证的内置/托管轮换**。SSM 参数上没有"托管轮换"功能。轮换必须通过 Parameter Store 外部的自定义代码/Lambda 完成。AWS 对于轮换 RDS 凭证的建议是使用 Secrets Manager。

- **D. X-Amz-Security-Token** — 这**不是凭证存储选项**。`X-Amz-Security-Token` 是用于传递临时 STS 会话令牌与签名 AWS API 请求的 HTTP 标头。它不能用于"存储" RDS 凭证，也没有轮换功能。此选项没有实际意义。

## 参考资源
- [Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)
- [Set up automatic rotation for RDS, Aurora, Redshift, DocumentDB secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotate-secrets_turn-on-for-db.html)
- [Rotate Amazon RDS database credentials with Secrets Manager (AWS Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/security/rotate-amazon-rds-database-credentials-automatically-with-aws-secrets-manager/)
- [Set up alternating users rotation tutorial (managed rotation)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/tutorials_rotation-alternating.html)

en.question: A developer wants to reduce risk when deploying a new version of an existing AWS Lambda function. To test the Lambda function, the developer needs to split the traffic between the existing version and the new version of the Lambda function. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure a weighted routing policy in Amazon Route 53. Associate the versions of the Lambda function with the weighted routing policy.
options.B: Create a function alias. Configure the alias to split the traffic between the two versions of the Lambda function.
options.C: Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) that uses the Lambda function as a target. Configure the ALB to split the traffic between the two versions of the Lambda function.
options.D: Create the new version of the Lambda function as a Lambda layer on the existing version. Configure the function to split the traffic between the two layers.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The developer wants to reduce risk when deploying a new version of an existing Lambda function by **splitting traffic between the existing version and the new version** (a canary deployment pattern).

## Correct Answer: B — Create a function alias and configure it to split traffic between the two versions

AWS Lambda natively supports traffic shifting via **weighted aliases**. You can use a weighted alias to split traffic between two different versions of the same function. With this approach, you can test new versions of your functions with a small percentage of traffic and quickly roll back if necessary. This is known as a canary deployment.

You can point an alias to a maximum of two Lambda function versions. The versions must meet the following criteria: Both versions must have the same execution role. Both versions must have the same dead-letter queue configuration, or no dead-letter queue configuration. Both versions must be published. The alias cannot point to $LATEST.

Example CLI configuration:

```bash
aws lambda create-alias \
  --name myAlias \
  --function-name myFunction \
  --function-version 1 \
  --routing-config AdditionalVersionWeights={"2"=0.05}
```

This routes 95% of invocations to version 1 and 5% to version 2. See [Implement Lambda canary deployments using a weighted alias](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html).

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**A. Route 53 weighted routing policy** — Route 53 routes DNS records (like ELB endpoints, IPs, or domain names), not Lambda function versions directly. Lambda function versions/aliases are invoked via the Lambda API or via integrations (API Gateway, ALB, EventBridge), not via DNS records. You cannot register Lambda versions as Route 53 record targets. See [Route 53 weighted routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-weighted.html).

**C. Application Load Balancer with Lambda target** — While ALB can invoke Lambda, an ALB target group can only be associated with a single Lambda function (via a specific version or alias). ALB does not natively split traffic at the version level between two Lambda function versions. The proper way to do version-level traffic splitting is at the Lambda layer using aliases — even if you used an ALB, you would still point it to a Lambda alias that itself does the splitting. ALB-level weighted target groups exist, but this is far more complex and unnecessary versus a built-in alias feature. See [ALB Lambda targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/lambda-functions.html).

**D. Lambda layers** — Lambda layers are a packaging mechanism for sharing libraries, custom runtimes, and other dependencies across functions. Layers are not function versions and cannot be used to split invocation traffic. See [Lambda layers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-layers.html).

zh.question: 开发人员希望在部署现有 AWS Lambda 函数的新版本时降低风险。为了测试 Lambda 函数，开发人员需要将流量分配到现有版本和新版本上。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 Amazon Route 53 中配置加权路由策略。将 Lambda 函数的版本与加权路由策略关联起来。
options.B: 创建函数别名。配置别名，将流量分配到 Lambda 函数的两个版本之间。
options.C: 创建一个以 Lambda 函数为目标的应用程序负载均衡器 (ALB)。配置 ALB，将流量分配到 Lambda 函数的两个版本之间。
options.D: 在现有 Lambda 函数的基础上，创建一个新的 Lambda 函数层。配置该函数，使其在两层之间分配流量。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

开发者希望通过**在现有版本和新版本之间分流**来降低部署新版 Lambda 函数的风险（金丝雀部署模式）。

## 正确答案：B — 创建函数别名并将其配置为在两个版本之间分流

AWS Lambda 原生支持通过**加权别名**进行流量转移。你可以使用加权别名在同一函数的两个不同版本之间分流。通过这种方法，你可以用一小部分流量测试新版本的函数，如果必要可以快速回滚。这被称为金丝雀部署。

别名最多可以指向两个 Lambda 函数版本。这些版本必须满足以下条件：两个版本必须具有相同的执行角色。两个版本必须具有相同的死信队列配置，或都没有死信队列配置。两个版本都必须已发布。别名不能指向 $LATEST。

CLI 配置示例：

```bash
aws lambda create-alias \
  --name myAlias \
  --function-name myFunction \
  --function-version 1 \
  --routing-config AdditionalVersionWeights={"2"=0.05}
```

这会将 95% 的调用路由到版本 1，5% 路由到版本 2。详见 [Implement Lambda canary deployments using a weighted alias](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html)。

## 其他选项为什么错误

**A. Route 53 加权路由策略** — Route 53 路由 DNS 记录（如 ELB 端点、IP 地址或域名），而不是直接路由 Lambda 函数版本。Lambda 函数版本/别名通过 Lambda API 或集成（API Gateway、ALB、EventBridge）调用，而不是通过 DNS 记录。你无法将 Lambda 版本注册为 Route 53 记录目标。详见 [Route 53 weighted routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-weighted.html)。

**C. Application Load Balancer with Lambda 目标** — 虽然 ALB 可以调用 Lambda，但 ALB 目标组只能关联一个 Lambda 函数（通过特定版本或别名）。ALB 无法原生在两个 Lambda 函数版本之间进行版本级别的流量分流。正确的版本级流量分流方式是在 Lambda 层使用别名进行分流——即使使用 ALB，你仍然会将其指向一个自身执行分流的 Lambda 别名。ALB 级别的加权目标组确实存在，但与使用内置别名功能相比，这种方法更加复杂且不必要。详见 [ALB Lambda targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/lambda-functions.html)。

**D. Lambda 层** — Lambda 层是一种打包机制，用于在函数间共享库、自定义运行时和其他依赖项。层不是函数版本，无法用于分流调用流量。详见 [Lambda layers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-layers.html)。

en.question: A developer has created a large AWS Lambda function. Deployment of the function is failing because of an InvalidParameterValueException error. The error message indicates that the unzipped size of the function exceeds the maximum supported value. Which actions can the developer take to resolve this error? (Choose two.)

options.A: Submit a quota increase request to AWS Support to increase the function to the required size.
options.B: Use a compression algorithm that is more efficient than ZIP.
options.C: Break up the function into multiple smaller functions.
options.D: Zip the .zip file twice to compress the file more.
options.E: Move common libraries, function dependencies, and custom runtimes into Lambda layers.

en.explanation:
# Lambda Deployment Package Size Exceeded — Resolution

## Scenario
A developer's Lambda function deployment fails with `InvalidParameterValueException` indicating the **unzipped size of the function exceeds the maximum supported value**. Lambda enforces a **250 MB unzipped limit** for the deployment package (including layers and custom runtimes). The developer needs two ways to resolve this.

## Correct Answers: C and E

### C. Break up the function into multiple smaller functions
Refactoring a monolithic Lambda into multiple smaller, single-purpose functions reduces each function's deployment footprint. This is a valid microservices-style mitigation for the 250 MB unzipped limit and aligns with Lambda best practices.

### E. Move common libraries, function dependencies, and custom runtimes into Lambda layers
Lambda layers let you package shared dependencies separately from function code. However, **note an important nuance**: The maximum size for a .zip deployment package for Lambda is 250 MB (unzipped), and this limit applies to the combined size of all the files you upload, including any Lambda layers. So layers don't increase the absolute 250 MB ceiling, but they help by:
- Removing duplicate dependencies from each function
- Allowing reuse across multiple functions (combined with option C)
- Better separation of code vs. dependencies, which often helps trim unused artifacts

This is the AWS-recommended best practice and is the answer AWS expects on the exam.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

### A. Submit a quota increase request — INCORRECT
The 250 MB unzipped deployment package size is a **hard limit** that AWS Support cannot raise. The maximum size of the contents of a deployment package, including layers and custom runtimes when unzipped is 250 MB. This is a hard limit and cannot be increased. The Lambda quotas page also confirms the quotas apply to function configuration, deployment, and execution, and except as noted, they can't be changed.

### B. Use a more efficient compression algorithm — INCORRECT
The error refers to the **unzipped** size, not the zipped size. A better compression algorithm wouldn't reduce the uncompressed footprint at all. Additionally, Lambda only accepts standard `.zip` archives.

### D. Zip the .zip file twice — INCORRECT
Double-zipping does **not** reduce the unzipped size (and typically increases the zipped size, since already-compressed data doesn't compress further). Lambda also requires a single, valid `.zip` archive containing the actual code—a nested zip would not be executable by the runtime.

## Alternative Approaches (not in options, but worth knowing)
For dependencies that genuinely exceed 250 MB, AWS recommends:
- **Container image deployment** — supports up to 10 GB image size
- **Amazon EFS mounted to Lambda** — for very large shared assets

## References
- [AWS Lambda quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html)
- [Working with .zip file archives for Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/python-package.html)
- [Unzipped size must be smaller than 262144000 bytes — AWS re:Post](https://repost.aws/articles/ARuWbuBaFETwihsWkPZXCpQQ/unzipped-size-must-be-smaller-than-262144000-bytes)
- [Lambda layers documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/chapter-layers.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员创建了一个大型 AWS Lambda 函数。由于 InvalidParameterValueException 错误，该函数的部署失败。错误消息表明，解压缩后的函数大小超过了支持的最大值。开发人员可以采取哪些措施来解决此错误？（选择两项。）

options.A: 向 AWS 支持部门提交配额增加请求，将函数增加到所需的大小。
options.B: 使用比 ZIP 更高效的压缩算法。
options.C: 将函数拆分成多个较小的函数。
options.D: 将 .zip 文件压缩两次，以进一步压缩文件。
options.E: 将通用库、函数依赖项和自定义运行时移至 Lambda 层。

zh.explanation:
# Lambda 部署包大小超限 — 解决方案

## 场景
开发人员的 Lambda 函数部署失败，显示 `InvalidParameterValueException` 错误，指示**函数的解压后大小超过最大支持值**。Lambda 对部署包（包括层和自定义运行时）强制执行 **250 MB 解压后限制**。开发人员需要两种方式来解决这个问题。

## 正确答案：C 和 E

### C. 将函数分解成多个较小的函数
将单体 Lambda 重构为多个较小的、单一用途的函数可以减少每个函数的部署占用空间。这是针对 250 MB 解压后限制的有效微服务式缓解方案，符合 Lambda 最佳实践。

### E. 将常见库、函数依赖项和自定义运行时移到 Lambda 层中
Lambda 层让您可以将共享依赖项与函数代码分开打包。但是，**请注意一个重要的细微差别**：Lambda 的 .zip 部署包的最大大小为 250 MB（解压后），此限制适用于您上传的所有文件的组合大小，包括任何 Lambda 层。 因此，层不会增加绝对的 250 MB 上限，但它们通过以下方式提供帮助：
- 从每个函数中删除重复的依赖项
- 允许在多个函数间重复使用（与选项 C 结合）
- 更好地分离代码和依赖项，这通常有助于修剪未使用的工件

这是 AWS 推荐的最佳实践，也是 AWS 在考试中期望的答案。

## 其他选项为什么错误

### A. 提交配额增加请求 — 错误
250 MB 解压后部署包大小是一个 **硬性限制**，AWS 支持部门无法提高。部署包内容（包括层和自定义运行时）在解压后的最大大小为 250 MB。这是硬性限制，不能增加。 Lambda 配额页面也确认配额适用于函数配置、部署和执行，除非另有说明，否则无法更改。

### B. 使用更高效的压缩算法 — 错误
错误指的是**解压后**的大小，而不是压缩后的大小。更好的压缩算法根本不会减少未压缩的占用空间。此外，Lambda 只接受标准 `.zip` 存档。

### D. 将 .zip 文件压缩两次 — 错误
双重压缩**不会**减少解压后的大小（通常会增加压缩后的大小，因为已压缩的数据无法进一步压缩）。Lambda 还要求使用单一的有效 `.zip` 存档，其中包含实际代码——嵌套的 zip 不会被运行时执行。

## 替代方法（不在选项中，但值得了解）
对于真正超过 250 MB 的依赖项，AWS 建议：
- **容器镜像部署** — 支持高达 10 GB 的镜像大小
- **挂载到 Lambda 的 Amazon EFS** — 用于非常大的共享资产

## 参考资料
- [AWS Lambda 配额](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html)
- [使用 Lambda 的 .zip 文件存档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/python-package.html)
- [解压后大小必须小于 262144000 字节 — AWS re:Post](https://repost.aws/articles/ARuWbuBaFETwihsWkPZXCpQQ/unzipped-size-must-be-smaller-than-262144000-bytes)
- [Lambda 层文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/chapter-layers.html)

en.question: A developer is troubleshooting an application in an integration environment. In the application, an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue consumes messages and then an AWS Lambda function processes the messages. The Lambda function transforms the messages and makes an API call to a third- party service. There has been an increase in application usage. The third-party API frequently returns an HTTP 429 Too Many Requests error message. The error message prevents a significant number of messages from being processed successfully. How can the developer resolve this issue?

options.A: Increase the SQS event source’s batch size setting.
options.B: Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function based on the third-party API’s documented rate limits.
options.C: Increase the retry attempts and maximum event age in the Lambda function’s asynchronous configuration.
options.D: Configure maximum concurrency on the SQS event source based on the third-party service’s documented rate limits.

en.explanation:
# SQS + Lambda: Throttling Calls to a Rate-Limited Third-Party API

## Scenario
An SQS queue triggers a Lambda function that calls a third-party API. As traffic grows, the third-party API returns **HTTP 429 Too Many Requests** because Lambda scales out faster than the API allows. The fix must throttle the rate at which Lambda calls the downstream API while preserving messages in the queue (no dropping, no DLQ flood).

## Correct Answer: D — Configure maximum concurrency on the SQS event source

The **Maximum Concurrency** setting on an SQS event source mapping (released January 2023) directly solves this problem. AWS Lambda provides a way to control the maximum number of concurrent functions invoked by Amazon SQS as an event source, which controls the concurrency of Lambda functions processing messages in individual SQS queues.

By aligning this value with the third-party API's documented rate limit, the developer caps how many Lambda invocations can run in parallel and therefore caps the rate of API calls. It sets a limit on the maximum number of concurrent function invocations per SQS event source, and once Lambda reaches the maximum concurrency configured on the event source, Lambda stops reading more messages from the queue.

Critically, this avoids the classic "SQS overpull" problem caused by using reserved concurrency: this feature can help prevent a Lambda function from consuming all available Lambda concurrency of the account and avoids messages returning to the queue unnecessarily because of Lambda functions being throttled.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

### A. Increase the SQS event source's batch size
This makes the problem **worse**. A larger batch size means each invocation processes more messages, but the function still iterates and makes more API calls per invocation. It does not reduce concurrency or rate of outbound API calls — it only changes how messages are grouped per invocation. It does nothing to slow Lambda's scale-out (up to 1,250 concurrent invocations for SQS standard queues).

### B. Configure provisioned concurrency based on the API's rate limits
**Provisioned concurrency** pre-warms a number of execution environments to eliminate cold starts; it is **not** an upper bound. When a large number of messages are in the SQS queue, Lambda scales out, adding additional functions to process the messages, and the scale out can consume the concurrency quota in the account. Lambda will still scale beyond the provisioned value using on-demand concurrency, so it will not prevent 429 errors. The setting that *limits* concurrency is reserved concurrency or — better here — SQS event source maximum concurrency.

### C. Increase retry attempts and maximum event age in the asynchronous configuration
The Lambda function invoked by an SQS event source mapping is invoked **synchronously**, not asynchronously. The asynchronous invocation settings (Maximum age of event, Retry attempts) do not apply to SQS-triggered Lambdas — retries for SQS are governed by the queue's visibility timeout and redrive policy. Even if retries did apply, retrying more aggressively against a rate-limited API will not solve 429s; it will worsen them.

## Key Reference
- [Configuring scaling behavior for SQS event source mappings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-scaling.html)
- [Introducing maximum concurrency of AWS Lambda functions when using Amazon SQS as an event source](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/introducing-maximum-concurrency-of-aws-lambda-functions-when-using-amazon-sqs-as-an-event-source/)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在集成环境中排查应用程序故障。该应用程序中，Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列会接收消息，然后由 AWS Lambda 函数处理这些消息。Lambda 函数会转换消息并调用第三方服务的 API。最近应用程序的使用量激增，第三方 API 频繁返回 HTTP 429 Too Many Requests 错误消息。该错误消息导致大量消息无法成功处理。开发人员该如何解决此问题？

options.A: 增加 SQS 事件源的批处理大小设置。
options.B: 根据第三方 API 文档中规定的速率限制，为 Lambda 函数配置预置并发。
options.C: 增加 Lambda 函数异步配置中的重试次数和最大事件年龄。
options.D: 根据第三方服务记录的速率限制，配置 SQS 事件源的最大并发数。

zh.explanation:
# SQS + Lambda：限流调用速率受限的第三方 API

## 场景
一个 SQS 队列触发 Lambda 函数调用第三方 API。随着流量增长，第三方 API 返回 **HTTP 429 Too Many Requests**，因为 Lambda 扩展速度快于 API 允许的速率。修复方案必须限流 Lambda 调用下游 API 的速率，同时保留队列中的消息（不丢弃、不导致死信队列溢出）。

## 正确答案：D — 在 SQS 事件源上配置最大并发性

SQS 事件源映射上的 **Maximum Concurrency** 设置（2023 年 1 月发布）直接解决了这个问题。AWS Lambda 提供了一种方式来控制由 Amazon SQS 作为事件源触发的 Lambda 函数的最大并发数，这控制了在单个 SQS 队列中处理消息的 Lambda 函数的并发性。

通过将此值与第三方 API 的文档化速率限制保持一致，开发者可以限制有多少个 Lambda 调用可以并行运行，从而限制 API 调用的速率。它设置了每个 SQS 事件源的最大并发函数调用数的限制，一旦 Lambda 达到事件源上配置的最大并发性，Lambda 会停止从队列读取更多消息。

至关重要的是，这避免了使用预留并发导致的经典"SQS 过度拉取"问题：此功能可以帮助防止 Lambda 函数消耗账户所有可用的 Lambda 并发性，并避免因 Lambda 函数被限流而导致消息不必要地返回队列。

## 其他选项为什么错误

### A. 增加 SQS 事件源的批大小
这会让问题**更糟**。更大的批大小意味着每次调用处理更多消息，但函数仍然会遍历并每次调用进行更多 API 调用。它不会减少并发性或出站 API 调用的速率 — 它只改变了每次调用消息的分组方式。它无法减慢 Lambda 的扩展速度（SQS 标准队列最多 1,250 个并发调用）。

### B. 基于 API 的速率限制配置预留并发性
**预留并发性**预先预热一定数量的执行环境来消除冷启动；它**不是**上限。当 SQS 队列中有大量消息时，Lambda 会扩展，添加额外的函数来处理消息，扩展会消耗账户中的并发配额。 Lambda 仍会使用按需并发超出预留值进行扩展，所以它不会防止 429 错误。*限制*并发的设置是预留并发或 — 这里更好的是 — SQS 事件源最大并发性。

### C. 在异步配置中增加重试次数和最大事件期限
由 SQS 事件源映射触发的 Lambda 函数是**同步**调用的，而非异步调用的。异步调用设置（最大事件期限、重试次数）不适用于 SQS 触发的 Lambda — SQS 的重试由队列的可见性超时和重定向策略控制。即使重试适用，更积极地对速率受限的 API 重试也不会解决 429 错误；反而会加重它们。

## 关键参考资源
- [Configuring scaling behavior for SQS event source mappings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-scaling.html)
- [Introducing maximum concurrency of AWS Lambda functions when using Amazon SQS as an event source](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/introducing-maximum-concurrency-of-aws-lambda-functions-when-using-amazon-sqs-as-an-event-source/)

en.question: A company has a three-tier application that is deployed in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). The application is using an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. The application performs more database reads than writes. During times of peak usage, the application’s performance degrades. When this performance degradation occurs, the DB instance’s ReadLatency metric in Amazon CloudWatch increases suddenly. How should a developer modify the application to improve performance?

options.A: Use Amazon ElastiCache to cache query results.
options.B: Scale the ECS cluster to contain more ECS instances.
options.C: Add read capacity units (RCUs) to the DB instance.
options.D: Modify the ECS task definition to increase the task memory.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A three-tier ECS application uses Amazon RDS for MySQL. The workload is **read-heavy**, and during peak usage the CloudWatch `ReadLatency` metric for the RDS instance spikes, causing performance degradation. The developer needs to reduce read pressure on the database.

## Correct Answer: A — Use Amazon ElastiCache to cache query results

ElastiCache is a managed in-memory caching service that sits in front of databases like RDS. By caching frequently accessed query results in memory, repeated reads are served from the cache rather than from RDS, which directly reduces the read load and `ReadLatency` on the DB instance.

- ElastiCache is ideally suited as a front end for AWS services like Amazon RDS and DynamoDB, providing extremely low latency for high-performance applications and offloading some of the request volume while these services provide long-lasting data durability.
- When you implement ElastiCache over a relational database such as Amazon RDS for MySQL, you can improve performance and reduce costs — saving up to 55% in cost and gaining up to 80x faster read performance using ElastiCache with RDS for MySQL versus RDS alone. ElastiCache can cache the result set and offload database IOPS, improving performance of both the database and the application.
- Read-heavy workloads with common database queries returning the same result set will benefit greatly from caching the query results.

This perfectly matches the scenario: read-heavy traffic spiking RDS `ReadLatency`. See the AWS blog [Optimize cost and boost performance of RDS for MySQL using Amazon ElastiCache for Redis](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/optimize-cost-and-boost-performance-of-rds-for-mysql-using-amazon-elasticache-for-redis/).

## Why the other options are wrong

**B. Scale the ECS cluster to contain more ECS instances** — The bottleneck is the database's read latency, not ECS compute capacity. Adding more ECS tasks would actually generate *more* concurrent reads against RDS, worsening the `ReadLatency` problem. Scaling the application tier does not address back-end DB contention.

**C. Add read capacity units (RCUs) to the DB instance** — RCUs (Read Capacity Units) are an Amazon **DynamoDB** capacity concept; they do not exist for Amazon RDS for MySQL. RDS scales reads via instance class size or **read replicas**, not via RCUs. Therefore this option is technically incorrect for an RDS MySQL DB instance. See [Amazon RDS Read Replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html) and [DynamoDB Read/Write Capacity Mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/HowItWorks.ReadWriteCapacityMode.html).

**D. Modify the ECS task definition to increase task memory** — Task memory affects the container's available RAM for the application process, not database query latency. The CloudWatch metric showing degradation is `ReadLatency` on the RDS instance, which is measured at the database level and is unaffected by ECS task memory allocation. See [ECS task definition parameters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task_definition_parameters.html).

## Key takeaway

For read-heavy RDS workloads suffering from high `ReadLatency`, fronting the database with **Amazon ElastiCache** (Redis or Memcached) is the standard AWS-recommended pattern to offload reads and dramatically improve performance.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个三层架构的应用程序，部署在 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 上。该应用程序使用 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例。该应用程序的数据库读取操作多于写入操作。在高峰使用期间，应用程序的性能会下降。当性能下降时，Amazon CloudWatch 中数据库实例的 ReadLatency 指标会突然升高。开发人员应该如何修改应用程序以提高性能？

options.A: 使用 Amazon ElastiCache 缓存查询结果。
options.B: 扩展 ECS 集群以容纳更多 ECS 实例。
options.C: 向数据库实例添加读取容量单位 (RCU)。
options.D: 修改 ECS 任务定义以增加任务内存。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一个三层 ECS 应用使用 Amazon RDS for MySQL。该工作负载是**读密集型**的，在峰值使用期间 RDS 实例的 CloudWatch `ReadLatency` 指标激增，导致性能下降。开发人员需要减少数据库的读压力。

## 正确答案：A — 使用 Amazon ElastiCache 缓存查询结果

ElastiCache 是一个托管的内存缓存服务，位于 RDS 等数据库的前端。通过在内存中缓存频繁访问的查询结果，重复读取将从缓存而不是 RDS 提供，这直接降低了数据库实例的读负载和 `ReadLatency`。

- ElastiCache 非常适合作为 AWS 服务（如 Amazon RDS 和 DynamoDB）的前端，为高性能应用提供极低的延迟，并卸载部分请求量，同时这些服务提供持久的数据耐久性。
- 在关系型数据库（如 Amazon RDS for MySQL）上实现 ElastiCache 时，您可以提高性能并降低成本 — 使用 ElastiCache 与 RDS for MySQL 相比单独使用 RDS，可节省高达 55% 的成本并获得高达 80 倍更快的读取性能。ElastiCache 可以缓存结果集并卸载数据库 IOPS，改善数据库和应用的性能。
- 具有返回相同结果集的常见数据库查询的读密集型工作负载将从缓存查询结果中受益良多。

这完全符合场景：读密集型流量导致 RDS `ReadLatency` 激增。请参阅 AWS 博客 [Optimize cost and boost performance of RDS for MySQL using Amazon ElastiCache for Redis](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/optimize-cost-and-boost-performance-of-rds-for-mysql-using-amazon-elasticache-for-redis/)。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**B. 扩展 ECS 集群以包含更多 ECS 实例** — 瓶颈在于数据库的读延迟，而不是 ECS 计算容量。添加更多 ECS 任务实际上会针对 RDS 生成*更多*并发读取，恶化 `ReadLatency` 问题。扩展应用层不会解决后端数据库争用问题。

**C. 向数据库实例添加读容量单位 (RCU)** — RCU（读容量单位）是 Amazon **DynamoDB** 的容量概念；它们不适用于 Amazon RDS for MySQL。RDS 通过实例类大小或**读副本**来扩展读取，而不是通过 RCU。因此，此选项在技术上对 RDS MySQL 数据库实例不正确。请参阅 [Amazon RDS Read Replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html) 和 [DynamoDB Read/Write Capacity Mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/HowItWorks.ReadWriteCapacityMode.html)。

**D. 修改 ECS 任务定义以增加任务内存** — 任务内存影响容器的可用 RAM 用于应用进程，不影响数据库查询延迟。显示性能下降的 CloudWatch 指标是 RDS 实例上的 `ReadLatency`，该指标在数据库级别测量，不受 ECS 任务内存分配的影响。请参阅 [ECS task definition parameters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task_definition_parameters.html)。

## 关键要点

对于遭受高 `ReadLatency` 的读密集型 RDS 工作负载，在数据库前使用 **Amazon ElastiCache**（Redis 或 Memcached）是 AWS 推荐的标准模式，用于卸载读取并大幅提高性能。

en.question: A company has an online web application that includes a product catalog. The catalog is stored in an Amazon S3 bucket that is named DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET. The application must be able to list the objects in the S3 bucket and must be able to download objects through an IAM policy. Which policy allows MINIMUM access to meet these requirements?
en.explanation:
## Scenario

The application needs to:
1. **List** objects in S3 bucket `DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET` → requires `s3:ListBucket` on the **bucket ARN**
2. **Download** objects → requires `s3:GetObject` on the **object ARN** (`bucket/*`)

The question asks for the policy granting **MINIMUM** access (principle of least privilege).

## Correct Answer: A

Option A grants exactly the two required permissions and nothing more:
- `s3:ListBucket` on `arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET` (bucket-level)
- `s3:GetObject` on `arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET/*` (object-level)

This matches the AWS-recommended minimum read pattern. Note that the s3:ListBucket permissions on the bucket itself are specified by the ARN arn:aws:s3:::amzn-s3-demo-bucket, and this action allows applications to list all the objects in the bucket; the second part grants permissions to interact with the objects in the bucket, specifically allowing actions like s3:GetObject on all objects in the bucket, specified by the ARN arn:aws:s3:::amzn-s3-demo-bucket/*. This is the canonical least-privilege read pattern documented by AWS.

```json
{
    "Version": "2012-10-17",
    "Statement": [
        {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": "s3:ListBucket",
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET"
        },
        {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": ["s3:GetObject"],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET/*"
        }
    ]
}
```

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **Option B** — Uses `"s3:*"` on objects, which grants **every** S3 object action (PutObject, DeleteObject, PutObjectAcl, RestoreObject, etc.). This violates the principle of least privilege; the requirement is only list + download.

- **Option C** — Adds `s3:PutObject` and `s3:DeleteObject`. The application only needs to **list and download** the catalog. Granting write and delete permissions exceeds the minimum required and could allow corruption or destruction of catalog objects.

- **Option D** — Contains an **explicit Deny** on `s3:GetObject`. Per IAM evaluation logic, when a request hits S3, AWS checks multiple policies and an explicit deny means the request is denied; a deny in any policy trumps an allow anywhere else. This policy would prevent the application from downloading any objects, breaking the requirement.

## References

- [Grant read and write access to Amazon S3 bucket objects (IAM User Guide)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_examples_s3_rw-bucket.html)
- [Writing IAM Policies: How to Grant Access to an Amazon S3 Bucket (AWS Security Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/security/writing-iam-policies-how-to-grant-access-to-an-amazon-s3-bucket/)
- [Policies and permissions in Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-policy-language-overview.html)

zh.question: 一家公司有一个包含产品目录的在线 Web 应用程序。该目录存储在名为 DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET 的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。该应用程序必须能够列出 S3 存储桶中的对象，并且必须能够通过 IAM 策略下载对象。哪个策略允许满足这些要求的最低访问权限？
zh.explanation:
## 场景

应用程序需要：
1. **列出** S3 存储桶 `DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET` 中的对象 → 需要对**存储桶 ARN** 的 `s3:ListBucket` 权限
2. **下载**对象 → 需要对**对象 ARN**（`bucket/*`）的 `s3:GetObject` 权限

问题要求授予**最少**访问权限（最小权限原则）。

## 正确答案：A

选项 A 仅授予两个必需的权限，没有其他权限：
- 对 `arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET` 的 `s3:ListBucket`（存储桶级别）
- 对 `arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET/*` 的 `s3:GetObject`（对象级别）

这符合 AWS 推荐的最小读取模式。请注意，存储桶本身上的 s3:ListBucket 权限由 ARN arn:aws:s3:::amzn-s3-demo-bucket 指定，此操作允许应用程序列出存储桶中的所有对象；第二部分授予与存储桶中对象交互的权限，特别是允许对存储桶中的所有对象执行 s3:GetObject 等操作，由 ARN arn:aws:s3:::amzn-s3-demo-bucket/* 指定。这是 AWS 记录的规范最小权限读取模式。

```json
{
    "Version": "2012-10-17",
    "Statement": [
        {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": "s3:ListBucket",
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET"
        },
        {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": ["s3:GetObject"],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET/*"
        }
    ]
}
```

## 其他选项为何错误

- **选项 B** — 对对象使用 `"s3:*"`，这会授予**所有** S3 对象操作（PutObject、DeleteObject、PutObjectAcl、RestoreObject 等）。这违反了最小权限原则；需求仅为列出和下载。

- **选项 C** — 添加了 `s3:PutObject` 和 `s3:DeleteObject`。应用程序仅需要**列出和下载**目录。授予写入和删除权限超过了最小需求，可能允许对目录对象的损坏或删除。

- **选项 D** — 包含对 `s3:GetObject` 的**显式拒绝**。根据 IAM 评估逻辑，当请求到达 S3 时，AWS 检查多个策略，显式拒绝意味着请求被拒绝；任何策略中的拒绝都会覆盖其他任何地方的允许。此策略将防止应用程序下载任何对象，破坏需求。

## 参考资源

- [授予对 Amazon S3 存储桶对象的读取和写入访问权限 (IAM 用户指南)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_examples_s3_rw-bucket.html)
- [编写 IAM 策略：如何授予对 Amazon S3 存储桶的访问权限 (AWS 安全博客)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/security/writing-iam-policies-how-to-grant-access-to-an-amazon-s3-bucket/)
- [Amazon S3 中的策略和权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-policy-language-overview.html)

en.question: A developer is writing an application to encrypt files outside of AWS before uploading the files to an Amazon S3 bucket. The encryption must be symmetric and must be performed inside the application. How can the developer implement the encryption in the application to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a data key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the AWS Encryption SDK to encrypt the files.
options.B: Create a Hash-Based Message Authentication Code (HMAC) key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the AWS Encryption SDK to encrypt the files.
options.C: Create a data key pair in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the AWS CLI to encrypt the files.
options.D: Create a data key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the AWS CLI to encrypt the files.

en.explanation:
# Client-side Encryption with AWS KMS Data Key + AWS Encryption SDK

## Scenario
A developer needs to encrypt files **inside the application** (client-side, outside of AWS) using **symmetric** encryption before uploading them to Amazon S3. The question asks for the right combination of KMS key type and tooling.

## Correct Answer: A — Create a data key in AWS KMS, then use the AWS Encryption SDK to encrypt the files

This is the canonical client-side envelope encryption pattern:

1. The application calls KMS `GenerateDataKey` (under a symmetric KMS CMK) to obtain a **plaintext data key** and an **encrypted data key**. You can use the AWS SDKs to interact with AWS KMS, including encrypting and decrypting small amounts of data (up to 4,096 bytes with a symmetric encryption key) and generating data keys for client-side encryption.
2. The plaintext data key is used to encrypt the file locally; the plaintext key is then discarded from memory and the encrypted data key is stored alongside the ciphertext.
3. The **AWS Encryption SDK** is purpose-built for this. The AWS Encryption SDK is a client-side encryption library designed to make it easy for everyone to encrypt and decrypt data using industry standards and best practices. It enables you to focus on the core functionality of your application, rather than on how to best encrypt and decrypt your data.
4. The SDK uses symmetric AES-GCM. The AWS Encryption SDK uses the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) symmetric algorithm in Galois/Counter Mode (GCM), known as AES-GCM, to encrypt your data.
5. The SDK only supports symmetric KMS keys for wrapping. The AWS Encryption SDK supports only symmetric encryption KMS keys. You cannot use an asymmetric KMS key for encryption or signing in the AWS Encryption SDK.
6. The SDK automates the envelope-encryption workflow described above. The AWS Encryption SDK handles this process for you. The AWS Encryption SDK provides a library that encrypts and decrypts data using industry standards and best practices. It generates the data key, encrypts it under the wrapping keys you specify, and returns an encrypted message, a portable data object that includes the encrypted data and the encrypted data keys you need to decrypt it.

## Why the other options are wrong

**B. HMAC key + AWS Encryption SDK** — HMAC KMS keys are used for generating/verifying message authentication codes (integrity/authenticity), not for encrypting data. The Encryption SDK requires a symmetric *encryption* KMS key, not an HMAC key, so this combination cannot encrypt files.

**C. Data key pair (asymmetric) + AWS CLI** — A "data key pair" is an asymmetric key pair (e.g., RSA/ECC), which violates the requirement for **symmetric** encryption. You can also request the service to generate an asymmetric data key pair. This operation returns a plaintext copy of the public key, private key, and a copy of the private key encrypted under a symmetric KMS key that you specify. You can use the plaintext public or private key in your local application and store the encrypted copy of the private key for future use. Additionally, the AWS CLI does not perform bulk file encryption inside an application — `aws kms encrypt` is limited to ≤4 KB and runs server-side at KMS, not "inside the application."

**D. Data key + AWS CLI** — While the symmetric data key part is correct, using the AWS CLI is not "inside the application" and the CLI does not provide a client-side envelope-encryption library. The developer would have to manually implement encrypting the data with the plaintext key, securely discarding it, and storing the encrypted data key — exactly the burden the Encryption SDK is designed to remove. You can use the AWS SDKs to interact with AWS KMS, including encrypting and decrypting small amounts of data (up to 4,096 bytes with a symmetric encryption key) and generating data keys for client-side encryption. However, when you generate a data key, you must manage the entire encryption and decryption process, includluding encrypting your data with the data key outside of AWS KMS, safely discarding the plaintext data key, storing the encrypted data key, and then decrypting the data key and decrypting your data. The AWS Encryption SDK handles this process for you.

## References
- [What is the AWS Encryption SDK?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/encryption-sdk/latest/developer-guide/introduction.html)
- [AWS Encryption SDK FAQ](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/encryption-sdk/latest/developer-guide/faq.html)
- [AWS KMS client-side encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/cryptographic-details/client-side-encryption.html)
- [AWS KMS features](https://aws.amazon.com/kms/features/)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在编写一个应用程序，用于在将文件上传到 Amazon S3 存储桶之前对 AWS 外部的文件进行加密。加密必须是对称的，并且必须在应用程序内部执行。开发人员如何在应用程序中实现加密以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 中创建数据密钥。使用 AWS Encryption SDK 对文件进行加密。
options.B: 在 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 中创建基于哈希的消息认证码 (HMAC) 密钥。使用 AWS 加密 SDK 对文件进行加密。
options.C: 在 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 中创建数据密钥对。使用 AWS CLI 对文件进行加密。
options.D: 在 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 中创建数据密钥。使用 AWS CLI 对文件进行加密。

zh.explanation:
# 使用 AWS KMS 数据密钥 + AWS Encryption SDK 进行客户端加密

## 场景
开发人员需要在应用程序内部（客户端，AWS 外部）使用**对称**加密来加密文件，然后再将其上传到 Amazon S3。问题要求找到正确的 KMS 密钥类型和工具组合。

## 正确答案：A — 在 AWS KMS 中创建数据密钥，然后使用 AWS Encryption SDK 加密文件

这是规范的客户端信封加密模式：

1. 应用程序调用 KMS `GenerateDataKey`（在对称 KMS CMK 下）以获取**明文数据密钥**和**加密数据密钥**。您可以使用 AWS SDK 与 AWS KMS 交互，包括加密和解密少量数据（使用对称加密密钥最多 4,096 字节）以及生成用于客户端加密的数据密钥。
2. 明文数据密钥用于在本地加密文件；然后从内存中丢弃明文密钥，加密数据密钥与密文一起存储。
3. **AWS Encryption SDK** 就是为此目的而设计的。AWS Encryption SDK 是一个客户端加密库，旨在使每个人都可以轻松使用行业标准和最佳实践来加密和解密数据。它使您能够专注于应用程序的核心功能，而不是如何最好地加密和解密数据。
4. SDK 使用对称 AES-GCM。AWS Encryption SDK 使用高级加密标准 (AES) 对称算法在 Galois/Counter Mode (GCM) 中（称为 AES-GCM）来加密您的数据。
5. SDK 仅支持对称 KMS 密钥进行包装。AWS Encryption SDK 仅支持对称加密 KMS 密钥。您不能在 AWS Encryption SDK 中使用非对称 KMS 密钥进行加密或签名。
6. SDK 自动化了上述信封加密工作流。AWS Encryption SDK 为您处理此过程。AWS Encryption SDK 提供一个库，使用行业标准和最佳实践来加密和解密数据。它生成数据密钥，在您指定的包装密钥下对其进行加密，并返回一条加密消息，这是一个便携式数据对象，包含加密数据和解密所需的加密数据密钥。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**B. HMAC 密钥 + AWS Encryption SDK** — HMAC KMS 密钥用于生成/验证消息认证码（完整性/真实性），而不是用于加密数据。Encryption SDK 需要对称*加密* KMS 密钥，而不是 HMAC 密钥，因此此组合无法加密文件。

**C. 数据密钥对（非对称）+ AWS CLI** — "数据密钥对"是非对称密钥对（例如 RSA/ECC），这违反了**对称**加密的要求。您也可以请求服务生成非对称数据密钥对。此操作返回公钥和私钥的明文副本，以及在您指定的对称 KMS 密钥下加密的私钥副本。您可以在本地应用程序中使用明文公钥或私钥，并存储加密的私钥副本供日后使用。此外，AWS CLI 不在应用程序内执行批量文件加密 — `aws kms encrypt` 限制为 ≤4 KB 并在 KMS 处运行服务器端，而不是"在应用程序内部"。

**D. 数据密钥 + AWS CLI** — 虽然对称数据密钥部分正确，但使用 AWS CLI 不在"应用程序内部"，CLI 也不提供客户端信封加密库。开发人员必须手动实现用数据密钥加密数据、安全丢弃密钥和存储加密数据密钥的过程 — 正是 Encryption SDK 旨在消除的负担。您可以使用 AWS SDK 与 AWS KMS 交互，包括加密和解密少量数据（使用对称加密密钥最多 4,096 字节）以及生成用于客户端加密的数据密钥。但是，当您生成数据密钥时，您必须管理整个加密和解密过程，包括在 AWS KMS 外部用数据密钥加密数据、安全地丢弃明文数据密钥、存储加密数据密钥，然后解密数据密钥和解密数据。AWS Encryption SDK 为您处理此过程。

## 参考资料
- [什么是 AWS Encryption SDK？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/encryption-sdk/latest/developer-guide/introduction.html)
- [AWS Encryption SDK 常见问题](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/encryption-sdk/latest/developer-guide/faq.html)
- [AWS KMS 客户端加密](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/cryptographic-details/client-side-encryption.html)
- [AWS KMS 功能](https://aws.amazon.com/kms/features/)

en.question: A developer is working on an application that is deployed on an Amazon EC2 instance. The developer needs a solution that will securely transfer files from the application to an Amazon S3 bucket. What should the developer do to meet these requirements in the MOST secure way?

options.A: Create an IAM user. Create an access key for the IAM user. Store the access key in the application’s environment variables.
options.B: Create an IAM role. Create an access key for the IAM role. Store the access key in the application’s environment variables.
options.C: Create an IAM role. Configure the IAM role to access the specific Amazon S3 API calls the application requires. Associate the IAM role with the EC2 instance.
options.D: Configure an S3 bucket policy for the S3 bucket. Configure the S3 bucket policy to allow access for the EC2 instance ID.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

An application runs on an Amazon EC2 instance and needs to upload files to an S3 bucket. The question asks for the **most secure** way to grant the application access to S3.

## Correct Answer: C

**Create an IAM role, configure it with the specific S3 API permissions the application requires, and associate the IAM role with the EC2 instance.**

This is the AWS-recommended best practice. IAM roles were designed so that applications can securely make API requests from EC2 instances, without requiring you to manage the security credentials that the applications use. When a role is attached to an instance, the application uses temporary, automatically rotated credentials retrieved from the Instance Metadata Service (IMDS), avoiding any long-lived secrets on the host.

Two key best practices are satisfied:

1. **No static credentials on the instance.** Using roles in this way has several benefits. Because role credentials are temporary and updated automatically, you don't have to manage credentials, and you don't have to worry about long-term security risks. In addition, if you use a single role for multiple instances, you can make a change to that one role and the change propagates automatically to all the instances.
2. **Least privilege.** When creating IAM roles, associate least privilege IAM policies that restrict access to the specific API calls the application requires. Option C explicitly says to scope the role to the specific S3 API calls required.

Example permissions policy:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Action": ["s3:PutObject"],
    "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::my-app-bucket/*"
  }]
}
```

The role's trust policy allows the EC2 service to assume it, and the role is attached to the instance via an instance profile.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. IAM user with an access key stored in environment variables.** This places long-lived static credentials on the EC2 instance. If the instance is compromised, credentials are exposed and must be manually rotated. AWS explicitly discourages this pattern; the entire point of IAM roles for EC2 is to eliminate the need to embed credentials. This is actually a better practice since you never type your security credentials on this server (which might be stolen if your server gets hacked).

- **B. Create an access key for an IAM role.** This is technically impossible — IAM roles do not have long-term access keys. Roles vend temporary credentials via STS (and via IMDS when attached to EC2). You cannot create a static access key for a role, so this option is invalid.

- **D. S3 bucket policy granting access based on EC2 instance ID.** S3 bucket policies cannot authorize requests by an "EC2 instance ID" — bucket policy `Principal` and condition keys operate on IAM principals (users, roles, accounts), not on EC2 instance IDs. There is no `aws:SourceInstanceID` style condition key supported on S3 bucket policies for general principal authentication. Even if you used `aws:SourceVpc`/`aws:SourceVpce`, the request still needs an authenticated IAM principal — meaning you'd still need an IAM role on the instance. So this option does not solve the credential problem.

## References

- [IAM roles for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/iam-roles-for-amazon-ec2.html)
- [Use an IAM role to grant permissions to applications running on EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_switch-role-ec2.html)
- [Using IAM roles to authenticate applications deployed to Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdkref/latest/guide/access-iam-roles-for-ec2.html)
- [Grant an EC2 instance access to an S3 bucket (AWS re:Post)](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/ec2-instance-access-s3-bucket)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在开发一个部署在 Amazon EC2 实例上的应用程序。该开发人员需要一个解决方案，能够安全地将文件从应用程序传输到 Amazon S3 存储桶。为了以最安全的方式满足这些要求，开发人员应该怎么做？

options.A: 创建一个 IAM 用户。为该 IAM 用户创建一个访问密钥。将访问密钥存储在应用程序的环境变量中。
options.B: 创建 IAM 角色。为该 IAM 角色创建访问密钥。将访问密钥存储在应用程序的环境变量中。
options.C: 创建 IAM 角色。配置 IAM 角色以访问应用程序所需的特定 Amazon S3 API 调用。将 IAM 角色与 EC2 实例关联。
options.D: 为 S3 存储桶配置 S3 存储桶策略。配置 S3 存储桶策略以允许 EC2 实例 ID 访问。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

应用程序在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行，需要将文件上传到 S3 存储桶。该问题要求找到授予应用程序访问 S3 的**最安全**方式。

## 正确答案：C

**创建 IAM 角色，使用应用程序所需的特定 S3 API 权限进行配置，并将 IAM 角色与 EC2 实例关联。**

这是 AWS 推荐的最佳实践。IAM 角色的设计目的是让应用程序可以安全地从 EC2 实例进行 API 请求，而无需您管理应用程序使用的安全凭证。当角色附加到实例时，应用程序使用从实例元数据服务 (IMDS) 检索的临时且自动轮换的凭证，避免在主机上保存任何长期有效的机密信息。

满足两个关键最佳实践：

1. **实例上没有静态凭证。** 以这种方式使用角色有几个优势。由于角色凭证是临时的且自动更新，您不必管理凭证，也不必担心长期安全风险。此外，如果您为多个实例使用单个角色，可以对该角色进行一次更改，更改会自动传播到所有实例。
2. **最小权限。** 创建 IAM 角色时，关联限制访问应用程序所需特定 API 调用的最小权限 IAM 策略。选项 C 明确表示将角色范围限制在所需的特定 S3 API 调用。

权限策略示例：

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Action": ["s3:PutObject"],
    "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::my-app-bucket/*"
  }]
}
```

角色的信任策略允许 EC2 服务承担它，并通过实例配置文件将角色附加到实例。

## 其他选项为什么是错误的

- **A. IAM 用户的访问密钥存储在环境变量中。** 这会将长期有效的静态凭证放在 EC2 实例上。如果实例遭到破坏，凭证会暴露，必须手动轮换。AWS 明确反对这种模式；IAM 角色的整个要点就是消除在凭证中嵌入凭证的需要。这实际上是一种更好的做法，因为您永远不会在此服务器上键入安全凭证（如果您的服务器遭到黑客入侵，凭证可能会被盗）。

- **B. 为 IAM 角色创建访问密钥。** 这在技术上是不可能的 — IAM 角色没有长期访问密钥。角色通过 STS 提供临时凭证（以及当附加到 EC2 时通过 IMDS）。您不能为角色创建静态访问密钥，因此此选项无效。

- **D. S3 存储桶策略根据 EC2 实例 ID 授予访问权限。** S3 存储桶策略无法根据"EC2 实例 ID"授权请求 — 存储桶策略 `Principal` 和条件键作用于 IAM 委托人（用户、角色、账户），而不是 EC2 实例 ID。S3 存储桶策略不支持 `aws:SourceInstanceID` 样式的条件键来进行一般的委托人身份验证。即使您使用 `aws:SourceVpc`/`aws:SourceVpce`，请求仍然需要经过身份验证的 IAM 委托人 — 这意味着您仍然需要实例上的 IAM 角色。所以此选项无法解决凭证问题。

## 参考资源

- [Amazon EC2 的 IAM 角色](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/iam-roles-for-amazon-ec2.html)
- [使用 IAM 角色授予在 EC2 上运行的应用程序权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_switch-role-ec2.html)
- [使用 IAM 角色对部署到 Amazon EC2 的应用程序进行身份验证](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdkref/latest/guide/access-iam-roles-for-ec2.html)
- [授予 EC2 实例对 S3 存储桶的访问权限 (AWS re:Post)](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/ec2-instance-access-s3-bucket)

en.question: A developer created a web API that receives requests by using an internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB) with an HTTPS listener. The developer configures an Amazon Cognito user pool and wants to ensure that every request to the API is authenticated through Amazon Cognito. What should the developer do to meet this requirement?

options.A: Add a listener rule to the listener to return a fixed response if the Authorization header is missing. Set the fixed response to 401 Unauthorized.
options.B: Create an authentication action for the listener rules of the ALSet the rule action type to authenticate-cognito. Set the OnUnauthenticatedRequest field to “deny.”
options.C: Create an Amazon API Gateway API. Configure all API methods to be forwarded to the ALB endpoint. Create an authorizer of the COGNITO_USER_POOLS type. Configure every API method to use that authorizer.
options.D: Create a new target group that includes an AWS Lambda function target that validates the Authorization header by using Amazon Cognito. Associate the target group with the listener.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer has an internet-facing **Application Load Balancer (ALB)** with an **HTTPS listener** fronting a web API. They have an Amazon Cognito user pool and need every request to be authenticated via Cognito before it reaches the backend.

## Correct Answer: B

ALB has **native, built-in support for Cognito authentication** at the listener-rule level. You define an `authenticate-cognito` action ahead of the `forward` action in a listener rule, and the ALB performs the OIDC handshake against the Cognito user pool transparently—no application code required.

You configure user authentication by creating an authenticate action for one or more listener rules. The authenticate-cognito and authenticate-oidc action types are supported only with HTTPS listeners. Since the listener in the question is already HTTPS, this is supported.

The `OnUnauthenticatedRequest` field controls what happens when a request arrives without a valid Cognito session. Setting it to **`deny`** ensures every unauthenticated request is rejected: If it is set to "deny", as I used for the /api endpoint, the client receives a 401 (Unauthorized) response. This is exactly the behavior the developer wants for an API.

The other valid values would not satisfy the requirement:
- `allow` — passes unauthenticated requests through to the target (useful for SPAs).
- `authenticate` (default) — redirects to the IdP login UI, which is appropriate for browser apps but not for API clients.

Example listener-rule action configuration:

```json
[
  {
    "Type": "authenticate-cognito",
    "Order": 1,
    "AuthenticateCognitoConfig": {
      "UserPoolArn": "arn:aws:cognito-idp:...:userpool/...",
      "UserPoolClientId": "...",
      "UserPoolDomain": "...",
      "OnUnauthenticatedRequest": "deny"
    }
  },
  { "Type": "forward", "Order": 2, "TargetGroupArn": "..." }
]
```

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**A. Fixed-response 401 if Authorization header is missing** — A listener rule that simply checks for the presence of an `Authorization` header does not actually validate the token against Cognito. Any client could send `Authorization: anything` and the request would pass through unauthenticated. ALB listener rules cannot decode/validate JWTs on their own; only the `authenticate-cognito`/`authenticate-oidc` actions do real authentication.

**C. API Gateway in front of the ALB with a `COGNITO_USER_POOLS` authorizer** — While technically functional, this introduces an unnecessary additional service, extra cost, and extra latency. The question presumes the existing ALB-only architecture; ALB itself can natively perform Cognito authentication, so adding API Gateway is not the right choice. ALB authentication offloads all of this to the load balancer itself. With ALB's built-in authentication, the load balancer intercepts unauthenticated requests, redirects users to your identity provider (Cognito, Okta, Google, or any OIDC-compatible provider), handles the OAuth 2.0 flow, validates tokens, and then forwards the authenticated request to your application with user claims in HTTP headers. Your backend just reads the headers - no auth libraries needed.

**D. Lambda target group that validates the Authorization header against Cognito** — This forces the developer to write and maintain custom JWT-verification code in Lambda, duplicating functionality the ALB provides natively. It also requires routing every request through an additional Lambda invocation, increasing cost and latency, and doesn't leverage ALB's `authenticate-cognito` action.

## References

- [Authenticate users using an Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-authenticate-users.html)
- [AuthenticateCognitoActionConfig — ELBv2 API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/APIReference/API_AuthenticateCognitoActionConfig.html)
- [Integrate an ALB with Amazon Cognito to authenticate users (re:Post)](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/cognito-user-pool-alb-authentication)
- [Simplify Login with ALB Built-in Authentication (AWS Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/built-in-authentication-in-alb/)

zh.question: 一位开发人员创建了一个 Web API，该 API 通过面向互联网的应用程序负载均衡器 (ALB) 和 HTTPS 监听器接收请求。该开发人员配置了一个 Amazon Cognito 用户池，并希望确保对 API 的每个请求都通过 Amazon Cognito 进行身份验证。开发人员应该如何满足此要求？

options.A: 向监听器添加一条规则，以便在缺少 Authorization 标头时返回固定响应。将固定响应设置为 401 Unauthorized。
options.B: 为 ALSet 的监听器规则创建身份验证操作，将规则操作类型设置为 authenticate-cognito。将 OnUnauthenticatedRequest 字段设置为“deny”。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon API Gateway API。配置所有 API 方法，使其转发到 ALB 端点。创建一个 COGNITO_USER_POOLS 类型的授权器。配置每个 API 方法使用该授权器。
options.D: 创建一个新的目标组，其中包含一个使用 Amazon Cognito 验证 Authorization 标头的 AWS Lambda 函数目标。将该目标组与监听器关联。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一位开发人员有一个面向互联网的 **Application Load Balancer (ALB)**，配有 **HTTPS 监听器**，在 Web API 前面。他们有一个 Amazon Cognito 用户池，需要每个请求在到达后端之前都通过 Cognito 进行身份验证。

## 正确答案：B

ALB 在监听器规则级别对 Cognito 身份验证有**原生的、内置的支持**。您在监听器规则中的 `forward` 操作之前定义一个 `authenticate-cognito` 操作，ALB 将对 Cognito 用户池透明地执行 OIDC 握手——无需应用代码。

您通过为一个或多个监听器规则创建身份验证操作来配置用户身份验证。authenticate-cognito 和 authenticate-oidc 操作类型仅在 HTTPS 监听器中受支持。由于问题中的监听器已经是 HTTPS，因此这是受支持的。

`OnUnauthenticatedRequest` 字段控制当没有有效 Cognito 会话的请求到达时会发生什么。将其设置为 **`deny`** 可确保每个未身份验证的请求都被拒绝：如果将其设置为"deny"（如我对 /api 端点使用的那样），客户端会收到 401（未授权）响应。这正是开发人员对 API 想要的行为。

其他有效值无法满足要求：
- `allow` — 将未身份验证的请求传递给目标（适用于 SPA）。
- `authenticate`（默认值） — 重定向到 IdP 登录 UI，适合浏览器应用但不适合 API 客户端。

示例监听器规则操作配置：

```json
[
  {
    "Type": "authenticate-cognito",
    "Order": 1,
    "AuthenticateCognitoConfig": {
      "UserPoolArn": "arn:aws:cognito-idp:...:userpool/...",
      "UserPoolClientId": "...",
      "UserPoolDomain": "...",
      "OnUnauthenticatedRequest": "deny"
    }
  },
  { "Type": "forward", "Order": 2, "TargetGroupArn": "..." }
]
```

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**A. 如果缺少 Authorization 标头则固定响应 401** — 简单检查 `Authorization` 标头是否存在的监听器规则不会针对 Cognito 实际验证令牌。任何客户端都可以发送 `Authorization: anything`，请求会通过而不进行身份验证。ALB 监听器规则无法自行解码/验证 JWT；只有 `authenticate-cognito`/`authenticate-oidc` 操作才能执行真正的身份验证。

**C. API Gateway 在 ALB 前面，带有 `COGNITO_USER_POOLS` 授权者** — 虽然在技术上可行，但这会引入不必要的额外服务、额外成本和额外延迟。该问题假定现有的仅 ALB 架构；ALB 本身可以原生执行 Cognito 身份验证，因此添加 API Gateway 不是正确的选择。ALB 身份验证将所有这些卸载到负载均衡器本身。通过 ALB 的内置身份验证，负载均衡器会拦截未身份验证的请求，将用户重定向到您的身份提供程序（Cognito、Okta、Google 或任何兼容 OIDC 的提供程序），处理 OAuth 2.0 流程，验证令牌，然后将已身份验证的请求转发到您的应用程序，HTTP 标头中包含用户声明。您的后端只需读取标头——无需身份验证库。

**D. 针对 Cognito 验证 Authorization 标头的 Lambda 目标组** — 这强制开发人员在 Lambda 中编写并维护自定义 JWT 验证代码，复制 ALB 原生提供的功能。它还需要通过额外的 Lambda 调用路由每个请求，增加成本和延迟，并且没有利用 ALB 的 `authenticate-cognito` 操作。

## 参考资源

- [使用 Application Load Balancer 对用户进行身份验证](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-authenticate-users.html)
- [AuthenticateCognitoActionConfig — ELBv2 API 参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/APIReference/API_AuthenticateCognitoActionConfig.html)
- [将 ALB 与 Amazon Cognito 集成以对用户进行身份验证 (re:Post)](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/cognito-user-pool-alb-authentication)
- [使用 ALB 内置身份验证简化登录 (AWS 博客)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/built-in-authentication-in-alb/)

en.question: A company recently deployed an AWS Lambda function. A developer notices an increase in the function throttle metrics in Amazon CloudWatch. What are the MOST operationally efficient solutions to reduce the function throttling? (Choose two.)

options.A: Migrate the function to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS).
options.B: Increase the maximum age of events in Lambda.
options.C: Increase the function’s reserved concurrency.
options.D: Add the lambda:GetFunctionConcurrency action to the execution role.
options.E: Request a service quota change for increased concurrency.

en.explanation:
# Lambda Throttling – Most Operationally Efficient Solutions

## Scenario
A Lambda function is showing increased **Throttles** in CloudWatch. Throttling occurs when invocation requests exceed available concurrency.
