It introduces additional moving parts (Lambda code, IAM execution role, EventBridge rule maintenance) when a simple stack option setting accomplishes the same goal. For exam purposes when both A and B are listed, AWS prefers the simpler, native solution. Note also that an EventBridge rule on the default bus would receive events from *all* CloudFormation stacks in the account; you must filter on the specific stack ARN, whereas A simply doesn't subscribe other stacks at all.

**C. CloudWatch alarm on CloudFormation metrics** — CloudFormation does **not** publish per-stack deployment status as CloudWatch metrics that you can alarm on by stack name and stack status. CloudWatch alarms work on numeric metrics; stack status changes are events, not metric data points. This option describes a service capability that does not exist.

**D. Lambda event source mapping from CloudFormation** — Lambda **event source mappings** are only supported for poll-based sources: Kinesis, DynamoDB Streams, SQS, Amazon MQ, Kafka, and DocumentDB. CloudFormation is **not** a valid event source for Lambda event source mappings. To trigger Lambda from CloudFormation events, you must use SNS or EventBridge as an intermediary — making this option technically impossible as written.

## References
- [AWS Config — cloudformation-stack-notification-check](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/cloudformation-stack-notification-check.html)
- [AWS re:Post — Receive an alert with a CloudFormation stack status change](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/cloudformation-rollback-email)
- [AWS Systems Manager Automation — AWS-EnableCloudFormationSNSNotification](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/AWS-EnableCloudFormationStackSNSNotification.html)

zh.question: 一家公司希望更频繁地测试其 Web 应用程序。该公司为每个环境使用独立的 AWS CloudFormation 堆栈来部署应用程序。随着应用程序在开发生命周期中的推进，该公司将相同的 CloudFormation 模板部署到每个堆栈。开发人员需要为质量保证 (QA) 团队构建通知功能。开发人员希望在最终预生产环境中进行新部署时收到通知。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。让 QA 团队订阅该 Amazon SNS 主题。在预生产环境中，更新 CloudFormation 堆栈选项，使其指向该 SNS 主题。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来通知 QA 团队。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，以在默认事件总线上调用该 Lambda 函数。筛选 CloudFormation 服务和 CloudFormation 堆栈 Amazon 资源名称 (ARN) 上的事件。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，用于监控 CloudFormation 的指标。根据堆栈名称和堆栈状态筛选指标。配置 CloudWatch 警报以通知 QA 团队。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于通知 QA 团队。配置事件源映射以接收来自 CloudFormation 的事件。指定筛选值，将调用限制在所需的 CloudFormation 堆栈中。

zh.explanation:
# CloudFormation 栈通知到 QA 团队

## 场景
一家公司使用单独的 CloudFormation 栈在多个环境中部署应用程序。开发人员需要在**最终预生产环境**中发生新部署时通知 QA 团队。

## 正确答案：A

CloudFormation 具有**与 Amazon SNS 的原生内置集成**，用于栈事件通知。创建或更新栈时，可以在栈选项中指定一个或多个 SNS 主题 ARN（`NotificationARNs` 参数，在控制台中公开为"SNS 主题 ARN"/"通知选项"字段，或在 CLI 上使用 `--notification-arns`）。然后 CloudFormation 将所有栈生命周期事件（CREATE_IN_PROGRESS、CREATE_COMPLETE、UPDATE_COMPLETE、ROLLBACK_*等）发布到该主题。

解决方案是：
1. 创建一个 SNS 主题。
2. 将 QA 团队（例如电子邮件端点）订阅到该主题。
3. 仅配置**预生产** CloudFormation 栈（通过栈选项）以指向该 SNS 主题 ARN。

由于仅预生产栈配置了该主题，QA 团队仅接收该环境的通知 — 完全符合需求。

```bash
aws cloudformation update-stack \
  --stack-name preprod-app-stack \
  --use-previous-template \
  --notification-arns arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:qa-deploy-topic
```

这种原生集成有文档记录，甚至由 AWS Config 规则 [`cloudformation-stack-notification-check`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/cloudformation-stack-notification-check.html) 验证，该规则"检查你的 CloudFormation 栈是否将事件通知发送到 Amazon SNS 主题"。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

**B. Lambda + EventBridge 规则，在默认总线上按栈 ARN 进行过滤** — 从技术上讲这是可行的（CloudFormation 事件以 `aws.cloudformation` / `CloudFormation Stack Status Change` 形式发布到 EventBridge），但与选项 A 中描述的原生 CloudFormation→SNS 集成相比，它不必要地复杂。它引入了额外的活动部件（Lambda 代码、IAM 执行角色、EventBridge 规则维护），而一个简单的栈选项设置就能完成相同的目标。在考试目的上，当选项 A 和 B 都列出时，AWS 倾向于选择更简单的原生解决方案。还要注意，默认总线上的 EventBridge 规则会接收来自帐户中**所有** CloudFormation 栈的事件；你必须按特定栈 ARN 进行过滤，而 A 根本不订阅其他栈。

**C. CloudFormation 指标上的 CloudWatch 警报** — CloudFormation **不**发布按栈的部署状态作为 CloudWatch 指标，你可以按栈名称和栈状态对其进行警报。CloudWatch 警报作用于数字指标；栈状态变更是事件，而不是指标数据点。此选项描述的是不存在的服务功能。

**D. 来自 CloudFormation 的 Lambda 事件源映射** — Lambda **事件源映射**仅支持基于轮询的源：Kinesis、DynamoDB Streams、SQS、Amazon MQ、Kafka 和 DocumentDB。CloudFormation **不是** Lambda 事件源映射的有效事件源。要从 CloudFormation 事件触发 Lambda，你必须使用 SNS 或 EventBridge 作为中间件 — 这使得此选项按照所写的方式在技术上是不可能的。

## 参考资源
- [AWS Config — cloudformation-stack-notification-check](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/cloudformation-stack-notification-check.html)
- [AWS re:Post — 接收 CloudFormation 栈状态变更警报](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/cloudformation-rollback-email)
- [AWS Systems Manager 自动化 — AWS-EnableCloudFormationSNSNotification](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/AWS-EnableCloudFormationStackSNSNotification.html)

en.question: A developer manages three AWS accounts. Each account contains an Amazon RDS DB instance in a private subnet. The developer needs to define users in each database in a consistent way. The developer must ensure that the same users are created and updated later in all three accounts. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Create an AWS CloudFormation template. Declare the users in the template. Attach the users to the database. Deploy the template in each account.
options.B: Create an AWS CloudFormation template that contains a custom resource to create the users in the database. Deploy the template in each account.
options.C: Write a script that creates the users. Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance in each account to run the script on the databases. Run the script in each account.
options.D: Implement an AWS Lambda function that creates the users in the database. Provide the function with the details of all three accounts.

en.explanation:
# Creating Consistent RDS Database Users Across Three AWS Accounts

## Scenario
A developer has three AWS accounts, each with an RDS DB instance in a private subnet. The goal is to **create and later update the same database users** in all three accounts in a consistent, repeatable way with minimum operational overhead.

The key insight is that "users in the database" here means **database-level users** (e.g., MySQL/PostgreSQL users created with `CREATE USER`), **not** IAM users or RDS master users defined via the `AWS::RDS::DBInstance` resource.

## Correct Answer: B

**Create an AWS CloudFormation template that contains a custom resource to create the users in the database. Deploy the template in each account.**

CloudFormation does **not** have a native resource type for managing database-level users inside an RDS engine (MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc.). As confirmed by community-built providers, "Although CloudFormation is very good in creating PostgreSQL database servers with Amazon RDS, the mundane task of creating logical database, schemas and users is not supported." To bridge this gap, you use a [CloudFormation custom resource](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/template-custom-resources.html), which is typically backed by a Lambda function placed in the same VPC as the RDS instance. The Lambda runs SQL statements (`CREATE USER`, `ALTER USER`, `GRANT`, etc.) at stack create/update/delete time.

Benefits:
- One template can be deployed (or rolled out via CloudFormation StackSets) to all three accounts.
- Updates to user definitions are managed declaratively — change the template, update the stack, and the custom resource re-runs in each account.
- The Lambda inside the VPC can reach the RDS instance in the private subnet.

This satisfies "consistent way," "created and updated later," and "MOST operational efficiency."

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

### A. CloudFormation template declaring users natively
There is no native CloudFormation resource type to create **database-engine users** inside RDS. `AWS::RDS::DBInstance` only configures the **master user** at instance creation. You cannot "declare the users" and "attach them to the database" using built-in resource types — that is precisely why a custom resource is required.

### C. EC2 instance running a script in each account
Provisioning, patching, securing, and paying for an EC2 instance in every account purely to run a SQL script is significantly more operational overhead than a Lambda-backed custom resource. It is also not a declarative IaC approach — drift between accounts is likely, and updating users requires re-running scripts manually.

### D. A single Lambda function with details of all three accounts
RDS instances are in **private subnets** in different accounts. A Lambda in one account would need cross-account VPC connectivity (VPC peering / Transit Gateway / cross-account ENIs) plus cross-account credentials and access to each DB master password. This is complex, fragile, and not declarative. It also doesn't integrate with stack updates per account.

## References
- [AWS CloudFormation – Custom resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/template-custom-resources.html)
- [Creating Amazon RDS resources with AWS CloudFormation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/creating-resources-with-cloudformation.html)
- [AWS::RDS::DBInstance template snippets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/quickref-rds.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员管理着三个 AWS 账户。每个账户都包含一个位于私有子网中的 Amazon RDS 数据库实例。开发人员需要在每个数据库中以一致的方式定义用户。开发人员必须确保在所有三个账户中创建和更新的用户都是相同的。哪种解决方案能够以最高的运行效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板。在模板中声明用户。将用户附加到数据库。在每个账户中部署该模板。
options.B: 创建一个包含自定义资源的 AWS CloudFormation 模板，用于在数据库中创建用户。将该模板部署到每个账户中。
options.C: 编写一个创建用户的脚本。在每个账户中部署一个 Amazon EC2 实例，用于在数据库上运行该脚本。在每个账户中运行该脚本。
options.D: 实现一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于在数据库中创建用户。向该函数提供所有三个账户的详细信息。

zh.explanation:
# 在三个 AWS 账户中创建一致的 RDS 数据库用户

## 场景
一位开发者拥有三个 AWS 账户，每个账户中都有一个 RDS DB 实例位于私有子网内。目标是**创建并稍后更新相同的数据库用户**，在所有三个账户中以一致、可重复的方式进行，同时将运营开销降至最低。

关键见解是这里的"数据库中的用户"指的是**数据库级别的用户**（例如，使用 `CREATE USER` 创建的 MySQL/PostgreSQL 用户），**而非** IAM 用户或通过 `AWS::RDS::DBInstance` 资源定义的 RDS 主用户。

## 正确答案：B

**创建一个包含自定义资源的 AWS CloudFormation 模板来在数据库中创建用户。在每个账户中部署该模板。**

CloudFormation **不支持**原生资源类型用于管理 RDS 引擎内（MySQL、PostgreSQL 等）的数据库级用户。如社区构建的提供程序所确认的那样，"虽然 CloudFormation 非常擅长使用 Amazon RDS 创建 PostgreSQL 数据库服务器，但创建逻辑数据库、模式和用户这样的常规任务不受支持"。为了弥补这一差距，你使用 [CloudFormation 自定义资源](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/template-custom-resources.html)，通常由位于与 RDS 实例相同 VPC 内的 Lambda 函数支持。Lambda 在栈创建/更新/删除时运行 SQL 语句（`CREATE USER`、`ALTER USER`、`GRANT` 等）。

优势：
- 一个模板可以部署到所有三个账户（或通过 CloudFormation StackSets 推出）。
- 用户定义的更新以声明方式进行管理 — 更改模板，更新栈，自定义资源将在每个账户中重新运行。
- VPC 内的 Lambda 可以访问私有子网中的 RDS 实例。

这满足了"一致的方式"、"创建并稍后更新"以及"最高运营效率"的要求。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

### A. 原生声明用户的 CloudFormation 模板
不存在原生 CloudFormation 资源类型来在 RDS 内创建**数据库引擎用户**。`AWS::RDS::DBInstance` 仅在实例创建时配置**主用户**。你无法使用内置资源类型"声明用户"并"将其附加到数据库" — 这正是为什么需要自定义资源的原因。

### C. 在每个账户中运行脚本的 EC2 实例
在每个账户中配置、修补、保护和付费运行 EC2 实例仅仅为了运行 SQL 脚本，相比 Lambda 支持的自定义资源来说运营开销要大得多。这也不是一种声明性基础设施即代码方法 — 账户之间的配置漂移很可能发生，更新用户需要手动重新运行脚本。

### D. 包含所有三个账户详情的单个 Lambda 函数
RDS 实例位于**不同账户的私有子网**中。一个账户中的 Lambda 需要跨账户 VPC 连接（VPC 对等互连/Transit Gateway/跨账户 ENI）以及跨账户凭证和对每个数据库主密码的访问权限。这很复杂、脆弱，并且不是声明性的。它也不与每个账户的栈更新集成。

## 参考资源
- [AWS CloudFormation – 自定义资源](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/template-custom-resources.html)
- [使用 AWS CloudFormation 创建 Amazon RDS 资源](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/creating-resources-with-cloudformation.html)
- [AWS::RDS::DBInstance 模板片段](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/quickref-rds.html)

en.question: A company is building a new application that runs on AWS and uses Amazon API Gateway to expose APIs. Teams of developers are working on separate components of the application in parallel. The company wants to publish an API without an integrated backend so that teams that depend on the application backend can continue the development work before the API backend development is complete. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create API Gateway resources and set the integration type value to MOCK. Configure the method integration request and integration response to associate a response with an HTTP status code. Create an API Gateway stage and deploy the API.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function that returns mocked responses and various HTTP status codes. Create API Gateway resources and set the integration type value to AWS_PROXY. Deploy the API.
options.C: Create an EC2 application that returns mocked HTTP responses. Create API Gateway resources and set the integration type value to AWS. Create an API Gateway stage and deploy the API.
options.D: Create API Gateway resources and set the integration type value set to HTTP_PROXY. Add mapping templates and deploy the API. Create an AWS Lambda layer that returns various HTTP status codes. Associate the Lambda layer with the API deployment.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The company wants to expose APIs through Amazon API Gateway **without** an integrated backend so that dependent teams can continue development while the backend is still being built. The solution must allow API Gateway itself to return responses (with HTTP status codes) without needing real backend logic.

## Correct Answer: A

Set the API Gateway integration type to **MOCK**. This feature enables API developers to generate API responses from API Gateway directly, without the need for an integration backend. As an API developer, you can use this feature to unblock dependent teams that need to work with an API before the project development is complete.

With a MOCK integration, you configure the **integration request** mapping template to set a `statusCode` (e.g., `{"statusCode": 200}`) and configure **integration responses** for each status code so API Gateway returns the appropriate response. After this, you create a stage and deploy the API — exactly what option A describes. This type of integration lets API Gateway return a response without sending the request further to the backend. This is useful for API testing because it can be used to test the integration set up without incurring charges for using the backend and to enable collaborative development of an API. In collaborative development, a team can isolate their development effort by setting up simulations of API components owned by other teams by using the MOCK integrations.

See [Mock integrations for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-mock-integration.html).

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **B. Lambda function returning mocked responses with `AWS_PROXY`** — This works functionally but unnecessarily introduces a backend (Lambda). The whole point of MOCK integration is to avoid building/operating any backend. It also incurs Lambda invocation cost and adds latency for what is purely a stub.

- **C. EC2 application with `AWS` integration type** — `AWS` integration type is used to call AWS service APIs (not arbitrary HTTP endpoints), so pointing it at an EC2 web app is technically incorrect. Worse, running EC2 just to return canned responses defeats the requirement of having "no integrated backend" and adds operational overhead and cost.

- **D. `HTTP_PROXY` integration with a Lambda layer** — `HTTP_PROXY` integration forwards requests to an HTTP backend; without a real backend URL the integration cannot return anything. Additionally, **Lambda layers cannot be associated with an API Gateway deployment** — layers are libraries packaged with Lambda functions, not standalone executable code that API Gateway can invoke. The architecture described is not valid.

## Key Takeaway

For DVA-C02: when the question describes "publish an API without a backend", "stub responses for parallel team development", or "return canned HTTP status codes from API Gateway directly", the answer is the **MOCK** integration type configured with integration request/response mapping templates.

zh.question: 一家公司正在构建一个运行在 AWS 上并使用 Amazon API Gateway 公开 API 的新应用程序。多个开发团队正在并行开发应用程序的不同组件。该公司希望发布一个不包含集成后端的 API，以便依赖应用程序后端的团队能够在 API 后端开发完成之前继续进行开发工作。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建 API 网关资源，并将集成类型值设置为 MOCK。配置集成请求和集成响应方法，将响应与 HTTP 状态代码关联起来。创建 API 网关阶段并部署 API。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数返回模拟响应和各种 HTTP 状态代码。创建 API 网关资源，并将集成类型值设置为 AWS_PROXY。部署 API。
options.C: 创建一个返回模拟 HTTP 响应的 EC2 应用程序。创建 API 网关资源，并将集成类型值设置为 AWS。创建一个 API 网关阶段并部署 API。
options.D: 创建 API 网关资源，并将集成类型值设置为 HTTP_PROXY。添加映射模板并部署 API。创建一个返回各种 HTTP 状态码的 AWS Lambda 层。将 Lambda 层与 API 部署关联。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

公司希望通过 Amazon API Gateway 暴露 API，**无需**集成后端，以便依赖团队可以在后端仍在构建中时继续开发。该解决方案必须允许 API Gateway 本身返回响应（包含 HTTP 状态码），而无需真实的后端逻辑。

## 正确答案：A

将 API Gateway 集成类型设置为 **MOCK**。此功能使 API 开发人员能够直接从 API Gateway 生成 API 响应，无需集成后端。作为 API 开发人员，您可以使用此功能来解除需要在项目开发完成之前使用 API 的依赖团队的阻塞。

使用 MOCK 集成，您可以配置**集成请求**映射模板来设置 `statusCode`（例如，`{"statusCode": 200}`），并为每个状态码配置**集成响应**，以便 API Gateway 返回相应的响应。之后，您创建一个阶段并部署 API — 这正是选项 A 所描述的。此集成类型让 API Gateway 在不将请求进一步发送到后端的情况下返回响应。这对 API 测试很有用，因为它可以在不产生后端使用费用的情况下测试集成设置，并可以实现 API 的协作开发。在协作开发中，团队可以通过使用 MOCK 集成来模拟其他团队拥有的 API 组件，从而隔离他们的开发工作。

参见 [API Gateway 中 REST API 的 Mock 集成](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-mock-integration.html)。

## 为什么其他选项错误

- **B. 使用 `AWS_PROXY` 返回模拟响应的 Lambda 函数** — 这在功能上是可行的，但不必要地引入了后端（Lambda）。MOCK 集成的整个目的是避免构建/运维任何后端。它还会产生 Lambda 调用成本，并为纯粹的存根增加延迟。

- **C. 采用 `AWS` 集成类型的 EC2 应用程序** — `AWS` 集成类型用于调用 AWS 服务 API（而非任意 HTTP 端点），因此将其指向 EC2 Web 应用在技术上是不正确的。更糟的是，运行 EC2 仅为了返回固定响应违反了"无集成后端"的要求，并增加了运营开销和成本。

- **D. 带有 Lambda 层的 `HTTP_PROXY` 集成** — `HTTP_PROXY` 集成将请求转发到 HTTP 后端；没有真实的后端 URL，集成无法返回任何内容。此外，**Lambda 层无法与 API Gateway 部署关联** — 层是与 Lambda 函数打包的库，不是 API Gateway 可以调用的独立可执行代码。所描述的架构无效。

## 关键要点

对于 DVA-C02：当题目描述"发布无后端的 API"、"为并行团队开发提供存根响应"或"直接从 API Gateway 返回固定的 HTTP 状态码"时，答案是使用**MOCK**集成类型，并配置集成请求/响应映射模板。

en.question: An application that runs on AWS receives messages from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue and processes the messages in batches. The application sends the data to another SQS queue to be consumed by another legacy application. The legacy system can take up to 5 minutes to process some transaction data. A developer wants to ensure that there are no out-of-order updates in the legacy system. The developer cannot alter the behavior of the legacy system. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use an SQS FIFO queue. Configure the visibility timeout value.
options.B: Use an SQS standard queue with a SendMessageBatchRequestEntry data type. Configure the DelaySeconds values.
options.C: Use an SQS standard queue with a SendMessageBatchRequestEntry data type. Configure the visibility timeout value.
options.D: Use an SQS FIFO queue. Configure the DelaySeconds value.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

An application reads messages from an SQS queue, processes them in batches, and forwards them to a second SQS queue consumed by a **legacy** application. The legacy app may take **up to 5 minutes** per message and **cannot be modified**. The developer must guarantee **no out-of-order updates** in the legacy system.

Two requirements drive the design:
1. **Strict ordering** of messages so the legacy system never receives them out of order.
2. **No duplicate / overlapping delivery** while the legacy system is working — because if the same message becomes visible to another consumer while still being processed (up to 5 minutes), ordering can break.

## Correct Answer: A — SQS FIFO queue + configured visibility timeout

- **FIFO queue** guarantees message ordering. FIFO (first-in-first-out) queues preserve the exact order in which messages are sent and received. If you use a FIFO queue, you don't have to place sequencing information in your messages.
- Within a message group, messages with the same message group ID are processed in a strict sequence. When a message with a message group ID is in-flight, subsequent messages in that group are not made available until the in-flight message is either deleted or the visibility timeout expires.
- Because the legacy system can take up to 5 minutes, the **visibility timeout must be set greater than 5 minutes** so the message is not redelivered while still being processed. If you have long-running queue message processing, configure the visibility timeout to be greater than the maximum duration of this processing. The maximum value you can choose is 12 hours. The default of 30 seconds would cause premature redelivery and break ordering.

## Why the other options are wrong

**B. Standard queue with `SendMessageBatchRequestEntry` + `DelaySeconds`** — Standard queues do **not** guarantee order. Amazon SQS standard queues (the new name for existing queues) remain unchanged, and you can still create standard queues. These queues continue to provide the highest scalability and throughput; however, you will not get ordering guarantees and duplicates might occur. `DelaySeconds` only postpones a message becoming visible (max 15 minutes); it doesn't enforce ordering or address the 5-minute processing window.

**C. Standard queue with `SendMessageBatchRequestEntry` + visibility timeout** — Same fundamental problem: standard queues do not preserve order, so the legacy system can still receive out-of-order updates regardless of visibility timeout.

**D. FIFO queue + `DelaySeconds`** — FIFO queues do preserve order, but `DelaySeconds` is the wrong control. It only delays initial visibility (max 15 min). It does **not** prevent a message that has already been received from being redelivered while the legacy system is still processing it for up to 5 minutes. The correct knob for "consumer needs N minutes to process" is the **visibility timeout**, not `DelaySeconds`. The default visibility timeout for a queue is 30 seconds, but you can adjust this to match the time your application needs to process and delete a message.

## Key AWS Docs
- [Amazon SQS visibility timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-visibility-timeout.html)
- [FIFO queue delivery logic](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/FIFO-queues-understanding-logic.html)
- [Amazon SQS FAQs](https://aws.amazon.com/sqs/faqs/)

zh.question: 一个运行在 AWS 上的应用程序从 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列接收消息，并分批处理这些消息。该应用程序将数据发送到另一个 SQS 队列，供另一个旧版应用程序使用。旧版系统处理某些事务数据可能需要长达 5 分钟的时间。开发人员希望确保旧版系统中不存在乱序更新。开发人员无法更改旧版系统的行为。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 SQS FIFO 队列。配置可见性超时值。
options.B: 使用具有 SendMessageBatchRequestEntry 数据类型的 SQS 标准队列。配置 DelaySeconds 值。
options.C: 使用数据类型为 SendMessageBatchRequestEntry 的 SQS 标准队列。配置可见性超时值。
options.D: 使用 SQS FIFO 队列。配置 DelaySeconds 值。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一个应用从 SQS 队列读取消息，分批处理这些消息，然后将其转发到由**遗留**应用消费的第二个 SQS 队列。遗留应用每条消息可能需要**长达 5 分钟**的处理时间，且**无法修改**。开发人员必须保证遗留系统中**没有无序更新**。

两个需求驱动设计：
1. **严格的消息顺序**，确保遗留系统永远不会收到无序的消息。
2. **没有重复/重叠交付** — 当遗留系统工作时，如果同一条消息在仍在处理中（长达 5 分钟）时对另一个消费者变为可见，则顺序会被破坏。

## 正确答案：A — SQS FIFO 队列 + 配置可见性超时

- **FIFO 队列**保证消息顺序。FIFO（先进先出）队列保留消息发送和接收的确切顺序。如果你使用 FIFO 队列，你不必在消息中放置排序信息。
- 在一个消息组内，具有相同消息组 ID 的消息按严格顺序处理。当具有消息组 ID 的消息处于传输中时，该组中的后续消息在传输中的消息被删除或可见性超时过期之前不会被提供。
- 由于遗留系统可能需要长达 5 分钟的处理时间，**可见性超时必须设置为大于 5 分钟**，以便在仍在处理时不会重新交付消息。如果你的队列消息处理需要长时间运行，请将可见性超时配置为大于此处理的最大持续时间。你可以选择的最大值是 12 小时。默认的 30 秒会导致过早重新交付并破坏顺序。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**B. 标准队列配合 `SendMessageBatchRequestEntry` + `DelaySeconds`** — 标准队列**不保证**顺序。Amazon SQS 标准队列（现有队列的新名称）保持不变，你仍可以创建标准队列。这些队列继续提供最高的可扩展性和吞吐量；但是，你不会获得顺序保证，可能会出现重复。`DelaySeconds` 仅延迟消息变为可见（最多 15 分钟）；它不强制顺序或解决 5 分钟的处理窗口问题。

**C. 标准队列配合 `SendMessageBatchRequestEntry` + 可见性超时** — 相同的根本问题：标准队列不保留顺序，所以遗留系统仍可能收到无序的更新，无论可见性超时如何。

**D. FIFO 队列 + `DelaySeconds`** — FIFO 队列确实保留顺序，但 `DelaySeconds` 是错误的控制。它仅延迟初始可见性（最多 15 分钟）。它**不**能阻止已经被接收的消息在遗留系统仍在处理它（长达 5 分钟）时被重新交付。处理"消费者需要 N 分钟来处理"的正确控制是**可见性超时**，而不是 `DelaySeconds`。队列的默认可见性超时为 30 秒，但你可以调整此值以匹配应用处理和删除消息所需的时间。

## AWS 相关文档
- [Amazon SQS 可见性超时](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-visibility-timeout.html)
- [FIFO 队列交付逻辑](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/FIFO-queues-understanding-logic.html)
- [Amazon SQS 常见问题](https://aws.amazon.com/sqs/faqs/)

en.question: A company is building a compute-intensive application that will run on a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. The application uses attached Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes for storing data. The Amazon EBS volumes will be created at time of initial deployment. The application will process sensitive information. All of the data must be encrypted. The solution should not impact the application's performance. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the fleet of EC2 instances to use encrypted EBS volumes to store data.
options.B: Configure the application to write all data to an encrypted Amazon S3 bucket.
options.C: Configure a custom encryption algorithm for the application that will encrypt and decrypt all data.
options.D: Configure an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that has an encrypted root volume and store the data to ephemeral disks.

en.explanation:
# EC2 Compute-Intensive App with EBS Encryption

## Scenario
A compute-intensive application runs on a fleet of EC2 instances using attached EBS volumes (created at deployment) for sensitive data. All data must be encrypted, and the encryption solution must not impact application performance.

## Correct Answer: A — Use encrypted EBS volumes

Amazon EBS encryption is the natural fit when data is being written to EBS volumes attached to EC2 instances. Encryption is supported by all EBS volume types. You can expect the same IOPS performance on encrypted volumes as on unencrypted volumes, with a minimal effect on latency. You can access encrypted volumes the same way that you access unencrypted volumes. Encryption and decryption are handled transparently, and they require no additional action from you or your applications.

The encryption is performed in hardware on the Nitro system: Amazon EC2 uses the plaintext data key in the Nitro hardware to encrypt disk I/O to the volume. The plaintext data key persists in memory as long as the volume is attached to the instance. EBS encryption uses AES-256 data encryption, integrates with AWS KMS, and protects both data at rest on the volume and data in transit between the EC2 instance and the volume — meeting the encryption requirement with negligible performance overhead.

Because the EBS volumes are being created at initial deployment, simply enabling encryption (or turning on EBS encryption-by-default for the region) ensures all new volumes are encrypted from the start.

## Why the Other Options Are Incorrect

**B. Write all data to an encrypted S3 bucket.**
This changes the storage architecture. The application is designed to use attached block storage (EBS) for compute-intensive workloads. Routing all I/O through S3 introduces network round-trips, higher latency, and reduced throughput vs. local block storage — which directly violates the "should not impact the application's performance" requirement. S3 is object storage, not a drop-in replacement for an attached block device.

**C. Configure a custom encryption algorithm in the application.**
Custom application-level encryption requires the application to perform CPU-intensive encrypt/decrypt on every read and write, which directly impacts performance on a compute-intensive workload. It also introduces key-management complexity and reinvents what AWS already provides transparently and at hardware speed via EBS encryption + KMS. AWS best practice is explicitly to use managed encryption services rather than rolling your own.

**D. AMI with encrypted root volume + ephemeral (instance store) disks for data.**
Encrypting only the root volume does not encrypt the data volumes where the sensitive information is processed. Instance store (ephemeral) volumes are lost when the instance stops or terminates, which is unsuitable for an application that needs persistent storage of sensitive information. Additionally, instance store encryption depends on instance type capability and does not satisfy persistent encrypted storage requirements like EBS encryption does.

## References
- [Requirements for Amazon EBS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-encryption-requirements.html)
- [How Amazon EBS encryption works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/how-ebs-encryption-works.html)
- [Amazon EBS Features – Encryption](https://aws.amazon.com/ebs/features/)
- [WKLD.08 Encrypt Amazon EBS volumes – AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/aws-startup-security-baseline/wkld-08.html)

zh.question: 一家公司正在构建一个计算密集型应用程序，该应用程序将在 Amazon EC2 实例集群上运行。该应用程序使用附加的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷来存储数据。Amazon EBS 卷将在初始部署时创建。该应用程序将处理敏感信息。所有数据都必须加密。该解决方案不应影响应用程序的性能。哪个解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 EC2 实例集群使用加密的 EBS 卷来存储数据。
options.B: 配置应用程序将所有数据写入加密的 Amazon S3 存储桶。
options.C: 为应用程序配置自定义加密算法，该算法将对所有数据进行加密和解密。
options.D: 配置具有加密根卷的 Amazon 系统映像 (AMI)，并将数据存储到临时磁盘。

zh.explanation:
# EC2 计算密集型应用与 EBS 加密

## 场景
一个计算密集型应用程序在一个 EC2 实例队列上运行，使用附加的 EBS 卷（在部署时创建）来存储敏感数据。所有数据必须加密，且加密解决方案不能影响应用程序的性能。

## 正确答案：A — 使用加密的 EBS 卷

Amazon EBS 加密是将数据写入附加到 EC2 实例的 EBS 卷时的自然选择。所有 EBS 卷类型都支持加密。您可以预期加密卷的 IOPS 性能与未加密卷相同，对延迟的影响最小。您可以以与访问未加密卷相同的方式访问加密卷。加密和解密是透明处理的，不需要您或您的应用程序采取任何其他操作。

加密在 Nitro 系统的硬件中执行：Amazon EC2 使用 Nitro 硬件中的明文数据密钥对卷的磁盘 I/O 进行加密。只要卷附加到实例，明文数据密钥就会保留在内存中。EBS 加密使用 AES-256 数据加密，与 AWS KMS 集成，并保护卷上的静态数据和 EC2 实例与卷之间传输中的数据 — 以最小的性能开销满足加密要求。

由于 EBS 卷在初始部署时创建，只需启用加密（或为该区域启用 EBS 默认加密）即可确保所有新卷从一开始就被加密。

## 其他选项为何不正确

**B. 将所有数据写入加密的 S3 存储桶。**
这改变了存储体系结构。该应用程序设计为使用附加的块存储 (EBS) 来处理计算密集型工作负载。通过 S3 路由所有 I/O 会引入网络往返、更高的延迟和吞吐量降低，与本地块存储相比 — 这直接违反了"不应影响应用程序性能"的要求。S3 是对象存储，不是附加块设备的直接替代品。

**C. 在应用程序中配置自定义加密算法。**
自定义应用级加密需要应用程序在每次读写时执行 CPU 密集的加密/解密操作，这直接影响计算密集型工作负载的性能。它还引入了密钥管理的复杂性，并重新实现了 AWS 已通过 EBS 加密 + KMS 透明地以硬件速度提供的功能。AWS 最佳实践明确建议使用托管加密服务，而不是自己开发。

**D. 使用加密根卷的 AMI + 临时（实例存储）磁盘存储数据。**
仅加密根卷不会加密处理敏感信息的数据卷。实例存储（临时）卷在实例停止或终止时会丢失，这不适合需要持久存储敏感信息的应用程序。此外，实例存储加密取决于实例类型能力，不满足 EBS 加密那样的持久加密存储要求。

## 参考资源
- [Amazon EBS 加密的要求](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-encryption-requirements.html)
- [Amazon EBS 加密的工作原理](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/how-ebs-encryption-works.html)
- [Amazon EBS 功能 – 加密](https://aws.amazon.com/ebs/features/)
- [WKLD.08 加密 Amazon EBS 卷 – AWS 规范性指导](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/aws-startup-security-baseline/wkld-08.html)

en.question: A developer is updating the production version of an AWS Lambda function to fix a defect. The developer has tested the updated code in a test environment. The developer wants to slowly roll out the updates to a small subset of production users before rolling out the changes to all users. Only 10% of the users should be initially exposed to the new code in production. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Update the Lambda code and create a new version of the Lambda function. Create a Lambda function trigger. Configure the traffic weights in the trigger between the two Lambda function versions. Send 90% of the traffic to the production version, and send 10% of the traffic to the new version.
options.B: Create a new Lambda function that uses the updated code. Create a Lambda alias for the production Lambda function. Configure the Lambda alias to send 90% of the traffic to the production Lambda function, and send 10% of the traffic to the test Lambda function.
options.C: Update the Lambda code and create a new version of the Lambda function. Create a Lambda proxy integration. Configure the Lambda proxy to split traffic between the two Lambda function versions. Send 90% of the traffic to the production version, and send 10% of the traffic to the new version.
options.D: Update the Lambda code and create a new version of the Lambda function. Create a Lambda function alias. Configure the traffic weights in the Lambda alias between the two Lambda function versions. Send 90% of the traffic to the production version, and send 10% of the traffic to the new version.

en.explanation:
# Lambda Canary Deployment with Weighted Alias

## Scenario
The developer needs to gradually roll out a new version of a Lambda function to production, exposing only **10%** of users to the new code initially. This is the classic **canary deployment** pattern in Lambda.

## Correct Answer: **D**

The proper way to do this in Lambda is to:
1. Update the function code and **publish a new version**.
2. Use a **Lambda alias** with a **weighted routing configuration** that points to two versions.
3. Configure the alias to send 90% to the current production version and 10% to the new version.

You can use a weighted alias to split traffic between two different versions of the same function. With this approach, you can test new versions of your functions with a small percentage of traffic and quickly roll back if necessary. This is known as a canary deployment.

Key constraints of the weighted alias:
- You can point an alias to a maximum of two Lambda function versions. Both versions must have the same execution role. Both versions must have the same dead-letter queue configuration, or no dead-letter queue configuration. Both versions must be published. The alias cannot point to $LATEST.

Example CLI to configure the 90/10 split:

```bash
aws lambda update-alias \
  --name prod \
  --function-name myFunction \
  --function-version 1 \
  --routing-config AdditionalVersionWeights={"2"=0.1}
```

This sends 10% of traffic to version 2 (new) and 90% to version 1 (production), exactly meeting the requirement.

## Why the Other Options Are Incorrect

**A. "Lambda function trigger" with traffic weights** — Wrong. A Lambda *trigger* (event source mapping or invocation trigger) does not support traffic-weighting between function versions. Traffic shifting is an **alias** feature, not a trigger feature. There is no such thing as a trigger-level routing configuration.

**B. Create a new (separate) Lambda function and alias the production function to split traffic to it** — Wrong. An alias can point to a maximum of two Lambda function versions *of the same function*. An alias cannot route traffic to a *different* Lambda function. Traffic shifting only works between **versions of the same function**, not between two distinct functions.

**C. Lambda proxy integration to split traffic** — Wrong. *Lambda proxy integration* is an API Gateway concept that defines how API Gateway passes the entire request to a Lambda function; it has no traffic-splitting/weighted routing capability between Lambda versions. Canary traffic splitting between Lambda versions must be done at the alias level (or via API Gateway stage canary settings, which is not what option C describes).

## References
- [Implement Lambda canary deployments using a weighted alias](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html)
- [Create an alias for a Lambda function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-aliases.html)
- [AWS Lambda Supports Traffic Shifting](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2017/11/aws-lambda-supports-traffic-shifting-and-phased-deployments-with-aws-codedeploy/)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在更新生产环境中的 AWS Lambda 函数以修复一个缺陷。他已在测试环境中测试了更新后的代码。他希望在向所有用户推出更改之前，先将更新逐步推送给一小部分生产用户。最初，只有 10% 的用户应该接触到生产环境中的新代码。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 更新 Lambda 代码并创建一个新版本的 Lambda 函数。创建一个 Lambda 函数触发器。在触发器中配置两个 Lambda 函数版本之间的流量权重。将 90% 的流量发送到生产版本，将 10% 的流量发送到新版本。
options.B: 创建一个使用更新后代码的新 Lambda 函数。为生产环境 Lambda 函数创建一个 Lambda 别名。配置 Lambda 别名，将 90% 的流量发送到生产环境 Lambda 函数，将 10% 的流量发送到测试环境 Lambda 函数。
options.C: 更新 Lambda 代码并创建新版本的 Lambda 函数。创建 Lambda 代理集成。配置 Lambda 代理以在两个 Lambda 函数版本之间分配流量。将 90% 的流量发送到生产版本，将 10% 的流量发送到新版本。
options.D: 更新 Lambda 代码并创建新版本的 Lambda 函数。创建 Lambda 函数别名。在 Lambda 别名中配置两个 Lambda 函数版本之间的流量权重。将 90% 的流量发送到生产版本，将 10% 的流量发送到新版本。

zh.explanation:
# Lambda 金丝雀部署与加权别名

## 场景
开发人员需要逐步向生产环境推出 Lambda 函数的新版本，初始时仅将 **10%** 的用户暴露给新代码。这是 Lambda 中经典的**金丝雀部署**模式。

## 正确答案：**D**

在 Lambda 中执行此操作的正确方法是：
1. 更新函数代码并**发布新版本**。
2. 使用**加权路由配置**的 **Lambda 别名**，指向两个版本。
3. 配置别名将 90% 的流量发送到当前生产版本，10% 发送到新版本。

您可以使用加权别名在同一函数的两个不同版本之间分流。使用此方法，您可以使用少量流量测试函数的新版本，并在必要时快速回滚。这称为金丝雀部署。

加权别名的关键限制：
- 别名最多可指向两个 Lambda 函数版本。两个版本必须具有相同的执行角色。两个版本必须具有相同的死信队列配置，或没有死信队列配置。两个版本都必须已发布。别名不能指向 $LATEST。

配置 90/10 分流的 CLI 示例：

```bash
aws lambda update-alias \
  --name prod \
  --function-name myFunction \
  --function-version 1 \
  --routing-config AdditionalVersionWeights={"2"=0.1}
```

这将 10% 的流量发送到版本 2（新版本），90% 发送到版本 1（生产版本），完全满足要求。

## 其他选项为何错误

**A. "Lambda 函数触发器"具有流量权重** — 错误。Lambda *触发器*（事件源映射或调用触发器）不支持函数版本之间的流量加权。流量转移是**别名**功能，不是触发器功能。不存在触发器级路由配置。

**B. 创建新的（独立的）Lambda 函数，并为生产函数创建别名以将流量分配给它** — 错误。别名最多可指向同一函数的两个 Lambda 函数版本。别名不能将流量路由到*不同的* Lambda 函数。流量转移仅在**同一函数的版本之间**工作，不在两个不同函数之间工作。

**C. Lambda 代理集成以分流** — 错误。*Lambda 代理集成*是 API Gateway 概念，定义 API Gateway 如何将整个请求传递给 Lambda 函数；它没有 Lambda 版本之间的流量分流/加权路由功能。Lambda 版本之间的金丝雀流量分流必须在别名级别完成（或通过 API Gateway 阶段金丝雀设置，这不是选项 C 所描述的）。

## 参考资源
- [使用加权别名实现 Lambda 金丝雀部署](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html)
- [为 Lambda 函数创建别名](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-aliases.html)
- [AWS Lambda 支持流量转移](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2017/11/aws-lambda-supports-traffic-shifting-and-phased-deployments-with-aws-codedeploy/)

en.question: A developer is creating an AWS Lambda function that consumes messages from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue. The developer notices that the Lambda function processes some messages multiple times. How should developer resolve this issue MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Change the Amazon SQS standard queue to an Amazon SQS FIFO queue by using the Amazon SQS message deduplication ID.
options.B: Set up a dead-letter queue.
options.C: Set the maximum concurrency limit of the AWS Lambda function to 1.
options.D: Change the message processing to use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams instead of Amazon SQS.

en.explanation:
# SQS Standard Queue Duplicates with Lambda

## Scenario
A Lambda function consuming from an **SQS standard queue** processes some messages multiple times. Standard queues only guarantee **at-least-once delivery**, which means duplicates are an inherent characteristic of the service. The developer wants to fix this **most cost-effectively**.

## Correct Answer: A — Switch to an SQS FIFO queue using Message Deduplication ID

SQS FIFO queues are explicitly designed to provide **exactly-once processing**. Unlike standard queues, FIFO queues don't introduce duplicate messages. FIFO queues help you avoid sending duplicates to a queue. If you retry the SendMessage action within the 5-minute deduplication interval, Amazon SQS doesn't introduce any duplicates into the queue.

MessageDeduplicationId is a token used only in Amazon SQS FIFO queues to prevent duplicate message delivery. It ensures that within a 5-minute deduplication window, only one instance of a message with the same deduplication ID is processed and delivered.

This directly solves the duplicate-processing problem at the queue level with **no extra infrastructure** (no DynamoDB lock table, no extra Lambda capacity, no second queue). FIFO queues do cost slightly more per request than standard queues, but among the listed options it remains the cheapest *complete* solution because it requires zero added components.

## Why the other options are wrong

### B. Set up a dead-letter queue
A DLQ does **not** prevent duplicate processing. A DLQ only collects messages that fail processing after `maxReceiveCount` attempts — it captures *poison-pill* messages, not duplicates. The Lambda would still receive and process duplicates from the source queue. See [Amazon SQS dead-letter queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-dead-letter-queues.html).

### C. Set Lambda reserved concurrency to 1
Throttling concurrency to 1 does not eliminate duplicates. Duplicates with standard SQS arise from:
1. SQS at-least-once delivery semantics (the same message can be delivered more than once even with a single consumer), and
2. Visibility-timeout expiry when processing exceeds the timeout — which becomes **worse**, not better, with concurrency = 1 because messages back up in the queue and risk visibility-timeout expiration. Standard queues guarantee at-least-once delivery, storing messages across multiple servers to maintain high availability. We may find on the rare occasion that one of these servers will be unavailable at the time our message is consumed or deleted. Subsequently the server, when available again, may re-send the message to the Lambda function, thereby delivering a duplicate. Concurrency = 1 also severely limits throughput, which is operationally costly even though the setting itself is free. See [Lambda reserved concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-concurrency.html).

### D. Switch to Kinesis Data Streams
Kinesis Data Streams also has **at-least-once** delivery semantics — it does not inherently prevent duplicates and consumer logic must still handle them. Additionally, Kinesis introduces shard-hour and PUT-payload-unit charges that make it considerably **more expensive** than SQS for this use case. See [Amazon Kinesis Data Streams pricing](https://aws.amazon.com/kinesis/data-streams/pricing/).

## Key references
- [Exactly-once processing in Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/FIFO-queues-exactly-once-processing.html)
- [Using the message deduplication ID in Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/using-messagededuplicationid-property.html)
- [Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数会从 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 标准队列中消费消息。开发人员注意到 Lambda 函数会多次处理某些消息。开发人员应该如何以最具成本效益的方式解决此问题？

options.A: 使用 Amazon SQS 消息去重 ID 将 Amazon SQS 标准队列更改为 Amazon SQS FIFO 队列。
options.B: 建立死信队列。
options.C: 将 AWS Lambda 函数的最大并发限制设置为 1。
options.D: 将消息处理更改为使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 而不是 Amazon SQS。

zh.explanation:
# SQS 标准队列与 Lambda 的重复消息问题

## 场景
一个从 **SQS 标准队列** 消费消息的 Lambda 函数多次处理某些消息。标准队列仅保证 **至少一次传递**，这意味着重复消息是该服务的固有特性。开发者希望以 **最经济高效的方式** 解决这个问题。

## 正确答案：A — 切换到使用消息去重 ID 的 SQS FIFO 队列

SQS FIFO 队列专门设计用于提供 **恰好一次处理**。与标准队列不同，FIFO 队列不会产生重复消息。FIFO 队列可帮助您避免向队列发送重复消息。如果您在 5 分钟去重时间间隔内重试 SendMessage 操作，Amazon SQS 不会向队列中引入任何重复消息。

MessageDeduplicationId 是仅在 Amazon SQS FIFO 队列中使用的令牌，用于防止重复消息传递。它确保在 5 分钟去重窗口内，只有一个具有相同去重 ID 的消息实例被处理和传递。

这在队列层级直接解决了重复处理问题，**无需额外的基础设施**（无需 DynamoDB 锁表、无需额外的 Lambda 容量、无需第二个队列）。FIFO 队列的每个请求成本略高于标准队列，但在列出的选项中，它仍然是最便宜的 *完整* 解决方案，因为它不需要任何附加组件。

## 为什么其他选项错误

### B. 设置死信队列
死信队列 **不能** 防止重复处理。死信队列仅收集在 `maxReceiveCount` 次尝试后处理失败的消息——它捕获 *有毒* 消息，而不是重复消息。Lambda 仍会从源队列接收和处理重复消息。参见 [Amazon SQS 死信队列](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-dead-letter-queues.html)。

### C. 将 Lambda 保留并发设置为 1
将并发限制为 1 不能消除重复消息。标准 SQS 的重复消息源于：
1. SQS 至少一次传递语义（即使只有一个消费者，相同消息也可以传递多次），以及
2. 可见性超时过期（当处理超过超时时间时）——当并发 = 1 时这会 **更糟糕**，而不是更好，因为消息在队列中堆积，面临可见性超时过期的风险。标准队列保证至少一次传递，在多个服务器上存储消息以维持高可用性。在极少数情况下，其中一台服务器在消息被消费或删除时可能不可用。随后，该服务器在恢复时可能会将消息重新发送到 Lambda 函数，从而传递重复消息。 并发 = 1 也严重限制吞吐量，即使该设置本身免费，在操作上也很昂贵。参见 [Lambda 保留并发](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-concurrency.html)。

### D. 切换到 Kinesis Data Streams
Kinesis Data Streams 也具有 **至少一次** 传递语义——它本身不能防止重复消息，消费者逻辑仍需处理它们。此外，Kinesis 引入的分片小时和 PUT 负载单位费用使其对此用例来说成本 **远高于** SQS。参见 [Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 定价](https://aws.amazon.com/kinesis/data-streams/pricing/)。

## 关键参考资源
- [Amazon SQS 中的恰好一次处理](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/FIFO-queues-exactly-once-processing.html)
- [在 Amazon SQS 中使用消息去重 ID](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/using-messagededuplicationid-property.html)
- [通过 Amazon SQS 使用 Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)

en.question: A developer is optimizing an AWS Lambda function and wants to test the changes in production on a small percentage of all traffic. The Lambda function serves requests to a RE ST API in Amazon API Gateway. The developer needs to deploy their changes and perform a test in production without changing the API Gateway URL. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Define a function version for the currently deployed production Lambda function. Update the API Gateway endpoint to reference the new Lambda function version. Upload and publish the optimized Lambda function code. On the production API Gateway stage, define a canary release and set the percentage of traffic to direct to the canary release. Update the API Gateway endpoint to use the $LATEST version of the Lambda function. Publish the API to the canary stage.
options.B: Define a function version for the currently deployed production Lambda function. Update the API Gateway endpoint to reference the new Lambda function version. Upload and publish the optimized Lambda function code. Update the API Gateway endpoint to use the $LATEST version of the Lambda function. Deploy a new API Gateway stage.
options.C: Define an alias on the $LATEST version of the Lambda function. Update the API Gateway endpoint to reference the new Lambda function alias. Upload and publish the optimized Lambda function code. On the production API Gateway stage, define a canary release and set the percentage of traffic to direct to the canary release. Update the API Gateway endpoint to use the $LATEST version of the Lambda function. Publish to the canary stage.
options.D: Define a function version for the currently deployed production Lambda function. Update the API Gateway endpoint to reference the new Lambda function version. Upload and publish the optimized Lambda function code. Update the API Gateway endpoint to use the $LATEST version of the Lambda function. Deploy the API to the production API Gateway stage.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer wants to deploy an optimized AWS Lambda function behind an existing API Gateway REST API and route only a **small percentage** of production traffic to the new code, **without changing the API Gateway URL**. This is the canonical use case for an **API Gateway canary release deployment** combined with **Lambda versioning**.

> **Note:** The originally listed answer **C** is incorrect. C proposes pointing a Lambda alias at `$LATEST`. Because `$LATEST` is mutated the moment new function code is uploaded, every request would immediately receive the new code — defeating the "small percentage of traffic" requirement. AWS guidance is that production aliases must point to a specific, immutable published version, not `$LATEST` ([Iterate rapidly, stay agile](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/serverless-multi-tier-architectures-api-gateway-lambda/iterate-rapidly-stay-agile.html)).

## Why A is correct

Option A implements the documented canary pattern step-by-step:

1. **Publish a version of the currently deployed Lambda** (call it V1). Published versions are immutable snapshots of code and configuration.
2. **Update the API Gateway integration to reference V1.** The base/production deployment is now safely pinned to the old code.
3. **Upload the optimized code.** This only modifies `$LATEST`; V1 is untouched, so production traffic is unaffected.
4. **Enable canary settings on the production stage** and configure the traffic percentage that should hit the canary.
5. **Change the API Gateway integration to `$LATEST` and publish only to the canary stage.** The base deployment keeps its V1 integration; the canary deployment uses `$LATEST` (new code).

The AWS documentation states: *"After you change the API and deploy it to this stage again, the new version will be in the canary release, while the base version remains in the production release. … API Gateway uses a weighted random distribution to split traffic"* ([Create a canary release deployment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/create-canary-deployment.html), [Set up an API Gateway canary release deployment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/canary-release.html)). Because both the base and canary share the same stage, **the invoke URL never changes** — exactly what the question requires.

A working blueprint of this pattern is described in [Performing canary deployments for service integrations with Amazon API Gateway](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/performing-canary-deployments-for-service-integrations-with-amazon-api-gateway/).

## Why the other options are wrong

### B — No canary, and a new stage changes the URL
Option B publishes the new code and "deploys a new API Gateway stage." A new stage produces a **different invoke URL** (e.g., `/test` vs `/prod`), violating the explicit "without changing the API Gateway URL" requirement. There is also no canary configuration, so 100% of traffic on that stage would hit the new version.

### C — Originally listed but wrong: alias on `$LATEST`
C says *"Define an alias on the `$LATEST` version of the Lambda function"* and integrates API Gateway with that alias. The fatal sequencing problem:

- A Lambda alias pointing at `$LATEST` is just a pointer to whatever is currently in `$LATEST`.
- When step 3 ("Upload and publish the optimized Lambda function code") runs, `$LATEST` is overwritten with the new code, and because the alias tracks `$LATEST`, **100% of production traffic immediately receives the new code** — before any canary is in place.
- This contradicts AWS best practice. [Lambda function aliases and versioning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html) describes alias traffic shifting between specific *published* versions, not `$LATEST`.
- The later step "Update the API Gateway endpoint to use the `$LATEST` version" is also redundant/contradictory, since the alias already tracks `$LATEST`.

### D — No canary configuration
Option D updates the integration to `$LATEST` and deploys directly to the production stage. There is **no canary release** defined, so 100% of production traffic instantly receives the new code, failing the small-percentage-of-traffic requirement.

## Key references

- [Set up an API Gateway canary release deployment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/canary-release.html)
- [Create a canary release deployment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/create-canary-deployment.html)
- [Lambda alias routing configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在优化一个 AWS Lambda 函数，并希望在生产环境中对一小部分流量进行测试。该 Lambda 函数负责处理对 Amazon API Gateway 中 REST API 的请求。开发人员需要在不更改 API Gateway URL 的情况下部署更改并在生产环境中执行测试。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 为当前已部署的生产环境 Lambda 函数定义一个函数版本。更新 API 网关端点以引用新的 Lambda 函数版本。上传并发布优化后的 Lambda 函数代码。在生产环境 API 网关上，定义一个金丝雀发布版本，并设置定向到金丝雀发布的流量百分比。更新 API 网关端点以使用 Lambda 函数的最新版本。将 API 发布到金丝雀发布环境。
options.B: 为当前已部署的生产环境 Lambda 函数定义一个函数版本。更新 API 网关端点以引用新的 Lambda 函数版本。上传并发布优化后的 Lambda 函数代码。更新 API 网关端点以使用 Lambda 函数的最新版本。部署一个新的 API 网关阶段。
options.C: 为 Lambda 函数的最新版本定义别名。更新 API 网关端点以引用新的 Lambda 函数别名。上传并发布优化后的 Lambda 函数代码。在生产 API 网关环境中，定义一个金丝雀发布版本，并设置定向到该金丝雀发布的流量百分比。更新 API 网关端点以使用 Lambda 函数的最新版本。发布到金丝雀发布环境。
options.D: 为当前已部署的生产环境 Lambda 函数定义一个函数版本。更新 API 网关端点以引用新的 Lambda 函数版本。上传并发布优化后的 Lambda 函数代码。更新 API 网关端点以使用 Lambda 函数的最新版本。将 API 部署到生产环境 API 网关。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一名开发人员想要在现有 API Gateway REST API 后面部署一个优化的 AWS Lambda 函数，并将**小部分**生产流量路由到新代码，**无需更改 API Gateway URL**。这是 **API Gateway canary 发布部署**结合 **Lambda 版本控制**的典型使用场景。

> **注意：** 最初列出的答案 **C** 是错误的。C 建议将 Lambda 别名指向 `$LATEST`。由于 `$LATEST` 在上传新函数代码时会立即改变，每个请求都会立即接收新代码 — 这违反了"小部分流量"的要求。AWS 指导是生产别名必须指向特定的不可变已发布版本，而不是 `$LATEST`（[Iterate rapidly, stay agile](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/serverless-multi-tier-architectures-api-gateway-lambda/iterate-rapidly-stay-agile.html)）。

## 为什么 A 是正确的

选项 A 逐步实现记录的 canary 模式：

1. **发布当前部署的 Lambda 版本**（称之为 V1）。已发布的版本是代码和配置的不可变快照。
2. **更新 API Gateway 集成以引用 V1**。基础/生产部署现在安全地固定在旧代码上。
3. **上传优化的代码**。这仅修改 `$LATEST`；V1 保持不变，所以生产流量不受影响。
4. **在生产阶段启用 canary 设置**并配置应该命中 canary 的流量百分比。
5. **将 API Gateway 集成更改为 `$LATEST` 并仅发布到 canary 阶段**。基础部署保持其 V1 集成；canary 部署使用 `$LATEST`（新代码）。

AWS 文档指出："在你更改 API 并再次将其部署到此阶段后，新版本将在 canary 发布中，而基础版本保持在生产发布中。…… API Gateway 使用加权随机分布来分割流量"（[Create a canary release deployment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/create-canary-deployment.html)、[Set up an API Gateway canary release deployment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/canary-release.html)）。由于基础和 canary 共享同一个阶段，**调用 URL 从不改变** — 正是问题所要求的。

此模式的工作蓝图在 [Performing canary deployments for service integrations with Amazon API Gateway](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/performing-canary-deployments-for-service-integrations-with-amazon-api-gateway/) 中有描述。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

### B — 无 canary，新阶段改变 URL
选项 B 发布新代码并"部署一个新的 API Gateway 阶段"。新阶段会产生**不同的调用 URL**（例如 `/test` vs `/prod`），违反了明确的"无需更改 API Gateway URL"要求。也没有 canary 配置，所以该阶段的 100% 流量将命中新版本。

### C — 最初列出但错误：别名指向 `$LATEST`
C 说"**在 Lambda 函数的 `$LATEST` 版本上定义别名**"并将 API Gateway 与该别名集成。致命的排序问题：

- 指向 `$LATEST` 的 Lambda 别名只是指向 `$LATEST` 中当前所有内容的指针。
- 当执行步骤 3（"上传并发布优化的 Lambda 函数代码"）时，`$LATEST` 被覆盖为新代码，由于别名追踪 `$LATEST`，**100% 的生产流量立即接收新代码** — 在任何 canary 就位之前。
- 这违反了 AWS 最佳实践。[Lambda function aliases and versioning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html) 描述了别名在特定*已发布*版本之间的流量转移，而不是 `$LATEST`。
- 稍后的步骤"更新 API Gateway 端点以使用 `$LATEST` 版本"也是冗余/矛盾的，因为别名已经追踪 `$LATEST`。

### D — 无 canary 配置
选项 D 将集成更新为 `$LATEST` 并直接部署到生产阶段。**没有定义 canary 发布**，所以 100% 的生产流量立即接收新代码，不满足小部分流量要求。

## 关键参考

- [Set up an API Gateway canary release deployment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/canary-release.html)
- [Create a canary release deployment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/create-canary-deployment.html)
- [Lambda alias routing configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html)
- [AWS Whitepaper: Iterate rapidly, stay agile](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/serverless-multi-tier-architectures-api-gateway-lambda/iterate-rapidly-stay-agile.html)
- [Performing canary deployments for service integrations with Amazon API Gateway](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/performing-canary-deployments-for-service-integrations-with-amazon-api-gateway/)

en.question: A company notices that credentials that the company uses to connect to an external software as a service (SaaS) vendor are stored in a configuration file as plaintext. The developer needs to secure the API credentials and enforce automatic credentials rotation on a quarterly basis. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST securely?

options.A: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to encrypt the configuration file. Decrypt the configuration file when users make API calls to the SaaS vendor. Enable rotation.
options.B: Retrieve temporary credentials from AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) every 15 minutes. Use the temporary credentials when users make API calls to the SaaS vendor.
options.C: Store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager and enable rotation. Configure the API to have Secrets Manager access.
options.D: Store the credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store and enable rotation. Retrieve the credentials when users make API calls to the SaaS vendor.

en.explanation:
# SaaS API Credentials with Automatic Rotation

## Scenario
A developer has SaaS vendor API credentials sitting in plaintext in a config file. The requirement is twofold:
1. **Securely store** the credentials (no more plaintext).
2. **Automatically rotate** them quarterly.

The question asks for the MOST secure solution.

## Correct Answer: C — AWS Secrets Manager with rotation enabled

AWS Secrets Manager is purpose-built for this use case. AWS Secrets Manager is a secrets management service that helps you protect access to your applications, services, and IT resources. This service enables you to easily rotate, manage, and retrieve database credentials, API keys, and other secrets throughout their lifecycle.

Key reasons C is the best fit:
- **Encryption at rest**: The credentials stored in Secrets Manager are encrypted either using AWS managed KMS keys or customer managed keys.
- **Native automatic rotation**: Rotation is the process of periodically updating a secret. When you rotate a secret, you update the credentials in both the secret and the database or service. In Secrets Manager, you can set up automatic rotation for your secrets.
- **SaaS / third-party support**: Secrets Manager natively supports rotating credentials for databases hosted on Amazon RDS and Amazon DocumentDB, clusters hosted on Amazon Redshift, and third-party SaaS providers such as Salesforce and Snowflake. Extend Secrets Manager to rotate secrets used with other services by modifying sample Lambda functions.
- **Fine-grained access**: IAM policies grant the application permission to call `secretsmanager:GetSecretValue`, replacing the plaintext file.
- **Quarterly schedule**: Rotation can be configured on any schedule (cron or interval), so a 90-day quarterly rotation is straightforward.

## Why the other options are wrong

**A. Use KMS to encrypt the configuration file; "enable rotation."**
KMS key rotation rotates the *encryption key*, not the SaaS credentials inside the file. The plaintext API credentials in the file would still need to be manually changed at the SaaS vendor and re-encrypted. KMS alone has no mechanism to call the SaaS provider and rotate API credentials. It also leaves operational burden of decrypting the file at runtime — a far less secure and more complex pattern than calling Secrets Manager directly.

**B. Retrieve temporary credentials from AWS STS every 15 minutes.**
[AWS STS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/STS/latest/APIReference/welcome.html) issues temporary AWS credentials for IAM principals — it cannot mint or vend credentials for an external third-party SaaS vendor. The SaaS provider does not trust STS tokens, so this approach simply does not work for external API authentication.

**D. Store credentials in Systems Manager Parameter Store and "enable rotation."**
[Parameter Store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html) supports `SecureString` (KMS-encrypted) storage but does **not** provide built-in/managed automatic rotation of secrets. To rotate, you would need to build and operate your own Lambda + EventBridge solution. Compared with Secrets Manager's native rotation feature, this is less secure and not what AWS recommends for credentials requiring automatic rotation.

## Summary
Secrets Manager is the only option that natively delivers both encrypted storage and scheduled automatic rotation for third-party/SaaS API credentials, satisfying the "MOST securely" requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司发现，用于连接外部软件即服务 (SaaS) 供应商的凭据以明文形式存储在配置文件中。开发人员需要保护 API 凭据，并强制每季度自动轮换凭据。哪种解决方案能够最安全地满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密配置文件。当用户向 SaaS 供应商发出 API 调用时，解密配置文件。启用轮换机制。
options.B: 每 15 分钟从 AWS 安全令牌服务 (AWS STS) 获取临时凭证。当用户向 SaaS 供应商发出 API 调用时，使用这些临时凭证。
options.C: 将凭证存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中并启用轮换功能。配置 API 以使其拥有对 Secrets Manager 的访问权限。
options.D: 将凭证存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中并启用轮换功能。当用户向 SaaS 供应商发出 API 调用时，检索凭证。

zh.explanation:
# SaaS API 凭证与自动轮换

## 场景
一名开发人员在配置文件中以明文形式存储 SaaS 供应商 API 凭证。需求分为两部分：
1. **安全存储**凭证（不再使用明文）。
2. **自动轮换**凭证（每季度一次）。

问题要求找出最安全的解决方案。

## 正确答案：C — 启用轮换的 AWS Secrets Manager

AWS Secrets Manager 是为此用例量身定制的服务。AWS Secrets Manager 是一项秘密管理服务，可帮助你保护对应用程序、服务和 IT 资源的访问。此服务使你能够在整个生命周期内轻松轮换、管理和检索数据库凭证、API 密钥和其他秘密。

C 是最佳选择的关键原因：
- **静态加密**：存储在 Secrets Manager 中的凭证使用 AWS 托管 KMS 密钥或客户托管密钥进行加密。
- **原生自动轮换**：轮换是定期更新秘密的过程。轮换秘密时，你需要在秘密以及数据库或服务中更新凭证。在 Secrets Manager 中，你可以为秘密设置自动轮换。
- **SaaS / 第三方支持**：Secrets Manager 原生支持轮换托管在 Amazon RDS 和 Amazon DocumentDB 上的数据库凭证、托管在 Amazon Redshift 上的集群凭证以及 Salesforce 和 Snowflake 等第三方 SaaS 提供商的凭证。通过修改示例 Lambda 函数，可以扩展 Secrets Manager 以轮换用于其他服务的秘密。
- **细粒度访问控制**：IAM 策略授予应用程序调用 `secretsmanager:GetSecretValue` 的权限，取代明文文件。
- **按季度时间表**：轮换可以配置为任何时间表（cron 或间隔），因此 90 天的季度轮换很直接。

## 其他选项为何不正确

**A. 使用 KMS 加密配置文件；"启用轮换"。**
KMS 密钥轮换是轮换*加密密钥*，而不是文件中的 SaaS 凭证。文件中的明文 API 凭证仍需要在 SaaS 供应商处手动更改并重新加密。KMS 单独无法调用 SaaS 提供商并轮换 API 凭证。它还在运行时留下了解密文件的操作负担——这是一种远不如直接调用 Secrets Manager 安全和复杂的模式。

**B. 每 15 分钟从 AWS STS 检索临时凭证。**
[AWS STS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/STS/latest/APIReference/welcome.html) 为 IAM 主体颁发临时 AWS 凭证——它无法为外部第三方 SaaS 供应商生成或提供凭证。SaaS 提供商不信任 STS 令牌，因此此方法根本无法用于外部 API 身份验证。

**D. 将凭证存储在 Systems Manager Parameter Store 中并"启用轮换"。**
[Parameter Store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html) 支持 `SecureString`（KMS 加密）存储，但**不**提供内置/托管的自动秘密轮换。要轮换，你需要构建和操作自己的 Lambda + EventBridge 解决方案。与 Secrets Manager 的原生轮换功能相比，这不够安全且不是 AWS 针对需要自动轮换的凭证推荐的方案。

## 总结
Secrets Manager 是唯一原生提供加密存储和定时自动轮换第三方/SaaS API 凭证的选项，满足"最安全"的需求。

en.question: A company has an application that is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances. The application stores objects in an Amazon S3 bucket and allows users to download objects from the S3 bucket. A developer turns on S3 Block Public Access for the S3 bucket. After this change, users report errors when they attempt to download objects. The developer needs to implement a solution so that only users who are signed in to the application can access objects in the S3 bucket. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements in the MOST secure way? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an EC2 instance profile and role with an appropriate policy. Associate the role with the EC2 instances.
options.B: Create an IAM user with an appropriate policy. Store the access key ID and secret access key on the EC2 instances.
options.C: Modify the application to use the S3 GeneratePresignedUrl API call.
options.D: Modify the application to use the S3 GetObject API call and to return the object handle to the user.
options.E: Modify the application to delegate requests to the S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

An EC2-hosted application stores objects in S3 and lets users download them. After enabling **S3 Block Public Access**, anonymous downloads no longer work. The developer needs a secure way for *only signed-in application users* to download objects.

This requires two things:
1. The EC2 application itself needs AWS credentials to interact with S3 (the bucket is now private).
2. A mechanism to deliver objects to authenticated end-users without making the bucket public.

## Correct Answers: A and C

### A — EC2 instance profile + IAM role
The application running on EC2 needs S3 permissions in order to call the S3 API (e.g., to generate presigned URLs). The most secure way to provide these credentials is via an IAM role attached through an **instance profile**. EC2 then receives automatically rotated, short-lived temporary credentials from the instance metadata service — no long-term keys are stored on disk. This follows the principle of least privilege and avoids credential leakage risks.

### C — Use S3 `GeneratePresignedUrl`
Once the application has authenticated the user (via its own application-level sign-in), it can call the S3 SDK's `generate_presigned_url` API to produce a **time-limited URL** for the specific object. A presigned URL lets you share or upload objects in Amazon S3 without requiring AWS security credentials or permissions, granting time-limited download access to objects in a private bucket. Pre-signed URLs are secure: they can only be used to access the specific object they were created for.

The combination is natural: the server can generate the pre-signed URLs autonomously by using its own set of AWS credentials (for example the server could be an EC2 instance with an IAM instance profile), and does not need to talk with S3 to be able to generate a pre-signed URL.

## Why the other options are wrong

### B — IAM user with access key/secret stored on EC2
This is explicitly an AWS anti-pattern. Storing long-term access keys on EC2 instances is insecure: keys do not rotate automatically, can be exfiltrated if the instance is compromised, and violate the principle of least privilege. AWS recommends IAM roles for EC2 instead. This makes B strictly less secure than A.

### D — Use `GetObject` and return the object handle to the user
"Object handle" is not a real S3 concept that can be transmitted to a remote browser. If interpreted as streaming the object through the EC2 application, it forces all bucket traffic to flow through your EC2 fleet, increasing bandwidth/CPU cost and adding an attack surface. It is also less elegant and less secure than presigned URLs that grant direct, scoped, time-limited access.

### E — "Modify the application to delegate requests to the S3 bucket"
This option is vague. If interpreted as proxying S3 requests through the application, it suffers from the same problems as D — added load and a larger attack surface on the EC2 tier. Presigned URLs let users download directly from S3 with a cryptographically scoped, expiring grant, which is more secure and more scalable. The community consensus (87% AC) reflects that E is not the recommended pattern.

## Key references
- [Download and upload objects with presigned URLs (AWS Docs)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/using-presigned-url.html)
- [Using IAM roles for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/iam-roles-for-amazon-ec2.html)
- [Blocking public access to your Amazon S3 storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-control-block-public-access.html)

zh.question: 一家公司有一个托管在 Amazon EC2 实例上的应用程序。该应用程序将对象存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中，并允许用户从 S3 存储桶下载对象。开发人员启用了 S3 存储桶的“阻止公共访问”功能。更改后，用户在尝试下载对象时报告错误。开发人员需要实现一个解决方案，以确保只有登录到该应用程序的用户才能访问 S3 存储桶中的对象。以下哪两项措施组合能够以最安全的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建具有适当策略的 EC2 实例配置文件和角色。将该角色与 EC2 实例关联。
options.B: 创建一个具有适当策略的 IAM 用户。将访问密钥 ID 和秘密访问密钥存储在 EC2 实例上。
options.C: 修改应用程序以使用 S3 GeneratePresignedUrl API 调用。
options.D: 修改应用程序，使其使用 S3 GetObject API 调用，并将对象句柄返回给用户。
options.E: 修改应用程序，将请求委托给 S3 存储桶。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

EC2 托管的应用程序在 S3 中存储对象并让用户下载。启用 **S3 Block Public Access** 后，匿名下载不再工作。开发人员需要一种安全的方式让*仅签名用户*下载对象。

这需要两件事：
1. EC2 应用程序本身需要 AWS 凭证来与 S3 交互（存储桶现在是私有的）。
2. 一种在不公开存储桶的情况下向已认证最终用户交付对象的机制。

## 正确答案：A 和 C

### A — EC2 实例配置文件 + IAM 角色
在 EC2 上运行的应用程序需要 S3 权限才能调用 S3 API（例如生成预签名 URL）。提供这些凭证的最安全方式是通过**实例配置文件**附加 IAM 角色。EC2 然后从实例元数据服务接收自动轮换的短期临时凭证——磁盘上不存储长期密钥。这遵循最小权限原则并避免凭证泄露风险。

### C — 使用 S3 `GeneratePresignedUrl`
应用程序对用户进行身份验证后（通过其自己的应用级登录），它可以调用 S3 SDK 的 `generate_presigned_url` API 为特定对象生成**时间限制的 URL**。预签名 URL 允许您共享或上传 Amazon S3 中的对象，无需 AWS 安全凭证或权限，向私有存储桶中的对象授予时间限制的下载访问权限。预签名 URL 是安全的：它们只能用于访问为其创建的特定对象。

这种组合很自然：服务器可以使用自己的 AWS 凭证（例如具有 IAM 实例配置文件的 EC2 实例）自主生成预签名 URL，无需与 S3 通信即可生成预签名 URL。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

### B — IAM 用户，访问密钥/密钥存储在 EC2 上
这是显然的 AWS 反模式。在 EC2 实例上存储长期访问密钥是不安全的：密钥不会自动轮换，如果实例被破坏可能会被泄露，违反最小权限原则。AWS 建议改用 IAM 角色。这使得 B 严格不如 A 安全。

### D — 使用 `GetObject` 并向用户返回对象句柄
"对象句柄"不是可以传输到远程浏览器的真实 S3 概念。如果解释为通过 EC2 应用程序流式传输对象，它会强制所有存储桶流量流经 EC2 集群，增加带宽/CPU 成本并扩大攻击面。它也不如预签名 URL 优雅和安全，预签名 URL 授予直接、有范围、时间限制的访问权限。

### E — "修改应用程序以将请求委托给 S3 存储桶"
此选项模糊不清。如果解释为通过应用程序代理 S3 请求，它会遇到与 D 相同的问题——增加负载和 EC2 层上更大的攻击面。预签名 URL 让用户直接从 S3 下载，具有加密范围、过期的授权，这更安全且可扩展性更强。社区共识（87% AC）反映 E 不是推荐模式。

## 关键参考
- [使用预签名 URL 下载和上传对象（AWS 文档）](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/using-presigned-url.html)
- [为 Amazon EC2 使用 IAM 角色](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/iam-roles-for-amazon-ec2.html)
- [阻止对 Amazon S3 存储的公共访问](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-control-block-public-access.html)

en.question: An Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue serves as an event source for an AWS Lambda function. In the SQS queue, each item corresponds to a video file that the Lambda function must convert to a smaller resolution. The Lambda function is timing out on longer video files, but the Lambda function's timeout is already configured to its maximum value. What should a developer do to avoid the timeouts without additional code changes?

options.A: Increase the memory configuration of the Lambda function.
options.B: Increase the visibility timeout on the SQS queue.
options.C: Increase the instance size of the host that runs the Lambda function.
options.D: Use multi-threading for the conversion.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A Lambda function processes video files from an SQS queue, reducing each video's resolution. The function times out on longer videos, but its timeout is already at the maximum (15 minutes / 900 seconds). The developer must resolve this **without code changes**.

## Correct Answer: A — Increase the memory configuration of the Lambda function

In Lambda, CPU power scales proportionally with allocated memory. Lambda doesn't allow you to modify CPU configuration directly; CPU is indirectly controlled via the memory settings. The Lambda service proportionally allocates more virtual CPU as you allocate more memory. At 1.8 GB memory, a Lambda function has an entire vCPU allocated, and above this level it has access to more than one vCPU core. At 10,240MB, it has 6 vCPUs available.

For a CPU-intensive workload like video transcoding, increasing memory directly increases the CPU and network throughput available, reducing execution duration so the function completes within the timeout window. If your functions are running much slower than expected, the first step is to increase the memory setting. For memory-bound functions, this will resolve the bottleneck and may improve performance. For compute-intensive operations, if your function experiences slower-than-expected performance, this may be due to your function being CPU-bound. In this case, the computational capacity of the function cannot keep pace with the work.

This change is a **configuration-only** adjustment — no code modifications required — which directly satisfies the question's constraint.

## Why the other options are wrong

**B. Increase the visibility timeout on the SQS queue** — Visibility timeout only controls how long a message stays hidden from other consumers after being received. It does **not** extend Lambda's execution time. The Lambda function will still hit its 15-minute execution timeout and fail mid-processing; the SQS message simply becomes visible again later for a retry that will also fail. (Note: the visibility timeout *should* be set to at least 6× the Lambda timeout per AWS guidance, but that doesn't solve the timeout itself.) See [AWS Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html).

**C. Increase the instance size of the host that runs the Lambda function** — Lambda is fully managed serverless compute. Customers do not have access to or control over the underlying host instances. There is no "instance size" to configure; you only configure memory (which proportionally scales CPU). See [Configure Lambda function memory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-memory.html).

**D. Use multi-threading for the conversion** — This explicitly requires **code changes** to refactor the conversion logic into parallel threads, which violates the question's "without additional code changes" constraint. Additionally, multi-threading only helps above ~1,769 MB, where multiple vCPUs are available.

## Key takeaway

When a Lambda function is CPU-bound (e.g., video/image processing) and times out, the no-code fix is to **increase its memory allocation**, which proportionally boosts CPU and reduces duration. Adding more memory proportionally increases the amount of CPU, increasing the overall computational power available. If a function is CPU, network or memory-bound, then increasing the memory setting can dramatically improve its performance.

zh.question: Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列用作 AWS Lambda 函数的事件源。在 SQS 队列中，每个项目对应一个视频文件，Lambda 函数需要将其转换为较低的分辨率。Lambda 函数在处理较长的视频文件时会超时，但 Lambda 函数的超时时间已设置为最大值。开发人员应该如何做才能在不修改代码的情况下避免超时？

options.A: 增加 Lambda 函数的内存配置。
options.B: 增加 SQS 队列的可见性超时时间。
options.C: 增加运行 Lambda 函数的主机的实例大小。
options.D: 使用多线程进行转换。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一个 Lambda 函数从 SQS 队列处理视频文件，降低每个视频的分辨率。该函数在较长的视频上超时，但其超时已经处于最大值（15 分钟 / 900 秒）。开发人员必须解决这个问题**而不进行代码更改**。

## 正确答案：A — 增加 Lambda 函数的内存配置

在 Lambda 中，CPU 能力与分配的内存成比例扩展。Lambda 不允许直接修改 CPU 配置；CPU 通过内存设置间接控制。Lambda 服务随着内存分配增加而按比例分配更多虚拟 CPU。 在 1.8 GB 内存处，Lambda 函数分配有整个 vCPU，在此级别以上它可以访问多个 vCPU 核心。在 10,240MB 处，它有 6 个 vCPU 可用。

对于像视频转码这样的 CPU 密集型工作负载，增加内存直接增加可用的 CPU 和网络吞吐量，减少执行时间，使函数在超时窗口内完成。如果您的函数运行速度远低于预期，第一步是增加内存设置。对于受内存限制的函数，这将解决瓶颈并可能改善性能。对于计算密集型操作，如果您的函数性能比预期慢，这可能是由于您的函数受 CPU 限制。在这种情况下，函数的计算能力跟不上工作。

此更改是**仅配置**调整 — 无需代码修改 — 这直接满足问题的约束。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**B. 增加 SQS 队列的可见性超时** — 可见性超时仅控制消息被接收后对其他消费者隐藏的时间长度。它**不会**扩展 Lambda 的执行时间。Lambda 函数仍然会达到其 15 分钟执行超时并在处理中失败；SQS 消息稍后只是再次变为可见以供也会失败的重试。（注意：根据 AWS 指南，可见性超时*应该*至少设置为 Lambda 超时的 6 倍，但这不会解决超时本身问题。）参见 [AWS Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)。

**C. 增加运行 Lambda 函数的主机实例大小** — Lambda 是完全托管的无服务器计算。客户无法访问或控制底层主机实例。没有"实例大小"可以配置；您只能配置内存（这与 CPU 成比例扩展）。参见 [Configure Lambda function memory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-memory.html)。

**D. 为转换使用多线程** — 这显式要求**代码更改**，以将转换逻辑重构为并行线程，这违反了问题的"不进行额外代码更改"约束。此外，多线程仅在约 1,769 MB 以上有帮助，其中可用多个 vCPU。

## 关键要点

当 Lambda 函数受 CPU 限制（例如视频/图像处理）并超时时，无代码修复是**增加其内存分配**，这按比例提升 CPU 并减少执行时间。添加更多内存按比例增加 CPU 的数量，增加可用的总体计算能力。如果函数受 CPU、网络或内存限制，那么增加内存设置可以显著改善其性能。

en.question: A company is building an application on AWS. The application's backend includes an Amazon API Gateway REST API. The company's frontend application developers cannot continue work until the backend API is ready for integration. The company needs a solution that will allow the frontend application developers to continue their work. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Configure mock integrations for API Gateway API methods.
options.B: Integrate a Lambda function with API Gateway and return a mocked response.
options.C: Add new API endpoints to the API Gateway stage and returns a mocked response.
options.D: Configure a proxy resource for API Gateway API methods.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A company is building a REST API on Amazon API Gateway. The frontend developers are blocked because the backend is not yet ready. They need a way to integrate against the API contract and continue development in parallel — with **minimal operational overhead**.

## Correct Answer: A — Configure mock integrations for API Gateway API methods

API Gateway natively supports a **Mock integration type**, in which the request is never forwarded to a real backend. Instead, API Gateway returns a response that you define via integration response mapping templates. As an API developer, you decide how API Gateway responds to a mock integration request. For this, you configure the method's integration request and integration response to associate a response with a given status code.

This is exactly the pattern recommended for unblocking frontend teams: The Mock Integration is excellent for prototyping APIs in a fast and efficient manner. It could also be used to unblock teams that depend on the API before the development is complete.

Because there is no Lambda, no EC2, and no other compute to deploy or pay for, this is the **most operationally efficient** option — You can speed up the process, and save money, using MockIntegration! You can configure a specific Resource, or Method, or the entire API with few lines of code (for the CDK setup) and no Lambda at all!

See the AWS doc: [Mock integrations for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-mock-integration.html).

## Why the other options are wrong

- **B. Integrate a Lambda function with API Gateway and return a mocked response.** This works functionally, but it requires writing, deploying, and maintaining Lambda code purely to return canned data, plus IAM permissions and per-invocation cost. It is strictly more operational overhead than a built-in Mock integration. AWS docs explicitly position Lambda mocking only as a fallback when payloads are too large for mock templates: Mock integrations aren't intended to support large response templates. If you need them for your use case, you should consider using a Lambda integration instead.

- **C. Add new API endpoints to the API Gateway stage and returns a mocked response.** Adding "new endpoints" doesn't itself produce a mocked response — you still must back each method with some integration. Without specifying Mock integration, this option is incomplete and adds extra resources that diverge from the real API contract that the frontend needs to integrate with. It also fragments the API surface unnecessarily.

- **D. Configure a proxy resource for API Gateway API methods.** A proxy resource (e.g., `{proxy+}` with `HTTP_PROXY` or `AWS_PROXY/Lambda proxy`) forwards requests to a backend HTTP endpoint or Lambda function. It does not return canned data on its own — it requires a real backend to forward to, which is exactly what doesn't yet exist. See [Set up a proxy integration with a proxy resource](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-set-up-simple-proxy.html).

## Key takeaway

For DVA-C02, remember the API Gateway integration types: **AWS, AWS_PROXY (Lambda proxy), HTTP, HTTP_PROXY, and MOCK**. The MOCK integration type is the canonical, no-code way to return canned responses so frontend teams can develop against the API contract before the backend exists.

zh.question: 一家公司正在AWS上构建一个应用程序。该应用程序的后端包含一个Amazon API Gateway REST API。在后端 API准备就绪之前，该公司的前端应用程序开发人员无法继续工作。该公司需要一个解决方案，使前端应用程序开发人员能够继续他们的工作。哪种解决方案能够以最高效的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 为 API 网关 API 方法配置模拟集成。
options.B: 将 Lambda 函数与 API 网关集成，并返回模拟响应。
options.C: 向 API 网关阶段添加新的 API 端点并返回模拟响应。
options.D: 为 API 网关 API 方法配置代理资源。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一家公司正在 Amazon API Gateway 上构建 REST API。前端开发人员被阻塞，因为后端尚未准备好。他们需要一种方法根据 API 契约进行集成，并以**最小的运维开销**继续并行开发。

## 正确答案：A — 为 API Gateway API 方法配置 Mock 集成

API Gateway 原生支持 **Mock 集成类型**，在这种类型中，请求永远不会转发到真正的后端。相反，API Gateway 返回您通过集成响应映射模板定义的响应。作为 API 开发人员，您可以决定 API Gateway 如何响应 Mock 集成请求。为此，您配置方法的集成请求和集成响应，以将响应与给定的状态代码相关联。

这正是为前端团队解除阻塞的推荐模式：Mock 集成非常适合以快速高效的方式进行 API 原型设计。它也可以用于解除依赖该 API 的团队的阻塞，直到开发完成。

因为没有 Lambda、EC2 或其他需要部署或付费的计算资源，这是**运维效率最高**的选项 — 您可以使用 Mock 集成加快流程并节省资金！您可以通过少数几行代码（CDK 设置）配置特定的资源、方法或整个 API，而根本不需要 Lambda！

参考 AWS 文档：[API Gateway 中的 REST API Mock 集成](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-mock-integration.html)。

## 其他选项为什么错误

- **B. 将 Lambda 函数与 API Gateway 集成并返回模拟响应。** 这在功能上是可行的，但它需要编写、部署和维护 Lambda 代码，仅用于返回罐头数据，加上 IAM 权限和每次调用的成本。它严格来说比内置 Mock 集成需要更多的运维开销。AWS 文档明确指出，Lambda 模拟仅作为后备方案，当有效负载对于 Mock 模板来说太大时：Mock 集成不适合支持大型响应模板。如果您的用例需要它们，应该考虑使用 Lambda 集成。

- **C. 向 API Gateway 阶段添加新 API 端点并返回模拟响应。** 添加"新端点"本身不会产生模拟响应 — 您仍然必须使用某种集成来支持每个方法。如果不指定 Mock 集成，此选项是不完整的，并且添加了与前端需要集成的实际 API 契约不同的额外资源。它还会不必要地分割 API 表面。

- **D. 为 API Gateway API 方法配置代理资源。** 代理资源（例如 `{proxy+}` 与 `HTTP_PROXY` 或 `AWS_PROXY/Lambda 代理`）将请求转发到后端 HTTP 端点或 Lambda 函数。它本身不返回罐头数据 — 它需要一个真正的后端来转发到，这正是不存在的。参考[使用代理资源设置代理集成](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-set-up-simple-proxy.html)。

## 核心要点

对于 DVA-C02，请记住 API Gateway 集成类型：**AWS、AWS_PROXY（Lambda 代理）、HTTP、HTTP_PROXY 和 MOCK**。MOCK 集成类型是返回罐头响应的规范、无代码方式，使前端团队可以在后端存在之前根据 API 契约进行开发。

en.question: A company is preparing to migrate an application to the company's first AWS environment.
