## 正确答案：A — Username

DynamoDB 对分区键进行哈希以决定哪个物理分区存储项。为了避免"热分区"，分区键必须具有**高基数**和均匀访问。您应该设计应用程序，使其在表及其二级索引的所有分区键间具有均匀活动。

使用高基数属性 — 这些属性为每个项都有不同的值，如 emailid、employee_no、customerid、sessionid、orderid 等。由于每个用户只能提交一个请求，**username 在每个项中是唯一的** — 完美的高基数行为。设计表架构使分区键值具有广泛分散（高基数）将自然地将数据分散在分区中，并可以提高读取速率和查询速率。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

### B. Submission date — 错误
在激增期间，许多用户在同一时刻提交，因此时间戳值严重聚集。基于时间的键（如时间戳、日期）对时间序列数据很诱人，但通常会导致热分区。例如，分区键 event_date 如果采用每日值，会将 2024-01-01 的所有写入集中到一个分区，在高峰时段导致其超载。这正是所述激增场景 — submission date 会导致滚动热分区。

### C. Validation status — 错误
仅**三个**可能的值（UNVALIDATED、VALID、NOT VALID）。这是极低的基数。使用布尔值（true / false）或枚举（red / green / blue）作为分区键不是个好主意。您的基数不足以将数据真正分散到分区中。所有项将仅哈希到 3 个分区，大多数项最初会落在"UNVALIDATED"上。

### D. Rating（1–5） — 错误
仅**五个**可能的值。这也是低基数，会强制所有项进入最多 5 个哈希桶，导致严重不平衡。使用低基数键：避免使用 status 或 category 等只有少数唯一值的键。此外，评分通常会出现倾斜（如许多 5 星评分），恶化热分区问题。

## 关键要点
选择具有**高基数**和**均匀访问**的分区键。`Username` 在每个请求中是唯一的，并自然地在激增期间将写入分散到许多分区。

## 参考资源
- [在 DynamoDB 中有效设计和使用分区键的最佳实践](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-partition-key-design.html)
- [选择正确的 DynamoDB 分区键（AWS 数据库博客）](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/choosing-the-right-dynamodb-partition-key/)
- [扩展 DynamoDB：分区、热键和分割对热的影响如何影响性能](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/part-3-scaling-dynamodb-how-partitions-hot-keys-and-split-for-heat-impact-performance/)

en.question: A developer is creating a publicly accessible enterprise website consisting of only static assets. The developer is hosting the website in Amazon S3 and serving the website to users through an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The users of this application must not be able to access the application content directly from an S3 bucket. All content must be served through the Amazon CloudFront distribution. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a new origin access control (OAC) in CloudFront. Configure the CloudFront distribution's origin to use the new OAC. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow CloudFront OAC with read and write access to access Amazon S3 as the origin.
options.B: Update the S3 bucket settings. Enable the block all public access setting in Amazon S3. Configure the CloudFront distribution's with Amazon S3 as the origin. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow CloudFront write access.
options.C: Update the S3 bucket's static website settings. Enable static website hosting and specifying index and error documents. Update the CloudFront origin to use the S3 bucket's website endpoint.
options.D: Update the CloudFront distribution's origin to send a custom header. Update the S3 bucket policy with a condition by using the aws:RequestTag/tag-key key. Configure the tag-key as the custom header name, and the value being matched is the header's value.

en.explanation:
# Restricting S3 Access to Only CloudFront via OAC

## Scenario
A static website is hosted on Amazon S3 and served through Amazon CloudFront. The requirement is that users must **only** be able to reach content through the CloudFront distribution — direct access via S3 URLs must be blocked.

## Correct Answer: A

The modern, AWS-recommended way to lock down an S3 origin so it is only reachable through a specific CloudFront distribution is **Origin Access Control (OAC)**. Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network that can distribute content from various origins, including Amazon S3 buckets. Origin Access Control (OAC) is used to restrict direct access to the S3 bucket, ensuring that only CloudFront can access the content. When a CloudFront distribution uses an S3 origin, enabling OAC ensures that CloudFront is the only allowed source to retrieve the content from the S3 bucket, preventing unauthorized access from the public internet.

The configuration steps are exactly what option A describes: create an OAC, attach it to the distribution origin, and update the S3 bucket policy to grant the CloudFront service principal access (scoped to the distribution ARN). Use an S3 bucket policy to allow the CloudFront service principal (cloudfront.amazonaws.com) to access the bucket. Use a Condition element in the policy to allow CloudFront to access the bucket only when the request is on behalf of the CloudFront distribution that contains the S3 origin.

A typical OAC bucket policy looks like:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": {
    "Sid": "AllowCloudFrontServicePrincipalReadOnly",
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": { "Service": "cloudfront.amazonaws.com" },
    "Action": "s3:GetObject",
    "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET/*",
    "Condition": {
      "StringEquals": {
        "AWS:SourceArn": "arn:aws:cloudfront::111122223333:distribution/EDFDVBD6EXAMPLE"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

> **Note on wording in option A:** Option A says "read and write access." For a purely static site only `s3:GetObject` (read) is technically required, but A is still the only option that correctly describes the OAC mechanism. The other three options are clearly wrong, so A is the intended/best answer despite the imprecise "write" wording.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**B. Block public access + grant CloudFront "write access"** — Blocking public access is correct, but simply giving CloudFront write access is not how restricted access works. There is no principal/identity in the policy (no OAC or OAI) that uniquely identifies CloudFront, and write permission is irrelevant for serving static content. Without OAC/OAI, CloudFront would have no way to authenticate to the private bucket.

**C. Use the S3 static website endpoint** — The S3 website endpoint is a public HTTP endpoint. Before you create and set up origin access control (OAC), you must have a CloudFront distribution with an Amazon S3 bucket origin. This origin must be a regular S3 bucket, not a bucket configured as a website endpoint. Likewise, If the S3 bucket is configured as a static website you can't use OAC or OAI. So this option leaves the bucket publicly reachable directly, violating the requirement.

**D. Custom header + `aws:RequestTag/tag-key` condition** — `aws:RequestTag` is used in IAM/tag-based access control during resource creation; it does not inspect HTTP headers from CloudFront. The legitimate "custom header" pattern (used with custom origins/ALB) relies on a secret header value but cannot be enforced by an S3 bucket policy condition key like `aws:RequestTag`. This approach does not work for S3 origins.

## References
- [Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin (CloudFront Developer Guide)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html)
- [Restrict access to an Amazon S3 bucket with a CloudFront distribution (AWS re:Post)](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/cloudfront-access-to-amazon-s3)
- [Amazon CloudFront introduces Origin Access Control (OAC)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/networking-and-content-delivery/amazon-cloudfront-introduces-origin-access-control-oac/)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在创建一个仅包含静态资源的、可公开访问的企业网站。该网站托管在 Amazon S3 上，并通过 Amazon CloudFront 分发向用户提供服务。用户不得直接从 S3 存储桶访问应用程序内容。所有内容都必须通过 Amazon CloudFront 分发提供。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 CloudFront 中创建一个新的源访问控制 (OAC)。配置 CloudFront 分发的源以使用新的 OAC。更新 S3 存储桶策略，允许具有读写权限的 CloudFront OAC 访问 Amazon S3 作为源。
options.B: 更新 S3 存储桶设置。在 Amazon S3 中启用“阻止所有公共访问”设置。将 CloudFront 分发配置为以 Amazon S3 为源。更新 S3 存储桶策略以允许 CloudFront 写入访问。
options.C: 更新 S3 存储桶的静态网站设置。启用静态网站托管并指定索引和错误文档。更新 CloudFront 源以使用 S3 存储桶的网站端点。
options.D: 更新 CloudFront 分发源以发送自定义标头。使用 aws:RequestTag/tag-key 键更新 S3 存储桶策略的条件。将 tag-key 配置为自定义标头名称，匹配的值即为该标头的值。

zh.explanation:
# 通过 OAC 限制仅 CloudFront 访问 S3

## 场景
一个静态网站托管在 Amazon S3 上，并通过 Amazon CloudFront 提供服务。要求是用户**仅**能通过 CloudFront 分配访问内容 — 必须阻止通过 S3 URL 的直接访问。

## 正确答案：A

AWS 推荐的现代方式，用于锁定 S3 源以使其仅通过特定 CloudFront 分配可访问的做法是**Origin Access Control (OAC)**。Amazon CloudFront 是一个内容分发网络，可以从各种源分发内容，包括 Amazon S3 存储桶。Origin Access Control (OAC) 用于限制对 S3 存储桶的直接访问，确保只有 CloudFront 可以访问内容。当 CloudFront 分配使用 S3 源时，启用 OAC 可确保 CloudFront 是唯一允许的源从 S3 存储桶检索内容，防止来自公网的未授权访问。

配置步骤正是选项 A 所描述的：创建 OAC，将其附加到分配源，并更新 S3 存储桶策略以授予 CloudFront 服务主体访问权限（作用域限定为分配 ARN）。使用 S3 存储桶策略允许 CloudFront 服务主体 (cloudfront.amazonaws.com) 访问存储桶。在策略中使用 Condition 元素，仅当请求代表包含 S3 源的 CloudFront 分配时才允许 CloudFront 访问存储桶。

典型的 OAC 存储桶策略如下所示：

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": {
    "Sid": "AllowCloudFrontServicePrincipalReadOnly",
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": { "Service": "cloudfront.amazonaws.com" },
    "Action": "s3:GetObject",
    "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET/*",
    "Condition": {
      "StringEquals": {
        "AWS:SourceArn": "arn:aws:cloudfront::111122223333:distribution/EDFDVBD6EXAMPLE"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

> **关于选项 A 的措辞说明：** 选项 A 说"读写访问"。对于纯静态网站，技术上仅需 `s3:GetObject`（读）权限，但 A 仍然是唯一正确描述 OAC 机制的选项。其他三个选项显然是错误的，因此 A 是预期的/最佳答案，尽管"写"措辞不够精确。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**B. 阻止公开访问 + 授予 CloudFront"写入访问"** — 阻止公开访问是正确的，但仅授予 CloudFront 写入访问权限并不是如何实现受限访问。策略中没有唯一标识 CloudFront 的主体/身份（没有 OAC 或 OAI），写入权限对于提供静态内容而言是无关的。没有 OAC/OAI，CloudFront 将无法对私有存储桶进行身份验证。

**C. 使用 S3 静态网站端点** — S3 网站端点是一个公开的 HTTP 端点。在创建和设置 Origin Access Control (OAC) 之前，您必须具有带有 Amazon S3 存储桶源的 CloudFront 分配。此源必须是常规 S3 存储桶，而不是配置为网站端点的存储桶。同样，如果 S3 存储桶配置为静态网站，则无法使用 OAC 或 OAI。因此此选项使存储桶直接可公开访问，违反了要求。

**D. 自定义标头 + `aws:RequestTag/tag-key` 条件** — `aws:RequestTag` 用于在资源创建期间的 IAM/基于标签的访问控制中，它不检查来自 CloudFront 的 HTTP 标头。合法的"自定义标头"模式（与自定义源/ALB 一起使用）依赖于秘密标头值，但不能由 S3 存储桶策略条件键（如 `aws:RequestTag`）强制执行。此方法对 S3 源不适用。

## 参考资源
- [Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin (CloudFront Developer Guide)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html)
- [Restrict access to an Amazon S3 bucket with a CloudFront distribution (AWS re:Post)](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/cloudfront-access-to-amazon-s3)
- [Amazon CloudFront introduces Origin Access Control (OAC)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/networking-and-content-delivery/amazon-cloudfront-introduces-origin-access-control-oac/)

en.question: A developer built an application that calls an external API to obtain data, processes the data, and saves the result to Amazon S3. The developer built a container image with all of the necessary dependencies to run the application as a container. The application runs locally and requires minimal CPU and RAM resources. The developer has created an Amazon ECS cluster. The developer needs to run the application hourly in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of infrastructure management overhead?

options.A: Add a capacity provider to manage instances.
options.B: Add an Amazon EC2 instance that runs the application.
options.C: Define a task definition with an AWS Fargate launch type.
options.D: Create an Amazon ECS cluster and add the managed node groups feature to run the application.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer has containerized an application that:
- Runs hourly
- Calls an external API
- Processes data and writes results to S3
- Uses minimal CPU/RAM

The developer already has an ECS cluster and wants to run the container with the **least infrastructure management overhead**.

## Correct Answer: C — Define a task definition with an AWS Fargate launch type

AWS Fargate is the serverless launch type for Amazon ECS. AWS Fargate is a serverless, pay-as-you-go compute engine that lets you focus on building applications without managing servers. Moving tasks such as server management, resource allocation, and scaling to AWS does not only improve your operational posture, but also accelerates the process of going from idea to production on the cloud, and lowers the total cost of ownership.

With Fargate, you don't need to provision or manage any EC2 instances. Instead, you specify the resources (CPU and memory) required by your containers, and AWS takes care of provisioning the necessary infrastructure to run your containers. This perfectly matches the requirement of "least infrastructure management overhead."

Fargate is also explicitly recommended for short, low-resource, batch-style workloads — exactly the hourly job described. Serverless (Fargate) - Pay only for the resources your tasks use without managing any infrastructure. Ideal for variable workloads and getting started quickly.

The hourly schedule can be implemented with an Amazon EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) rule that triggers a Fargate `RunTask` on the predefined task definition.

### Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Add a capacity provider to manage instances.** A capacity provider backed by an EC2 Auto Scaling group still requires you to manage EC2 instances (AMI patching, scaling configuration, instance lifecycle). This adds infrastructure overhead compared to Fargate. While Fargate itself is also offered as a capacity provider, the option specifies "manage instances," indicating EC2-backed capacity. Amazon ECS supports following capacity providers: Fargate and FARGATE_SPOT, Auto Scaling groups for self-managed EC2 instances, and Amazon ECS Managed Instances.

- **B. Add an Amazon EC2 instance that runs the application.** Running a dedicated EC2 instance means the developer must provision, patch, secure, and pay for an instance that sits idle 23 hours a day — the opposite of "least overhead."

- **D. Create an Amazon ECS cluster and add the managed node groups feature to run the application.** "Managed node groups" is an Amazon EKS concept, not ECS — it doesn't apply here. Even if interpreted as managed EC2 nodes, it still implies managing EC2 capacity, which is more overhead than Fargate. Additionally, the cluster already exists per the question.

## References

- [Amazon ECS launch types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/launch_types.html)
- [AWS Fargate](https://aws.amazon.com/fargate/)
- [Amazon ECS task definition parameters for Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task_definition_parameters.html)
- [ECS launch types and capacity providers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/capacity-launch-type-comparison.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员构建了一个应用程序，该应用程序调用外部 API 获取数据、处理数据并将结果保存到 Amazon S3。开发人员构建了一个包含所有必要依赖项的容器镜像，以便以容器形式运行该应用程序。该应用程序在本地运行，仅需极少的 CPU 和内存资源。开发人员创建了一个 Amazon ECS 集群。开发人员需要在 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 中每小时运行一次该应用程序。哪种解决方案能够以最小的基础设施管理开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 添加容量提供程序来管理实例。
options.B: 添加运行该应用程序的 Amazon EC2 实例。
options.C: 定义一个具有 AWS Fargate 启动类型的任务定义。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon ECS 集群，并添加托管节点组功能来运行应用程序。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一位开发者已经将应用程序容器化，该应用程序：
- 每小时运行一次
- 调用外部 API
- 处理数据并将结果写入 S3
- 使用最少的 CPU/RAM

开发者已经拥有一个 ECS 集群，希望以**最少的基础设施管理开销**运行容器。

## 正确答案：C — 使用 AWS Fargate 启动类型定义任务定义

AWS Fargate 是 Amazon ECS 的无服务器启动类型。AWS Fargate 是一个无服务器的按需付费计算引擎，让你可以专注于构建应用程序，而无需管理服务器。将服务器管理、资源分配和扩展等任务转移到 AWS，不仅改进了你的运营态势，还加快了从想法到云上生产的流程，并降低了总体拥有成本。

使用 Fargate，你无需预配置或管理任何 EC2 实例。相反，你指定容器所需的资源（CPU 和内存），AWS 会负责预配置必要的基础设施来运行你的容器。这完美满足了"最少基础设施管理开销"的需求。

Fargate 也明确推荐用于短期、低资源、批处理风格的工作负载——正是所描述的每小时运行的任务。无服务器 (Fargate) - 仅为任务使用的资源付费，无需管理任何基础设施。适合可变工作负载和快速入门。

每小时的计划可以通过 Amazon EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) 规则实现，该规则在预定义的任务定义上触发 Fargate RunTask。

### 为什么其他选项错误

- **A. 添加容量提供程序来管理实例。** 由 EC2 Auto Scaling 组支持的容量提供程序仍需要你管理 EC2 实例（AMI 修补、扩展配置、实例生命周期）。与 Fargate 相比，这增加了基础设施开销。虽然 Fargate 本身也作为容量提供程序提供，但该选项指定"管理实例"，表示 EC2 支持的容量。Amazon ECS 支持以下容量提供程序：Fargate 和 FARGATE_SPOT、用于自管理 EC2 实例的 Auto Scaling 组，以及 Amazon ECS 托管实例。

- **B. 添加运行应用程序的 Amazon EC2 实例。** 运行专用 EC2 实例意味着开发者必须预配置、修补、保护和为一个一天中闲置 23 小时的实例付费——这与"最少开销"的目标相反。

- **D. 创建 Amazon ECS 集群并添加托管节点组功能来运行应用程序。** "托管节点组"是 Amazon EKS 的概念，不适用于 ECS——不在这里适用。即使解释为托管 EC2 节点，它仍然意味着管理 EC2 容量，这比 Fargate 的开销更大。此外，根据问题描述，集群已经存在。

## 参考资源

- [Amazon ECS 启动类型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/launch_types.html)
- [AWS Fargate](https://aws.amazon.com/fargate/)
- [Fargate 的 Amazon ECS 任务定义参数](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task_definition_parameters.html)
- [ECS 启动类型和容量提供程序](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/capacity-launch-type-comparison.html)

en.question: A company runs its website on AWS. The company posts daily polls on its website and publishes the poll results next day. The website stores user responses in an Amazon DynamoDB table. After the poll results are published, the company does not need to keep the user responses. A developer needs to implement a solution that will automatically remove old user responses from the DynamoDB table. The developer adds a new expiration_date attribute to the DynamoDB table. The developer plans to use the expiration_date attribute for the automation. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to delete old user responses based on the expiration_date attribute. Create an Amazon EventBridge schedule to run the Lambda function daily.
options.B: Create an AWS Fargate task in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to delete old user responses based on the expiration_date attribute. Create an Amazon EventBridge schedule to run the Fargate task daily.
options.C: Create an AWS Glue job to delete old user responses based on the expiration_date attribute. Create an AWS Glue trigger schedule to run the job daily.
options.D: Enable TTL on the DynamoDB table and specify the expiration_date attribute. Expire old user responses by using DynamoDB TTL.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The company stores daily poll responses in a DynamoDB table and no longer needs them after the next day's results are published. A new `expiration_date` attribute has been added, and the developer needs to automatically remove old items with **the least development effort**.

## Correct Answer: D — Enable DynamoDB TTL using the `expiration_date` attribute

DynamoDB Time to Live (TTL) is a built-in feature designed exactly for this use case. You can simply specify an attribute containing the timestamp when each item in your table should expire and DynamoDB will delete the items for you automatically. DynamoDB automatically deletes expired items within a few days of their expiration time, without consuming write throughput.

Enabling TTL is a one-time configuration (console, CLI, or `UpdateTimeToLive` API) — no code, no schedules, no compute resources to manage:

```bash
aws dynamodb update-time-to-live \
  --table-name PollResponses \
  --time-to-live-specification "Enabled=true, AttributeName=expiration_date"
```

The `expiration_date` attribute must be a Number in Unix epoch seconds. TTL doesn't incur any additional costs. This is by far the lowest-effort solution.

See [Using time to live (TTL) in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/TTL.html) and [Enable TTL in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/time-to-live-ttl-how-to.html).

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Lambda + EventBridge schedule** — Requires writing, deploying, and maintaining Lambda code that scans/queries the table for items where `expiration_date` is in the past and issues `DeleteItem` calls. It also incurs Lambda invocation costs and consumes provisioned/on-demand RCUs and WCUs for the scan and deletes, unlike TTL deletions which don't consume write throughput. More development effort than TTL.

- **B. Fargate task + EventBridge schedule** — Even more development overhead than option A: you must build a container image, push it to ECR, define an ECS task definition, configure networking (VPC/subnets/security groups), and write the deletion logic. This is the heaviest option in terms of development effort.

- **C. AWS Glue job + Glue trigger schedule** — Glue is an ETL service for analytics workloads (Spark/Python shell jobs over data lakes), not a tool for routinely deleting individual DynamoDB items. You'd have to author a Glue script, configure a connector or use the DynamoDB SDK, and pay DPU-hour charges. Significantly more development effort than enabling a built-in feature.

## Key Takeaway

Whenever a DynamoDB scenario asks for automatic, low-effort expiration of items based on a timestamp attribute, the answer is almost always **DynamoDB TTL**.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行其网站。该公司每天在其网站上发布投票，并在第二天公布投票结果。网站将用户回复存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。投票结果公布后，该公司无需保留用户回复。开发人员需要实现一个解决方案，自动从 DynamoDB 表中删除旧的用户回复。开发人员向 DynamoDB 表添加了一个新的 expiration_date 属性。开发人员计划使用该 expiration_date 属性来实现自动化。哪种解决方案能够以最少的开发工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，根据 expiration_date 属性删除旧的用户回复。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 计划任务，每天运行该 Lambda 函数。
options.B: 在 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 中创建一个 AWS Fargate 任务，用于根据 expiration_date 属性删除旧的用户响应。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 计划任务，使其每天运行一次。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Glue 作业，根据 expiration_date 属性删除旧的用户回复。创建一个 AWS Glue 触发计划，使该作业每天运行。
options.D: 在 DynamoDB 表上启用 TTL（生存时间）并指定 expiration_date 属性。使用 DynamoDB TTL 使旧的用户响应过期。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

该公司将每日民意调查响应存储在 DynamoDB 表中，在下一天的结果发布后就不再需要它们。已添加了新的 `expiration_date` 属性，开发人员需要以**最少的开发工作量**自动移除旧项目。

## 正确答案：D — 使用 `expiration_date` 属性启用 DynamoDB TTL

DynamoDB Time to Live (TTL) 是专为此用例设计的内置功能。您可以简单地指定一个属性，其中包含表中每个项目应过期的时间戳，DynamoDB 将自动为您删除这些项目。DynamoDB 会在项目过期后的几天内自动删除过期项目，而不会消耗写入吞吐量。

启用 TTL 是一次性配置（控制台、CLI 或 `UpdateTimeToLive` API）— 无需代码、无需计划、无需管理计算资源：

```bash
aws dynamodb update-time-to-live \
  --table-name PollResponses \
  --time-to-live-specification "Enabled=true, AttributeName=expiration_date"
```

`expiration_date` 属性必须是 Unix 纪元秒数格式的数字。TTL 不会产生任何额外成本。这是迄今为止工作量最少的解决方案。

请参阅 [Using time to live (TTL) in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/TTL.html) 和 [Enable TTL in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/time-to-live-ttl-how-to.html)。

## 为什么其他选项错误

- **A. Lambda + EventBridge 计划** — 需要编写、部署和维护 Lambda 代码，该代码扫描/查询表中 `expiration_date` 在过去的项目，并发出 `DeleteItem` 调用。它还会产生 Lambda 调用成本，并消耗预配置/按需 RCU 和 WCU 用于扫描和删除，而 TTL 删除不会消耗写入吞吐量。开发工作量比 TTL 多。

- **B. Fargate 任务 + EventBridge 计划** — 开发开销甚至比选项 A 还要多：您必须构建容器镜像、将其推送到 ECR、定义 ECS 任务定义、配置网络（VPC/子网/安全组），并编写删除逻辑。就开发工作量而言，这是最繁重的选项。

- **C. AWS Glue 任务 + Glue 触发器计划** — Glue 是用于分析工作负载（数据湖上的 Spark/Python shell 任务）的 ETL 服务，不是用于例行删除单个 DynamoDB 项目的工具。您必须编写 Glue 脚本、配置连接器或使用 DynamoDB SDK，并支付 DPU 小时费用。开发工作量远远超过启用内置功能。

## 关键要点

每当 DynamoDB 场景询问基于时间戳属性自动、低工作量地使项目过期时，答案几乎总是 **DynamoDB TTL**。

en.question: A developer is creating a simple proof-of-concept demo by using AWS CloudFormation and AWS Lambda functions. The demo will use a CloudFormation template to deploy an existing Lambda function. The Lambda function uses deployment packages and dependencies stored in Amazon S3. The developer defined an AWS::Lambda::Function resource in a CloudFormation template. The developer needs to add the S3 bucket to the CloudFormation template. What should the developer do to meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Add the function code in the CloudFormation template inline as the code property.
options.B: Add the function code in the CloudFormation template as the ZipFile property.
options.C: Find the S3 key for the Lambda function. Add the S3 key as the ZipFile property in the CloudFormation template.
options.D: Add the relevant key and bucket to the S3Bucket and S3Key properties in the CloudFormation template.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer is building a CloudFormation template to deploy an **existing** Lambda function whose deployment package (`.zip` with code and dependencies) is **already stored in S3**. The developer has defined an `AWS::Lambda::Function` resource and now needs to point that resource at the existing S3 deployment package with the **least development effort**.

## Correct Answer: D — Use the `S3Bucket` and `S3Key` properties of the `Code` property

The `Code` property of `AWS::Lambda::Function` accepts the location of the deployment package. For .zip deployment packages, you can specify the Amazon S3 location of the .zip file in the S3Bucket, S3Key, and S3ObjectVersion properties. Because the zip already exists in S3, simply referencing it via `S3Bucket`/`S3Key` requires no code changes, no inlining, and no repackaging — the minimum development effort.

Example template snippet:

```yaml
Resources:
  Function:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/lambda-role
      Runtime: nodejs20.x
      Code:
        S3Bucket: my-lambda-bucket
        S3Key: path/to/function.zip
```

This is exactly the canonical pattern shown in the AWS documentation for `AWS::Lambda::Function`.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. Add the function code inline as the `code` property.** There is no `code` (lowercase) property; the property is `Code`, and inlining requires the `ZipFile` sub-property. More importantly, the package and its dependencies already exist in S3, so rewriting the code inline is unnecessary work — the opposite of "least effort." Inline code also cannot include external dependency files, only Node.js/Python source.
- **B. Add the function code as the `ZipFile` property.** For .zip deployment packages, you can alternatively define the function code inline in the ZipFile property. This method works only for Node.js and Python functions. ZipFile only accepts inline source code, not a reference to a pre-built package, and it cannot carry external dependencies — forcing the developer to rewrite code that already exists.
- **C. Put the S3 key in the `ZipFile` property.** This is a misuse of the property. `ZipFile` expects literal source code, not an S3 object key. CloudFormation would treat the key string as the function source and the deployment would fail or produce a broken function.

## References

- [AWS::Lambda::Function (CloudFormation)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-resource-lambda-function.html)
- [AWS::Lambda::Function Code property](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-properties-lambda-function-code.html)
- [Deploying AWS Lambda functions using AWS CloudFormation (the portable way)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/infrastructure-and-automation/deploying-aws-lambda-functions-using-aws-cloudformation-the-portable-way/)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在使用 AWS CloudFormation 和 AWS Lambda 函数创建一个简单的概念验证演示。该演示将使用 CloudFormation 模板部署一个现有的 Lambda 函数。该 Lambda 函数使用存储在 Amazon S3 中的部署包和依赖项。开发人员在 CloudFormation 模板中定义了一个 AWS::Lambda::Function 资源。开发人员需要将 S3 存储桶添加到 CloudFormation 模板中。为了以最小的开发工作量满足这些要求，开发人员应该怎么做？

options.A: 将函数代码作为 code 属性以内联方式添加到 CloudFormation 模板中。
options.B: 将函数代码作为 ZipFile 属性添加到 CloudFormation 模板中。
options.C: 找到 Lambda 函数的 S3 密钥。将 S3 密钥作为 ZipFile 属性添加到 CloudFormation 模板中。
options.D: 将相关的密钥和存储桶添加到 CloudFormation 模板中的 S3Bucket 和 S3Key 属性。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一名开发人员正在构建 CloudFormation 模板来部署一个**已存在**的 Lambda 函数，该函数的部署程序包（包含代码和依赖项的 `.zip` 文件）**已经存储在 S3 中**。开发人员已定义了 `AWS::Lambda::Function` 资源，现在需要将该资源指向现有的 S3 部署程序包，并且需要**最少的开发工作量**。

## 正确答案：D — 使用 `Code` 属性的 `S3Bucket` 和 `S3Key` 属性

`AWS::Lambda::Function` 的 `Code` 属性接受部署程序包的位置。对于 .zip 部署程序包，您可以在 S3Bucket、S3Key 和 S3ObjectVersion 属性中指定 .zip 文件的 Amazon S3 位置。由于 zip 文件已存在于 S3 中，只需通过 `S3Bucket`/`S3Key` 引用它，不需要修改代码、内联代码或重新打包 — 这是最少的开发工作量。

示例模板片段：

```yaml
Resources:
  Function:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/lambda-role
      Runtime: nodejs20.x
      Code:
        S3Bucket: my-lambda-bucket
        S3Key: path/to/function.zip
```

这正是 AWS 文档中 `AWS::Lambda::Function` 所示的规范模式。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. 将函数代码作为 `code` 属性内联添加。** 没有 `code`（小写）属性；属性是 `Code`，内联需要使用 `ZipFile` 子属性。更重要的是，程序包及其依赖项已经存在于 S3 中，所以将代码重写为内联是不必要的工作 — 这与"最少工作量"的目标相反。内联代码也无法包含外部依赖文件，只能包含 Node.js/Python 源代码。
- **B. 将函数代码作为 `ZipFile` 属性添加。** 对于 .zip 部署程序包，您可以在 ZipFile 属性中内联定义函数代码。此方法仅适用于 Node.js 和 Python 函数。ZipFile 只接受内联源代码，不接受对预构建程序包的引用，且无法包含外部依赖 — 这会迫使开发人员重写已经存在的代码。
- **C. 将 S3 密钥放在 `ZipFile` 属性中。** 这是对该属性的误用。`ZipFile` 需要的是字面源代码，而不是 S3 对象密钥。CloudFormation 会将密钥字符串视为函数源代码，部署将失败或产生损坏的函数。

## 参考资源

- [AWS::Lambda::Function (CloudFormation)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-resource-lambda-function.html)
- [AWS::Lambda::Function Code 属性](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-properties-lambda-function-code.html)
- [使用 AWS CloudFormation 部署 AWS Lambda 函数（可移植的方式）](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/infrastructure-and-automation/deploying-aws-lambda-functions-using-aws-cloudformation-the-portable-way/)

en.question: A developer is building a microservices-based application by using Python on AWS and several AWS services. The developer must use AWS X-Ray. The developer views the service map by using the console to view the service dependencies. During testing, the developer notices that some services are missing from the service map. What can the developer do to ensure that all services appear in the X-Ray service map?

options.A: Modify the X-Ray Python agent configuration in each service to increase the sampling rate.
options.B: Instrument the application by using the X-Ray SDK for Python. Install the X-Ray SDK for all the services that the application uses.
options.C: Enable X-Ray data aggregation in Amazon CloudWatch Logs for all the services that the application uses.
options.D: Increase the X-Ray service map timeout value in the X-Ray console.

en.explanation:
# X-Ray Service Map – Missing Services

## Scenario
A developer building a Python microservices application uses AWS X-Ray and views the service map in the console. Some services are missing from the map. The developer needs to make all services appear.

## Why services are missing
The X-Ray service map is built from trace **segments** that each service sends to X-Ray. If a service is not instrumented (no SDK installed, no middleware patched, no AWS SDK clients patched), it will not emit segments and therefore will not appear as a node in the service map. X-Ray receives traces from your application in addition to AWS services already integrated with X-Ray, and instrumenting your application involves sending trace data for incoming and outbound requests and other events within your application.

## Correct answer: B – Instrument the application by using the X-Ray SDK for Python and install the SDK in all services

The X-Ray SDK for Python is a library for Python web applications that provides classes and methods for generating and sending trace data to the X-Ray daemon, including information about incoming HTTP requests served by the application and calls that the application makes to downstream services using the AWS SDK, HTTP clients, or an SQL database connector.

When your application makes calls to microservices or public HTTP APIs, you can use the X-Ray SDK for Python to instrument those calls and add the API to the service graph as a downstream service; to instrument HTTP clients, patch the library you use to make outgoing calls.

So, installing and using the X-Ray SDK in each Python microservice (adding middleware for incoming requests, calling `patch_all()` for AWS SDK/HTTP/SQL clients) will cause every service to emit segments and show up as nodes on the service map.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. Increase the sampling rate.** Sampling controls *how many* requests are recorded, not whether a service produces traces at all. The SDK uses sampling rules you define in the X-Ray console to determine which requests to record; the default rule traces the first request each second and 5% of any additional requests. If a service is not instrumented, it sends zero segments regardless of sampling rate, so the node will still be missing.

- **C. Enable X-Ray data aggregation in CloudWatch Logs.** This is not a real X-Ray feature. X-Ray segments travel from the SDK to the X-Ray daemon (UDP) and on to the X-Ray service, not via CloudWatch Logs. Instead of sending trace data directly to X-Ray, each client SDK sends JSON segment documents to a daemon process listening for UDP traffic, and the X-Ray daemon buffers segments in a queue and uploads them to X-Ray in batches.

- **D. Increase the X-Ray service map timeout in the console.** There is no "service map timeout" setting in the X-Ray console. The service map is rendered from the segments X-Ray has received; missing nodes mean missing trace data, which only instrumentation can solve.

## Key takeaway
For every microservice you want to see in the X-Ray service map, you must instrument that service (install the X-Ray SDK for Python, add middleware for incoming requests, and patch downstream client libraries such as `botocore`, `requests`, and database connectors).

## References
- [AWS X-Ray SDK for Python](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-sdk-python.html)
- [Tracing AWS SDK calls with the X-Ray SDK for Python](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-sdk-python-awssdkclients.html)
- [Tracing calls to downstream HTTP web services using the X-Ray SDK for Python](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-sdk-python-httpclients.html)
- [What is AWS X-Ray?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/aws-xray.html)
- [Configuring the X-Ray SDK for Python](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-sdk-python-configuration.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在使用 Python 在 AWS 上构建一个基于微服务的应用程序，并使用了多个 AWS 服务。该开发人员必须使用 AWS X-Ray。开发人员通过控制台查看服务依赖关系，从而查看服务映射。在测试过程中，开发人员发现服务映射中缺少一些服务。开发人员应该如何做才能确保所有服务都显示在 X-Ray 服务映射中？

options.A: 修改每个服务中的 X-Ray Python 代理配置，以提高采样率。
options.B: 使用适用于 Python 的 X-Ray SDK 对应用程序进行检测。为应用程序使用的所有服务安装 X-Ray SDK。
options.C: 在 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中为应用程序使用的所有服务启用 X-Ray 数据聚合。
options.D: 增加 X-Ray 控制台中的 X-Ray 服务映射超时值。

zh.explanation:
# X-Ray 服务地图 – 缺失服务

## 场景
开发人员在构建 Python 微服务应用程序时使用 AWS X-Ray 并在控制台中查看服务地图。服务地图中缺少某些服务。开发人员需要让所有服务都显示在地图上。

## 为什么服务缺失
X-Ray 服务地图是由每个服务发送给 X-Ray 的跟踪**段**构建的。如果某个服务未进行分析（未安装 SDK、未修补中间件、未修补 AWS SDK 客户端），它将不会发出段，因此不会作为节点出现在服务地图中。X-Ray 从您的应用程序接收跟踪，以及已经与 X-Ray 集成的 AWS 服务，对应用程序进行分析涉及为传入和传出请求以及应用程序内的其他事件发送跟踪数据。

## 正确答案：B – 使用 X-Ray SDK for Python 对应用程序进行分析，并在所有服务中安装 SDK

X-Ray SDK for Python 是一个适用于 Python Web 应用程序的库，提供用于生成跟踪数据并将其发送到 X-Ray 守护程序的类和方法，包括有关应用程序提供的传入 HTTP 请求的信息以及应用程序使用 AWS SDK、HTTP 客户端或 SQL 数据库连接器对下游服务进行的调用。

当应用程序调用微服务或公共 HTTP API 时，您可以使用 X-Ray SDK for Python 对这些调用进行分析，并将 API 添加到服务图作为下游服务；要对 HTTP 客户端进行分析，请修补用于进行传出调用的库。

因此，在每个 Python 微服务中安装和使用 X-Ray SDK（为传入请求添加中间件，为 AWS SDK/HTTP/SQL 客户端调用 `patch_all()`）将导致每个服务发出段并显示为服务地图上的节点。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **A. 增加采样率。** 采样控制的是*记录多少*请求，而不是服务是否完全产生跟踪。SDK 使用您在 X-Ray 控制台中定义的采样规则来确定要记录哪些请求；默认规则跟踪每秒的第一个请求和任何其他请求的 5%。如果某个服务未进行分析，无论采样率如何，它都会发送零个段，所以节点仍然会缺失。

- **C. 在 CloudWatch Logs 中启用 X-Ray 数据聚合。** 这不是真实的 X-Ray 功能。X-Ray 段从 SDK 传输到 X-Ray 守护程序（UDP），然后传输到 X-Ray 服务，不会通过 CloudWatch Logs。每个客户端 SDK 不是直接将跟踪数据发送到 X-Ray，而是将 JSON 段文档发送到侦听 UDP 流量的守护程序进程，X-Ray 守护程序将段缓冲在队列中并分批上传到 X-Ray。

- **D. 在控制台中增加 X-Ray 服务地图超时。** X-Ray 控制台中没有"服务地图超时"设置。服务地图是从 X-Ray 收到的段渲染的；缺失的节点意味着缺失的跟踪数据，只有分析才能解决。

## 关键要点
对于您想在 X-Ray 服务地图中看到的每个微服务，您都必须对该服务进行分析（安装 X-Ray SDK for Python、为传入请求添加中间件，以及修补下游客户端库，如 `botocore`、`requests` 和数据库连接器）。

## 参考资源
- [AWS X-Ray SDK for Python](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-sdk-python.html)
- [Tracing AWS SDK calls with the X-Ray SDK for Python](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-sdk-python-awssdkclients.html)
- [Tracing calls to downstream HTTP web services using the X-Ray SDK for Python](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-sdk-python-httpclients.html)
- [What is AWS X-Ray?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/aws-xray.html)
- [Configuring the X-Ray SDK for Python](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-sdk-python-configuration.html)

en.question: A developer is building a containerized application on AWS. The application communicates with a third- party service by using API keys. The developer needs a secure way to store the API keys and pass the API keys to the containerized application. Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Store the API keys as a SecureString parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Grant the application access to retrieve the value from Parameter Store.
options.B: Store the API keys in AWS CloudFormation templates by using base64 encoding. Pass the API keys to the application through container definition environment variables.
options.C: Add a new AWS CloudFormation parameter to the CloudFormation template. Pass the API keys to the application by using the container definition environment variables.
options.D: Embed the API keys in the application. Build the container image on-premises. Upload the container image to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR).
options.E: Store the API keys as a SecretString parameter in AWS Secrets Manager. Grant the application access to retrieve the value from Secrets Manager.

en.explanation:
# Securely Storing API Keys for a Containerized Application

## Scenario
A developer needs to **store API keys securely** and **pass them to a containerized application** running on AWS. The key requirements are:
1. Secure storage (encrypted at rest)
2. Secure delivery to the container at runtime
3. Access controlled via IAM

## Correct Answers: A and E

Both AWS Secrets Manager and AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store (SecureString) are the AWS-recommended services for storing secrets such as API keys. You should securely store API keys, database credentials, and other secret materials in Secrets Manager or as an encrypted parameter in Systems Manager Parameter Store. These services are similar because they're both managed key-value stores that use AWS KMS to encrypt sensitive data.

### A. Parameter Store SecureString — ✅ Correct
A SecureString parameter is encrypted with AWS KMS. The container's task role (or application IAM role) can be granted `ssm:GetParameters` permission to retrieve the value. ECS task definitions can also natively reference Parameter Store ARNs in the `secrets` block to inject the value at runtime, avoiding plaintext environment variables. See [Pass sensitive data to an Amazon ECS container](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/specifying-sensitive-data.html).

### E. Secrets Manager SecretString — ✅ Correct
Secrets Manager also includes the ability to automatically rotate secrets, generate random secrets, and share secrets across accounts. To utilize these features, use Secrets Manager. The container is granted `secretsmanager:GetSecretValue` (and `kms:Decrypt`) permission to retrieve the value securely. See [AWS Secrets Manager User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html).

```json
"secrets": [
  {
    "name": "THIRD_PARTY_API_KEY",
    "valueFrom": "arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:123456789012:secret:prod/api-key"
  }
]
```

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

### B. Base64-encoded API keys in CloudFormation templates ❌
Base64 is **encoding, not encryption**. Anyone who can read the CloudFormation template (in the repo, in the CloudFormation console, or via `GetTemplate`) can trivially decode the keys. CloudFormation templates are stored in plaintext, so this exposes the secret. Additionally, secrets stored in environment variables are easily leaked and unencrypted as secrets are visible in docker inspect.

### C. CloudFormation parameter passed via container env vars ❌
A standard CloudFormation parameter (even `NoEcho`) is not designed to be a secret store: the value is passed in plaintext to resources and shows up in environment variables visible via `docker inspect`. The proper pattern is `{{resolve:secretsmanager:...}}` or `{{resolve:ssm-secure:...}}` references — not a raw parameter. See [Using dynamic references in CloudFormation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/dynamic-references.html).

### D. Embedding API keys in the application image ❌
This is an explicit anti-pattern. Building secrets into the container image means secrets are unencrypted and can be leaked easily via build cache or image sharing. Anyone who pulls the image from ECR (or extracts its layers) can read the keys. ECR image scanning, image promotion, and registry replication can all spread the secret further.

## Key Takeaway
For containerized workloads on AWS, always store API keys in **Secrets Manager** or **Parameter Store SecureString**, and grant the container's IAM role permission to retrieve them at runtime. It's highly recommended to use AWS Secrets Manager or Amazon EC2 Systems Manager Parameter Store for storing secret materials such as API keys, database credentials, and other sensitive information.

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在 AWS 上构建一个容器化应用程序。该应用程序使用 API 密钥与第三方服务通信。开发人员需要一种安全的方式来存储 API 密钥，并将 API 密钥传递给容器化应用程序。哪些解决方案可以满足这些要求？（选择两个。）

options.A: 将 API 密钥作为 SecureString 参数存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。授予应用程序访问权限，使其能够从 Parameter Store 中检索该值。
options.B: 使用 base64 编码将 API 密钥存储在 AWS CloudFormation 模板中。通过容器定义环境变量将 API 密钥传递给应用程序。
options.C: 向 CloudFormation 模板添加一个新的 AWS CloudFormation 参数。使用容器定义环境变量将 API 密钥传递给应用程序。
options.D: 将 API 密钥嵌入到应用程序中。在本地构建容器镜像。将容器镜像上传到 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR)。
options.E: 将 API 密钥作为 SecretString 参数存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。授予应用程序访问权限，使其能够从 Secrets Manager 中检索该值。

zh.explanation:
# 为容器化应用程序安全存储 API 密钥

## 场景
开发人员需要**安全地存储 API 密钥**并**在运行时将其传递到 AWS 上的容器化应用程序**。关键要求是：
1. 安全存储（静态加密）
2. 在运行时安全交付到容器
3. 通过 IAM 控制访问

## 正确答案：A 和 E

AWS Secrets Manager 和 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store (SecureString) 都是 AWS 推荐的用于存储 API 密钥等机密的服务。您应该在 Secrets Manager 中安全地存储 API 密钥、数据库凭证和其他机密材料，或作为 Systems Manager Parameter Store 中的加密参数。这些服务很相似，因为它们都是托管的键值存储，使用 AWS KMS 来加密敏感数据。

### A. Parameter Store SecureString — ✅ 正确
SecureString 参数使用 AWS KMS 加密。容器的任务角色（或应用程序 IAM 角色）可以被授予 `ssm:GetParameters` 权限以检索该值。ECS 任务定义还可以在 `secrets` 块中以本地方式引用 Parameter Store ARN，在运行时注入该值，避免使用明文环境变量。请参阅 [将敏感数据传递到 Amazon ECS 容器](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/specifying-sensitive-data.html)。

### E. Secrets Manager SecretString — ✅ 正确
Secrets Manager 还包括自动轮换机密、生成随机机密和跨账户共享机密的功能。要使用这些功能，请使用 Secrets Manager。容器被授予 `secretsmanager:GetSecretValue`（和 `kms:Decrypt`）权限以安全地检索该值。请参阅 [AWS Secrets Manager 用户指南](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)。

```json
"secrets": [
  {
    "name": "THIRD_PARTY_API_KEY",
    "valueFrom": "arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:123456789012:secret:prod/api-key"
  }
]
```

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

### B. CloudFormation 模板中的 Base64 编码的 API 密钥 ❌
Base64 是**编码，不是加密**。任何能够读取 CloudFormation 模板的人（在仓库中、CloudFormation 控制台中或通过 `GetTemplate`）都可以轻松解码密钥。CloudFormation 模板以明文形式存储，因此这会暴露机密。此外，存储在环境变量中的机密很容易泄露且未加密，因为机密在 docker inspect 中可见。

### C. 通过容器环境变量传递的 CloudFormation 参数 ❌
标准 CloudFormation 参数（即使是 `NoEcho`）不是为成为机密存储而设计的：该值以明文形式传递到资源，并在通过 `docker inspect` 可见的环境变量中显示。正确的模式是 `{{resolve:secretsmanager:...}}` 或 `{{resolve:ssm-secure:...}}` 引用——而不是原始参数。请参阅 [在 CloudFormation 中使用动态引用](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/dynamic-references.html)。

### D. 将 API 密钥嵌入应用程序镜像 ❌
这是明确的反模式。将机密构建到容器镜像中意味着机密未加密，可以通过构建缓存或镜像共享轻松泄露。任何从 ECR 拉取镜像的人（或提取其层）都可以读取密钥。ECR 镜像扫描、镜像推广和注册表复制都可能进一步传播机密。

## 关键要点
对于 AWS 上的容器化工作负载，始终在 **Secrets Manager** 或 **Parameter Store SecureString** 中存储 API 密钥，并授予容器的 IAM 角色在运行时检索它们的权限。强烈建议使用 AWS Secrets Manager 或 Amazon EC2 Systems Manager Parameter Store 来存储机密材料，例如 API 密钥、数据库凭证和其他敏感信息。

en.question: A company runs an application on AWS. The application stores data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Some queries are taking a long time to run. These slow queries involve an attribute that is not the table's partition key or sort key. The amount of data that the application stores in the DynamoDB table is expected to increase significantly. A developer must increase the performance of the queries. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Increase the page size for each request by setting the Limit parameter to be higher than the default value. Configure the application to retry any request that exceeds the provisioned throughput.
options.B: Create a global secondary index (GSI). Set query attribute to be the partition key of the index.
options.C: Perform a parallel scan operation by issuing individual scan requests. In the parameters, specify the segment for the scan requests and the total number of segments for the parallel scan.
options.D: Turn on read capacity auto scaling for the DynamoDB table. Increase the maximum read capacity units (RCUs).

en.explanation:
# DynamoDB Performance for Non-Key Attribute Queries

## Scenario
The application stores data in DynamoDB, and slow queries involve **an attribute that is not the table's partition key or sort key**. Data volume will grow significantly. The developer needs to make these queries faster.

In DynamoDB, the `Query` operation can only be performed efficiently against a partition key (and optionally a sort key). Querying on non-key attributes requires either a `Scan` with a `FilterExpression` (which reads the entire table and is expensive/slow) or a secondary index that promotes the attribute to a key.

## Correct Answer: B — Create a Global Secondary Index (GSI)

A GSI lets you define a different partition key (and optional sort key) on an attribute that is not part of the base table's primary key. Amazon DynamoDB provides fast access to items in a table by specifying primary key values. However, many applications might benefit from having one or more secondary (or alternate) keys available, to allow efficient access to data with attributes other than the primary key. To address this, you can create one or more secondary indexes on a table and issue Query or Scan requests against these indexes.

It is not necessary for either of these key attributes to be the same as a key attribute in the table. For example, in the GameScores table, neither TopScore nor TopScoreDateTime are key attributes. You could create a global secondary index with a partition key of TopScore and a sort key of TopScoreDateTime.

By making the slow-query attribute the **partition key of the GSI**, the application can issue a `Query` (instead of a Scan), making lookup time independent of table size — ideal as data grows significantly.

See: [Using Global Secondary Indexes in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GSI.html) and [Improving data access with secondary indexes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/SecondaryIndexes.html).

## Why the other options are wrong

### A. Increase Limit and retry on throughput exceeded
The `Limit` parameter in Query/Scan controls how many items are evaluated **per request page**, not the speed of the underlying operation. Raising it does not change the fact that finding items by a non-key attribute still requires a Scan or filter. Retrying on `ProvisionedThroughputExceededException` is good practice but doesn't solve the fundamental access-pattern problem. As data grows, this approach gets worse, not better.

### C. Parallel Scan
Parallel Scan splits a Scan into segments processed concurrently. While it can finish a full table scan faster, **a Scan still reads every item in the table** and applies a filter afterward. It consumes large amounts of RCU and **gets slower and more expensive as the table grows** — exactly the opposite of what's needed here. As one source notes, any large scale service handling data at this size will quickly create a bottleneck if it attempts to retrieve items using a Scan, and it will only get worse as the size of your table increases. If you don't actually require every item in the table, it is more scalable to run a Query on a GSI.

### D. Auto-scale RCUs / increase max RCUs
Adding read capacity addresses **throttling**, not query efficiency. The query still has to scan the entire table to filter by a non-key attribute, so each query consumes proportionally more RCUs as data grows. This is more expensive and does not scale architecturally — a GSI is the correct, cost-efficient design fix.

## Key takeaway
When you need to query DynamoDB by an attribute that is not the table's primary key, the canonical solution is to create a **GSI** with that attribute as the partition key, then `Query` the index.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行一个应用程序。该应用程序将数据存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。某些查询运行时间过长。这些慢查询涉及的属性并非表的分区键或排序键。预计应用程序在 DynamoDB 表中存储的数据量将显著增加。开发人员必须提高查询性能。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 通过将 Limit 参数设置为高于默认值的值来增加每个请求的页面大小。配置应用程序以重试任何超出预置吞吐量的请求。
options.B: 创建全局二级索引（GSI）。将查询属性设置为索引的分区键。
options.C: 通过发出单独的扫描请求来执行并行扫描操作。在参数中，指定扫描请求的段以及并行扫描的总段数。
options.D: 为 DynamoDB 表启用读取容量自动扩展。增加最大读取容量单位 (RCU)。

zh.explanation:
# DynamoDB 非键属性查询的性能优化

## 场景
应用程序在 DynamoDB 中存储数据，慢查询涉及**不是表分区键或排序键的属性**。数据量将显著增长。开发者需要加快这些查询的速度。

在 DynamoDB 中，`Query` 操作只能针对分区键（以及可选的排序键）高效执行。对非键属性的查询需要使用带 `FilterExpression` 的 `Scan`（读取整个表，成本高且速度慢）或使用将该属性提升为键的辅助索引。

## 正确答案：B — 创建全局辅助索引 (GSI)

GSI 允许您在不是基表主键的属性上定义不同的分区键（以及可选的排序键）。Amazon DynamoDB 通过指定主键值来快速访问表中的项。但是，许多应用程序可能受益于有一个或多个辅助（或备用）键可用，以允许使用主键之外的属性高效访问数据。为了解决这个问题，您可以在表上创建一个或多个辅助索引，并对这些索引发出 Query 或 Scan 请求。

这两个键属性中的任何一个都不必与表中的键属性相同。例如，在 GameScores 表中，TopScore 和 TopScoreDateTime 都不是键属性。您可以创建一个全局辅助索引，其分区键为 TopScore，排序键为 TopScoreDateTime。

通过将慢查询属性设为 **GSI 的分区键**，应用程序可以发出 `Query`（而不是 Scan），使查找时间与表大小无关——随着数据显著增长，这是理想的方案。

参见：[在 DynamoDB 中使用全局辅助索引](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GSI.html)和[使用辅助索引改进数据访问](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/SecondaryIndexes.html)。

## 其他选项为什么错误

### A. 增加 Limit 并在超出吞吐量时重试
Query/Scan 中的 `Limit` 参数控制每个请求页面**评估的项数**，而不是底层操作的速度。提高它不会改变按非键属性查找项仍然需要 Scan 或过滤的事实。在 `ProvisionedThroughputExceededException` 时重试是很好的做法，但不能解决根本的访问模式问题。随着数据增长，这种方法会变得更糟，而不是更好。

### C. 并行 Scan
并行 Scan 将 Scan 拆分成并发处理的段。虽然它可以更快地完成完整表扫描，但**Scan 仍然读取表中的每一项**并在之后应用过滤。它消耗大量 RCU，并且**随着表增长会变得更慢且更昂贵**——这正好与这里的需求相反。正如一个来源所指出的那样，任何处理此规模数据的大规模服务，如果尝试使用 Scan 检索项，将很快产生瓶颈，并且随着表大小的增加只会变得更糟。如果您实际上不需要表中的每一项，那么对 GSI 运行 Query 会更具可扩展性。

### D. 自动扩展 RCU / 增加最大 RCU
添加读取容量解决的是**限流**，而不是查询效率。查询仍然必须扫描整个表以按非键属性过滤，因此随着数据增长，每个查询消耗的 RCU 成比例增加。这更昂贵，在架构上无法扩展——GSI 是正确的、成本高效的设计修复。

## 关键要点
当您需要按不是表主键的属性查询 DynamoDB 时，规范的解决方案是创建以该属性作为分区键的 **GSI**，然后对索引执行 `Query`。

en.question: A company runs a payment application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balance. The EC2 instances run in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. The application needs to retrieve application secrets during the application startup and export the secrets as environment variables. These secrets must be encrypted at rest and need to be rotated every month. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Save the secrets in a text file and store the text file in Amazon S3. Provision a customer managed key. Use the key for secret encryption in Amazon S3. Read the contents of the text file and read the export as environment variables. Configure S3 Object Lambda to rotate the text file every month.
options.B: Save the secrets as strings in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store and use the default AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Configure an Amazon EC2 user data script to retrieve the secrets during the startup and export as environment variables. Configure an AWS Lambda function to rotate the secrets in Parameter Store every month.
options.C: Save the secrets as base64 encoded environment variables in the application properties. Retrieve the secrets during the application startup. Reference the secrets in the application code. Write a script to rotate the secrets saved as environment variables.
options.D: Store the secrets in AWS Secrets Manager. Provision a new customer master key. Use the key to encrypt the secrets. Enable automatic rotation. Configure an Amazon EC2 user data script to programmatically retrieve the secrets during the startup and export as environment variables.

en.explanation:
# Secret Storage and Rotation for EC2 Payment Application

## Scenario
A payment application running on EC2 instances behind an ALB (in an Auto Scaling group) needs to:
1. Retrieve secrets at startup and export them as environment variables
2. Encrypt secrets at rest
3. Rotate secrets every month
4. Use the **least development effort**

## Correct Answer: D

**Store the secrets in AWS Secrets Manager, use a customer managed KMS key, enable automatic rotation, and use EC2 user data to retrieve secrets at startup.**

AWS Secrets Manager is purpose-built for this exact use case:

- **Encryption at rest**: Every secret is encrypted at rest with a KMS key. By default that key is the AWS-managed aws/secretsmanager key, but for production workloads with compliance requirements, you can bring your own customer-managed KMS key so the key policy becomes a second audit layer on top of the resource policy.
- **Built-in automatic rotation**: In Secrets Manager, you can set up automatic rotation for your secrets. For most managed secrets, you use managed rotation, where the service configures and manages rotation for you. Managed rotation doesn't use a Lambda function. You can configure Secrets Manager to rotate secrets automatically, which can help you meet your security and compliance needs.
- **Retrieval at startup**: An EC2 user data script can call `aws secretsmanager get-secret-value` and export the result as environment variables — minimal code to write.

Example user data script:
```bash
#!/bin/bash
SECRET=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
  --secret-id payment-app-secret \
  --query SecretString --output text)
export DB_PASSWORD=$SECRET
```

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

### A. S3 + customer managed KMS + S3 Object Lambda for rotation
- **S3 Object Lambda does not rotate secrets** — it transforms data on `GetObject` calls. It is not a scheduled rotation mechanism, so this option doesn't actually meet the rotation requirement.
- Storing plaintext secrets in a text file in S3 (even encrypted at rest) is a poor security pattern compared to a purpose-built secret store.
- Significantly more development effort to build a custom rotation pipeline.

### B. Systems Manager Parameter Store + custom Lambda rotation
- Parameter Store **does not have native automatic rotation built in for arbitrary secrets** — you must write, deploy, schedule (EventBridge), and maintain a custom Lambda function. You can extend Secrets Manager to meet your custom rotation requirements by creating an AWS Lambda function to rotate other types of secrets, but in Parameter Store you'd have to build everything yourself.
- This is **more development effort**, which directly violates the "LEAST development effort" requirement.
- Note: while the Advanced tier of Parameter Store supports a `policies` field for expiration/notification, true rotation is not a native Parameter Store feature.

### C. Base64-encoded secrets in application properties + custom rotation script
- Base64 is **encoding, not encryption** — fails the "encrypted at rest" requirement.
- Embedding secrets directly in application properties is an anti-pattern (secrets end up in source control, AMIs, logs).
- Requires writing a custom rotation script and a redeployment process — high development effort.

## Key AWS Documentation
- [AWS Secrets Manager – Rotate secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)
- [Secret encryption and decryption in AWS Secrets Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/security-encryption.html)
- [Set up automatic rotation for non-database secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotate-secrets_turn-on-for-other.html)

zh.question: 一家公司在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行支付应用程序，这些实例位于应用程序负载均衡器 (APP) 之后。这些 EC2 实例运行在跨多个可用区的自动扩展组中。该应用程序需要在启动时检索应用程序密钥，并将这些密钥导出为环境变量。这些密钥必须静态加密，并且需要每月轮换一次。哪种解决方案能够以最少的开发工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 将密钥保存到文本文件中，并将该文本文件存储在 Amazon S3 中。配置一个客户管理的密钥。使用该密钥对 Amazon S3 中的密钥进行加密。读取文本文件的内容，并将导出的内容保存为环境变量。配置 S3 Object Lambda 函数，使其每月轮换一次该文本文件。
options.B: 将密钥以字符串形式保存在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中，并使用默认的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 密钥。配置一个 Amazon EC2 用户数据脚本，以便在启动时检索密钥并将其导出为环境变量。配置一个 AWS Lambda 函数，每月轮换一次 Parameter Store 中的密钥。
options.C: 将密钥以 base64 编码的环境变量形式保存在应用程序属性中。在应用程序启动时检索这些密钥。在应用程序代码中引用这些密钥。编写一个脚本来轮换保存为环境变量的密钥。
options.D: 将密钥存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。配置一个新的客户主密钥。使用该密钥加密密钥。启用自动轮换。配置 Amazon EC2 用户数据脚本，以便在启动期间以编程方式检索密钥并将其导出为环境变量。

zh.explanation:
# EC2 支付应用的密钥存储和轮换

## 场景
运行在 ALB 后面（在 Auto Scaling 组中）的 EC2 实例上的支付应用需要：
1. 在启动时检索密钥并将其导出为环境变量
2. 加密静态密钥
3. 每月轮换密钥
4. 使用**最少的开发工作量**

## 正确答案：D

**将密钥存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中，使用客户管理的 KMS 密钥，启用自动轮换，并使用 EC2 用户数据在启动时检索密钥。**

AWS Secrets Manager 是为这种确切用例设计的：

- **静态加密**：每个密钥都使用 KMS 密钥进行静态加密。默认情况下，该密钥是 AWS 管理的 aws/secretsmanager 密钥，但对于具有合规性要求的生产工作负载，您可以自带客户管理的 KMS 密钥，以便密钥策略成为资源策略之上的第二个审计层。
- **内置自动轮换**：在 Secrets Manager 中，您可以为密钥设置自动轮换。对于大多数托管密钥，您使用托管轮换，其中服务为您配置和管理轮换。托管轮换不使用 Lambda 函数。 您可以配置 Secrets Manager 自动轮换密钥，这可以帮助您满足安全和合规需求。
- **启动时检索**：EC2 用户数据脚本可以调用 `aws secretsmanager get-secret-value` 并将结果导出为环境变量——需要编写的代码最少。

示例用户数据脚本：
```bash
#!/bin/bash
SECRET=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
  --secret-id payment-app-secret \
  --query SecretString --output text)
export DB_PASSWORD=$SECRET
```

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

### A. S3 + 客户管理的 KMS + S3 Object Lambda 用于轮换
- **S3 Object Lambda 不轮换密钥**——它在 `GetObject` 调用时转换数据。它不是一个定时轮换机制，因此此选项实际上不满足轮换要求。
- 将纯文本密钥存储在 S3 中的文本文件中（即使在静态加密）与专用密钥存储相比是一个较差的安全模式。
- 构建自定义轮换管道需要大量开发工作。

### B. Systems Manager Parameter Store + 自定义 Lambda 轮换
- Parameter Store **对于任意密钥没有内置的本地自动轮换**——您必须编写、部署、调度（EventBridge）和维护自定义 Lambda 函数。您可以通过创建 AWS Lambda 函数来扩展 Secrets Manager 以满足自定义轮换要求，以轮换其他类型的密钥，但在 Parameter Store 中您必须自己构建所有内容。
- 这**需要更多开发工作**，直接违反了"最少开发工作量"的要求。
- 注意：虽然 Parameter Store 的高级层支持用于过期/通知的 `policies` 字段，但真正的轮换不是本地 Parameter Store 功能。

### C. 应用属性中的 Base64 编码密钥 + 自定义轮换脚本
- Base64 是**编码，不是加密**——不符合"静态加密"要求。
- 直接在应用属性中嵌入密钥是一个反模式（密钥最终出现在源代码控制、AMI、日志中）。
- 需要编写自定义轮换脚本和重新部署流程——开发工作量高。

## 关键 AWS 文档
- [AWS Secrets Manager – 轮换密钥](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)
- [AWS Secrets Manager 中的密钥加密和解密](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/security-encryption.html)
- [为非数据库密钥设置自动轮换](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotate-secrets_turn-on-for-other.html)

en.question: A company is using Amazon API Gateway to invoke a new AWS Lambda function. The company has Lambda function versions in its PROD and DEV environments. In each environment, there is a Lambda function alias pointing to the corresponding Lambda function version. API Gateway has one stage that is configured to point at the PROD alias. The company wants to configure API Gateway to enable the PROD and DEV Lambda function versions to be simultaneously and distinctly available. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Enable a Lambda authorizer for the Lambda function alias in API Gateway. Republish PROD and create a new stage for DEV. Create API Gateway stage variables for the PROD and DEV stages. Point each stage variable to the PROD Lambda authorizer to the DEV Lambda authorizer.
options.B: Set up a gateway response in API Gateway for the Lambda function alias. Republish PROD and create a new stage for DEV. Create gateway responses in API Gateway for PROD and DEV Lambda aliases.
options.C: Use an environment variable for the Lambda function alias in API Gateway. Republish PROD and create a new stage for development. Create API gateway environment variables for PROD and DEV stages. Point each stage variable to the PROD Lambda function alias to the DEV Lambda function alias.
options.D: Use an API Gateway stage variable to configure the Lambda function alias. Republish PROD and create a new stage for development. Create API Gateway stage variables for PROD and DEV stages. Point each stage variable to the PROD Lambda function alias and to the DEV Lambda function alias.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The company has a single Lambda function with two versions, each tied to an alias (PROD and DEV). API Gateway currently has one stage pointed at the PROD alias. They want **both** environments simultaneously available through API Gateway, distinctly mapped to their respective aliases.

## Correct Answer: D — Use API Gateway Stage Variables

API Gateway **stage variables** are name-value pairs associated with a deployment stage. They behave like environment variables for an API stage and can be used to dynamically reference a Lambda function alias at runtime, so the same API definition can call different Lambda aliases per stage.

Stage variables are key-value pairs that you can define as configuration attributes associated with a deployment stage of a REST API. They act like environment variables and can be used in your API setup and mapping templates. With deployment stages in API Gateway, you can configure an API deployment stage to interact with different backend endpoints.

A stage variable can be used in place of a Lambda function name, or version/alias.

The integration ARN takes a form such as:

```
arn:aws:lambda:<region>:<account_id>:function:<function_name>:${stageVariables.lambdaAlias}
```

Then create two API Gateway stages (PROD and DEV). On each stage, define a stage variable (e.g., `lambdaAlias`) whose value is the corresponding alias name (`PROD` on the PROD stage, `DEV` on the DEV stage). At invocation time API Gateway substitutes the stage variable to call the correct Lambda alias.

> Note: When specifying a Lambda function name as a stage variable value, you must configure the permissions on the Lambda function manually using `lambda:add-permission` for each alias.

This achieves the requirement that both PROD and DEV Lambda alias-backed versions are simultaneously and distinctly available behind one API.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Lambda authorizer per stage** — A Lambda authorizer is an authentication/authorization mechanism that returns IAM policies; it does not control which Lambda function/alias the integration invokes. Pointing stage variables to authorizers does not route traffic to PROD vs DEV function versions.

- **B. Gateway responses** — Gateway responses are templates used to customize error responses (e.g., 4XX/5XX) returned by API Gateway. They have nothing to do with selecting Lambda integration targets or aliases.

- **C. "Environment variable for the Lambda function alias in API Gateway"** — API Gateway has no concept of "environment variables." Lambda has environment variables, but they cannot be used by API Gateway to select which alias to invoke. The correct API Gateway feature for per-stage configuration is *stage variables*, not environment variables.

## References

- [Use stage variables for a REST API in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/stage-variables.html)
- [API Gateway stage variables reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/aws-api-gateway-stage-variables-reference.html)
- [Set up stage variables in API Gateway console](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-set-stage-variables-aws-console.html)
- [Using API Gateway stage variables to manage Lambda functions (AWS Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/using-api-gateway-stage-variables-to-manage-lambda-functions/)

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon API Gateway 调用一个新的 AWS Lambda 函数。该公司在生产环境 (PROD) 和开发环境 (DEV) 中分别配置了不同版本的 Lambda 函数。每个环境中都有一个指向相应 Lambda 函数版本的别名。API Gateway 有一个阶段配置为指向 PROD 别名。该公司希望配置 API Gateway，使 PROD 和 DEV 环境中的 Lambda 函数版本能够同时且独立地可用。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 API 网关中为 Lambda 函数别名启用 Lambda 授权器。重新发布生产环境 (PROD) 并为开发环境 (DEV) 创建一个新阶段。为生产环境和开发环境创建 API 网关阶段变量。将每个阶段变量分别指向生产环境的 Lambda 授权器和开发环境的 Lambda 授权器。
options.B: 在 API 网关中为 Lambda 函数别名设置网关响应。重新发布 PROD 环境，并为 DEV 环境创建一个新阶段。在 API 网关中为 PROD 和 DEV Lambda 函数别名创建网关响应。
options.C: 在 API 网关中使用环境变量来指定 Lambda 函数别名。重新发布生产环境 (PROD)，并创建一个新的开发环境。为生产环境 (PROD) 和开发环境 (DEV) 创建 API 网关环境变量。将每个环境变量分别指向生产环境 (PROD) 和开发环境 (DEV) 的 Lambda 函数别名。
options.D: 使用 API 网关阶段变量配置 Lambda 函数别名。重新发布 PROD 环境，并创建一个新的开发阶段。为 PROD 和 DEV 阶段创建 API 网关阶段变量。将每个阶段变量分别指向 PROD Lambda 函数别名和 DEV Lambda 函数别名。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

公司有一个单一的 Lambda 函数，有两个版本，每个版本都关联到一个别名（PROD 和 DEV）。API Gateway 目前有一个指向 PROD 别名的阶段。他们希望 **两个** 环境同时通过 API Gateway 可用，并分别映射到各自的别名。

## 正确答案：D — 使用 API Gateway 阶段变量

API Gateway **阶段变量** 是与部署阶段相关联的名称-值对。它们的作用类似于 API 阶段的环境变量，可用于在运行时动态引用 Lambda 函数别名，因此同一个 API 定义可以根据阶段调用不同的 Lambda 别名。

阶段变量是可以定义为 REST API 部署阶段的配置属性的键值对。它们的作用类似于环境变量，可以在 API 设置和映射模板中使用。通过 API Gateway 中的部署阶段，您可以将 API 部署阶段配置为与不同的后端端点交互。

阶段变量可以用来代替 Lambda 函数名称或版本/别名。

集成 ARN 的格式如下：

```
arn:aws:lambda:<region>:<account_id>:function:<function_name>:${stageVariables.lambdaAlias}
```

然后创建两个 API Gateway 阶段（PROD 和 DEV）。在每个阶段上，定义一个阶段变量（例如 `lambdaAlias`），其值为相应的别名名称（PROD 阶段上为 `PROD`，DEV 阶段上为 `DEV`）。在调用时，API Gateway 会替换阶段变量以调用正确的 Lambda 别名。

> 注意：当将 Lambda 函数名称指定为阶段变量值时，必须使用 `lambda:add-permission` 为每个别名手动配置 Lambda 函数的权限。

这样就实现了 PROD 和 DEV Lambda 别名支持的版本同时且独立地在一个 API 后面可用的要求。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. 每个阶段的 Lambda 授权方** — Lambda 授权方是一个身份验证/授权机制，它返回 IAM 策略；它不控制集成调用的 Lambda 函数/别名。将阶段变量指向授权方不会根据不同的函数版本路由流量。

- **B. 网关响应** — 网关响应是用于自定义 API Gateway 返回的错误响应（例如 4XX/5XX）的模板。它们与选择 Lambda 集成目标或别名无关。

- **C. "API Gateway 中 Lambda 函数别名的环境变量"** — API Gateway 没有"环境变量"的概念。Lambda 有环境变量，但它们不能由 API Gateway 用来选择要调用的别名。用于每个阶段配置的正确 API Gateway 功能是 *阶段变量*，而不是环境变量。

## 参考资源

- [在 API Gateway 中对 REST API 使用阶段变量](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/stage-variables.html)
- [API Gateway 阶段变量参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/aws-api-gateway-stage-variables-reference.html)
- [在 API Gateway 控制台中设置阶段变量](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-set-stage-variables-aws-console.html)
- [使用 API Gateway 阶段变量管理 Lambda 函数 (AWS 博客)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/using-api-gateway-stage-variables-to-manage-lambda-functions/)

en.question: A developer is working on an ecommerce platform that communicates with several third-party payment processing APIs. The third-party payment services do not provide a test environment. The developer needs to validate the ecommerce platform's integration with the third-party payment processing APIs. The developer must test the API integration code without invoking the third-party payment processing APIs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up an Amazon API Gateway REST API with a gateway response configured for status code 200. Add response templates that contain sample responses captured from the real third-party API.
options.B: Set up an AWS AppSync GraphQL API with a data source configured for each third-party API. Specify an integration type of Mock. Configure integration responses by using sample responses captured from the real third-party API.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function for each third-party API. Embed responses captured from the real third-party API. Configure Amazon Route 53 Resolver with an inbound endpoint for each Lambda function's Amazon Resource Name (ARN).
options.D: Set up an Amazon API Gateway REST API for each third-party API. Specify an integration request type of Mock. Configure integration responses by using sample responses captured from the real third-party API.

en.explanation:
# Mocking Third-Party Payment APIs with API Gateway Mock Integration

## Scenario
The developer integrates with multiple third-party payment processing APIs that have **no test environment**. The team needs a way to test their integration code (request/response handling, error paths, parsing) without actually calling the real payment APIs. The solution must produce realistic responses that the application code can consume.

## Correct Answer: D

API Gateway natively supports a **Mock integration type**, which is purpose-built for this exact use case. This feature enables API developers to generate API responses from API Gateway directly, without the need for an integration backend. As an API developer, you can use this feature to unblock dependent teams that need to work with an API before the project development is complete.

With a Mock integration, you configure:
- **Integration type = MOCK** on the method For Integration type, select Mock.
- A **request template** that returns a `statusCode` to API Gateway
- **Integration response** mapping templates that return the canned (sample) JSON captured from the real third-party API

This perfectly matches option D: a REST API per third-party API with integration type Mock and integration responses populated with previously captured real responses. The application can be pointed at the API Gateway URL instead of the real payment endpoints, exercising the full HTTP request/response code path without invoking the live payment service.

This approach is also cost-effective: it will have very low latency as the payload is not passed to other AWS services like lambda which can take some time to load and execute. Invoking lambda function will cost us for every 100ms but this logic is handled by API gateway without any additional charges.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**A. API Gateway REST API with a "gateway response" for status code 200 + response templates.**
This conflates two distinct features. **Gateway Responses** are responses generated by API Gateway itself for *error* conditions (e.g., `DEFAULT_4XX`, `UNAUTHORIZED`, `ACCESS_DENIED`, `MISSING_AUTHENTICATION_TOKEN`) — they are not used to mock successful integration responses for arbitrary methods/resources. To mock realistic third-party API responses, you need an **Integration** of type **Mock** with **Integration Responses** (not Gateway Responses). Option A therefore uses the wrong API Gateway feature.

**B. AWS AppSync GraphQL API with integration type "Mock".**
AppSync is a managed **GraphQL** service. It does not have an "integration type of Mock" the way API Gateway REST does — AppSync uses **data sources** (Lambda, DynamoDB, HTTP, OpenSearch, RDS, EventBridge, None) and resolvers. The "Mock" integration type is an API Gateway concept, not AppSync. Additionally, third-party payment APIs are REST/HTTP, so wrapping them with a GraphQL façade adds unnecessary complexity. The terminology in the option is incorrect.

**C. Lambda functions with embedded responses + Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint per Lambda ARN.**
Two things are wrong:
1. **Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoints** are for **DNS query forwarding from on-premises networks into a VPC** — they have nothing to do with routing HTTP traffic to a Lambda function. You cannot configure a Resolver inbound endpoint with a Lambda ARN.
2. While Lambda *can* return mock responses, you would need API Gateway or a Function URL in front of it; Route 53 Resolver is the wrong service entirely. This option mixes services in a non-functional way.

## Reference
- [Mock integrations for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-mock-integration.html)
- [Enable mock integration using the API Gateway console](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-mock-integration-console.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在开发一个电子商务平台，该平台需要与多个第三方支付处理 API 进行通信。这些第三方支付服务商不提供测试环境。开发人员需要验证该电子商务平台与第三方支付处理 API 的集成。开发人员必须在不调用第三方支付处理 API 的情况下测试 API 集成代码。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 设置 Amazon API Gateway REST API，并将网关响应配置为状态码 200。添加包含从真实第三方 API 捕获的示例响应的响应模板。
options.B: 设置 AWS AppSync GraphQL API，并为每个第三方 API 配置数据源。指定集成类型为“模拟”。使用从真实第三方 API 捕获的示例响应来配置集成响应。
options.C: 为每个第三方 API 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数。嵌入从真实的第三方 API 捕获的响应。为每个 Lambda 函数的 Amazon 资源名称 (ARN) 配置 Amazon Route 53 解析器，并为其创建一个入站端点。
options.D: 为每个第三方 API 设置 Amazon API Gateway REST API。指定集成请求类型为“模拟”。使用从真实第三方 API 捕获的示例响应来配置集成响应。

zh.explanation:
# 使用 API Gateway Mock 集成模拟第三方支付 API

## 场景
开发者需要集成多个第三方支付处理 API，这些 API **没有测试环境**。团队需要一种方法来测试他们的集成代码（请求/响应处理、错误路径、解析），而无需实际调用真实支付 API。解决方案必须产生应用代码可以使用的逼真响应。

## 正确答案：D

API Gateway 原生支持 **Mock 集成类型**，这正是为这个确切用例而设计的功能。此功能使 API 开发者能够直接从 API Gateway 生成 API 响应，而无需集成后端。作为 API 开发者，您可以使用此功能来解除依赖团队的阻碍，他们需要在项目开发完成前就开始使用 API。

使用 Mock 集成，您需要配置：
- 在方法上 **Integration type = MOCK** 对于 Integration type，选择 Mock。
- 一个 **请求模板**，向 API Gateway 返回 `statusCode`
- **集成响应**映射模板，返回从真实第三方 API 捕获的罐装（示例）JSON

这完全符合选项 D：每个第三方 API 对应一个 REST API，集成类型为 Mock，集成响应填充以前捕获的真实响应。应用程序可以指向 API Gateway URL 而不是真实支付端点，执行完整的 HTTP 请求/响应代码路径，而无需调用实时支付服务。

这种方法也具有成本效益：它将具有非常低的延迟，因为有效负载不会传递给其他 AWS 服务（如 lambda），这可能需要一些时间来加载和执行。调用 lambda 函数每 100ms 都会产生费用，但此逻辑由 API Gateway 处理，无需任何额外费用。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**A. API Gateway REST API，带有状态码 200 的"网关响应"+ 响应模板。**
这混淆了两个不同的功能。**网关响应**是 API Gateway 自身为*错误*条件（例如 `DEFAULT_4XX`、`UNAUTHORIZED`、`ACCESS_DENIED`、`MISSING_AUTHENTICATION_TOKEN`）生成的响应——它们不用于模拟任意方法/资源的成功集成响应。要模拟逼真的第三方 API 响应，您需要集成类型为 **Mock** 的**集成**，以及**集成响应**（而不是网关响应）。因此选项 A 使用了错误的 API Gateway 功能。

**B. AWS AppSync GraphQL API，集成类型为"Mock"。**
AppSync 是一个托管 **GraphQL** 服务。它不像 API Gateway REST 那样具有"Mock 集成类型"——AppSync 使用**数据源**（Lambda、DynamoDB、HTTP、OpenSearch、RDS、EventBridge、None）和解析器。"Mock"集成类型是 API Gateway 的概念，不是 AppSync 的概念。此外，第三方支付 API 是 REST/HTTP，因此用 GraphQL 外观包装它们会增加不必要的复杂性。选项中的术语是不正确的。

**C. Lambda 函数，带有嵌入式响应 + 每个 Lambda ARN 的 Route 53 Resolver 入站端点。**
两个方面是错误的：
1. **Route 53 Resolver 入站端点**用于**DNS 查询转发，从本地网络转发到 VPC**——它们与将 HTTP 流量路由到 Lambda 函数无关。您无法使用 Lambda ARN 配置 Resolver 入站端点。
2. 虽然 Lambda *可以*返回模拟响应，但您需要在其前面使用 API Gateway 或函数 URL；Route 53 Resolver 完全是错误的服务。此选项以非功能性的方式混合了服务。

## 参考资源
- [API Gateway 中 REST API 的 Mock 集成](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-mock-integration.html)
- [使用 API Gateway 控制台启用 Mock 集成](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-mock-integration-console.html)

en.question: A developer is storing many objects in a single Amazon S3 bucket. The developer needs to optimize the S3 bucket for high request rates. How should the developer store the objects to meet this requirement?

options.A: Store the objects by using S3 Intelligent-Tiering.
options.B: Store the objects at the root of the S3 bucket.
options.C: Store the objects by using object key names distributed across multiple prefixes.
options.D: Store each object with an object tag named "prefix" that contains a unique value.

en.explanation:
# S3 High Request Rate Optimization

## Scenario
A developer is storing many objects in a single S3 bucket and wants to optimize the bucket for **high request rates**. The question asks how to organize/store the objects to achieve this goal.

## Correct Answer: C — Distribute object key names across multiple prefixes

Amazon S3 scales request capacity **per prefix** within a bucket. Your application can achieve at least 3,500 PUT/COPY/POST/DELETE or 5,500 GET/HEAD requests per second per partitioned Amazon S3 prefix, and there are no limits to the number of prefixes in a bucket.

This means that by spreading object keys across many prefixes, you scale request capacity linearly. To optimize performance for high-request rate workloads, distribute requests across multiple prefixes — use a randomized or sequential prefix pattern to spread requests across multiple partitions.

For example, instead of putting all objects under a single hot prefix, design key names like `a1b2/log-2024-01-01.txt`, `c3d4/log-2024-01-02.txt`, etc., so the load is sharded across many internal S3 partitions.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. S3 Intelligent-Tiering** — This is a *storage class* designed to automatically move objects between access tiers (frequent, infrequent, archive) to optimize **storage cost**, not request throughput. It has no effect on per-prefix request limits.

- **B. Store the objects at the root of the S3 bucket** — Storing all objects under a single (root) prefix concentrates load onto one partition, which is exactly the *opposite* of the recommended pattern. This makes hitting the 3,500 write / 5,500 read per-second per-prefix ceiling more likely and triggers HTTP 503 (Slow Down) responses.

- **D. Tag each object with a tag named "prefix"** — Object **tags** are metadata used for cost allocation, lifecycle filtering, replication filtering, and IAM conditions. They are **not** the same as key-name prefixes and do **not** influence S3's internal partitioning or request-rate scaling. Only the object **key name** determines the prefix used for partitioning.

## Reference
- [Best practices design patterns: optimizing Amazon S3 performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance.html)
- [Performance design patterns for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance-design-patterns.html)
- [Performance guidelines for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance-guidelines.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员将大量对象存储在单个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。为了应对高请求速率，开发人员需要优化 S3 存储桶的性能。为了满足此要求，开发人员应该如何存储这些对象？

options.A: 使用 S3 智能分层存储对象。
options.B: 将对象存储在 S3 存储桶的根目录下。
options.C: 使用分布在多个前缀中的对象键名来存储对象。
options.D: 将每个对象存储为名为“prefix”的对象标签，该标签包含一个唯一值。

zh.explanation:
# S3 高请求率优化

## 场景
开发者在单个 S3 存储桶中存储许多对象，并想为**高请求率**优化该存储桶。问题询问如何组织/存储对象以实现此目标。

## 正确答案：C — 将对象键名分散到多个前缀中

Amazon S3 按**前缀**在存储桶内扩展请求容量。您的应用程序可以为每个分区的 Amazon S3 前缀实现至少 3,500 个 PUT/COPY/POST/DELETE 或 5,500 个 GET/HEAD 请求/秒，存储桶中的前缀数量没有限制。

这意味着通过将对象键分散到许多前缀中，您可以线性扩展请求容量。为了优化高请求率工作负载的性能，将请求分散到多个前缀中 — 使用随机或顺序前缀模式将请求分散到多个分区。

例如，与其将所有对象放在单个热前缀下，不如设计像 `a1b2/log-2024-01-01.txt`、`c3d4/log-2024-01-02.txt` 这样的键名，这样负载会分散到许多内部 S3 分区。

## 其他选项为什么错误

- **A. S3 Intelligent-Tiering** — 这是一种*存储类*，旨在自动将对象在访问层（频繁、不频繁、存档）之间移动以优化**存储成本**，而不是请求吞吐量。它对每前缀请求限制没有影响。

- **B. 将对象存储在 S3 存储桶的根目录** — 将所有对象存储在单个（根）前缀下会将负载集中在一个分区上，这正好与推荐的模式**相反**。这使得更容易达到每秒 3,500 个写入 / 5,500 个读取的每前缀上限并触发 HTTP 503（慢速响应）。

- **D. 使用名为 "prefix" 的标签标记每个对象** — 对象**标签**是用于成本分配、生命周期过滤、复制过滤和 IAM 条件的元数据。它们**不**同于键名前缀，也**不**影响 S3 的内部分区或请求率扩展。只有对象**键名**决定了用于分区的前缀。

## 参考资源
- [Best practices design patterns: optimizing Amazon S3 performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance.html)
- [Performance design patterns for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance-design-patterns.html)
- [Performance guidelines for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance-guidelines.html)

en.question: A company deploys a new application to AWS. The company is streaming application logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. The company's development team must receive notification by email when the word "ERROR" appears in any log lines. A developer sets up an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic and subscribes the development team to the topic. What should the developer do next to meet the requirements?

options.A: Select the appropriate log group. Create a CloudWatch metric filter with "ERROR" as the search term. Create an alarm on this metric that notifies the SNS topic when the metric is 1 or higher.
options.B: In CloudWatch Logs Insights, select the appropriate log group. Create a metric query to search for the term "ERROR" in the logs. Create an alarm on this metric that notifies the SNS topic when the metric is 1 or higher.
options.C: Select the appropriate log group. Create an SNS subscription filter with "ERROR" as the filter pattern. Select the SNS topic as the destination.
options.D: Create a CloudWatch alarm that includes "ERROR" as a filter pattern, a log group dimension that defines the appropriate log group, and a destination that notifies the SNS topic.

en.explanation:
# Notify on "ERROR" in CloudWatch Logs via SNS

## Scenario
The application streams logs to CloudWatch Logs. When the literal string `ERROR` appears in any log line, the dev team (already subscribed to an SNS topic) must get an email. The question is: what is the next step to wire log content → SNS notification?

## Correct Answer: A

The standard, AWS-documented pattern for alerting on a textual term in CloudWatch Logs is:
