**C. `Fn::ImportValue`** — 此内置函数导入已由另一个 CloudFormation 堆栈通过 `Outputs` 部分使用 `Export` **导出的值**。此处的主机名位于 SSM Parameter Store 中，而不是另一堆栈的导出值中，因此 `Fn::ImportValue` 不适用。

**D. `ssm-secure` 动态引用** — 使用 ssm-secure 动态引用模式在模板中指定 AWS Systems Manager SecureString 类型参数。问题明确指出主机名存储为**纯文本**，而不是 SecureString，所以 `ssm-secure` 是错误的模式。此外，ssm-secure 引用仅适用于特定资源属性（如 AWS::RDS::DBInstance MasterUserPassword），这进一步限制了其适用性。

## 参考资源

- [Get values stored in other services using dynamic references](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/dynamic-references.html)
- [Get a plaintext value from Systems Manager Parameter Store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/dynamic-references-ssm.html)
- [Get a secure string value from Systems Manager Parameter Store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/dynamic-references-ssm-secure-strings.html)

en.question: A company uses an AWS Lambda function to call a third-party service. The third-party service has a limit of requests each minute. If the number of requests exceeds the limit, the third-party service returns rate- limiting errors. A developer needs to configure the Lambda function to avoid receiving rate limiting errors from the third- party service. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Set the reserved concurrency on the Lambda function to match the number of concurrent requests that the third-party service allows.
options.B: Decrease the memory that is allocated to the Lambda function.
options.C: Set the provisioned concurrency on the Lambda function to match the number of concurrent requests that the third-party service allows.
options.D: Increase the timeout value that is specified on the Lambda function.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A Lambda function calls a third-party API that throttles when the number of requests per minute exceeds a limit. The developer needs a way to cap the number of in-flight Lambda invocations so the downstream API isn't overwhelmed and doesn't return rate-limiting errors.

## Correct Answer: A — Set the reserved concurrency on the Lambda function

Reserved concurrency is the right tool for capping how many simultaneous executions of a Lambda function can run. Reserved concurrency sets both the maximum and minimum number of concurrent instances allocated to your function. When a function has reserved concurrency, no other function can use that concurrency. Reserved concurrency is useful for ensuring that your most critical functions always have enough concurrency to handle incoming requests. Additionally, reserved concurrency can be used for limiting concurrency to prevent overwhelming downstream resources, like database connections.

Crucially, reserved concurrency acts as both a lower and upper bound — it reserves the specified capacity exclusively for your function while also preventing it from scaling beyond that limit. By matching this upper bound to the third-party service's allowed concurrent requests, the Lambda function will be throttled by Lambda itself before it can exceed the third-party API's limit, avoiding rate-limiting errors. There is also no additional charge for configuring reserved concurrency for a function.

You can configure it via:

```bash
aws lambda put-function-concurrency \
  --function-name my-function \
  --reserved-concurrent-executions 10
```

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**B. Decrease the memory allocated to the Lambda function.** Memory in Lambda controls CPU/memory allocation per execution and affects performance and cost — it does **not** limit how many concurrent invocations occur. Lower memory might actually make functions run longer, increasing concurrent executions for the same request rate, making throttling worse.

**C. Set provisioned concurrency to match the allowed requests.** Provisioned concurrency is for performance, not for capping invocations. Provisioned concurrency is the number of pre-initialized execution environments allocated to your function. These execution environments are ready to respond immediately to incoming function requests. Provisioned concurrency is useful for reducing cold start latencies for functions and designed to make functions available with double-digit millisecond response times. It does not act as a hard ceiling — when a function reaches its provisioned concurrency, Lambda can use unreserved concurrency to handle additional requests (there's no throttling). So requests beyond the provisioned amount will still go through and continue hitting the third-party API.

**D. Increase the timeout value.** Timeout controls how long a single invocation can run before Lambda terminates it. It has nothing to do with the rate of requests sent to the downstream service. A longer timeout would not prevent rate-limiting errors; it would only allow individual invocations to wait longer.

## References

- [Configuring reserved concurrency for a function — AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-concurrency.html)
- [Configuring provisioned concurrency for a function — AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)
- [Understanding Lambda function scaling — AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-concurrency.html)

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Lambda 函数调用第三方服务。该第三方服务每分钟的请求次数有限制。如果请求次数超过限制，第三方服务会返回速率限制错误。开发人员需要配置 Lambda 函数以避免收到来自第三方服务的速率限制错误。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 Lambda 函数的预留并发数设置为与第三方服务允许的并发请求数相匹配。
options.B: 减少分配给 Lambda 函数的内存。
options.C: 将 Lambda 函数的配置并发数设置为与第三方服务允许的并发请求数相匹配。
options.D: 增加 Lambda 函数中指定的超时值。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一个 Lambda 函数调用第三方 API，当每分钟的请求数超过限制时会进行限流。开发人员需要一种方法来限制 Lambda 的并发调用数，以防止下游 API 被压垮并返回速率限制错误。

## 正确答案：A — 在 Lambda 函数上设置预留并发

预留并发是限制 Lambda 函数可以同时运行多少个实例的正确工具。预留并发设置了分配给函数的并发实例的最大和最小数量。当函数具有预留并发时，其他函数无法使用该并发。预留并发对于确保最关键的函数始终有足够的并发来处理传入请求非常有用。此外，预留并发可用于限制并发以防止压垮下游资源，如数据库连接。

关键是，预留并发既作为下限又作为上限——它为函数独家预留指定的容量，同时防止其超过该限制。通过将这个上限与第三方服务允许的并发请求数相匹配，Lambda 函数将在 Lambda 本身进行限流，而不会超过第三方 API 的限制，从而避免速率限制错误。此外，为函数配置预留并发不收取额外费用。

你可以通过以下方式配置它：

```bash
aws lambda put-function-concurrency \
  --function-name my-function \
  --reserved-concurrent-executions 10
```

## 其他选项为什么错误

**B. 减少分配给 Lambda 函数的内存。** Lambda 中的内存控制每次执行的 CPU/内存分配，影响性能和成本——它**不会**限制有多少个并发调用可以发生。较低的内存可能会让函数运行时间更长，对于相同的请求速率会增加并发执行数，使限流问题更糟。

**C. 将预配置并发设置为匹配允许的请求数。** 预配置并发是为了性能，而不是限制调用数。预配置并发是分配给函数的预初始化执行环境的数量。这些执行环境已准备好立即响应传入的函数请求。预配置并发对于降低函数的冷启动延迟非常有用，并且旨在使函数以两位数毫秒的响应时间可用。它不会充当硬上限——当函数达到其预配置并发时，Lambda 可以使用未预留的并发来处理额外请求（没有限流）。因此超过预配置数量的请求仍然会通过并继续访问第三方 API。

**D. 增加超时值。** 超时控制单个调用在 Lambda 终止它之前可以运行多长时间。它与发送到下游服务的请求速率无关。更长的超时不会防止速率限制错误；它只会允许单个调用等待更长时间。

## 参考资源

- [为函数配置预留并发 — AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-concurrency.html)
- [为函数配置预配置并发 — AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)
- [理解 Lambda 函数扩展 — AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-concurrency.html)

en.question: A developer is building a new containerized application by using AWS Copilot. The developer uses the AWS Copilot command line interface (CLI) to deploy the application during development. The developer committed the application code to a new AWS CodeCommit repository. The developer must create an automated deployment process before releasing the new application to production. What should the developer do to meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Create a buildspec file that invokes the AWS Copilot CLI commands to build and deploy the application. Use the AWS Copilot CLI to create an AWS CodePipeline that uses the CodeCommit repository in the source stage and AWS CodeBuild in the build stage.
options.B: Use the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) CLI to bootstrap and initialize an AWS CodePipeline configuration. Use the CodeCommit repository as the source. Invoke the AWS Copilot CLI to build and deploy the application.
options.C: Use the AWS Copilot CLI to define the AWS Copilot pipeline and to deploy the AWS CodePipeline. Select CodeCommit as the source for the AWS CodePipeline.
options.D: Define an AWS CloudFormation template for an AWS CodePipeline with CodeCommit as the source. Configure the template as an AWS Copilot CLI add-on. Use the AWS Copilot CLI to deploy the application.

en.explanation:
# Question Analysis

A developer using AWS Copilot CLI for a containerized application needs to set up an automated deployment pipeline from a CodeCommit repository, with the **most operationally efficient** approach.

## Correct Answer: C

AWS Copilot CLI has **built-in pipeline commands** that natively integrate with AWS CodePipeline and support CodeCommit as a source provider out of the box. Copilot provides commands to create multiple deployment environments in separate AWS accounts and regions, as well as creating an AWS CodePipeline pipeline to build your container images, deploy your services, and run automated tests.

The workflow is just three commands:
```bash
$ copilot pipeline init
$ git add copilot/ && git commit -m "Adding pipeline artifacts" && git push
$ copilot pipeline deploy
```

You need to have initiated at least one workload (service or job) before running pipeline deploy, so that your pipeline has something to deploy to your environments.

CodeCommit is a first-class supported source provider: source.provider is the name of your provider. Currently, GitHub, Bitbucket, and CodeCommit are supported. Once configured, once you've set up a CodePipeline using Copilot, all you'll have to do is push to your GitHub, Bitbucket, or CodeCommit repository, and CodePipeline will orchestrate the deployments.

The `copilot pipeline init` command auto-generates both the `pipeline.yml` manifest and a `buildspec.yml` for the CodeBuild stage — the developer doesn't need to write either by hand.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**A. Manually create a buildspec invoking Copilot CLI commands, then use Copilot CLI to create CodePipeline** — While technically workable, this duplicates work that Copilot already automates. Copilot's `pipeline init` already generates the buildspec.yml automatically (it knows how to build/push container images to ECR for each environment). Hand-crafting a buildspec that wraps Copilot CLI commands is unnecessary effort and less operationally efficient than option C.

**B. Use AWS SAM CLI to bootstrap CodePipeline** — AWS SAM is for **serverless (Lambda) applications**, not containerized ECS/Fargate apps deployed via Copilot. SAM has no native bootstrap for a Copilot-managed pipeline, and mixing the two tools adds complexity rather than reducing it.

**C. ✅ Use Copilot CLI to define and deploy the pipeline with CodeCommit as source** — This is the native, purpose-built approach. Minimal commands, no custom buildspec, native CodeCommit support.

**D. Define a CloudFormation template for CodePipeline as a Copilot add-on** — Copilot add-ons are intended for **additional AWS resources** a service depends on (DynamoDB tables, S3 buckets, etc.), not for the deployment pipeline itself. Writing custom CloudFormation duplicates what `copilot pipeline init/deploy` already produces, making it the least operationally efficient option.

## References
- [AWS Copilot Pipelines Concepts](https://aws.github.io/copilot-cli/docs/concepts/pipelines/)
- [AWS Copilot Pipeline Manifest](https://aws.github.io/copilot-cli/docs/manifest/pipeline/)
- [AWS Copilot CLI Home](https://aws.github.io/copilot-cli/)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在使用 AWS Copilot 构建一个新的容器化应用程序。在开发过程中，开发人员使用 AWS Copilot 命令行界面 (CLI) 部署该应用程序。开发人员已将应用程序代码提交到一个新的 AWS CodeCommit 代码库。在将新应用程序发布到生产环境之前，开发人员必须创建一个自动化部署流程。为了以最高效的方式满足这些要求，开发人员应该怎么做？

options.A: 创建一个构建规范文件，该文件调用 AWS Copilot CLI 命令来构建和部署应用程序。使用 AWS Copilot CLI 创建一个 AWS CodePipeline，该管道在源代码阶段使用 CodeCommit 存储库，在构建阶段使用 AWS CodeBuild。
options.B: 使用 AWS 无服务器应用程序模型 (AWS SAM) CLI 引导并初始化 AWS CodePipeline 配置。使用 CodeCommit 代码库作为源。调用 AWS Copilot CLI 构建并部署应用程序。
options.C: 使用 AWS Copilot CLI 定义 AWS Copilot 管道并部署 AWS CodePipeline。选择 CodeCommit 作为 AWS CodePipeline 的源。
options.D: 为 AWS CodePipeline 定义一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，并将 CodeCommit 作为数据源。将该模板配置为 AWS Copilot CLI 插件。使用 AWS Copilot CLI 部署应用程序。

zh.explanation:
# 问题分析

一位开发者使用 AWS Copilot CLI 处理容器化应用，需要从 CodeCommit 存储库设置自动化部署管道，采用**操作效率最高**的方法。

## 正确答案：C

AWS Copilot CLI 具有**内置管道命令**，本身与 AWS CodePipeline 集成，并开箱即用地支持 CodeCommit 作为源提供程序。Copilot 提供命令来在不同的 AWS 账户和区域中创建多个部署环境，以及创建 AWS CodePipeline 管道来构建容器镜像、部署服务和运行自动化测试。

工作流程只需三个命令：
```bash
$ copilot pipeline init
$ git add copilot/ && git commit -m "Adding pipeline artifacts" && git push
$ copilot pipeline deploy
```

在运行 pipeline deploy 前，需要至少初始化一个工作负载（服务或任务），以便管道有部署目标。

CodeCommit 是一流支持的源提供程序：source.provider 是提供程序的名称。目前支持 GitHub、Bitbucket 和 CodeCommit。配置完成后，设置好 Copilot CodePipeline 后，只需推送到 GitHub、Bitbucket 或 CodeCommit 存储库，CodePipeline 就会编排部署。

`copilot pipeline init` 命令会自动生成 `pipeline.yml` 清单和 CodeBuild 阶段的 `buildspec.yml`——开发者无需手工编写任何一个。

## 其他选项为何错误

**A. 手动创建调用 Copilot CLI 命令的 buildspec，然后使用 Copilot CLI 创建 CodePipeline** — 虽然在技术上可行，但这种方式重复了 Copilot 已经自动化的工作。Copilot 的 `pipeline init` 已经自动生成 buildspec.yml（它知道如何为每个环境构建容器镜像并推送到 ECR）。手工编写包装 Copilot CLI 命令的 buildspec 是不必要的额外工作，其操作效率不如选项 C。

**B. 使用 AWS SAM CLI 引导 CodePipeline** — AWS SAM 用于**无服务器（Lambda）应用**，不适用于通过 Copilot 部署的容器化 ECS/Fargate 应用。SAM 没有针对 Copilot 管理管道的原生引导功能，混合使用这两个工具会增加复杂性而非降低复杂性。

**C. ✅ 使用 Copilot CLI 定义并部署以 CodeCommit 作为源的管道** — 这是原生的、专门设计的方法。命令最少、无需自定义 buildspec、原生支持 CodeCommit。

**D. 将 CodePipeline 的 CloudFormation 模板定义为 Copilot 附加组件** — Copilot 附加组件用于服务**依赖的其他 AWS 资源**（DynamoDB 表、S3 存储桶等），不适用于部署管道本身。编写自定义 CloudFormation 重复了 `copilot pipeline init/deploy` 已产生的内容，是操作效率最低的选项。

## 参考资料
- [AWS Copilot Pipelines Concepts](https://aws.github.io/copilot-cli/docs/concepts/pipelines/)
- [AWS Copilot Pipeline Manifest](https://aws.github.io/copilot-cli/docs/manifest/pipeline/)
- [AWS Copilot CLI Home](https://aws.github.io/copilot-cli/)

en.question: A developer is creating a new application for a pet store. The application will manage customer rewards points. The developer will use Amazon DynamoDB to store the data for the application. The developer needs to optimize query performance and limit partition overload before actual performance analysis. Which option should the developer use for a partition key to meet these requirements?

options.A: A randomly generated universally unique identifier (UUID)
options.B: The customer's full name
options.C: The date when the customer signed up for the rewards program
options.D: The name of the customer's pet

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer is building a pet store rewards points application backed by Amazon DynamoDB. Before doing any real performance analysis, the developer wants a partition key that:

1. **Optimizes query performance**, and
2. **Limits partition overload** (i.e., avoids "hot partitions").

The question is essentially asking which attribute provides the best **distribution of data across partitions** by having **high cardinality and uniform access**.

## Correct Answer: A — A randomly generated UUID

DynamoDB hashes the partition key value to determine which physical partition stores an item. Every partition is capped at roughly **3,000 RCU and 1,000 WCU**, so traffic concentration on a single key value causes throttling — even when overall table capacity is high.

AWS guidance is explicit: choose a **high‑cardinality** attribute with **uniform request distribution**. Examples called out by AWS include `customerid`, `orderid`, `sessionid`, etc. A UUID maximizes cardinality (every item is unique) and distributes hash values evenly across partitions, avoiding hot partitions before any actual workload tuning is needed. See the AWS guidance on [Choosing the Right DynamoDB Partition Key](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/choosing-the-right-dynamodb-partition-key/) and [Best practices for designing and using partition keys effectively](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-partition-key-design.html), as well as the AWS re:Post article [Learn how to choose a primary key for a DynamoDB table](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/primary-key-dynamodb-table), which states that an attribute with a unique value for each item (such as a user ID/UUID) is a good partition key.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **B. Customer's full name** — Names are **not unique** (many customers can share the same name) and the natural distribution is highly skewed (common names like "John Smith" become hot keys). This is exactly the low-cardinality / non-uniform pattern AWS warns against.

- **C. Date the customer signed up** — Dates are a classic **hot partition anti-pattern**. All sign-ups on a given day hash to the same partition, creating a "rolling hot partition." AWS specifically warns that loading sequential/time-based data focuses traffic on one partition key value at a time. The cardinality is also limited to the number of distinct days.

- **D. Pet's name** — Pet names have **very low cardinality and skewed distribution** (popular names like "Bella" or "Max" recur frequently). Many customers will share pet names, causing collisions and hot partitions, and the value isn't even guaranteed to be unique or always present.

## Key takeaway

For a brand-new table where you have no measured access pattern yet, the safest default that "limits partition overload" is the **highest-cardinality, most-uniformly-distributed key** available — a UUID (or equivalent CustomerID).

```text
PartitionKey = UUID  →  hashed evenly  →  even distribution across partitions
```

If query patterns later require lookup by customer attributes, a **GSI** can be added; the base table key still benefits from UUID-based even distribution.

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在为一家宠物商店创建一个新应用程序。该应用程序将管理顾客的奖励积分。开发人员将使用 Amazon DynamoDB 来存储应用程序的数据。在进行实际性能分析之前，开发人员需要优化查询性能并限制分区过载。为了满足这些要求，开发人员应该使用哪种分区键选项？

options.A: 随机生成的通用唯一标识符 (UUID)
options.B: 客户的全名
options.C: 客户注册奖励计划的日期
options.D: 顾客宠物的名字

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一位开发人员正在构建由 Amazon DynamoDB 支持的宠物店奖励积分应用程序。在进行任何真正的性能分析之前，开发人员需要一个分区键能够：

1. **优化查询性能**，以及
2. **限制分区过载**（即避免"热分区"）。

这个问题本质上是在询问哪个属性能够通过**高基数和均匀的访问**来提供**跨分区的最佳数据分布**。

## 正确答案：A — 随机生成的 UUID

DynamoDB 对分区键值进行哈希处理以确定哪个物理分区存储项目。每个分区的容量上限大约为 **3,000 RCU 和 1,000 WCU**，因此单个键值上的流量集中会导致节流——即使总体表容量很高。

AWS 指导非常明确：选择具有**高基数**和**均匀请求分布**的属性。AWS 指出的例子包括 `customerid`、`orderid`、`sessionid` 等。UUID 最大化了基数（每个项目都是唯一的），并且将哈希值均匀分布到各个分区，在任何实际工作负载调整之前就避免了热分区。详见 AWS 关于 [Choosing the Right DynamoDB Partition Key](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/choosing-the-right-dynamodb-partition-key/) 和 [Best practices for designing and using partition keys effectively](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-partition-key-design.html) 的指导，以及 AWS re:Post 文章 [Learn how to choose a primary key for a DynamoDB table](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/primary-key-dynamodb-table)，其中指出具有每个项目唯一值的属性（如用户 ID/UUID）是一个很好的分区键。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **B. 客户的全名** — 名字是**不唯一的**（许多客户可以共享相同的名字），自然分布高度倾斜（像"John Smith"这样的常见名字会成为热键）。这正是 AWS 警告的低基数/非均匀模式。

- **C. 客户注册日期** — 日期是典型的**热分区反模式**。给定日期的所有注册都会哈希到同一分区，形成"滚动热分区"。AWS 明确警告说加载顺序/基于时间的数据会将流量集中在一个分区键值上。基数也仅限于不同日期的数量。

- **D. 宠物的名字** — 宠物名字具有**非常低的基数和倾斜分布**（像"Bella"或"Max"这样的常见名字经常重复）。许多客户将共享宠物名字，导致冲突和热分区，该值甚至不保证是唯一的或始终存在的。

## 关键要点

对于新表，当你还没有测量过访问模式时，最安全的默认选择是**基数最高、分布最均匀的可用键** — UUID（或等效的 CustomerID）。

```text
PartitionKey = UUID  →  均匀哈希  →  跨分区均匀分布
```

如果以后查询模式需要按客户属性查找，可以添加 **GSI**；基表键仍然受益于基于 UUID 的均匀分布。

en.question: A developer uses AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) to interact with the AWS CLI and AWS SDKs on a local workstation. API calls to AWS services were working when the SSO access was first configured. However, the developer is now receiving Access Denied errors. The developer has not changed any configuration files or scripts that were previously working on the workstation. What is the MOST likely cause of the developer's access issue?

options.A: The access permissions to the developer's AWS CLI binary file have changed.
options.B: The permission set that is assumed by IAM Identity Center does not have the necessary permissions to complete the API call.
options.C: The credentials from the IAM Identity Center federated role have expired.
options.D: The developer is attempting to make API calls to the incorrect AWS account.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer configured AWS IAM Identity Center (formerly AWS SSO) on a local workstation to use the AWS CLI/SDKs. Initially the API calls worked, but now they fail with **Access Denied** errors. Importantly, **no configuration files or scripts have been changed**. We need to identify the most likely root cause.

## Correct Answer: C — The credentials from the IAM Identity Center federated role have expired

IAM Identity Center hands out **temporary security credentials**, not long-term access keys. Users in IAM Identity Center are different than IAM users. IAM users are granted long-term credentials to AWS resources. Users in IAM Identity Center are granted temporary credentials.

When you authenticate via `aws sso login`, the CLI caches a JSON Web Token (access token) and uses it to obtain short-lived role credentials. The access token is valid for 8 hours. The expiresAt timestamp in the JSON file shows the expiration time.

After that token expires, the SSO session must be re-established: As long as you are signed in to IAM Identity Center and those cached credentials are not expired, the AWS CLI automatically renews expired AWS credentials when needed. However, if your IAM Identity Center credentials expire, you must explicitly renew them by logging in to your IAM Identity Center account again.

Once expired, AWS refuses any further API calls — Temporary credentials expire after a specified interval. After temporary credentials expire, any calls that you make with those credentials will fail, so you must generate a new set of temporary credentials. This manifests as Access Denied / expired token errors even though nothing on the workstation has changed.

The fix is simple: run `aws sso login` again to obtain a new access token and refreshed role credentials.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A. The access permissions to the developer's AWS CLI binary file have changed.** Local file system permissions on the CLI binary do not produce AWS-side `Access Denied` errors. The CLI binary either runs (and signs API requests) or it doesn't run at all (giving an OS-level permission error like "permission denied"). AWS service responses such as Access Denied come from AWS's IAM authorization layer, not from local executable file permissions.

- **B. The permission set assumed by IAM Identity Center does not have the necessary permissions.** The scenario explicitly states the API calls **were working** when first configured and that nothing has changed. If the permission set lacked the needed permissions, the calls would have failed from the start, not started failing later. There is no indication an administrator modified the permission set.

- **D. The developer is attempting to make API calls to the incorrect AWS account.** Again, the scenario states the configuration files and scripts (which include `sso_account_id` and `sso_role_name`) were not changed. The same profile that worked before is still being used, so the target account did not change.

## Key Takeaway

For DVA-C02: IAM Identity Center delivers **temporary credentials** via a cached SSO access token (default ~8 hours). When previously-working CLI/SDK calls suddenly start returning Access Denied with no config changes, the first thing to check is whether the SSO session has expired — fix it with `aws sso login`.

## References

- [Get temporary credentials for IAM Identity Center users with the AWS CLI (AWS re:Post)](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/sso-temporary-credentials)
- [Configuring IAM Identity Center authentication with the AWS CLI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-sso.html)
- [Getting IAM Identity Center user credentials for the AWS CLI or AWS SDKs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/howtogetcredentials.html)
- [Use temporary credentials with AWS resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_temp_use-resources.html)
- [How IAM Identity Center authentication is resolved for AWS SDKs and tools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdkref/latest/guide/understanding-sso.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员使用 AWS IAM Identity Center（AWS 单点登录）在本地工作站上与 AWS CLI 和 AWS 开发工具包 (SDK) 进行交互。首次配置 SSO 访问权限时，对 AWS 服务的 API 调用正常。但是，现在开发人员收到“访问被拒绝”错误。开发人员没有更改工作站上之前运行正常的任何配置文件或脚本。导致开发人员访问问题的最可能原因是什么？

options.A: 开发人员的 AWS CLI 二进制文件的访问权限已更改。
options.B: IAM Identity Center 所采用的权限集没有完成 API 调用所需的必要权限。
options.C: IAM 身份中心联合角色的凭证已过期。
options.D: 开发人员正在尝试向错误的 AWS 账户发出 API 调用。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一位开发人员在本地工作站上配置了 AWS IAM Identity Center（前身为 AWS SSO）以使用 AWS CLI/SDKs。最初 API 调用能够正常工作，但现在它们失败并出现**访问被拒绝**错误。重要的是，**没有任何配置文件或脚本被更改过**。我们需要找出最可能的根本原因。

## 正确答案：C — IAM Identity Center 联合角色的凭证已过期

IAM Identity Center 分配的是**临时安全凭证**，而不是长期访问密钥。IAM Identity Center 中的用户与 IAM 用户不同。IAM 用户被授予对 AWS 资源的长期凭证。IAM Identity Center 中的用户被授予临时凭证。

当你通过 `aws sso login` 进行身份验证时，CLI 会缓存一个 JSON Web Token（访问令牌）并使用它来获取短期角色凭证。访问令牌的有效期为 8 小时。JSON 文件中的 expiresAt 时间戳显示过期时间。

该令牌过期后，必须重新建立 SSO 会话：只要你保持登录到 IAM Identity Center 并且那些缓存的凭证未过期，AWS CLI 会在需要时自动更新已过期的 AWS 凭证。但是，如果你的 IAM Identity Center 凭证过期，你必须通过再次登录到你的 IAM Identity Center 账户来显式更新它们。

一旦过期，AWS 将拒绝任何进一步的 API 调用 — 临时凭证在指定的时间间隔后过期。在临时凭证过期后，使用这些凭证进行的任何调用都会失败，所以你必须生成一套新的临时凭证。这表现为访问被拒绝/令牌过期错误，即使工作站上的任何内容都没有改变。

解决方案很简单：再次运行 `aws sso login` 来获取新的访问令牌和刷新的角色凭证。

## 为什么其他选项是不正确的

- **A. 开发人员的 AWS CLI 二进制文件的访问权限已更改。**本地文件系统对 CLI 二进制文件的权限不会产生 AWS 侧的`访问被拒绝`错误。CLI 二进制文件要么运行（并签署 API 请求），要么完全不运行（给出操作系统级别的权限错误，如"permission denied"）。来自 AWS 服务的响应（如访问被拒绝）来自 AWS 的 IAM 授权层，而不是来自本地可执行文件权限。

- **B. IAM Identity Center 假设的权限集没有必要的权限。**场景明确说明 API 调用**最初能够工作**，并且没有任何内容被更改。如果权限集缺少所需的权限，调用从一开始就会失败，而不是之后才失败。没有迹象表明管理员修改了权限集。

- **D. 开发人员尝试对错误的 AWS 账户进行 API 调用。**再次，场景说明配置文件和脚本（包括 `sso_account_id` 和 `sso_role_name`）未被更改。之前工作的相同配置文件仍在使用中，所以目标账户没有改变。

## 关键要点

对于 DVA-C02：IAM Identity Center 通过缓存的 SSO 访问令牌提供**临时凭证**（默认约 8 小时）。当之前工作正常的 CLI/SDK 调用突然开始返回访问被拒绝错误且没有配置更改时，首先要检查的是 SSO 会话是否已过期 — 用 `aws sso login` 修复它。

## 参考资源

- [Get temporary credentials for IAM Identity Center users with the AWS CLI (AWS re:Post)](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/sso-temporary-credentials)
- [Configuring IAM Identity Center authentication with the AWS CLI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-sso.html)
- [Getting IAM Identity Center user credentials for the AWS CLI or AWS SDKs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/howtogetcredentials.html)
- [Use temporary credentials with AWS resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_temp_use-resources.html)
- [How IAM Identity Center authentication is resolved for AWS SDKs and tools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdkref/latest/guide/understanding-sso.html)

en.question: A company is building a serverless application. The application uses an API key to authenticate with a third-party application. The company wants to store the external API key as a part of an AWS Lambda configuration. The company needs to have full control over the AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys that will encrypt the API key and should be visible only to authorized entities. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Store the API key in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as a string parameter. Use the default AWS KMS key that AWS provides to encrypt the API key.
options.B: Store the API key in AWS Lambda environment variables. Create an AWS KMS customer managed key to encrypt the API key.
options.C: Store the API key in the code repository. Use an AWS managed key to encrypt the code repository.
options.D: Store the API key as an Amazon DynamoDB table record. Use an AWS managed key to encrypt the API key.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A serverless application needs to store an external API key as part of its **AWS Lambda configuration**. The company requires:
1. The API key stored in the Lambda configuration (environment variables).
2. **Full control** over the KMS keys used to encrypt the API key.
3. The key visible only to authorized entities.

## Correct Answer: B

**Store the API key in AWS Lambda environment variables. Create an AWS KMS customer managed key (CMK) to encrypt the API key.**

Lambda always encrypts environment variables at rest with a KMS key. Lambda always provides server-side encryption at rest with an AWS KMS key, and by default Lambda uses an AWS managed key. However, you can provide an AWS KMS customer managed key instead — you might do this to have control over rotation of the KMS key or to meet the requirements of your organization for managing KMS keys.

A customer managed CMK gives the company full control. By default, Lambda uses an AWS managed key. AWS recommends using a customer managed key because you have full control over the key, including management, rotation, and auditing.

Visibility is also restricted: When you use a customer managed key, only users in your account with access to the KMS key can view or manage environment variables on the function. This satisfies the "visible only to authorized entities" requirement, since users without `kms:Decrypt` cannot view the value.

## Why the other options are wrong

**A. Parameter Store with the default AWS-managed KMS key** — Two problems:
- The requirement explicitly says the key should be stored as **part of the Lambda configuration**, not in Parameter Store.
- More importantly, an **AWS managed key** does **not** provide "full control." AWS owns its policy and rotation schedule; the customer cannot edit the key policy. Only a **customer managed** CMK gives full control.

**C. Store the API key in the code repository** — This is a major security anti-pattern. Hard-coding secrets/API keys in source control exposes them to anyone with repo access regardless of how the repo is encrypted. Encrypting "the code repository" with an AWS managed key does not satisfy the requirement for full control and is not how Lambda configuration secrets are managed.

**D. Store as a DynamoDB record with an AWS managed key** — Again, the requirement is to store the key as part of the **Lambda configuration**, not in DynamoDB. Additionally, an AWS managed key does not give the company full control over key policy, rotation cadence, or auditing.

## Key takeaway

For Lambda configuration secrets that require full customer control over encryption: use **Lambda environment variables + a customer managed KMS key (CMK)**.

### References
- [Securing Lambda environment variables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-envvars-encryption.html)
- [Encryption best practices for AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/encryption-best-practices/lambda.html)
- [Data encryption at rest for AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/security-encryption-at-rest.html)

zh.question: 一家公司正在构建一个无服务器应用程序。该应用程序使用 API 密钥与第三方应用程序进行身份验证。该公司希望将外部 API 密钥存储在 AWS Lambda 配置中。该公司需要完全控制用于加密 API 密钥的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 密钥，并且这些密钥只能对授权实体可见。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 API 密钥作为字符串参数存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。使用 AWS 提供的默认 AWS KMS 密钥对 API 密钥进行加密。
options.B: 将 API 密钥存储在 AWS Lambda 环境变量中。创建 AWS KMS 客户管理密钥以加密 API 密钥。
options.C: 将 API 密钥存储在代码库中。使用 AWS 托管密钥对代码库进行加密。
options.D: 将 API 密钥存储为 Amazon DynamoDB 表记录。使用 AWS 托管密钥对 API 密钥进行加密。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一个无服务器应用程序需要将外部 API 密钥作为其 **AWS Lambda 配置**的一部分进行存储。公司要求：
1. API 密钥存储在 Lambda 配置（环境变量）中。
2. **完全控制** KMS 密钥用于加密 API 密钥。
3. 密钥仅对授权实体可见。

## 正确答案：B

**在 AWS Lambda 环境变量中存储 API 密钥。创建一个 AWS KMS 客户托管密钥 (CMK) 来加密 API 密钥。**

Lambda 始终使用 KMS 密钥对静态环境变量进行加密。Lambda 始终使用 AWS KMS 密钥提供静态服务器端加密，默认情况下 Lambda 使用 AWS 托管密钥。但是，你可以改为提供 AWS KMS 客户托管密钥 — 你可能希望这样做以控制 KMS 密钥的轮换或满足你的组织对管理 KMS 密钥的要求。

客户托管 CMK 为公司提供完全控制。默认情况下，Lambda 使用 AWS 托管密钥。AWS 建议使用客户托管密钥，因为你对密钥具有完全控制权，包括管理、轮换和审计。

可见性也受到限制：当你使用客户托管密钥时，只有你账户中有权访问 KMS 密钥的用户才能查看或管理该函数上的环境变量。这满足了"仅对授权实体可见"的要求，因为没有 `kms:Decrypt` 权限的用户无法查看该值。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**A. Parameter Store 配合默认 AWS 托管 KMS 密钥** — 两个问题：
- 要求明确指出密钥应该存储为 **Lambda 配置的一部分**，而不是在 Parameter Store 中。
- 更重要的是，**AWS 托管密钥** **不能** 提供"完全控制"。AWS 拥有其策略和轮换计划；客户无法编辑密钥策略。只有 **客户托管** CMK 才能提供完全控制。

**C. 在代码仓库中存储 API 密钥** — 这是一个重大的安全反面模式。在源代码控制中硬编码机密/API 密钥会将其暴露给任何有权访问仓库的人，无论仓库如何加密。使用 AWS 托管密钥加密"代码仓库"不满足完全控制的要求，也不是 Lambda 配置机密的管理方式。

**D. 作为 DynamoDB 记录存储，配合 AWS 托管密钥** — 同样，要求是将密钥存储为 **Lambda 配置的一部分**，而不是在 DynamoDB 中。此外，AWS 托管密钥无法让公司完全控制密钥策略、轮换周期或审计。

## 关键要点

对于需要完全客户控制加密的 Lambda 配置机密：使用 **Lambda 环境变量 + 客户托管 KMS 密钥 (CMK)**。

### 参考资源
- [Securing Lambda environment variables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-envvars-encryption.html)
- [Encryption best practices for AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/encryption-best-practices/lambda.html)
- [Data encryption at rest for AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/security-encryption-at-rest.html)

en.question: A developer is writing an application to analyze the traffic to a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances run behind a public Application Load Balancer (ALB). An HTTP server runs on each of the EC2 instances, logging all requests to a log file. The developer wants to capture the client public IP addresses. The developer analyzes the log files and notices only the IP address of the ALB. What must the developer do to capture the client public IP addresses in the log file?

options.A: Add a Host header to the HTTP server log configuration file.
options.B: Install the Amazon CloudWatch Logs agent on each EC2 instance. Configure the agent to write to the log file.
options.C: Install the AWS X-Ray daemon on each EC2 instance. Configure the daemon to write to the log file.
options.D: Add an X-Forwarded-For header to the HTTP server log configuration file.

en.explanation:
# Capturing Client Public IP Behind an ALB

## Scenario
An HTTP server runs on EC2 instances behind a public Application Load Balancer (ALB). The HTTP server logs only show the ALB's IP address — not the originating client's public IP. The developer needs to log the actual client IP addresses.

## Why This Happens
Because the ALB terminates the client TCP connection and opens a new connection to the backend EC2 instance, the source IP that the HTTP server sees is the ALB's private IP. The X-Forwarded-For request header helps you identify the IP address of a client when you use an HTTP or HTTPS load balancer. Because load balancers intercept traffic between clients and servers, your server access logs only contain the IP address of the load balancer.

## Correct Answer: D — Add an X-Forwarded-For header to the HTTP server log configuration file

The ALB automatically inserts the client's IP into the `X-Forwarded-For` HTTP header. By default, the Application Load Balancer stores the IP address of the client in the X-Forwarded-For request header and passes the header to your server. If the X-Forwarded-For request header is not included in the original request, the load balancer creates one with the client IP address as the request value.

The fix is to update the HTTP server's log format (e.g., Apache `LogFormat` or NGINX `log_format`) to include the value of the `X-Forwarded-For` header. For example, in Apache:

```apache
LogFormat "%h %l %u %t \"%r\" %>s %b \"%{X-Forwarded-For}i\"" combined_xff
CustomLog /var/log/httpd/access_log combined_xff
```

In NGINX:

```nginx
log_format main '$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] "$request" '
                '$status $body_bytes_sent "$http_x_forwarded_for"';
```

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Add a Host header to the HTTP server log configuration file.** The `Host` header identifies the virtual hostname the client requested (e.g., `www.example.com`); it does not contain any IP address information. It cannot be used to derive the client public IP.

- **B. Install the Amazon CloudWatch Logs agent on each EC2 instance.** The CloudWatch Logs agent only ships existing log files to CloudWatch Logs. It does not change what the HTTP server writes to those files, so the logs would still contain only the ALB's IP.

- **C. Install the AWS X-Ray daemon on each EC2 instance.** The X-Ray daemon forwards trace segments from the X-Ray SDK to the AWS X-Ray service for distributed tracing. It does not modify or write to web-server access logs and is unrelated to capturing the client IP in HTTP server logs.

## References
- [HTTP headers and Application Load Balancers (AWS docs)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/x-forwarded-headers.html)
- [HTTP headers and Classic Load Balancers (AWS docs)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/classic/x-forwarded-headers.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在编写一个应用程序，用于分析一组 Amazon EC2 实例的流量。这些 EC2 实例运行在公共应用程序负载均衡器 (ALB) 之后。每个 EC2 实例上都运行着一个 HTTP 服务器，并将所有请求记录到日志文件中。开发人员希望获取客户端的公有 IP 地址。开发人员分析日志文件后发现，日志文件中只包含 ALB 的 IP 地址。开发人员需要做什么才能在日志文件中获取客户端的公有 IP 地址？

options.A: 在 HTTP 服务器日志配置文件中添加 Host 标头。
options.B: 在每个 EC2 实例上安装 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 代理。配置代理以写入日志文件。
options.C: 在每个 EC2 实例上安装 AWS X-Ray 守护程序。配置守护程序以写入日志文件。
options.D: 在 HTTP 服务器日志配置文件中添加 X-Forwarded-For 标头。

zh.explanation:
# 捕获 ALB 背后的客户端公网 IP

## 场景
HTTP 服务器运行在公共应用负载均衡器 (ALB) 背后的 EC2 实例上。HTTP 服务器日志只显示 ALB 的 IP 地址 — 而不是源客户端的公网 IP。开发者需要记录实际的客户端 IP 地址。

## 为什么会发生这种情况
因为 ALB 终止客户端 TCP 连接，并向后端 EC2 实例建立新连接，所以 HTTP 服务器看到的源 IP 是 ALB 的私有 IP。当您使用 HTTP 或 HTTPS 负载均衡器时，X-Forwarded-For 请求标头可帮助您识别客户端的 IP 地址。由于负载均衡器拦截客户端和服务器之间的流量，您的服务器访问日志只包含负载均衡器的 IP 地址。

## 正确答案：D — 将 X-Forwarded-For 标头添加到 HTTP 服务器日志配置文件

ALB 会自动将客户端 IP 插入 `X-Forwarded-For` HTTP 标头中。默认情况下，应用负载均衡器将客户端的 IP 地址存储在 X-Forwarded-For 请求标头中，并将该标头传递给您的服务器。如果原始请求中不包含 X-Forwarded-For 请求标头，负载均衡器将创建一个，其中包含客户端 IP 地址作为请求值。

解决方案是更新 HTTP 服务器的日志格式（例如 Apache `LogFormat` 或 NGINX `log_format`）以包含 `X-Forwarded-For` 标头的值。例如，在 Apache 中：

```apache
LogFormat "%h %l %u %t \"%r\" %>s %b \"%{X-Forwarded-For}i\"" combined_xff
CustomLog /var/log/httpd/access_log combined_xff
```

在 NGINX 中：

```nginx
log_format main '$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] "$request" '
                '$status $body_bytes_sent "$http_x_forwarded_for"';
```

## 为什么其他选项错误

- **A. 将 Host 标头添加到 HTTP 服务器日志配置文件。** `Host` 标头标识客户端请求的虚拟主机名（例如 `www.example.com`）；它不包含任何 IP 地址信息。它不能用于推导客户端公网 IP。

- **B. 在每个 EC2 实例上安装 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 代理。** CloudWatch Logs 代理仅将现有日志文件传送到 CloudWatch Logs。它不会更改 HTTP 服务器写入这些文件的内容，因此日志仍然只包含 ALB 的 IP。

- **C. 在每个 EC2 实例上安装 AWS X-Ray 守护程序。** X-Ray 守护程序将 X-Ray SDK 中的跟踪段转发到 AWS X-Ray 服务进行分布式跟踪。它不会修改或写入 Web 服务器访问日志，与捕获 HTTP 服务器日志中的客户端 IP 无关。

## 参考资源
- [HTTP 标头和应用负载均衡器 (AWS 文档)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/x-forwarded-headers.html)
- [HTTP 标头和经典负载均衡器 (AWS 文档)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/classic/x-forwarded-headers.html)

en.question: A company is developing a serverless application by using AWS Lambda functions. One of the Lambda functions needs to access an Amazon RDS DB instance. The DB instance is in a private subnet inside a VPC. The company creates a role that includes the necessary permissions to access the DB instance. The company then assigns the role to the Lambda function. A developer must take additional action to give the Lambda function access to the DB instance. What should the developer do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Assign a public IP address to the DB instance. Modify the security group of the DB instance to allow inbound traffic from the IP address of the Lambda function.
options.B: Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection between the Lambda function and the DB instance.
options.C: Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution to create a secure connection between the Lambda function and the DB instance.
options.D: Configure the Lambda function to connect to the private subnets in the VPC. Add security group rules to allow traffic to the DB instance from the Lambda function.

en.explanation:
# Lambda Function Access to RDS in Private Subnet

## Scenario
A Lambda function needs to access an RDS DB instance located in a **private subnet** within a VPC. The IAM role with required permissions has been attached to the Lambda function. The question asks what additional **networking** action is required so the function can reach the database.

## Correct Answer: D

By default, Lambda functions run in an AWS-managed VPC that is isolated from customer VPCs. To reach private resources (like an RDS DB instance in a private subnet), the function must be explicitly attached to the customer's VPC.

With Amazon VPC, you can create private networks in your AWS account to host resources such as Amazon EC2, Amazon RDS, and Amazon ElastiCache instances. You can give your Lambda function access to resources hosted in an Amazon VPC by attaching your function to the VPC through the private subnets that contain the resources.

When you attach Lambda to the VPC, AWS creates Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs) for each subnet that the function is attached to. These ENIs allow the function to communicate with other resources within the VPC.

In addition to VPC attachment, security groups must permit the traffic. The Lambda's security group must allow outbound to the DB port, and the RDS security group must allow inbound from the Lambda's security group. This security group has an inbound rule with the VPC security group of the Lambda function as the source. This security group is associated with the DB instance and allows the function to access the DB instance.

So the two required configuration steps in option D — (1) connect the Lambda to the private subnets in the VPC, and (2) configure security group rules to allow traffic — are exactly what AWS prescribes.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Public IP on the DB instance + allow Lambda IP inbound** — This violates the architecture (RDS in a private subnet should not be made public) and is also infeasible: a Lambda function not connected to a VPC uses dynamic, non-deterministic public egress IPs from the AWS Lambda service, so you cannot whitelist a stable "Lambda IP." Exposing RDS publicly is also a serious security anti-pattern.

- **B. AWS Direct Connect between Lambda and RDS** — Direct Connect is a dedicated private network link from an **on-premises** data center to AWS. It is not a mechanism for connecting two AWS services to each other. Lambda-to-RDS connectivity uses VPC networking (ENIs in the VPC), not Direct Connect.

- **C. CloudFront distribution between Lambda and RDS** — CloudFront is a content delivery network for caching/distributing HTTP(S) content to end users. It does not proxy database protocols (e.g., MySQL/PostgreSQL/TCP) and is not used to connect Lambda to RDS. This option is conceptually wrong.

## Reference Architecture (Option D)

```
Lambda (attached to private subnets, SG = LambdaSG)
        │  outbound rule: allow TCP 3306/5432 → RDS_SG
        ▼
ENI in private subnet
        │
        ▼
RDS DB instance (SG = RDS_SG)
        inbound rule: allow TCP 3306/5432 from LambdaSG
```

## Sources
- [Giving Lambda functions access to resources in an Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)
- [Automatically connecting a Lambda function and a DB instance (RDS User Guide)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/lambda-rds-connect.html)
- [How to configure a Lambda function to connect to an RDS instance (AWS re:Post)](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/connect-lambda-to-an-rds-instance)

zh.question: 一家公司正在使用 AWS Lambda 函数开发一个无服务器应用程序。其中一个 Lambda 函数需要访问 Amazon RDS 数据库实例。该数据库实例位于 VPC 内的私有子网中。该公司创建了一个角色，该角色包含访问数据库实例所需的权限。然后，该公司将该角色分配给了 Lambda 函数。开发人员必须采取额外操作才能使 Lambda 函数获得对数据库实例的访问权限。开发人员应该如何操作才能满足这些要求？

options.A: 为数据库实例分配一个公网 IP 地址。修改数据库实例的安全组，允许来自 Lambda 函数 IP 地址的入站流量。
options.B: 在 Lambda 函数和数据库实例之间建立 AWS Direct Connect 连接。
options.C: 配置 Amazon CloudFront 分发，以在 Lambda 函数和数据库实例之间创建安全连接。
options.D: 配置 Lambda 函数连接到 VPC 中的私有子网。添加安全组规则，允许 Lambda 函数向数据库实例发送流量。

zh.explanation:
# Lambda 函数访问私有子网中的 RDS

## 场景
Lambda 函数需要访问位于 VPC 内**私有子网**中的 RDS DB 实例。具有所需权限的 IAM 角色已附加到 Lambda 函数。问题要求 Lambda 函数能够到达数据库所需的额外**网络**操作。

## 正确答案：D

默认情况下，Lambda 函数运行在 AWS 托管的 VPC 中，该 VPC 与客户 VPC 隔离。要访问私有资源（如私有子网中的 RDS DB 实例），必须将函数显式附加到客户的 VPC。

使用 Amazon VPC，你可以在 AWS 账户中创建私有网络来托管资源，例如 Amazon EC2、Amazon RDS 和 Amazon ElastiCache 实例。通过将 Lambda 函数附加到包含资源的私有子网，可以让 Lambda 函数访问 Amazon VPC 中托管的资源。

将 Lambda 附加到 VPC 时，AWS 为函数附加到的每个子网创建弹性网络接口 (ENI)。这些 ENI 允许函数与 VPC 内的其他资源通信。

除了 VPC 附加外，安全组必须允许流量。Lambda 的安全组必须允许出站到数据库端口，RDS 安全组必须允许来自 Lambda 安全组的入站流量。此安全组具有以 Lambda 函数的 VPC 安全组作为源的入站规则。此安全组与 DB 实例关联，允许函数访问 DB 实例。

因此，选项 D 中的两个所需配置步骤——(1) 将 Lambda 连接到 VPC 中的私有子网，以及 (2) 配置安全组规则以允许流量——正是 AWS 规定的做法。

## 其他选项为何错误

- **A. DB 实例上的公有 IP + 允许 Lambda IP 入站** — 这违反了架构设计（私有子网中的 RDS 不应暴露于公网），而且在技术上也不可行：未连接到 VPC 的 Lambda 函数使用来自 AWS Lambda 服务的动态、非确定性公有出站 IP，因此无法将稳定的"Lambda IP"列入白名单。将 RDS 暴露于公网也是严重的安全反模式。

- **B. AWS Direct Connect（Lambda 和 RDS 之间）** — Direct Connect 是从**本地**数据中心到 AWS 的专用私有网络链接。它不是连接两个 AWS 服务的机制。Lambda 到 RDS 的连接使用 VPC 网络（VPC 中的 ENI），而不是 Direct Connect。

- **C. Lambda 和 RDS 之间的 CloudFront 分发** — CloudFront 是一个内容分发网络 (CDN)，用于缓存和分发 HTTP(S) 内容到终端用户。它不代理数据库协议（如 MySQL/PostgreSQL/TCP），也不用于连接 Lambda 到 RDS。此选项在概念上是错误的。

## 参考架构（选项 D）

```
Lambda（附加到私有子网，SG = LambdaSG）
        │  出站规则：允许 TCP 3306/5432 → RDS_SG
        ▼
私有子网中的 ENI
        │
        ▼
RDS DB 实例（SG = RDS_SG）
        入站规则：允许来自 LambdaSG 的 TCP 3306/5432
```

## 参考资源
- [为 Lambda 函数提供对 Amazon VPC 中资源的访问权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)
- [自动连接 Lambda 函数和 DB 实例（RDS 用户指南）](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/lambda-rds-connect.html)
- [如何配置 Lambda 函数以连接到 RDS 实例（AWS re:Post）](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/connect-lambda-to-an-rds-instance)

en.question: A developer needs temporary access to resources in a second account. What is the MOST secure way to achieve this?

options.A: Use the Amazon Cognito user pools to get short-lived credentials for the second account.
options.B: Create a dedicated IAM access key for the second account, and send it by mail.
options.C: Create a cross-account access role, and use sts:AssumeRole API to get short-lived credentials.
options.D: Establish trust, and add an SSH key for the second account to the IAM user.

en.explanation:
# Cross-Account Temporary Access — Most Secure Approach

## Scenario
A developer needs **temporary access** to resources that live in a **second AWS account**. The question asks for the *most secure* method.

## Correct Answer: C — Create a cross-account IAM role and use `sts:AssumeRole`

This is the canonical AWS pattern for cross-account access. The administrator of the second account creates an IAM role with:
1. A **trust policy** that allows the first (developer's) account to assume the role.
2. A **permissions policy** that grants only the actions/resources the developer needs (least privilege).

The developer in the first account calls the STS `AssumeRole` API with the role's ARN. AssumeRole returns a set of temporary security credentials (access key ID, secret access key, and security token) that you can use to access AWS resources, and is typically used within your account or for cross-account access.

These credentials expire automatically — Account A's users or services call sts:AssumeRole to get temporary credentials that work in Account B, and these credentials expire automatically (default: 1 hour) — so there is nothing long-lived to leak or rotate. IAM best practices recommend that you require human users to use federation with an identity provider to access AWS using temporary credentials instead of using IAM users with long-term credentials.

Example CLI:

```bash
aws sts assume-role \
  --role-arn arn:aws:iam::222222222222:role/CrossAccountAccessRole \
  --role-session-name dev-session
```

The trust policy on the role in Account B looks like:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111111111111:root" },
    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
  }]
}
```

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. Amazon Cognito user pools** — Cognito user pools are an end-user identity directory for web/mobile apps (sign-up/sign-in). They are not the mechanism for granting an AWS developer cross-account access to AWS resources. (Identity pools can vend AWS credentials, but they do so for federated end users, not for developer-to-second-account scenarios.) This is the wrong tool.

- **B. Create a dedicated IAM access key for the second account, and send it by mail** — Long-term IAM access keys are exactly what AWS recommends *against* using. IAM best practices recommend requiring human users to use federation with temporary credentials instead of IAM users with long-term credentials. Mailing keys is also an insecure transport that could expose the credentials in transit.

- **D. Establish trust, and add an SSH key for the second account to the IAM user** — IAM users do not authenticate to AWS APIs via SSH keys. SSH keys in IAM are only used for AWS CodeCommit Git access (or EC2 Instance Connect), not for granting cross-account API access. This option is technically nonsensical for the stated requirement.

## Key AWS Docs
- [AssumeRole — AWS STS API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/STS/latest/APIReference/API_AssumeRole.html)
- [IAM tutorial: Delegate access across AWS accounts using IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/tutorial_cross-account-with-roles.html)

zh.question: 开发人员需要临时访问第二个帐户中的资源。实现此目的最安全的方法是什么？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Cognito 用户池为第二个帐户获取短期凭证。
options.B: 为第二个帐户创建一个专用的 IAM 访问密钥，并通过邮件发送。
options.C: 创建一个跨账户访问角色，并使用 sts:AssumeRole API 获取短期凭证。
options.D: 建立信任，并将第二个帐户的 SSH 密钥添加到 IAM 用户。

zh.explanation:
# 跨账户临时访问 — 最安全的方法

## 场景
开发者需要**临时访问**位于**另一个 AWS 账户**中的资源。问题询问的是*最安全的*方法。

## 正确答案：C — 创建跨账户 IAM 角色并使用 `sts:AssumeRole`

这是 AWS 跨账户访问的规范模式。第二个账户的管理员创建一个 IAM 角色，包含：
1. 一个**信任策略**，允许第一个（开发者的）账户来担任该角色。
2. 一个**权限策略**，仅授予开发者需要的操作/资源（最小权限原则）。

第一个账户中的开发者调用 STS `AssumeRole` API，传入该角色的 ARN。AssumeRole 返回一组临时安全凭证（访问密钥 ID、秘密访问密钥和安全令牌），你可以使用这些凭证来访问 AWS 资源，通常用于账户内或跨账户访问。

这些凭证会自动过期 — 账户 A 的用户或服务调用 sts:AssumeRole 获取在账户 B 中工作的临时凭证，这些凭证会自动过期（默认：1 小时） — 因此没有长期凭证会泄露或需要轮换。IAM 最佳实践建议要求人类用户使用与身份提供商的联合身份验证来访问 AWS，而不是使用具有长期凭证的 IAM 用户。

示例 CLI：

```bash
aws sts assume-role \
  --role-arn arn:aws:iam::222222222222:role/CrossAccountAccessRole \
  --role-session-name dev-session
```

账户 B 中该角色的信任策略如下所示：

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111111111111:root" },
    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
  }]
}
```

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. Amazon Cognito 用户池** — Cognito 用户池是针对 Web/移动应用的最终用户身份目录（注册/登录）。它不是用于授予 AWS 开发者跨账户访问 AWS 资源的机制。（身份池可以向联合最终用户分发 AWS 凭证，但不适用于开发者访问第二个账户的场景。）这是错误的工具。

- **B. 为第二个账户创建专用 IAM 访问密钥，并通过邮件发送** — 长期 IAM 访问密钥正是 AWS 建议*避免*使用的。IAM 最佳实践建议要求人类用户使用与身份提供商的联合身份验证来访问 AWS，而不是使用具有长期凭证的 IAM 用户。通过邮件发送密钥也是一种不安全的传输方式，可能在传输过程中暴露凭证。

- **D. 建立信任，并将第二个账户的 SSH 密钥添加到 IAM 用户** — IAM 用户不能通过 SSH 密钥对 AWS API 进行身份验证。IAM 中的 SSH 密钥仅用于 AWS CodeCommit Git 访问（或 EC2 Instance Connect），不用于授予跨账户 API 访问权限。此选项对于所述需求在技术上毫无意义。

## 关键 AWS 文档
- [AssumeRole — AWS STS API 参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/STS/latest/APIReference/API_AssumeRole.html)
- [IAM 教程：使用 IAM 角色委托跨 AWS 账户的访问权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/tutorial_cross-account-with-roles.html)

en.question: A company wants to migrate applications from its on-premises servers to AWS. As a first step, the company is modifying and migrating a non-critical application to a single Amazon EC2 instance. The application will store information in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs to follow security best practices when deploying the application on AWS. Which approach should the company take to allow the application to interact with Amazon S3?

options.A: Create an IAM role that has administrative access to AWS. Attach the role to the EC2 instance.
options.B: Create an IAM user. Attach the AdministratorAccess policy. Copy the generated access key and secret key. Within the application code, use the access key and secret key along with the AWS SDK to communicate with Amazon S3.
options.C: Create an IAM role that has the necessary access to Amazon S3. Attach the role to the EC2 instance.
options.D: Create an IAM user. Attach a policy that provides the necessary access to Amazon S3. Copy the generated access key and secret key. Within the application code, use the access key and secret key along with the AWS SDK to communicate with Amazon S3.

en.explanation:
# EC2 to S3 Access — Security Best Practice

## Scenario
A company is migrating a non-critical application to a single EC2 instance. The application stores data in S3 and must follow AWS **security best practices**. The question is how to grant the application on EC2 access to S3.

## Correct Answer: **C** — Create an IAM role with the necessary S3 access and attach it to the EC2 instance

This combines two AWS best practices:

1. **Use IAM roles, not long-term access keys, for workloads on EC2.** IAM roles are designed so that applications can securely make API requests from EC2 instances without requiring you to manage the security credentials that the applications use. The EC2 instance metadata service automatically supplies temporary, auto-rotated credentials to the SDK/CLI. Because role credentials are temporary and updated automatically, you don't have to manage credentials, and you don't have to worry about long-term security risks.

2. **Grant least privilege.** When creating IAM roles, associate least privilege IAM policies that restrict access to the specific API calls the application requires. Option C says "necessary access to S3" — i.e., scoped permissions, not admin.

The flow described in AWS documentation matches Option C exactly: An administrator creates the service role and attaches the role to the Amazon EC2 instance. The role includes a permissions policy that grants read-only access to the specified S3 bucket. It also includes a trust policy that allows the Amazon EC2 instance to assume the role and retrieve the temporary credentials. When the application runs on the instance, it can use the role's temporary credentials to access the photos bucket.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. IAM role with administrative access attached to EC2** — Uses a role (good) but violates the **principle of least privilege**. If the EC2 instance is compromised, the attacker gains full admin control of the AWS account. AWS explicitly recommends restricting IAM role policies to only what the application requires.

- **B. IAM user with AdministratorAccess; embed access key/secret in code** — Two violations:
  - Embedding **long-term access keys** in application code is an explicit anti-pattern. This is actually a better practice since you never type your security credentials on this server (which might be stolen if your server gets hacked). Hard-coded keys can leak via source control, logs, or instance compromise and must be manually rotated.
  - **AdministratorAccess** grossly violates least privilege.

- **D. IAM user with scoped S3 policy; embed access key/secret in code** — Better than B (least privilege is respected), but still uses **long-term static credentials** stored in code instead of temporary, auto-rotated role credentials delivered through the instance metadata service. AWS guidance is clear that workloads on EC2 should use IAM roles rather than IAM user access keys.

## Key References
- [IAM roles for Amazon EC2 (EC2 User Guide)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/iam-roles-for-amazon-ec2.html)
- [Use an IAM role to grant permissions to applications running on EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_switch-role-ec2.html)

zh.question: 一家公司希望将应用程序从本地服务器迁移到 AWS。作为第一步，该公司正在修改一个非关键应用程序并将其迁移到单个 Amazon EC2 实例。该应用程序会将信息存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。该公司在 AWS 上部署应用程序时需要遵循安全最佳实践。该公司应该采取哪种方法来允许应用程序与 Amazon S3 交互？

options.A: 创建一个具有 AWS 管理权限的 IAM 角色。将该角色附加到 EC2 实例。
options.B: 创建一个 IAM 用户。附加 AdministratorAccess 策略。复制生成的访问密钥和秘密密钥。在应用程序代码中，使用访问密钥和秘密密钥以及 AWS 开发工具包与 Amazon S3 通信。
options.C: 创建一个具有访问 Amazon S3 所需权限的 IAM 角色。将该角色附加到 EC2 实例。
options.D: 创建一个 IAM 用户。附加一个策略，授予其访问 Amazon S3 的必要权限。复制生成的访问密钥和秘密密钥。在应用程序代码中，使用访问密钥和秘密密钥以及 AWS 开发工具包与 Amazon S3 通信。

zh.explanation:
# EC2 到 S3 访问 — 安全最佳实践

## 场景
一家公司正在将一个非关键应用程序迁移到单个 EC2 实例。该应用程序将数据存储在 S3 中，必须遵循 AWS **安全最佳实践**。问题是如何授予 EC2 上的应用程序对 S3 的访问权限。

## 正确答案：**C** — 创建具有必要 S3 访问权限的 IAM 角色，并将其附加到 EC2 实例

这结合了两个 AWS 最佳实践：

1. **对 EC2 上的工作负载使用 IAM 角色，而不是长期访问密钥。** IAM 角色设计使得应用程序可以从 EC2 实例安全地发出 API 请求，而无需管理应用程序使用的安全凭证。 EC2 实例元数据服务会自动向 SDK/CLI 提供临时且自动轮转的凭证。由于角色凭证是临时的且自动更新，您无需管理凭证，也不必担心长期安全风险。

2. **授予最小权限。** 创建 IAM 角色时，关联限制访问应用程序所需的特定 API 调用的最小权限 IAM 策略。 选项 C 说"S3 的必要访问权限"— 即作用域限制的权限，而不是管理员权限。

AWS 文档中描述的流程与选项 C 完全匹配：管理员创建服务角色，并将该角色附加到 Amazon EC2 实例。该角色包含一个权限策略，授予对指定 S3 存储桶的只读访问权限。它还包含一个信任策略，允许 Amazon EC2 实例承担该角色并检索临时凭证。当应用程序在实例上运行时，它可以使用角色的临时凭证访问照片存储桶。

## 为什么其他选项错误

- **A. IAM 角色具有管理员访问权限并附加到 EC2** — 使用角色（正确），但违反了**最小权限原则**。如果 EC2 实例被破坏，攻击者将获得对整个 AWS 账户的完全管理员控制权。AWS 明确建议将 IAM 角色策略限制为仅应用程序所需的内容。

- **B. IAM 用户具有 AdministratorAccess；将访问密钥/密钥嵌入代码中** — 两个违规：
  - 在应用程序代码中嵌入**长期访问密钥**是明确的反面模式。这实际上是更好的做法，因为您永远不会在此服务器上键入安全凭证（如果服务器被黑客入侵，凭证可能会被盗）。 硬编码的密钥可能会通过源代码控制、日志或实例泄露，必须手动轮转。
  - **AdministratorAccess** 严重违反了最小权限。

- **D. IAM 用户具有作用域限制的 S3 策略；将访问密钥/密钥嵌入代码中** — 比 B 更好（尊重最小权限），但仍然使用存储在代码中的**长期静态凭证**，而不是通过实例元数据服务提供的临时自动轮转角色凭证。AWS 指导清楚表明 EC2 上的工作负载应使用 IAM 角色而不是 IAM 用户访问密钥。

## 关键参考资源
- [Amazon EC2 的 IAM 角色（EC2 用户指南）](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/iam-roles-for-amazon-ec2.html)
- [使用 IAM 角色授予 EC2 实例上的应用程序权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_switch-role-ec2.html)
- [使用 IAM 角色验证部署到 EC2 的应用程序（AWS SDK 和工具）](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdkref/latest/guide/access-iam-roles-for-ec2.html)
- [授予 EC2 实例对 S3 存储桶的访问权限（AWS re:Post）](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/ec2-instance-access-s3-bucket)

en.question: A company has an internal website that contains sensitive data. The company wants to make the website public. The company must ensure that only employees who authenticate through the company's OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity provider (IdP) can access the website. A developer needs to implement authentication without editing the website. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create a public Network Load Balancer.
options.B: Create a public Application Load Balancer.
options.C: Configure a listener for the load balancer that listens on HTTPS port 443. Add a default authenticate action providing the OIDC IdP configuration.
options.D: Configure a listener for the load balancer that listens on HTTP port 80. Add a default authenticate action providing the OIDC IdP configuration.
options.E: Configure a listener for the load balancer that listens on HTTPS port 443. Add a default AWS Lambda action providing an Amazon Resource Name (ARN) to a Lambda authentication function.

en.explanation:
# ALB OIDC Authentication for Public Website

## Scenario
A company has an internal website with sensitive data and wants to make it publicly accessible, but only to employees authenticated via the company's OIDC IdP. The developer **cannot modify the website code**, so authentication must be offloaded to AWS infrastructure.

## Correct Answers: B and C

### B. Create a public Application Load Balancer
The Application Load Balancer (ALB) natively supports authentication offloading. You can configure an Application Load Balancer to securely authenticate users as they access your applications. This enables you to offload the work of authenticating users to your load balancer so that your applications can focus on their business logic. ALB can authenticate users through an identity provider (IdP) that is OpenID Connect (OIDC) compliant. This satisfies the "without editing the website" requirement.

### C. Configure an HTTPS listener on port 443 with a default authenticate action for the OIDC IdP
The authenticate-oidc action requires HTTPS. The authenticate-cognito and authenticate-oidc action types are supported only with HTTPS listeners. This cookie always contains the secure attribute, because user authentication requires an HTTPS listener. Additionally, since the website contains sensitive data, HTTPS is required for confidentiality in transit.

## Why the Other Options Are Incorrect

### A. Create a public Network Load Balancer — INCORRECT
NLBs operate at Layer 4 (TCP/UDP) and have no concept of HTTP listeners, listener rules, or authenticate actions. The OIDC authentication feature is exclusive to ALB. NLB cannot perform OIDC token exchange, redirect users to an IdP authorization endpoint, or manage session cookies.

### D. Configure an HTTP port 80 listener with authenticate action — INCORRECT
The authenticate-oidc action is **not supported on HTTP listeners**. The authenticate-cognito and authenticate-oidc action types are supported only with HTTPS listeners, because authentication cannot be used for non TLS HTTP workloads. Additionally, sending sensitive credentials and session cookies over plaintext HTTP would be insecure.

### E. HTTPS listener with default Lambda action for authentication — INCORRECT
While ALB supports Lambda as a target, this approach would require **writing custom Lambda code** to implement the OIDC authorization code flow (token exchange, JWT validation, cookie management). The requirement explicitly states authentication must be implemented **without editing the website** and the simplest, native solution is the built-in `authenticate-oidc` action — which requires no custom code. Option C is the correct, AWS-native pattern.

## Configuration Summary

```
Listener: HTTPS:443
  Default Action 1: authenticate-oidc
    - Issuer
    - AuthorizationEndpoint
    - TokenEndpoint
    - UserInfoEndpoint
    - ClientId / ClientSecret
  Default Action 2: forward → target group (website)
```

## Authentication Flow
User sends an HTTPS request to a website hosted behind an Application Load Balancer. When the conditions for a rule with an authenticate action are met, the load balancer checks for an authentication session cookie in the request headers. If the cookie is not present, the load balancer redirects the user to the IdP authorization endpoint so that the IdP can authenticate the user. After the user is authenticated, the IdP sends the user back to the load balancer with an authorization grant code. The load balancer presents the authorization grant code to the IdP token endpoint.

## References
- [Authenticate users using an Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-authenticate-users.html)
- [Security best practices when using ALB authentication](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/networking-and-content-delivery/security-best-practices-when-using-alb-authentication/)
- [Integrate an ALB with Amazon Cognito to authenticate users](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/cognito-user-pool-alb-authentication)

zh.question: 一家公司有一个包含敏感数据的内部网站。该公司希望将该网站公开。公司必须确保只有通过公司 OpenID Connect (OIDC) 身份提供商 (IdP) 进行身份验证的员工才能访问该网站。开发人员需要在不修改网站的情况下实现身份验证。以下哪两项步骤组合可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建公共网络负载均衡器。
options.B: 创建公共应用程序负载均衡器。
options.C: 为负载均衡器配置监听器，监听 HTTPS 端口 443。添加默认身份验证操作，提供 OIDC IdP 配置。
options.D: 为负载均衡器配置监听器，监听 HTTP 端口 80。添加默认身份验证操作，提供 OIDC IdP 配置。
options.E: 为负载均衡器配置监听器，监听 HTTPS 端口 443。添加一个默认的 AWS Lambda 操作，向 Lambda 身份验证函数提供 Amazon 资源名称 (ARN)。

zh.explanation:
# ALB OIDC 身份验证用于公共网站

## 场景
一家公司有一个包含敏感数据的内部网站，希望将其公开访问，但仅限于通过公司 OIDC IdP 进行身份验证的员工。开发人员**不能修改网站代码**，因此身份验证必须在 AWS 基础设施中进行。

## 正确答案：B 和 C

### B. 创建公共应用负载均衡器
应用负载均衡器 (ALB) 本身支持身份验证卸载。您可以配置应用负载均衡器来安全地对访问应用程序的用户进行身份验证。这使您能够将用户身份验证工作卸载到负载均衡器，以便您的应用程序可以专注于其业务逻辑。 ALB 可以通过符合 OpenID Connect (OIDC) 的身份提供者 (IdP) 对用户进行身份验证。 这满足"无需编辑网站"的要求。

### C. 在端口 443 上配置 HTTPS 监听器，并使用 OIDC IdP 的默认身份验证操作
authenticate-oidc 操作需要 HTTPS。authenticate-cognito 和 authenticate-oidc 操作类型仅支持 HTTPS 监听器。 此 Cookie 始终包含安全属性，因为用户身份验证需要 HTTPS 监听器。 另外，由于网站包含敏感数据，传输过程中需要 HTTPS 来确保机密性。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

### A. 创建公共网络负载均衡器 — 错误
NLB 在第 4 层 (TCP/UDP) 运行，没有 HTTP 监听器、监听器规则或身份验证操作的概念。OIDC 身份验证功能仅限于 ALB。NLB 无法执行 OIDC 令牌交换、将用户重定向到 IdP 授权端点或管理会话 Cookie。

### D. 在 HTTP 端口 80 监听器上配置身份验证操作 — 错误
authenticate-oidc 操作**不支持 HTTP 监听器**。authenticate-cognito 和 authenticate-oidc 操作类型仅支持 HTTPS 监听器，因为身份验证不能用于非 TLS HTTP 工作负载。 另外，通过纯文本 HTTP 发送敏感凭证和会话 Cookie 是不安全的。

### E. 使用默认 Lambda 操作进行身份验证的 HTTPS 监听器 — 错误
虽然 ALB 支持 Lambda 作为目标，但这种方法需要**编写自定义 Lambda 代码**来实现 OIDC 授权代码流（令牌交换、JWT 验证、Cookie 管理）。该要求明确指出身份验证必须在**无需编辑网站**的情况下实现，而最简单的、原生的解决方案是内置的 `authenticate-oidc` 操作 — 无需自定义代码。选项 C 是正确的、AWS 原生的模式。

## 配置摘要

```
监听器：HTTPS:443
  默认操作 1：authenticate-oidc
    - Issuer
    - AuthorizationEndpoint
    - TokenEndpoint
    - UserInfoEndpoint
    - ClientId / ClientSecret
  默认操作 2：forward → 目标组（网站）
```

## 身份验证流程
用户向应用负载均衡器后面托管的网站发送 HTTPS 请求。当满足具有身份验证操作的规则条件时，负载均衡器检查请求标头中的身份验证会话 Cookie。如果 Cookie 不存在，负载均衡器会将用户重定向到 IdP 授权端点，以便 IdP 可以对用户进行身份验证。用户经过身份验证后，IdP 会将用户与授权授予代码一起发送回负载均衡器。负载均衡器将授权授予代码呈递给 IdP 令牌端点。

## 参考资源
- [使用应用负载均衡器对用户进行身份验证](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-authenticate-users.html)
- [使用 ALB 身份验证时的安全最佳实践](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/networking-and-content-delivery/security-best-practices-when-using-alb-authentication/)
- [将 ALB 与 Amazon Cognito 集成以对用户进行身份验证](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/cognito-user-pool-alb-authentication)

en.question: A developer is working on a web application that requires selective activation of specific features. The developer wants to keep the features hidden from end users until the features are ready for public access. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a feature flag configuration profile in AWS AppSync. Store the feature flag values in the configuration profile. Activate and deactivate feature flags as needed.
options.B: Store prerelease data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Enable Amazon DynamoDB Streams in the table. Toggle between hidden and visible states by using DynamoDB Streams.
options.C: Create a feature flag configuration profile in AWS AppConfig. Store the feature flag values in the configuration profile. Activate and deactivate feature flags as needed.
options.D: Store prerelease data in AWS Amplify DataStore. Toggle between hidden and visible states by using Amplify DataStore cloud synchronization.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer needs to selectively activate features in a web app and keep them hidden from end users until ready for public release. This is the classic feature flag / feature toggle use case.

## Correct Answer: C

**Create a feature flag configuration profile in AWS AppConfig.** AWS AppConfig is the AWS-native service designed exactly for this purpose. AWS AppConfig feature flags and dynamic configurations help software builders quickly and securely adjust application behavior in production environments without full code deployments. With feature flags, you can gradually release new capabilities to users and measure the impact of those changes before fully deploying the new capabilities to all users.

Feature flags and toggles – Safely release new capabilities to your customers in a controlled environment. Instantly roll back changes if you experience a problem.

The workflow matches the question precisely: AWS AppConfig supports configuration profile types including feature flags, which you can use to enable or disable features within your applications or to configure different characteristics of your application features using flag attributes. The developer creates a configuration profile, defines flags (e.g., `featureA: false`), and toggles them on when the feature is ready for public access — without redeploying code.

Example feature flag configuration:
```json
{
  "featureA": { "enabled": false },
  "featureB": { "enabled": true }
}
```

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**A. AWS AppSync** — AppSync is a managed **GraphQL API** service for building data-driven APIs (with real-time and offline capabilities). It does **not** have a "feature flag configuration profile" concept. The option is technically incorrect — feature flag configuration profiles are an AppConfig feature, not AppSync.

**B. DynamoDB Streams** — DynamoDB Streams capture **change data** (item-level inserts/updates/deletes) for downstream processing (e.g., Lambda triggers, replication). Streams are not a mechanism for toggling feature visibility; they emit events when data changes and cannot be used to "toggle between hidden and visible states." This misuses the service.

**D. Amplify DataStore** — Amplify DataStore is a **client-side data store** with cloud synchronization (backed by AppSync/DynamoDB) for offline-capable apps. It synchronizes application data; it is not a feature flag service and has no built-in mechanism to selectively activate/hide features for end users.

## References

- [AWS AppConfig – What is AppConfig?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appconfig/latest/userguide/what-is-appconfig.html)
- [Creating a feature flag configuration profile in AWS AppConfig](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appconfig/latest/userguide/appconfig-creating-configuration-and-profile-feature-flags.html)
- [Using AWS AppConfig Feature Flags (AWS Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/mt/using-aws-appconfig-feature-flags/)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在开发一个需要选择性激活特定功能的Web应用程序。开发人员希望在这些功能准备好公开访问之前，对最终用户保持隐藏状态。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 AWS AppSync 中创建功能标志配置概要文件。将功能标志值存储在该配置概要文件中。根据需要激活和停用功能标志。
options.B: 将预发布数据存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。在该表中启用 Amazon DynamoDB Streams。使用 DynamoDB Streams 在隐藏和可见状态之间切换。
options.C: 在 AWS AppConfig 中创建功能标志配置文件。将功能标志值存储在配置文件中。根据需要激活和停用功能标志。
options.D: 将预发布数据存储在 AWS Amplify DataStore 中。利用 Amplify DataStore 云同步功能，在隐藏和可见状态之间切换。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

开发人员需要在网络应用中有选择性地激活功能，并在准备好面向公众发布之前将其隐藏在最终用户之外。这是经典的特性开关/功能切换用例。

## 正确答案：C

**在 AWS AppConfig 中创建特性开关配置文件。** AWS AppConfig 是专为此目的设计的 AWS 原生服务。AWS AppConfig 特性开关和动态配置帮助软件构建者在生产环境中快速安全地调整应用程序行为，无需完整的代码部署。使用特性开关，您可以逐步向用户发布新功能，并在完全向所有用户部署新功能之前衡量这些变更的影响。

特性开关和切换 – 在受控环境中安全地向客户发布新功能。如果遇到问题，可以立即回滚更改。

工作流与问题完全匹配：AWS AppConfig 支持包括特性开关在内的配置文件类型，您可以使用它来启用或禁用应用程序中的功能，或使用标志属性配置应用程序功能的不同特性。 开发人员创建一个配置文件，定义标志（例如，`featureA: false`），并在功能准备好面向公众时切换它们 — 无需重新部署代码。

特性开关配置示例：
```json
{
  "featureA": { "enabled": false },
  "featureB": { "enabled": true }
}
```

## 为什么其他选项错误

**A. AWS AppSync** — AppSync 是一项受管 **GraphQL API** 服务，用于构建数据驱动的 API（具有实时和离线功能）。它没有"特性开关配置文件"的概念。该选项在技术上是不正确的 — 特性开关配置文件是 AppConfig 的功能，而不是 AppSync。

**B. DynamoDB Streams** — DynamoDB Streams 捕获**更改数据**（项目级插入/更新/删除）用于下游处理（例如，Lambda 触发、复制）。Streams 不是切换功能可见性的机制；它们在数据更改时发出事件，无法用于"在隐藏和可见状态之间切换"。这是对服务的误用。

**D. Amplify DataStore** — Amplify DataStore 是一个**客户端数据存储**，具有云同步功能（由 AppSync/DynamoDB 支持），适用于离线能力的应用程序。它同步应用程序数据；它不是特性开关服务，也没有内置机制来有选择性地为最终用户激活/隐藏功能。

## 参考资源

- [AWS AppConfig – 什么是 AppConfig？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appconfig/latest/userguide/what-is-appconfig.html)
- [在 AWS AppConfig 中创建特性开关配置文件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appconfig/latest/userguide/appconfig-creating-configuration-and-profile-feature-flags.html)
- [使用 AWS AppConfig 特性开关（AWS 博客）](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/mt/using-aws-appconfig-feature-flags/)

en.question: A developer at a company writes an AWS CloudFormation template. The template refers to subnets that were created by a separate AWS CloudFormation template that the company's network team wrote. When the developer attempts to launch the stack for the first time, the launch fails. Which template coding mistakes could have caused this failure? (Choose two.)

options.A: The developer's template does not use the Ref intrinsic function to refer to the subnets.
options.B: The developer's template does not use the ImportValue intrinsic function to refer to the subnets.
options.C: The Mappings section of the developer's template does not refer to the subnets.
options.D: The network team's template does not export the subnets in the Outputs section.
options.E: The network team's template does not export the subnets in the Mappings section.

en.explanation:
# CloudFormation Cross-Stack References

## Scenario
A developer's CloudFormation template needs to reference subnet resources that are created and managed by a separate stack owned by the network team. When the developer's stack is launched for the first time, it fails. The question asks which two template-coding mistakes could have caused this failure.

This is a classic **cross-stack reference** scenario. To share a resource (like a subnet ID) from one stack to another, CloudFormation requires two things working together:

1. The **producing** stack must declare the value in its `Outputs` section **with an `Export` field**.
2. The **consuming** stack must use the **`Fn::ImportValue`** intrinsic function to import that exported value.

[Refer to resource outputs in another CloudFormation stack](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/walkthrough-crossstackref.html) confirms that you use the `Export` output field together with `Fn::ImportValue` to create cross-stack references.

## Correct Answers: B and D

**B. The developer's template does not use the ImportValue intrinsic function to refer to the subnets.** ✅
The consuming template must use `Fn::ImportValue` to read a value exported by another stack. The [Fn::ImportValue documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/intrinsic-function-reference-importvalue.html) states it returns the value of an output exported by another stack and is used to create cross-stack references. Without `Fn::ImportValue`, the developer's template has no way to retrieve the subnet IDs from the network team's stack.

```yaml
Resources:
  WebServerInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !ImportValue NetworkStack-SubnetID
```

**D. The network team's template does not export the subnets in the Outputs section.** ✅
For another stack to import a value, the producing stack must declare it in `Outputs` and add an `Export` name. Per [AWS re:Post guidance](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/cloudformation-reference-resource), you must declare the `Export` field in the `Outputs` section of the template. If the network team never exported the subnets, there is nothing to import.

```yaml
Outputs:
  PublicSubnet:
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SubnetID"
```

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**A. The developer's template does not use the Ref intrinsic function to refer to the subnets.** ❌
`Ref` only returns values for resources defined **within the same template**. It cannot reach into another stack to retrieve a resource ID. The correct cross-stack mechanism is `Fn::ImportValue`, not `Ref`.

**C. The Mappings section of the developer's template does not refer to the subnets.** ❌
The `Mappings` section is for **static key/value lookups** (e.g., region-to-AMI tables). It is not a mechanism for sharing resources across stacks and has no role in importing values from another stack.

**E. The network team's template does not export the subnets in the Mappings section.** ❌
You cannot export values from `Mappings`. Cross-stack exports are declared only in the `Outputs` section using the `Export` field. `Mappings` cannot be flagged for export.

## References
- [Walkthrough: Refer to resource outputs in another CloudFormation stack](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/walkthrough-crossstackref.html)
- [Fn::ImportValue intrinsic function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/intrinsic-function-reference-importvalue.html)
- [Get exported outputs from a deployed CloudFormation stack](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-stack-exports.html)
- [Reference resources across stacks in CloudFormation templates (re:Post)](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/cloudformation-reference-resource)

zh.question: 某公司的一名开发人员编写了一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板。该模板引用了由公司网络团队编写的另一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板创建的子网。当开发人员首次尝试启动该堆栈时，启动失败。哪些模板编码错误可能导致了此次失败？（选择两项。）

options.A: 开发人员的模板未使用 Ref 内置函数来引用子网。
options.B: 开发人员的模板未使用 ImportValue 内置函数来引用子网。
options.C: 开发人员模板的映射部分没有提及子网。
options.D: 网络团队的模板不会在“输出”部分导出子网。
options.E: 网络团队的模板不会导出映射部分中的子网。

zh.explanation:
# CloudFormation 跨栈引用

## 场景
一个开发者的 CloudFormation 模板需要引用由网络团队创建和管理的另一个栈中的子网资源。当开发者的栈首次启动时失败。问题要求指出哪两个模板编码错误可能导致了此故障。

这是一个经典的**跨栈引用**场景。要在栈之间共享资源（如子网 ID），CloudFormation 需要两个协同工作的东西：

1. **生产者**栈必须在其 `Outputs` 部分声明该值，**并带有 `Export` 字段**。
2. **消费者**栈必须使用 **`Fn::ImportValue`** 内置函数来导入该导出值。

[在另一个 CloudFormation 栈中引用资源输出](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/walkthrough-crossstackref.html)确认您可以使用 `Export` 输出字段和 `Fn::ImportValue` 来创建跨栈引用。

## 正确答案：B 和 D

**B. 开发者的模板未使用 ImportValue 内置函数来引用子网。** ✅
消费者模板必须使用 `Fn::ImportValue` 来读取由另一个栈导出的值。[Fn::ImportValue 文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/intrinsic-function-reference-importvalue.html)说明它返回由另一个栈导出的输出值，用于创建跨栈引用。没有 `Fn::ImportValue`，开发者的模板无法从网络团队的栈中检索子网 ID。

```yaml
Resources:
  WebServerInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !ImportValue NetworkStack-SubnetID
```

**D. 网络团队的模板在 Outputs 部分未导出子网。** ✅
要让另一个栈导入某个值，生产者栈必须在 `Outputs` 中声明它并添加 `Export` 名称。根据 [AWS re:Post 指南](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/cloudformation-reference-resource)，您必须在模板的 `Outputs` 部分声明 `Export` 字段。如果网络团队从未导出子网，则没有任何内容可导入。

```yaml
Outputs:
  PublicSubnet:
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SubnetID"
```

## 其他选项为何错误

**A. 开发者的模板未使用 Ref 内置函数来引用子网。** ❌
`Ref` 仅返回**在同一模板中定义的**资源的值。它无法跨越另一个栈来检索资源 ID。正确的跨栈机制是 `Fn::ImportValue`，而不是 `Ref`。

**C. 开发者模板的 Mappings 部分未引用子网。** ❌
`Mappings` 部分用于**静态键/值查找**（例如区域到 AMI 映射表）。它不是跨栈共享资源的机制，在从另一个栈导入值时无任何作用。

**E. 网络团队的模板在 Mappings 部分未导出子网。** ❌
您无法从 `Mappings` 导出值。跨栈导出仅在 `Outputs` 部分中使用 `Export` 字段声明。`Mappings` 不能被标记为导出。

## 参考资源
- [演练：在另一个 CloudFormation 栈中引用资源输出](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/walkthrough-crossstackref.html)
- [Fn::ImportValue 内置函数](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/intrinsic-function-reference-importvalue.html)
- [从已部署的 CloudFormation 栈获取导出输出](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-stack-exports.html)
- [在 CloudFormation 模板中跨栈引用资源 (re:Post)](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/cloudformation-reference-resource)

en.question: A developer is running an application on an Amazon EC2 instance. When the application tries to read an Amazon S3 bucket, the application fails. The developer notices that the associated IAM role is missing the S3 read permission. The developer needs to give the application the ability to read the S3 bucket. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST application disruption?

options.A: Add the permission to the role. Terminate the existing EC2 instance. Launch a new EC2 instance.
options.B: Add the permission to the role so that the change will take effect automatically.
options.C: Add the permission to the role. Hibernate and restart the existing EC2 instance.
options.D: Add the permission to the S3 bucket. Restart the EC2 instance.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

An application running on an EC2 instance fails to read from an S3 bucket because the IAM role attached to the instance is missing the required `s3:Get*`/`s3:List*` permissions. The developer needs to grant access with the **least application disruption** (no downtime, no restart, no relaunch).

## Correct Answer: B — Add the permission to the role; the change takes effect automatically
