When you modify the permissions policy attached to an IAM role that is already associated with an EC2 instance via an instance profile, the change propagates automatically to the running instance. According to the [AWS EC2 documentation on IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/iam-roles-for-amazon-ec2.html), if you change a role, the change is propagated to all instances. Similarly, the [IAM User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_switch-role-ec2.html) states that if you use a single role for multiple instances, you can make a change to that one role and the change propagates automatically to all the instances.

The EC2 instance retrieves temporary credentials from the Instance Metadata Service (IMDS), and the temporary security credentials available on the instance automatically update before they expire so that a valid set is always available — the application just needs to make sure that it gets a new set of credentials from the instance metadata before the current ones expire. Because the role itself already has the trust relationship and is attached, simply updating the attached policy is sufficient — no instance disruption is required.

This achieves the requirement with **zero application disruption**.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Terminate and launch a new EC2 instance** — Causes maximum disruption. Termination destroys the instance and its instance-store data, requires re-launch, re-provisioning, and any in-flight work is lost. Completely unnecessary because role policy changes propagate automatically.

- **C. Hibernate and restart the existing EC2 instance** — Hibernation stops the instance (RAM is written to the EBS root volume), causing the application to go offline during hibernation and restart. This is unnecessary disruption; the policy change does not require any instance state change.

- **D. Add the permission to the S3 bucket and restart the EC2 instance** — Two problems. (1) Adding a bucket policy is a different mechanism (resource-based policy) and not what was asked — the question explicitly states the IAM role is missing the permission, so the fix should be on the role/identity side. (2) Restarting the instance causes unnecessary downtime; restart is not required for IAM role changes to take effect. Note that AWS only recommends a stop/start to *force* a credential refresh in edge cases such as a trust-policy change — see [Troubleshoot IAM and Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/troubleshoot_iam-ec2.html), which mentions that to force the change, you must disassociate the instance profile and then associate the instance profile, or you can stop your instance and then restart it — but this is for forcing immediate refresh, not normal permission policy updates which propagate via the next IMDS credential rotation.

## Key Takeaway

IAM role **permission policy** changes propagate automatically to attached EC2 instances via the temporary credentials served by IMDS, with no instance restart needed. This is one of the core advantages of using IAM roles for EC2.

zh.question: 一位开发人员在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个应用程序。当该应用程序尝试读取 Amazon S3 存储桶时，操作失败。开发人员发现关联的 IAM 角色缺少 S3 读取权限。开发人员需要授予该应用程序读取 S3 存储桶的权限。哪种解决方案能够在最大程度减少应用程序中断的情况下满足此要求？

options.A: 将权限添加到角色。终止现有的 EC2 实例。启动一个新的 EC2 实例。
options.B: 将权限添加到角色，以便更改自动生效。
options.C: 将权限添加到角色。休眠并重启现有的 EC2 实例。
options.D: 为 S3 存储桶添加权限。重启 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

在 EC2 实例上运行的应用程序无法从 S3 存储桶读取数据，因为附加到该实例的 IAM 角色缺少所需的 `s3:Get*`/`s3:List*` 权限。开发人员需要在**最小化应用程序中断**（无停机时间、无重启、无重新启动）的情况下授予访问权限。

## 正确答案：B — 将权限添加到角色；更改自动生效

当您修改已与 EC2 实例通过实例配置文件关联的 IAM 角色附加的权限策略时，更改会自动传播到正在运行的实例。根据 [AWS EC2 IAM 角色文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/iam-roles-for-amazon-ec2.html)，如果您更改角色，该更改会传播到所有实例。同样，[IAM 用户指南](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_switch-role-ec2.html)指出如果您为多个实例使用单个角色，可以对该角色进行更改，该更改会自动传播到所有实例。

EC2 实例从实例元数据服务 (IMDS) 检索临时凭证，实例上可用的临时安全凭证在过期前自动更新，以确保始终可用有效的凭证集——应用程序只需确保在当前凭证过期前从实例元数据获取新的凭证集。由于角色本身已具有信任关系且已附加，仅更新附加的策略就足够了——不需要对实例进行任何中断。

这可以实现**零应用程序中断**的要求。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

- **A. 终止并启动新的 EC2 实例** — 导致最大程度的中断。终止会销毁实例及其实例存储数据，需要重新启动、重新配置，任何进行中的工作都会丢失。完全不必要，因为角色策略更改会自动传播。

- **C. 休眠并重新启动现有 EC2 实例** — 休眠停止实例（RAM 写入 EBS 根卷），导致应用程序在休眠和重新启动期间离线。这是不必要的中断；策略更改不需要任何实例状态更改。

- **D. 将权限添加到 S3 存储桶并重新启动 EC2 实例** — 有两个问题。(1) 添加存储桶策略是另一种机制（基于资源的策略），不是问题所要求的——问题明确指出 IAM 角色缺少权限，因此修复应在角色/身份端。(2) 重新启动实例会导致不必要的停机时间；IAM 角色更改生效不需要重新启动。请注意，AWS 仅建议在边缘情况下（例如信任策略更改）进行停止/启动以*强制*凭证刷新——参见 [排查 IAM 和 Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/troubleshoot_iam-ec2.html)，其中提到要强制该更改，您必须取消关联实例配置文件，然后关联实例配置文件，或者可以停止实例然后重新启动——但这是为了强制立即刷新，而不是普通权限策略更新，后者通过下一个 IMDS 凭证轮转传播。

## 关键要点

IAM 角色**权限策略**更改通过 IMDS 提供的临时凭证自动传播到附加的 EC2 实例，无需实例重新启动。这是使用 IAM 角色处理 EC2 的核心优势之一。

en.question: A developer is writing a web application that is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances behind an internet- facing Application Load Balancer (ALB). The developer must add an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the ALB. The developer also must ensure that customer data from outside the VPC is encrypted in transit. Which combination of CloudFront configuration settings should the developer use to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Restrict viewer access by using signed URLs.
options.B: Set the Origin Protocol Policy setting to Match Viewer.
options.C: Enable field-level encryption.
options.D: Enable automatic object compression.
options.E: Set the Viewer Protocol Policy setting to Redirect HTTP to HTTPS.

en.explanation:
# CloudFront + ALB: Encrypt Customer Data In Transit

## Scenario
A web app runs on EC2 instances behind an internet-facing ALB. The developer is putting CloudFront in front of the ALB and must ensure that **customer data outside the VPC is encrypted in transit**. "Outside the VPC" covers two hops:

1. **Viewer → CloudFront** (over the public internet)
2. **CloudFront → ALB (custom origin)** (over the public internet)

Both legs must use HTTPS. The question asks which two CloudFront settings deliver this end-to-end encryption.

## Correct Answers: B and E

### E. Set the Viewer Protocol Policy to "Redirect HTTP to HTTPS"
This forces the **viewer-to-CloudFront** leg to use HTTPS. To enable encryption in transit for your distribution, you need to configure the distribution's viewer protocol policy to redirect HTTP requests to HTTPS or to require the viewers to use only the HTTPS protocol to access your web content. With Redirect HTTP to HTTPS, viewers can use both protocols, but HTTP requests are automatically redirected to HTTPS requests. CloudFront returns HTTP status code 301 (Moved Permanently) along with the new HTTPS URL. The viewer then resubmits the request to CloudFront using the HTTPS URL.

### B. Set the Origin Protocol Policy to "Match Viewer"
This controls the **CloudFront-to-ALB** leg. Match viewer: CloudFront communicates with your origin using HTTP or HTTPS, depending on the protocol of the viewer request. Because option E forces all viewer requests to be HTTPS, Match Viewer ensures CloudFront also uses HTTPS to talk to the ALB origin. The AWS docs explicitly pair these two settings: Choose Match Viewer only if you specify Redirect HTTP to HTTPS or HTTPS Only for Viewer Protocol Policy. CloudFront caches the object only once even if viewers make requests using both HTTP and HTTPS protocols.

> Note: "HTTPS Only" for Origin Protocol Policy would also satisfy the requirement, but it isn't offered. Match Viewer combined with E gives the equivalent end-to-end HTTPS guarantee.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Restrict viewer access by using signed URLs** — Signed URLs control **authorization** (who can access content) by validating a signed request. They do not encrypt the data in transit; HTTPS does. Wrong control for the requirement.
- **C. Enable field-level encryption** — Field-level encryption encrypts **specific POST data fields** at the edge with a public key so only designated downstream services can decrypt them. It is an application-layer protection for sensitive fields (e.g., credit card numbers), not a way to encrypt the overall transport channel between viewer/CloudFront/origin. It also requires HTTPS to already be in place — it does not by itself satisfy the "encrypted in transit" requirement.
- **D. Enable automatic object compression** — Compression (gzip/Brotli) reduces payload size for performance/cost. It has no relationship to encryption or transport security.

## Reference Configuration (CLI snippet)

```json
"DefaultCacheBehavior": {
  "ViewerProtocolPolicy": "redirect-to-https"
},
"Origins": {
  "Items": [{
    "CustomOriginConfig": {
      "OriginProtocolPolicy": "match-viewer",
      "OriginSslProtocols": { "Items": ["TLSv1.2"], "Quantity": 1 }
    }
  }]
}
```

## AWS Documentation
- [Require HTTPS for communication between viewers and CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/using-https-viewers-to-cloudfront.html)
- [Require HTTPS for communication between CloudFront and your custom origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/using-https-cloudfront-to-custom-origin.html)
- [CloudFront Origin settings (Match Viewer / HTTPS Only)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesOrigin.html)
- [Request and response behavior for custom origins](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/RequestAndResponseBehaviorCustomOrigin.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在编写一个 Web 应用程序，该应用程序部署在面向互联网的应用程序负载均衡器 (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上。开发人员必须在 ALB 前面添加一个 Amazon CloudFront 分发。开发人员还必须确保来自 VPC 外部的客户数据在传输过程中加密。开发人员应该使用哪两项 CloudFront 配置设置组合来满足这些要求？

options.A: 通过使用签名 URL 来限制查看者访问权限。
options.B: 将源协议策略设置设为匹配查看器。
options.C: 启用字段级加密。
options.D: 启用自动对象压缩。
options.E: 将查看器协议策略设置设为将 HTTP 重定向到 HTTPS。

zh.explanation:
# CloudFront + ALB：加密传输中的客户数据

## 场景
一个网络应用在互联网面向的 ALB 后的 EC2 实例上运行。开发人员将 CloudFront 放在 ALB 前面，必须确保 **VPC 外的客户数据在传输中是加密的**。"VPC 外"包括两个跃点：

1. **Viewer → CloudFront**（通过公网）
2. **CloudFront → ALB（自定义源）**（通过公网）

两个链路都必须使用 HTTPS。问题要求选择两个 CloudFront 设置来实现此端到端加密。

## 正确答案：B 和 E

### E. 将 Viewer Protocol Policy 设置为"Redirect HTTP to HTTPS"
这强制 **viewer-to-CloudFront** 链路使用 HTTPS。要为您的分布启用传输中的加密，您需要配置分布的 viewer protocol policy 以将 HTTP 请求重定向到 HTTPS，或要求 viewer 仅使用 HTTPS 协议访问您的网络内容。使用 Redirect HTTP to HTTPS，viewer 可以使用两种协议，但 HTTP 请求会自动重定向到 HTTPS 请求。CloudFront 返回 HTTP 状态代码 301（永久移动）以及新的 HTTPS URL。viewer 然后使用 HTTPS URL 向 CloudFront 重新提交请求。

### B. 将 Origin Protocol Policy 设置为"Match Viewer"
这控制 **CloudFront-to-ALB** 链路。Match Viewer：CloudFront 根据 viewer 请求的协议使用 HTTP 或 HTTPS 与您的源通信。因为选项 E 强制所有 viewer 请求都是 HTTPS，Match Viewer 确保 CloudFront 也使用 HTTPS 与 ALB 源通信。AWS 文档明确配对这两个设置：仅当您为 Viewer Protocol Policy 指定 Redirect HTTP to HTTPS 或 HTTPS Only 时才选择 Match Viewer。即使 viewer 使用 HTTP 和 HTTPS 协议进行请求，CloudFront 也只缓存该对象一次。

> 注意："HTTPS Only"用于 Origin Protocol Policy 也会满足要求，但它未提供。Match Viewer 与 E 结合提供等效的端到端 HTTPS 保证。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. 使用签名 URL 限制 viewer 访问** — 签名 URL 通过验证签名请求来控制**授权**（谁可以访问内容）。它们不加密传输中的数据；HTTPS 才是。对该需求来说是错误的控制。
- **C. 启用字段级加密** — 字段级加密使用公钥在边缘加密**特定的 POST 数据字段**，以便只有指定的下游服务可以解密。它是对敏感字段（例如信用卡号）的应用层保护，不是加密 viewer/CloudFront/源之间整体传输通道的方式。它还需要 HTTPS 已经就位 — 它本身不满足"传输中加密"要求。
- **D. 启用自动对象压缩** — 压缩（gzip/Brotli）减少有效负载大小以提高性能/成本。它与加密或传输安全无关。

## 参考配置（CLI 片段）

```json
"DefaultCacheBehavior": {
  "ViewerProtocolPolicy": "redirect-to-https"
},
"Origins": {
  "Items": [{
    "CustomOriginConfig": {
      "OriginProtocolPolicy": "match-viewer",
      "OriginSslProtocols": { "Items": ["TLSv1.2"], "Quantity": 1 }
    }
  }]
}
```

## AWS 文档
- [Require HTTPS for communication between viewers and CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/using-https-viewers-to-cloudfront.html)
- [Require HTTPS for communication between CloudFront and your custom origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/using-https-cloudfront-to-custom-origin.html)
- [CloudFront Origin settings (Match Viewer / HTTPS Only)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesOrigin.html)
- [Request and response behavior for custom origins](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/RequestAndResponseBehaviorCustomOrigin.html)

en.question: A developer is implementing an AWS Lambda function that will be invoked when an object is uploaded to Amazon S3. The developer wants to test the Lambda function in a local development machine before publishing the function to a production AWS account. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Upload an object to Amazon S3 by using the aws s3api put-object CLI command. Wait for the local Lambda invocation from the S3 event.
options.B: Create a sample JSON text file for a put object S3 event. Invoke the Lambda function locally. Use the aws lambda invoke CLI command with the JSON file and Lambda function name as arguments.
options.C: Use the sam local start-lambda CLI command to start Lambda. Use the sam local generate-event s3 put CLI command to create the Lambda test JSON file. Use the sam local invoke CLI command with the JSON file as the argument to invoke the Lambda function.
options.D: Create a JSON string for the put object S3 event. In the AWS Management Console, use the JSON string to create a test event for the local Lambda function. Perform the test.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The developer needs to test a Lambda function locally — before deploying to a production AWS account — that is intended to be triggered by an S3 object upload event. The goal is to test with the LEAST operational overhead.

## Correct Answer: C

The AWS SAM CLI is purpose-built for local Lambda development and testing. The standard local-test workflow is:

1. `sam local generate-event s3 put` — produces a sample S3 PUT event JSON payload that mirrors the real event S3 sends to Lambda. The command generates sample payloads from different event sources, such as Amazon S3, Amazon API Gateway, and Amazon SNS. These payloads contain the information that the event sources send to your Lambda functions.
2. `sam local invoke --event events/s3.json <FunctionLogicalId>` — invokes the function locally inside a Lambda-like Docker container using the generated event. The sam local invoke subcommand initiates a one-time invocation of an AWS Lambda function locally.

A typical example: `sam local invoke --event events/s3.json S3JsonLoggerFunction`. SAM also provides `sam local generate-event s3 [put/delete]` which can be customized with flags like `--bucket` and `--key`, and piped directly into `sam local invoke -e -`.

This is the lowest-overhead approach because SAM CLI handles the Lambda runtime emulation, event format, and execution in one toolchain — no S3 bucket or AWS account interaction is required.

## Why the other options are wrong

**A. `aws s3api put-object` waiting for local Lambda invocation** — Real S3 PUT events are delivered by the S3 service to the Lambda service in AWS, not to a local machine. There is no native mechanism for an actual S3 upload to invoke a Lambda running on the developer's laptop. This requires an AWS account, a real bucket, deploying the function, and event-source configuration — the opposite of "test locally with least overhead."

**B. Hand-craft a JSON file and use `aws lambda invoke`** — `aws lambda invoke` is an AWS CLI command that calls the Lambda **service in the cloud**; it does not run code locally. It would require the function to already be deployed, defeating the requirement to test locally before publishing to production. Also, manually authoring the S3 event JSON is more work than `sam local generate-event`.

**D. Use the AWS Management Console test event feature** — The Console's test event feature runs the function in the Lambda service in AWS, not on a local development machine. The question explicitly asks for testing "in a local development machine." Additionally, this requires the function to be uploaded to an AWS account first.

## Reference Workflow

```bash
# 1. Generate a sample S3 PUT event
sam local generate-event s3 put > events/s3.json

# 2. Invoke the function locally with that event
sam local invoke --event events/s3.json MyS3HandlerFunction
```

## Sources

- [Introduction to testing with sam local generate-event](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/using-sam-cli-local-generate-event.html)
- [Introduction to testing with sam local invoke](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/using-sam-cli-local-invoke.html)
- [sam local invoke command reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/sam-cli-command-reference-sam-local-invoke.html)
- [Locally invoke Lambda functions with AWS SAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/serverless-sam-cli-using-invoke.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在实现一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数将在对象上传到 Amazon S3 时被调用。开发人员希望在将 Lambda 函数发布到生产 AWS 账户之前，先在本地开发机器上对其进行测试。哪种解决方案能够以最小的运维开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 aws s3api put-object CLI 命令将对象上传到 Amazon S3。等待 S3 事件触发本地 Lambda 函数调用。
options.B: 创建一个用于向 S3 上传对象的 JSON 文本文件示例。在本地调用 Lambda 函数。使用 `aws lambda invoke` CLI 命令，并将 JSON 文件和 Lambda 函数名称作为参数。
options.C: 使用 `sam local start-lambda` CLI 命令启动 Lambda 函数。使用 `sam local generate-event s3 put` CLI 命令创建 Lambda 测试 JSON 文件。使用 `sam local invoke` CLI 命令，并将该 JSON 文件作为参数传递给 Lambda 函数。
options.D: 为 S3 对象上传事件创建 JSON 字符串。在 AWS 管理控制台中，使用该 JSON 字符串为本地 Lambda 函数创建一个测试事件。执行测试。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

开发人员需要在部署到生产 AWS 账户之前，在本地测试一个 Lambda 函数——该函数旨在由 S3 对象上传事件触发。目标是以最低的操作开销进行测试。

## 正确答案：C

AWS SAM CLI 是为本地 Lambda 开发和测试而专门构建的。标准的本地测试工作流程是：

1. `sam local generate-event s3 put` — 生成一个示例 S3 PUT 事件 JSON 有效负载，镜像 S3 发送给 Lambda 的真实事件。该命令从不同的事件源（如 Amazon S3、Amazon API Gateway 和 Amazon SNS）生成示例有效负载。这些有效负载包含事件源发送给 Lambda 函数的信息。
2. `sam local invoke --event events/s3.json <FunctionLogicalId>` — 使用生成的事件在本地 Lambda 样式的 Docker 容器内调用该函数。sam local invoke 子命令在本地启动 AWS Lambda 函数的一次性调用。

一个典型示例：`sam local invoke --event events/s3.json S3JsonLoggerFunction`。SAM 还提供`sam local generate-event s3 [put/delete]`，可以使用 `--bucket` 和 `--key` 等标志进行自定义，并直接通过管道传输到 `sam local invoke -e -`。

这是最低开销的方法，因为 SAM CLI 在一个工具链中处理 Lambda 运行时仿真、事件格式和执行 — 无需与 S3 桶或 AWS 账户交互。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**A. `aws s3api put-object` 等待本地 Lambda 调用** — 真实的 S3 PUT 事件由 S3 服务在 AWS 中传递给 Lambda 服务，而不是传递给开发人员的本地计算机。没有本机机制来让实际的 S3 上传调用在开发人员笔记本电脑上运行的 Lambda。这需要 AWS 账户、真实的桶、部署该函数以及事件源配置 — 与"以最低开销本地测试"的要求相反。

**B. 手动编写 JSON 文件并使用 `aws lambda invoke`** — `aws lambda invoke` 是一个调用云中 Lambda **服务**的 AWS CLI 命令；它不在本地运行代码。它需要该函数已经部署，违反了在发布到生产之前本地测试的要求。此外，手动编写 S3 事件 JSON 的工作量比 `sam local generate-event` 更多。

**D. 使用 AWS 管理控制台测试事件功能** — 控制台的测试事件功能在 AWS 中的 Lambda 服务中运行该函数，而不是在本地开发计算机上。问题明确要求在"本地开发计算机"上进行测试。此外，这需要该函数首先上传到 AWS 账户。

## 参考工作流程

```bash
# 1. 生成示例 S3 PUT 事件
sam local generate-event s3 put > events/s3.json

# 2. 使用该事件本地调用函数
sam local invoke --event events/s3.json MyS3HandlerFunction
```

## 来源

- [sam local generate-event 测试简介](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/using-sam-cli-local-generate-event.html)
- [sam local invoke 测试简介](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/using-sam-cli-local-invoke.html)
- [sam local invoke 命令参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/sam-cli-command-reference-sam-local-invoke.html)
- [使用 AWS SAM 本地调用 Lambda 函数](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/serverless-sam-cli-using-invoke.html)

en.question: A developer is publishing critical log data to a log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. The log group was created 2 months ago. The developer must encrypt the log data by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key so that future data can be encrypted to comply with the company's security policy. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST effort?

options.A: Use the AWS Encryption SDK for encryption and decryption of the data before writing to the log group.
options.B: Use the AWS KMS console to associate the KMS key with the log group.
options.C: Use the AWS CLI aws logs create-log-group command, and specify the key Amazon Resource Name (ARN).
options.D: Use the AWS CLI aws logs associate-kms-key command, and specify the key Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer has a CloudWatch Logs log group that already exists (created 2 months ago). The company's security policy requires that future log data ingested into this log group be encrypted with a customer-managed AWS KMS key. The developer needs the **least-effort** way to enable KMS encryption on this **existing** log group.

## Correct Answer: D

Use the AWS CLI command `aws logs associate-kms-key --log-group-name <name> --kms-key-id <KMS-Key-ARN>`.

CloudWatch Logs encryption with KMS is enabled at the log group level. Encryption using AWS KMS is enabled at the log group level, by associating a KMS key with a log group, either when you create the log group or after it exists. Since the log group already exists, the `AssociateKmsKey` API (exposed as `aws logs associate-kms-key` in the CLI) is precisely the operation designed for this. Specify the logGroupName parameter to cause log events ingested into that log group to be encrypted with that key. Only the log events ingested after the key is associated are encrypted with that key. This satisfies the requirement that "future data" be encrypted.

```bash
aws logs associate-kms-key \
    --log-group-name my-log-group \
    --kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-...
```

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Use the AWS Encryption SDK before writing to the log group** — This requires the developer to write/modify application code to perform client-side encryption and to manage decryption when reading logs. CloudWatch Logs would no longer be able to render logs in plaintext for searches/Insights queries. This is far more effort than a single CLI call and is not the native way to encrypt CloudWatch Logs.

- **B. Use the AWS KMS console to associate the KMS key with the log group** — There is no workflow in the KMS console (or even the CloudWatch console) to attach a KMS key to an **existing** log group. Per AWS guidance, you can't use the CloudWatch console to associate an AWS KMS key with an existing log group; to associate an AWS KMS key after you created it, run the associate-kms-key command. So this option is not possible.

- **C. Use `aws logs create-log-group` and specify the key ARN** — `create-log-group` only works when **creating** a new log group. The log group already exists (it was created 2 months ago), so running create-log-group would either fail (ResourceAlreadyExists) or require deleting and recreating the log group, losing 2 months of historical log data. That is the opposite of "least effort."

## References
- [Encrypt log data in CloudWatch Logs using AWS KMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/encrypt-log-data-kms.html)
- [AWS CLI: aws logs associate-kms-key](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/reference/logs/associate-kms-key.html)
- [AssociateKmsKey API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatchLogs/latest/APIReference/API_AssociateKmsKey.html)
- [re:Post – Use AWS KMS to encrypt CloudWatch Logs data](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/cloudwatch-encrypt-log-data)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在将关键日志数据发布到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中的一个日志组。该日志组创建于两个月前。开发人员必须使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 密钥对日志数据进行加密，以便将来也能加密数据，从而符合公司的安全策略。哪种解决方案能够以最少的投入满足此要求？

options.A: 在将数据写入日志组之前，使用 AWS 加密 SDK 对数据进行加密和解密。
options.B: 使用 AWS KMS 控制台将 KMS 密钥与日志组关联。
options.C: 使用 AWS CLI aws logs create-log-group 命令，并指定键 Amazon 资源名称 (ARN)。
options.D: 使用 AWS CLI aws logs associate-kms-key 命令，并指定密钥 Amazon 资源名称 (ARN)。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

开发人员拥有一个已存在的 CloudWatch Logs 日志组（创建于 2 个月前）。公司的安全策略要求将来摄取到该日志组的日志数据必须用客户托管的 AWS KMS 密钥进行加密。开发人员需要以**最小工作量**的方式在这个**现有**日志组上启用 KMS 加密。

## 正确答案：D

使用 AWS CLI 命令 `aws logs associate-kms-key --log-group-name <name> --kms-key-id <KMS-Key-ARN>`。

CloudWatch Logs 的 KMS 加密在日志组级别启用。使用 AWS KMS 的加密在日志组级别启用，方法是将 KMS 密钥与日志组关联，可以在创建日志组时进行，也可以在日志组创建后进行。由于日志组已存在，`AssociateKmsKey` API（在 CLI 中公开为 `aws logs associate-kms-key`）正是为此设计的操作。指定 logGroupName 参数会导致摄取到该日志组的日志事件用该密钥进行加密。只有在密钥关联后摄取的日志事件才会用该密钥加密。这满足了"将来的数据"被加密的要求。

```bash
aws logs associate-kms-key \
    --log-group-name my-log-group \
    --kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-...
```

## 其他选项为什么错误

- **A. 在写入日志组前使用 AWS Encryption SDK 进行加密** — 这要求开发人员编写/修改应用程序代码来执行客户端加密，并在读取日志时管理解密。CloudWatch Logs 将无法以纯文本形式呈现日志用于搜索/Insights 查询。这比单个 CLI 调用需要更多工作，也不是加密 CloudWatch Logs 的原生方式。

- **B. 使用 AWS KMS 控制台将 KMS 密钥与日志组关联** — KMS 控制台（甚至 CloudWatch 控制台）中没有工作流可以将 KMS 密钥附加到**现有**日志组。根据 AWS 指导，不能使用 CloudWatch 控制台将 AWS KMS 密钥与现有日志组关联；要在创建日志组后关联 AWS KMS 密钥，请运行 associate-kms-key 命令。所以这个选项是不可能的。

- **C. 使用 `aws logs create-log-group` 并指定密钥 ARN** — `create-log-group` 仅在**创建**新日志组时有效。该日志组已存在（创建于 2 个月前），运行 create-log-group 要么会失败（ResourceAlreadyExists），要么需要删除并重新创建日志组，这样会丢失 2 个月的历史日志数据。这正好与"最小工作量"相反。

## 参考资源
- [使用 AWS KMS 加密 CloudWatch Logs 中的日志数据](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/encrypt-log-data-kms.html)
- [AWS CLI：aws logs associate-kms-key](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/reference/logs/associate-kms-key.html)
- [AssociateKmsKey API 参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatchLogs/latest/APIReference/API_AssociateKmsKey.html)
- [re:Post – 使用 AWS KMS 加密 CloudWatch Logs 数据](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/cloudwatch-encrypt-log-data)

en.question: A developer is working on an app for a company that uses an Amazon DynamoDB table named Orders to store customer orders. The table uses OrderID as the partition key and there is no sort key. The table contains more than 100,000 records. The developer needs to add a functionality that will retrieve all Orders records that contain an OrderSource attribute with the MobileApp value. Which solution will improve the user experience in the MOST efficient way?

options.A: Perform a Scan operation on the Orders table. Provide a QueryFilter condition to filter to only the items where the OrderSource attribute is equal to the MobileApp value.
options.B: Create a local secondary index (LSI) with OrderSource as the partition key. Perform a Query operation by using MobileApp as the key.
options.C: Create a global secondary index (GSI) with OrderSource as the sort key. Perform a Query operation by using MobileApp as the key.
options.D: Create a global secondary index (GSI) with OrderSource as the partition key. Perform a Query operation by using MobileApp as the key.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The Orders table has `OrderID` as its only partition key (no sort key) and contains 100,000+ items. The developer wants to retrieve all orders where `OrderSource = "MobileApp"`. The question asks for the MOST efficient way to support this access pattern.

## Correct Answer: D — Create a GSI with `OrderSource` as the partition key, then Query using `MobileApp`

A Query operation in DynamoDB requires an equality condition on the partition key. By making `OrderSource` the **partition key** of a GSI, all items with `OrderSource = "MobileApp"` are grouped together in the index, and a single Query with `KeyConditionExpression: OrderSource = :MobileApp` will efficiently return them.

A global secondary index has a partition key and a sort key that can be different from those on the base table. A global secondary index is considered "global" because queries on the index can span all of the data in the base table, across all partitions, and has its own provisioned throughput.

Except for Scan, DynamoDB API operations require an equality operator (EQ) on the partition key for tables and GSIs. As a result, the partition key must be something that is easily queried by your application with a simple lookup.

This is exactly the use case: an equality lookup on `OrderSource = "MobileApp"`.

## Why the other options are wrong

### A. Scan with QueryFilter
A Scan reads **every item** in the table (100,000+ records) and then applies the filter, consuming RCUs for all items scanned (not just the matched ones). This is the least efficient option and contradicts DynamoDB best practices for repeated access patterns. If retrieving all orders is not a commonly requested access pattern, we can utilize a Scan operation and filter the results, however this method may prove inefficient in terms of both performance and cost. If this access pattern is frequently requested, we require an alternative approach. Also, `QueryFilter` is not a valid parameter for Scan — Scan uses `FilterExpression`.

### B. LSI with OrderSource as partition key
Two fatal problems:
1. A local secondary index has the same partition key as the base table, but a different sort key. An LSI cannot have a different partition key — it must keep `OrderID`. So the option's design is impossible.
2. You need to add the sort key at the initial table creation stage as you cannot add a sort key to an already existing table. LSIs can only be created at table-creation time, not added to an existing table.

### C. GSI with OrderSource as the sort key
A Query requires an **equality condition on the partition key**. If `OrderSource` is only a sort key, you'd still need a partition key value to query — but the option doesn't define one (and `OrderID` as PK with `OrderSource` as SK would still require knowing the OrderID first, defeating the purpose). You cannot Query a GSI by sort key alone. This makes the design unusable for "fetch all MobileApp orders" without resorting to a Scan.

## Reference

- [Using Global Secondary Indexes in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GSI.html)
- [General guidelines for secondary indexes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-indexes-general.html)
- [Choosing the Right DynamoDB Partition Key](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/choosing-the-right-dynamodb-partition-key/)

```python
# Query the GSI
response = dynamodb.query(
    TableName='Orders',
    IndexName='OrderSource-index',
    KeyConditionExpression='OrderSource = :src',
    ExpressionAttributeValues={':src': {'S': 'MobileApp'}}
)
```

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在为一家公司开发一款应用程序，该应用程序使用名为 Orders 的 Amazon DynamoDB 表来存储客户订单。该表使用 OrderID 作为分区键，但没有排序键。该表包含超过 10 万条记录。开发人员需要添加一个功能，用于检索所有 OrderSource 属性值为 MobileApp 的 Orders 记录。哪种解决方案能够以最有效的方式改善用户体验？

options.A: 对 Orders 表执行扫描操作。提供 QueryFilter 条件，筛选出 OrderSource 属性等于 MobileApp 值的项。
options.B: 创建一个以 OrderSource 为分区键的本地二级索引 (LSI)。使用 MobileApp 作为键执行查询操作。
options.C: 创建一个以 OrderSource 为排序键的全局二级索引 (GSI)。使用 MobileApp 作为键执行查询操作。
options.D: 创建一个全局二级索引 (GSI)，以 OrderSource 作为分区键。使用 MobileApp 作为键执行查询操作。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

Orders 表的 `OrderID` 是唯一的分区键（无排序键），包含 100,000+ 项。开发者想要检索所有 `OrderSource = "MobileApp"` 的订单。该问题要求找到支持这种访问模式的最有效方式。

## 正确答案：D — 使用 `OrderSource` 作为分区键创建 GSI，然后使用 Query 查询 `MobileApp`

DynamoDB 中的 Query 操作需要在分区键上使用等值条件。通过让 `OrderSource` 成为 GSI 的**分区键**，所有 `OrderSource = "MobileApp"` 的项都会在索引中分组在一起，单个 Query 操作使用 `KeyConditionExpression: OrderSource = :MobileApp` 将高效地返回结果。

全局二级索引具有可能与基表不同的分区键和排序键。全局二级索引被称为"全局"是因为对该索引的查询可以跨越基表中的所有数据、跨越所有分区，并且具有自己预配置的吞吐量。

除了 Scan 外，DynamoDB API 操作要求在表和 GSI 的分区键上使用等值操作符 (EQ)。因此，分区键必须是应用程序可以通过简单查找轻松查询的内容。

这正是使用场景：对 `OrderSource = "MobileApp"` 进行等值查询。

## 其他选项为什么是错误的

### A. 使用 QueryFilter 进行 Scan
Scan 读取表中的**每一项**（100,000+ 条记录），然后应用过滤器，消耗所有被扫描项的 RCU（不仅仅是匹配的项）。这是效率最低的选项，违反了 DynamoDB 重复访问模式的最佳实践。如果检索所有订单不是常见的请求访问模式，我们可以使用 Scan 操作并过滤结果，但这种方法在性能和成本方面可能不太有效。如果经常请求此访问模式，我们需要采用替代方案。此外，`QueryFilter` 不是 Scan 的有效参数 — Scan 使用 `FilterExpression`。

### B. 使用 OrderSource 作为分区键的 LSI
存在两个致命问题：
1. 本地二级索引具有与基表相同的分区键，但排序键不同。LSI 不能有不同的分区键 — 它必须保持 `OrderID`。所以该选项的设计是不可能的。
2. 您需要在初始表创建阶段添加排序键，因为您不能将排序键添加到已存在的表。LSI 只能在表创建时创建，不能添加到现有表。

### C. 使用 OrderSource 作为排序键的 GSI
Query 需要在**分区键上使用等值条件**。如果 `OrderSource` 仅是排序键，您仍然需要分区键值来进行查询 — 但该选项没有定义一个（而 `OrderID` 作为 PK、`OrderSource` 作为 SK 仍需要先知道 OrderID，这违反了目的）。您无法仅通过排序键对 GSI 进行 Query。这使得设计对于"获取所有 MobileApp 订单"无法使用，除非求助于 Scan。

## 参考

- [在 DynamoDB 中使用全局二级索引](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GSI.html)
- [二级索引的一般指南](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-indexes-general.html)
- [选择正确的 DynamoDB 分区键](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/choosing-the-right-dynamodb-partition-key/)

```python
# Query GSI
response = dynamodb.query(
    TableName='Orders',
    IndexName='OrderSource-index',
    KeyConditionExpression='OrderSource = :src',
    ExpressionAttributeValues={':src': {'S': 'MobileApp'}}
)
```

en.question: A company has an application that uses an AWS Lambda function to process data. A developer must implement encryption in transit for all sensitive configuration data, such as API keys, that is stored in the application. The developer creates an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. What should the developer do next to meet the encryption requirement?

options.A: Create parameters of the String type in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. For each parameter, specify the KMS key ID to encrypt the parameter in transit. Reference the GetParameter API call in the Lambda environment variables.
options.B: Create secrets in AWS Secrets Manager by using the customer managed KMS key. Create a new Lambda function and set up a Lambda layer. Configure the Lambda layer to retrieve the values from Secrets Manager.
options.C: Create objects in Amazon S3 for each sensitive data field. Specify the customer managed KMS key to encrypt the object. Configure the Lambda function to retrieve the objects from Amazon S3 during data processing.
options.D: Create encrypted Lambda environment variables. Specify the customer managed KMS key to encrypt the variables. Enable encryption helpers for encryption in transit. Grant permission to the Lambda function's execution role to access the KMS key.

en.explanation:
# Encryption in Transit for Lambda Environment Variables

## Scenario
A developer must implement **encryption in transit** for sensitive configuration data (API keys) used by a Lambda function. A KMS customer managed key (CMK) has already been created. The question asks the next step.

## Correct Answer: D

Lambda has a built-in feature called **encryption helpers** that performs **client-side encryption** of environment variables using a KMS key. When enabled, the variable values are encrypted in the browser/client before being transmitted to the Lambda service — this is precisely "encryption in transit."

Per AWS docs, the procedure is to enable console encryption helpers to use client-side encryption to protect your data in transit, choose Enable helpers for encryption in transit, choose Encrypt next to each environment variable, and select a customer managed KMS key to encrypt in transit. AWS Prescriptive Guidance also explicitly states: "For data in transit that requires encryption, enable helpers, which ensures that environment variables are encrypted client-side for protection in transit by using the preferred KMS key."

The Lambda execution role also needs KMS permissions: if you're enabling client-side encryption for security in transit, your function needs permission to call the kms:Decrypt API operation; add the policy to the function's execution role. This is exactly what option D describes — encrypted env vars + customer managed KMS key + encryption helpers + execution role permission.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Systems Manager Parameter Store String type** — The `String` parameter type is **plain text and not encrypted**. To encrypt a parameter with KMS in Parameter Store you must use the `SecureString` type, not `String`. Also, referencing `GetParameter` "in the Lambda environment variables" is not a valid mechanism (env vars cannot directly invoke API calls).

- **B. Secrets Manager + Lambda layer** — While Secrets Manager is a valid pattern (and AWS even recommends it for credentials), the option specifies creating a *new* Lambda function and a *layer* to retrieve the secrets. This is more complex than needed and the question asks specifically what to do *next* after creating the KMS key for encrypting configuration data already stored in the application. Also, an environment-variable-based encryption helper is the most direct fit; the Lambda layer description is contrived (layers don't natively "retrieve values from Secrets Manager" — code does). Some commenters argue B is correct because of the "in transit" wording, but the encryption helpers feature explicitly satisfies in-transit encryption.

- **C. S3 objects per field** — Storing each sensitive value as an individual S3 object is operationally awkward, and SSE-KMS encrypts data **at rest** in S3, not specifically in transit (TLS handles that automatically and doesn't require the CMK). Doesn't match the configuration-data use case.

## Key AWS Documentation
- [Securing Lambda environment variables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-envvars-encryption.html)
- [Encryption best practices for AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/encryption-best-practices/lambda.html)

## Required IAM Permission Snippet
```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:REGION:ACCOUNT_ID:key/KEY_ID"
}
```

zh.question: 一家公司有一个使用 AWS Lambda 函数处理数据的应用程序。开发人员必须对应用程序中存储的所有敏感配置数据（例如 API 密钥）实现传输加密。开发人员创建了一个 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户托管密钥。为了满足加密要求，开发人员接下来应该做什么？

options.A: 在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中创建字符串类型的参数。对于每个参数，指定 KMS 密钥 ID 以加密传输中的参数。在 Lambda 环境变量中引用 GetParameter API 调用。
options.B: 使用客户管理的 KMS 密钥在 AWS Secrets Manager 中创建密钥。创建一个新的 Lambda 函数并设置 Lambda 层。配置 Lambda 层以从 Secrets Manager 中检索值。
options.C: 为每个敏感数据字段在 Amazon S3 中创建对象。指定客户管理的 KMS 密钥来加密对象。配置 Lambda 函数，以便在数据处理期间从 Amazon S3 中检索对象。
options.D: 创建加密的 Lambda 环境变量。指定客户管理的 KMS 密钥来加密这些变量。启用加密辅助函数以实现传输中加密。授予 Lambda 函数的执行角色访问 KMS 密钥的权限。

zh.explanation:
# Lambda 环境变量的传输中加密

## 场景
开发人员必须为 Lambda 函数使用的敏感配置数据（API 密钥）实现**传输中加密**。已经创建了 KMS 客户托管密钥 (CMK)。问题要求下一步操作。

## 正确答案：D

Lambda 具有称为**加密助手**的内置功能，使用 KMS 密钥执行环境变量的**客户端加密**。启用后，变量值在传输到 Lambda 服务之前在浏览器/客户端中进行加密 — 这正是"传输中加密"的含义。

根据 AWS 文档，操作步骤是启用控制台加密助手以使用客户端加密保护传输中的数据、选择启用传输中加密的助手、在每个环境变量旁边选择加密、以及选择客户托管 KMS 密钥以进行传输中加密。AWS Prescriptive Guidance 也明确声明："对于需要加密的传输中数据，启用助手，这可确保环境变量通过使用首选 KMS 密钥在客户端进行加密以保护传输中的数据。"

Lambda 执行角色还需要 KMS 权限：如果启用客户端加密以确保传输中的安全性，函数需要有权限调用 kms:Decrypt API 操作；将策略添加到函数的执行角色。这正是选项 D 所描述的 — 加密的环境变量 + 客户托管 KMS 密钥 + 加密助手 + 执行角色权限。

## 其他选项为什么错误

- **A. Systems Manager Parameter Store String 类型** — `String` 参数类型是**纯文本且未加密**。要在 Parameter Store 中使用 KMS 加密参数，必须使用 `SecureString` 类型，而不是 `String`。此外，在 Lambda 环境变量中引用 `GetParameter` "不是有效的机制（环境变量不能直接调用 API）。

- **B. Secrets Manager + Lambda 层** — 虽然 Secrets Manager 是有效的方案（AWS 甚至为凭证推荐它），但该选项指定创建*新的* Lambda 函数和*层*来检索机密。这比所需的更复杂，问题特别要求在创建 KMS 密钥后的*下一步*，用于加密已存储在应用程序中的配置数据。此外，基于环境变量的加密助手是最直接的方式；Lambda 层的描述过于复杂（层本身不能本地"从 Secrets Manager 检索值" — 代码才能）。有些评论者认为 B 正确是因为"传输中"的措辞，但加密助手功能明确满足传输中加密的需求。

- **C. 每个字段对应 S3 对象** — 将每个敏感值存储为单个 S3 对象在操作上很笨拙，并且 SSE-KMS 加密 S3 中**静态**的数据，不是特别针对传输中（TLS 自动处理且不需要 CMK）。与配置数据用例不匹配。

## 关键 AWS 文档
- [保护 Lambda 环境变量](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-envvars-encryption.html)
- [AWS Lambda 加密最佳实践](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/encryption-best-practices/lambda.html)

## 所需的 IAM 权限代码片段
```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:REGION:ACCOUNT_ID:key/KEY_ID"
}
```

en.question: A developer is building an ecommerce application. When there is a sale event, the application needs to concurrently call three third-party systems to record the sale. The developer wrote three AWS Lambda functions. There is one Lambda function for each third-party system, which contains complex integration logic. These Lambda functions are all independent. The developer needs to design the application so each Lambda function will run regardless of others' success or failure. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Publish the sale event from the application to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the three Lambda functions to poll the queue.
options.B: Publish the sale event from the application to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the three Lambda functions to be triggered by the SNS topic.
options.C: Publish the sale event from the application to an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Add the three Lambda functions as ALB targets.
options.D: Publish the sale event from the application to an AWS Step Functions state machine. Move the logic from the three Lambda functions into the Step Functions state machine.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The application needs to invoke three independent Lambda functions concurrently when a sale event occurs. Each function must run independently — the success or failure of one must not affect the others. This is the classic **fan-out** pattern.

## Correct Answer: B — Amazon SNS topic with three Lambda subscribers

Amazon SNS is a pub/sub service designed exactly for this use case. In a fanout architecture, any message published on an SNS topic is replicated and sent to multiple subscriber endpoints, which allows parallel asynchronous processing. This means a single message can be sent to different endpoints, such as SQS queues and Lambda functions, where it will be used for further processing.

When the application publishes the sale event to the SNS topic, the Lambda function is invoked with the payload of the published message for each subscribed function. Each function is invoked independently and asynchronously, so a failure in one subscriber does not affect delivery to or execution of the others. Lambda processes SNS messages asynchronously by queuing the messages and handling retries. If Amazon SNS can't reach Lambda or the message is rejected, Amazon SNS retries at increasing intervals over several hours.

Example setup:
```bash
aws sns create-topic --name SaleEvents

aws sns subscribe --topic-arn arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:SaleEvents \
  --protocol lambda --notification-endpoint arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:function:Function1
# Repeat for Function2 and Function3
```

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. SQS queue with three Lambdas polling the same queue** — SQS delivers each message to **only one consumer**. Once a Lambda function (via event source mapping) receives and deletes the message, the other two functions will never see it. SQS is a point-to-point queue, not pub/sub, so it cannot fan out a single event to all three systems.

- **C. Application Load Balancer with Lambdas as targets** — ALB routes each incoming HTTP request to **a single target** based on listener/target group rules; it does not duplicate a request to multiple Lambda targets. ALB is for synchronous request routing, not event fan-out.

- **D. Step Functions state machine, moving logic into the state machine** — The requirement explicitly says the existing Lambda functions contain complex integration logic and should be kept. Rewriting them into Step Functions states is an unnecessary refactor. Although Step Functions Parallel state could call all three, the question asks for a solution that uses the existing Lambdas while ensuring each runs independently — SNS fan-out is the simpler, correct fit. Also, "publishing to a state machine" isn't how Step Functions is invoked (you start an execution).

## References

- [Fanout to Lambda functions (SNS Developer Guide)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-lambda-as-subscriber.html)
- [Invoking Lambda functions with Amazon SNS notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sns.html)
- [Messaging Fanout Pattern for Serverless Architectures Using Amazon SNS](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/messaging-fanout-pattern-for-serverless-architectures-using-amazon-sns/)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在构建一个电子商务应用程序。当发生促销活动时，该应用程序需要同时调用三个第三方系统来记录销售信息。开发人员编写了三个 AWS Lambda 函数，每个第三方系统对应一个 Lambda 函数，其中包含复杂的集成逻辑。这些 Lambda 函数彼此独立。开发人员需要设计应用程序，使得每个 Lambda 函数都能独立运行，不受其他函数执行成功或失败的影响。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 将销售事件从应用程序发布到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。配置三个 Lambda 函数来轮询该队列。
options.B: 将应用程序中的销售事件发布到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。订阅三个 Lambda 函数，使其由该 SNS 主题触发。
options.C: 将销售事件从应用程序发布到应用程序负载均衡器 (ALB)。将三个 Lambda 函数添加为 ALB 目标。
options.D: 将销售事件从应用程序发布到 AWS Step Functions 状态机。将逻辑从三个 Lambda 函数迁移到 Step Functions 状态机中。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

应用需要在发生销售事件时并发调用三个独立的 Lambda 函数。每个函数必须独立运行 — 一个函数的成功或失败不得影响其他函数。这是经典的**扇出**模式。

## 正确答案：B — Amazon SNS 主题（带三个 Lambda 订阅者）

Amazon SNS 是一个发布/订阅服务，专为此用例设计。在扇出架构中，发布到 SNS 主题的任何消息都会被复制并发送到多个订阅者端点，这允许并行异步处理。这意味着单个消息可以被发送到不同的端点，如 SQS 队列和 Lambda 函数，进行进一步处理。

当应用将销售事件发布到 SNS 主题时，Lambda 函数会使用已发布消息的有效载荷进行调用，每个订阅的函数都会收到。每个函数独立异步调用，因此一个订阅者的失败不会影响其他订阅者的交付或执行。Lambda 通过对消息进行队列处理并处理重试来异步处理 SNS 消息。如果 Amazon SNS 无法到达 Lambda 或消息被拒绝，Amazon SNS 会在数小时内以递增的间隔重试。

示例设置：
```bash
aws sns create-topic --name SaleEvents

aws sns subscribe --topic-arn arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:SaleEvents \
  --protocol lambda --notification-endpoint arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:function:Function1
# 对 Function2 和 Function3 重复操作
```

## 其他选项为何错误

- **A. SQS 队列（带三个轮询同一队列的 Lambda）** — SQS 仅将每条消息传递给**一个消费者**。一旦 Lambda 函数（通过事件源映射）接收并删除消息，其他两个函数将永远看不到它。SQS 是点对点队列，不是发布/订阅，因此无法将单个事件扇出到所有三个系统。

- **C. 应用负载均衡器（带 Lambda 作为目标）** — ALB 根据侦听器/目标组规则将每个传入 HTTP 请求路由到**单个目标**；它不会将请求复制到多个 Lambda 目标。ALB 用于同步请求路由，而非事件扇出。

- **D. Step Functions 状态机（将逻辑移动到状态机）** — 需求明确指出现有 Lambda 函数包含复杂的集成逻辑，应保持不变。将它们重写为 Step Functions 状态是不必要的重构。虽然 Step Functions Parallel 状态可以调用全部三个函数，但问题要求使用现有 Lambda 的解决方案，同时确保每个函数独立运行 — SNS 扇出是更简单、正确的选择。另外，"发布到状态机"不是 Step Functions 的调用方式（你启动一个执行）。

## 参考资源

- [扇出到 Lambda 函数（SNS 开发者指南）](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-lambda-as-subscriber.html)
- [使用 Amazon SNS 通知调用 Lambda 函数](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sns.html)
- [使用 Amazon SNS 的无服务器架构消息扇出模式](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/messaging-fanout-pattern-for-serverless-architectures-using-amazon-sns/)

en.question: A developer is writing an application, which stores data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. The developer wants to query the DynamoDB table by using the partition key and a different sort key value. The developer needs the latest data with all recent write operations. How should the developer write the DynamoDB query?

options.A: Add a local secondary index (LSI) during table creation. Query the LSI by using eventually consistent reads.
options.B: Add a local secondary index (LSI) during table creation. Query the LSI by using strongly consistent reads.
options.C: Add a global secondary index (GSI) during table creation. Query the GSI by using eventually consistent reads.
options.D: Add a global secondary index (GSI) during table creation. Query the GSI by using strongly consistent reads.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The developer needs to query a DynamoDB table using the **same partition key** but with a **different sort key**, and must read the **latest data** (i.e., reflecting all recent writes — strongly consistent reads).

Two key DynamoDB design decisions drive the answer:
1. **Which index type** allows querying with the same partition key but a different sort key?
2. **Which index type** supports strongly consistent reads?

## Correct Answer: B — LSI with strongly consistent reads

**Local Secondary Index (LSI)** is the right index type:
- An LSI lets you use the same partition key but query using a different sort key.
- LSIs must be defined at table creation and share the same partition key as the base table, which matches "Add an LSI during table creation."

**Strongly consistent reads** are required because the developer needs the latest data:
- If you set ConsistentRead to true, DynamoDB returns a response with the most up-to-date data, reflecting the updates from all prior write operations that were successful. Strongly consistent reads are only supported on tables and local secondary indexes.
- By default, all reads from a local secondary index are eventually consistent. However, you may opt into a strongly consistent read if you need it.

## Why the other options are wrong

**A. LSI with eventually consistent reads** — Wrong consistency choice. When issuing eventually consistent reads to a DynamoDB table or an index, the responses may not reflect the results of a recently completed write operation. The requirement explicitly states the developer needs the latest data with all recent writes, so eventually consistent reads do not satisfy the requirement.

**C. GSI with eventually consistent reads** — Two problems. First, a GSI is unnecessary because the partition key is unchanged (LSIs are designed for "same partition key, different sort key"). Second, eventual consistency does not guarantee the latest data.

**D. GSI with strongly consistent reads** — Not possible. Strongly consistent reads from a global secondary index or a DynamoDB stream are not supported. With a global secondary index, you don't have this option. All reads from a global secondary index are eventually consistent. A GSI configured with `ConsistentRead=true` would throw a validation error.

## Summary

| Requirement | Index choice |
|---|---|
| Same partition key, different sort key | LSI |
| Latest data (read-after-write) | Strongly consistent read (only LSI/base table support this) |

Both requirements are satisfied **only** by an LSI with strongly consistent reads → **Answer B**.

## References
- [DynamoDB read consistency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/HowItWorks.ReadConsistency.html)
- [Local Secondary Indexes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/LSI.html)
- [Global Secondary Indexes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GSI.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在编写一个应用程序，该应用程序将数据存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。开发人员希望使用分区键和不同的排序键值来查询 DynamoDB 表。开发人员需要包含所有最近写入操作的最新数据。开发人员应该如何编写 DynamoDB 查询？

options.A: 在创建表时添加本地二级索引（LSI）。使用最终一致性读取来查询 LSI。
options.B: 在创建表时添加本地二级索引（LSI）。使用强一致性读取查询 LSI。
options.C: 在创建表时添加全局二级索引 (GSI)。使用最终一致性读取来查询 GSI。
options.D: 在创建表时添加全局二级索引 (GSI)。使用强一致性读取查询 GSI。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

开发者需要使用**相同的分区键**但**不同的排序键**查询 DynamoDB 表，并且必须读取**最新数据**（即反映所有最近的写入操作——强一致性读取）。

两个关键的 DynamoDB 设计决策驱动答案：
1. **哪种索引类型**允许使用相同的分区键但不同的排序键进行查询？
2. **哪种索引类型**支持强一致性读取？

## 正确答案：B — LSI 与强一致性读取

**本地二级索引 (LSI)** 是正确的索引类型：
- LSI 让你能够使用相同的分区键但使用不同的排序键进行查询。
- LSI 必须在表创建时定义，并与基表共享相同的分区键，这与"在表创建期间添加 LSI"相符。

**强一致性读取**是必需的，因为开发者需要最新数据：
- 如果将 ConsistentRead 设置为 true，DynamoDB 返回具有最新数据的响应，反映所有之前成功的写入操作的更新。强一致性读取仅在表和本地二级索引上受支持。
- 默认情况下，从本地二级索引的所有读取都是最终一致的。但是，如果需要，你可以选择加入强一致性读取。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**A. LSI 与最终一致性读取** — 错误的一致性选择。当对 DynamoDB 表或索引发出最终一致性读取时，响应可能不反映最近完成的写入操作的结果。需求明确指出开发者需要包含所有最近写入的最新数据，因此最终一致性读取不满足要求。

**C. GSI 与最终一致性读取** — 有两个问题。首先，GSI 是不必要的，因为分区键没有改变（LSI 设计用于"相同分区键，不同排序键"）。其次，最终一致性不能保证最新数据。

**D. GSI 与强一致性读取** — 不可能。不支持从全局二级索引或 DynamoDB 流进行强一致性读取。对于全局二级索引，你没有此选项。从全局二级索引的所有读取都是最终一致的。配置有 `ConsistentRead=true` 的 GSI 会抛出验证错误。

## 总结

| 需求 | 索引选择 |
|---|---|
| 相同分区键，不同排序键 | LSI |
| 最新数据（读取后写入） | 强一致性读取（仅 LSI/基表支持） |

两个需求**仅由**带有强一致性读取的 LSI 满足 → **答案 B**。

## 参考资源
- [DynamoDB 读取一致性](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/HowItWorks.ReadConsistency.html)
- [本地二级索引](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/LSI.html)
- [全局二级索引](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GSI.html)

en.question: A developer manages an application that writes customer orders to an Amazon DynamoDB table. The orders use customer_id as the partition key, order_id as the sort key, and order_date as an attribute. A new access pattern requires accessing data by order_date and order_id. The developer needs to implement a new AWS Lambda function to support the new access pattern. How should the developer support the new access pattern in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Add a new local secondary index (LSI) to the DynamoDB table that specifies order_date as the partition key and order_id as the sort key. Write the new Lambda function to query the new LSI index.
options.B: Write the new Lambda function to scan the DynamoDB table. In the Lambda function, write a method to retrieve and combine results by order_date and order_id.
options.C: Add a new global secondary index (GSI) to the DynamoDB table that specifies order_date as the partition key and order_id as the sort key. Write the new Lambda function to query the new GSI index.
options.D: Enable DynamoDB Streams on the table. Choose the new and old images information to write to the DynamoDB stream. Write the new Lambda function to query the DynamoDB stream

en.explanation:
# DynamoDB: Supporting a New Access Pattern with a GSI

## Scenario
The base table uses `customer_id` (partition key) and `order_id` (sort key), with `order_date` as a non-key attribute. A new access pattern requires querying by `order_date` (partition key) and `order_id` (sort key). The developer must choose the most operationally efficient option.

## Correct Answer: C — Add a Global Secondary Index (GSI)

A GSI is the right tool because the new access pattern needs a **completely different partition key** (`order_date`) than the base table's partition key (`customer_id`).

Per the AWS documentation, a Global Secondary Index is an index with a partition key and a sort key that can be different from those on the base table. It is "global" because queries on the index can span all of the data in the base table, across all partitions, and it has its own provisioned throughput settings separate from the table.

Additionally, unlike LSI, you can add a GSI to an existing DynamoDB table, which makes this the operationally efficient choice—no table rebuild is necessary. The Lambda function can then issue efficient `Query` operations against the new GSI on `order_date` + `order_id`.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

### A. Local Secondary Index (LSI)
An LSI requires the **same partition key** as the base table. Per AWS, an LSI is an index that has the same partition key as the base table, but a different sort key; it is "local" in the sense that every partition of a local secondary index is scoped to a base table partition that has the same partition key value. Since the new access pattern needs `order_date` as the **partition key** (not `customer_id`), an LSI cannot satisfy it. Also, an LSI cannot be added or removed after the table has been created; it must be defined at the time of table creation, so adding one to an existing table isn't even possible.

### B. Scan the table and filter in Lambda
A `Scan` reads every item in the table, consuming large amounts of RCU and increasing latency and cost as the table grows. This is the opposite of "operationally efficient" and is explicitly discouraged when secondary indexes can support the access pattern.

### D. DynamoDB Streams
DynamoDB automatically handles item additions, updates, and deletes in a GSI when corresponding changes are made to the table asynchronously. Streams capture **change events** (inserts/updates/deletes) — they are not a queryable store of historical data. You cannot run ad-hoc queries by `order_date` and `order_id` against a stream; streams are intended for change-data-capture / event-driven processing, not random-access reads.

## Reference Query Pattern (after creating the GSI)

```python
import boto3
from boto3.dynamodb.conditions import Key

table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table('Orders')

response = table.query(
    IndexName='OrderDateIndex',
    KeyConditionExpression=Key('order_date').eq('2025-01-15') &
                           Key('order_id').begins_with('ORD-')
)
```

## References
- [Using Global Secondary Indexes in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GSI.html)
- [General guidelines for secondary indexes in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-indexes-general.html)
- [Difference between GSI and LSI (AWS re:Post)](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/dynamodb-gsi-lsi-difference)

zh.explanation:
# DynamoDB：使用 GSI 支持新的访问模式

## 场景
基表使用 `customer_id`（分区键）和 `order_id`（排序键），`order_date` 是非键属性。新的访问模式需要按 `order_date`（分区键）和 `order_id`（排序键）查询。开发人员必须选择操作效率最高的选项。

## 正确答案：C — 添加全局二级索引 (GSI)

GSI 是正确的工具，因为新的访问模式需要一个**完全不同的分区键**（`order_date`），而不是基表的分区键（`customer_id`）。

根据 AWS 文档，全局二级索引是具有分区键和排序键的索引，这些键可以与基表上的键不同。它是"全局"的，因为对索引的查询可以跨越基表中的所有数据（跨越所有分区），并且它具有独立于表的预配置吞吐量设置。

此外，与 LSI 不同，你可以向现有 DynamoDB 表添加 GSI，这使其成为操作效率高的选择——无需重建表。Lambda 函数随后可以针对 `order_date` + `order_id` 的新 GSI 执行高效的 `Query` 操作。

## 其他选项为什么错误

### A. 本地二级索引 (LSI)
LSI 需要与基表**相同的分区键**。根据 AWS，本地二级索引是具有与基表相同的分区键但不同排序键的索引；它是"本地"的，因为本地二级索引的每个分区都限定在具有相同分区键值的基表分区内。由于新的访问模式需要 `order_date` 作为**分区键**（而不是 `customer_id`），LSI 无法满足要求。另外，表创建后无法添加或删除 LSI；必须在表创建时定义它，因此无法向现有表添加 LSI。

### B. 扫描表并在 Lambda 中过滤
`Scan` 读取表中的每一项，消耗大量 RCU，并随着表的增长增加延迟和成本。这与"操作效率高"相反，在可以使用二级索引支持访问模式时明确不推荐。

### D. DynamoDB Streams
当对表进行相应更改时，DynamoDB 会自动处理 GSI 中项的添加、更新和删除。流捕获**变更事件**（插入/更新/删除）——它们不是可查询的历史数据存储。你无法针对流按 `order_date` 和 `order_id` 运行即席查询；流用于变更数据捕获/事件驱动处理，而不是随机访问读取。

## 参考查询模式（创建 GSI 后）

```python
import boto3
from boto3.dynamodb.conditions import Key

table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table('Orders')

response = table.query(
    IndexName='OrderDateIndex',
    KeyConditionExpression=Key('order_date').eq('2025-01-15') &
                           Key('order_id').begins_with('ORD-')
)
```

## 参考资源
- [在 DynamoDB 中使用全局二级索引](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GSI.html)
- [DynamoDB 中二级索引的一般指南](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-indexes-general.html)
- [GSI 和 LSI 之间的区别 (AWS re:Post)](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/dynamodb-gsi-lsi-difference)

en.question: A developer is creating a web application for a school that stores data in Amazon DynamoDB. The ExamScores table has the following attributes: student_id, subject_name, and top_score. Each item in the ExamScores table is identified with student_id as the partition key and subject_name as the sort key. The web application needs to display the student _id for the top scores for each school subject. The developer needs to increase the speed of the queries to retrieve the student_id for the top scorer for each school subject. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a local secondary index (LSI) with subject_name as the partition key and top_score as the sort key.
options.B: Create a local secondary index (LSI) with top_score as the partition key and student_id as the sort key.
options.C: Create a global secondary index (GSI) with subject_name as the partition key and top_score as the sort key.
options.D: Create a global secondary index (GSI) with subject_name as the partition key and student_id as the sort key.

en.explanation:
# DynamoDB: GSI for Top Scores by Subject

## Scenario
The `ExamScores` table uses `student_id` as the partition key and `subject_name` as the sort key. The application needs to **find the top scorer (student_id) per subject** quickly. To do this, queries must be issued by `subject_name` (not `student_id`) and the results must be sorted by `top_score`.

Because the required query partition key (`subject_name`) is different from the base table's partition key (`student_id`), a Local Secondary Index (LSI) cannot satisfy this access pattern. A Global Secondary Index (GSI) is required.

## Correct Answer: C — GSI with `subject_name` as partition key and `top_score` as sort key

A GSI allows a completely different key schema from the base table. A global secondary index has a partition key and a sort key that can be different from those on the base table; queries on the index can span all of the data in the base table, across all partitions.

By choosing:
- **Partition key = `subject_name`** → groups all scores per subject together
- **Sort key = `top_score`** → results are physically sorted by score, so a single `Query` with `ScanIndexForward=false` and `Limit=1` returns the top scorer for that subject in O(1) read cost.

This exactly matches the access pattern the application needs.

## Why the other options are wrong

### A. LSI with `subject_name` as partition key, `top_score` as sort key — INVALID
An LSI must reuse the base table's partition key. A local secondary index has the same partition key as the base table, but a different sort key; every partition of a local secondary index is scoped to a base table partition that has the same partition key value. Since the base table's partition key is `student_id`, an LSI **cannot** use `subject_name` as its partition key. This option is structurally impossible.

### B. LSI with `top_score` as partition key, `student_id` as sort key — INVALID
Same problem as A — an LSI cannot redefine the partition key. The LSI's partition key is required to be the same as the base table, and the sort key attribute must be different from that of the table. Also, using `top_score` as a partition key would scatter scores instead of grouping them by subject.

### D. GSI with `subject_name` as partition key, `student_id` as sort key — Suboptimal
While this GSI would let you query by subject, the result set would be sorted by `student_id`, not by `top_score`. To find the top scorer, the application would have to retrieve **all students for the subject** and compute the maximum client-side (or perform a Scan/filter). This defeats the goal of *increasing query speed* to retrieve only the top scorer. A query against option C, by contrast, returns the top score with a single item read.

## Key Takeaway
- **LSI**: same partition key as base table, alternate sort key (must be created at table creation).
- **GSI**: completely different partition key and/or sort key; can be added anytime; queries span all partitions.
- To efficiently get the **top N** records for a category, make the category the GSI partition key and the ranked numeric attribute the GSI sort key, then `Query` with `ScanIndexForward=false` and `Limit=N`.

## References
- [General guidelines for secondary indexes in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-indexes-general.html)
- [Difference between GSI and LSI (AWS re:Post)](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/dynamodb-gsi-lsi-difference)

options.A: 创建一个本地二级索引（LSI），以 subject_name 作为分区键，top_score 作为排序键。
options.B: 创建一个本地二级索引（LSI），以 top_score 作为分区键，student_id 作为排序键。
options.C: 创建一个全局二级索引（GSI），以 subject_name 作为分区键，top_score 作为排序键。
options.D: 创建一个全局二级索引（GSI），以 subject_name 作为分区键，student_id 作为排序键。

zh.explanation:
# DynamoDB：按科目排名的 GSI

## 场景
`ExamScores` 表使用 `student_id` 作为分区键，`subject_name` 作为排序键。应用程序需要**快速找到每个科目的最高分学生（student_id）**。为此，查询必须由 `subject_name`（而非 `student_id`）发起，结果必须按 `top_score` 排序。

由于所需的查询分区键（`subject_name`）不同于基表的分区键（`student_id`），本地二级索引（LSI）无法满足这种访问模式。需要使用全局二级索引（GSI）。

## 正确答案：C — GSI，分区键为 `subject_name`，排序键为 `top_score`

GSI 允许与基表完全不同的键架构。全局二级索引具有与基表不同的分区键和排序键；对索引的查询可以跨越基表中的所有数据，跨越所有分区。

通过选择：
- **分区键 = `subject_name`** → 将每个科目的所有分数分组在一起
- **排序键 = `top_score`** → 结果按分数进行物理排序，因此单次 `Query`，设置 `ScanIndexForward=false` 和 `Limit=1`，即可以 O(1) 的读成本返回该科目的最高分学生。

这完全符合应用程序所需的访问模式。

## 其他选项为何错误

### A. LSI，分区键为 `subject_name`，排序键为 `top_score` — 无效
LSI 必须重复使用基表的分区键。本地二级索引与基表具有相同的分区键，但排序键不同；本地二级索引的每个分区都被限定在具有相同分区键值的基表分区范围内。由于基表的分区键是 `student_id`，LSI **不能**使用 `subject_name` 作为其分区键。这个选项在结构上是不可行的。

### B. LSI，分区键为 `top_score`，排序键为 `student_id` — 无效
与 A 相同的问题 — LSI 不能重新定义分区键。LSI 的分区键必须与基表相同，排序键属性必须与表的排序键不同。此外，使用 `top_score` 作为分区键会将分数分散，而不是按科目分组。

### D. GSI，分区键为 `subject_name`，排序键为 `student_id` — 次优方案
虽然这个 GSI 允许按科目查询，但结果集将按 `student_id` 排序，而非按 `top_score` 排序。要找到最高分学生，应用程序必须检索**该科目的所有学生**并在客户端计算最大值（或执行 Scan/filter）。这违背了*提高查询速度*的目标，只读取最高分学生。相比之下，针对选项 C 的查询仅需单次项目读取即可返回最高分。

## 关键要点
- **LSI**：分区键与基表相同，备用排序键（必须在表创建时创建）。
- **GSI**：分区键和/或排序键完全不同；可随时添加；查询跨越所有分区。
- 要有效地获取某个类别的**前 N 条**记录，将该类别作为 GSI 分区键，将排名数值属性作为 GSI 排序键，然后使用 `ScanIndexForward=false` 和 `Limit=N` 执行 `Query`。

## 参考资源
- [DynamoDB 中二级索引的常规指南](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-indexes-general.html)
- [GSI 与 LSI 的区别（AWS re:Post）](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/dynamodb-gsi-lsi-difference)

en.question: A developer wrote an application that uses an AWS Lambda function to asynchronously generate short videos based on requests from customers. This video generation can take up to 10 minutes. After the video is generated, a URL to download the video is pushed to the customer's web browser. The customer should be able to access these videos for at least 3 hours after generation. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Store the video in the /tmp folder within the Lambda execution environment. Push a Lambda function URL to the customer.
options.B: Store the video in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system attached to the function. Generate a pre-signed URL for the video object and push the URL to the customer.
options.C: Store the video in Amazon S3. Generate a pre-signed URL for the video object and push the URL to the customer.
options.D: Store the video in an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Generate a pre-signed URL for the video object and push the URL to the customer.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A Lambda function asynchronously generates short videos (taking up to 10 minutes). After generation, customers need to download the video via a URL that remains accessible for **at least 3 hours**. We need durable storage for the video and a secure, time-limited download URL.

## Correct Answer: C — Store the video in Amazon S3 and generate a presigned URL

Amazon S3 is the natural choice for storing generated media objects: it is durable, scalable, and decoupled from the Lambda execution environment. By default, all Amazon S3 objects are private, only the object owner has permission to access them. However, the object owner may share objects with others by creating a presigned URL. A presigned URL uses security credentials to grant time-limited permission to download objects. The URL can be entered in a browser or used by a program to download the object. The credentials used by the presigned URL are those of the AWS user who generated the URL.

A 3-hour expiration is well within the supported window: A presigned URL remains valid for the period of time specified when the URL is generated. If you create a presigned URL with the Amazon S3 console, the expiration time can be set between 1 minute and 12 hours. If you use the AWS CLI or AWS SDKs, the expiration time can be set as high as 7 days.

> ⚠️ Caveat for real-world use: when Lambda generates the presigned URL using its IAM role's temporary credentials, the URL is bound to those credentials. Temporary security credentials can't be valid for longer than the credentials themselves. These credentials include: IAM role credentials – The presigned URL expires when the role session expires, even if you specify a longer expiration time. Lambda role sessions typically last around 12 hours, so 3 hours is comfortably achievable.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. Store in `/tmp` and push a Lambda function URL.** The `/tmp` directory is **ephemeral** to a single Lambda execution environment. It is wiped when the environment is recycled, and a different concurrent invocation receives a different execution environment without that file. A Lambda function URL invokes the function, not a static file, and there is no built-in mechanism to serve a previously generated file from `/tmp` reliably for 3 hours. Additionally, `/tmp` is limited (default 512 MB, configurable up to 10,240 MB) and is not designed for shared persistent storage.

- **B. Store in EFS attached to the function and generate a presigned URL.** **Amazon EFS does not support presigned URLs.** Presigned URLs are an S3 feature. EFS is a POSIX file system accessed via NFS from within a VPC; you cannot grant a browser direct download access to an EFS file via a URL without building an extra HTTP-serving layer (e.g., another Lambda or EC2). This option does not technically work as described.

- **D. Store in a CloudFront distribution and generate a presigned URL.** **You cannot store objects in CloudFront**—CloudFront is a CDN that caches content from an *origin* (such as S3). The equivalent secure mechanism in CloudFront is **signed URLs / signed cookies**, not S3 presigned URLs, and they require an origin where the file actually lives. The phrasing "store the video in CloudFront" is incorrect.

## Reference

- [Sharing objects with presigned URLs – Amazon S3 User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/ShareObjectPreSignedURL.html)
- [Download and upload objects with presigned URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/using-presigned-url.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员编写了一个应用程序，该应用程序使用 AWS Lambda 函数根据客户的请求异步生成短视频。视频生成过程最多可能需要 10 分钟。视频生成后，会将一个用于下载视频的 URL 推送至客户的 Web 浏览器。客户应该能够在视频生成后至少 3 小时内访问这些视频。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.B: 将视频存储在附加到该函数的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统中。为视频对象生成预签名 URL，并将该 URL 推送给客户。
options.C: 将视频存储在 Amazon S3 中。为视频对象生成预签名 URL，并将该 URL 推送给客户。
options.D: 将视频存储在 Amazon CloudFront 分发中。为视频对象生成预签名 URL，并将该 URL 推送给客户。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

Lambda 函数异步生成短视频（最长 10 分钟）。生成后，客户需要通过一个至少在 **3 小时内** 保持可访问的 URL 下载视频。我们需要为视频提供持久存储，以及安全的、时间受限的下载 URL。

## 正确答案：C — 在 Amazon S3 中存储视频并生成预签名 URL

Amazon S3 是存储生成的媒体对象的自然选择：它具有持久性、可扩展性，并且与 Lambda 执行环境解耦。默认情况下，所有 Amazon S3 对象都是私有的，只有对象所有者才能访问它们。但是，对象所有者可以通过创建预签名 URL 与他人共享对象。预签名 URL 使用安全凭证授予时间受限的权限以下载对象。可以在浏览器中输入该 URL，或由程序使用该 URL 下载对象。预签名 URL 使用的凭证是生成该 URL 的 AWS 用户的凭证。

3 小时的过期时间完全在支持的范围内：预签名 URL 在生成该 URL 时指定的时间段内保持有效。如果使用 Amazon S3 控制台创建预签名 URL，过期时间可以设置为 1 分钟到 12 小时。如果使用 AWS CLI 或 AWS SDK，过期时间最高可以设置为 7 天。

> ⚠️ 实际使用的注意事项：当 Lambda 使用其 IAM 角色的临时凭证生成预签名 URL 时，该 URL 与这些凭证绑定。临时安全凭证的有效期不能超过凭证本身的有效期。这些凭证包括：IAM 角色凭证——预签名 URL 将在角色会话过期时过期，即使您指定了更长的过期时间。Lambda 角色会话通常持续约 12 小时，因此 3 小时是完全可以达到的。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. 在 `/tmp` 中存储并推送 Lambda 函数 URL。** `/tmp` 目录 **是临时的**，仅存在于单个 Lambda 执行环境中。当环境被回收时会被清除，不同的并发调用会获得不同的执行环境，不包含该文件。Lambda 函数 URL 会调用该函数，而不是提供静态文件，并且没有内置机制可以可靠地从 `/tmp` 为先前生成的文件服务 3 小时。此外，`/tmp` 容量有限（默认 512 MB，可配置最高 10,240 MB），并且不是为共享持久存储而设计的。

- **B. 在附加到函数的 EFS 中存储并生成预签名 URL。** **Amazon EFS 不支持预签名 URL。** 预签名 URL 是 S3 的功能。EFS 是通过 NFS 从 VPC 内访问的 POSIX 文件系统；如果不构建额外的 HTTP 服务层（例如，另一个 Lambda 或 EC2），则无法通过 URL 为浏览器授予对 EFS 文件的直接下载访问权限。此选项在技术上不会按照描述的方式工作。

- **D. 在 CloudFront 分发中存储并生成预签名 URL。** **无法在 CloudFront 中存储对象**——CloudFront 是一个 CDN，缓存来自*源*（例如 S3）的内容。CloudFront 中的等效安全机制是 **签名 URL / 签名 Cookie**，而不是 S3 预签名 URL，它们需要一个文件实际存储的源。"在 CloudFront 中存储视频"的措辞是不正确的。

## 参考资料

- [使用预签名 URL 共享对象 – Amazon S3 用户指南](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/ShareObjectPreSignedURL.html)
- [使用预签名 URL 下载和上传对象](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/using-presigned-url.html)

en.question: A developer is creating an AWS Lambda function that is invoked by messages to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. The messages represent customer data updates from a customer relationship management (CRM) system The developer wants the Lambda function to process only the messages that pertain to email address changes. Additional subscribers to the SNS topic will process any other messages. Which solution will meet these requirements in the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Use Lambda event filtering to allow only messages that are related to email address changes to invoke the Lambda function.
options.B: Use an SNS filter policy on the Lambda function subscription to allow only messages that are related to email address changes to invoke the Lambda function.
options.C: Subscribe an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to the SNS topic. Configure the SQS queue with a filter policy to allow only messages that are related to email address changes. Connect the SQS queue to the Lambda function.
options.D: Configure the Lambda code to check the received message. If the message is not related to an email address change, configure the Lambda function to publish the message back to the SNS topic for the other subscribers to process.

en.explanation:
# Analysis

The Lambda function is invoked from an SNS topic, and the developer needs to ensure only messages that pertain to email-address changes invoke this particular Lambda. Other subscribers will handle the rest. The requirement is **least development effort**.

## Correct Answer: B — Use an SNS subscription filter policy on the Lambda subscription

By default, an Amazon SNS topic subscriber receives every message that's published to the topic. To receive only a subset of the messages, a subscriber must assign a filter policy to the topic subscription. A filter policy is a JSON object containing properties that define which messages the subscriber receives.

Amazon SNS supports policies that act on the message attributes or on the message body, according to the filter policy scope that you set for the subscription. This means the developer only has to attach a JSON filter policy (e.g., matching an attribute like `change_type: ["email"]`) to the Lambda's SNS subscription. No code changes, no extra infrastructure, and the filtering happens at SNS — messages that don't match are simply not delivered to the Lambda.

Example filter policy:

```json
{
  "change_type": ["email_address"]
}
```

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**A. Lambda event filtering for SNS** — Lambda event source mapping filters apply to *poll-based* event sources (Kinesis, DynamoDB Streams, SQS, MSK, self-managed Kafka, Amazon MQ). SNS invokes Lambda via *push* (asynchronous invocation), so there is no event source mapping and no Lambda event filtering capability for SNS. As a commenter noted, "Lambda event filtering does not support SNS." Filtering for SNS-triggered Lambdas must be done with an SNS subscription filter policy.

**C. SQS queue subscribed to SNS with a filter policy, then connected to Lambda** — While technically functional (you would still attach the filter policy to the SNS→SQS subscription), this requires creating and managing an additional SQS queue, configuring the queue policy/permissions, and setting up an event source mapping from SQS to Lambda. This is significantly more development effort than simply applying a filter policy directly to the existing SNS→Lambda subscription.

**D. Lambda checks the message and republishes back to SNS** — This wastes invocations (Lambda runs for every message), introduces an infinite-loop risk, requires custom code, and increases cost. When using SNS to publish events to AWS Lambda, it's important to ensure that Lambda functions are triggered only for relevant events to avoid unnecessary concurrent executions and reduce costs. This is the opposite of "least development effort" and also breaks the per-subscriber filtering model.

## References

- [Amazon SNS subscription filter policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-subscription-filter-policies.html)
- [Amazon SNS message filtering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-message-filtering.html)
- [Lambda event filtering (note: applies to poll-based sources only)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-eventfiltering.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数由发送到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题的消息触发。这些消息代表来自客户关系管理 (CRM) 系统的客户数据更新。开发人员希望 Lambda 函数仅处理与电子邮件地址更改相关的消息。SNS 主题的其他订阅者将处理任何其他消息。哪种解决方案能够以最少的开发工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Lambda 事件过滤，仅允许与电子邮件地址更改相关的消息调用 Lambda 函数。
options.B: 在 Lambda 函数订阅中使用 SNS 过滤策略，仅允许与电子邮件地址更改相关的消息调用 Lambda 函数。
options.C: 将 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列订阅到 SNS 主题。配置 SQS 队列的过滤策略，使其仅允许与电子邮件地址更改相关的消息。将 SQS 队列连接到 Lambda 函数。
options.D: 配置 Lambda 代码以检查收到的消息。如果消息与电子邮件地址更改无关，则配置 Lambda 函数将该消息发布回 SNS 主题，供其他订阅者处理。

zh.explanation:
# 分析

Lambda 函数从 SNS 主题调用，开发人员需要确保只有与电子邮件地址更改相关的消息才会调用此特定 Lambda。其他订阅者将处理其余部分。要求是**最少开发工作量**。

## 正确答案：B — 在 Lambda 订阅上使用 SNS 订阅筛选策略

默认情况下，Amazon SNS 主题订阅者会接收发布到该主题的每条消息。若要仅接收消息的子集，订阅者必须为主题订阅分配筛选策略。筛选策略是一个 JSON 对象，其中包含定义订阅者接收哪些消息的属性。

Amazon SNS 支持根据您为订阅设置的筛选策略范围，对消息属性或消息正文进行操作的策略。这意味着开发人员只需将 JSON 筛选策略（例如，匹配属性如 `change_type: ["email"]`）附加到 Lambda 的 SNS 订阅即可。无需修改代码，无需额外的基础设施，筛选在 SNS 处进行——不匹配的消息根本不会被传递到 Lambda。

示例筛选策略：

```json
{
  "change_type": ["email_address"]
}
```

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**A. Lambda 事件筛选用于 SNS** — Lambda 事件源映射筛选适用于*基于轮询*的事件源（Kinesis、DynamoDB Streams、SQS、MSK、自管理 Kafka、Amazon MQ）。SNS 通过*推送*（异步调用）方式调用 Lambda，因此不存在事件源映射，SNS 触发的 Lambda 也没有事件筛选功能。如一位评论者所指出的，"Lambda 事件筛选不支持 SNS"。SNS 触发的 Lambda 的筛选必须使用 SNS 订阅筛选策略完成。

**C. 订阅到 SNS 的 SQS 队列（带筛选策略），然后连接到 Lambda** — 虽然在技术上可行（您仍然会将筛选策略附加到 SNS→SQS 订阅），但这需要创建和管理额外的 SQS 队列、配置队列策略/权限，以及设置从 SQS 到 Lambda 的事件源映射。这比简单地将筛选策略直接应用于现有 SNS→Lambda 订阅需要更多的开发工作。

**D. Lambda 检查消息并重新发布回 SNS** — 这会浪费调用次数（Lambda 为每条消息运行），引入无限循环风险，需要自定义代码，并增加成本。使用 SNS 向 AWS Lambda 发布事件时，重要的是确保 Lambda 函数仅针对相关事件被触发，以避免不必要的并发执行并降低成本。这与"最少开发工作量"的目标相反，同时也破坏了按订阅者筛选的模型。

## 参考资源

- [Amazon SNS 订阅筛选策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-subscription-filter-policies.html)
- [Amazon SNS 消息筛选](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-message-filtering.html)
- [Lambda 事件筛选（注：仅适用于基于轮询的源）](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-eventfiltering.html)

en.question: A developer is designing a fault-tolerant environment where client sessions will be saved. How can the developer ensure that no sessions are lost if an Amazon EC2 instance fails?

options.A: Use sticky sessions with an Elastic Load Balancer target group.
options.B: Use Amazon SQS to save session data.
options.C: Use Amazon DynamoDB to perform scalable session handling.
options.D: Use Elastic Load Balancer connection draining to stop sending requests to failing instances.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The developer needs to design a fault-tolerant architecture where client session data survives even if an EC2 instance fails. The key requirement is **no session loss on EC2 instance failure**, which means session state must be stored *outside* of any individual EC2 instance in a durable, shared, highly available data store.

## Correct Answer: C — Use Amazon DynamoDB to perform scalable session handling

Storing session state in DynamoDB externalizes it from the EC2 instances, so the failure of any single instance does not destroy session data. When developing a new ASP.NET application, a common approach is to store session data in memory. Unfortunately, this approach doesn't scale very well; once your application grows beyond a single web server, the session state must be shared between servers. The common solution to sharing session state over multiple web servers is to set up a dedicated session state server with SQL Server. Of course, this approach has certain drawbacks: you must administer another machine, the session state server is a single point of failure, and the session state server can be a performance bottleneck. Amazon DynamoDB, a new NoSQL database store from Amazon Web Services (AWS), is designed to address these drawbacks.

DynamoDB is purpose-built to solve this: Amazon DynamoDB stands out as a highly available, scalable solution for session persistence. As a fully managed NoSQL database service, DynamoDB delivers dependable performance under various loads. Key advantages of using DynamoDB for session management include: High Availability: DynamoDB's multi-AZ deployment ensures data replication across geographic locations, minimizing data loss risks. Automatic Scalability: It adjusts throughput to accommodate fluctuating traffic, maintaining consistent performance.
