Caveat noted in comments: `/tmp` is per-execution-environment, so each new cold-start container will repopulate its own cache. Each instance of a function has its own /tmp directory and data is not shared amongst different instances of a function. A more robust production design would use ElastiCache, DynamoDB, or S3, but among the four offered choices, **B is the only option that actually addresses the root cause** (repeated DB queries and Translate calls for identical content).

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. Change to asynchronous Lambda invocation.** Async invocation is for fire-and-forget event processing — the caller does not receive a response payload. The website must return the translated newsletter to the browser synchronously, so async invocation breaks the user-facing flow and does nothing to reduce DB load or Translate latency.

- **C. Enable TranslateText API caching.** Amazon Translate **does not provide a built-in API-level caching feature**. The `TranslateText` operation has no caching toggle in the [Amazon Translate API reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/translate/latest/dg/API_TranslateText.html). AWS guidance is for customers to implement their own caching layer (e.g., DynamoDB, ElastiCache, S3, or `/tmp`) — see [Maximize your Amazon Translate architecture using strategic caching layers](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/maximize-your-amazon-translate-architecture-using-strategic-caching-layers/). So this option describes a feature that does not exist.

- **D. Change the Lambda function to use parallel processing.** Parallelizing work inside the function does not eliminate the DB hit or the Translate call — both still happen on every invocation. The bottleneck is the overloaded database, not single-threaded computation inside Lambda. Parallel calls would actually increase concurrent load on the on-premises DB.

## References
- [Configure ephemeral storage for Lambda functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-ephemeral-storage.html)
- [Choosing between AWS Lambda data storage options in web apps](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/choosing-between-aws-lambda-data-storage-options-in-web-apps/)
- [Using larger ephemeral storage for AWS Lambda](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/using-larger-ephemeral-storage-for-aws-lambda/)
- [Maximize your Amazon Translate architecture using strategic caching layers](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/maximize-your-amazon-translate-architecture-using-strategic-caching-layers/)

zh.question: 一家公司有一个网站，每天发布新闻简报。当用户访问该网站时，AWS Lambda 函数会处理浏览器的请求，并查询公司本地数据库以获取当日新闻简报。新闻简报以英文存储。Lambda 函数使用 Amazon Translate 的 TranslateText API 操作来翻译新闻简报，并将翻译结果显示给用户。由于访问量激增，网站响应速度变慢，数据库也因此过载。公司无法更改数据库，因此需要一个能够提升 Lambda 函数响应速度的解决方案。请问哪个解决方案符合这些要求？

options.A: 改为异步 Lambda 函数调用。
options.B: 将翻译后的新闻稿缓存到 Lambda/tmp 目录中。
options.C: 启用 TranslateText API 缓存。
options.D: 将 Lambda 函数改为使用并行处理。

zh.explanation:
# 在 Lambda /tmp 中缓存翻译后的新闻稿

## 场景
Lambda 函数从一个过载的本地数据库中获取每日新闻稿，然后调用 Amazon Translate 的 `TranslateText` API 进行翻译后返回给用户。由于数据库过载，网站速度很慢。由于新闻稿内容**整天相同**（仅每天更改一次），每次调用都会重新查询数据库并为相同的输入重新调用 Translate。修复方案必须减少数据库负载并改进 Lambda 响应时间，而无需修改数据库。

## 正确答案：B — 在 Lambda /tmp 目录中缓存翻译后的新闻稿

Lambda 执行环境在预热时会在调用之间被重用。同一个 Lambda 执行环境可能被多个 Lambda 调用重用以优化性能。/tmp 区域在执行环境的生命周期内被保留，为调用之间的数据提供临时缓存。这使得 `/tmp` 成为缓存当天翻译后新闻稿的有效位置，这样后续的预热调用可以避免数据库查询和 Translate API 调用。

您可以使用相同的执行环境在调用之间的 /tmp 中缓存静态资产。由于新闻稿仅每天更改一次，缓存翻译后的文本（按日期和目标语言作为键）可以大幅降低数据库负载和 TranslateText 延迟/成本。访问 Lambda 临时存储中的数据不需要外部互联网请求，使其比访问 S3 等对象存储中的数据更快更便宜，因为后者需要网络请求。

注意事项：`/tmp` 是按执行环境的，所以每个新的冷启动容器都会重新填充自己的缓存。函数的每个实例都有自己的 /tmp 目录，数据不会在函数的不同实例之间共享。更加稳健的生产设计应该使用 ElastiCache、DynamoDB 或 S3，但在四个提供的选项中，**B 是唯一实际解决根本原因**（针对相同内容重复查询数据库和调用 Translate）的选项。

## 其他选项为什么错误

- **A. 更改为异步 Lambda 调用。** 异步调用适用于即发即忘的事件处理 — 调用者不会收到响应负载。网站必须将翻译后的新闻稿同步返回给浏览器，所以异步调用会破坏用户面向的流程，并且无法减少数据库负载或 Translate 延迟。

- **C. 启用 TranslateText API 缓存。** Amazon Translate **不提供内置的 API 级缓存功能**。`TranslateText` 操作在 [Amazon Translate API 参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/translate/latest/dg/API_TranslateText.html)中没有缓存切换。AWS 指导是客户实现自己的缓存层（例如 DynamoDB、ElastiCache、S3 或 `/tmp`）— 参见 [Maximize your Amazon Translate architecture using strategic caching layers](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/maximize-your-amazon-translate-architecture-using-strategic-caching-layers/)。所以这个选项描述的是一个不存在的功能。

- **D. 更改 Lambda 函数以使用并行处理。** 在函数内部并行化工作不会消除数据库命中或 Translate 调用 — 两者仍然会在每次调用时发生。瓶颈是过载的数据库，而不是 Lambda 内部的单线程计算。并行调用实际上会增加对本地数据库的并发负载。

## 参考资源
- [Configure ephemeral storage for Lambda functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-ephemeral-storage.html)
- [Choosing between AWS Lambda data storage options in web apps](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/choosing-between-aws-lambda-data-storage-options-in-web-apps/)
- [Using larger ephemeral storage for AWS Lambda](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/using-larger-ephemeral-storage-for-aws-lambda/)
- [Maximize your Amazon Translate architecture using strategic caching layers](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/maximize-your-amazon-translate-architecture-using-strategic-caching-layers/)

en.question: A developer is monitoring an application that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. The developer has configured a custom Amazon CloudWatch metric with data granularity of 1 second. If any issues occur, the developer wants to be notified within 30 seconds by Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS). What should the developer do to meet this requirement?

options.A: Configure a high-resolution CloudWatch alarm.
options.B: Set up a custom CloudWatch dashboard.
options.C: Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights.
options.D: Change to a default CloudWatch metric.

en.explanation:
# High-Resolution CloudWatch Alarm for Sub-Minute Notification

## Scenario
A developer publishes a custom CloudWatch metric at **1-second granularity** (a high-resolution metric) and needs SNS notification within **30 seconds** of an issue. The question asks how to wire the metric to a near-real-time alert.

## Correct Answer: A — Configure a high-resolution CloudWatch alarm

A standard CloudWatch alarm only evaluates at 60-second periods, which cannot meet a 30-second notification SLA. CloudWatch supports a special alarm type — the **high-resolution alarm** — that evaluates at 10-second or 30-second periods.

When you publish a custom metric, you can define it as either standard resolution or high resolution. When you publish a high-resolution metric, CloudWatch stores it with a resolution of 1 second, and you can read and retrieve it with a period of 1 second, 5 seconds, 10 seconds, 30 seconds, or any multiple of 60 seconds.

If you set an alarm on a high-resolution metric, you can specify a high-resolution alarm with a period of 10 seconds or 30 seconds, or you can set a regular alarm with a period of any multiple of 60 seconds.

In addition, you can also alert sooner with High-Resolution Alarms, as frequently as 10-second periods. High-Resolution Alarms allow you to react and take actions faster, and support the same actions available today with standard 1-minute alarms.

A high-resolution alarm with a 10- or 30-second period, combined with an SNS topic as the alarm action, satisfies the 30-second notification requirement.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **B. Set up a custom CloudWatch dashboard.** Dashboards are visualization widgets only. They do not evaluate thresholds and cannot trigger SNS notifications. Dashboards aren't an alerting mechanism.

- **C. Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights.** Logs Insights is an interactive log-querying tool for CloudWatch Logs (not metrics). It does not perform continuous evaluation of metric data and does not natively notify via SNS within 30 seconds of a metric breach.

- **D. Change to a default CloudWatch metric.** "Default" (standard-resolution) metrics are stored at 1-minute (or 5-minute basic monitoring) resolution. When setting an alarm on a detailed monitoring metric, select a period of at least 60 seconds (1 minute). A standard alarm evaluates at minimum every 60 seconds, so it cannot reliably notify within 30 seconds, and this option also throws away the 1-second granularity the developer specifically configured.

## Key takeaways for the exam
- **High-resolution custom metric** → published with `StorageResolution = 1` via `PutMetricData`.
- **High-resolution alarm** → period of 10s or 30s; High-resolution alarms (evaluating every 10 or 30 seconds): $0.30 per alarm per month.
- Alarm action → SNS topic → email/SMS/Lambda subscriber.

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在监控运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的应用程序。该开发人员配置了一个自定义的 Amazon CloudWatch 指标，数据粒度为 1 秒。如果出现任何问题，开发人员希望 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 在 30 秒内通知他们。开发人员应该如何操作才能满足此要求？

options.A: 配置高分辨率 CloudWatch 警报。
options.B: 设置自定义 CloudWatch 控制面板。
options.C: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights。
options.D: 更改为默认的 CloudWatch 指标。

zh.explanation:
# 高分辨率 CloudWatch 告警用于亚分钟级通知

## 场景
开发人员以 **1 秒粒度**（高分辨率指标）发布自定义 CloudWatch 指标，需要在问题发生后 **30 秒内** 获得 SNS 通知。问题要求如何将指标连接到近实时告警。

## 正确答案：A — 配置高分辨率 CloudWatch 告警

标准 CloudWatch 告警只能在 60 秒周期内进行评估，无法满足 30 秒通知 SLA。CloudWatch 支持一种特殊告警类型——**高分辨率告警**——可以在 10 秒或 30 秒周期内进行评估。

发布自定义指标时，可以将其定义为标准分辨率或高分辨率。发布高分辨率指标时，CloudWatch 以 1 秒分辨率存储它，您可以以 1 秒、5 秒、10 秒、30 秒或 60 秒的任意倍数周期读取和检索它。

如果在高分辨率指标上设置告警，可以指定周期为 10 秒或 30 秒的高分辨率告警，或者设置周期为 60 秒任意倍数的常规告警。

此外，通过高分辨率告警，您可以更快地获得警报，频率最高可达 10 秒周期。高分辨率告警使您能够更快地响应和采取行动，并支持与标准 1 分钟告警相同的所有操作。

高分辨率告警配合 10 秒或 30 秒周期，以及 SNS 主题作为告警操作，可满足 30 秒通知要求。

## 其他选项为什么错误

- **B. 设置自定义 CloudWatch 仪表板。** 仪表板仅用于可视化小部件。它们不评估阈值，无法触发 SNS 通知。仪表板不是告警机制。

- **C. 使用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights。** Logs Insights 是 CloudWatch Logs（而非指标）的交互式日志查询工具。它不能持续评估指标数据，也不能在指标超出阈值后的 30 秒内通过 SNS 本地通知。

- **D. 改为使用默认 CloudWatch 指标。** "默认"（标准分辨率）指标以 1 分钟（或 5 分钟基础监控）分辨率存储。在详细监控指标上设置告警时，选择至少 60 秒（1 分钟）的周期。标准告警最少每 60 秒评估一次，无法可靠地在 30 秒内通知，且此选项还会舍弃开发人员特意配置的 1 秒粒度。

## 考试关键要点
- **高分辨率自定义指标** → 通过 `PutMetricData` 发布，`StorageResolution = 1`。
- **高分辨率告警** → 周期为 10 秒或 30 秒；高分辨率告警（每 10 或 30 秒评估一次）：每个告警每月 $0.30。
- 告警操作 → SNS 主题 → 电子邮件/短信/Lambda 订阅者。

en.question: A company has a web application that contains an Amazon API Gateway REST API. A developer has created an AWS CloudFormation template for the initial deployment of the application. The developer has deployed the application successfully as part of an AWS CodePipeline continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) process. All resources and methods are available through the deployed stage endpoint. The CloudFormation template contains the following resource types: • AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi • AWS::ApiGateway::Resource • AWS::ApiGateway::Method • AWS::ApiGateway::Stage • AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment The developer adds a new resource to the REST API with additional methods and redeploys the template. CloudFormation reports that the deployment is successful and that the stack is in the UPDATE_COMPLETE state. However, calls to all new methods are returning 404 (Not Found) errors. What should the developer do to make the new methods available?

options.A: Specify the disable-rollback option during the update-stack operation.
options.B: Unset the CloudFormation stack failure options.
options.C: Add an AWS CodeBuild stage to CodePipeline to run the aws apigateway create-deployment AWS CLI command.
options.D: Add an action to CodePipeline to run the aws cloudfront create-invalidation AWS CLI command.

en.explanation:
# API Gateway Deployment Not Reflecting New Methods in CloudFormation

## Scenario
A developer maintains a REST API defined via CloudFormation with these resource types:
- `AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi`
- `AWS::ApiGateway::Resource`
- `AWS::ApiGateway::Method`
- `AWS::ApiGateway::Stage`
- `AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment`

After adding a new resource and methods, the CloudFormation update succeeds (`UPDATE_COMPLETE`), yet calls to the new methods return **404 Not Found**.

## Root Cause
An API Gateway **Deployment is an immutable snapshot** of the REST API configuration. Changes to resources/methods don't take effect on the stage until a **new deployment** is created and the stage points to it. If you don't change the Deployment's logical id, CloudFormation will not create another Deployment nor update the existing Deployment (Deployment is an immutable snapshot of API). Because of this, your first CloudFormation deployment will be fine, though the subsequent deployment will not create a new Deployment in API Gateway.

In other words, when an API Gateway CloudFormation stack is updated, it might make changes to the API Gateway resources, but in AWS these do not become active until the API Gateway is redeployed. The stack reaches `UPDATE_COMPLETE` because CloudFormation considers the existing `AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment` resource unchanged (its logical ID and properties are the same), so it never calls API Gateway's `CreateDeployment` action again.

## Correct Answer: C
**Add a CodeBuild stage to CodePipeline that runs `aws apigateway create-deployment`.**

After CloudFormation finishes updating the stack, the pipeline should explicitly create a new API Gateway deployment to push the latest API definition (new resources/methods) onto the existing stage.

Example buildspec snippet:

```yaml
version: 0.2
phases:
  build:
    commands:
      - aws apigateway create-deployment \
          --rest-api-id $REST_API_ID \
          --stage-name prod \
          --description "Deployment from CodePipeline build $CODEBUILD_BUILD_NUMBER"
```

This forces API Gateway to create a fresh snapshot of the API and associate it with the stage, making the new methods callable. AWS even acknowledges that this isn't built into CloudFormation directly — one way would be to use AWS SAM as it has an AlwaysDeploy setting that should force the API deployment to occur even when no changes are detected, however this feature is not directly available through CloudFormation.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Specify `--disable-rollback` on update-stack** — This only controls whether CloudFormation rolls back the stack on failure. The current update is *succeeding*; the issue isn't a rollback problem, it's that no new API Gateway deployment was created. Disabling rollback changes nothing about API Gateway's stage configuration.

- **B. Unset CloudFormation stack failure options** — Same as A: failure-handling options are irrelevant because the stack update completed successfully. The methods are missing on the deployed stage, not from the stack itself.

- **D. Run `aws cloudfront create-invalidation`** — CloudFront cache invalidation only matters if requests traverse a CloudFront distribution and you suspect cached responses. The 404 is coming from API Gateway because the stage's deployment snapshot doesn't include the new methods. Invalidating CloudFront caches will not add methods to an API Gateway stage.

## Best-Practice Alternative
Instead of (or in addition to) the CodeBuild step, you can change the **logical ID of the `AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment` resource** on every template change (e.g., append a hash/timestamp), which forces CloudFormation to create a brand-new Deployment and update the Stage to use it. You can fix this issue by making the logical id unique (e.g., append timestamp or a hashed value) for each CloudFormation deployment. However, given the answer choices, **C** is the option presented.

## References
- [AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment - AWS CloudFormation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-resource-apigateway-deployment.html)
- [API Gateway create-deployment CLI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/reference/apigateway/create-deployment.html)
- [API Gateway deployment issue – AWS re:Post](https://repost.aws/questions/QU6NuFvCDfRkyXkTAEc1wpyQ/api-gateway-deployment-issue)

zh.question: 一家公司有一个包含 Amazon API Gateway REST API 的 Web 应用程序。开发人员创建了一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，用于应用程序的初始部署。开发人员已成功将该应用程序部署到 AWS CodePipeline 持续集成和持续交付 (CI/CD) 流程中。所有资源和方法都可通过已部署阶段的端点访问。该 CloudFormation 模板包含以下资源类型： • AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi • AWS::ApiGateway::Resource • AWS::ApiGateway::Method • AWS::ApiGateway::Stage • AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment 。开发人员向 REST API 添加了一个包含其他方法的新资源，并重新部署了该模板。CloudFormation 报告部署成功，并且堆栈处于 UPDATE_COMPLETE 状态。但是，对所有新方法的调用都返回 404（未找到）错误。开发人员应该如何操作才能使新方法可用？

options.A: 在更新堆栈操作期间指定禁用回滚选项。
options.B: 取消设置 CloudFormation 堆栈故障选项。
options.C: 向 CodePipeline 添加 AWS CodeBuild 阶段，以运行 aws apigateway create-deployment AWS CLI 命令。
options.D: 向 CodePipeline 添加一个操作，以运行 aws cloudfront create-invalidation AWS CLI 命令。

zh.explanation:
# API Gateway 部署未在 CloudFormation 中反映新方法

## 场景
一位开发人员通过 CloudFormation 维护一个 REST API，包含以下资源类型：
- `AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi`
- `AWS::ApiGateway::Resource`
- `AWS::ApiGateway::Method`
- `AWS::ApiGateway::Stage`
- `AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment`

添加新资源和方法后，CloudFormation 更新成功（`UPDATE_COMPLETE`），但对新方法的调用返回 **404 Not Found**。

## 根本原因
API Gateway **Deployment 是 REST API 配置的不可变快照**。对资源/方法的更改在阶段上生效之前，需要**创建新的部署**并且阶段指向它。如果您不更改 Deployment 的逻辑 ID，CloudFormation 不会创建另一个 Deployment，也不会更新现有 Deployment（Deployment 是 API 的不可变快照）。因此，您的第一个 CloudFormation 部署可以正常工作，但后续部署将不会在 API Gateway 中创建新的 Deployment。

换句话说，当 API Gateway CloudFormation 堆栈更新时，它可能会对 API Gateway 资源进行更改，但在 AWS 中这些更改在 API Gateway 重新部署之前不会生效。堆栈达到 `UPDATE_COMPLETE` 是因为 CloudFormation 认为现有 `AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment` 资源未更改（其逻辑 ID 和属性相同），因此它永远不会再次调用 API Gateway 的 `CreateDeployment` 操作。

## 正确答案：C
**向 CodePipeline 添加 CodeBuild 阶段，运行 `aws apigateway create-deployment`。**

CloudFormation 完成堆栈更新后，管道应显式创建新的 API Gateway 部署，以将最新的 API 定义（新资源/方法）推送到现有阶段。

示例 buildspec 代码段：

```yaml
version: 0.2
phases:
  build:
    commands:
      - aws apigateway create-deployment \
          --rest-api-id $REST_API_ID \
          --stage-name prod \
          --description "Deployment from CodePipeline build $CODEBUILD_BUILD_NUMBER"
```

这会强制 API Gateway 创建 API 的新快照并将其与阶段关联，使新方法可调用。AWS 甚至承认这不是 CloudFormation 直接内置的功能——一种方法是使用 AWS SAM，因为它具有 AlwaysDeploy 设置，即使没有检测到更改也应强制进行 API 部署，但此功能在 CloudFormation 中不直接可用。

## 为什么其他选项错误

- **A. 在 update-stack 上指定 `--disable-rollback`** — 这仅控制 CloudFormation 在失败时是否回滚堆栈。当前更新是*成功的*；问题不是回滚问题，而是未创建新的 API Gateway 部署。禁用回滚不会改变 API Gateway 的阶段配置。

- **B. 取消设置 CloudFormation 堆栈故障选项** — 与 A 相同：故障处理选项无关，因为堆栈更新已成功完成。方法缺失在已部署的阶段上，而不是在堆栈本身中。

- **D. 运行 `aws cloudfront create-invalidation`** — CloudFront 缓存失效仅在请求遍历 CloudFront 分布且您怀疑缓存响应时才重要。404 来自 API Gateway，因为阶段的部署快照不包括新方法。失效 CloudFront 缓存不会将方法添加到 API Gateway 阶段。

## 最佳实践替代方案
除了（或结合）CodeBuild 步骤，您可以在每次模板更改时更改 **`AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment` 资源的逻辑 ID**（例如，附加哈希值/时间戳），这会强制 CloudFormation 创建全新的 Deployment 并更新 Stage 使用它。您可以通过使逻辑 ID 唯一（例如，为每个 CloudFormation 部署附加时间戳或哈希值）来解决此问题。但是，根据答案选项，**C** 是所呈现的选项。

## 参考资源
- [AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment - AWS CloudFormation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-resource-apigateway-deployment.html)
- [API Gateway create-deployment CLI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/reference/apigateway/create-deployment.html)
- [API Gateway deployment issue – AWS re:Post](https://repost.aws/questions/QU6NuFvCDfRkyXkTAEc1wpyQ/api-gateway-deployment-issue)

en.question: A developer updates an AWS Lambda function that an Amazon API Gateway API uses. The API is the backend for a web application. The developer needs to test the updated Lambda function before deploying the Lambda function to production. The testing must not affect any production users of the web application. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Create a canary release deployment for the existing API stage. Deploy the API to the existing stage. Test the updated Lambda function by using the existing URL.
options.B: Update the API Gateway API endpoint type to private. Deploy the changes to the existing API stage. Test the API by using the existing URL.
options.C: Create a new test API stage in API Gateway. Add stage variables to deploy the updated Lambda function to only the test stage. Test the updated Lambda function by using the new stage URL.
options.D: Create a new AWS CloudFormation stack to deploy a copy of the entire production API and Lambda function. Use the stack's API URL to test the updated Lambda function.

en.explanation:
# Testing an Updated Lambda Function Behind API Gateway

## Scenario
A developer has updated a Lambda function used as the backend integration of an API Gateway API serving a production web application. The updated Lambda must be tested **without impacting any production users**, and the solution must be the **most operationally efficient**.

## Correct Answer: **C** — Create a new test API stage and use stage variables

API Gateway supports multiple deployment **stages** (e.g., `prod`, `test`, `dev`) per API, each with its own invoke URL. Combined with **stage variables**, you can point each stage at a different Lambda function (or Lambda alias/version) without duplicating the API definition.

Stage variables act like environment variables and can be used to change the behavior of your API Gateway methods for each deployment stage; for example, making it possible to reach a different back end depending on which stage the API is running on.

In the Method Integration, the Lambda function is referenced as `${stageVariables.lambdaFunction}` (or `myFunc:${stageVariables.lambdaAlias}`). A stage variable can be used in place of a Lambda function name, or version/alias.

This allows the developer to:
1. Create a new `test` stage on the existing API.
2. Set its stage variable to point to the **updated** Lambda function (or its `test` alias).
3. Keep the `prod` stage's stage variable pointing to the **current** Lambda.
4. Test the new function via the test stage's invoke URL — production users continue to hit the prod stage URL with the unchanged backend.

This is the textbook use case: "everything in development stay in development, which won't affect anything in production."

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

### A. Canary release on the existing API stage
A canary release on the **existing production stage** would route a percentage of **real production traffic** to the new Lambda. The requirement explicitly says the testing **must not affect any production users** — even a small canary percentage exposes real users to the untested code. Also, "test by using the existing URL" mixes test and production traffic, violating the isolation requirement.

### B. Change the API endpoint to Private
Switching the endpoint type to **Private** restricts access to within a VPC via interface VPC endpoints — it would actually **break the public web application** for all production users. It does not isolate test traffic from production traffic; it just blocks public access entirely.

### D. Deploy a copy of the entire API + Lambda via a new CloudFormation stack
While this would work functionally and provide isolation, it is **not the most operationally efficient** option. Duplicating the entire API and Lambda function (and maintaining two complete stacks) creates unnecessary infrastructure, drift risk, and operational overhead compared to simply adding a new stage on the existing API and toggling a stage variable.

## Key Takeaways
- API Gateway **stages + stage variables + Lambda aliases** are the canonical mechanism for promoting Lambda changes through dev → test → prod without code-level changes to the API definition.
- Canary deployments are for gradual production rollouts, **not** for pre-production testing in isolation from real users.

## References
- [Stage variables reference for REST APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/aws-api-gateway-stage-variables-reference.html)
- [Set up stage variables for REST APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-set-stage-variables-aws-console.html)
- [Using API Gateway stage variables to manage Lambda functions (AWS Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/using-api-gateway-stage-variables-to-manage-lambda-functions/)

zh.question: 开发人员更新了 Amazon API Gateway API 使用的 AWS Lambda 函数。该 API 是 Web 应用程序的后端。开发人员需要在将 Lambda 函数部署到生产环境之前对其进行测试。测试不得影响 Web 应用程序的任何生产用户。哪种解决方案能够以最高效的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 为现有 API 阶段创建金丝雀发布部署。将 API 部署到现有阶段。使用现有 URL 测试更新后的 Lambda 函数。
options.B: 将 API 网关 API 端点类型更新为私有。将更改部署到现有 API 阶段。使用现有 URL 测试 API。
options.C: 在 API 网关中创建一个新的测试 API 阶段。添加阶段变量，以便将更新后的 Lambda 函数仅部署到该测试阶段。使用新的阶段 URL 测试更新后的 Lambda 函数。
options.D: 创建一个新的 AWS CloudFormation 堆栈，用于部署整个生产 API 和 Lambda 函数的副本。使用该堆栈的 API URL 测试更新后的 Lambda 函数。

zh.explanation:
# 测试 API Gateway 后的已更新 Lambda 函数

## 场景
开发人员已更新用作生产 Web 应用程序 API Gateway API 后端集成的 Lambda 函数。更新后的 Lambda 必须经过测试，**不能对任何生产用户产生影响**，并且解决方案必须是**运维效率最高的**。

## 正确答案：**C** — 创建新的测试 API 阶段并使用阶段变量

API Gateway 支持每个 API 的多个部署**阶段**（例如 `prod`、`test`、`dev`），每个阶段都有自己的调用 URL。结合**阶段变量**，您可以将每个阶段指向不同的 Lambda 函数（或 Lambda 别名/版本），而无需复制 API 定义。

阶段变量的作用类似环境变量，可用于为每个部署阶段更改 API Gateway 方法的行为；例如，可以使 API 根据运行的阶段到达不同的后端。

在方法集成中，Lambda 函数被引用为 `${stageVariables.lambdaFunction}`（或 `myFunc:${stageVariables.lambdaAlias}`）。阶段变量可用来代替 Lambda 函数名称、版本或别名。

这允许开发人员：
1. 在现有 API 上创建新的 `test` 阶段。
2. 将其阶段变量设置为指向**更新后的** Lambda 函数（或其 `test` 别名）。
3. 保持 `prod` 阶段的阶段变量指向**当前的** Lambda。
4. 通过测试阶段的调用 URL 测试新函数 — 生产用户继续使用 prod 阶段 URL 访问未更改的后端。

这是典型的用例："开发中的所有内容保持在开发阶段，不会对生产环境产生任何影响。"

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

### A. 在现有 API 阶段上进行金丝雀发布
在**现有生产阶段**上进行金丝雀发布会将一定百分比的**真实生产流量**路由到新 Lambda。此要求明确指出测试**不得影响任何生产用户** — 即使很小的金丝雀百分比也会使真实用户面临未测试代码的风险。另外，"使用现有 URL 进行测试"混合了测试和生产流量，违反了隔离要求。

### B. 将 API 端点更改为私有
将端点类型切换为**私有**会将访问限制在 VPC 内部，通过接口 VPC 端点访问 — 实际上会为所有生产用户**破坏公共 Web 应用程序**。它不会将测试流量与生产流量隔离；它只是完全阻止公共访问。

### D. 通过新的 CloudFormation 栈部署完整的 API 和 Lambda 副本
虽然这在功能上可行并提供隔离，但它**不是运维效率最高的**选项。复制整个 API 和 Lambda 函数（并维护两个完整的栈）会创建不必要的基础设施、漂移风险和运维开销，相比之下只需在现有 API 上添加新阶段并切换阶段变量要简单得多。

## 关键要点
- API Gateway **阶段 + 阶段变量 + Lambda 别名**是在 dev → test → prod 中推进 Lambda 更改的规范机制，无需对 API 定义进行代码级别的更改。
- 金丝雀部署用于逐步生产推出，**不是**用于与真实用户隔离的预生产测试。

## 参考资源
- [REST API 的阶段变量参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/aws-api-gateway-stage-variables-reference.html)
- [为 REST API 设置阶段变量](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-set-stage-variables-aws-console.html)
- [使用 API Gateway 阶段变量管理 Lambda 函数（AWS 博客）](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/using-api-gateway-stage-variables-to-manage-lambda-functions/)

en.question: A developer wants the ability to roll back to a previous version of an AWS Lambda function in the event of errors caused by a new deployment. How can the developer achieve this with MINIMAL impact on users?

options.A: Change the application to use an alias that points to the current version. Deploy the new version of the code. Update the alias to use the newly deployed version. If too many errors are encountered, point the alias back to the previous version.
options.B: Change the application to use an alias that points to the current version. Deploy the new version of the code. Update the alias to direct 10% of users to the newly deployed version. If too many errors are encountered, send 100% of traffic to the previous version.
options.C: Do not make any changes to the application. Deploy the new version of the code. If too many errors are encountered, point the application back to the previous version using the version number in the Amazon Resource Name (ARN).
options.D: Create three aliases: new, existing, and router. Point the existing alias to the current version. Have the router alias direct 100% of users to the existing alias. Update the application to use the router alias. Deploy the new version of the code. Point the new alias to this version. Update the router alias to direct 10% of users to the new alias. If too many errors are encountered, send 100% of traffic to the existing alias.

en.explanation:
# Lambda Rollback with Minimal User Impact

## Scenario
A developer wants to be able to roll back to a previous version of a Lambda function if a new deployment causes errors, with **MINIMAL impact on users**. The keyword is "minimal impact" — this points to a canary (weighted alias) deployment strategy.

## Correct Answer: B

Lambda aliases support **weighted routing** (traffic shifting) between two versions of the same function. This is the canonical canary deployment pattern on Lambda.

You can use a weighted alias to split traffic between two different versions of the same function. With this approach, you can test new versions of your functions with a small percentage of traffic and quickly roll back if necessary. This is known as a canary deployment.

By directing only 10% of users to the new version, only that small fraction is exposed to potential errors. If problems are detected, you shift 100% of traffic back to the previous version — minimizing user impact during both the rollout and any rollback.

If everything looks good, you increase the weight to 100% for the new version (promoting it to full production). If something goes wrong, you quickly roll back the alias to 0% on the new version (i.e., routing all traffic back to the old version). This weighted alias mechanism allows rapid, controlled releases without changing client configuration – clients always invoke the alias (like "prod"), and the alias decides how to distribute requests to underlying versions.

Example CLI to perform the canary shift:
```bash
aws lambda update-alias \
  --name prod \
  --function-name my-function \
  --function-version 2 \
  --routing-config 'AdditionalVersionWeights={"2"=0.1}'
```

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Update alias to point fully to new version, roll back if errors.** This is a blue/green "flip" — 100% of users get the new code immediately. Before the release of traffic shifting for Lambda aliases, deployments of a Lambda function could only be performed in a single "flip" by updating function code for version $LATEST, or by updating an alias to target a different function version. After the update propagates, typically within a few seconds, 100% of function invocations execute the new version. Rollback is possible, but **all** users are impacted by errors until the rollback occurs — not "minimal impact."

- **C. No changes; reference a version ARN directly.** This bypasses aliases entirely. Without an alias, clients invoke a fixed version ARN, so to "roll back" you must redeploy/reconfigure every client/event source pointing at that ARN. There is no traffic-shifting capability and 100% of users are affected by a bad deployment. Best practice is to always invoke through the alias, not a version ARN.

- **D. Three aliases (new, existing, router).** Lambda aliases cannot point to other aliases — an alias points to a function version (or two versions for weighted routing), not to another alias. You can point an alias to a maximum of two Lambda function versions. The versions must meet the following criteria: Both versions must have the same execution role. Both versions must have the same dead-letter queue configuration, or no dead-letter queue configuration. Both versions must be published. The alias cannot point to $LATEST. The "router alias pointing at another alias" design is not a supported Lambda construct, and weighted routing on a single alias already accomplishes the goal natively.

## Key Takeaway
For minimal user impact during a Lambda rollout/rollback, use a single alias with **weighted (canary) routing** — shift a small percentage to the new version, monitor, and either promote to 100% or revert to 0% on the new version.

## References
- [Implement Lambda canary deployments using a weighted alias (AWS docs)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html)
- [Implementing Canary Deployments of AWS Lambda Functions with Alias Traffic Shifting (AWS Compute Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/implementing-canary-deployments-of-aws-lambda-functions-with-alias-traffic-shifting/)

zh.question: 开发人员希望在因新部署导致错误时，能够回滚到 AWS Lambda 函数的先前版本。开发人员如何才能在对用户影响最小的情况下实现这一点？

options.A: 将应用程序的别名更改为指向当前版本。部署新版本的代码。更新别名以使用新部署的版本。如果遇到过多错误，则将别名指向之前的版本。
options.B: 将应用程序的别名更改为指向当前版本。部署新版本的代码。更新别名，将 10% 的用户定向到新部署的版本。如果遇到过多错误，则将所有流量重定向到旧版本。
options.C: 请勿对应用程序进行任何更改。部署新版本的代码。如果遇到过多错误，请使用 Amazon 资源名称 (ARN) 中的版本号将应用程序回滚到以前的版本。
options.D: 创建三个别名：new、existing 和 router。将 existing 别名指向当前版本。将 router 别名引导 100% 的用户访问 existing 别名。更新应用程序以使用 router 别名。部署新版本的代码。将 new 别名指向新版本。更新 router 别名，引导 10% 的用户访问 new 别名。如果遇到过多错误，则将所有流量转发到 existing 别名。

zh.explanation:
# Lambda 回滚且最小化用户影响

## 场景
开发人员希望在新部署导致错误时能够回滚到 Lambda 函数的先前版本，同时**最小化对用户的影响**。关键词是"最小化影响"——这指向金丝雀（加权别名）部署策略。

## 正确答案：B

Lambda 别名支持**加权路由**（流量转移），可以在同一函数的两个版本之间分配流量。这是 Lambda 上规范的金丝雀部署模式。

您可以使用加权别名在同一函数的两个不同版本之间分配流量。通过这种方法，您可以使用一小部分流量测试函数的新版本，并在必要时快速回滚。这称为金丝雀部署。

通过仅将 10% 的用户流量指向新版本，只有这一小部分用户会暴露于潜在错误中。如果检测到问题，您可以将 100% 的流量转移回先前的版本——最小化回滚期间和任何回滚时对用户的影响。

如果一切看起来都很好，您将新版本的权重增加到 100%（将其提升为完整生产环境）。如果出现问题，您可以快速将别名回滚到新版本的 0%（即将所有流量路由回旧版本）。这种加权别名机制允许快速、受控的发布，无需更改客户端配置——客户端始终调用别名（如"prod"），别名决定如何将请求分配给基础版本。

执行金丝雀转移的 CLI 示例：
```bash
aws lambda update-alias \
  --name prod \
  --function-name my-function \
  --function-version 2 \
  --routing-config 'AdditionalVersionWeights={"2"=0.1}'
```

## 其他选项为何错误

- **A. 将别名完全更新为指向新版本，如果出现错误则回滚。** 这是蓝/绿"翻转"——100% 的用户立即获得新代码。在 Lambda 别名的流量转移功能发布之前，Lambda 函数的部署只能通过更新 $LATEST 版本的函数代码或将别名更新为指向不同的函数版本来执行单个"翻转"。更新传播后（通常在几秒内），100% 的函数调用执行新版本。 回滚是可能的，但在回滚发生之前，**所有**用户都会受到错误的影响——而不是"最小化影响"。

- **C. 不做更改；直接引用版本 ARN。** 这绕过了别名。没有别名的情况下，客户端调用固定版本 ARN，因此要"回滚"您必须重新部署/重新配置指向该 ARN 的每个客户端/事件源。没有流量转移功能，100% 的用户会受到不良部署的影响。最佳实践是始终通过别名调用，而不是版本 ARN。

- **D. 三个别名（新的、现有的、路由器）。** Lambda 别名不能指向其他别名——别名指向函数版本（或用于加权路由的两个版本），而不是另一个别名。您可以将别名指向最多两个 Lambda 函数版本。这些版本必须满足以下条件：两个版本必须具有相同的执行角色。两个版本必须具有相同的死信队列配置，或没有死信队列配置。两个版本都必须已发布。别名不能指向 $LATEST。 "路由器别名指向另一个别名"的设计不是受支持的 Lambda 构造，单个别名上的加权路由已本地实现了该目标。

## 关键要点
对于 Lambda 回滚期间最小化用户影响，请使用单个别名配合**加权（金丝雀）路由**——将一小部分流量转移到新版本、监控，然后要么提升到 100%，要么将新版本的权重回滚到 0%。

## 参考资源
- [使用加权别名实现 Lambda 金丝雀部署（AWS 文档）](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html)
- [使用别名流量转移实现 AWS Lambda 函数的金丝雀部署（AWS Compute 博客）](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/implementing-canary-deployments-of-aws-lambda-functions-with-alias-traffic-shifting/)

en.question: A company maintains a REST service using Amazon API Gateway and the API Gateway native API key validation. The company recently launched a new registration page, which allows users to sign up for the service. The registration page creates a new API key using CreateApiKey and sends the new key to the user. When the user attempts to call the API using this key, the user receives a 403 Forbidden error. Existing users are unaffected and can still call the API. What code updates will grant these new users access to the API?

options.A: The createDeployment method must be called so the API can be redeployed to include the newly created API key.
options.B: The updateAuthorizer method must be called to update the API's authorizer to include the newly created API key.
options.C: The importApiKeys method must be called to import all newly created API keys into the current stage of the API.
options.D: The createUsagePlanKey method must be called to associate the newly created API key with the correct usage plan.

en.explanation:
# API Gateway: New API Keys Returning 403 Forbidden

## Scenario
The company uses API Gateway with native API key validation. The registration page calls `CreateApiKey` to issue keys to new users, but those users get **403 Forbidden** when calling the API. Existing users still work.

## Why 403 Happens
In API Gateway, simply creating an API key is not enough. The key must be associated with a **usage plan** that is in turn associated with the API stage(s) the user is calling. A usage plan specifies who can access one or more deployed API stages and methods—and optionally sets the target request rate to start throttling requests. The plan uses API keys to identify API clients and who can access the associated API stages for each key.

If a key has no usage plan tying it to the stage, API Gateway rejects the request with 403 Forbidden, exactly as described in the question.

## Correct Answer: D — `createUsagePlanKey`

The `CreateUsagePlanKey` operation links an existing API key to a usage plan. Creates a usage plan key for adding an existing API key to a usage plan.

Example (boto3):
```python
import boto3
client = boto3.client('apigateway')

# 1) Create the API key
resp = client.create_api_key(name='NewUserKey', enabled=True)
api_key_id = resp['id']

# 2) Associate the key with the usage plan tied to the API stage
client.create_usage_plan_key(
    usagePlanId='YOUR_USAGE_PLAN_ID',
    keyId=api_key_id,
    keyType='API_KEY'
)
```

After this association, the new user's key will be authorized for the stage(s) that the usage plan is mapped to.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. `createDeployment`** — Redeployment pushes API configuration (resources/methods/integrations) to a stage. API keys are independent of deployments; existing users are unaffected, proving the API is already deployed correctly. Redeploying does nothing to associate the new key with a usage plan.
- **B. `updateAuthorizer`** — Authorizers (Lambda authorizers, Cognito user pool authorizers) are a separate access-control mechanism from API keys. The question explicitly states the company uses *native API key validation*, not a custom authorizer. Authorizers do not contain a list of API keys.
- **C. `importApiKeys`** — This bulk-imports API keys from a CSV file into API Gateway. The keys in this scenario are already created via `CreateApiKey`; they do not need to be imported. Importing also does not, by itself, attach keys to a usage plan/stage.

## References
- [CreateUsagePlanKey – API Gateway API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/api/API_CreateUsagePlanKey.html)
- [Usage plans and API keys for REST APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-api-usage-plans.html)
- [Set up usage plans for REST APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-create-usage-plans.html)
- [aws apigateway create-usage-plan-key (CLI)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/reference/apigateway/create-usage-plan-key.html)

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 API Gateway 原生 API 密钥验证功能维护 REST 服务。该公司最近推出了一个新的注册页面，允许用户注册该服务。注册页面使用 CreateApiKey 函数创建一个新的 API 密钥，并将新密钥发送给用户。当用户尝试使用此密钥调用 API 时，会收到 403 Forbidden 错误。现有用户不受影响，仍然可以调用 API。需要进行哪些代码更新才能使这些新用户能够访问 API？

options.A: 必须调用 createDeployment 方法，以便重新部署 API 以包含新创建的 API 密钥。
options.B: 必须调用 updateAuthorizer 方法来更新 API 的授权器，使其包含新创建的 API 密钥。
options.C: 必须调用 importApiKeys 方法将所有新创建的 API 密钥导入到 API 的当前阶段。
options.D: 必须调用 createUsagePlanKey 方法，将新创建的 API 密钥与正确的使用计划关联起来。

zh.explanation:
# API Gateway：新 API 密钥返回 403 Forbidden

## 场景
公司使用 API Gateway 和原生 API 密钥验证。注册页面调用 `CreateApiKey` 为新用户颁发密钥，但这些用户在调用 API 时收到 **403 Forbidden** 错误。现有用户仍然可以正常工作。

## 为什么会出现 403
在 API Gateway 中，仅创建 API 密钥是不够的。该密钥必须与一个 **usage plan** 相关联，而该 usage plan 又必须与用户调用的 API 阶段相关联。使用计划指定谁可以访问一个或多个已部署的 API 阶段和方法——并可以选择性地设置目标请求速率以开始限制请求。该计划使用 API 密钥来识别 API 客户端以及谁可以访问每个密钥关联的 API 阶段。

如果密钥没有将其绑定到阶段的使用计划，API Gateway 将以 403 Forbidden 拒绝该请求，这正是问题中描述的情况。

## 正确答案：D — `createUsagePlanKey`

`CreateUsagePlanKey` 操作将现有 API 密钥链接到使用计划。创建使用计划密钥，用于将现有 API 密钥添加到使用计划。

示例（boto3）：
```python
import boto3
client = boto3.client('apigateway')

# 1) 创建 API 密钥
resp = client.create_api_key(name='NewUserKey', enabled=True)
api_key_id = resp['id']

# 2) 将密钥与绑定到 API 阶段的使用计划相关联
client.create_usage_plan_key(
    usagePlanId='YOUR_USAGE_PLAN_ID',
    keyId=api_key_id,
    keyType='API_KEY'
)
```

进行此关联后，新用户的密钥将被授权访问使用计划映射到的阶段。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. `createDeployment`** — 重新部署会将 API 配置（资源/方法/集成）推送到阶段。API 密钥独立于部署；现有用户不受影响，这证明 API 已正确部署。重新部署对将新密钥与使用计划关联没有帮助。
- **B. `updateAuthorizer`** — 授权器（Lambda 授权器、Cognito 用户池授权器）是与 API 密钥不同的独立访问控制机制。问题明确指出公司使用的是*原生 API 密钥验证*，而不是自定义授权器。授权器不包含 API 密钥列表。
- **C. `importApiKeys`** — 这是从 CSV 文件批量导入 API 密钥到 API Gateway 的操作。此场景中的密钥已通过 `CreateApiKey` 创建；它们不需要导入。导入本身也不会自动将密钥附加到使用计划/阶段。

## 参考资源
- [CreateUsagePlanKey – API Gateway API 参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/api/API_CreateUsagePlanKey.html)
- [REST API 的使用计划和 API 密钥](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-api-usage-plans.html)
- [为 REST API 设置使用计划](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-create-usage-plans.html)
- [aws apigateway create-usage-plan-key (CLI)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/reference/apigateway/create-usage-plan-key.html)

en.question: A company uses an AWS CloudFormation template to deploy and manage its AWS infrastructure. The CloudFormation template creates Amazon VPC security groups and Amazon EC2 security groups. A manager finds out that some engineers modified the security groups of a few EC2 instances for testing purposes. A developer needs to determine what modifications occurred. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Add a Conditions section statement in the source YAML file of the template. Run the CloudFormation stack.
options.B: Perform a drift detection operation on the CloudFormation stack.
options.C: Execute a change set for the CloudFormation stack.
options.D: Use Amazon Detective to detect the modifications.

en.explanation:
# CloudFormation Drift Detection for Modified Security Groups

## Scenario
Infrastructure is provisioned via a CloudFormation template that creates VPC and EC2 security groups. Engineers modified some EC2 security groups directly (outside of CloudFormation) for testing. The developer needs to identify what was changed compared to the template definitions.

## Correct Answer: B — Perform a drift detection operation on the CloudFormation stack

CloudFormation drift detection is purpose-built for exactly this situation. You can use drift detection to identify stack resources to which configuration changes have been made outside of CloudFormation management. You can then take corrective action so that your stack resources are again in sync with their definitions in the stack template.

To determine whether a resource has drifted, CloudFormation determines the expected resource property values, as defined in the stack template and any values specified as template parameters. CloudFormation then compares those expected values with the actual values of those resource properties as they currently exist in the stack. A resource is considered to have drifted if one or more of its properties have been deleted, or had their value changed.

The drift report shows exactly what changed: This page lists the resource's expected and current property values, and any differences between the two. To highlight a difference, in the Differences section select the property name. Added properties are highlighted in green in the Current column of the Details section. Deleted properties are highlighted in red in the Expected column of the Details section. Properties whose value have been changed are highlighted in yellow in the both Expected and Current columns.

You can run drift detection from the console (Stack actions → Detect drift) or via the CLI:

```bash
aws cloudformation detect-stack-drift --stack-name my-stack
aws cloudformation describe-stack-resource-drifts \
  --stack-name my-stack \
  --stack-resource-drift-status-filters MODIFIED DELETED
```

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. Add a Conditions section to the YAML and run the stack** — The `Conditions` section in CloudFormation controls *whether* resources or outputs are created based on input parameters/pseudo-parameters at deploy time. It has no capability to compare live resource state with the template. Re-running the stack would also not report what engineers changed — at best it would attempt to update resources back, possibly causing unintended replacements.

- **C. Execute a change set for the CloudFormation stack** — A change set previews the changes that *a new template or parameter set* would make to a stack. It compares the *new template* against the *current stack template definition*, not the live AWS resource configuration. It cannot detect out-of-band modifications made directly via the EC2/VPC console or API.

- **D. Use Amazon Detective** — Amazon Detective is a security investigation service that analyzes VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail, and GuardDuty findings to investigate security incidents (e.g., compromised credentials, unusual API calls). It does not compare resource configuration against a CloudFormation template. The right service to *audit who changed what* would be CloudTrail or AWS Config, not Detective — and to compare against the template, drift detection is the correct tool.

## References
- [Detect unmanaged configuration changes to stacks and resources with drift detection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-stack-drift.html)
- [Detect drift on an entire CloudFormation stack](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/detect-drift-stack.html)
- [detect-stack-drift CLI reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/reference/cloudformation/detect-stack-drift.html)

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板来部署和管理其 AWS 基础设施。该 CloudFormation 模板会创建 Amazon VPC 安全组和 Amazon EC2 安全组。一位经理发现，一些工程师出于测试目的修改了部分 EC2 实例的安全组。开发人员需要确定具体进行了哪些修改。哪种解决方案能够满足此要求？

options.A: 在模板的源 YAML 文件中添加条件部分语句。运行 CloudFormation 堆栈。
options.B: 对 CloudFormation 堆栈执行漂移检测操作。
options.C: 为 CloudFormation 堆栈执行变更集。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Detective 检测修改。

zh.explanation:
# CloudFormation 漂移检测用于修改的安全组

## 场景
基础设施通过 CloudFormation 模板进行配置，该模板创建 VPC 和 EC2 安全组。工程师直接修改了一些 EC2 安全组（在 CloudFormation 外部）以进行测试。开发人员需要识别与模板定义相比发生了什么更改。

## 正确答案：B — 对 CloudFormation 堆栈执行漂移检测操作

CloudFormation 漂移检测正是为了这种情况而设计的。您可以使用漂移检测来识别已在 CloudFormation 管理之外进行了配置更改的堆栈资源。然后，您可以采取纠正措施，使堆栈资源再次与堆栈模板中的定义同步。

为了确定资源是否已漂移，CloudFormation 确定预期的资源属性值（如堆栈模板和任何指定为模板参数的值中所定义）。然后，CloudFormation 将这些预期值与堆栈中当前存在的这些资源属性的实际值进行比较。如果一个或多个属性已被删除或其值已更改，则资源被视为已漂移。

漂移报告准确显示了发生的更改：此页面列出资源的预期和当前属性值，以及两者之间的任何差异。要突出显示差异，请在"Differences"（差异）部分中选择属性名称。添加的属性在"Details"（详细信息）部分的"Current"（当前）列中以绿色突出显示。删除的属性在"Details"（详细信息）部分的"Expected"（预期）列中以红色突出显示。值已更改的属性在"Expected"（预期）和"Current"（当前）列中都以黄色突出显示。

您可以从控制台运行漂移检测（Stack actions（堆栈操作）→ Detect drift（检测漂移））或通过 CLI 运行：

```bash
aws cloudformation detect-stack-drift --stack-name my-stack
aws cloudformation describe-stack-resource-drifts \
  --stack-name my-stack \
  --stack-resource-drift-status-filters MODIFIED DELETED
```

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. 在 YAML 中添加 Conditions 部分并运行堆栈** — CloudFormation 中的 `Conditions` 部分控制资源或输出是否基于在部署时输入参数/伪参数创建。它无法比较实时资源状态与模板。重新运行堆栈也不会报告工程师更改了什么 — 最多会尝试将资源更新回去，可能会导致意外的替换。

- **C. 为 CloudFormation 堆栈执行变更集** — 变更集预览*新模板或参数集*将对堆栈进行的更改。它比较的是*新模板*与*当前堆栈模板定义*，而不是实时 AWS 资源配置。它无法检测通过 EC2/VPC 控制台或 API 直接进行的带外修改。

- **D. 使用 Amazon Detective** — Amazon Detective 是一项安全调查服务，用于分析 VPC Flow Logs、CloudTrail 和 GuardDuty 发现结果，以调查安全事件（例如，被盗用的凭证、异常 API 调用）。它无法比较资源配置与 CloudFormation 模板。要*审计谁更改了什么*，正确的服务是 CloudTrail 或 AWS Config，而不是 Detective — 要比较与模板，漂移检测是正确的工具。

## 参考资源
- [Detect unmanaged configuration changes to stacks and resources with drift detection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-stack-drift.html)
- [Detect drift on an entire CloudFormation stack](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/detect-drift-stack.html)
- [detect-stack-drift CLI reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/reference/cloudformation/detect-stack-drift.html)

en.question: An IAM role is attached to an Amazon EC2 instance that explicitly denies access to all Amazon S3 API actions. The EC2 instance credentials file specifies the IAM access key and secret access key, which allow full administrative access. Given that multiple modes of IAM access are present for this EC2 instance, which of the following is correct?

options.A: The EC2 instance will only be able to list the S3 buckets.
options.B: The EC2 instance will only be able to list the contents of one S3 bucket at a time.
options.C: The EC2 instance will be able to perform all actions on any S3 bucket.
options.D: The EC2 instance will not be able to perform any S3 action on any S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
# Question 385 — EC2 with Conflicting IAM Role and Static Credentials

## Correct Answer: **C** — The EC2 instance will be able to perform all actions on any S3 bucket.

> ⚠️ **Note on the originally-listed answer (D):** The previously stated answer (D) is incorrect. It misapplies the "explicit deny overrides allow" rule. That rule governs policy evaluation **for a single principal making a request** — but in this scenario, two *different* principals (an IAM role and an IAM user) are present, and the AWS credential provider chain causes the IAM user's keys to be used, so the role's deny is never evaluated.

---

## Scenario Summary

An EC2 instance has **two distinct credential sources** simultaneously available:

1. **An IAM role** attached via instance profile that contains an **explicit deny** on all `s3:*` API actions.
2. **A shared credentials file** (`~/.aws/credentials`) holding an **IAM user's** access key and secret key that grant **full administrative access**.

The question hinges on which principal is actually used when an SDK or the AWS CLI on that instance calls S3.

---

## Why C Is Correct

### 1. The AWS Default Credential Provider Chain

The AWS CLI and SDKs walk a documented precedence chain when locating credentials. Per the [AWS CLI authentication and access credentials reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/v1/userguide/cli-chap-authentication.html) and the [AWS SDK standardized credentials guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdkref/latest/guide/standardized-credentials.html), the order (highest → lowest priority) is roughly:

1. Command-line options
2. Environment variables
3. Assume-role / web identity
4. **Shared credentials file (`~/.aws/credentials`)**
5. CLI/SDK config file
6. Container credentials (ECS/EKS)
7. **EC2 instance profile credentials (lowest priority)**

The shared credentials file is consulted **before** the EC2 instance profile. The instance profile is the *fallback* — used only when no other source supplies credentials.

### 2. AWS Officially Documents This Exact Scenario

The AWS Knowledge Center article ["Why does my EC2 instance use IAM user credentials from the AWS CLI instead of the attached IAM role's credentials?"](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/iam-ec2-user-role-credentials) describes precisely this configuration. It states that when IAM user credentials are present in `.aws/credentials`, they "have a higher precedence than role credentials," so API calls are signed as the IAM user, not the role. AWS even recommends removing the credentials file as the remediation.

### 3. IAM Policy Evaluation Is Per-Principal

Per the [IAM policy evaluation logic documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_evaluation-logic.html), AWS evaluates policies against the **principal in the signed request**. Because the requests are signed with the IAM user's keys, only that **IAM user's** policies are evaluated — and the user has admin permissions. The IAM role's explicit-deny policy is never consulted, because the role is never assumed for these calls.

Net result: full S3 access succeeds.

---

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. List buckets only** — Incorrect. No policy restricts the IAM user to `s3:ListAllMyBuckets`. The user has full admin permissions, so all S3 actions succeed.
- **B. List one bucket at a time** — Incorrect. This is not a real IAM mechanism; nothing in the scenario or in IAM works that way.
- **D. No S3 actions allowed (originally listed answer)** — Incorrect. This answer assumes the IAM role's explicit deny will block requests, applying the "explicit deny overrides allow" rule. But that rule only applies when the *same principal* has both an allow and a deny. Here, the SDK signs requests as the IAM user (per the [credential provider chain](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/v1/userguide/cli-chap-authentication.html)) — the role is never the principal, so its deny statement is irrelevant. D would only be correct if the role's credentials were actually being used.

---

## Key Exam Takeaway

> **"Explicit deny overrides allow" only applies within a single principal's policy evaluation.** When multiple credential sources exist on an EC2 instance, the AWS SDK/CLI **default credential provider chain** decides which principal signs the request — and the **shared credentials file beats the instance profile**. This is a documented anti-pattern: AWS recommends never placing static IAM user keys on an EC2 instance that already has a role, precisely because the static keys silently shadow the role.

---

## References

- [AWS CLI — Configuration and credential file settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-chap-configure.html)
- [AWS CLI — Authentication and access credentials](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/v1/userguide/cli-chap-authentication.html)
- [AWS SDKs and Tools — Standardized credential providers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdkref/latest/guide/standardized-credentials.html)
- [AWS re:Post — Why EC2 uses IAM user credentials instead of role credentials](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/iam-ec2-user-role-credentials)
- [IAM — Policy evaluation logic](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_evaluation-logic.html)

zh.question: 一个 IAM 角色已附加到 Amazon EC2 实例，该角色明确拒绝访问所有 Amazon S3 API 操作。EC2 实例凭证文件指定了 IAM 访问密钥和秘密访问密钥，从而允许完全管理访问权限。鉴于此 EC2 实例存在多种 IAM 访问模式，以下哪项是正确的？

options.A: EC2 实例只能列出 S3 存储桶。
options.B: EC2 实例一次只能列出一个 S3 存储桶的内容。
options.C: EC2 实例将能够对任何 S3 存储桶执行所有操作。
options.D: EC2 实例将无法对任何 S3 存储桶执行任何 S3 操作。

zh.explanation:
# 问题 385 — EC2 与冲突的 IAM 角色和静态凭证

## 正确答案：**C** — EC2 实例将能够对任何 S3 存储桶执行所有操作。

> ⚠️ **关于最初列出的答案 (D) 的说明：** 之前声称的答案 (D) 是不正确的。它误用了"显式拒绝覆盖允许"规则。该规则管理**单个主体发出请求**时的策略评估 — 但在此场景中，存在两个*不同的*主体（IAM 角色和 IAM 用户），AWS 凭证提供者链导致使用 IAM 用户的密钥，因此角色的拒绝永远不会被评估。

---

## 场景摘要

一个 EC2 实例有**两个不同的凭证源**同时可用：

1. **通过实例配置文件附加的 IAM 角色**，包含对所有 `s3:*` API 操作的**显式拒绝**。
2. **共享凭证文件**（`~/.aws/credentials`），包含授予**完整管理员访问权限**的 IAM 用户的访问密钥和密钥。

问题的关键在于当该实例上的 SDK 或 AWS CLI 调用 S3 时，实际使用哪个主体。

---

## 为什么 C 是正确的

### 1. AWS 默认凭证提供者链

AWS CLI 和 SDK 在查找凭证时遵循有文档记录的优先级链。根据 [AWS CLI 身份验证和访问凭证参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/v1/userguide/cli-chap-authentication.html)和 [AWS SDK 标准化凭证指南](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdkref/latest/guide/standardized-credentials.html)，顺序（最高 → 最低优先级）大致如下：

1. 命令行选项
2. 环境变量
3. Assume-role / web identity
4. **共享凭证文件 (`~/.aws/credentials`)**
5. CLI/SDK 配置文件
6. 容器凭证 (ECS/EKS)
7. **EC2 实例配置文件凭证（最低优先级）**

共享凭证文件在 EC2 实例配置文件**之前**被查询。实例配置文件是*后备*选项 — 仅当没有其他源提供凭证时使用。

### 2. AWS 官方记录了这个确切的场景

AWS 知识中心文章 ["为什么我的 EC2 实例使用 AWS CLI 中的 IAM 用户凭证而不是附加的 IAM 角色的凭证？"](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/iam-ec2-user-role-credentials) 描述了正是这个配置。它指出当 IAM 用户凭证存在于 `.aws/credentials` 中时，它们"优先级高于角色凭证"，因此 API 调用以 IAM 用户身份签名，而不是角色。AWS 甚至建议移除凭证文件作为补救方案。

### 3. IAM 策略评估是按主体进行的

根据 [IAM 策略评估逻辑文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_evaluation-logic.html)，AWS 根据**已签名请求中的主体**来评估策略。因为请求使用 IAM 用户的密钥签名，只有该 **IAM 用户的**策略被评估 — 且该用户有管理员权限。IAM 角色的显式拒绝策略永远不会被查询，因为这些调用永远不会假定该角色。

最终结果：完整的 S3 访问成功。

---

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. 仅列出存储桶** — 不正确。没有策略将 IAM 用户限制为 `s3:ListAllMyBuckets`。该用户具有完整的管理员权限，因此所有 S3 操作都会成功。
- **B. 一次列出一个存储桶** — 不正确。这不是真实的 IAM 机制；场景中或 IAM 中没有任何东西以这种方式工作。
- **D. 不允许任何 S3 操作（最初列出的答案）** — 不正确。此答案假设 IAM 角色的显式拒绝将阻止请求，应用"显式拒绝覆盖允许"规则。但该规则仅在*同一主体*同时拥有允许和拒绝时适用。这里，SDK 将请求签名为 IAM 用户（根据[凭证提供者链](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/v1/userguide/cli-chap-authentication.html)） — 角色永远不是主体，所以其拒绝语句无关。只有在实际使用角色的凭证时，D 才会正确。

---

## 关键考试要点

> **"显式拒绝覆盖允许"仅适用于单个主体的策略评估。** 当 EC2 实例上存在多个凭证源时，AWS SDK/CLI **默认凭证提供者链**决定哪个主体签名请求 — **共享凭证文件优先于实例配置文件**。这是一个有文档记录的反模式：AWS 建议永远不要将静态 IAM 用户密钥放在已有角色的 EC2 实例上，正是因为静态密钥会无声地遮蔽该角色。

---

## 参考资源

- [AWS CLI — 配置和凭证文件设置](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-chap-configure.html)
- [AWS CLI — 身份验证和访问凭证](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/v1/userguide/cli-chap-authentication.html)
- [AWS SDK 和工具 — 标准化凭证提供者](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdkref/latest/guide/standardized-credentials.html)
- [AWS re:Post — EC2 为什么使用 IAM 用户凭证而不是角色凭证](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/iam-ec2-user-role-credentials)
- [IAM — 策略评估逻辑](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_evaluation-logic.html)

en.question: A company uses an AWS Lambda function to transfer files from an Amazon S3 bucket to the company's SFTP server. The Lambda function connects to the SFTP server by using credentials such as username and password. The company uses Lambda environment variables to store these credentials. A developer needs to implement encrypted username and password credentials. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Remove the user credentials from the Lambda environment. Implement IAM database authentication.
options.B: Move the user credentials from Lambda environment variables to AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store.
options.C: Move the user credentials from Lambda environment variables to AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).
options.D: Move the user credentials from the Lambda environment to an encrypted .txt file. Store the file in an S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A Lambda function transfers files from S3 to an SFTP server using a username/password stored as **Lambda environment variables**. The developer needs the credentials to be **encrypted** rather than sitting as plaintext config on the function.

## Correct Answer: B — Move credentials to AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store

Parameter Store provides a `SecureString` parameter type that is purpose-built for sensitive data like SFTP usernames and passwords. To manage sensitive data, you can create SecureString parameters. Parameter Store uses AWS KMS keys to encrypt the parameter values of SecureString parameters when you create or change them. It also uses KMS keys to decrypt the parameter values when you access them.

AWS explicitly recommends this pattern for credentials: If you have data that you don't want users to alter or reference in plaintext, such as passwords or license keys, create those parameters using the SecureString data type.

The Lambda function retrieves the secret at runtime using the SSM API with `WithDecryption=True`:

```python
import boto3
ssm = boto3.client('ssm')

def lambda_handler(event, context):
    username = ssm.get_parameter(Name='SFTPUsername', WithDecryption=True)['Parameter']['Value']
    password = ssm.get_parameter(Name='SFTPPassword', WithDecryption=True)['Parameter']['Value']
    # ... connect to SFTP
```

The Lambda execution role needs `ssm:GetParameter` and, for SecureString, `kms:Decrypt`. The IAM role used to run the function must have the following permissions to interact with Parameter Store: ssm:GetParameter – Required to retrieve parameters from Parameter Store · kms:Decrypt – Required if you are retrieving SecureString parameters from Parameter Store.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. Remove credentials and implement IAM database authentication.** IAM database authentication is a feature of Amazon RDS / Aurora (MySQL & PostgreSQL). It cannot be used to authenticate to a third‑party **SFTP server**, which uses its own user/password (or SSH keys). It does not solve the problem.

- **C. Move credentials to AWS KMS.** KMS is a key‑management service — it stores **encryption keys**, not arbitrary secrets like usernames and passwords. KMS encrypts/decrypts data on behalf of other services; you still need a secret store (Parameter Store or Secrets Manager) to hold the ciphertext. Parameter Store does not perform any cryptographic operations. Instead, it relies on AWS KMS to encrypt and decrypt SecureString parameter values. So KMS alone is not a credential store.

- **D. Store credentials in an encrypted .txt file in S3.** While S3 supports server‑side encryption, this approach requires you to manage the file, its KMS key permissions, and parsing logic yourself, and an encrypted `.txt` file is not a standard AWS pattern for credentials. It is operationally heavier and less secure than Parameter Store SecureString, which is the AWS‑recommended mechanism for this exact use case (and provides fine‑grained IAM control, versioning, and CloudTrail auditing). The comment claiming "Parameter Store doesn't encrypt by default" is a misunderstanding — choosing the **SecureString** type encrypts the value with KMS by design.

## References

- [AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html)
- [AWS KMS encryption for Parameter Store SecureString parameters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/secure-string-parameter-kms-encryption.html)
- [Using Parameter Store parameters in AWS Lambda functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/ps-integration-lambda-extensions.html)

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Lambda 函数将文件从 Amazon S3 存储桶传输到公司的 SFTP 服务器。Lambda 函数通过用户名和密码等凭证连接到 SFTP 服务器。该公司使用 Lambda 环境变量来存储这些凭证。开发人员需要实现用户名和密码凭证的加密。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 从Lambda 环境中移除用户凭据。实施 IAM 数据库身份验证。
options.B: 将用户凭证从 Lambda 环境变量移至 AWS Systems Manager 参数存储。
options.C: 将用户凭证从 Lambda 环境变量移至 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS)。
options.D: 将用户凭据从 Lambda 环境移动到加密的 .txt 文件。将该文件存储在 S3 存储桶中。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一个 Lambda 函数使用存储为 **Lambda 环境变量** 的用户名/密码将文件从 S3 传输到 SFTP 服务器。开发人员需要将凭证进行**加密**，而不是以明文形式保存在函数配置中。

## 正确答案：B — 将凭证移至 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store

Parameter Store 提供了 `SecureString` 参数类型，专为 SFTP 用户名和密码等敏感数据而设计。为了管理敏感数据，你可以创建 SecureString 参数。Parameter Store 使用 AWS KMS 密钥在你创建或更改 SecureString 参数时加密参数值。它也使用 KMS 密钥在你访问参数值时对其进行解密。

AWS 明确推荐这种凭证管理模式：如果你的数据是你不想让用户修改或以明文形式引用的，例如密码或许可证密钥，应使用 SecureString 数据类型创建这些参数。

Lambda 函数在运行时使用 SSM API 并设置 `WithDecryption=True` 来检索秘密：

```python
import boto3
ssm = boto3.client('ssm')

def lambda_handler(event, context):
    username = ssm.get_parameter(Name='SFTPUsername', WithDecryption=True)['Parameter']['Value']
    password = ssm.get_parameter(Name='SFTPPassword', WithDecryption=True)['Parameter']['Value']
    # ... 连接到 SFTP
```

Lambda 执行角色需要 `ssm:GetParameter` 权限，以及对于 SecureString，还需要 `kms:Decrypt` 权限。用于运行函数的 IAM 角色必须具有以下权限才能与 Parameter Store 交互：ssm:GetParameter – 从 Parameter Store 检索参数所需 · kms:Decrypt – 如果你从 Parameter Store 检索 SecureString 参数时所需。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. 移除凭证并实现 IAM 数据库身份验证。** IAM 数据库身份验证是 Amazon RDS / Aurora（MySQL 和 PostgreSQL）的功能。它不能用于对第三方 **SFTP 服务器** 进行身份验证，SFTP 服务器使用自己的用户/密码（或 SSH 密钥）。这无法解决问题。

- **C. 将凭证移至 AWS KMS。** KMS 是一个密钥管理服务——它存储**加密密钥**，而不是用户名和密码等任意秘密。KMS 代表其他服务执行加密/解密操作；你仍然需要一个秘密存储库（Parameter Store 或 Secrets Manager）来保存密文。Parameter Store 不执行任何加密操作。相反，它依赖 AWS KMS 来加密和解密 SecureString 参数值。所以 KMS 单独不是凭证存储。

- **D. 将凭证存储在 S3 中的加密 .txt 文件中。** 虽然 S3 支持服务器端加密，但这种方法需要你自己管理文件、其 KMS 密钥权限和解析逻辑，加密的 `.txt` 文件不是 AWS 凭证管理的标准方式。它在操作上更加繁琐，安全性也低于 Parameter Store SecureString，而 Parameter Store SecureString 是 AWS 为此用例推荐的机制（并提供细粒度的 IAM 控制、版本控制和 CloudTrail 审计）。关于"Parameter Store 默认不加密"的评论是一个误解——选择 **SecureString** 类型按设计使用 KMS 加密值。

## 参考资源

- [AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html)
- [Parameter Store SecureString 参数的 AWS KMS 加密](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/secure-string-parameter-kms-encryption.html)
- [在 AWS Lambda 函数中使用 Parameter Store 参数](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/ps-integration-lambda-extensions.html)

en.question: A developer is creating a new batch application that will run on an Amazon EC2 instance. The application requires read access to an Amazon S3 bucket. The developer needs to follow security best practices to grant S3 read access to the application. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Add the permissions to an IAM policy. Attach the policy to a role. Attach the role to the EC2 instance profile.
options.B: Add the permissions inline to an IAM group. Attach the group to the EC2 instance profile.
options.C: Add the permissions to an IAM policy. Attach the policy to a user. Attach the user to the EC2 instance profile.
options.D: Add the permissions to an IAM policy. Use IAM web identity federation to access the S3 bucket with the policy.

en.explanation:
# Granting S3 Access to EC2 — Best Practice

## Scenario
A batch application running on an Amazon EC2 instance needs **read access to an S3 bucket**. The developer must follow AWS security best practices.

## Correct Answer: A
**Add the permissions to an IAM policy. Attach the policy to a role. Attach the role to the EC2 instance profile.**

This is the canonical AWS pattern. When you use a role, you don't have to distribute long-term credentials (such as sign-in credentials or access keys) to an Amazon EC2 instance. Instead, the role supplies temporary permissions that applications can use when they make calls to other AWS resources.

Amazon EC2 uses an instance profile as a container for an IAM role. When you create an IAM role using the IAM console, the console creates an instance profile automatically and gives it the same name as the role to which it corresponds.

When the application runs, it obtains temporary security credentials from Amazon EC2 instance metadata, and these credentials are automatically rotated by AWS — eliminating the need to store or manage access keys on the instance.

Best-practice flow:
1. Create an IAM **policy** granting only the required S3 read actions (e.g., `s3:GetObject`, `s3:ListBucket`) on the specific bucket (least privilege).
2. Attach the policy to an IAM **role** with an EC2 trust relationship.
3. Attach the role via the **instance profile** to the EC2 instance.

Example least-privilege policy:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:ListBucket"],
    "Resource": [
      "arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket",
      "arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/*"
    ]
  }]
}
```

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **B. Attach an IAM group to the EC2 instance profile.** This is technically impossible. IAM groups are containers for **IAM users only** — you cannot attach a group to an instance profile. Instance profiles only carry IAM roles.

- **C. Attach an IAM user to the EC2 instance profile.** Instance profiles do not contain IAM users — they contain a single IAM role. Furthermore, using an IAM user would typically require embedding long-term access keys on the instance, which violates security best practices and is exactly what IAM roles for EC2 were designed to avoid.

- **D. Use IAM web identity federation.** Web identity federation (via providers like Cognito, Google, Facebook, or OIDC) is intended for **external/mobile users** who authenticate with a third-party identity provider and then assume a role via STS. It is not the appropriate mechanism for an application running on an EC2 instance — the EC2 instance profile already provides a clean, automatic way to deliver temporary credentials.

## References
- [Use an IAM role to grant permissions to applications running on Amazon EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_switch-role-ec2.html)
- [IAM roles for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/iam-roles-for-amazon-ec2.html)
- [Using IAM roles to authenticate applications deployed to Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdkref/latest/guide/access-iam-roles-for-ec2.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在创建一个新的批处理应用程序，该应用程序将在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行。该应用程序需要对 Amazon S3 存储桶拥有读取权限。开发人员需要遵循安全最佳实践来授予应用程序 S3 读取权限。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 将权限添加到 IAM 策略。将该策略附加到角色。将该角色附加到 EC2 实例配置文件。
options.B: 将权限直接添加到 IAM 组。将该组附加到 EC2 实例配置文件。
options.C: 将权限添加到 IAM 策略。将该策略附加到用户。将该用户附加到 EC2 实例配置文件。
options.D: 将权限添加到 IAM 策略中。使用 IAM Web 身份联合来访问该策略下的 S3 存储桶。

zh.explanation:
# 授予 EC2 对 S3 的访问权限 — 最佳实践

## 场景
在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行的批处理应用程序需要**对 S3 bucket 的读取访问权限**。开发人员必须遵循 AWS 安全最佳实践。

## 正确答案：A
**将权限添加到 IAM 策略。将策略附加到角色。将角色附加到 EC2 实例配置文件。**

这是规范的 AWS 模式。使用角色时，您无需向 Amazon EC2 实例分发长期凭证（例如登录凭证或访问密钥）。相反，角色提供临时权限，应用程序在调用其他 AWS 资源时可以使用这些权限。

Amazon EC2 使用实例配置文件作为 IAM 角色的容器。使用 IAM 控制台创建 IAM 角色时，控制台会自动创建实例配置文件，并为其指定与对应角色相同的名称。

应用程序运行时，它从 Amazon EC2 实例元数据获取临时安全凭证，这些凭证由 AWS 自动轮换 — 无需在实例上存储或管理访问密钥。

最佳实践流程：
1. 创建 IAM **策略**，仅授予所需的 S3 读取操作权限（例如 `s3:GetObject`、`s3:ListBucket`）在特定 bucket 上（最小权限原则）。
2. 将策略附加到具有 EC2 信任关系的 IAM **角色**。
3. 通过**实例配置文件**将角色附加到 EC2 实例。

示例最小权限策略：
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:ListBucket"],
    "Resource": [
      "arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket",
      "arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/*"
    ]
  }]
}
```

## 为什么其他选项是错的

- **B. 将 IAM 组附加到 EC2 实例配置文件。** 这在技术上是不可能的。IAM 组是 **IAM 用户的容器** — 您无法将组附加到实例配置文件。实例配置文件仅包含 IAM 角色。

- **C. 将 IAM 用户附加到 EC2 实例配置文件。** 实例配置文件不包含 IAM 用户 — 它们包含单个 IAM 角色。此外，使用 IAM 用户通常需要在实例上嵌入长期访问密钥，这违反了安全最佳实践，也正是为 EC2 设计 IAM 角色旨在避免的情况。

- **D. 使用 IAM web 身份联合。** Web 身份联合（通过 Cognito、Google、Facebook 或 OIDC 等提供商）用于**外部/移动用户**，他们使用第三方身份提供商进行身份验证，然后通过 STS 担任角色。这不是在 EC2 实例上运行的应用程序的适当机制 — EC2 实例配置文件已经提供了一种干净、自动的方式来传递临时凭证。

## 参考资源
- [使用 IAM 角色授予在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行的应用程序权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_switch-role-ec2.html)
- [Amazon EC2 的 IAM 角色](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/iam-roles-for-amazon-ec2.html)
- [使用 IAM 角色对部署到 Amazon EC2 的应用程序进行身份验证](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdkref/latest/guide/access-iam-roles-for-ec2.html)

en.question: A company has an application that receives batches of orders from partners every day. The application uses an AWS Lambda function to process the batches. If a batch contains no orders, the Lambda function must publish to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as soon as possible. Which combination of steps will meet this requirement with the LEAST implementation effort? (Choose two.)

options.A: Update the existing Lambda function's code to send an Amazon CloudWatch custom metric for the number of orders in a batch for each partner.
options.B: Create a new Lambda function as an Amazon Kinesis data stream consumer. Configure the new Lambda function to track orders and to publish to the SNS topic when a batch contains no orders.
options.C: Set up an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that will send a notification to the SNS topic when the value of the custom metric is 0.
options.D: Schedule a new Lambda function to analyze Amazon CloudWatch metrics every 24 hours to identify batches that contain no orders. Configure the Lambda function to publish to the SNS topic.
options.E: Modify the existing Lambda function to log orders to an Amazon Kinesis data stream.

en.explanation:
# Empty Batch Notification with Least Effort

## Scenario
A Lambda function processes daily batches of orders. When a batch contains **zero orders**, the system must publish to an SNS topic **as soon as possible** with **least implementation effort**.

## Correct Answer: A and C

The simplest, native AWS pattern is:
1. **(A)** Have the existing Lambda emit a CloudWatch **custom metric** representing the number of orders in each batch.
2. **(C)** Configure a **CloudWatch alarm** on that metric with a threshold of `0`. When the alarm enters the `ALARM` state, it triggers the SNS topic action.

This works because a metric alarm watches a single CloudWatch metric or the result of a math expression based on CloudWatch metrics, performs one or more actions based on the value of the metric relative to a threshold, and the action can be sending a notification to an Amazon SNS topic. Adding an SNS topic ARN as the alarm action is the canonical, low-code path — no consumer Lambda or stream plumbing required.

### Implementation sketch
```python
# Inside the existing Lambda after counting batch orders:
cloudwatch.put_metric_data(
    Namespace='Orders/Partners',
    MetricData=[{
        'MetricName': 'OrdersInBatch',
        'Dimensions': [{'Name': 'PartnerId', 'Value': partner_id}],
        'Value': len(batch),
        'Unit': 'Count'
    }]
)
```
```bash
aws cloudwatch put-metric-alarm \
  --alarm-name EmptyBatchAlarm \
  --metric-name OrdersInBatch --namespace Orders/Partners \
  --statistic Sum --period 60 --evaluation-periods 1 \
  --threshold 0 --comparison-operator LessThanOrEqualToThreshold \
  --alarm-actions arn:aws:sns:...:empty-batch-topic
```

## Why the other options are wrong

- **B. New Lambda as a Kinesis Data Streams consumer** — Requires provisioning a Kinesis stream, modifying the producer to write to it, and writing/maintaining a second consumer Lambda. This is significantly more implementation effort than emitting a metric and adding an alarm.

- **D. Schedule a Lambda to analyze CloudWatch metrics every 24 hours** — This violates the "**as soon as possible**" requirement. A scheduled, polling Lambda introduces up to a 24-hour delay, whereas a CloudWatch alarm reacts to threshold breaches in near real time. It's also more code to maintain than a native alarm action.

- **E. Modify the Lambda to log orders to a Kinesis data stream** — On its own this does nothing (no notifier). Combined with B it adds unnecessary streaming infrastructure compared to the simple custom-metric + alarm pattern.

## References
- [Using Amazon CloudWatch alarms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/AlarmThatSendsEmail.html)
- [PutMetricData – CloudWatch API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/APIReference/API_PutMetricData.html)
- [Publishing custom metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/publishingMetrics.html)

zh.question: 一家公司有一个应用程序，每天都会接收来自合作伙伴的多批订单。该应用程序使用 AWS Lambda 函数来处理这些订单批次。如果某个批次中没有订单，Lambda 函数必须尽快向 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题发布通知。以下哪两项步骤组合能够以最小的实施工作量满足此要求？

options.A: 更新现有 Lambda 函数的代码，以便为每个合作伙伴发送批次订单数的 Amazon CloudWatch 自定义指标。
options.B: 创建一个新的 Lambda 函数作为 Amazon Kinesis 数据流消费者。配置该 Lambda 函数以跟踪订单，并在批次中不包含任何订单时发布到 SNS 主题。
options.C: 设置 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，当自定义指标的值为 0 时，向 SNS 主题发送通知。
options.D: 安排一个新的 Lambda 函数，每 24 小时分析一次 Amazon CloudWatch 指标，以识别不包含任何订单的批次。配置该 Lambda 函数，使其将结果发布到 SNS 主题。
options.E: 修改现有的 Lambda 函数，将订单记录到 Amazon Kinesis 数据流中。

zh.explanation:
# 空批次通知，最小实现成本

## 场景
Lambda 函数每天处理订单批次。当批次包含**零个订单**时，系统必须**尽快**向 SNS 主题发布消息，**实现成本最低**。

## 正确答案：A 和 C

最简单、最原生的 AWS 模式是：
1. **(A)** 让现有 Lambda 发出 CloudWatch **自定义指标**，表示每个批次中的订单数。
2. **(C)** 在该指标上配置 **CloudWatch 告警**，阈值为 `0`。当告警进入 `ALARM` 状态时，会触发 SNS 主题操作。

这之所以有效，是因为指标告警监视单个 CloudWatch 指标或基于 CloudWatch 指标的数学表达式的结果，根据指标相对于阈值的值执行一个或多个操作，该操作可以是向 Amazon SNS 主题发送通知。将 SNS 主题 ARN 添加为告警操作是规范的、低代码的路径——无需使用者 Lambda 或流管道。

### 实现示意
```python
# 在现有 Lambda 内，计算批次订单数后：
cloudwatch.put_metric_data(
    Namespace='Orders/Partners',
    MetricData=[{
        'MetricName': 'OrdersInBatch',
        'Dimensions': [{'Name': 'PartnerId', 'Value': partner_id}],
        'Value': len(batch),
        'Unit': 'Count'
    }]
)
```
```bash
aws cloudwatch put-metric-alarm \
  --alarm-name EmptyBatchAlarm \
  --metric-name OrdersInBatch --namespace Orders/Partners \
  --statistic Sum --period 60 --evaluation-periods 1 \
  --threshold 0 --comparison-operator LessThanOrEqualToThreshold \
  --alarm-actions arn:aws:sns:...:empty-batch-topic
```

## 为什么其他选项错误

- **B. 新 Lambda 作为 Kinesis Data Streams 使用者** — 需要部署 Kinesis 流、修改生产者写入流，以及编写/维护第二个使用者 Lambda。相比发出指标和添加告警，实现成本显著增加。

- **D. 计划 Lambda 每 24 小时分析一次 CloudWatch 指标** — 这违反了"**尽快**"的要求。定时轮询 Lambda 引入最长 24 小时的延迟，而 CloudWatch 告警可近实时地对阈值突破作出反应。相比简单的原生告警操作，它也需要更多代码维护。

- **E. 修改 Lambda 将订单记录到 Kinesis 数据流** — 单独使用此选项无法执行任何操作（无通知程序）。与 B 结合时，相比简单的自定义指标 + 告警模式，它添加了不必要的流基础设施。

## 参考资源
- [Using Amazon CloudWatch alarms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/AlarmThatSendsEmail.html)
- [PutMetricData – CloudWatch API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/APIReference/API_PutMetricData.html)
- [Publishing custom metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/publishingMetrics.html)

en.question: A developer has an application that uses an Amazon DynamoDB table with a configured local secondary index (LSI). During application testing, the DynamoDB table metrics report a ProvisionedThroughputExceededException error message. The number of requests made by the test suite did not exceed the table's provisioned capacity limits. What is the cause of this issue?

options.A: The data in the table's partition key column is not evenly distributed.
options.B: The LSI's capacity is different from the table's capacity.
options.C: The application is not implementing exponential backoff retry logic while interacting with the DynamoDB API.
options.D: The application has the IAM permission to query the DynamoDB table but not to query the LSI.

en.explanation:
# DynamoDB ProvisionedThroughputExceededException with LSI

## Scenario
A DynamoDB table with a Local Secondary Index (LSI) is reporting `ProvisionedThroughputExceededException` errors during testing, even though the overall request rate is below the table's provisioned capacity. We need to identify the root cause.

## Correct Answer: A — The data in the table's partition key column is not evenly distributed

DynamoDB distributes a table's provisioned throughput evenly across its underlying physical partitions. When the partition key has low cardinality or skewed access patterns, requests concentrate on a few "hot" partitions, exceeding their per-partition throughput limits—even when total table consumption is well below provisioned capacity.

DynamoDB distributes data across partitions based on the partition key. If your access pattern hits the same partition key repeatedly, that single partition gets overwhelmed even if your overall capacity is sufficient.

A hot partition occurs when a partition key that doesn't have a high cardinality results in many requests that target only a few partitions. If you exceed the partition quota of 3000 RCU, 1000 WCU, or a linear combination of both per second, then a hot partition might cause throttling.

This is exactly the symptom described: throttling that occurs even though the table-level provisioned throughput hasn't been exhausted. AWS explicitly documents that "the consumption rate of one or more partitions in your DynamoDB table exceeds the partition's read throughput limit. This throttling occurs regardless of your table's total provisioned capacity".

The classic AWS Canadian-census example demonstrates the exact same scenario: "If you had a nonuniform workload with one partition receiving more than 100 writes per second (a hot partition), those requests might have returned a ProvisionedThroughputExceededException error."

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**B. The LSI's capacity is different from the table's capacity.** — This is technically impossible. Unlike Global Secondary Indexes (GSIs), a Local Secondary Index **shares the provisioned throughput of its base table**. You cannot configure separate capacity for an LSI; reads/writes against an LSI consume the base table's RCUs/WCUs. So an LSI capacity mismatch cannot exist.

**C. The application is not implementing exponential backoff retry logic.** — Exponential backoff is a *mitigation* strategy for handling throttling errors gracefully; it does not cause `ProvisionedThroughputExceededException`. The error is generated by DynamoDB when partition-level throughput is exceeded, regardless of client retry behavior. Lack of backoff would only worsen retries, not produce the original throttling event.

**D. The application has IAM permission to query the DynamoDB table but not to query the LSI.** — An IAM permission failure would produce an `AccessDeniedException` or `UnauthorizedOperation`, not `ProvisionedThroughputExceededException`. Additionally, IAM permissions for LSIs are inherited from the base table resource ARN—you don't grant separate permissions to an LSI.

## Key Takeaway
