```json
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Sid": "RestrictToTLSRequestsOnly",
    "Effect": "Deny",
    "Principal": "*",
    "Action": "s3:*",
    "Resource": [
      "arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket",
      "arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/*"
    ],
    "Condition": { "Bool": { "aws:SecureTransport": "false" } }
  }]
}
```

### C — 使用客户托管的 KMS 密钥在上传前进行客户端加密
在上传前使用**客户托管的 KMS 密钥**加密对象满足静止状态加密要求，使用客户可以按需轮换的密钥。创建客户托管密钥可以为您提供更多的灵活性和控制。例如，您可以创建、轮换和禁用客户托管密钥。您可以选择让 AWS KMS 在可配置的天数范围内自动轮换 KMS 密钥（从 90 天到 2560 天（7 年）），或使用 RotateKeyOnDemand API 调用立即密钥轮换。

注意：S3 加密客户端 / AWS 加密 SDK 使用 KMS CMK 执行客户端加密，加密的密文是上传的内容 — 满足"上传前加密"要求。（使用 CMK 的服务器端加密 SSE-KMS 也会满足静止状态要求，但选项 C 是所提供的唯一静止状态 KMS 选项；选项 B 按原文是不正确的。）

## 其他选项为什么错误

### A — "权限边界"用于强制实施 HTTPS
错误。**权限边界**是一个 IAM 功能，限制 IAM 用户/角色可以拥有的最大权限；它们不用于 S3 存储桶强制实施 HTTPS。正确的机制是带有 `aws:SecureTransport` 的**存储桶策略**。

### B — "存储桶策略以启用客户端加密"
错误。**存储桶策略无法启用客户端加密**。客户端加密由应用程序/SDK 在上传前执行；存储桶策略只能允许/拒绝请求（例如，它可以为 SSE 要求加密标头），但它无法启用客户端加密。

### E — "S3 阻止公有访问设置仅允许 HTTPS"
错误。Amazon S3 公有访问块旨在在整个 AWS 账户或单个 S3 存储桶级别提供控制，以确保对象永远不会拥有公有访问权限。公有访问是通过访问控制列表 (ACL)、存储桶策略或两者向存储桶和对象授予的。"阻止公有访问"与强制实施 HTTPS/TLS 无关。

## 参考资源
- [保护传输中的数据 – Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingEncryptionInTransit.html)
- [Amazon S3 的安全最佳实践](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/security-best-practices.html)
- [使用 SSE-KMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html)
- [AWS KMS 常见问题 – 密钥轮换](https://aws.amazon.com/kms/faqs/)

en.question: A company has a monolithic desktop-based application that processes images. A developer is converting the application into an AWS Lambda function by using Python. Currently, the desktop application runs every 5 minutes to process the latest image from an Amazon S3 bucket. The desktop application completes the image processing task within 1 minute. During testing on AWS, the developer notices that the Lambda function runs at the specified 5-minute interval. However, the Lambda function takes more than 2 minutes to complete the image processing task. The developer needs a solution that will improve the Lambda function's performance. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Update the instance type of the Lambda function to a compute optimized instance with at least eight virtual CPU (vCPU).
options.B: Update the configuration of the Lambda function to use the latest Python runtime.
options.C: Increase the memory that is allocated to the Lambda function.
options.D: Configure a reserved concurrency on the Lambda function.

en.explanation:
# Lambda Performance Optimization for Image Processing

## Scenario
A developer migrated a desktop image-processing application to AWS Lambda (Python). The original desktop app finished in ~1 minute, but the Lambda version takes more than 2 minutes. The 5-minute schedule isn't the issue — execution duration is. The question asks how to improve Lambda performance.

## Correct Answer: C — Increase the memory allocated to the Lambda function

In Lambda, CPU is not configured directly. Lambda allocates CPU power in proportion to the amount of memory configured. You can configure memory between 128 MB and 10,240 MB in 1-MB increments. At 1,769 MB, a function has the equivalent of one vCPU.

Image processing is typically CPU- and memory-intensive. If a function is CPU, network or memory-bound, then increasing the memory setting can dramatically improve its performance. AWS's own performance optimization guidance confirms this: when memory is increased to 1024 MB, the duration average drops to 1.465 seconds... For a one-thousandth of a cent cost difference, the function has a 10-fold improvement in performance.

Therefore, raising the memory setting raises the proportional vCPU allocation, which directly reduces image-processing time.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**A. Update the instance type to a compute-optimized instance with at least 8 vCPUs.**
Lambda is serverless — there are no instance types to choose. You don't pick EC2-style instance families for Lambda. The only way to get more CPU is by raising the memory setting (and Lambda's maximum is roughly 6 vCPUs at 10,240 MB, not arbitrary 8 vCPUs). This option misrepresents Lambda's resource model.

**B. Update the configuration to use the latest Python runtime.**
While newer runtimes can offer minor performance improvements, switching Python versions will not change a 2-minute execution into a 1-minute execution for a CPU-bound image task. The bottleneck is compute capacity, not language runtime version. Also, simply moving to "the latest" runtime can break compatibility without addressing root cause.

**D. Configure reserved concurrency on the Lambda function.**
Reserved concurrency controls how many concurrent executions a function is guaranteed/limited to. It has no effect on the duration of a single invocation. Since the problem is per-invocation execution time (not throttling or scaling), reserved concurrency is irrelevant.

## Key AWS Documentation
- [Configure Lambda function memory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-memory.html)
- [Operating Lambda: Performance optimization – Part 2 (AWS Compute Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/operating-lambda-performance-optimization-part-2/)

## Tip
Consider using the open-source [AWS Lambda Power Tuning](https://github.com/alexcasalboni/aws-lambda-power-tuning) tool to find the optimal memory/cost ratio for the image-processing workload.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个基于桌面的单体图像处理应用程序。一位开发人员正在使用 Python 将该应用程序转换为 AWS Lambda 函数。目前，桌面应用程序每 5 分钟运行一次，处理 Amazon S3 存储桶中的最新图像。桌面应用程序可以在 1 分钟内完成图像处理任务。在 AWS 上进行测试时，开发人员注意到 Lambda 函数虽然以指定的 5 分钟间隔运行，但完成图像处理任务却需要 2 分钟以上。开发人员需要一个能够提高 Lambda 函数性能的解决方案。哪个解决方案能够满足此要求？

options.A: 将 Lambda 函数的实例类型更新为至少具有 8 个虚拟 CPU (vCPU) 的计算优化实例。
options.B: 更新 Lambda 函数的配置，使其使用最新的 Python 运行时。
options.C: 增加分配给 Lambda 函数的内存。
options.D: 在 Lambda 函数上配置保留并发数。

zh.explanation:
# Lambda 性能优化用于图像处理

## 场景
开发人员将桌面图像处理应用迁移到 AWS Lambda (Python)。原始桌面应用在约 1 分钟内完成，但 Lambda 版本需要超过 2 分钟。5 分钟的计划时间表不是问题——执行时间是。问题要求如何改进 Lambda 性能。

## 正确答案：C — 增加分配给 Lambda 函数的内存

在 Lambda 中，CPU 不能直接配置。Lambda 分配的 CPU 性能与配置的内存量成比例。 你可以配置 128 MB 到 10,240 MB 之间的内存，以 1 MB 为增量。在 1,769 MB 时，函数拥有相当于一个 vCPU 的性能。

图像处理通常是 CPU 密集型和内存密集型的。如果函数受 CPU、网络或内存限制，那么增加内存设置可以显著改善其性能。 AWS 自己的性能优化指南证实了这一点：当内存增加到 1024 MB 时，平均执行时间下降到 1.465 秒...对于万分之一美分的成本差异，函数的性能提高了 10 倍。

因此，提高内存设置会提高相应的 vCPU 分配，这直接降低了图像处理时间。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**A. 将实例类型更新为至少 8 个 vCPU 的计算优化实例。**
Lambda 是无服务器的——没有可选择的实例类型。你不能为 Lambda 选择 EC2 风格的实例系列。获得更多 CPU 的唯一方法是提高内存设置（Lambda 的最大值在 10,240 MB 时大约为 6 个 vCPU，不是任意的 8 个 vCPU）。此选项错误表示了 Lambda 的资源模型。

**B. 更新配置以使用最新的 Python 运行时。**
虽然较新的运行时可以提供小幅的性能改进，但切换 Python 版本不会将 CPU 密集型图像任务的 2 分钟执行时间改为 1 分钟。瓶颈是计算能力，而不是语言运行时版本。此外，简单地移至"最新"运行时可能会破坏兼容性，而不解决根本原因。

**D. 在 Lambda 函数上配置预留并发。**
预留并发控制函数有多少并发执行得到保证/限制。它对单个调用的执行时间没有影响。由于问题是每个调用的执行时间（而不是限流或扩展），预留并发是不相关的。

## AWS 关键文档
- [配置 Lambda 函数内存](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-memory.html)
- [Operating Lambda: Performance optimization – Part 2 (AWS Compute Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/operating-lambda-performance-optimization-part-2/)

## 提示
考虑使用开源的 [AWS Lambda Power Tuning](https://github.com/alexcasalboni/aws-lambda-power-tuning) 工具来找到图像处理工作负载的最优内存/成本比率。

en.question: A company uses AWS CloudFormation templates to manage infrastructure for a public-facing application in its development, pre-production, and production environments. The company needs to scale for increasing customer demand. A developer must upgrade the Amazon RDS DB instance type to a larger instance. The developer deploys an update to the CloudFormation stack with the instance size change in the pre- production environment. The developer notices that the stack is in an UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED slate in CloudFormation. Which option is the cause of this issue?

options.A: The new instance type specified in the CloudFormation template is invalid
options.B: The database was deleted or modified manually outside of the CloudFormation stack
options.C: There is a syntax error in the CloudFormation template
options.D: The developer has insufficient IAM permissions to provision an instance of the specified type

en.explanation:
# CloudFormation UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED — Cause Analysis

## Scenario
A developer updates a CloudFormation stack to change the RDS DB instance type in pre-production. The update fails and CloudFormation tries to roll back to the previous state, but the rollback itself fails — leaving the stack in `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED`. The question asks what causes a *rollback* (not the update itself) to fail.

## Correct Answer: B — The database was deleted or modified manually outside of the CloudFormation stack

When CloudFormation rolls back, it tries to restore the previous resource state recorded in its own model of the stack. If the actual resource has drifted from that model — because someone deleted or modified it outside CloudFormation — the rollback cannot reconcile reality with the expected state.

The official AWS troubleshooting guide gives this exact example: a dependent resource can't return to its original state, causing the rollback to fail (UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED state). For example, you might have a stack that's rolling back to an old database instance that was deleted outside of CloudFormation. Because CloudFormation doesn't know the database was deleted, it assumes that the database instance still exists and attempts to roll back to it, causing the update rollback to fail.

This precisely matches the scenario in the question (an RDS database update failing to roll back).

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**A. Invalid instance type in the template** — An invalid DB instance class would cause the *update* to fail, but CloudFormation would then successfully roll back to the prior, valid configuration, ending in `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_COMPLETE`, not `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED`. The rollback target (the previously valid instance) still exists, so rollback succeeds.

**C. Syntax error in the template** — A template with syntax errors fails validation *before* the stack update begins. CloudFormation rejects the change set; the stack never enters `UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS`, so it cannot reach `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED`.

**D. Insufficient IAM permissions** — Missing IAM permissions would cause the update operation to fail at resource creation/modification, but CloudFormation would still roll back to the previously deployed (and existing) resource state. This produces `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_COMPLETE`. IAM permission errors during rollback are also typically resolvable by retrying with refreshed credentials, per AWS guidance — they don't leave the stack stuck unless the underlying resource is also gone.

## Key Takeaway
`UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED` is almost always caused by **drift** — the live resource no longer matches what CloudFormation expects to roll back to. Avoid making manual changes to resources managed by CloudFormation. If someone modifies a resource outside the stack, the next update or rollback might fail because the actual state doesn't match what CloudFormation expects.

Recovery uses the [`continue-update-rollback`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-updating-stacks-continueupdaterollback.html) API, optionally with `--resources-to-skip` for the drifted resource.

## References
- [Continue rolling back an update — AWS CloudFormation User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-updating-stacks-continueupdaterollback.html)
- [Troubleshooting CloudFormation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/troubleshooting.html)

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板来管理其面向公众的应用程序的基础设施，该应用程序分布在其开发、预生产和生产环境中。该公司需要扩展以满足不断增长的客户需求。一位开发人员必须将 Amazon RDS 数据库实例类型升级到更大的实例。该开发人员在预生产环境中部署了包含实例大小更改的 CloudFormation 堆栈更新。开发人员注意到 CloudFormation 中的堆栈处于 UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED 状态。哪个选项是导致此问题的原因？

options.A: CloudFormation 模板中指定的新实例类型无效
options.B: 数据库在 CloudFormation 堆栈之外被手动删除或修改。
options.C: CloudFormation 模板中存在语法错误
options.D: 开发人员没有足够的 IAM 权限来配置指定类型的实例

zh.explanation:
# CloudFormation UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED — 原因分析

## 场景
开发人员更新 CloudFormation 堆栈以更改预生产环境中的 RDS 数据库实例类型。更新失败，CloudFormation 尝试回滚到先前的状态，但回滚本身失败 — 堆栈处于 `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED` 状态。问题询问什么原因导致*回滚*（而非更新本身）失败。

## 正确答案：B — 数据库在 CloudFormation 堆栈外被手动删除或修改

当 CloudFormation 执行回滚时，它尝试将资源恢复到堆栈模型中记录的先前状态。如果实际资源与该模型出现了偏差 — 因为有人在 CloudFormation 外删除或修改了它 — 回滚无法协调现实与预期状态。

AWS 官方故障排除指南给出了这个确切的示例：依赖资源无法返回到其原始状态，导致回滚失败（UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED 状态）。例如，您可能有一个堆栈正在回滚到一个在 CloudFormation 外被删除的旧数据库实例。因为 CloudFormation 不知道数据库被删除了，它假设数据库实例仍然存在并尝试回滚到它，导致更新回滚失败。

这正好与问题中的场景相符（RDS 数据库更新无法回滚）。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**A. 模板中的无效实例类型** — 无效的数据库实例类会导致*更新*失败，但 CloudFormation 随后会成功回滚到之前的有效配置，以 `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_COMPLETE` 结束，而非 `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED`。回滚目标（之前的有效实例）仍然存在，所以回滚成功。

**C. 模板中的语法错误** — 包含语法错误的模板在堆栈更新开始*之前*就会验证失败。CloudFormation 拒绝变更集；堆栈永远不会进入 `UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS`，因此无法到达 `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED`。

**D. IAM 权限不足** — 缺少 IAM 权限会导致资源创建/修改的更新操作失败，但 CloudFormation 仍会回滚到先前已部署的（且存在的）资源状态。这会产生 `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_COMPLETE`。根据 AWS 指导，回滚期间的 IAM 权限错误通常也可以通过使用刷新的凭证重试来解决 — 除非底层资源也已消失，否则不会使堆栈卡住。

## 关键要点
`UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED` 几乎总是由**偏差**引起 — 实时资源不再与 CloudFormation 期望回滚到的状态相符。避免手动更改由 CloudFormation 管理的资源。如果有人在堆栈外修改了资源，下次更新或回滚可能会失败，因为实际状态与 CloudFormation 的预期不匹配。

恢复使用 [`continue-update-rollback`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-updating-stacks-continueupdaterollback.html) API，可选择使用 `--resources-to-skip` 跳过偏差的资源。

## 参考资源
- [继续回滚更新 — AWS CloudFormation 用户指南](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-updating-stacks-continueupdaterollback.html)
- [CloudFormation 故障排除](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/troubleshooting.html)

en.question: A developer needs to store files in an Amazon S3 bucket for a company's application. Each S3 object can have multiple versions. The objects must be permanently removed 1 year after object creation. The developer creates an S3 bucket that has versioning enabled. What should the developer do next to meet the data retention requirements?

options.A: Create an S3 Lifecycle rule on the S3 bucket. Configure the rule to expire current versions of objects and permanently delete noncurrent versions 1 year after object creation.
options.B: Create an event notification for all object creation events in the S3 bucket. Configure the event notification to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to check the object creation date and to delete the object if the object is older than 1 year.
options.C: Create an event notification for all object removal events in the S3 bucket. Configure the event notification to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to check the object creation date and to delete the object if the object is older than 1 year.
options.D: Create an S3 Lifecycle rule on the S3 bucket. Configure the rule to delete expired object delete markers and permanently delete noncurrent versions 1 year after object creation.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer needs to store versioned objects in an S3 bucket and **permanently remove** all object versions 1 year after creation. Versioning is already enabled. The developer must choose the most efficient, native mechanism to enforce this 1-year retention.

## Correct Answer: A

Create an S3 Lifecycle rule that expires current versions and permanently deletes noncurrent versions 1 year after object creation.

In a versioning-enabled bucket, lifecycle actions behave differently than in a non-versioned bucket:

- The Expiration action applies to the current object version. Instead of deleting the current object version, Amazon S3 retains the current version as a noncurrent version by adding a delete marker, which then becomes the current version.
- The NoncurrentVersionExpiration action applies to noncurrent object versions, and Amazon S3 permanently removes these object versions. You cannot recover permanently removed objects.

So to **permanently** remove all data after 1 year in a versioned bucket you need both actions together. AWS explicitly documents this pattern: to permanently delete all versioned objects and delete markers, create lifecycle rules: one to expire current versions and permanently delete noncurrent versions of objects, and another to delete expired object delete markers. Option A captures the essential pair (Expiration + NoncurrentVersionExpiration) needed to satisfy the 1-year permanent-removal requirement. S3 Lifecycle is a native, server-side, no-cost mechanism — you are not charged for expiration or the storage time associated with an object that has expired.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**B. Lambda triggered on object creation events** — S3 event notifications fire only at the moment of object creation; they cannot "fire 1 year later." The developer would have to build additional scheduling (e.g., EventBridge Scheduler, Step Functions wait state, or DynamoDB TTL queue) on top of Lambda. This adds operational complexity, cost, and failure modes when S3 Lifecycle already does this natively. It also wouldn't permanently delete versioned objects unless the Lambda explicitly deletes by `versionId` — when versioning is enabled, a simple DELETE cannot permanently delete an object. Instead, Amazon S3 inserts a delete marker in the bucket, and that marker becomes the current version of the object with a new ID.

**C. Lambda triggered on object removal events** — Object removal events fire *after* an object is deleted. Triggering deletion logic on a removal event is circular and would never run for objects that simply age out without being deleted. This option does not implement a 1-year retention policy at all.

**D. Lifecycle rule for "delete expired object delete markers" + permanently delete noncurrent versions** — This is missing the critical Expiration action on current versions. In a versioning-enabled bucket, a delete marker with zero noncurrent versions is referred to as an expired object delete marker. You can use this lifecycle action to direct Amazon S3 to remove expired object delete markers. Without an Expiration rule on current versions, current versions of objects are never moved to noncurrent state and will never be deleted. The expired-delete-marker cleanup is a housekeeping action, not a retention mechanism.

## References

- [Expiring objects (Amazon S3 User Guide)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-expire-general-considerations.html)
- [Deleting object versions from a versioning-enabled bucket](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/DeletingObjectVersions.html)
- [Lifecycle configuration elements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intro-lifecycle-rules.html)
- [Troubleshooting versioning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/troubleshooting-versioning.html)

zh.question: 开发人员需要将文件存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中，用于公司的应用程序。每个 S3 对象可以有多个版本。这些对象必须在创建一年后永久删除。开发人员创建了一个启用了版本控制的 S3 存储桶。为了满足数据保留要求，开发人员接下来应该做什么？

options.A: 在 S3 存储桶上创建 S3 生命周期规则。配置该规则，使对象的当前版本在对象创建 1 年后过期，并永久删除非当前版本。
options.B: 为 S3 存储桶中的所有对象创建事件创建事件通知。配置该事件通知以调用 AWS Lambda 函数。编写 Lambda 函数，使其检查对象创建日期，如果对象创建时间超过 1 年，则将其删除。
options.C: 为 S3 存储桶中的所有对象删除事件创建事件通知。配置事件通知以调用 AWS Lambda 函数。编写 Lambda 函数，使其检查对象创建日期，如果对象创建时间超过 1 年，则将其删除。
options.D: 在 S3 存储桶上创建 S3 生命周期规则。配置该规则，以删除过期的对象删除标记，并在对象创建 1 年后永久删除非当前版本。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

开发人员需要在 S3 存储桶中存储版本化对象，并在创建后 1 年**永久删除**所有对象版本。版本控制已启用。开发人员必须选择最有效的本机机制来强制执行这一 1 年的保留期。

## 正确答案：A

创建一个 S3 生命周期规则，在对象创建后 1 年内使当前版本过期，并永久删除非当前版本。

在启用版本控制的存储桶中，生命周期操作的行为与非版本化存储桶不同：

- 过期操作应用于当前对象版本。Amazon S3 不是删除当前对象版本，而是通过添加删除标记将当前版本保留为非当前版本，该标记随后成为当前版本。
- 非当前版本过期操作应用于非当前对象版本，Amazon S3 永久删除这些对象版本。您无法恢复永久删除的对象。

因此，要在版本化存储桶中在 1 年后**永久**删除所有数据，您需要同时使用这两个操作。AWS 明确记录了这种模式：要永久删除所有版本化对象和删除标记，请创建生命周期规则：一条规则用于使当前版本过期并永久删除对象的非当前版本，另一条规则用于删除已过期的对象删除标记。选项 A 捕获了满足 1 年永久删除要求所需的基本对（过期 + 非当前版本过期）。S3 生命周期是一种本机、服务器端、无成本的机制 — 对于已过期的对象或与已过期对象相关联的存储时间，您无需支付费用。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**B. 在对象创建事件上触发的 Lambda** — S3 事件通知仅在对象创建时触发；它们无法"在 1 年后触发"。开发人员必须在 Lambda 之上构建额外的调度机制（例如 EventBridge Scheduler、Step Functions 等待状态或 DynamoDB TTL 队列）。这会增加操作复杂性、成本和故障模式，而 S3 生命周期已经本机完成此操作。它也不会永久删除版本化对象，除非 Lambda 显式地通过 `versionId` 删除 — 启用版本控制后，简单的 DELETE 无法永久删除对象。而是 Amazon S3 在存储桶中插入删除标记，该标记成为对象的当前版本并获得新 ID。

**C. 在对象删除事件上触发的 Lambda** — 对象删除事件在对象被删除*后*触发。在删除事件上触发删除逻辑是循环的，永远不会为简单地老化而不被删除的对象运行。此选项根本不实现 1 年保留期策略。

**D. "删除已过期对象删除标记"的生命周期规则 + 永久删除非当前版本** — 这缺少对当前版本的关键过期操作。在启用版本控制的存储桶中，具有零个非当前版本的删除标记被称为已过期对象删除标记。您可以使用此生命周期操作来指示 Amazon S3 删除已过期对象删除标记。没有对当前版本的过期规则，当前版本的对象永远不会转移到非当前状态，也不会被删除。已过期删除标记清理是一种维护操作，不是保留机制。

## 参考资源

- [Expiring objects (Amazon S3 用户指南)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-expire-general-considerations.html)
- [从启用版本控制的存储桶中删除对象版本](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/DeletingObjectVersions.html)
- [生命周期配置元素](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intro-lifecycle-rules.html)
- [故障排除版本控制](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/troubleshooting-versioning.html)

en.question: A company uses AWS X-Ray to monitor a serverless application. The components of the application have different request rates. The user interactions and transactions are important to trace, but they are low in volume. The background processes such as application health checks, polling, and connection maintenance generate high volumes of read-only requests. Currently, the default X-Ray sampling rules are universal for all requests. Only the first request per second and some additional requests are recorded. This setup is not helping the company review the requests based on service or request type. A developer must configure rules to trace requests based on service or request properties. The developer must trace the user interactions and transactions without wasting effort recording minor background tasks. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Disable sampling for high-volume read-only requests. Sample at a lower rate for all requests that handle user interactions or transactions.
options.B: Disable sampling and trace all requests for requests that handle user interactions or transactions. Sample high-volume read-only requests at a higher rate.
options.C: Disable sampling and trace all requests for requests that handle user interactions or transactions. Sample high-volume read-only requests at a lower rate.
options.D: Disable sampling for high-volume read-only requests. Sample at a higher rate for all requests that handle user interactions or transactions.

en.explanation:
# X-Ray Sampling Rules for Mixed Workload

## Scenario
A serverless application has two distinct request profiles:
- **User interactions/transactions** – low volume but high business value (need full trace coverage)
- **Background tasks** (health checks, polling, connection maintenance) – very high volume, low value (noise)

The default X-Ray sampling rule (1 request/second + 5% of additional requests) is applied universally, so important user requests get under-sampled while noisy background traffic still consumes a disproportionate share of recorded traces. The developer needs **custom sampling rules that match on service or request properties** (e.g., `URLPath`, `HTTPMethod`, `ServiceName`).

## Why C is Correct

[X-Ray sampling rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-console-sampling.html) let you control how many requests are recorded by matching on properties such as `ServiceName`, `ServiceType`, `Host`, `HTTPMethod`, and `URLPath`. By customizing sampling rules, you can control the amount of data recorded, and modify behavior without redeploying code.

The right strategy is:
1. **Create a high-priority rule for user interactions/transactions with `FixedRate: 1.0` (100%) and a sufficient reservoir** – this effectively "disables sampling" for that traffic by tracing every request. Because the volume is low, full tracing is affordable.
2. **Create a rule for the high-volume read-only background paths (health checks, polling, etc.) with a very low `FixedRate`** (e.g., 0.003 / 0.3% as in the AWS "polling-scorekeep" example in the [X-Ray API configuration docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-api-configuration.html)) and a `ReservoirSize` of 0. This drastically reduces the noise from background tasks.

This is exactly what **Option C** describes: "Disable sampling and trace all requests for user interactions/transactions. Sample high-volume read-only requests at a lower rate."

Example sampling rule for the noisy background traffic (from AWS docs):

```json
{
  "RuleName": "polling-healthchecks",
  "ResourceARN": "*",
  "Priority": 5000,
  "FixedRate": 0.003,
  "ReservoirSize": 0,
  "ServiceName": "MyService",
  "ServiceType": "*",
  "Host": "*",
  "HTTPMethod": "GET",
  "URLPath": "/health*",
  "Version": 1
}
```

And for critical user transactions:

```json
{
  "RuleName": "user-transactions",
  "Priority": 100,
  "FixedRate": 1.0,
  "ReservoirSize": 10,
  "ServiceName": "*",
  "URLPath": "/api/transactions/*",
  "HTTPMethod": "*",
  "Host": "*",
  "ResourceARN": "*",
  "Version": 1
}
```

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Disable sampling for high-volume read-only requests; sample at a lower rate for user interactions/transactions.** – This is backwards. "Disable sampling" means *trace everything*, so you'd be recording every health check / polling request (huge cost and noise) while *under*-recording the important user traffic. It directly contradicts the stated goal of "trace user interactions without wasting effort on minor background tasks."

- **B. Disable sampling for user interactions; sample high-volume read-only requests at a higher rate.** – The first half is correct, but raising the rate on background tasks increases noise and cost. The requirement is to *avoid* wasting effort on background traffic, so the rate must be lower, not higher.

- **D. Disable sampling for high-volume read-only requests; sample user interactions at a higher rate.** – Same fundamental error as A: "disable sampling" on background tasks means *every* health check and poll will be traced, exactly what the company wants to avoid. Even though user transactions get a higher rate, the primary requirement (eliminate noise from background tasks) is violated. The wording "disable sampling" in X-Ray context (e.g., setting FixedRate=1.0) means full capture, which is overwhelming for high-volume read-only traffic.

## Key Takeaway
"Disable sampling" in X-Ray phrasing on these exam questions means **record 100% of matching requests**. You only want to do that for low-volume, high-value traffic (user transactions), and apply a *low* sampling rate to high-volume noise (health checks/polling).

## References
- [Configuring sampling rules – AWS X-Ray Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-console-sampling.html)
- [Configuring sampling, groups, and encryption settings with the AWS X-Ray API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-api-configuration.html)
- [SamplingRule API reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/api/API_SamplingRule.html)
- [Dynamically adjusting X-Ray sampling rules – AWS Cloud Operations Blog](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/mt/dynamically-adjusting-x-ray-sampling-rules/)

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS X-Ray 监控一个无服务器应用程序。该应用程序的各个组件请求速率各不相同。用户交互和事务虽然重要，但数量较少，因此需要进行跟踪。而应用程序健康检查、轮询和连接维护等后台进程会产生大量的只读请求。目前，X-Ray 的默认采样规则对所有请求都是通用的，仅记录每秒第一个请求以及一些额外的请求。这种设置无法帮助公司根据服务或请求类型来审查请求。开发人员必须配置规则，以便根据服务或请求属性来跟踪请求。开发人员必须跟踪用户交互和事务，同时避免浪费精力记录次要的后台任务。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 禁用高流量只读请求的采样。降低所有处理用户交互或事务的请求的采样率。
options.B: 禁用采样，并跟踪所有处理用户交互或事务的请求。提高对高容量只读请求的采样频率。
options.C: 禁用采样，并跟踪所有处理用户交互或事务的请求。降低对高容量只读请求的采样频率。
options.D: 禁用高流量只读请求的采样。对所有处理用户交互或事务的请求，提高采样率。

zh.explanation:
# X-Ray 混合工作负载采样规则

## 场景
一个无服务器应用程序有两种不同的请求配置文件：
- **用户交互/事务** – 低量但高商业价值（需要完整的跟踪覆盖）
- **后台任务**（健康检查、轮询、连接维护）– 非常高的量，低价值（噪音）

默认 X-Ray 采样规则（每秒 1 个请求 + 额外请求的 5%）普遍适用，因此重要的用户请求被欠采样，而嘈杂的后台流量仍然消耗了记录跟踪的不成比例的份额。开发人员需要**与服务或请求属性匹配的自定义采样规则**（例如 `URLPath`、`HTTPMethod`、`ServiceName`）。

## 为什么 C 是正确的

[X-Ray 采样规则](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-console-sampling.html)让你通过匹配 `ServiceName`、`ServiceType`、`Host`、`HTTPMethod` 和 `URLPath` 等属性来控制记录多少请求。通过自定义采样规则，你可以控制记录的数据量，并在无需重新部署代码的情况下修改行为。

正确的策略是：
1. **为用户交互/事务创建高优先级规则，`FixedRate: 1.0`（100%）和足够的预留库** – 这通过跟踪每个请求来有效地"禁用采样"该流量。由于量很低，完整跟踪是可以承受的。
2. **为高量读取专用后台路径（健康检查、轮询等）创建规则，使用非常低的 `FixedRate`**（例如 0.003 / 0.3%，如 [X-Ray API 配置文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-api-configuration.html)中 AWS"polling-scorekeep"示例）和 `ReservoirSize` 为 0。这大幅减少了后台任务的噪音。

这正是**选项 C** 描述的：「禁用采样并跟踪用户交互/事务的所有请求。以较低的速率采样高量读取专用请求。」

后台流量采样规则示例（来自 AWS 文档）：

```json
{
  "RuleName": "polling-healthchecks",
  "ResourceARN": "*",
  "Priority": 5000,
  "FixedRate": 0.003,
  "ReservoirSize": 0,
  "ServiceName": "MyService",
  "ServiceType": "*",
  "Host": "*",
  "HTTPMethod": "GET",
  "URLPath": "/health*",
  "Version": 1
}
```

以及用于关键用户事务的规则：

```json
{
  "RuleName": "user-transactions",
  "Priority": 100,
  "FixedRate": 1.0,
  "ReservoirSize": 10,
  "ServiceName": "*",
  "URLPath": "/api/transactions/*",
  "HTTPMethod": "*",
  "Host": "*",
  "ResourceARN": "*",
  "Version": 1
}
```

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. 禁用高量读取专用请求的采样；以较低的速率采样用户交互/事务。** – 这是颠倒的。「禁用采样」意味着*跟踪一切*，所以你会记录每个健康检查/轮询请求（巨大的成本和噪音），同时*欠*记录重要的用户流量。它直接违反了「在不浪费精力于次要后台任务的情况下跟踪用户交互」的既定目标。

- **B. 禁用用户交互的采样；以更高的速率采样高量读取专用请求。** – 前半部分是正确的，但提高后台任务的速率增加了噪音和成本。要求是*避免*浪费精力于后台流量，所以速率必须更低，而不是更高。

- **D. 禁用高量读取专用请求的采样；以更高的速率采样用户交互。** – 与 A 相同的根本错误：「禁用」后台任务的采样意味着*每个*健康检查和轮询都会被跟踪，这正是公司想要避免的。尽管用户事务获得更高的速率，但主要要求（消除后台任务的噪音）被违反了。选项 D 中的措辞「禁用采样」在 X-Ray 上下文中（例如设置 FixedRate=1.0）意味着完整捕获，这对于高量读取专用流量是压倒性的。

## 关键要点
X-Ray 短语中的「禁用采样」在这些考试问题中意味着**记录 100% 的匹配请求**。你只想对低量、高价值的流量（用户事务）这样做，并对高量噪音（健康检查/轮询）应用*低*采样率。

## 参考资源
- [配置采样规则 – AWS X-Ray 开发者指南](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-console-sampling.html)
- [使用 AWS X-Ray API 配置采样、组和加密设置](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-api-configuration.html)
- [SamplingRule API 参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/api/API_SamplingRule.html)
- [动态调整 X-Ray 采样规则 – AWS Cloud Operations 博客](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/mt/dynamically-adjusting-x-ray-sampling-rules/)

en.question: A developer uses an AWS Lambda function in an application to edit users' uploaded photos. The developer needs to update the Lambda function code and needs to test the updates. For testing, the developer must divide the user traffic between the original version of the Lambda function and the new version of the Lambda function. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Publish a version of the original Lambda function. Make the necessary changes to the Lambda code. Publish a new version of the Lambda function.
options.B: Use AWS CodeBuild to detect updates to the Lambda function. Configure CodeBuild to incrementally shift traffic from the original version of the Lambda function to the new version of the Lambda function.
options.C: Update the original version of the Lambda function to add a function URL. Make the necessary changes to the Lambda code. Publish another function URL for the updated Lambda code.
options.D: Create an alias that points to the original version of the Lambda function. Configure the alias to be a weighted alias that also includes the new version of the Lambda function. Divide traffic between the two versions.
options.E: Create an alias that points to the original function URL. Configure the alias to be a weighted alias that also includes the additional function URL. Divide traffic between the two function URLs.

en.explanation:
# Lambda Traffic Shifting Between Versions

## Scenario
A developer needs to deploy an updated Lambda function and split user traffic between the **original** and **new** versions for testing (canary/A-B style testing).

## Correct Answer: A and D

To split traffic between two Lambda versions, you must:

1. **Publish immutable versions** of the Lambda code (one for the original, one for the new code).
2. **Create a Lambda alias with a weighted routing configuration** that points to both versions.

### Why A is correct
You cannot split traffic against `$LATEST` — weighted aliases require **published versions**. The developer must publish a version of the original function, make the changes, then publish a new version. A Lambda alias is a pointer to a function version that you can update. The function's users can access the function version using the alias Amazon Resource Name (ARN). When you deploy a new version, you can update the alias to use the new version, or split traffic between two versions.

### Why D is correct
A Lambda alias supports a `RoutingConfig` with `AdditionalVersionWeights` that splits invocation traffic between the alias's primary version and one additional version. With the introduction of alias traffic shifting, it is now possible to trivially implement canary deployments of Lambda functions. By updating additional version weights on an alias, invocation traffic is routed to the new function versions based on the weight specified.

Example CLI:
```bash
aws lambda update-alias \
  --function-name myFunction \
  --name myAlias \
  --function-version 1 \
  --routing-config 'AdditionalVersionWeights={"2"=0.1}'
```
This sends 90% of traffic to version 1 and 10% to version 2. You can use a weighted alias to split traffic between two different versions of the same function. You can point an alias to a maximum of two Lambda function versions.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **B. CodeBuild for traffic shifting** — CodeBuild is a build service that compiles source and runs tests. It does **not** detect Lambda updates or shift traffic. Gradual traffic shifting for Lambda is performed by **AWS CodeDeploy** (often via SAM), not CodeBuild. AWS CodeDeploy leverages Lambda's traffic shifting capabilities to automate the gradual rollout of new function versions.

- **C. Multiple Function URLs on the same function** — A Lambda function URL is a single dedicated HTTPS endpoint. You can configure a function URL on a specific version/alias, but you cannot "publish another function URL for the updated code" and have Lambda automatically split user traffic between two URLs. Function URLs do not provide weighted routing between versions.

- **E. Weighted alias of function URLs** — Lambda aliases route between **function versions**, not between function URLs. There is no native AWS feature that creates a "weighted alias" over two function URLs. Aliases reference function versions only.

## References
- [Create an alias for a Lambda function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-traffic-shifting-using-aliases.html)
- [Implement Lambda canary deployments using a weighted alias](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html)
- [Implementing Canary Deployments of AWS Lambda Functions with Alias Traffic Shifting (AWS Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/implementing-canary-deployments-of-aws-lambda-functions-with-alias-traffic-shifting/)

zh.question: 一位开发人员在应用程序中使用 AWS Lambda 函数来编辑用户上传的照片。该开发人员需要更新 Lambda 函数的代码并测试更新后的代码。为了进行测试，开发人员必须将用户流量分配到 Lambda 函数的原始版本和新版本上。以下哪两项步骤组合可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 发布原始 Lambda 函数的一个版本。对 Lambda 代码进行必要的修改。发布新版本的 Lambda 函数。
options.B: 使用 AWS CodeBuild 检测 Lambda 函数的更新。配置 CodeBuild 将流量从 Lambda 函数的原始版本逐步转移到 Lambda 函数的新版本。
options.C: 更新 Lambda 函数的原始版本，添加函数 URL。对 Lambda 代码进行必要的更改。发布更新后的 Lambda 代码的另一个函数 URL。
options.D: 创建一个指向 Lambda 函数原始版本的别名。将该别名配置为加权别名，使其也包含 Lambda 函数的新版本。在两个版本之间分配流量。
options.E: 创建一个指向原始函数 URL 的别名。将该别名配置为加权别名，使其同时包含附加函数 URL。在两个函数 URL 之间分配流量。

zh.explanation:
# Lambda 版本间的流量转移

## 场景
一名开发者需要部署更新的 Lambda 函数，并在**原始**版本和**新**版本之间分割用户流量以进行测试（金丝雀/A-B 风格测试）。

## 正确答案：A 和 D

要在两个 Lambda 版本之间分割流量，你必须：

1. **发布 Lambda 代码的不可变版本**（一个用于原始代码，一个用于新代码）。
2. **创建带有加权路由配置的 Lambda 别名**，指向两个版本。

### 为什么 A 正确
你不能针对 `$LATEST` 分割流量 — 加权别名需要**已发布的版本**。开发者必须发布原始函数的版本，进行更改，然后发布新版本。Lambda 别名是指向函数版本的指针，你可以更新它。函数的用户可以使用别名 Amazon Resource Name (ARN) 访问函数版本。在部署新版本时，你可以更新别名以使用新版本，或在两个版本之间分割流量。

### 为什么 D 正确
Lambda 别名支持带有 `AdditionalVersionWeights` 的 `RoutingConfig`，它可以在别名的主版本和一个额外版本之间分割调用流量。通过引入别名流量转移，现在可以轻松实现 Lambda 函数的金丝雀部署。通过更新别名上的其他版本权重，调用流量根据指定的权重路由到新函数版本。

示例 CLI：
```bash
aws lambda update-alias \
  --function-name myFunction \
  --name myAlias \
  --function-version 1 \
  --routing-config 'AdditionalVersionWeights={"2"=0.1}'
```
这会将 90% 的流量发送到版本 1，10% 发送到版本 2。你可以使用加权别名在同一函数的两个不同版本之间分割流量。你可以将一个别名指向最多两个 Lambda 函数版本。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **B. 使用 CodeBuild 进行流量转移** — CodeBuild 是一个编译源代码并运行测试的构建服务。它**不**检测 Lambda 更新或转移流量。Lambda 的渐进式流量转移由 **AWS CodeDeploy**（通常通过 SAM）执行，而不是 CodeBuild。AWS CodeDeploy 利用 Lambda 的流量转移功能来自动化新函数版本的渐进式推出。

- **C. 同一函数上的多个函数 URL** — Lambda 函数 URL 是单个专用的 HTTPS 端点。你可以在特定版本/别名上配置函数 URL，但你不能"为更新的代码发布另一个函数 URL"并让 Lambda 自动在两个 URL 之间分割用户流量。函数 URL 不提供版本之间的加权路由。

- **E. 函数 URL 的加权别名** — Lambda 别名在**函数版本**之间路由，而不是在函数 URL 之间路由。没有原生 AWS 功能在两个函数 URL 上创建"加权别名"。别名仅引用函数版本。

## 参考资源
- [为 Lambda 函数创建别名](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-traffic-shifting-using-aliases.html)
- [使用加权别名实现 Lambda 金丝雀部署](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html)
- [使用别名流量转移实现 AWS Lambda 函数的金丝雀部署（AWS 博客）](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/implementing-canary-deployments-of-aws-lambda-functions-with-alias-traffic-shifting/)

en.question: A company had an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance that was named mysql-db. The DB instance was deleted within the past 90 days. A developer needs to find which IAM user or role deleted the DB instance in the AWS environment. Which solution will provide this information?

options.A: Retrieve the AWS CloudTrail events for the resource mysql-db where the event name is DeleteDBInstance. Inspect each event.
options.B: Retrieve the Amazon CloudWatch log events from the most recent log stream within the rds/mysql-db log group. Inspect the log events.
options.C: Retrieve the AWS X-Ray trace summaries. Filter by services with the name mysql-db. Inspect the ErrorRootCauses values within each summary.
options.D: Retrieve the AWS Systems Manager deletions inventory. Filter the inventory by deletions that have a TypeName value of RDS. Inspect the deletion details.

en.explanation:
# RDS DB Instance Deletion — Identifying the IAM Principal

## Scenario
An RDS for MySQL DB instance named `mysql-db` was deleted within the past 90 days. The developer needs to identify **which IAM user or role performed the deletion**. This is an audit/governance task — we need a service that records API activity along with the caller identity.

## Correct Answer: A — CloudTrail Event History for `DeleteDBInstance`

AWS CloudTrail records all RDS management API calls, including the principal (IAM user/role) who made the call. Amazon RDS activity is recorded in a CloudTrail event in Event history, and you can use the CloudTrail console to view the last 90 days of recorded API activity and events in an AWS Region.

The relevant API for deleting an RDS instance is `DeleteDBInstance`. CloudTrail logs can be used to identify resource deletion events; these logs contain the account that performed the action (within the userIdentity field), a timestamp, and more detailed information — examples include DeleteDBInstance for RDS deletion.

Because the deletion occurred within the past 90 days, the event is still available in the CloudTrail **Event history**, which can be filtered by **Resource name** (`mysql-db`) and **Event name** (`DeleteDBInstance`). The `userIdentity` element in the event payload reveals the IAM user or role that initiated the call.

A sample CloudTrail event for an RDS API call looks like:

```json
{
  "eventSource": "rds.amazonaws.com",
  "eventName": "DeleteDBInstance",
  "userIdentity": {
    "type": "IAMUser",
    "arn": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/johndoe",
    "userName": "johndoe"
  },
  "requestParameters": { "dBInstanceIdentifier": "mysql-db" }
}
```

See [Monitoring Amazon RDS API calls in AWS CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/logging-using-cloudtrail.html) and [Working with CloudTrail event history](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/view-cloudtrail-events.html).

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **B. CloudWatch Logs `rds/mysql-db` log group.** RDS can publish *database engine* logs (error, slow query, audit, general) to CloudWatch Logs, but these are MySQL-engine-level logs about queries and database events — they do **not** record AWS control-plane API calls like `DeleteDBInstance`. Also, once the DB instance is deleted, no new engine log streams would be produced; and engine logs do not contain IAM principal information.

- **C. AWS X-Ray trace summaries.** X-Ray traces requests through instrumented application code (e.g., Lambda, API Gateway, ECS). It does not capture AWS service control-plane API calls, has no concept of an RDS "service" named `mysql-db`, and `ErrorRootCauses` is for application errors — not audit of who deleted infrastructure.

- **D. AWS Systems Manager "deletions inventory".** No such feature exists. Systems Manager Inventory collects software/configuration data from managed EC2/on-prem instances; there is no `TypeName=RDS` "deletions inventory". This option is fabricated.

## Key takeaway
For the question "**who** did **what** to an AWS resource?", the answer on AWS is almost always **CloudTrail** — specifically, the `userIdentity` field of the relevant management event.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个名为 mysql-db 的 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库实例。该数据库实例在过去 90 天内被删除。开发人员需要找出是哪个 IAM 用户或角色删除了 AWS 环境中的该数据库实例。哪个解决方案可以提供此信息？

options.A: 检索 AWS CloudTrail 中资源 mysql-db 的事件，其中事件名称为 DeleteDBInstance。检查每个事件。
options.B: 从 rds/mysql-db 日志组中最新的日志流中检索 Amazon CloudWatch 日志事件。检查日志事件。
options.C: 获取 AWS X-Ray 跟踪摘要。筛选名称为 mysql-db 的服务。检查每个摘要中的 ErrorRootCauses 值。
options.D: 获取 AWS Systems Manager 删除清单。筛选清单中 TypeName 值为 RDS 的删除项。检查删除详情。

zh.explanation:
# RDS 数据库实例删除 — 确定 IAM 主体

## 场景
一个名为 `mysql-db` 的 RDS for MySQL 数据库实例在过去 90 天内被删除。开发人员需要确定**哪个 IAM 用户或角色执行了删除操作**。这是一项审计/治理任务 — 我们需要一项记录 API 活动以及调用者身份的服务。

## 正确答案：A — CloudTrail 事件历史记录中的 `DeleteDBInstance`

AWS CloudTrail 记录所有 RDS 管理 API 调用，包括执行调用的主体（IAM 用户/角色）。Amazon RDS 活动被记录在 CloudTrail 事件的事件历史记录中，你可以使用 CloudTrail 控制台查看 AWS 区域中最近 90 天的已记录 API 活动和事件。

删除 RDS 实例的相关 API 是 `DeleteDBInstance`。CloudTrail 日志可用于识别资源删除事件；这些日志包含执行该操作的账户（在 userIdentity 字段中）、时间戳和更多详细信息 — 示例包括用于 RDS 删除的 DeleteDBInstance。

由于删除发生在过去 90 天内，该事件仍可在 CloudTrail **事件历史记录**中获得，可以按**资源名称**（`mysql-db`）和**事件名称**（`DeleteDBInstance`）进行筛选。事件有效负载中的 `userIdentity` 元素揭示了发起该调用的 IAM 用户或角色。

RDS API 调用的示例 CloudTrail 事件如下所示：

```json
{
  "eventSource": "rds.amazonaws.com",
  "eventName": "DeleteDBInstance",
  "userIdentity": {
    "type": "IAMUser",
    "arn": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/johndoe",
    "userName": "johndoe"
  },
  "requestParameters": { "dBInstanceIdentifier": "mysql-db" }
}
```

请参阅 [Monitoring Amazon RDS API calls in AWS CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/logging-using-cloudtrail.html) 和 [Working with CloudTrail event history](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/view-cloudtrail-events.html)。

## 其他选项为什么错误

- **B. CloudWatch Logs `rds/mysql-db` 日志组。** RDS 可以将*数据库引擎*日志（错误、慢查询、审计、常规）发布到 CloudWatch Logs，但这些是关于查询和数据库事件的 MySQL 引擎级日志 — 它们**不**记录 AWS 控制平面 API 调用，如 `DeleteDBInstance`。此外，一旦数据库实例被删除，就不会生成新的引擎日志流；引擎日志也不包含 IAM 主体信息。

- **C. AWS X-Ray 跟踪摘要。** X-Ray 跟踪通过检测的应用程序代码（例如 Lambda、API Gateway、ECS）的请求。它不捕获 AWS 服务控制平面 API 调用，对名为 `mysql-db` 的 RDS"服务"没有概念，`ErrorRootCauses` 用于应用程序错误 — 不用于基础设施删除的审计。

- **D. AWS Systems Manager"删除清单"。** 不存在这样的功能。Systems Manager Inventory 从受管 EC2/本地实例收集软件/配置数据；不存在 `TypeName=RDS` 的"删除清单"。此选项是虚构的。

## 关键要点
对于"**谁**对 AWS 资源做了**什么**？"这样的问题，AWS 上的答案几乎总是 **CloudTrail** — 特别是相关管理事件的 `userIdentity` 字段。

en.question: A company has an ecommerce web application that uses an on-premises MySQL database as a data store. The company migrates the on-premises MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL. A developer needs to configure the application's access to the RDS for MySQL database. The developer's solution must not use long term credentials. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Enable IAM database authentication on the RDS for MySQL DB instance. Create an IAM role that has the minimum required permissions. Assign the role to the application.
options.B: Store the MySQL credentials as secrets in AWS Secrets Manager. Create an IAM role that has the minimum required permissions to retrieve the secrets. Assign the role to the application.
options.C: Configure the MySQL credentials as environment variables that are available at runtime for the application.
options.D: Store the MySQL credentials as SecureString parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Create an IAM role that has the minimum required permissions to retrieve the parameters. Assign the role to the application.

en.explanation:
# RDS for MySQL Authentication Without Long-Term Credentials

## Scenario Analysis

A developer is configuring an application's access to an Amazon RDS for MySQL database. The hard requirement is **no long-term credentials**. The question is asking which approach truly eliminates long-lived secrets (like static usernames/passwords) from the authentication flow.

## Correct Answer: A — IAM Database Authentication

With IAM database authentication enabled on the RDS for MySQL instance, the application uses an IAM role to generate a short-lived authentication token instead of a password.

With this authentication method, you don't need to use a password when you connect to a DB instance. Instead, you use an authentication token. An authentication token is a unique string of characters that Amazon RDS generates on request. Authentication tokens are generated using AWS Signature Version 4. Each token has a lifetime of 15 minutes. You don't need to store user credentials in the database, because authentication is managed externally using IAM.

Key reasons this satisfies the "no long-term credentials" requirement:

- You can use an authentication token when you connect to Amazon RDS from another AWS service, such as AWS Lambda. By using a token, you can avoid placing a password in your code.
- The IAM role attached to the application (EC2 instance profile, ECS task role, Lambda execution role, etc.) supplies temporary credentials via STS, which are automatically rotated by AWS.
- Instead of a password, your application generates a short-lived authentication token using its AWS IAM credentials. No passwords to manage, no secrets to rotate, and access is controlled through the same IAM policies you're already using for everything else in AWS.

### Required IAM policy

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "rds-db:connect",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:rds-db:us-east-1:123456789012:dbuser:db-ABCDEFGHIJ/db_user"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Enable IAM authentication on the DB instance

```bash
aws rds modify-db-instance \
  --db-instance-identifier mydbinstance \
  --enable-iam-database-authentication \
  --apply-immediately
```

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **B. Secrets Manager** — Even though Secrets Manager can rotate credentials, the underlying MySQL username/password it stores **is itself a long-term credential**. The application retrieves a database password and uses it directly to authenticate to MySQL. Rotation reduces exposure but does not eliminate long-term credentials in the strict sense, whereas IAM DB auth replaces them entirely with 15-minute tokens.

- **C. Environment variables** — Storing credentials in environment variables is the *worst* option. The credentials are still long-term static MySQL passwords, and they are exposed in plaintext at runtime with no encryption, rotation, or access auditing.

- **D. SSM Parameter Store SecureString** — Same fundamental problem as B: the actual MySQL password retrieved from Parameter Store is a long-term static credential. Parameter Store also lacks built-in automatic rotation for RDS-style credentials. The application still authenticates to MySQL using a persistent password.

Only Option A removes the long-term credential from the authentication flow itself by using ephemeral IAM-generated tokens.

## References

- [IAM database authentication for MariaDB, MySQL, and PostgreSQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/UsingWithRDS.IAMDBAuth.html)
- [Connecting to your DB instance using IAM authentication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/UsingWithRDS.IAMDBAuth.Connecting.html)

zh.question: 一家公司有一个电子商务 Web 应用程序，该应用程序使用本地 MySQL 数据库作为数据存储。该公司将本地 MySQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL。开发人员需要配置应用程序对 RDS for MySQL 数据库的访问。开发人员的解决方案不能使用长期凭证。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 RDS for MySQL 数据库实例上启用 IAM 数据库身份验证。创建一个具有最低必要权限的 IAM 角色。将该角色分配给应用程序。
options.B: 将 MySQL 凭证作为密钥存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。创建一个具有检索密钥所需最低权限的 IAM 角色。将该角色分配给应用程序。
options.C: 将 MySQL 凭据配置为应用程序运行时可用的环境变量。
options.D: 将 MySQL 凭证作为 SecureString 参数存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。创建一个具有检索这些参数所需最低权限的 IAM 角色。将该角色分配给应用程序。

zh.explanation:
# RDS for MySQL 无长期凭证身份验证

## 场景分析

开发人员正在配置应用程序对 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库的访问。硬性要求是**无长期凭证**。问题是询问哪种方法真正消除了身份验证流程中的长期密钥（如静态用户名/密码）。

## 正确答案：A — IAM 数据库身份验证

启用 RDS for MySQL 实例上的 IAM 数据库身份验证后，应用程序使用 IAM 角色生成短期身份验证令牌，而不是密码。

使用此身份验证方法，连接到数据库实例时无需使用密码。相反，您可以使用身份验证令牌。身份验证令牌是 Amazon RDS 按需生成的唯一字符串。身份验证令牌使用 AWS Signature Version 4 生成。每个令牌的生命周期为 15 分钟。由于身份验证通过 IAM 在外部管理，您无需在数据库中存储用户凭证。

此方法满足"无长期凭证"要求的关键原因：

- 从另一个 AWS 服务（如 AWS Lambda）连接到 Amazon RDS 时，可以使用身份验证令牌。通过使用令牌，可以避免在代码中放置密码。
- 附加到应用程序的 IAM 角色（EC2 实例配置文件、ECS 任务角色、Lambda 执行角色等）通过 STS 提供临时凭证，由 AWS 自动轮换。
- 应用程序无需使用密码，而是使用其 AWS IAM 凭证生成短期身份验证令牌。无需管理密码，无需轮换密钥，访问控制通过您已在 AWS 中使用的相同 IAM 策略进行。

### 所需的 IAM 策略

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "rds-db:connect",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:rds-db:us-east-1:123456789012:dbuser:db-ABCDEFGHIJ/db_user"
    }
  ]
}
```

### 在数据库实例上启用 IAM 身份验证

```bash
aws rds modify-db-instance \
  --db-instance-identifier mydbinstance \
  --enable-iam-database-authentication \
  --apply-immediately
```

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **B. Secrets Manager** — 虽然 Secrets Manager 可以轮换凭证，但其存储的底层 MySQL 用户名/密码**本身是长期凭证**。应用程序检索数据库密码并直接使用它对 MySQL 进行身份验证。轮换减少了暴露，但不能严格意义上消除长期凭证，而 IAM 数据库身份验证则用 15 分钟令牌完全替代它们。

- **C. 环境变量** — 在环境变量中存储凭证是**最坏的**选项。凭证仍然是长期的静态 MySQL 密码，在运行时以明文形式公开，没有加密、轮换或访问审计。

- **D. SSM Parameter Store SecureString** — 与 B 相同的根本问题：从 Parameter Store 检索的实际 MySQL 密码是长期的静态凭证。Parameter Store 也缺乏 RDS 风格凭证的内置自动轮换。应用程序仍然使用持久密码对 MySQL 进行身份验证。

只有选项 A 通过使用短期 IAM 生成的令牌从身份验证流程本身中移除长期凭证。

## 参考资源

- [IAM database authentication for MariaDB, MySQL, and PostgreSQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/UsingWithRDS.IAMDBAuth.html)
- [Connecting to your DB instance using IAM authentication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/UsingWithRDS.IAMDBAuth.Connecting.html)

en.question: A developer is creating an application that must transfer expired items from Amazon DynamoDB to Amazon S3. The developer sets up the DynamoDB table to automatically delete items after a specific TTL. The application must process the items in DynamoDB and then must store the expired items in Amazon S3. The entire process, including item processing and storage in Amazon S3, will take 5 minutes. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to query for expired items based on the TTL. Save the results to Amazon S3.
options.B: Configure DynamoDB Streams to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to process the items and to store the expired items in Amazon S3.
options.C: Deploy a custom application on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster on Amazon EC2 instances. Program the custom application to process the items and to store the expired items in Amazon S3.
options.D: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Program the Lambda function to process the items and to store the expired items in Amazon S3.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The application uses DynamoDB TTL to automatically expire items, then needs to process those expired items and store them in Amazon S3. Total processing time is 5 minutes. The goal is the **least operational overhead** solution.

## Correct Answer: B

**Configure DynamoDB Streams to invoke an AWS Lambda function** that processes the items and stores them in S3.

This is the AWS-recommended pattern for archiving TTL-expired DynamoDB items. Combining DynamoDB Time to Live (TTL), DynamoDB Streams, and AWS Lambda can help simplify archiving data, reduce DynamoDB storage costs, and reduce code complexity. Once deleted, items go into DynamoDB Streams as service deletions instead of user deletes, and items deleted by the TTL process have userIdentity.type "Service" and userIdentity.principalId "dynamodb.amazonaws.com", which can be matched with a Lambda event source filter.

**Lambda 5-minute fit:** Lambda's maximum timeout is 15 minutes, so a 5-minute processing window is well within Lambda's limits.

**Why this has the least operational overhead:**
- Fully serverless – no servers to provision, patch, or scale
- DynamoDB Streams → Lambda is a native event-source mapping (no polling code to write)
- You aren't charged for GetRecords API calls on your DynamoDB stream when using Lambda to consume events, and Lambda can provide event filtering by identifying JSON patterns in a stream event, allowing you to invoke only on TTL deletes

## Why the other options are wrong

**A. DAX to query for expired items based on TTL** – DAX is an in-memory **read cache** in front of DynamoDB to accelerate reads; it cannot query/filter on TTL expiration nor write to S3. TTL deletions happen in the background and DAX has no mechanism to detect them. This does not solve the problem at all.

**C. Custom application on ECS on EC2** – Running an ECS-on-EC2 cluster requires managing the EC2 instances (patching, scaling, capacity), the cluster, the task definitions, and a custom polling/processing application. This is the **highest** operational overhead option and is the opposite of what the question asks for.

**D. EventBridge rule to invoke Lambda** – EventBridge does **not** have a native event source for DynamoDB TTL expirations. There is no event emitted to EventBridge when an item is deleted by TTL. To get TTL deletes into EventBridge you would still need DynamoDB Streams plus extra plumbing, making this both incorrect and more complex than option B.

## References

- [DynamoDB Streams and Time to Live](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/time-to-live-ttl-streams.html)
- [Working with expired items and TTL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/ttl-expired-items.html)
- [Automatically archive items to Amazon S3 using DynamoDB TTL (AWS Prescriptive Guidance)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/patterns/automatically-archive-items-to-amazon-s3-using-dynamodb-ttl.html)
- [Automatically Archive Items to S3 Using DynamoDB TTL with Lambda (AWS Database Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/automatically-archive-items-to-s3-using-dynamodb-time-to-live-with-aws-lambda-and-amazon-kinesis-firehose/)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在创建一个应用程序，该应用程序需要将过期项目从 Amazon DynamoDB 传输到 Amazon S3。开发人员已将 DynamoDB 表设置为在特定生存时间 (TTL) 后自动删除项目。该应用程序必须处理 DynamoDB 中的项目，然后将过期项目存储到 Amazon S3 中。整个过程（包括项目处理和存储到 Amazon S3）需要 5 分钟。哪种解决方案能够以最小的运维开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 以根据 TTL 查询过期项目。将结果保存到 Amazon S3。
options.B: 配置 DynamoDB Streams 以调用 AWS Lambda 函数。编写 Lambda 函数程序，使其处理数据项并将过期数据项存储到 Amazon S3 中。
options.C: 在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群中部署自定义应用程序。编写自定义应用程序程序，使其能够处理项目并将过期项目存储在 Amazon S3 中。
options.D: 创建一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则以调用 AWS Lambda 函数。编写 Lambda 函数程序，使其处理这些项目并将过期项目存储到 Amazon S3 中。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

该应用使用 DynamoDB TTL 自动过期项目，然后需要处理这些过期的项目并将其存储在 Amazon S3 中。总处理时间为 5 分钟。目标是**最少操作开销**的解决方案。

## 正确答案：B

**配置 DynamoDB Streams 以调用 AWS Lambda 函数**，该函数处理项目并将其存储在 S3 中。

这是 AWS 推荐的用于存档 TTL 过期 DynamoDB 项目的模式。将 DynamoDB Time to Live (TTL)、DynamoDB Streams 和 AWS Lambda 结合起来可以帮助简化数据存档、降低 DynamoDB 存储成本并降低代码复杂性。 删除后，项目作为服务删除而不是用户删除进入 DynamoDB Streams，并且 由 TTL 进程删除的项目具有 userIdentity.type "Service" 和 userIdentity.principalId "dynamodb.amazonaws.com"，可以通过 Lambda 事件源筛选器进行匹配。

**Lambda 5 分钟适配：** Lambda 的最大超时时间为 15 分钟，因此 5 分钟的处理窗口远在 Lambda 的限制范围内。

**为什么这个方案的操作开销最少：**
- 完全无服务器 – 无需配置、修补或扩展服务器
- DynamoDB Streams → Lambda 是原生事件源映射（无需编写轮询代码）
- 当使用 Lambda 消费流中的事件时，不会对 DynamoDB 流收取 GetRecords API 调用费用，Lambda 可以通过识别流事件中的 JSON 模式来提供事件筛选，允许仅在 TTL 删除时调用

## 为什么其他选项错误

**A. 使用 DAX 根据 TTL 查询过期项目** – DAX 是 DynamoDB 前面的内存**读缓存**，用于加速读取；它无法查询/筛选 TTL 过期项目，也无法写入 S3。TTL 删除在后台进行，DAX 没有检测机制。这根本不能解决问题。

**C. ECS on EC2 上的自定义应用程序** – 运行 ECS-on-EC2 集群需要管理 EC2 实例（修补、扩展、容量）、集群、任务定义和自定义轮询/处理应用程序。这是**最高**操作开销的选项，与问题要求的相反。

**D. EventBridge 规则以调用 Lambda** – EventBridge **没有** DynamoDB TTL 过期的原生事件源。项目被 TTL 删除时不会向 EventBridge 发出事件。要将 TTL 删除放入 EventBridge，您仍然需要 DynamoDB Streams 加上额外的管道，这使得该选项既不正确又比选项 B 更复杂。

## 参考资源

- [DynamoDB Streams and Time to Live](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/time-to-live-ttl-streams.html)
- [Working with expired items and TTL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/ttl-expired-items.html)
- [Automatically archive items to Amazon S3 using DynamoDB TTL (AWS Prescriptive Guidance)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/patterns/automatically-archive-items-to-amazon-s3-using-dynamodb-ttl.html)
- [Automatically Archive Items to S3 Using DynamoDB TTL with Lambda (AWS Database Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/automatically-archive-items-to-s3-using-dynamodb-time-to-live-with-aws-lambda-and-amazon-kinesis-firehose/)

en.question: A developer has an application that uses WebSocket APIs in Amazon API Gateway. The developer wants to use an API Gateway Lambda authorizer to control access to the application. The developer needs to add credential caching and reduce repeated usage of secret keys and authorization tokens on every request. Which combination of steps should the developer take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use a token-based Lambda authorizer.
options.B: Use a request parameter-based Lambda authorizer.
options.C: Configure an integration request mapping template to reference the context map from the APIGateway Lambda authorizer.
options.D: Configure an integration request mapping template to reference the identity API key value from the API Gateway Lambda authorizer.
options.E: Use VPC endpoint policies for the WebSocket APIs.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer is building an application that uses **WebSocket APIs in Amazon API Gateway** and wants to use a **Lambda authorizer** to control access. The requirements are to:

1. Add credential caching, and
2. Reduce repeated usage of secret keys and authorization tokens on every request.

The correct combination is **B and C**.

> **Note on the originally listed answer (A, C):** Option A (token-based Lambda authorizer) is technically invalid for WebSocket APIs. AWS API Gateway only supports **REQUEST** (parameter-based) Lambda authorizers on WebSocket APIs — TOKEN authorizers are a REST-API-only construct and cannot be attached to a WebSocket `$connect` route. Therefore A is incorrect, and B replaces it.

---

## Why B is correct — Use a request parameter-based Lambda authorizer

WebSocket APIs in API Gateway support **only REQUEST (parameter-based) Lambda authorizers**. The official AWS guide is literally titled *"Control access to WebSocket APIs with AWS Lambda REQUEST authorizers"* and states that the Lambda authorizer is attached to the `$connect` route, where it inspects identity sources such as headers and query string parameters from the connection request ([Control access to WebSocket APIs with AWS Lambda REQUEST authorizers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-websocket-api-lambda-auth.html)).

This design directly satisfies the requirement to *reduce repeated usage of secret keys/tokens*:

- Authorization runs **only once per WebSocket connection** (at `$connect`), not on every message frame.
- REQUEST authorizers also support **authorization caching** via a configurable TTL, with the cache key derived from the chosen identity sources ([Use API Gateway Lambda authorizers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-use-lambda-authorizer.html)).

The parent control-access page for WebSocket APIs only enumerates IAM authorization and Lambda **REQUEST** authorizers as supported mechanisms ([Control and manage access to WebSocket APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-websocket-api-control-access.html)).

---

## Why C is correct — Reference the authorizer context map in an integration request mapping template

A Lambda authorizer can return a **`context` object** alongside the IAM policy. API Gateway exposes those values through mapping expressions like `$context.authorizer.<key>`, which can be referenced from an **integration request mapping template** to forward authenticated identity/authorization attributes to the backend ([Output from an API Gateway Lambda authorizer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-lambda-authorizer-output.html)).

This avoids re-sending secrets/tokens to the backend and avoids re-validating credentials per request — exactly the caching/reuse pattern the question is describing.

---

## Why the other options are wrong

### A. Use a token-based Lambda authorizer ❌ (the originally listed but incorrect answer)
TOKEN authorizers are supported only by **REST APIs**. WebSocket APIs cannot be configured with a TOKEN authorizer — API Gateway requires `AuthorizerType: REQUEST` for `AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Authorizer` on a WebSocket API ([Use API Gateway Lambda authorizers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-use-lambda-authorizer.html)). Selecting A in a WebSocket scenario is technically impossible.

### D. Reference the identity API key value (`$context.identity.apiKey`) ❌
API keys are tied to **REST API usage plans and throttling**, not to Lambda authorizer output. They are not the mechanism by which authorizer-derived credentials/claims are passed to the backend, so this does not satisfy the caching/reuse requirement.

### E. Use VPC endpoint policies for the WebSocket APIs ❌
VPC endpoint policies govern which principals can access an API via an interface VPC endpoint — they have nothing to do with Lambda authorizer caching or with reducing repeated credential evaluation. Additionally, WebSocket APIs do not use private VPC endpoints in the same way private REST APIs do.

---

## Key takeaway

For **WebSocket APIs**, the only valid Lambda authorizer type is **REQUEST (parameter-based)** (B), and authorizer-produced identity/authorization data is propagated to the backend via the **authorizer context map** referenced from integration request mapping templates (C). Together, these eliminate per-message re-validation of secrets and tokens.

## Sources
- [Control access to WebSocket APIs with AWS Lambda REQUEST authorizers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-websocket-api-lambda-auth.html)
- [Use API Gateway Lambda authorizers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-use-lambda-authorizer.html)
- [Control and manage access to WebSocket APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-websocket-api-control-access.html)
- [Output from an API Gateway Lambda authorizer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-lambda-authorizer-output.html)

zh.question: 一位开发者有一个使用 Amazon API Gateway 中的 WebSocket API 的应用程序。该开发者希望使用 API Gateway Lambda 授权器来控制对该应用程序的访问。开发者需要添加凭证缓存，并减少每次请求中重复使用密钥和授权令牌的情况。为了满足这些要求，开发者应该采取哪些步骤组合？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用基于令牌的 Lambda 授权器。
options.B: 使用基于请求参数的 Lambda 授权器。
options.C: 配置集成请求映射模板，以引用来自 APIGateway Lambda 授权器的上下文映射。
options.D: 配置集成请求映射模板，以引用 API 网关 Lambda 授权器中的身份 API 密钥值。
options.E: 对 WebSocket API 使用 VPC 端点策略。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一位开发者正在构建一个使用 **Amazon API Gateway 中的 WebSocket API** 并想要使用 **Lambda 授权者**来控制访问的应用程序。要求是：

1. 添加凭证缓存，以及
2. 减少对每个请求重复使用密钥和授权令牌。

正确的组合是 **B 和 C**。

> **关于最初列出的答案（A、C）的说明：** 选项 A（基于令牌的 Lambda 授权者）在技术上对 WebSocket API 无效。AWS API Gateway 在 WebSocket API 上仅支持 **REQUEST**（基于参数的）Lambda 授权者 — TOKEN 授权者是仅限 REST API 的构造，无法附加到 WebSocket `$connect` 路由。因此 A 是不正确的，B 取而代之。

---

## 为什么 B 是正确的 — 使用基于请求参数的 Lambda 授权者

API Gateway 中的 WebSocket API **仅支持 REQUEST（基于参数的）Lambda 授权者**。官方 AWS 指南的标题为"*使用 AWS Lambda REQUEST 授权者控制对 WebSocket API 的访问*"，并指出 Lambda 授权者附加到 `$connect` 路由，其中它检查来自连接请求的标头和查询字符串参数等身份来源（[使用 AWS Lambda REQUEST 授权者控制对 WebSocket API 的访问](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-websocket-api-lambda-auth.html)）。

此设计直接满足*减少密钥和令牌的重复使用*的要求：

- 授权**仅在每个 WebSocket 连接一次运行**（在 `$connect` 处），而不是在每个消息帧上运行。
- REQUEST 授权者也支持通过可配置的 TTL 进行**授权缓存**，缓存密钥源自所选的身份来源（[使用 API Gateway Lambda 授权者](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-use-lambda-authorizer.html)）。

WebSocket API 的父控制访问页面仅列举 IAM 授权和 Lambda **REQUEST** 授权者作为支持的机制（[控制和管理对 WebSocket API 的访问](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-websocket-api-control-access.html)）。

---

## 为什么 C 是正确的 — 在集成请求映射模板中引用授权者上下文映射

Lambda 授权者可以返回 **`context` 对象**以及 IAM 策略。API Gateway 通过映射表达式（如 `$context.authorizer.<key>`）公开这些值，这些值可以从**集成请求映射模板**中引用，以将经过身份验证的身份/授权属性转发到后端（[来自 API Gateway Lambda 授权者的输出](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-lambda-authorizer-output.html)）。

这样可以避免向后端重新发送密钥/令牌，避免每个请求重新验证凭证 — 正是问题描述的缓存/重用模式。

---

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

### A. 使用基于令牌的 Lambda 授权者 ❌ （最初列出但不正确的答案）
TOKEN 授权者仅由 **REST API** 支持。WebSocket API 无法配置为 TOKEN 授权者 — API Gateway 要求 WebSocket API 上的 `AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Authorizer` 为 `AuthorizerType: REQUEST`（[使用 API Gateway Lambda 授权者](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-use-lambda-authorizer.html)）。在 WebSocket 场景中选择 A 在技术上是不可能的。

### D. 引用身份 API 密钥值 (`$context.identity.apiKey`) ❌
API 密钥与 **REST API 使用计划和限流**相关联，与 Lambda 授权者输出无关。它们不是授权者派生的凭证/声明被传递到后端的机制，因此不满足缓存/重用要求。

### E. 为 WebSocket API 使用 VPC 端点策略 ❌
VPC 端点策略管理哪些主体可以通过接口 VPC 端点访问 API — 它们与 Lambda 授权者缓存或减少重复的凭证评估无关。此外，WebSocket API 不以与私有 REST API 相同的方式使用私有 VPC 端点。

---

## 关键要点

对于 **WebSocket API**，唯一有效的 Lambda 授权者类型是 **REQUEST（基于参数的）**（B），授权者生成的身份/授权数据通过从集成请求映射模板引用的**授权者上下文映射**传播到后端（C）。这些共同消除了对每个消息的密钥和令牌的重新验证。

## 来源
- [使用 AWS Lambda REQUEST 授权者控制对 WebSocket API 的访问](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-websocket-api-lambda-auth.html)
- [使用 API Gateway Lambda 授权者](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-use-lambda-authorizer.html)
- [控制和管理对 WebSocket API 的访问](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-websocket-api-control-access.html)
- [来自 API Gateway Lambda 授权者的输出](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-lambda-authorizer-output.html)

en.question: A developer builds a serverless application on AWS by using Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda functions, and Amazon Route 53. During testing, the developer notices errors but cannot immediately locate the root cause. To identify the errors, the developer needs to search all the application's logs. What should the developer do to meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Set up API Gateway health checks to monitor the application's availability. Use the Amazon CloudWatch PutMetricData API operation to publish the logs to CloudWatch. Search and query the logs by using Amazon Athena.
options.B: Set up Route 53 health checks to monitor the application's availability. Turn on AWS CloudTrail logs for all the AWS services that the application uses. Send the logs to a specified Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to query the log files directly from Amazon S3.
options.C: Configure all the application's AWS services to publish a real-time feed of log events to an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream. Configure the delivery stream to publish all the logs to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon OpenSearch Service to search and analyze the logs.
options.D: Set up Route 53 health checks to monitor the application's availability. Turn on Amazon CloudWatch Logs for the API Gateway stages to log API requests with a JSON log format. Use CloudWatch Logs Insights to search and analyze the logs from the AWS services that the application uses.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer has built a serverless application using **API Gateway + Lambda + Route 53**. Errors are occurring during testing, and the developer needs to **search across all logs** from these services to find the root cause — with the **least operational overhead**.

The key requirement is centralized log search with minimal configuration/management.

## Correct Answer: D

**D. Set up Route 53 health checks, enable CloudWatch Logs for API Gateway stages with JSON format, and use CloudWatch Logs Insights to search and analyze logs.**

This option leverages fully-managed, native AWS services:

- **Lambda automatically writes logs to CloudWatch Logs** (no extra setup needed) — every Lambda invocation produces START/END/REPORT lines plus any application output to a `/aws/lambda/<function-name>` log group.
- **API Gateway** can be configured to publish [execution and access logs to CloudWatch Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/set-up-logging.html) at the stage level, in JSON format which Logs Insights can auto-parse.
- **Route 53 health checks** monitor application availability, and Route 53 can publish query/health-check logs to CloudWatch Logs.
- **CloudWatch Logs Insights** lets you [interactively search and analyze log data](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/AnalyzingLogData.html), including **automatic field discovery for AWS services such as Route 53, Lambda, CloudTrail, and JSON-formatted logs**, and you can query multiple log groups in a single query.

This delivers centralized, cross-service log search with virtually no infrastructure to manage — the lowest operational overhead.

## Why the other options are wrong

**A. API Gateway health checks + PutMetricData + Athena**
- API Gateway does not have "health checks" — health checks are a Route 53 feature. 
- `PutMetricData` publishes **metrics**, not log events; you cannot push logs to CloudWatch via this API.
- Athena over S3 requires you to first export logs into S3 in a queryable format (extra ETL/Glue work) — high operational overhead.

**B. Route 53 health checks + CloudTrail to S3 + Athena**
- **CloudTrail logs API management/control-plane activity, not application logs**. It will not capture Lambda function `console.log` output, API Gateway access logs, or runtime errors.
- Querying via Athena requires schema definition (Glue tables, partitioning) — more overhead than CloudWatch Logs Insights.

**C. Kinesis Data Firehose → S3 → OpenSearch**
- Requires building a pipeline (Firehose stream, S3 destination, OpenSearch domain provisioning, index management). 
- OpenSearch Service is not serverless by default and incurs cluster management overhead. This is the **opposite** of "least operational overhead."

## Key References
- [Analyzing log data with CloudWatch Logs Insights](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/AnalyzingLogData.html) — auto-discovery of fields for Route 53, Lambda, CloudTrail, and JSON logs.
- [Set up CloudWatch logging for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/set-up-logging.html) — execution & access logging, JSON format support.
- [Monitoring Lambda with CloudWatch Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/monitoring-cloudwatchlogs.html) — Lambda automatically streams logs to CloudWatch.
- [CloudWatch Logs Insights sample queries](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CWL_QuerySyntax-examples.html) — includes dedicated query examples for Lambda, API Gateway, and Route 53.

zh.question: 一位开发人员使用 Amazon API Gateway、AWS Lambda 函数和 Amazon Route 53 在 AWS 上构建了一个无服务器应用程序。在测试过程中，开发人员发现了一些错误，但无法立即找到根本原因。为了识别这些错误，开发人员需要搜索应用程序的所有日志。为了在满足这些要求的同时最大限度地减少运维开销，开发人员应该怎么做？

options.A: 设置 API 网关运行状况检查以监控应用程序的可用性。使用 Amazon CloudWatch PutMetricData API 操作将日志发布到 CloudWatch。使用 Amazon Athena 搜索和查询日志。
options.B: 设置 Route 53 健康检查以监控应用程序的可用性。启用应用程序使用的所有 AWS 服务的 AWS CloudTrail 日志。将日志发送到指定的 Amazon S3 存储桶。使用 Amazon Athena 直接从 Amazon S3 查询日志文件。
options.C: 配置应用程序的所有 AWS 服务，使其将日志事件的实时流发布到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 传输流。配置该传输流，使其将所有日志发布到 Amazon S3 存储桶。使用 Amazon OpenSearch Service 搜索和分析日志。
options.D: 设置 Route 53 健康检查以监控应用程序的可用性。为 API Gateway 阶段启用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs，以 JSON 日志格式记录 API 请求。使用 CloudWatch Logs Insights 搜索和分析应用程序使用的 AWS 服务的日志。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一位开发者使用 **API Gateway + Lambda + Route 53** 构建了无服务器应用程序。在测试过程中出现了错误，开发者需要**跨所有日志进行搜索**来找到根本原因——并且**运维开销最小**。

关键需求是集中式日志搜索，配置和管理工作量最少。

## 正确答案：D

**D. 设置 Route 53 健康检查，为 API Gateway 阶段启用 CloudWatch Logs（JSON 格式），并使用 CloudWatch Logs Insights 搜索和分析日志。**

此选项利用了完全托管的原生 AWS 服务：

- **Lambda 自动将日志写入 CloudWatch Logs**（无需额外设置）—— 每次 Lambda 调用都会生成 START/END/REPORT 行，以及应用程序输出到 `/aws/lambda/<function-name>` 日志组。
- **API Gateway** 可配置为[将执行和访问日志发布到 CloudWatch Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/set-up-logging.html)（在阶段级别），使用 JSON 格式便于 Logs Insights 自动解析。
- **Route 53 健康检查**监控应用程序可用性，Route 53 可将查询/健康检查日志发布到 CloudWatch Logs。
- **CloudWatch Logs Insights** 允许您[交互式搜索和分析日志数据](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/AnalyzingLogData.html)，包括**对 Route 53、Lambda、CloudTrail 和 JSON 格式日志的自动字段发现**，并且可以在单个查询中查询多个日志组。

这提供了集中式跨服务日志搜索，几乎无需管理任何基础设施 —— 运维开销最低。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**A. API Gateway 健康检查 + PutMetricData + Athena**
- API Gateway 没有"健康检查" —— 健康检查是 Route 53 的功能。
- `PutMetricData` 发布**指标**，而不是日志事件；无法通过此 API 将日志推送到 CloudWatch。
- Athena 查询 S3 需要首先将日志导出到 S3（以可查询的格式）—— 需要额外的 ETL/Glue 工作，运维开销大。

**B. Route 53 健康检查 + CloudTrail 到 S3 + Athena**
- **CloudTrail 记录 API 管理/控制平面活动，而不是应用程序日志**。它不会捕获 Lambda 函数 `console.log` 输出、API Gateway 访问日志或运行时错误。
- 通过 Athena 查询需要定义架构（Glue 表、分区）—— 比 CloudWatch Logs Insights 的开销更大。

**C. Kinesis Data Firehose → S3 → OpenSearch**
- 需要构建管道（Firehose 流、S3 目标、OpenSearch 域配置、索引管理）。
- OpenSearch Service 默认情况下不是无服务器的，需要承担集群管理开销。这与"最少运维开销"的要求**相反**。

## 关键参考资源
- [使用 CloudWatch Logs Insights 分析日志数据](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/AnalyzingLogData.html) —— Route 53、Lambda、CloudTrail 和 JSON 日志的自动字段发现。
- [在 API Gateway 中为 REST API 设置 CloudWatch 日志](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/set-up-logging.html) —— 执行和访问日志，支持 JSON 格式。
- [使用 CloudWatch Logs 监控 Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/monitoring-cloudwatchlogs.html) —— Lambda 自动将日志流式传输到 CloudWatch。
- [CloudWatch Logs Insights 示例查询](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CWL_QuerySyntax-examples.html) —— 包括 Lambda、API Gateway 和 Route 53 的专用查询示例。

en.question: A developer needs to freeze changes to an AWS CodeCommit repository before a production release. The developer will work on new features while a quality assurance (QA) team tests the release. The QA testing and all bug fixes must take place in isolation from the main branch. After the release, the developer must integrate all bug fixes into the main branch. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a release branch from the latest Git commit that will be in the release. Apply fixes to the release branch. Continue developing new features, and merge the features into the main branch. Merge the release branch into the main branch after the release.
options.B: Create a Git tag on the latest Git commit that will be in the release. Continue developing new features, and merge the features into the main branch. Apply fixes to the main branch. Update the Git tag for the release to be on the latest commit on the main branch.
options.C: Create a release branch from the latest Git commit that will be in the release. Apply fixes to the release branch. Continue developing new features, and merge the features into the main branch. Rebase the main branch onto the release branch after the release.
options.D: Create a Git tag on the latest Git commit that will be in the release. Continue developing new features, and merge the features into the main branch. Apply the Git commits for fixes to the Git tag for the release.

en.explanation:
# Git Release Branch Strategy for CodeCommit

## Scenario
The developer needs to "freeze" the codebase for a production release while:
1. Allowing QA to test the release in isolation
2. Allowing bug fixes against the release without disturbing main
3. Letting the developer continue feature work on main
4. Eventually integrating the release bug fixes back into main

This is the classic **Gitflow release branch** pattern.

## Correct Answer: A

Create a **release branch** from the latest commit destined for the release. The QA team tests this branch and any bug fixes are committed to the release branch (isolated from main). Meanwhile, the developer continues developing new features and merging them into main. After the release ships, the release branch is merged back into main so the bug fixes are integrated.

This matches AWS Prescriptive Guidance for Gitflow, where "After the release branch has deployed to production, it should be merged back into the develop and main branches to make sure that any bugfixes or hotfixes are merged back into future development efforts."

It also matches the canonical Gitflow definition: "Creating this branch starts the next release cycle, so no new features can be added after this point—only bug fixes, documentation generation, and other release-oriented tasks should go in this branch." And "Once it's ready to ship, the release branch gets merged into main and tagged with a version number. In addition, it should be merged back into develop, which may have progressed since the release was initiated."

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**B. Git tag + apply fixes to main** — A Git tag is just an immutable pointer to a commit; it cannot isolate work. If bug fixes are applied to main, they are mixed with new feature commits, so QA cannot test in isolation and the "freeze" requirement is violated. Updating a tag to point to a later commit also defeats the purpose of tagging a release.

**C. Rebase main onto release branch** — Rebasing main onto the release branch would rewrite the history of the shared main branch (a destructive operation on a published branch) and would replay main's new feature commits on top of the release branch, effectively making the release branch the new base. This is dangerous on a shared/protected main branch and is not how release branches are integrated. The standard practice is a **merge** back into main, not a rebase of main.

**D. Apply commits to a Git tag** — You cannot commit to a tag. Tags are static references to specific commits; they are not branches and cannot receive new commits. This option is technically impossible in Git.

## References
- [AWS Prescriptive Guidance: Branches in a Gitflow strategy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/choosing-git-branch-approach/branches-in-a-gitflow-strategy.html)
