Lambda **别名**是指向函数版本的指针，别名支持**路由配置**，可在两个版本之间分割调用流量。您可以将 Lambda 别名指向两个函数版本，并配置路由到每个版本的流量百分比。将 `AdditionalVersionWeights` 设置为新版本的 `0.1` 会向其发送 10% 的调用，而 90% 继续流向主要版本。routingConfig 属性启用加权流量分割 — 例如，90% 的调用转到版本 2（主要 functionVersion），而 10% 转到版本 1（在 additionalVersionWeights 中指定）。

示例 CLI：
```bash
aws lambda update-alias \
  --function-name my-function \
  --name live \
  --function-version 1 \
  --routing-config AdditionalVersionWeights={"2"=0.1}
```

API Gateway 随后配置为调用别名 ARN（例如 `my-function:live`），Lambda 透明地执行加权分割。当您有 API Gateway 端点触发 Lambda 函数时，必须确保 API Gateway 配置为调用正确的 Lambda 别名，而不是 $LATEST 版本。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

### B. 使用加权路由的新 API Gateway 阶段
**API Gateway 阶段不支持 Lambda 版本之间的加权路由。** API Gateway 在阶段上提供 **canary 部署**（在阶段的当前部署和 canary 部署之间分割流量），但它没有跨阶段的"加权路由"功能，而问题中的机制 — 在两个 Lambda 版本之间分割 — 本质上是 Lambda 别名功能，而不是 API Gateway 阶段功能。

### D. Network Load Balancer 路由策略
NLB 不在 Lambda 函数前面（Lambda 不是 NLB 的有效目标；仅 Application Load Balancer 支持 Lambda 目标，即使 ALB 也不以请求的方式提供 Lambda 版本之间的加权路由）。NLB 在 L4 运行，对 Lambda 函数版本没有任何概念。

### E. Route 53 加权路由策略
Route 53 在 **端点（记录）**之间执行 DNS 级别的加权路由，而不是在 Lambda 函数版本之间。Lambda 版本无法通过 DNS 记录寻址，因此 Route 53 无法在同一函数的版本 1 和版本 2 之间分割调用流量。

## 参考资源
- [使用加权别名实现 Lambda Canary 部署](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html)
- [为 Lambda 函数创建别名](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-aliases.html)
- [AWS Lambda 支持流量转移（公告）](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2017/11/aws-lambda-supports-traffic-shifting-and-phased-deployments-with-aws-codedeploy/)
- [使用别名流量转移实现 AWS Lambda 函数的 Canary 部署](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/implementing-canary-deployments-of-aws-lambda-functions-with-alias-traffic-shifting/)

en.question: A developer is creating a video search application for a global company. The video files have an average size of 2.5 TB. The video storage system must provide instant access to the video files for the first 90 days. After the first 90 days, the video files can take more than 10 minutes to load. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Upload the video files to the Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) Standard storage class for the first 90 days. After 90 days, transition the video files to the EFS Standard-Infrequent Access (Standard- IA) storage class.
options.B: Upload the video files to Amazon S3. Use the S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage class for the first 90 days. After 90 days, transition the video file to the S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval storage class.
options.C: Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) to store the video files for the first 90 days. After 90 days, transition the video files to the Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage class.
options.D: Upload the video files to Amazon S3. Use the S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval storage class for the first 90 days. After 90 days, transition the video files to the S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval storage class.

en.explanation:
## Scenario Analysis

A global video search application stores 2.5 TB videos with two distinct access patterns:
- **First 90 days:** Instant access required (millisecond retrieval)
- **After 90 days:** Loading time over 10 minutes is acceptable (asynchronous retrieval is fine)

We need the **most cost-effective** S3 storage strategy meeting both requirements.

## Correct Answer: D

**Upload to S3, use S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval for 90 days, then transition to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.**

### Why D is correct

**S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval (first 90 days):** This class provides millisecond access (instant) at archive-tier pricing. [S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval](https://aws.amazon.com/s3/storage-classes/glacier/instant-retrieval/) "delivers the fastest access to archive storage, with the same throughput and milliseconds access as the S3 Standard and S3 Standard-IA storage classes" and saves "up to 68% on storage costs compared to using the S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage class". For large 2.5 TB video files that need instant access, this is far cheaper than S3 Standard or Standard-IA.

**S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval (after 90 days):** This class is "up to 10% lower cost (than S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval)" and offers retrieval "in minutes or free bulk retrievals in 5—12 hours" — which fits the ">10 minutes load time is acceptable" requirement. See [S3 Glacier storage classes](https://aws.amazon.com/s3/storage-classes/glacier/).

**Minimum duration alignment:** S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval has a 90-day minimum storage duration, so the lifecycle transition at day 90 incurs no early-deletion penalty. See [Glacier storage classes docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html).

### Why the other options are wrong

**A. EFS Standard → EFS Standard-IA:** EFS is a file system service designed for POSIX file access from EC2/Lambda, not for object-style video storage. EFS Standard ($0.30/GB-month) and EFS IA are dramatically more expensive than any S3 archive tier. EFS IA still provides immediate access (no 10+ minute retrieval), so it doesn't take advantage of the relaxed retrieval requirement to save money.

**B. S3 Glacier Deep Archive → S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval:** Deep Archive **violates the first requirement**: it has 12–48 hour retrieval times, not instant/millisecond access. The customer needs instant access for the first 90 days. Additionally, Deep Archive has a 180-day minimum storage duration, so leaving after 90 days would incur early-deletion penalties. Transitioning from a colder class (Deep Archive) to a warmer class (Flexible Retrieval) is also not a normal lifecycle pattern — lifecycle transitions go from warmer to colder.

**C. EBS → S3 Glacier Deep Archive:** EBS is block storage attached to a single EC2 instance (single-AZ), making it unsuitable for a global video search application and very expensive ($0.08–0.10/GB-month for gp3). It also doesn't natively integrate with S3 lifecycle rules — you'd have to manually copy data to S3. Deep Archive again violates the second requirement only marginally (>10 min is fine, but 12–48 hours is much longer than needed when Flexible Retrieval is cheaper for the access pattern described, and Deep Archive's 180-day minimum makes transitions less flexible).

### Sample S3 Lifecycle Configuration

```json
{
  "Rules": [{
    "ID": "VideoArchive",
    "Status": "Enabled",
    "Filter": {},
    "Transitions": [
      { "Days": 0,  "StorageClass": "GLACIER_IR" },
      { "Days": 90, "StorageClass": "GLACIER" }
    ]
  }]
}
```

Note: Objects can be uploaded directly to GLACIER_IR via PUT (no transition needed for day 0).

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在为一家全球性公司开发视频搜索应用程序。视频文件的平均大小为 2.5 TB。视频存储系统必须在前 90 天内提供视频文件的即时访问。90 天后，视频文件的加载时间可能超过 10 分钟。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 在前 90 天，将视频文件上传到 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 标准存储类。90 天后，将视频文件迁移到 EFS 标准-不频繁访问 (Standard-IA) 存储类。
options.B: 将视频文件上传到 Amazon S3。前 90 天使用 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 存储类。90 天后，将视频文件迁移到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 存储类。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 存储视频文件 90 天。90 天后，将视频文件迁移到 Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive 存储类别。
options.D: 将视频文件上传到 Amazon S3。前 90 天使用 S3 Glacier 即时检索存储类。90 天后，将视频文件迁移到 S3 Glacier 灵活检索存储类。

zh.explanation:
## 场景分析

一个全球视频搜索应用程序存储 2.5 TB 视频，具有两种不同的访问模式：
- **前 90 天：** 需要即时访问（毫秒级检索）
- **90 天后：** 加载时间超过 10 分钟可接受（异步检索可行）

我们需要满足两项要求的**最具成本效益的** S3 存储策略。

## 正确答案：D

**上传到 S3，前 90 天使用 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval，然后过渡到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。**

### 为什么 D 是正确的

**S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval（前 90 天）：** 该存储类提供毫秒级访问（即时），价格与归档层相同。[S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval](https://aws.amazon.com/s3/storage-classes/glacier/instant-retrieval/) "提供对归档存储的最快访问，与 S3 Standard 和 S3 Standard-IA 存储类具有相同的吞吐量和毫秒级访问"，相比 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 存储类"节省高达 68% 的存储成本"。对于需要即时访问的大型 2.5 TB 视频文件，这远比 S3 Standard 或 Standard-IA 便宜。

**S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval（90 天后）：** 该存储类的成本"比 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 低至 10%"，提供"分钟级检索或免费批量检索（5-12 小时）"——符合"加载时间 >10 分钟可接受"的要求。参见 [S3 Glacier 存储类](https://aws.amazon.com/s3/storage-classes/glacier/)。

**最低存储时长对齐：** S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 的最低存储时长为 90 天，因此在第 90 天进行生命周期过渡不会产生早期删除费用。参见 [Glacier 存储类文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)。

### 为什么其他选项是错误的

**A. EFS Standard → EFS Standard-IA：** EFS 是一个文件系统服务，设计用于从 EC2/Lambda 进行 POSIX 文件访问，而不是用于对象式视频存储。EFS Standard（$0.30/GB-月）和 EFS IA 的成本比任何 S3 归档层都要高得多。EFS IA 仍然提供即时访问（无 10+ 分钟检索），所以它无法利用放松的检索要求来节省成本。

**B. S3 Glacier Deep Archive → S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval：** Deep Archive **违反了第一个要求**：它的检索时间为 12-48 小时，而非即时/毫秒级访问。客户在前 90 天需要即时访问。此外，Deep Archive 的最低存储时长为 180 天，所以在 90 天后离开会产生早期删除费用。从更冷的存储类（Deep Archive）过渡到更温暖的存储类（Flexible Retrieval）也不是常见的生命周期模式——生命周期过渡应该从更温暖的类到更冷的类。

**C. EBS → S3 Glacier Deep Archive：** EBS 是连接到单个 EC2 实例的块存储（单可用区），不适合全球视频搜索应用程序，且成本非常高昂（gp3 为 $0.08-0.10/GB-月）。它也不能原生与 S3 生命周期规则集成——你必须手动将数据复制到 S3。Deep Archive 再次仅边际性地违反第二个要求（>10 分钟可以接受，但 12-48 小时远长于所需，而且当 Flexible Retrieval 对所述访问模式成本更低时，Deep Archive 的 180 天最低存储时长使过渡灵活性降低）。

### S3 生命周期配置示例

```json
{
  "Rules": [{
    "ID": "VideoArchive",
    "Status": "Enabled",
    "Filter": {},
    "Transitions": [
      { "Days": 0,  "StorageClass": "GLACIER_IR" },
      { "Days": 90, "StorageClass": "GLACIER" }
    ]
  }]
}
```

注意：对象可以通过 PUT 直接上传到 GLACIER_IR（第 0 天不需要过渡）。

en.question: A company has an ecommerce platform. A developer is designing an Amazon DynamoDB table to store customer order data for the platform. The table uses the order ID as the partition key. The developer needs to modify the table to get all order IDs that are associated with a given customer email address in a single query. The solution must give the developer the ability to query order IDs by other item attributes in the future. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the partition key to use the customer email address as the sort key.
options.B: Update the table to use the customer email address as the partition key.
options.C: Create a local secondary index (LSI) with the customer email address as the sort key.
options.D: Create a global secondary index (GSI) with the customer email address as the partition key.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A DynamoDB table stores customer orders with **order ID as the partition key**. The developer needs to:
1. Query all order IDs by **customer email address** in a single query.
2. Retain flexibility to support **future query patterns** on other attributes.

## Correct Answer: D — Create a GSI with customer email address as the partition key

A Global Secondary Index (GSI) is the right tool because a global secondary index is an index with a partition key and a sort key that can be different from those on the base table, and queries on the index can span all of the data in the base table across all partitions. By making `customerEmail` the GSI partition key, a single `Query` returns all orders for that email.

For future flexibility, you can create up to 20 global secondary indexes (default quota) and up to 5 local secondary indexes per table, and GSIs can be altered after the table has been created — you can add and delete them whenever you want. This means new access patterns can be supported later by simply adding more GSIs without re-creating the table.

This pattern is exactly the standard solution for "find orders by email" — see for example a table of users where partition key is uuid but you also want to find a user by email → add GSI with partition key email.

## Why the other options are wrong

**A. Configure the partition key to use the customer email address as the sort key.**
- A table's primary key cannot be redefined after creation. Even if it could, adding a sort key still requires the partition key (orderID) to be supplied in every Query — you couldn't query by email alone without a Scan. Also, primary key schema changes on an existing table are not supported by DynamoDB.

**B. Update the table to use the customer email address as the partition key.**
- DynamoDB does not allow changing the primary key of an existing table — you would have to create a new table and migrate data. It also breaks the existing fast lookup by order ID and forces all orders for one customer onto a single partition (hot partition risk). It also doesn't address the requirement to support **future** queries on other attributes.

**C. Create a Local Secondary Index (LSI) with the customer email address as the sort key.**
- A local secondary index has the same partition key as the base table, but a different sort key. The base table's partition key is `orderID`, so an LSI would still require specifying an order ID in the query — you cannot query "all orders for an email" without scanning. Additionally, LSIs have to be specified at table creation - you can't add or remove them after provisioning the table, which contradicts the requirement to add new query patterns later.

## Reference

```text
Base table:  PK = orderId
GSI:         PK = customerEmail   (optionally SK = orderId or createdAt)
Query GSI:   KeyConditionExpression = "customerEmail = :email"
```

- [Using Global Secondary Indexes in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GSI.html)
- [Improving data access with secondary indexes in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/SecondaryIndexes.html)
- [General guidelines for secondary indexes in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-indexes-general.html)

zh.question: 一家公司拥有一个电子商务平台。一位开发人员正在设计一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表来存储该平台的客户订单数据。该表使用订单 ID 作为分区键。开发人员需要修改该表，以便通过一次查询获取与给定客户电子邮件地址关联的所有订单 ID。此外，该解决方案还必须允许开发人员将来能够根据其他商品属性查询订单 ID。哪个解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置分区键，使用客户电子邮件地址作为排序键。
options.B: 更新表，使用客户电子邮件地址作为分区键。
options.C: 创建一个以客户电子邮件地址为排序键的本地二级索引（LSI）。
options.D: 创建一个全局二级索引 (GSI)，以客户电子邮件地址作为分区键。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一个 DynamoDB 表存储客户订单，**订单 ID 为分区键**。开发人员需要：
1. 通过**客户电子邮件地址**在单次查询中查询所有订单 ID。
2. 保持灵活性以支持**未来的查询模式**，涉及其他属性。

## 正确答案：D — 创建一个 GSI，将客户电子邮件地址作为分区键

Global Secondary Index (GSI) 是正确的工具，因为全局二级索引是具有分区键和排序键的索引，这些键可以与基表上的不同，对索引的查询可以跨越基表中的所有数据和所有分区。通过将 `customerEmail` 设为 GSI 分区键，单次 `Query` 即可返回该电子邮件对应的所有订单。

为了获得未来的灵活性，你可以为每个表创建最多 20 个全局二级索引（默认配额）和最多 5 个本地二级索引，并且可以在表创建后修改 GSI — 你可以随时添加和删除它们。这意味着新的访问模式可以通过简单地添加更多 GSI 在以后得到支持，而无需重新创建表。

这种模式正是"按电子邮件查找订单"的标准解决方案 — 例如见用户表，其中分区键是 uuid，但你还想按电子邮件查找用户 → 添加分区键为 email 的 GSI。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**A. 将客户电子邮件地址配置为分区键的排序键。**
- 表的主键在创建后无法重新定义。即使可以，添加排序键仍然需要在每次 Query 中提供分区键 (orderID) — 你无法仅通过电子邮件进行查询而不使用 Scan。此外，DynamoDB 不支持对现有表的主键架构进行更改。

**B. 更新表以使用客户电子邮件地址作为分区键。**
- DynamoDB 不允许更改现有表的主键 — 你必须创建新表并迁移数据。这也破坏了按订单 ID 进行的现有快速查询，并将一个客户的所有订单强制放在单个分区上（热分区风险）。它也不能解决支持**未来**在其他属性上进行查询的需求。

**C. 创建一个 Local Secondary Index (LSI)，将客户电子邮件地址作为排序键。**
- 本地二级索引与基表具有相同的分区键，但排序键不同。基表的分区键是 `orderID`，因此 LSI 仍然需要在查询中指定订单 ID — 你无法在不扫描的情况下查询"某个电子邮件的所有订单"。此外，LSI 必须在表创建时指定 - 在配置表后无法添加或删除它们，这与添加新查询模式的需求相矛盾。

## 参考资料

```text
基表：   PK = orderId
GSI：    PK = customerEmail   (可选 SK = orderId 或 createdAt)
查询 GSI：KeyConditionExpression = "customerEmail = :email"
```

- [在 DynamoDB 中使用全局二级索引](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GSI.html)
- [使用二级索引改进 DynamoDB 中的数据访问](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/SecondaryIndexes.html)
- [DynamoDB 中二级索引的一般指南](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-indexes-general.html)

en.question: A company has a virtual reality (VR) game. The game has a serverless backend that consists of Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, and Amazon DynamoDB. Recently, the company noticed a sudden increase of new users globally. The company also noticed delays in the retrieval of user data. Which AWS service or feature can the company use to reduce the database response time to microseconds?

options.A: Amazon ElastiCache
options.B: DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)
options.C: DynamoDB auto scaling
options.D: Amazon CloudFront

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A serverless VR game uses **API Gateway + Lambda + DynamoDB**. After a global surge of new users, the company observes delays when retrieving user data from DynamoDB. They need to reduce **database** response time to **microseconds**.

## Correct Answer: B — DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)

DAX is purpose-built as an in-memory cache **for DynamoDB**. As an in-memory cache, DAX reduces the response times of eventually consistent read workloads by an order of magnitude from single-digit milliseconds to microseconds. It is API-compatible with DynamoDB, so adding it to an existing Lambda backend requires only minimal code changes (point the SDK at the DAX cluster endpoint). Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) is a fully managed, highly available caching service built for Amazon DynamoDB. DAX delivers up to a 10 times performance improvement—from milliseconds to microseconds—even at millions of requests per second. DAX does all the heavy lifting required to add in-memory acceleration to your DynamoDB tables, without requiring developers to manage cache invalidation, data population, or cluster management.

This perfectly matches the question's wording — "reduce the database response time to microseconds."

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. Amazon ElastiCache** — ElastiCache (Redis/Memcached) is a general-purpose cache that delivers **sub-millisecond** latency, not microseconds, and it is **not API-compatible with DynamoDB**. You would need to rewrite application code to manage cache population, invalidation, and the dual-write pattern. The question specifically asks for microsecond latency, which is DAX's distinguishing characteristic.

- **C. DynamoDB auto scaling** — Auto scaling adjusts provisioned **read/write capacity units** based on traffic patterns. It prevents throttling under high load but does not change the underlying response latency of DynamoDB, which remains in **single-digit milliseconds**. It cannot achieve microsecond response times.

- **D. Amazon CloudFront** — CloudFront is a CDN that caches **HTTP/web content** at edge locations. It does not cache DynamoDB item-level reads from Lambda functions (which talk to DynamoDB via the AWS SDK over the AWS network, not via HTTP origins fronted by CloudFront). It cannot reduce DynamoDB query latency to microseconds.

## References

- [In-memory acceleration with DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)
- [Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) product page](https://aws.amazon.com/dynamodbaccelerator/)

zh.question: 一家公司开发了一款虚拟现实 (VR) 游戏。该游戏采用无服务器后端，由 Amazon API Gateway、AWS Lambda 和 Amazon DynamoDB 组成。最近，该公司注意到全球新用户数量突然激增。同时，该公司也发现用户数据检索存在延迟。该公司可以使用哪项 AWS 服务或功能将数据库响应时间缩短至微秒级？

options.A: Amazon ElastiCache
options.B: DynamoDB 加速器 (DAX)
options.C: DynamoDB 自动扩缩容
options.D: 亚马逊云前沿

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一款无服务器 VR 游戏使用 **API Gateway + Lambda + DynamoDB**。在全球新用户激增后，公司观察到从 DynamoDB 检索用户数据时出现延迟。他们需要将**数据库**响应时间降低到**微秒**级别。

## 正确答案：B — DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)

DAX 是专为 **DynamoDB** 构建的内存缓存。作为一种内存缓存，DAX 将最终一致性读取工作负载的响应时间减少了一个数量级，从单位数毫秒减少到微秒。它与 DynamoDB API 兼容，因此将其添加到现有 Lambda 后端只需进行最少的代码更改（将 SDK 指向 DAX 集群端点）。Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 是为 Amazon DynamoDB 构建的完全托管、高可用性缓存服务。DAX 可提供高达 10 倍的性能改进——从毫秒到微秒——即使在每秒数百万个请求时也是如此。DAX 完成了为 DynamoDB 表添加内存加速所需的所有繁重工作，无需开发人员管理缓存失效、数据填充或集群管理。

这完全符合问题的措辞——"将数据库响应时间降低到微秒"。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. Amazon ElastiCache** — ElastiCache（Redis/Memcached）是一个通用缓存，提供**亚毫秒级**延迟，而非微秒级，且它与 DynamoDB **不兼容 API**。您需要重写应用程序代码来管理缓存填充、失效和双写模式。问题具体要求微秒级延迟，这是 DAX 的显著特点。

- **C. DynamoDB 自动扩展** — 自动扩展根据流量模式调整预配的**读/写容量单位**。它可以防止高负载下的限流，但不会改变 DynamoDB 底层响应延迟，该延迟仍为**单位数毫秒**。它无法实现微秒级响应时间。

- **D. Amazon CloudFront** — CloudFront 是一个 CDN，在边缘位置缓存**HTTP/网络内容**。它不缓存 Lambda 函数的 DynamoDB 项级读取（Lambda 函数通过 AWS SDK 经由 AWS 网络与 DynamoDB 通信，而非通过 CloudFront 前置的 HTTP 源）。它无法将 DynamoDB 查询延迟降低到微秒级。

## 参考资源

- [使用 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 进行内存加速](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)
- [Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 产品页面](https://aws.amazon.com/dynamodbaccelerator/)

en.question: A developer is creating a solution to track an account's Amazon S3 buckets over time. The developer has created an AWS Lambda function that will run on a schedule. The function will list the account's S3 buckets and will store the list in an Amazon DynamoDB table. The developer receives a permissions error when the developer runs the function with the AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole AWS managed policy. Which combination of permissions should the developer use to resolve this error? (Choose two.)

options.A: Cross-account IAM role
options.B: Permission for the Lambda function to list buckets in Amazon S3
options.C: Permission for the Lambda function to write in DynamoDB
options.D: Permission for Amazon S3 to invoke the Lambda function
options.E: Permission for DynamoDB to invoke the Lambda function

en.explanation:
# Tracking S3 Buckets via Scheduled Lambda — Required Permissions

## Scenario
A Lambda function runs on a schedule, calls `s3:ListAllMyBuckets`, and writes results to a DynamoDB table. The function's execution role only has the `AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole` AWS managed policy. The developer is getting permission errors.

## Why the error happens
The AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole managed policy provides write permissions to CloudWatch Logs — and only that. Specifically, it grants `logs:CreateLogGroup`, `logs:CreateLogStream`, and `logs:PutLogEvents`. It does **not** grant any S3 or DynamoDB permissions.

Therefore, to make the Lambda function work, the execution role must be augmented with permissions to:
1. List S3 buckets (e.g., `s3:ListAllMyBuckets`)
2. Write items to DynamoDB (e.g., `dynamodb:PutItem` / `dynamodb:BatchWriteItem`)

## Correct Answers: **B and C**

- **B. Permission for the Lambda function to list buckets in Amazon S3** ✅
  Required so the function can call `ListBuckets` (`s3:ListAllMyBuckets`).
- **C. Permission for the Lambda function to write in DynamoDB** ✅
  Required so the function can persist the bucket list (e.g., `dynamodb:PutItem`).

Example inline policy to attach to the Lambda execution role:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "s3:ListAllMyBuckets",
      "Resource": "*"
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["dynamodb:PutItem", "dynamodb:BatchWriteItem"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:dynamodb:REGION:ACCOUNT_ID:table/TABLE_NAME"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. Cross-account IAM role** — The scenario involves a single account ("tracking an account's S3 buckets"). No cross-account access is required, so assuming a role in another account is irrelevant to the permission error.
- **D. Permission for Amazon S3 to invoke the Lambda function** — This describes a resource-based policy/permission allowing S3 to trigger Lambda (e.g., S3 event notifications). The function is invoked on a **schedule** (e.g., EventBridge), not by S3, so this is not needed and would not resolve the error.
- **E. Permission for DynamoDB to invoke the Lambda function** — DynamoDB does not invoke Lambda directly; only DynamoDB Streams via an event source mapping would, and that is not the flow here. The Lambda calls DynamoDB, not the other way around.

## Key takeaway
If your Lambda function needs additional permissions to perform tasks such as updating entries in an Amazon DynamoDB database, you can create a custom execution role with the necessary permissions. The basic execution role only covers CloudWatch Logs; any access to S3, DynamoDB, or other services must be added explicitly.

## References
- [AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole - AWS Managed Policy Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-managed-policy/latest/reference/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole.html)
- [Defining Lambda function permissions with an execution role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-intro-execution-role.html)
- [Working with AWS managed policies in the execution role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/permissions-managed-policies.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在创建一个解决方案，用于跟踪账户的 Amazon S3 存储桶随时间的变化。该开发人员创建了一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数将按计划运行。该函数会列出账户的 S3 存储桶，并将列表存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。当开发人员使用 AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole AWS 托管策略运行该函数时，会收到权限错误。开发人员应该使用哪两种权限组合来解决此错误？（选择两项。）

options.A: 跨账户 IAM 角色
options.B: 允许 Lambda 函数列出 Amazon S3 中的存储桶
options.C: 授予 Lambda 函数写入 DynamoDB 的权限
options.D: 允许 Amazon S3 调用 Lambda 函数
options.E: 允许 DynamoDB 调用 Lambda 函数

zh.explanation:
# 通过定时 Lambda 追踪 S3 Bucket — 所需权限

## 场景
一个 Lambda 函数按计划运行，调用 `s3:ListAllMyBuckets`，并将结果写入 DynamoDB 表。该函数的执行角色只有 `AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole` AWS 托管策略。开发者收到权限错误。

## 错误发生的原因
AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole 托管策略仅提供 CloudWatch Logs 的写入权限 — 仅此而已。具体来说，它授予 `logs:CreateLogGroup`、`logs:CreateLogStream` 和 `logs:PutLogEvents`。它**不**授予任何 S3 或 DynamoDB 权限。

因此，为了使 Lambda 函数工作，执行角色必须增加以下权限：
1. 列出 S3 bucket（例如，`s3:ListAllMyBuckets`）
2. 写入 DynamoDB 项（例如，`dynamodb:PutItem` / `dynamodb:BatchWriteItem`）

## 正确答案：**B 和 C**

- **B. Lambda 函数在 Amazon S3 中列出 bucket 的权限** ✅
  需要此权限才能调用 `ListBuckets`（`s3:ListAllMyBuckets`）。
- **C. Lambda 函数在 DynamoDB 中写入的权限** ✅
  需要此权限才能持久化 bucket 列表（例如，`dynamodb:PutItem`）。

要附加到 Lambda 执行角色的内联策略示例：

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "s3:ListAllMyBuckets",
      "Resource": "*"
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["dynamodb:PutItem", "dynamodb:BatchWriteItem"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:dynamodb:REGION:ACCOUNT_ID:table/TABLE_NAME"
    }
  ]
}
```

## 其他选项为何错误

- **A. 跨账户 IAM 角色** — 此场景涉及单个账户（"追踪账户的 S3 bucket"）。不需要跨账户访问，因此假设另一个账户中的角色与权限错误无关。
- **D. Amazon S3 调用 Lambda 函数的权限** — 这描述的是允许 S3 触发 Lambda 的基于资源的策略/权限（例如，S3 事件通知）。该函数按**计划**调用（例如，EventBridge），而不是由 S3 调用，因此不需要此权限，也不会解决错误。
- **E. DynamoDB 调用 Lambda 函数的权限** — DynamoDB 不直接调用 Lambda；只有 DynamoDB Streams 通过事件源映射才会调用，但这不是此处的流程。Lambda 调用 DynamoDB，而不是相反。

## 关键要点
如果您的 Lambda 函数需要额外的权限来执行任务（例如更新 Amazon DynamoDB 数据库中的条目），您可以创建具有必要权限的自定义执行角色。基本执行角色仅涵盖 CloudWatch Logs；对 S3、DynamoDB 或其他服务的任何访问都必须显式添加。

## 参考资料
- [AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole - AWS 托管策略参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-managed-policy/latest/reference/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole.html)
- [使用执行角色定义 Lambda 函数权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-intro-execution-role.html)
- [在执行角色中使用 AWS 托管策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/permissions-managed-policies.html)

en.question: A company uses AWS to run its learning management system (LMS) application. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The application's domain name is managed in Amazon Route 53. The application is deployed in a single AWS Region, but the company wants to improve application performance for users all over the world. Which solution will improve global performance with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses the ALB as the origin server. Configure Route 53 to create a DNS alias record that points the application's domain name to the CloudFront distribution URL.
options.B: Launch more EC2 instances behind the ALConfigure the ALB to use session affinity (sticky sessions). Create a Route 53 alias record for the ALB by using a geolocation routing policy.
options.C: Create an AWS Client VPN endpoint in the VPInstruct users to connect to the VPN to access the application. Create a Route 53 alias record for the VPN endpoint. Configure Route 53 to use a geolocation routing policy.
options.D: Deploy the application to multiple Regions across the world. Create a Route 53 alias record for the ALB by using a latency-based routing policy.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A single-Region LMS application runs on EC2 behind an ALB, with DNS managed in Route 53. The company wants to **improve global performance** for users worldwide while incurring the **least operational overhead**. The application architecture should not need to be redesigned or duplicated.

## Correct Answer: A

**Set up a CloudFront distribution with the ALB as the origin and create a Route 53 alias record pointing to the CloudFront distribution.**

CloudFront is AWS's global content delivery network with 300+ edge locations worldwide. CloudFront acts as the global entry point through its distributed edge locations and automatically selects the locations closest to users to minimize latency and maximize availability.

Even for **dynamic** application content (like an LMS), CloudFront accelerates delivery because static assets are delivered from the CloudFront edge cache, dramatically reducing Time-To-First-Byte (TTFB), while dynamic content benefits from CloudFront persistent TCP connections that reuse existing TCP upstream connections to your origin server across multiple user requests, rather than establishing new connections for each request. This eliminates redundant TCP/TLS handshakes between the global user and the single-Region origin.

Pointing Route 53 at the distribution is straightforward: Alias records let you point the zone apex or subdomains at AWS resources like CloudFront or an Application Load Balancer without managing IPs.

This approach requires **no application changes, no multi-Region replication, and no client-side software**, satisfying the "least operational overhead" requirement.

References:
- [Optimizing application performance: CloudFront with ALB](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/networking-and-content-delivery/optimizing-application-performance-the-strategic-benefits-of-combining-amazon-cloudfront-with-application-load-balancers/)
- [Use various origins with CloudFront distributions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistS3AndCustomOrigins.html)
- [Routing traffic to a CloudFront distribution by using your domain name](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-cloudfront-distribution.html)

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

### B. More EC2 instances + sticky sessions + geolocation routing
- Adding more EC2 instances and sticky sessions only scales **within the single Region** — it does nothing to reduce the network latency for users far away from that Region.
- Geolocation routing returns answers based on the user's country/continent, but if there is only **one Region** to route to, all users still hit the same Regional ALB. There's no performance improvement for users far from that Region.
- Sticky sessions actually reduce flexibility and are unrelated to the global-performance objective.

### C. AWS Client VPN endpoint
- Client VPN is intended to give remote users **private** network access to a VPC; it is not a content-acceleration service.
- Forcing every global user to install and connect through a VPN client adds **enormous operational overhead** (client deployment, certificate management, user training) and would actually **hurt** performance because traffic would still tunnel back to the single VPC over the public Internet.

### D. Deploy the application to multiple Regions with latency-based routing
- This would improve latency, but multi-Region deployment introduces substantial operational overhead: replicating EC2/ALB stacks, syncing application state and databases across Regions, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and cost. The question explicitly demands the **LEAST operational overhead**, so this is not the best fit.
- CloudFront in front of the existing single-Region ALB achieves global acceleration without any of that complexity.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS 运行其学习管理系统 (LMS) 应用程序。该应用程序运行在应用程序负载均衡器 (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上。应用程序的域名由 Amazon Route 53 管理。该应用程序部署在单个 AWS 区域中，但该公司希望提高全球用户的应用程序性能。哪种解决方案能够在最大限度减少运维开销的情况下提高全球性能？

options.A: 设置一个使用 ALB 作为源服务器的 Amazon CloudFront 分发。配置 Route 53 以创建一个 DNS 别名记录，将应用程序的域名指向 CloudFront 分发 URL。
options.B: 在 ALB 后启动更多 EC2 实例。配置 ALB 以使用会话亲和性（粘性会话）。使用地理位置路由策略为 ALB 创建 Route 53 别名记录。
options.C: 在 VP 中创建 AWS 客户端 VPN 端点，并指示用户连接到该 VPN 以访问应用程序。为该 VPN 端点创建 Route 53 别名记录。配置 Route 53 以使用地理位置路由策略。
options.D: 将应用程序部署到世界各地的多个区域。使用基于延迟的路由策略为 ALB 创建 Route 53 别名记录。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一个单区域 LMS 应用运行在 EC2 上，位于 ALB 后面，DNS 在 Route 53 中管理。公司希望**改善全球用户的性能**，同时**降低运维开销**。应用架构不需要重新设计或复制。

## 正确答案：A

**使用 ALB 作为源设置 CloudFront 分发，并创建指向 CloudFront 分发的 Route 53 别名记录。**

CloudFront 是 AWS 的全球内容分发网络，在全球拥有 300 多个边缘站点。CloudFront 通过分布式边缘站点充当全球入口点，自动选择最靠近用户的位置以最小化延迟并最大化可用性。

即使对于**动态**应用内容（如 LMS），CloudFront 也可以加快交付速度，因为静态资产从 CloudFront 边缘缓存交付，大幅减少首字节时间 (TTFB)，而动态内容受益于 CloudFront 持久 TCP 连接，可在多个用户请求中重用现有 TCP 上游连接到源服务器，而不是为每个请求建立新连接。这消除了全球用户与单区域源之间冗余的 TCP/TLS 握手。

在 Route 53 中指向分发很简单：别名记录允许您将区域顶点或子域指向 CloudFront 或应用负载均衡器等 AWS 资源，而无需管理 IP 地址。

这种方法**无需应用更改、无需多区域复制和无需客户端软件**，满足"最少运维开销"的要求。

参考资源：
- [优化应用性能：CloudFront 与 ALB 的结合](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/networking-and-content-delivery/optimizing-application-performance-the-strategic-benefits-of-combining-amazon-cloudfront-with-application-load-balancers/)
- [在 CloudFront 分发中使用各种源](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistS3AndCustomOrigins.html)
- [使用您的域名将流量路由到 CloudFront 分发](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-cloudfront-distribution.html)

## 其他选项为什么错误

### B. 更多 EC2 实例 + 粘性会话 + 地理位置路由
- 添加更多 EC2 实例和粘性会话仅在**单个区域内**扩展——对于远离该区域的用户的网络延迟没有任何影响。
- 地理位置路由根据用户的国家/地区返回答案，但如果只有**一个区域**可以路由到，所有用户仍然会访问同一个区域 ALB。对于远离该区域的用户没有性能改进。
- 粘性会话实际上降低了灵活性，与全球性能目标无关。

### C. AWS Client VPN 端点
- Client VPN 的目的是为远程用户提供对 VPC 的**私有**网络访问；它不是内容加速服务。
- 强制每个全球用户安装和连接通过 VPN 客户端会增加**巨大的运维开销**（客户端部署、证书管理、用户培训），并且实际上会**损害**性能，因为流量仍然会通过公网隧道回到单个 VPC。

### D. 将应用部署到多个区域并使用基于延迟的路由
- 这会改善延迟，但多区域部署引入了大量运维开销：复制 EC2/ALB 堆栈、跨区域同步应用状态和数据库、部署管道、监控和成本。问题明确要求**最少运维开销**，因此这不是最佳选项。
- CloudFront 放在现有单区域 ALB 前面可以实现全球加速，而无需任何复杂性。

en.question: A developer hosts a static website on Amazon S3 and connects the website to an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The website uses a custom domain name that points to the CloudFront URL. The developer has set up a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline. The pipeline automatically runs when changes occur in an AWS CodeCommit repository. The pipeline has a source stage and then a build stage. The build stage invokes an AWS CodeBuild project that references a buildspec.yml file. The buildspec.yml file builds the code and deploys the static files to the S3 bucket. The pipeline runs successfully, and the latest website files are visible in the S3 bucket and at the S3 website URL. However, when the developer accesses the website through the CloudFront domain, the updates are not reflected on the website. What should the developer configure the buildspec.yml file to do to resolve this issue?

options.A: Properly synchronize the objects in the S3 bucket with new files from the source stage.
options.B: Delete the previous website files in the S3 bucket and redeploy the website files.
options.C: Invalidate the file caches for the primary CloudFront distribution.
options.D: Modify the cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) policy of the S3 bucket and redeploy the website files.

en.explanation:
# CloudFront Cache Invalidation in CI/CD Pipeline

## Scenario
A developer has a CI/CD pipeline (CodeCommit → CodeBuild) that deploys static files to an S3 bucket which is fronted by a CloudFront distribution with a custom domain. After a successful pipeline run, the S3 bucket and S3 website URL show the latest files, but the CloudFront-served website still shows old content.

## Why This Happens
When you use Amazon S3 to store files and Amazon CloudFront to deliver them, CloudFront stores copies of your files in "Edge Locations" around the world. CloudFront will keep that copy until it expires (often 24 hours or more). If you upload a new version of a webpage to S3, CloudFront won't know it changed. Invalidation tells CloudFront to delete its cached copies and fetch the brand-new version from S3 immediately.

This is the classic "stale cache" problem: if you've updated your website, but you are still seeing stale content when visiting your CloudFront powered website, one likely reason is that CloudFront is still serving up cached content.

## Correct Answer: C — Invalidate the file caches for the primary CloudFront distribution

CloudFront invalidation requests are a way to force CloudFront to expire content. Invalidation requests aren't immediate. It takes several minutes from the time you submit one to the time that CloudFront actually expires the content.

The fix is to add an invalidation step to the `buildspec.yml` after the S3 sync. A typical post_build command:

```yaml
version: 0.2
phases:
  build:
    commands:
      - aws s3 sync ./build s3://my-bucket --delete
  post_build:
    commands:
      - aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E1234567890 --paths "/*"
```

The CodeBuild service role needs `cloudfront:CreateInvalidation` permission on the distribution.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Properly synchronize the objects in the S3 bucket** — The question states the pipeline succeeds and "the latest website files are visible in the S3 bucket and at the S3 website URL." S3 sync is already working correctly; the issue is downstream at the CloudFront edge cache, not S3.

- **B. Delete the previous website files in the S3 bucket and redeploy** — Same reason as A: the S3 bucket already contains the new files (verified via the S3 website URL). Deleting and redeploying would not change what CloudFront has cached at edge locations. The cache TTL still applies regardless of how files reach S3.

- **D. Modify the CORS policy of the S3 bucket** — CORS controls cross-origin browser requests (e.g., a browser loading resources from a different domain). It has no effect on CloudFront's edge caching behavior. Stale content being served by CloudFront is unrelated to CORS.

## References
- [Hosting Static Websites on AWS – Controlling how long S3 content is cached by CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/build-static-websites-aws/controlling-how-long-amazon-s3-content-is-cached-by-amazon-cloudfront.html)
- [AWS CLI: cloudfront create-invalidation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/reference/cloudfront/create-invalidation.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员在 Amazon S3 上托管了一个静态网站，并将该网站连接到 Amazon CloudFront 分发。该网站使用指向 CloudFront URL 的自定义域名。开发人员已设置持续集成和持续交付 (CI/CD) 流水线。当 AWS CodeCommit 存储库发生更改时，该流水线会自动运行。该流水线包含源代码阶段和构建阶段。构建阶段会调用一个引用 buildspec.yml 文件的 AWS CodeBuild 项目。buildspec.yml 文件用于构建代码并将静态文件部署到 S3 存储桶。流水线运行成功，最新的网站文件在 S3 存储桶和 S3 网站 URL 上可见。但是，当开发人员通过 CloudFront 域名访问该网站时，网站上并未反映这些更新。开发人员应该如何配置 buildspec.yml 文件才能解决此问题？

options.A: 将 S3 存储桶中的对象与源阶段的新文件正确同步。
options.B: 删除 S3 存储桶中的先前网站文件，然后重新部署网站文件。
options.C: 使主 CloudFront 分发的文件缓存失效。
options.D: 修改 S3 存储桶的跨域资源共享 (CORS) 策略并重新部署网站文件。

zh.explanation:
# CloudFront 缓存失效在 CI/CD 管道中

## 场景
开发者拥有一个 CI/CD 管道（CodeCommit → CodeBuild），将静态文件部署到由 CloudFront 分配（具有自定义域）前置的 S3 存储桶。管道成功运行后，S3 存储桶和 S3 网站 URL 显示最新文件，但 CloudFront 提供的网站仍显示旧内容。

## 为什么会发生这种情况
当你使用 Amazon S3 存储文件并使用 Amazon CloudFront 提供它们时，CloudFront 在世界各地的"边缘位置"存储文件的副本。CloudFront 会保留该副本直到过期（通常 24 小时或更长时间）。如果你将网页的新版本上传到 S3，CloudFront 不会知道它已更改。失效会告诉 CloudFront 删除其缓存副本并立即从 S3 获取全新版本。

这是经典的"过时缓存"问题：如果你已更新网站，但访问 CloudFront 提供的网站时仍然看到过时内容，一个可能的原因是 CloudFront 仍在提供缓存内容。

## 正确答案：C — 使主 CloudFront 分配的文件缓存失效

CloudFront 失效请求是强制 CloudFront 过期内容的一种方法。失效请求不是即时的。从提交请求到 CloudFront 实际过期内容需要几分钟。

解决方案是在 S3 同步之后向 `buildspec.yml` 添加失效步骤。一个典型的 post_build 命令：

```yaml
version: 0.2
phases:
  build:
    commands:
      - aws s3 sync ./build s3://my-bucket --delete
  post_build:
    commands:
      - aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E1234567890 --paths "/*"
```

CodeBuild 服务角色需要对分配的 `cloudfront:CreateInvalidation` 权限。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. 正确同步 S3 存储桶中的对象** — 问题陈述管道成功，且"最新网站文件在 S3 存储桶和 S3 网站 URL 中可见"。S3 同步已正常工作；问题在于下游的 CloudFront 边缘缓存，而非 S3。

- **B. 删除 S3 存储桶中的旧网站文件并重新部署** — 与 A 相同的原因：S3 存储桶已包含新文件（通过 S3 网站 URL 验证）。删除并重新部署不会更改 CloudFront 在边缘位置缓存的内容。无论文件如何到达 S3，缓存 TTL 仍然适用。

- **D. 修改 S3 存储桶的 CORS 策略** — CORS 控制跨域浏览器请求（例如，浏览器从不同域加载资源）。它对 CloudFront 的边缘缓存行为没有影响。由 CloudFront 提供的过时内容与 CORS 无关。

## 参考资源
- [在 AWS 上托管静态网站 – 控制 CloudFront 缓存 S3 内容的时长](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/build-static-websites-aws/controlling-how-long-amazon-s3-content-is-cached-by-amazon-cloudfront.html)
- [AWS CLI: cloudfront create-invalidation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/reference/cloudfront/create-invalidation.html)

en.question: A developer is working on an ecommerce application that stores data in an Amazon RDS for MySQL cluster. The developer needs to implement a caching layer for the application to retrieve information about the most viewed products. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Edit the RDS for MySQL cluster by adding a cache node. Configure the cache endpoint instead of the cluster endpoint in the application.
options.B: Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster. Update the application code to use the ElastiCache for Redis cluster endpoint.
options.C: Create an Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster in front of the RDS for MySQL cluster. Configure the application to connect to the DAX endpoint instead of the RDS endpoint.
options.D: Configure the RDS for MySQL cluster to add a standby instance in a different Availability Zone. Configure the application to read the data from the standby instance.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The developer has an ecommerce app backed by an **Amazon RDS for MySQL** cluster and needs to add a **caching layer** to quickly serve "most viewed products" data. The goal is to reduce repetitive read load on the relational database and provide low‑latency responses for hot items.

## Correct Answer: B — Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster

Amazon ElastiCache for Redis is the AWS-managed, in-memory key/value cache designed for exactly this use case: caching frequently accessed query results in front of an RDS database. When you implement ElastiCache, a caching solution, over a relational database such as Oracle, SQL Server, or Amazon RDS for MySQL, you can improve performance of your applications and reduce costs — saving up to 55% in cost and gaining up to 80x faster read performance using ElastiCache with RDS for MySQL versus RDS for MySQL alone.

The typical pattern is **cache-aside (lazy loading)**: the application first checks ElastiCache for the cached "most viewed products" key; on a miss it queries RDS for MySQL and populates the cache for subsequent requests. You can manually implement query caching by using ElastiCache as a separate caching layer in front of your database services: set up an ElastiCache cluster (using Redis or Memcached) to act as a cache, modify your application code to check the cache before querying the database, and if the data is found in the cache, retrieve it directly from ElastiCache and avoid the database query.

Redis also provides rich data structures (sorted sets, hashes, lists) which are ideal for ranking-style data like "most viewed products."

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. Add a "cache node" to the RDS for MySQL cluster** — RDS for MySQL has **no concept of an integrated cache node** or a cache endpoint. You cannot edit an RDS cluster to add an in-memory cache node; caching requires a separate service like ElastiCache. While the RDS console can *launch* an ElastiCache cluster alongside RDS, it is still a separate ElastiCache cluster, not a node inside RDS. The ability to create and attach an Amazon ElastiCache cluster and attach it to your relational database is supported for all Amazon RDS and Amazon Aurora database engines — note it is an *ElastiCache* cluster, not a built-in RDS feature.

- **C. DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) in front of RDS for MySQL** — DAX is a **write-through cache exclusively for Amazon DynamoDB**. It uses the DynamoDB API and cannot front a relational database such as RDS for MySQL.

- **D. Add a Multi-AZ standby and read from it** — In Amazon RDS Multi-AZ, the **standby instance is not readable**; it exists for failover/HA only. To offload reads you would need read replicas, and even then this provides another database instance — not an in-memory cache, so it would not deliver the sub-millisecond latency or the database load reduction that a true caching layer provides.

## Reference

- [Optimize cost and boost performance of RDS for MySQL using Amazon ElastiCache for Redis (AWS Database Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/optimize-cost-and-boost-performance-of-rds-for-mysql-using-amazon-elasticache-for-redis/)
- [Creating an Amazon ElastiCache cache using Amazon RDS DB instance settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/creating-elasticache-cluster-with-RDS-settings.html)
- [Add an Amazon ElastiCache cache to Amazon RDS databases in the RDS console](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2023/04/amazon-elasticache-cache-rds-databases-console/)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在开发一个电子商务应用程序，该应用程序将数据存储在 Amazon RDS for MySQL 集群中。开发人员需要为该应用程序实现一个缓存层，以便检索有关浏览量最高产品的信息。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 通过添加缓存节点来编辑 RDS for MySQL 集群。在应用程序中配置缓存端点，而不是集群端点。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 集群。更新应用程序代码以使用 ElastiCache for Redis 集群端点。
options.C: 在 RDS for MySQL 集群前面创建一个 Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 集群。配置应用程序连接到 DAX 端点而不是 RDS 端点。
options.D: 配置 RDS for MySQL 集群，在不同的可用区中添加备用实例。配置应用程序从备用实例读取数据。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

开发人员有一个由 **Amazon RDS for MySQL** 集群支持的电子商务应用，需要添加**缓存层**以快速提供"最受欢迎产品"数据。目标是减少关系数据库的重复读取负载，并为热门项目提供低延迟响应。

## 正确答案：B — 创建 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 集群

Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 是 AWS 托管的内存键值缓存，专为此类使用场景而设计：在 RDS 数据库前缓存频繁访问的查询结果。当在关系数据库（如 Oracle、SQL Server 或 Amazon RDS for MySQL）上实施缓存解决方案 ElastiCache 时，您可以改善应用程序性能并降低成本——与仅使用 RDS for MySQL 相比，使用 ElastiCache 与 RDS for MySQL 可节省高达 55% 的成本并获得高达 80 倍的读取性能提升。

典型的模式是 **cache-aside（惰性加载）**：应用程序首先在 ElastiCache 中检查缓存的"最受欢迎产品"键；未命中时查询 RDS for MySQL 并为后续请求填充缓存。您可以通过使用 ElastiCache 作为数据库服务前的单独缓存层来手动实施查询缓存：设置 ElastiCache 集群（使用 Redis 或 Memcached）作为缓存，修改应用程序代码在查询数据库之前检查缓存，如果在缓存中找到数据，则直接从 ElastiCache 检索并避免数据库查询。

Redis 还提供丰富的数据结构（有序集、哈希、列表），非常适合排名类数据，如"最受欢迎产品"。

## 其他选项为何错误

- **A. 向 RDS for MySQL 集群添加"缓存节点"** — RDS for MySQL **没有集成缓存节点或缓存端点的概念**。您无法编辑 RDS 集群来添加内存缓存节点；缓存需要单独的服务，如 ElastiCache。虽然 RDS 控制台可以*启动* ElastiCache 集群并与 RDS 一起使用，但它仍然是单独的 ElastiCache 集群，不是 RDS 内的节点。创建和附加 Amazon ElastiCache 集群并将其附加到您的关系数据库的功能在所有 Amazon RDS 和 Amazon Aurora 数据库引擎上都受支持——注意这是 *ElastiCache* 集群，不是 RDS 内置功能。

- **C. DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 在 RDS for MySQL 前** — DAX 是**专门为 Amazon DynamoDB 的写入通路缓存**。它使用 DynamoDB API，无法在关系数据库（如 RDS for MySQL）前面使用。

- **D. 添加 Multi-AZ 备用实例并从其读取** — 在 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ 中，**备用实例不可读**；它仅用于故障转移/高可用性。要卸载读取，您需要读取副本，即使这样也只是另一个数据库实例——不是内存缓存，因此无法提供真正缓存层所带来的亚毫秒级延迟或数据库负载减少。

## 参考资源

- [Optimize cost and boost performance of RDS for MySQL using Amazon ElastiCache for Redis (AWS Database Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/optimize-cost-and-boost-performance-of-rds-for-mysql-using-amazon-elasticache-for-redis/)
- [Creating an Amazon ElastiCache cache using Amazon RDS DB instance settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/creating-elasticache-cluster-with-RDS-settings.html)
- [Add an Amazon ElastiCache cache to Amazon RDS databases in the RDS console](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2023/04/amazon-elasticache-cache-rds-databases-console/)

en.question: A gaming application stores scores for players in an Amazon DynamoDB table that has four attributes: user_id, user_name, user_score, and user_rank. The users are allowed to update their names only. A user is authenticated by web identity federation. Which set of conditions should be added in the policy attached to the role for the dynamodb:PutItem API call?
en.explanation:
# DynamoDB Fine-Grained Access Control with Web Identity Federation

## Scenario
A gaming app stores player records in DynamoDB with attributes `user_id`, `user_name`, `user_score`, and `user_rank`. Users authenticate via web identity federation (Login with Amazon → `www.amazon.com`). Users must be allowed to update **only their own record** and **only the `user_name` attribute**.

The IAM policy attached to the federated role for `dynamodb:PutItem` needs two restrictions:
1. **Item-level (row) restriction** — the user can only modify the item whose partition key (`user_id`) matches their own federated identity.
2. **Attribute-level (column) restriction** — the user can only modify the `user_name` attribute.

## Correct Answer: **A**

### Why A is correct
- `dynamodb:LeadingKeys` represents the first key attribute of a table — the partition key — and the key name is plural even when used with single-item actions; you must use the `ForAllValues` modifier when using LeadingKeys in a condition.
- `dynamodb:Attributes` represents a list of the top-level attributes accessed by a request, allowing attribute-level restrictions.
- The substitution variable `${www.amazon.com:user_id}` is an identity-provider-specific IAM context key used as a variable in the IAM policy for users authenticated via Login with Amazon.
- The `dynamodb:LeadingKeys` condition key limits user actions only on the items whose partition key value matches the Login with Amazon unique user ID for this app.

Therefore, option A correctly:
- Restricts the row to the user's own item: `dynamodb:LeadingKeys = ${www.amazon.com:user_id}` (matches the partition key `user_id`).
- Restricts the modifiable attribute to only `user_name`: `dynamodb:Attributes = ["user_name"]`.

```json
"Condition": {
    "ForAllValues:StringEquals": {
        "dynamodb:LeadingKeys": ["${www.amazon.com:user_id}"],
        "dynamodb:Attributes": ["user_name"]
    }
}
```

### Why the other options are wrong

- **B.** Uses `${www.amazon.com:user_name}` as `LeadingKeys`. The federated identity context key returned by Login with Amazon is `user_id`, not `user_name`, and the table's partition key is `user_id`. Also, restricting `Attributes` to `user_id` would allow modification of the partition key (which can't actually be changed via PutItem on the same item) but would prevent the legitimate name update.

- **C.** Permits attributes `user_name` **and** `user_id`. The requirement is that users can update only `user_name`. Allowing `user_id` in `Attributes` is broader than needed (and irrelevant since `user_id` is the partition key already constrained by `LeadingKeys`). The restriction must list **only** `user_name`.

- **D.** Wrong on both clauses: it uses `${www.amazon.com:user_name}` (non-existent / wrong context key — Login with Amazon exposes `user_id`) for `LeadingKeys`, and it permits the user to modify `user_id` in addition to `user_name`, violating the stated requirement.

## References
- [Using web identity federation - Amazon DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/WIF.html)
- [Using IAM policy conditions for fine-grained access control - Amazon DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/specifying-conditions.html)
- [Restrict an IAM user or role to specific attributes in a DynamoDB table](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/dynamodb-table-restrict-attributes)

zh.question: 一款游戏应用将玩家分数存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中，该表包含四个属性：user_id、user_name、 user_score 和 user_rank。用户仅允许更新其用户名。用户通过 Web 身份联合身份验证。对于 dynamodb:PutItem API 调用，应在附加到角色的策略中添加哪组条件？
zh.explanation:
# DynamoDB 细粒度访问控制与 Web 身份联合

## 场景
一款游戏应用在 DynamoDB 中存储玩家记录，包含属性 `user_id`、`user_name`、`user_score` 和 `user_rank`。用户通过 Web 身份联合（Login with Amazon → `www.amazon.com`）进行身份验证。用户必须被允许**仅更新自己的记录**和**仅更新 `user_name` 属性**。

附加到 `dynamodb:PutItem` 联合角色的 IAM 策略需要两项限制：
1. **项级（行）限制** — 用户只能修改其分区键（`user_id`）与其联合身份匹配的项。
2. **属性级（列）限制** — 用户只能修改 `user_name` 属性。

## 正确答案：**A**

### 为什么 A 正确
- `dynamodb:LeadingKeys` 代表表的第一个键属性 — 分区键 — 即使在单项操作中使用时，键名也是复数形式；在条件中使用 LeadingKeys 时，必须使用 `ForAllValues` 修饰符。
- `dynamodb:Attributes` 代表请求访问的顶级属性列表，允许属性级限制。
- 替换变量 `${www.amazon.com:user_id}` 是 IAM 策略中用作变量的身份提供商特定 IAM 上下文键，用于通过 Login with Amazon 进行身份验证的用户。
- `dynamodb:LeadingKeys` 条件键限制用户操作仅限于分区键值与此应用的 Login with Amazon 唯一用户 ID 匹配的项。

因此，选项 A 正确地：
- 将行限制为用户自己的项：`dynamodb:LeadingKeys = ${www.amazon.com:user_id}`（与分区键 `user_id` 匹配）。
- 将可修改的属性限制为仅 `user_name`：`dynamodb:Attributes = ["user_name"]`。

```json
"Condition": {
    "ForAllValues:StringEquals": {
        "dynamodb:LeadingKeys": ["${www.amazon.com:user_id}"],
        "dynamodb:Attributes": ["user_name"]
    }
}
```

### 为什么其他选项错误

- **B.** 使用 `${www.amazon.com:user_name}` 作为 `LeadingKeys`。Login with Amazon 返回的联合身份上下文键是 `user_id`，而非 `user_name`，表的分区键是 `user_id`。此外，将 `Attributes` 限制为 `user_id` 会允许修改分区键（实际上无法通过在同一项上的 PutItem 修改），但会阻止合法的名称更新。

- **C.** 允许属性 `user_name` **和** `user_id`。要求是用户只能更新 `user_name`。允许 `Attributes` 中的 `user_id` 范围过大（且无关，因为 `user_id` 已被 `LeadingKeys` 约束的分区键限制）。限制必须**仅列出** `user_name`。

- **D.** 两个条款都错误：对 `LeadingKeys` 使用 `${www.amazon.com:user_name}`（不存在/错误的上下文键 — Login with Amazon 暴露的是 `user_id`），并允许用户除了修改 `user_name` 外还修改 `user_id`，违反了规定的要求。

## 参考资源
- [Using web identity federation - Amazon DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/WIF.html)
- [Using IAM policy conditions for fine-grained access control - Amazon DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/specifying-conditions.html)
- [Restrict an IAM user or role to specific attributes in a DynamoDB table](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/dynamodb-table-restrict-attributes)

en.question: A developer is creating a database of products. Queries for frequently accessed products must have retrieval times of microseconds. To ensure data consistency, the application cache must be updated whenever products are added, changed, or deleted. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up an Amazon DynamoDB database and a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster.
options.B: Set up an Amazon RDS database and an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster. Implement a lazy loading caching strategy with ElastiCache.
options.C: Setup an Amazon DynamoDB database that has an in-memory cache. Implement a lazy loading caching strategy in the application.
options.D: Set up an Amazon RDS database and an Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster. Specify a TTL setting for the DAX cluster.

en.explanation:
# Analysis

## Scenario
A developer needs a product database where:
- Frequently accessed items must be retrieved in **microseconds**
- The cache must stay **consistent** with the database when products are added/changed/deleted (write-through behavior)

## Correct Answer: A — DynamoDB + DAX

DAX is purpose-built for DynamoDB and meets both requirements directly:

- **Microsecond latency**: DAX provides access to eventually consistent data from DynamoDB tables, with microsecond latency. DAX delivers up to a 10 times performance improvement—from milliseconds to microseconds—even at millions of requests per second.

- **Cache consistency on writes (no custom invalidation logic)**: DAX is a write-through cache. DAX intercepts the write and then writes the key-value pair to DynamoDB. Upon a successful write, DAX hydrates the DAX cache with the new value so that any subsequent reads for the same key-value pair result in a cache hit. DAX automatically updates the cache after write operations, ensuring data consistency between the cache and the DynamoDB table.

- **No application changes**: DAX does all the heavy lifting required to add in-memory acceleration to your DynamoDB tables, without requiring developers to manage cache invalidation, data population, or cluster management. As DAX is compatible with existing DynamoDB API calls, no application logic modification is required.

## Why the other options are wrong

### B. RDS + ElastiCache for Redis with **lazy loading**
ElastiCache can deliver sub-millisecond latency, but a **lazy-loading (cache-aside)** strategy only populates the cache on a cache miss. It does **not** automatically update or invalidate the cache when items are added, changed, or deleted, so cached data goes stale until the TTL expires or the item is explicitly evicted. This violates the requirement that the cache be updated whenever products are added/changed/deleted. A write-through strategy would be needed for that behavior.

### C. DynamoDB with an "in-memory cache" + lazy loading
Same lazy-loading problem as B — writes do not update the cache, so consistency on add/change/delete is not guaranteed. Additionally, DynamoDB's only native fully-managed in-memory cache is DAX, which the option fails to specify; lazy-loading inherently is not a write-through pattern.

### D. RDS + DAX
This is technically invalid. You do not need to modify application logic because DAX is compatible with existing DynamoDB API calls. DAX is exclusively a cache for **DynamoDB**, not RDS. You cannot place a DAX cluster in front of an Amazon RDS database. Adding a TTL doesn't help — TTL-based expiration would also allow stale data between writes and TTL expiry, contradicting the consistency requirement.

## Key AWS docs
- [In-memory acceleration with DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)
- [DAX: A Read-Through/Write-Through Cache for DynamoDB](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/amazon-dynamodb-accelerator-dax-a-read-throughwrite-through-cache-for-dynamodb/)
- [DAX and DynamoDB consistency models](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.consistency.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在创建一个产品数据库。对于频繁访问的产品，查询响应时间必须控制在微秒级。为了确保数据一致性，每当添加、更改或删除产品时，应用程序缓存都必须更新。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 设置 Amazon DynamoDB 数据库和 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 集群。
options.B: 设置 Amazon RDS 数据库和 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 集群。使用 ElastiCache 实现延迟加载缓存策略。
options.C: 设置一个具有内存缓存的 Amazon DynamoDB 数据库。在应用程序中实现延迟加载缓存策略。
options.D: 设置 Amazon RDS 数据库和 Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 集群。为 DAX 集群指定 TTL 设置。

zh.explanation:
# 分析

## 场景
开发人员需要一个产品数据库，其中：
- 频繁访问的项目必须在**微秒**内检索
- 当添加/更改/删除产品时，缓存必须与数据库保持**一致**（写穿透行为）

## 正确答案：A — DynamoDB + DAX

DAX 是为 DynamoDB 专门构建的，直接满足两个要求：

- **微秒级延迟**: DAX 提供从 DynamoDB 表访问最终一致数据的能力，延迟为微秒级。 DAX 提供高达 10 倍的性能改进——从毫秒到微秒——即使在每秒数百万请求的情况下。

- **写入时的缓存一致性（无需自定义失效逻辑）**: DAX 是写穿透缓存。 DAX 拦截写入，然后将键值对写入 DynamoDB。写入成功后，DAX 使用新值更新 DAX 缓存，以便对同一键值对的任何后续读取都会导致缓存命中。 DAX 在写入操作后自动更新缓存，确保缓存与 DynamoDB 表之间的数据一致性。

- **无需修改应用程序**: DAX 完成了向 DynamoDB 表添加内存加速所需的所有繁重工作，而不需要开发人员管理缓存失效、数据填充或集群管理。由于 DAX 与现有 DynamoDB API 调用兼容，不需要修改应用程序逻辑。

## 为什么其他选项是错的

### B. RDS + ElastiCache for Redis，采用**懒加载**策略
ElastiCache 可以提供亚毫秒级延迟，但**懒加载（旁路缓存）**策略仅在缓存未命中时填充缓存。它**不会**在添加、更改或删除项目时自动更新或失效缓存，因此缓存数据会变得陈旧，直到 TTL 过期或项目被显式逐出。这违反了缓存在添加/更改/删除产品时必须更新的要求。需要采用写穿透策略才能实现该行为。

### C. DynamoDB 配合"内存缓存" + 懒加载
与 B 相同的懒加载问题——写入不会更新缓存，因此无法保证在添加/更改/删除时的一致性。此外，DynamoDB 唯一的原生全托管内存缓存是 DAX，但该选项未指定它；懒加载本质上不是写穿透模式。

### D. RDS + DAX
这在技术上是无效的。您无需修改应用程序逻辑，因为 DAX 与现有 DynamoDB API 调用兼容。 DAX 专门是 **DynamoDB** 的缓存，而不是 RDS。您无法在 Amazon RDS 数据库前面放置 DAX 集群。添加 TTL 无法解决问题——基于 TTL 的过期也会允许在写入和 TTL 到期之间的数据陈旧，这与一致性要求矛盾。

## AWS 关键文档
- [使用 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 进行内存加速](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)
- [DAX：DynamoDB 的读穿透/写穿透缓存](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/amazon-dynamodb-accelerator-dax-a-read-throughwrite-through-cache-for-dynamodb/)
- [DAX 和 DynamoDB 一致性模型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.consistency.html)

en.question: A developer is creating a script to automate the deployment process for a serverless application. The developer wants to use an existing AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) template for the application. What should the developer use for the project? (Choose two.)

options.A: Call aws cloudformation package to create the deployment package. Call aws cloudformation deploy to deploy the package afterward.
options.B: Call sam package to create the deployment package. Call sam deploy to deploy the package afterward.
options.C: Call aws s3 cp to upload the AWS SAM template to Amazon S3. Call aws lambda update-function- code to create the application.
options.D: Create a ZIP package locally and call aws serverlessrepo create-applicatiion to create the application.
options.E: Create a ZIP package and upload it to Amazon S3. Call aws cloudformation create-stack to create the application.

en.explanation:
# Automating Deployment of an AWS SAM Application

## Scenario
A developer wants to automate deployment of a serverless application using an existing AWS SAM template. The question asks for **two** valid command sequences that can package and deploy the application.

## Correct Answers: A and B

Because an AWS SAM template is an extension of an AWS CloudFormation template, both the AWS CLI's CloudFormation commands and the SAM CLI commands can be used to package and deploy it. The SAM transform (`Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31`) is a CloudFormation macro, so CloudFormation natively understands SAM templates.

### B. `sam package` + `sam deploy` ✅
This is the canonical SAM CLI workflow. `sam package` zips the application code, uploads artifacts to Amazon S3, and produces a packaged template with S3 references. `sam deploy` then deploys that packaged template to CloudFormation, which provisions Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, etc. The `sam deploy` command [deploys an application to the AWS Cloud using AWS CloudFormation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/sam-cli-command-reference-sam-deploy.html).

### A. `aws cloudformation package` + `aws cloudformation deploy` ✅
Since SAM templates are a superset of CloudFormation templates, the equivalent AWS CLI commands work identically:

```bash
aws cloudformation package \
  --template-file template.yaml \
  --s3-bucket my-bucket \
  --output-template-file packaged.yaml

aws cloudformation deploy \
  --template-file packaged.yaml \
  --stack-name my-sam-app \
  --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM
```

`aws cloudformation package` performs the same upload/rewrite logic as `sam package`, and `aws cloudformation deploy` submits the transformed template to CloudFormation, which applies the SAM transform during stack creation.

## Why the other options are wrong

### C. `aws s3 cp` + `aws lambda update-function-code` ❌
This bypasses CloudFormation/SAM entirely. `aws lambda update-function-code` only updates the code of an **existing** Lambda function — it does not create the function, IAM roles, API Gateway, or any other resources defined in the SAM template. Simply copying the SAM template to S3 does nothing to provision resources.

### D. `aws serverlessrepo create-application` ❌
The `serverlessrepo` API publishes an application to the **AWS Serverless Application Repository** for sharing/distribution; it does not deploy resources into the developer's account. Also, the input is a SAM template referenced from S3, not a local ZIP file with code only.

### E. ZIP + `aws cloudformation create-stack` ❌
`aws cloudformation create-stack` requires a template, not a ZIP package — and a raw SAM template uploaded as-is references local code paths (e.g., `CodeUri: ./src/`) that CloudFormation cannot resolve. The packaging step (uploading code artifacts to S3 and rewriting the template) is mandatory and is exactly what `sam package` / `aws cloudformation package` perform. Skipping that step makes `create-stack` fail. Additionally, `create-stack` cannot update an existing stack, making it unsuitable for repeatable automation.

## References
- [sam deploy command reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/sam-cli-command-reference-sam-deploy.html)
- [Deploy your application with AWS SAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/serverless-deploying.html)
- [What is AWS SAM?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/what-is-sam.html)
- [Building and deploying a serverless app using AWS SAM and CloudFormation](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/mt/build-deploy-serverless-app-using-aws-serverless-application-model-and-aws-cloudformation/)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在编写脚本以自动化无服务器应用程序的部署流程。该开发人员希望使用现有的 AWS 无服务器应用程序模型 (AWS SAM) 模板。开发人员应该为该项目选择哪些模板？（选择两项。）

options.A: 调用 aws cloudformation package 创建部署包。之后调用 aws cloudformation deploy 部署该包。
options.B: 调用 sam package 创建部署包。之后调用 sam deploy 部署该包。
options.C: 调用 aws s3 cp 将 AWS SAM 模板上传到 Amazon S3。调用 aws lambda update-function-code 创建应用程序。
options.D: 在本地创建一个 ZIP 包，并调用 aws serverlessrepo create-application 来创建应用程序。
options.E: 创建一个 ZIP 包并将其上传到 Amazon S3。调用 aws cloudformation create-stack 来创建应用程序。

zh.explanation:
# 自动化部署 AWS SAM 应用

## 场景
开发者希望使用现有的 AWS SAM 模板自动化部署无服务器应用。问题要求选择**两个**有效的命令序列来打包和部署应用。

## 正确答案：A 和 B

由于 AWS SAM 模板是 AWS CloudFormation 模板的扩展，可以使用 AWS CLI 的 CloudFormation 命令和 SAM CLI 命令来部署它。SAM 转换（`Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31`）是 CloudFormation 宏，所以 CloudFormation 本身就能理解 SAM 模板。

### B. `sam package` + `sam deploy` ✅
这是规范的 SAM CLI 工作流。`sam package` 将应用代码压缩，将工件上传到 Amazon S3，并生成包含 S3 引用的打包模板。`sam deploy` 然后将打包的模板部署到 CloudFormation，CloudFormation 将配置 Lambda、API Gateway、DynamoDB 等资源。`sam deploy` 命令[使用 AWS CloudFormation 将应用部署到 AWS 云](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/sam-cli-command-reference-sam-deploy.html)。

### A. `aws cloudformation package` + `aws cloudformation deploy` ✅
由于 SAM 模板是 CloudFormation 模板的超集，对应的 AWS CLI 命令的作用完全相同：

```bash
aws cloudformation package \
  --template-file template.yaml \
  --s3-bucket my-bucket \
  --output-template-file packaged.yaml

aws cloudformation deploy \
  --template-file packaged.yaml \
  --stack-name my-sam-app \
  --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM
```

`aws cloudformation package` 执行与 `sam package` 相同的上传/重写逻辑，`aws cloudformation deploy` 将转换后的模板提交给 CloudFormation，CloudFormation 在堆栈创建期间应用 SAM 转换。

## 为什么其他选项错误

### C. `aws s3 cp` + `aws lambda update-function-code` ❌
这完全绕过了 CloudFormation/SAM。`aws lambda update-function-code` 仅更新**现有** Lambda 函数的代码——它不会创建函数、IAM 角色、API Gateway 或 SAM 模板中定义的任何其他资源。简单地将 SAM 模板复制到 S3 不会配置任何资源。

### D. `aws serverlessrepo create-application` ❌
`serverlessrepo` API 将应用发布到 **AWS 无服务器应用程序库**用于共享/分发，而不是将资源部署到开发者的账户中。此外，输入是从 S3 引用的 SAM 模板，而不是仅包含代码的本地 ZIP 文件。

### E. ZIP + `aws cloudformation create-stack` ❌
`aws cloudformation create-stack` 需要的是模板，而不是 ZIP 包——原始的 SAM 模板引用本地代码路径（例如 `CodeUri: ./src/`），CloudFormation 无法解析。打包步骤（将代码工件上传到 S3 并重写模板）是必需的，这正是 `sam package` / `aws cloudformation package` 的作用。跳过该步骤会导致 `create-stack` 失败。此外，`create-stack` 无法更新现有堆栈，不适合重复的自动化。

## 参考资源
- [sam deploy 命令参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/sam-cli-command-reference-sam-deploy.html)
- [使用 AWS SAM 部署应用](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/serverless-deploying.html)
- [什么是 AWS SAM？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/what-is-sam.html)
- [使用 AWS SAM 和 CloudFormation 构建和部署无服务器应用](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/mt/build-deploy-serverless-app-using-aws-serverless-application-model-and-aws-cloudformation/)

en.question: A developer adds new dependencies to an existing AWS Lambda function. The developer cannot deploy the Lambda function because the unzipped deployment package exceeds the maximum size quota for the Lambda function. The instruction set architecture of the Lambda function is x86_64. The developer must implement a solution to deploy the Lambda function with the new dependencies. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a snapshot of all the dependencies. Configure the Lambda function to use the snapshot.
options.B: Change the instruction set architecture of the Lambda function to use an arm64 architecture.
options.C: Associate an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume with the Lambda function. Store all the dependencies on the EBS volume.
options.D: Create and deploy a Lambda container image with all the dependencies.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer added new dependencies to a Lambda function, but the unzipped deployment package now exceeds Lambda's quota. The Lambda function uses x86_64 architecture. The developer needs a deployment solution that can accommodate the larger package.

## Key Lambda Quotas

- **.zip deployment package**: 50 MB (zipped, direct upload) / 250 MB (unzipped, including layers)
- **Container image**: up to 10 GB

You can package container images up to 10GB, which is significantly higher than the 250MB limit on (unzipped) deployment package size. It's also worth mentioning that although the container image can be up to 10GB, the Lambda runtime provides a read-only filesystem for the function.

## Correct Answer: D — Create and deploy a Lambda container image with all the dependencies

Packaging the Lambda function as a container image and pushing it to Amazon ECR is the AWS-recommended approach when dependencies exceed the .zip package quota. Lambda functions built using container images can be up to 10 GB in size. You push images to an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR) repository, a managed AWS container image registry service.

Example Dockerfile using the AWS Lambda Python base image:

```dockerfile
FROM public.ecr.aws/lambda/python:3.12
COPY requirements.txt ${LAMBDA_TASK_ROOT}
RUN pip3 install -r requirements.txt
COPY app.py ${LAMBDA_TASK_ROOT}
CMD [ "app.lambda_handler" ]
```

Note: You cannot change the deployment package type (.zip or container image) for an existing function. For example, you cannot convert a container image function to use a .zip file archive. You must create a new function.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Snapshot of dependencies** — Lambda does not support attaching "snapshots" of dependencies. While Lambda SnapStart exists for Java, it is a runtime startup optimization (snapshot of the initialized execution environment), not a mechanism for storing or loading dependencies, and it does not raise the package size limit.

- **B. Change to arm64** — The instruction set architecture only affects the CPU type (Graviton2 vs. x86) and pricing/performance. The package size quotas (50 MB zipped / 250 MB unzipped) are identical for both architectures, so this does nothing to solve the size issue.

- **C. Attach an EBS volume** — Lambda **cannot mount EBS volumes**. EBS volumes are block storage attached to EC2 instances. For shared external storage, Lambda supports **Amazon EFS** (mounted via VPC), not EBS. Even if EFS were used, the question asks how to *deploy* the Lambda with the new dependencies — using a container image is the canonical AWS solution.

## References

- [Lambda quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html)
- [Create a Lambda function using a container image](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/images-create.html)

zh.question: 开发人员向现有的 AWS Lambda 函数添加了新的依赖项。由于解压缩后的部署包超过了 Lambda 函数的最大大小配额，开发人员无法部署该 Lambda 函数。该 Lambda 函数的指令集架构为 x86_64。开发人员必须实现一个解决方案来部署包含新依赖项的 Lambda 函数。哪个解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建所有依赖项的快照。配置 Lambda 函数以使用该快照。
options.B: 将 Lambda 函数的指令集架构更改为使用 arm64 架构。
options.C: 将 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷与 Lambda 函数关联。将所有依赖项存储在 EBS 卷上。
options.D: 创建并部署包含所有依赖项的 Lambda 容器镜像。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一位开发人员为 Lambda 函数添加了新的依赖项，但现在未压缩的部署包超过了 Lambda 的配额。该 Lambda 函数使用 x86_64 架构。开发人员需要一个能够容纳更大包的部署方案。

## 关键 Lambda 配额

- **.zip 部署包**：50 MB（压缩，直接上传）/ 250 MB（未压缩，包括层）
- **容器镜像**：最大 10 GB

您可以打包最大 10GB 的容器镜像，这远高于（未压缩）部署包大小的 250MB 限制。还值得一提的是，尽管容器镜像可以最大 10GB，但 Lambda 运行时为函数提供只读文件系统。

## 正确答案：D — 创建并部署 Lambda 容器镜像，包含所有依赖项

当依赖项超过 .zip 包配额时，将 Lambda 函数打包为容器镜像并将其推送到 Amazon ECR 是 AWS 推荐的方法。使用容器镜像构建的 Lambda 函数大小可以达到 10 GB。您将镜像推送到 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR) 存储库，这是一个由 AWS 管理的容器镜像注册服务。

使用 AWS Lambda Python 基础镜像的 Dockerfile 示例：

```dockerfile
FROM public.ecr.aws/lambda/python:3.12
COPY requirements.txt ${LAMBDA_TASK_ROOT}
RUN pip3 install -r requirements.txt
COPY app.py ${LAMBDA_TASK_ROOT}
CMD [ "app.lambda_handler" ]
```

注意：您无法更改现有函数的部署包类型（.zip 或容器镜像）。例如，您无法将容器镜像函数转换为使用 .zip 文件存档。您必须创建一个新函数。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

- **A. 依赖项快照** — Lambda 不支持附加依赖项的"快照"。虽然 Lambda SnapStart 对 Java 存在，但它是一个运行时启动优化（初始化执行环境的快照），不是存储或加载依赖项的机制，并且它不会提高包大小限制。

- **B. 更改为 arm64** — 指令集架构仅影响 CPU 类型（Graviton2 vs. x86）和定价/性能。两种架构的包大小配额（50 MB 压缩 / 250 MB 未压缩）相同，因此这无法解决大小问题。

- **C. 附加 EBS 卷** — Lambda **无法挂载 EBS 卷**。EBS 卷是连接到 EC2 实例的块存储。对于共享外部存储，Lambda 支持 **Amazon EFS**（通过 VPC 挂载），而不是 EBS。即使使用了 EFS，问题要求的是如何用新依赖项*部署* Lambda — 使用容器镜像是规范的 AWS 解决方案。

## 参考资源

- [Lambda 配额](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html)
- [使用容器镜像创建 Lambda 函数](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/images-create.html)
- [使用容器镜像部署 Lambda 函数（AWS 规范指南）](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/patterns/deploy-lambda-functions-with-container-images.html)

en.question: A developer is working on a project that requires regular updates to a web application’s backend code. The code is stored in AWS CodeCommit. Company policy states that all code must have complete unit testing and that the test results must be available for access. The developer needs to implement a solution that will take each change to the code repository, build the code, and run unit tests. The solution also must provide a detailed report of the test results. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure AWS CodeDeploy to deploy code from CodeCommit and to run unit tests. Send the test results to Amazon CloudWatch metrics to view reports.
options.B: Configure Amazon CodeWhisperer to create the code and to run unit tests. Save the test results in an Amazon S3 bucket to generate reports.
options.C: Configure AWS CodeBuild to build the code and to run unit tests. Use test reporting in CodeBuild to generate and view reports.
options.D: Create AWS Lambda functions that run when changes are made in CodeCommit. Program the Lambda functions to build the code, run unit tests, and save the test results to a Lambda layer.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer needs a CI solution that, on every code change in **AWS CodeCommit**, will:
1. Build the code
2. Run unit tests
3. Provide a **detailed report** of the test results that can be viewed/accessed.

## Correct Answer: C — Use AWS CodeBuild with Test Reporting

AWS CodeBuild is a fully managed build service that compiles source code, runs tests, and produces deployable artifacts. It integrates natively with CodeCommit (CodeBuild can use CodeCommit as a source provider) and supports a built-in **test reporting** feature.

You can create reports in CodeBuild that contain details about tests that are run during builds. You can create tests such as unit tests, configuration tests, and functional tests. CodeBuild supports test report formats such as JUnit XML, NUnit XML, TestNG, Cucumber JSON, and Visual Studio TRX.

To enable reporting, you add a `reports:` section to the `buildspec.yml`. To create a test report, you add a report group name to the buildspec file of a build project with information about your test cases. When you run the build project, the test cases are run and a test report is created. A new test report is created in the report group each time the test cases run.

Example `buildspec.yml`:

```yaml
version: 0.2
phases:
  install:
    runtime-versions:
      python: 3.9
    commands:
      - pip install pytest
  build:
    commands:
      - python -m pytest --junitxml=reports/report.xml
reports:
  pytest_reports:
    files:
      - report.xml
    base-directory: reports
    file-format: JUNITXML
```

Reports can be viewed directly in the CodeBuild console with metrics like pass rate, duration, and pass/fail counts. You can view metrics such as Pass Rate %, Test Run Duration, and number of Passed versus Failed/Error test cases in one location. Reports expire after 30 days, but raw data can be exported to S3 for long-term retention.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**A. CodeDeploy + CloudWatch metrics** — CodeDeploy is a **deployment** service; it does not build code or run unit tests as part of its core function. CloudWatch metrics are numeric time-series data — they cannot store/render the detailed structured test reports (per-test status, duration, error messages) required.

**B. Amazon CodeWhisperer** — CodeWhisperer is an **AI code-suggestion tool** (now part of Amazon Q Developer) that helps developers author code in their IDE. It does not build code, run tests, or produce test reports. It has no role in a CI pipeline triggered by CodeCommit changes.

**D. Lambda functions saving results to a Lambda layer** — Lambda **layers** are immutable ZIP archives meant to package shared libraries/runtimes for reuse across functions; they are not a storage location for build artifacts or test results. Additionally, builds and unit-test toolchains often exceed Lambda's 15-minute execution limit and 10 GB ephemeral storage, and you would have to build all reporting/UI yourself — re-implementing what CodeBuild provides natively.

## References

- [Test reports in AWS CodeBuild](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/test-reporting.html)
- [Create test reports](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/report-create.html)
- [View test reports for a build](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/test-view-project-reports.html)
- [Test Reports with AWS CodeBuild (AWS DevOps Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/devops/test-reports-with-aws-codebuild/)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在开发一个项目，该项目需要定期更新 Web 应用程序的后端代码。代码存储在 AWS CodeCommit 中。公司政策规定所有代码都必须经过完整的单元测试，并且测试结果必须可供访问。开发人员需要实现一个解决方案，该方案能够处理代码库的每次更改，构建代码并运行单元测试。此外，该解决方案还必须提供详细的测试结果报告。哪个解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 AWS CodeDeploy 以从 CodeCommit 部署代码并运行单元测试。将测试结果发送到 Amazon CloudWatch 指标以查看报告。
options.B: 配置 Amazon CodeWhisperer 以生成代码并运行单元测试。将测试结果保存到 Amazon S3 存储桶中以生成报告。
options.C: 配置 AWS CodeBuild 以构建代码并运行单元测试。使用 CodeBuild 中的测试报告功能生成和查看报告。
options.D: 创建在 CodeCommit 发生更改时运行的 AWS Lambda 函数。编写 Lambda 函数以构建代码、运行单元测试并将测试结果保存到 Lambda 层。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一位开发人员需要一个 CI 解决方案，在 **AWS CodeCommit** 中每次代码变更时，执行以下操作：
1. 构建代码
2. 运行单元测试
3. 提供可以查看/访问的**详细测试结果报告**。

## 正确答案：C — 使用带有测试报告功能的 AWS CodeBuild

AWS CodeBuild 是一项完全托管的构建服务，它可以编译源代码、运行测试并生成可部署的工件。它与 CodeCommit 原生集成（CodeBuild 可以使用 CodeCommit 作为源提供程序），并支持内置的**测试报告**功能。

你可以在 CodeBuild 中创建报告，其中包含构建期间运行的测试的详细信息。你可以创建单元测试、配置测试和功能测试等测试。CodeBuild 支持 JUnit XML、NUnit XML、TestNG、Cucumber JSON 和 Visual Studio TRX 等测试报告格式。

要启用报告功能，需要在 `buildspec.yml` 中添加 `reports:` 部分。要创建测试报告，你需要在构建项目的 buildspec 文件中添加报告组名称和关于测试用例的信息。运行构建项目时，测试用例会运行，并创建测试报告。每次测试用例运行时，都会在报告组中创建一份新的测试报告。

示例 `buildspec.yml`：

```yaml
version: 0.2
phases:
  install:
    runtime-versions:
      python: 3.9
    commands:
      - pip install pytest
  build:
    commands:
      - python -m pytest --junitxml=reports/report.xml
reports:
  pytest_reports:
    files:
      - report.xml
    base-directory: reports
    file-format: JUNITXML
```

报告可以直接在 CodeBuild 控制台中查看，包括通过率、耗时和通过/失败计数等指标。你可以在一个位置查看通过率百分比、测试运行耗时以及通过/失败/错误测试用例的数量等指标。报告在 30 天后过期，但原始数据可以导出到 S3 以进行长期保留。

## 为什么其他选项错误

**A. CodeDeploy + CloudWatch 指标** — CodeDeploy 是一项**部署**服务；它不作为其核心功能的一部分来构建代码或运行单元测试。CloudWatch 指标是数值时间序列数据 — 它们无法存储/呈现所需的详细结构化测试报告（每个测试的状态、耗时、错误消息）。

**B. Amazon CodeWhisperer** — CodeWhisperer 是一款**AI 代码建议工具**（现已纳入 Amazon Q Developer），可帮助开发人员在其 IDE 中编写代码。它不构建代码、不运行测试，也不生成测试报告。在由 CodeCommit 变更触发的 CI 管道中没有任何作用。

**D. Lambda 函数将结果保存到 Lambda 层** — Lambda **层**是不可变的 ZIP 存档，用于打包共享库/运行时供函数重复使用；它们不是构建工件或测试结果的存储位置。此外，构建和单元测试工具链通常会超过 Lambda 的 15 分钟执行时限和 10 GB 临时存储，并且你必须自己构建所有报告/UI — 重新实现 CodeBuild 原生提供的功能。

## 参考资源

- [Test reports in AWS CodeBuild](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/test-reporting.html)
- [Create test reports](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/report-create.html)
- [View test reports for a build](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/test-view-project-reports.html)
- [Test Reports with AWS CodeBuild (AWS DevOps Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/devops/test-reports-with-aws-codebuild/)
