en.question: A developer is building an application on AWS. The application has an Amazon API Gateway API that sends requests to an AWS Lambda function. The API is experiencing increased latency because the Lambda function has limited available CPU to fulfill the requests. Before the developer deploys the API into production, the developer must configure the Lambda function to have more CPU. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Increase the virtual CPU (vCPU) cores quota of the Lambda function.
options.B: Increase the amount of memory that is allocated to the Lambda function.
options.C: Increase the ephemeral storage size of the Lambda function.
options.D: Increase the timeout value of the Lambda function.

en.explanation:
# Lambda CPU Allocation via Memory Setting

## Scenario
An API Gateway-backed Lambda function is experiencing high latency because the Lambda function is CPU-constrained. The developer needs to give the function more CPU before deploying to production.

## Correct Answer: B — Increase the amount of memory allocated to the Lambda function

In AWS Lambda, you cannot configure CPU directly. CPU is allocated **proportionally to the memory** setting. You can increase or decrease the memory and CPU power allocated to your function using the Memory setting. You can configure memory between 128 MB and 10,240 MB in 1-MB increments. At 1,769 MB, a function has the equivalent of one vCPU.

Adding more memory proportionally increases the amount of CPU, increasing the overall computational power available. If a function is CPU, network or memory-bound, then increasing the memory setting can dramatically improve its performance.

Therefore, to give the Lambda function more CPU, the developer simply increases the **MemorySize** configuration value.

```yaml
Resources:
  MyFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      MemorySize: 3008   # increases CPU proportionally
      Timeout: 30
```

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Increase the vCPU cores quota of the Lambda function** — Lambda has **no vCPU configuration setting or vCPU quota** that you can adjust. Lambda doesn't let you configure CPU independently. CPU scales linearly with memory. The only way to get more vCPU is to raise the memory setting.

- **C. Increase the ephemeral storage size of the Lambda function** — Ephemeral storage (`/tmp`, 512 MB–10,240 MB) only affects scratch disk space available to the function. It has no effect on CPU allocation or execution speed for CPU-bound workloads.

- **D. Increase the timeout value of the Lambda function** — Timeout only controls how long an invocation can run before being terminated. Raising the timeout does not provide any additional CPU resources; the function would still run slowly and the API latency would remain high (and likely make latency worse, since slow invocations would no longer be cut short).

## Reference
- [Configure Lambda function memory — AWS Lambda Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-memory.html)
- [Lambda quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在 AWS 上构建一个应用程序。该应用程序使用 Amazon API Gateway API 向 AWS Lambda 函数发送请求。由于 Lambda 函数可用的 CPU 资源有限，无法处理所有请求，导致 API 延迟增加。在将 API 部署到生产环境之前，开发人员必须配置 Lambda 函数以获得更多 CPU 资源。以下哪个解决方案可以满足此要求？

options.A: 增加 Lambda 函数的虚拟 CPU (vCPU) 核心配额。
options.B: 增加分配给 Lambda 函数的内存量。
options.C: 增加 Lambda 函数的临时存储大小。
options.D: 增加 Lambda 函数的超时值。

zh.explanation:
# Lambda 通过内存设置分配 CPU

## 场景
一个由 API Gateway 支持的 Lambda 函数出现高延迟，因为 Lambda 函数受 CPU 限制。开发人员需要在部署到生产环境之前为函数分配更多 CPU。

## 正确答案：B — 增加分配给 Lambda 函数的内存量

在 AWS Lambda 中，您无法直接配置 CPU。CPU 是**按比例与内存**设置分配的。您可以使用内存设置来增加或减少分配给函数的内存和 CPU 功率。您可以在 128 MB 到 10,240 MB 之间以 1 MB 的增量配置内存。在 1,769 MB 时，函数具有等效的一个 vCPU。

添加更多内存会按比例增加 CPU 数量，从而增加可用的总体计算能力。如果函数受 CPU、网络或内存限制，那么增加内存设置可以显著提高其性能。

因此，要为 Lambda 函数提供更多 CPU，开发人员只需增加 **MemorySize** 配置值。

```yaml
Resources:
  MyFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      MemorySize: 3008   # 按比例增加 CPU
      Timeout: 30
```

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. 增加 Lambda 函数的 vCPU 核心配额** — Lambda **没有 vCPU 配置设置或 vCPU 配额**可以调整。Lambda 不允许您独立配置 CPU。CPU 随内存线性扩展。获取更多 vCPU 的唯一方法是提高内存设置。

- **C. 增加 Lambda 函数的临时存储大小** — 临时存储（`/tmp`，512 MB–10,240 MB）仅影响函数可用的临时磁盘空间。它对 CPU 分配或 CPU 绑定工作负载的执行速度没有影响。

- **D. 增加 Lambda 函数的超时值** — 超时仅控制调用在被终止之前可以运行的时间长度。提高超时不会提供任何额外的 CPU 资源；函数仍然会运行缓慢，API 延迟将保持高位（并且可能会使延迟更糟，因为缓慢的调用将不再被中断）。

## 参考
- [配置 Lambda 函数内存 — AWS Lambda 开发人员指南](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-memory.html)
- [Lambda 配额](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html)

en.question: A developer is creating a web application to upload and store private data. The application will encrypt private data and then will upload the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. The developer needs to implement a solution to automatically find any unencrypted private data in the S3 bucket. The solution must monitor the security and access control of the S3 bucket and must provide a notification if there are any security issues. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Step Functions to run Amazon Athena queries. Configure Athena to find unencrypted private data and to monitor for security issues in the S3 bucket. Start the queries when new objects are added to the S3 bucket. Configure Athena to provide a notification if security issues are detected.
options.B: Enable Amazon Macie for the S3 bucket. Set up custom criteria to find unencrypted private data in the S3 bucket. Set up AWS User Notifications to provide a notification when Macie detects security issues.
options.C: Enable Amazon Inspector for the AWS account. Use Amazon Inspector to scan the S3 bucket to find unencrypted private data and to monitor for security issues. Set up Amazon EventBridge to provide a notification when Amazon Inspector detects security issues.
options.D: Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Configure Amazon S3 to send new object notifications to the stream. Create an AWS Lambda function that runs every 10 minutes to check the stream for unencrypted private data and to monitor for security issues. Program the Lambda function to provide a notification when security issues are detected.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A web application encrypts private data client-side and uploads it to Amazon S3. The developer needs an automated way to:
1. Find any **unencrypted private/sensitive data** sitting in the S3 bucket.
2. Continuously **monitor the security and access control** posture of the bucket.
3. **Notify** the team when issues are detected.

## Correct Answer: B — Enable Amazon Macie

Amazon Macie is the AWS managed service purpose-built for exactly this use case. Macie provides an inventory of S3 general purpose buckets, automatically evaluates and monitors the buckets for security and access control, and if it detects a potential issue with the security or privacy of your data, such as a bucket that becomes publicly accessible, Macie generates a finding for you to review and remediate.

For sensitive-data discovery, Macie automates discovery and reporting of sensitive data using built-in criteria, custom criteria that you define, or a combination of the two, and generates a finding when sensitive data is detected in an S3 object. This matches the requirement to "set up custom criteria to find unencrypted private data."

For notifications, Macie integrates with Amazon EventBridge and AWS Security Hub to monitor, process, and remediate findings. AWS User Notifications can subscribe to those EventBridge events and deliver alerts via email, chat, or the AWS Console mobile app.

Macie also explicitly tracks encryption status: Macie continually evaluates your S3 buckets for security and access controls and generates findings to notify you of issues such as unencrypted buckets, publicly accessible buckets, and buckets that are shared with AWS accounts outside your organization.

## Why the other options are wrong

**A. Step Functions + Athena.** Athena is a SQL query service for data in S3; it cannot inspect object encryption metadata or evaluate bucket-level access controls, and it has no native finding/notification mechanism. Building this would require significant custom code and still wouldn't equal Macie's policy-finding capability described above (Macie uses automated, logic-based reasoning to analyze resource-based policies, account- and bucket-level permissions settings, bucket policies, ACLs, and block public access settings.).

**C. Amazon Inspector.** Inspector is a vulnerability-management service for **Amazon EC2 instances, container images in Amazon ECR, and Lambda functions** — it does not scan S3 buckets for sensitive/unencrypted data or evaluate S3 access-control posture. See [Amazon Inspector features](https://aws.amazon.com/inspector/features/).

**D. Kinesis Data Streams + Lambda polling every 10 minutes.** This is a custom build that:
- Would require writing logic to detect unencrypted/sensitive content (re-implementing Macie).
- Polling Kinesis on a schedule misses Kinesis's real-time consumer model and is operationally complex.
- Provides no built-in evaluation of bucket-level security/access-control posture.

It is unnecessarily complex when Macie offers a fully managed solution.

## References
- [Amazon Macie — What is Macie?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)
- [How Macie monitors Amazon S3 data security](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/monitoring-s3-how-it-works.html)
- [Monitoring data security and privacy with Macie](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/monitoring-s3.html)
- [Amazon Macie features](https://aws.amazon.com/macie/features/)
- [Amazon Inspector features](https://aws.amazon.com/inspector/features/)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在创建一个用于上传和存储私有数据的 Web 应用程序。该应用程序会对私有数据进行加密，然后将数据上传到 Amazon S3 存储桶。开发人员需要实现一个解决方案，以自动查找 S3 存储桶中任何未加密的私有数据。该解决方案必须监控 S3 存储桶的安全性和访问控制，并在出现任何安全问题时发出通知。哪个解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Step Functions 运行 Amazon Athena 查询。配置 Athena 以查找未加密的私有数据并监控 S3 存储桶中的安全问题。当新对象添加到 S3 存储桶时启动查询。配置 Athena 以便在检测到安全问题时发出通知。
options.B: 为 S3 存储桶启用 Amazon Macie。设置自定义条件以查找 S3 存储桶中未加密的私有数据。设置 AWS 用户通知，以便在 Macie 检测到安全问题时发出通知。
options.C: 为 AWS 账户启用 Amazon Inspector。使用 Amazon Inspector 扫描 S3 存储桶，查找未加密的私有数据并监控安全问题。设置 Amazon EventBridge，以便在 Amazon Inspector 检测到安全问题时发出通知。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon Kinesis 数据流。配置 Amazon S3 向该数据流发送新对象通知。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，每 10 分钟运行一次，以检查数据流中是否存在未加密的私有数据并监控安全问题。编写 Lambda 函数，使其在检测到安全问题时发出通知。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一个网络应用程序在客户端加密私密数据并将其上传到 Amazon S3。开发人员需要一种自动化的方法来：
1. 查找 S3 存储桶中任何**未加密的私密/敏感数据**。
2. 持续**监控存储桶的安全性和访问控制**态势。
3. 当检测到问题时**通知**团队。

## 正确答案：B — 启用 Amazon Macie

Amazon Macie 是为这个用例量身定制的 AWS 托管服务。Macie 提供 S3 通用存储桶的清单，自动评估和监控存储桶的安全性和访问控制，如果检测到数据安全或隐私的潜在问题（例如存储桶变为公开访问），Macie 会生成一个供您审查和修复的发现。

对于敏感数据发现，Macie 使用内置条件、您定义的自定义条件或两者的组合来自动发现和报告敏感数据，并在检测到 S3 对象中的敏感数据时生成发现。这符合"设置自定义条件以查找未加密的私密数据"的要求。

对于通知，Macie 与 Amazon EventBridge 和 AWS Security Hub 集成以监控、处理和修复发现。AWS 用户通知可以订阅这些 EventBridge 事件，并通过电子邮件、聊天或 AWS Console 移动应用交付警报。

Macie 还显式跟踪加密状态：Macie 持续评估您的 S3 存储桶的安全性和访问控制，并生成发现来通知您存在的问题，例如未加密的存储桶、公开访问的存储桶以及与组织外 AWS 账户共享的存储桶。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**A. Step Functions + Athena.** Athena 是 S3 中数据的 SQL 查询服务；它无法检查对象加密元数据或评估存储桶级别访问控制，并且它没有本机发现/通知机制。构建这个需要大量自定义代码，仍然不等于上文描述的 Macie 的策略发现能力（Macie 使用自动化、基于逻辑的推理来分析基于资源的策略、账户和存储桶级别权限设置、存储桶策略、ACL 和阻止公共访问设置。）。

**C. Amazon Inspector.** Inspector 是 **Amazon EC2 实例、Amazon ECR 中的容器映像和 Lambda 函数**的漏洞管理服务——它不扫描 S3 存储桶中的敏感/未加密数据或评估 S3 访问控制态势。请参阅 [Amazon Inspector 功能](https://aws.amazon.com/inspector/features/)。

**D. Kinesis Data Streams + Lambda 每 10 分钟轮询一次。** 这是一个自定义构建，它：
- 需要编写逻辑来检测未加密/敏感内容（重新实现 Macie）。
- 按计划轮询 Kinesis 错过了 Kinesis 的实时消费者模型，在操作上很复杂。
- 不提供对存储桶级别安全/访问控制态势的内置评估。

在 Macie 提供完全托管解决方案时，这会不必要地复杂。

## 参考资源
- [Amazon Macie — 什么是 Macie？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)
- [Macie 如何监控 Amazon S3 数据安全](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/monitoring-s3-how-it-works.html)
- [使用 Macie 监控数据安全和隐私](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/monitoring-s3.html)
- [Amazon Macie 功能](https://aws.amazon.com/macie/features/)
- [Amazon Inspector 功能](https://aws.amazon.com/inspector/features/)

en.question: A developer has an application that uses AWS Lambda functions and AWS CloudFormation templates. Usage of the application has increased. As a result, the Lambda functions are encountering rate limit errors when they retrieve data. The Lambda functions retrieve an advanced parameter from AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store on every call. The parameter changes only during new deployments. Because the application’s usage is unpredictable, the developer needs a way to avoid the rate limiting. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure the Lambda functions to use reserved concurrency that is equal to the last month’s average number of concurrent invocations.
options.B: Add a retry mechanism with exponential backoff to the call to Parameter Store.
options.C: Request a service quota increase for Parameter Store GetParameter API operations to match the expected usage of the Lambda functions.
options.D: Add an SSM dynamic reference as an environment variable to the Lambda functions resource in the CloudFormation templates.

en.explanation:
# Lambda Rate Limiting on SSM Parameter Store Calls

## Scenario
A Lambda function calls SSM Parameter Store on every invocation to retrieve an **advanced parameter**. As traffic grows, calls hit Parameter Store throttling limits. Importantly, the parameter value only changes during deployments — so calling Parameter Store on every invocation is wasteful. The developer needs the **most cost-effective** solution.

## Correct Answer: D — Use an SSM dynamic reference as an environment variable in the CloudFormation template

By placing the parameter value into the Lambda function's environment variables via a CloudFormation SSM dynamic reference (`{{resolve:ssm:parameter-name:version}}`) or an `AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<String>` template parameter, CloudFormation resolves the SSM value **once at stack create/update time** and bakes it into the Lambda's environment configuration.

Dynamic references provide a convenient way to specify external values stored and managed in other services and decouple sensitive information from infrastructure-as-code templates. CloudFormation retrieves the value of the specified reference when necessary during stack and change set operations.

Because the parameter only changes during deployments, this perfectly aligns with the redeployment lifecycle — every new deployment refreshes the env-var, and runtime calls to SSM are eliminated entirely. Result:
- **Zero runtime SSM API calls** → no rate limit errors
- **No additional cost** (env vars are free; no extension, no provisioned concurrency)

Example CloudFormation snippet:
```yaml
Resources:
  MyFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Environment:
        Variables:
          MY_PARAM: '{{resolve:ssm:/app/myparam:1}}'
```

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**A. Reserved concurrency equal to last month's average concurrent invocations**
This actually *limits* (caps) Lambda concurrency, which would throttle the function itself, not solve Parameter Store throttling. Reserved concurrency does not reduce per-invocation calls to SSM — every invocation still calls GetParameter. It would degrade availability without addressing the root cause.

**B. Retry with exponential backoff**
Retries do not reduce the number of GetParameter calls; in fact, they *increase* them under load and add latency. The function would still keep hitting the SSM TPS quota and eventually fail. This treats the symptom, not the cause.

**C. Request a service quota increase for GetParameter**
This may help, but it's not the **most cost-effective** solution. Parameter Store has a low throughput quota by default (40 per second) and reading the value every time you need it will also add latency. Higher-tier (advanced) parameter throughput is billable per API interaction. The parameter rarely changes, so paying for high-throughput reads of a near-static value is wasteful when you can simply load it once at deploy time. It also doesn't eliminate the unnecessary latency on every Lambda call.

## Key References
- [CloudFormation SSM dynamic references](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/dynamic-references-ssm.html)
- [CloudFormation dynamic references overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/dynamic-references.html)
- [Using Parameter Store parameters in Lambda functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/ps-integration-lambda-extensions.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员开发了一个使用 AWS Lambda 函数和 AWS CloudFormation 模板的应用程序。随着应用程序使用量的增加，Lambda 函数在检索数据时遇到了速率限制错误。Lambda 函数每次调用都会从 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中检索一个高级参数。该参数仅在新部署期间更改。由于应用程序的使用量不可预测，开发人员需要一种方法来避免速率限制。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 Lambda 函数，使其使用预留的并发数，该并发数等于上个月的平均并发调用数。
options.B: 向参数存储调用添加指数退避重试机制。
options.C: 请求增加参数存储 GetParameter API 操作的服务配额，以匹配 Lambda 函数的预期使用量。
options.D: 在 CloudFormation 模板中，将 SSM 动态引用作为环境变量添加到 Lambda 函数资源。

zh.explanation:
# Lambda 速率限制于 SSM Parameter Store 调用

## 场景
一个 Lambda 函数在每次调用时都会调用 SSM Parameter Store 来检索一个**高级参数**。随着流量增长，调用达到 Parameter Store 限流限制。重要的是，参数值仅在部署期间更改——因此在每次调用时调用 Parameter Store 是浪费。开发人员需要**最具成本效益**的解决方案。

## 正确答案：D — 在 CloudFormation 模板中使用 SSM 动态参考作为环境变量

通过将参数值放入 Lambda 函数的环境变量中，使用 CloudFormation SSM 动态参考（`{{resolve:ssm:parameter-name:version}}`）或 `AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<String>` 模板参数，CloudFormation 会在栈创建/更新时**解析 SSM 值一次**，并将其嵌入到 Lambda 的环境配置中。

动态参考提供了一种方便的方式来指定存储和管理在其他服务中的外部值，并将敏感信息与基础设施即代码模板分离。CloudFormation 在栈和更改集操作期间在必要时检索指定参考的值。

因为参数仅在部署期间更改，这与重新部署生命周期完全一致——每次新部署都刷新环境变量，运行时不再调用 SSM。结果：
- **零运行时 SSM API 调用** → 无限流错误
- **无额外成本**（环境变量免费；无扩展、无预留并发）

CloudFormation 代码片段示例：
```yaml
Resources:
  MyFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Environment:
        Variables:
          MY_PARAM: '{{resolve:ssm:/app/myparam:1}}'
```

## 为什么其他选项错误

**A. 预留并发等于上月平均并发调用数**
这实际上*限制*（上限）Lambda 并发，会对函数本身进行限流，不能解决 Parameter Store 限流。预留并发不会减少每次调用对 SSM 的调用——每次调用仍然会调用 GetParameter。它会降低可用性而不解决根本原因。

**B. 使用指数退避重试**
重试不会减少 GetParameter 调用次数；实际上，在高负载下会*增加*调用次数并增加延迟。函数仍然会不断达到 SSM TPS 配额并最终失败。这治疗的是症状，而非根本原因。

**C. 请求提高 GetParameter 的服务配额**
这可能有所帮助，但它不是**最具成本效益**的解决方案。Parameter Store 默认具有较低的吞吐量配额（每秒 40 个），每次需要时读取该值也会增加延迟。更高层级（高级）参数吞吐量按每个 API 交互计费。参数很少更改，所以为近乎静态值的高吞吐量读取付费是浪费，当你可以在部署时简单地加载一次时。它也不会消除每个 Lambda 调用上的不必要延迟。

## 关键参考
- [CloudFormation SSM 动态参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/dynamic-references-ssm.html)
- [CloudFormation 动态参考概览](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/dynamic-references.html)
- [在 Lambda 函数中使用 Parameter Store 参数](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/ps-integration-lambda-extensions.html)

en.question: A developer is using an AWS Lambda function to process data. The developer needs to extract custom metrics about processing times from the Lambda logs. The developer needs to analyze the metrics, set alarms, and detect issues in real time. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Publish custom metric data to AWS CloudTrail by using the PutMetricData API operation. Classify and collect the metrics. Create graphs and alarms in CloudTrail for the custom metrics.
options.B: Use the open source client libraries provided by Amazon to generate the logs in the Amazon CloudWatch embedded metric format. Use CloudWatch to create the required graphs and alarms for the custom metrics.
options.C: Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights to create custom metrics by querying the logs that come from the Lambda function. Use CloudWatch to create the required graphs and alarms for the custom metrics.
options.D: Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream to stream log events in real time from Lambda. Specify an Amazon S3 bucket as the destination for the Kinesis data stream. Use Amazon CloudWatch to visualize the log data and to set alarms.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer needs to extract **custom metrics** (processing times) from **AWS Lambda logs**, then **graph, alarm, and detect issues in real time**. The question asks for the most direct, efficient solution.

## Correct Answer: B

**Use the open-source [aws-embedded-metrics](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-embedded-metrics-node) client libraries to write logs in the [CloudWatch Embedded Metric Format (EMF)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch_Embedded_Metric_Format.html), then graph and alarm in CloudWatch.**

The CloudWatch embedded metric format is a JSON specification that instructs CloudWatch Logs to **automatically extract metric values** embedded in structured log events. When a Lambda function writes EMF-formatted JSON to stdout, CloudWatch Logs ingests it, detects the `_aws` metadata, and asynchronously publishes the values as native CloudWatch metrics — with **no extra `PutMetricData` API calls**, no added latency, and no throttling concerns. These extracted metrics are immediately available for **graphs, alarms, and real-time incident detection**, while the original log events remain queryable in CloudWatch Logs Insights.

Example EMF document:

```json
{
  "_aws": {
    "Timestamp": 1574109732004,
    "CloudWatchMetrics": [{
      "Namespace": "lambda-function-metrics",
      "Dimensions": [["functionVersion"]],
      "Metrics": [{ "Name": "ProcessingTime", "Unit": "Milliseconds" }]
    }]
  },
  "functionVersion": "$LATEST",
  "ProcessingTime": 100,
  "requestId": "989ffbf8-9ace-4817-a57c-e4dd734019ee"
}
```

This perfectly matches the requirement: extract custom processing-time metrics from Lambda logs, then analyze, alarm, and detect issues in real time.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Publish to AWS CloudTrail via `PutMetricData`** — Wrong service. `PutMetricData` is a **CloudWatch** API, not CloudTrail. CloudTrail records API calls for audit/governance; it does not store custom application metrics, nor does it provide graphs or alarms for them.

- **C. CloudWatch Logs Insights to "create custom metrics"** — Logs Insights is an **interactive query/analytics tool** for log data. It does **not create CloudWatch metrics** that can be alarmed on directly. To turn log data into a metric you need a metric filter or EMF; Insights queries are run on demand and are not a real-time metric/alarm source. (Metric filters could turn logs into metrics, but the option as written specifies Logs Insights, which doesn't produce persistent metrics.)

- **D. Kinesis Data Stream → S3, then visualize in CloudWatch** — Overly complex and wrong target. Streaming logs to S3 does not produce CloudWatch metrics, and CloudWatch cannot natively "visualize" data sitting in an S3 bucket. This adds latency and infrastructure with no real-time alarming on processing-time metrics.

## References

- [Embedding metrics within logs (CloudWatch EMF)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch_Embedded_Metric_Format.html)
- [EMF Specification](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch_Embedded_Metric_Format_Specification.html)
- [aws-embedded-metrics-node (open-source client library)](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-embedded-metrics-node)
- [aws-embedded-metrics-python](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-embedded-metrics-python)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在使用 AWS Lambda 函数处理数据。他需要从 Lambda 日志中提取有关处理时间的自定义指标。开发人员需要分析这些指标、设置警报并实时检测问题。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 PutMetricData API 操作将自定义指标数据发布到 AWS CloudTrail。对指标进行分类和收集。在 CloudTrail 中为自定义指标创建图表和警报。
options.B: 使用亚马逊提供的开源客户端库，以亚马逊 CloudWatch 嵌入式指标格式生成日志。使用 CloudWatch 为自定义指标创建所需的图表和警报。
options.C: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights 查询 Lambda 函数生成的日志，创建自定义指标。使用 CloudWatch 为这些自定义指标创建所需的图表和警报。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon Kinesis 数据流，用于从 Lambda 函数实时传输日志事件。指定 Amazon S3 存储桶作为 Kinesis 数据流的目标位置。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 可视化日志数据并设置警报。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一个开发者需要从 **AWS Lambda 日志**中提取**自定义指标**（处理时间），然后**绘制图表、设置告警并实时检测问题**。问题要求找到最直接、高效的解决方案。

## 正确答案：B

**使用开源 [aws-embedded-metrics](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-embedded-metrics-node) 客户端库，以 [CloudWatch Embedded Metric Format (EMF)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch_Embedded_Metric_Format.html) 格式写入日志，然后在 CloudWatch 中绘制图表和设置告警。**

CloudWatch 嵌入式指标格式是一个 JSON 规范，它指示 CloudWatch Logs **自动从结构化日志事件中提取指标值**。当 Lambda 函数将 EMF 格式的 JSON 写入 stdout 时，CloudWatch Logs 会摄入它，检测 `_aws` 元数据，并异步地将这些值发布为原生 CloudWatch 指标 — **无需额外的 `PutMetricData` API 调用**、无增加延迟、无限流问题。这些提取的指标可立即用于**图表、告警和实时事件检测**，同时原始日志事件仍可在 CloudWatch Logs Insights 中查询。

EMF 文档示例：

```json
{
  "_aws": {
    "Timestamp": 1574109732004,
    "CloudWatchMetrics": [{
      "Namespace": "lambda-function-metrics",
      "Dimensions": [["functionVersion"]],
      "Metrics": [{ "Name": "ProcessingTime", "Unit": "Milliseconds" }]
    }]
  },
  "functionVersion": "$LATEST",
  "ProcessingTime": 100,
  "requestId": "989ffbf8-9ace-4817-a57c-e4dd734019ee"
}
```

这完美满足需求：从 Lambda 日志中提取自定义处理时间指标，然后分析、告警和实时检测问题。

## 其他选项为什么错误

- **A. 通过 `PutMetricData` 发布到 AWS CloudTrail** — 错误的服务。`PutMetricData` 是 **CloudWatch** API，不是 CloudTrail。CloudTrail 记录 API 调用以供审计/治理之用；它不存储自定义应用指标，也不提供图表或告警功能。

- **C. 使用 CloudWatch Logs Insights 来"创建自定义指标"** — Logs Insights 是一个**交互式查询/分析工具**，用于日志数据。它**不创建**可直接告警的 CloudWatch 指标。要将日志数据转换为指标，需要使用指标过滤器或 EMF；Logs Insights 查询是按需运行的，不是实时指标/告警来源。（指标过滤器可以将日志转换为指标，但选项中指定的是 Logs Insights，它不产生持久指标。）

- **D. Kinesis Data Stream → S3，然后在 CloudWatch 中可视化** — 过度复杂且目标错误。将日志流式传输到 S3 不会生成 CloudWatch 指标，CloudWatch 也无法原生"可视化"存放在 S3 桶中的数据。这增加了延迟和基础设施成本，但无法对处理时间指标进行实时告警。

## 参考资源

- [在日志中嵌入指标 (CloudWatch EMF)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch_Embedded_Metric_Format.html)
- [EMF 规范](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch_Embedded_Metric_Format_Specification.html)
- [aws-embedded-metrics-node (开源客户端库)](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-embedded-metrics-node)
- [aws-embedded-metrics-python](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-embedded-metrics-python)

en.question: A developer needs to fix an AWS CodeDeploy deployment that failed. During the failed deployment, the developer received the following error message: “The overall deployment failed because too many individual instances failed deployment, too few healthy instances are available for deployment, or some instances in your deployment group are experiencing problems. (Error code: HEALTH-CONSTRAINTS)” What are the possible causes of the failed deployment? (Choose two.)

options.A: The CodeDeploy agent was not running on the instances that CodeDeploy was trying to deploy to.
options.B: The unified Amazon CloudWatch agent was not running on the instances that CodeDeploy was trying to deploy to.
options.C: The developer’s IAM role did not have the necessary permissions to perform code deployment to the instances.
options.D: CodeDeploy was trying to deploy to instances that were attached to an IAM instance profile that did not have the required permissions.
options.E: CodeDeploy was trying to deploy to instances that were not set up with correct CodeDeploy health checks.

en.explanation:
# CodeDeploy HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS Error Analysis

## Scenario
A CodeDeploy deployment failed with error code `HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS`. This error means the deployment failed on too many instances within the health constraints specified for the deployment group. HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS: The deployment failed on too many instances to be successfully deployed within the instance health constraints specified.

The question asks for **two** possible causes from the AWS troubleshooting guidance.

## Correct Answers: A and E

### A. CodeDeploy agent was not running on the instances ✅
This is the **first cause** documented in the AWS troubleshooting guide. If all lifecycle events of an EC2 or on-premises deployment are skipped, you might receive an error similar to "The overall deployment failed because too many individual instances failed deployment, too few healthy instances are available for deployment, or some instances in your deployment group are experiencing problems." (Error code: HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS). Here are some possible causes and solutions: The CodeDeploy agent might not be installed or running on the instance.

If the agent isn't running, the instance cannot poll for and execute deployment commands, leading to lifecycle events being skipped and the overall deployment failing health constraints.

### E. Instances were not set up with correct CodeDeploy health checks ✅
The HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS error is by definition tied to the deployment group's instance health constraints / minimum healthy hosts configuration. Error Code: HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS — Message: Deployment could not continue: Constraint 'default' requires a minimum of 1 healthy hosts to continue. Remaining hosts are skipped. All this means is the deployment failed on >0 hosts, which is the "constraint" in the application settings. Misconfigured health checks (or instances unable to satisfy the configured `MinimumHealthyHosts`) directly trigger this error code.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

### B. Unified CloudWatch agent was not running ❌
The CloudWatch agent has **no role** in CodeDeploy execution. CodeDeploy relies on the **CodeDeploy agent** (`codedeploy-agent`), not the CloudWatch agent, to pull and execute deployment lifecycle hooks. CloudWatch is only used for optional alarms/monitoring and would never produce a HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS error.

### C. Developer's IAM role lacked permissions ❌
If the developer (the principal calling `CreateDeployment`) lacked IAM permissions, the API call itself would fail with an **AccessDenied / authorization error** at submission time — the deployment would never start, so it could not produce a HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS error which occurs *during* deployment to instances. The associated error code would be `IAM_ROLE_PERMISSIONS` or `IAM_ROLE_MISSING`, not HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS. Valid Values: ... IAM_ROLE_MISSING | IAM_ROLE_PERMISSIONS | ... HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS — these are distinct error codes.

### D. Instance profile lacked required permissions ❌
While missing instance profile permissions is a real CodeDeploy problem, it manifests differently. The CodeDeploy agent would log a "Missing credentials" error, and AWS surfaces this as a separate condition (CommandPoller missing credentials), typically yielding `IAM_ROLE_PERMISSIONS` style failures rather than HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS as the documented root-cause category in the troubleshooting guide for this specific error message. The official AWS troubleshooting page for HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS lists the **agent not installed/running** and network reachability — not instance profile permissions — as the documented causes. If the CodeDeploy agent is not installed or running, see Verify the CodeDeploy agent is running. Your instance might not be able to reach the CodeDeploy or Amazon S3 public endpoint using port 443.

## References
- [Troubleshoot EC2/On-Premises deployment issues - AWS CodeDeploy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/troubleshooting-deployments.html)
- [ErrorInformation - AWS CodeDeploy API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/APIReference/API_ErrorInformation.html)
- [Error codes for AWS CodeDeploy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/error-codes.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员需要修复一个失败的 AWS CodeDeploy 部署。在部署失败期间，开发人员收到以下错误消息： “整体部署失败，原因是部署失败的实例过多、可用于部署的健康实例过少，或者部署组中的某些实例出现问题。（错误代码：HEALTH-CONSTRAINTS）” 导致部署失败的可能原因有哪些？（选择两个。）

options.A: CodeDeploy 代理程序没有在 CodeDeploy 尝试部署到的实例上运行。
options.B: CodeDeploy 尝试部署到的实例上没有运行统一的 Amazon CloudWatch 代理。
options.C: 开发人员的 IAM 角色没有执行代码部署到实例所需的权限。
options.D: CodeDeploy 尝试部署到附加到没有所需权限的 IAM 实例配置文件的实例上。
options.E: CodeDeploy 尝试部署到未正确设置 CodeDeploy 健康检查的实例上。

zh.explanation:
# CodeDeploy HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS 错误分析

## 场景
CodeDeploy 部署失败，错误代码为 `HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS`。此错误表示部署在太多实例上失败，超过了为部署组指定的健康约束。HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS: 部署在过多实例上失败，无法在指定的实例健康约束内成功部署。

问题要求从 AWS 故障排除指南中找出**两个**可能的原因。

## 正确答案：A 和 E

### A. CodeDeploy agent 在实例上未运行 ✅
这是 AWS 故障排除指南中记录的**第一个原因**。如果 EC2 或本地部署的所有生命周期事件都被跳过，您可能会收到类似"总体部署失败，因为太多个别实例部署失败、可用的健康实例不足或部署组中的某些实例出现问题"的错误。（错误代码：HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS）。以下是一些可能的原因和解决方案：CodeDeploy agent 可能未安装或在实例上运行。

如果 agent 未运行，实例无法轮询和执行部署命令，导致生命周期事件被跳过，整体部署失败，无法满足健康约束。

### E. 实例未配置正确的 CodeDeploy 健康检查 ✅
HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS 错误从定义上讲与部署组的实例健康约束/最小健康主机数配置相关。错误代码：HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS — 消息：部署无法继续：约束"default"需要至少 1 个健康主机才能继续。其余主机被跳过。这只是意味着部署在 >0 个主机上失败，这是应用程序设置中的"约束"。配置错误的健康检查（或实例无法满足已配置的 `MinimumHealthyHosts`）直接触发此错误代码。

## 为什么其他选项错误

### B. Unified CloudWatch agent 未运行 ❌
CloudWatch agent **不参与** CodeDeploy 执行。CodeDeploy 依靠 **CodeDeploy agent**（`codedeploy-agent`）而不是 CloudWatch agent 来拉取和执行部署生命周期钩子。CloudWatch 仅用于可选的告警/监控，永远不会产生 HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS 错误。

### C. 开发者的 IAM 角色缺少权限 ❌
如果开发者（调用 `CreateDeployment` 的主体）缺少 IAM 权限，API 调用本身会在提交时失败，出现 **AccessDenied / 授权错误** — 部署永远不会启动，因此无法产生在部署到实例*期间*发生的 HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS 错误。相关的错误代码将是 `IAM_ROLE_PERMISSIONS` 或 `IAM_ROLE_MISSING`，而非 HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS。有效值：... IAM_ROLE_MISSING | IAM_ROLE_PERMISSIONS | ... HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS — 这些是不同的错误代码。

### D. 实例配置文件缺少所需权限 ❌
虽然缺少实例配置文件权限是真实的 CodeDeploy 问题，但它会以不同方式表现。CodeDeploy agent 会记录"缺少凭证"错误，AWS 将其表现为单独的条件（CommandPoller 缺少凭证），通常会产生 `IAM_ROLE_PERMISSIONS` 类型的失败，而不是根据此特定错误消息的故障排除指南，HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS 作为记录的根本原因类别。官方 AWS HEALTH_CONSTRAINTS 故障排除页面列出了 **agent 未安装/未运行**和网络可达性 — 而不是实例配置文件权限 — 作为本错误的记录原因。如果 CodeDeploy agent 未安装或未运行，请参阅验证 CodeDeploy agent 正在运行。您的实例可能无法使用端口 443 到达 CodeDeploy 或 Amazon S3 公有端点。

## 参考资源
- [EC2/本地部署问题故障排除 - AWS CodeDeploy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/troubleshooting-deployments.html)
- [ErrorInformation - AWS CodeDeploy API 参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/APIReference/API_ErrorInformation.html)
- [AWS CodeDeploy 错误代码](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/error-codes.html)

en.question: A company is developing a serverless application that requires storage of sensitive API keys as environment variables for various services. The application requires the automatic rotation of the encryption keys every year. Which solution will meet these requirements with no development effort?

options.A: Encrypt the environment variables by using AWS Secrets Manager. Set up automatic rotation in Secrets Manager.
options.B: Encrypt the environment variables by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed keys. Enable automatic key rotation.
options.C: Encrypt the environment variables by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed keys. Configure a custom AWS Lambda function to automate key rotation.
options.D: Encrypt the environment variables by using AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Set up automatic rotation in Parameter Store.

en.explanation:
## Scenario Analysis

A serverless application needs to store sensitive API keys **as environment variables**. The requirement is automatic rotation of the **encryption keys** (the keys that encrypt the env vars) every year, with **no development effort**.

The key phrasing matters:
- "API keys as environment variables" → Lambda environment variables
- "automatic rotation of the **encryption keys**" → rotating the KMS key material, not the secret values
- "no development effort" → no Lambda rotation function to write

## Correct Answer: B

Lambda environment variables are always encrypted at rest with a KMS key. By default, Lambda uses an AWS managed key, but you can supply a **customer managed key** (CMK) instead. Lambda always provides server-side encryption at rest with an AWS KMS key. By default, Lambda uses an AWS managed key. If you prefer, you can provide an AWS KMS customer managed key instead. You might do this to have control over rotation of the KMS key or to meet the requirements of your organization for managing KMS keys.

For customer managed KMS keys, you can enable automatic key rotation. By default, when you enable automatic rotation of a customer managed KMS key, AWS KMS rotates the key material of the KMS key one year (approximately 365 days) from the enable date and every year thereafter. This is a single configuration setting — **no code, no Lambda rotation function** — directly meeting the "no development effort" requirement.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**A. Secrets Manager with automatic rotation** — Secrets Manager rotates **the secret value itself** (e.g., generating new credentials), not the KMS encryption key. Furthermore, automatic rotation in Secrets Manager for arbitrary secrets like third-party API keys requires you to **author and maintain a Lambda rotation function**, which is significant development effort. The question also explicitly asks for env-var storage, not Secrets Manager retrieval.

**C. AWS managed KMS keys + custom Lambda for rotation** — You cannot enable or disable automatic rotation of AWS managed KMS keys. AWS KMS always rotates the key material of AWS managed keys every year. So a custom Lambda for rotation is unnecessary, and the answer wording explicitly requires "custom Lambda function" = development effort, violating the requirement.

**D. Systems Manager Parameter Store with automatic rotation** — Parameter Store does **not** offer a built-in "automatic rotation" feature like Secrets Manager. There is no native rotation toggle. To rotate secrets in Parameter Store you must build your own automation (EventBridge + Lambda), which is development effort. The option's premise is factually incorrect.

## Reference Documentation

- [Securing Lambda environment variables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-envvars-encryption.html)
- [Rotating AWS KMS keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotate-keys.html)
- [EnableKeyRotation API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/APIReference/API_EnableKeyRotation.html)
- [Encryption best practices for AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/encryption-best-practices/lambda.html)

zh.question: 一家公司正在开发一款无服务器应用程序，该应用程序需要将敏感的 API 密钥作为环境变量存储，以供各种服务使用。该应用程序还要求每年自动轮换加密密钥。哪种解决方案无需任何开发工作即可满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Secrets Manager 加密环境变量。在 Secrets Manager 中设置自动轮换。
options.B: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户管理的密钥加密环境变量。启用自动密钥轮换。
options.C: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 托管密钥加密环境变量。配置自定义 AWS Lambda 函数以实现密钥轮换自动化。
options.D: 使用 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 对环境变量进行加密。在 Parameter Store 中设置自动轮换。

zh.explanation:
## 场景分析

一个无服务器应用程序需要将敏感的 API 密钥**存储为环境变量**。要求是每年**自动轮换加密密钥**（加密环境变量的密钥），**无需开发工作**。

关键措辞很重要：
- "API 密钥作为环境变量" → Lambda 环境变量
- "自动轮换**加密密钥**" → 轮换 KMS 密钥材料，而不是密钥值本身
- "无需开发工作" → 无需编写 Lambda 轮换函数

## 正确答案：B

Lambda 环境变量始终使用 KMS 密钥进行静态加密。默认情况下，Lambda 使用 AWS 托管密钥，但您可以改为提供**客户托管密钥** (CMK)。Lambda 始终使用 AWS KMS 密钥提供静态服务器端加密。默认情况下，Lambda 使用 AWS 托管密钥。如果您愿意，可以改为提供 AWS KMS 客户托管密钥。您可能需要这样做以控制 KMS 密钥的轮换或满足组织对 KMS 密钥管理的要求。

对于客户托管的 KMS 密钥，您可以启用自动密钥轮换。默认情况下，当您启用客户托管 KMS 密钥的自动轮换时，AWS KMS 从启用日期起大约一年（约 365 天）轮换一次 KMS 密钥的密钥材料，之后每年轮换一次。这是一个单一的配置设置 — **无需代码，无需 Lambda 轮换函数** — 直接满足"无需开发工作"的要求。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**A. Secrets Manager 自动轮换** — Secrets Manager 轮换的是**密钥值本身**（例如，生成新凭证），而不是 KMS 加密密钥。此外，Secrets Manager 对任意密钥（如第三方 API 密钥）的自动轮换需要您**编写和维护 Lambda 轮换函数**，这是大量开发工作。问题还明确要求存储在环境变量中，而不是从 Secrets Manager 检索。

**C. AWS 托管 KMS 密钥 + 自定义 Lambda 轮换** — 您无法启用或禁用 AWS 托管 KMS 密钥的自动轮换。AWS KMS 始终每年轮换 AWS 托管密钥的密钥材料。因此，自定义 Lambda 轮换是不必要的，答案措辞明确要求"自定义 Lambda 函数" = 开发工作，违反了要求。

**D. Systems Manager Parameter Store 自动轮换** — Parameter Store **不**提供内置的"自动轮换"功能，如 Secrets Manager 那样。没有本机轮换开关。要轮换 Parameter Store 中的密钥，您必须构建自己的自动化（EventBridge + Lambda），这是开发工作。该选项的前提在事实上是不正确的。

## 参考文档

- [保护 Lambda 环境变量](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-envvars-encryption.html)
- [轮换 AWS KMS 密钥](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotate-keys.html)
- [EnableKeyRotation API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/APIReference/API_EnableKeyRotation.html)
- [AWS Lambda 加密最佳实践](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/encryption-best-practices/lambda.html)

en.question: A developer built an application that uses AWS Lambda functions to process images. The developer wants to improve image processing times throughout the day. The developer needs to create an Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights query that shows the average, slowest, and fastest processing time in 1-minute intervals. Which query will meet these requirements?

options.A:
```
filter @type = "REPORT" |
    stats avg(@duration), max(@duration), min(@duration) by bin(1m)
```
options.B:
```
filter @type = "DISPLAY" |
    stats avg(@duration), max(@duration), min(@duration) by bin(5m)
```
options.C:
```
filter @type = "STATS" |
    stats avg(@duration), max(@duration), min(@duration) by bin(5m)
```
options.D:
```
filter @type = "PATTERN" |
    stats avg(@duration), max(@duration), min(@duration) by bin(1m)
```

en.explanation:
# Lambda Performance Query in CloudWatch Logs Insights

## Scenario
The developer wants to monitor Lambda image processing performance over the day, computing the **average, slowest (max), and fastest (min)** processing time, grouped into **1-minute intervals**.

## Why A is correct
Each Lambda invocation emits a `REPORT` log line at the end of execution that includes runtime metadata such as `Duration`, `Billed Duration`, `Memory Size`, `Max Memory Used`, and `Init Duration`. CloudWatch Logs Insights automatically discovers these as standard fields prefixed with `@`, including `@type`, `@duration`, `@billedDuration`, `@maxMemoryUsed`, and `@memorySize` ([Viewing CloudWatch logs for Lambda functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/monitoring-cloudwatchlogs-view.html)).

To get average, slowest, and fastest runtimes per minute, you filter on `@type = "REPORT"` (so you only consider invocation summary lines) and aggregate `@duration` with `avg`, `max`, and `min`, grouping with `bin(1m)`:

```
filter @type = "REPORT"
| stats avg(@duration), max(@duration), min(@duration) by bin(1m)
```

This is exactly the query published in the official [aws-samples/cloudwatch-logs-insights-queries](https://github.com/aws-samples/cloudwatch-logs-insights-queries) repository, where the same construct is provided to view Lambda latency stats — only the bin width changes (1m vs 5m) depending on desired granularity. The question explicitly requires **1-minute** intervals, so `bin(1m)` is required.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **B. `filter @type = "DISPLAY" | ... by bin(5m)`** — There is no `DISPLAY` value for `@type` in Lambda logs. Lambda only emits `START`, `END`, and `REPORT` types. Additionally, `bin(5m)` does not satisfy the requirement of 1-minute intervals.

- **C. `filter @type = "STATS" | ... by bin(5m)`** — `STATS` is not a valid `@type` value for Lambda log entries (`stats` is the Logs Insights aggregation command, not a log type). Also `bin(5m)` is the wrong interval.

- **D. `filter @type = "PATTERN" | ... by bin(1m)`** — `PATTERN` is not a valid value for Lambda's `@type` field. (`pattern` is a separate Logs Insights command for log pattern detection, not a `@type` value.) The filter would match no records, returning empty results.

## Key takeaway
For Lambda performance analysis in CloudWatch Logs Insights, always filter `@type = "REPORT"` to access the duration/memory metrics emitted at the end of each invocation, and use `bin(<interval>)` with the `stats` command to aggregate at the desired time granularity.

## References
- [Viewing CloudWatch logs for Lambda functions — AWS Lambda Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/monitoring-cloudwatchlogs-view.html)
- [Operating Lambda: Using CloudWatch Logs Insights — AWS Compute Blog](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/operating-lambda-using-cloudwatch-logs-insights/)
- [aws-samples/cloudwatch-logs-insights-queries (GitHub)](https://github.com/aws-samples/cloudwatch-logs-insights-queries)

zh.question: 一位开发人员构建了一个使用 AWS Lambda 函数处理图像的应用程序。该开发人员希望提高全天的图像处理速度。他需要创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights 查询，以 1 分钟为间隔显示平均、最慢和最快的处理时间。哪个查询能够满足这些要求？

options.A:
```
filter @type = "REPORT" |
    stats avg(@duration), max(@duration), min(@duration) by bin(1m)
```
options.B:
```
filter @type = "DISPLAY" |
    stats avg(@duration), max(@duration), min(@duration) by bin(5m)
```
options.C:
```
filter @type = "STATS" |
    stats avg(@duration), max(@duration), min(@duration) by bin(5m)
```
options.D:
```
filter @type = "PATTERN" |
    stats avg(@duration), max(@duration), min(@duration) by bin(1m)
```

zh.explanation:
# CloudWatch Logs Insights 中的 Lambda 性能查询

## 场景
开发人员想要监控 Lambda 图像处理在一天内的性能，计算**平均、最慢（最大）和最快（最小）**处理时间，并分组为**1分钟的时间间隔**。

## 为什么 A 是正确的
每次 Lambda 调用在执行结束时会发出一条 `REPORT` 日志行，其中包含 `Duration`、`Billed Duration`、`Memory Size`、`Max Memory Used` 和 `Init Duration` 等运行时元数据。CloudWatch Logs Insights 会自动将这些字段识别为以 `@` 为前缀的标准字段，包括 `@type`、`@duration`、`@billedDuration`、`@maxMemoryUsed` 和 `@memorySize`（[查看 Lambda 函数的 CloudWatch 日志](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/monitoring-cloudwatchlogs-view.html)）。

要获得每分钟的平均、最慢和最快运行时间，您需要对 `@type = "REPORT"` 进行筛选（仅考虑调用摘要行），并使用 `avg`、`max` 和 `min` 聚合 `@duration`，按 `bin(1m)` 分组：

```
filter @type = "REPORT"
| stats avg(@duration), max(@duration), min(@duration) by bin(1m)
```

这正是官方 [aws-samples/cloudwatch-logs-insights-queries](https://github.com/aws-samples/cloudwatch-logs-insights-queries) 存储库中发布的查询，该存储库提供了相同的构造来查看 Lambda 延迟统计信息 — 唯一的区别是 bin 宽度会根据所需的粒度更改（1m 与 5m）。问题明确要求**1分钟**的时间间隔，因此需要 `bin(1m)`。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **B. `filter @type = "DISPLAY" | ... by bin(5m)`** — Lambda 日志中没有 `DISPLAY` 值用于 `@type`。Lambda 只发出 `START`、`END` 和 `REPORT` 类型。此外，`bin(5m)` 不满足1分钟间隔的要求。

- **C. `filter @type = "STATS" | ... by bin(5m)`** — `STATS` 不是 Lambda 日志条目的有效 `@type` 值（`stats` 是 Logs Insights 聚合命令，不是日志类型）。同样，`bin(5m)` 是错误的时间间隔。

- **D. `filter @type = "PATTERN" | ... by bin(1m)`** — `PATTERN` 不是 Lambda 的 `@type` 字段的有效值。（`pattern` 是 Logs Insights 中用于日志模式检测的独立命令，不是 `@type` 值。）该筛选器将不匹配任何记录，返回空结果。

## 关键要点
对于 CloudWatch Logs Insights 中的 Lambda 性能分析，始终筛选 `@type = "REPORT"` 以访问每次调用结束时发出的持续时间/内存指标，并在 `stats` 命令中使用 `bin(<interval>)` 在所需的时间粒度下进行聚合。

## 参考资源
- [查看 Lambda 函数的 CloudWatch 日志 — AWS Lambda 开发者指南](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/monitoring-cloudwatchlogs-view.html)
- [Operating Lambda: Using CloudWatch Logs Insights — AWS Compute Blog](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/operating-lambda-using-cloudwatch-logs-insights/)
- [aws-samples/cloudwatch-logs-insights-queries (GitHub)](https://github.com/aws-samples/cloudwatch-logs-insights-queries)

en.question: An application stores user data in Amazon S3 buckets in multiple AWS Regions. A developer needs to implement a solution that analyzes the user data in the S3 buckets to find sensitive information. The analysis findings from all the S3 buckets must be available in the eu-west-2 Region. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to generate findings. Program the Lambda function to send the findings to another S3 bucket in eu-west-2.
options.B: Configure Amazon Macie to generate findings. Use Amazon EventBridge to create rules that copy the findings to eu-west-2.
options.C: Configure Amazon Inspector to generate findings. Use Amazon EventBridge to create rules that copy the findings to eu-west-2.
options.D: Configure Amazon Macie to generate findings and to publish the findings to AWS CloudTrail. Use a CloudTrail trail to copy the results to eu-west-2.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

An application stores user data in S3 buckets across multiple AWS Regions. A developer needs to find sensitive information (e.g., PII) in those buckets, and aggregate the analysis findings into the **eu-west-2** Region. The requirement is to do this with the **least development effort**.

## Correct Answer: B — Configure Amazon Macie + EventBridge rules

**Amazon Macie** is the AWS managed service purpose-built for discovering sensitive data in S3. Amazon Macie is a data security service that discovers sensitive data by using machine learning and pattern matching, provides visibility into data security risks, and enables automated protection against those risks. Because Macie is a regional service, you enable it in each region where the S3 buckets reside.

To aggregate findings to eu-west-2 with minimal development effort, leverage Macie's native integration with EventBridge. To support integration with other applications, services, and systems, such as monitoring or event management systems, Amazon Macie automatically publishes findings to Amazon EventBridge as events. You can then create EventBridge rules that forward (cross-region) these `Macie Finding` events to an event bus in eu-west-2 — no custom code required. By default Macie automatically publishes policy and sensitive data findings to Amazon EventBridge as events and publishes policy findings to Security Hub.

This combination (managed sensitive data discovery + managed cross-region event routing) is the lowest-effort solution.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. Custom Lambda function to generate findings.** Writing a Lambda that scans S3 objects for sensitive data (PII, credit cards, etc.) means re-implementing what Macie already does — you would need to build pattern matching, ML detectors, scaling logic, and aggregation. This is the *opposite* of "least development effort."

- **C. Amazon Inspector.** Inspector is a vulnerability assessment service for **EC2 instances, Lambda functions, and ECR container images**. It does **not** scan S3 objects for sensitive data. It produces no findings about PII in S3 buckets, so it cannot meet the requirement.

- **D. Macie publishing findings to CloudTrail; CloudTrail trail to copy results.** Macie does **not** publish findings *to* CloudTrail. CloudTrail records API activity (management/data events) — it is an audit log, not a delivery mechanism for service findings. While a CloudTrail multi-region trail can deliver log files to a single S3 bucket, that mechanism doesn't carry Macie findings. The described pipeline is technically incorrect.

## Reference Architecture

```
S3 buckets (multiple regions)
        │
        ▼
   Amazon Macie  (per region)
        │  publishes "Macie Finding" events
        ▼
   EventBridge (source region)
        │  rule with target = event bus in eu-west-2
        ▼
   EventBridge (eu-west-2)  →  S3 / Lambda / SNS / Security Hub
```

## References

- [What is Amazon Macie?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)
- [Amazon EventBridge event schema for Macie findings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/findings-publish-event-schemas.html)
- [Sending and receiving events between AWS Regions (EventBridge cross-region)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-cross-region.html)
- [Amazon Inspector — what is scanned](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)

zh.question: 一个应用程序将用户数据存储在多个 AWS 区域的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。开发人员需要实现一个解决方案，用于分析 S3 存储桶中的用户数据以查找敏感信息。所有 S3 存储桶的分析结果必须可在 eu-west-2 区域访问。哪种解决方案能够以最少的开发工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来生成结果。编写 Lambda 函数，将结果发送到 eu-west-2 中的另一个 S3 存储桶。
options.B: 配置 Amazon Macie 以生成结果。使用 Amazon EventBridge 创建规则，将结果复制到 eu-west-2。
options.C: 配置 Amazon Inspector 以生成发现结果。使用 Amazon EventBridge 创建规则，将发现结果复制到 eu- west-2。
options.D: 配置 Amazon Macie 以生成调查结果并将调查结果发布到 AWS CloudTrail。使用 CloudTrail 跟踪将结果复制到 eu-west-2。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一个应用程序在多个 AWS 区域的 S3 存储桶中存储用户数据。开发人员需要在这些存储桶中查找敏感信息（例如 PII），并将分析结果汇总到 **eu-west-2** 区域。要求是以**最少的开发工作量**完成此操作。

## 正确答案：B — 配置 Amazon Macie + EventBridge 规则

**Amazon Macie** 是一项 AWS 托管服务，专为发现 S3 中的敏感数据而设计。Amazon Macie 是一项数据安全服务，使用机器学习和模式匹配来发现敏感数据，提供对数据安全风险的可见性，并支持针对这些风险的自动化保护。 由于 Macie 是区域服务，你需要在 S3 存储桶所在的每个区域启用它。

要以最少的开发工作量将查询结果汇总到 eu-west-2，请利用 Macie 与 EventBridge 的原生集成。为了支持与其他应用程序、服务和系统（如监控或事件管理系统）的集成，Amazon Macie 会自动将查询结果发布到 Amazon EventBridge 作为事件。 然后可以创建 EventBridge 规则，将这些 `Macie Finding` 事件转发（跨区域）到 eu-west-2 中的事件总线 — 无需自定义代码。默认情况下，Macie 会自动将策略和敏感数据查询结果发布到 Amazon EventBridge 作为事件，并将策略查询结果发布到 Security Hub。

这个组合（托管敏感数据发现 + 托管跨区域事件路由）是工作量最少的解决方案。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

- **A. 自定义 Lambda 函数来生成查询结果。** 编写一个扫描 S3 对象以查找敏感数据（PII、信用卡等）的 Lambda 函数意味着重新实现 Macie 已经做的事情 — 你需要构建模式匹配、ML 检测器、扩展逻辑和聚合功能。这与"最少的开发工作量"的目标相反。

- **C. Amazon Inspector。** Inspector 是适用于 **EC2 实例、Lambda 函数和 ECR 容器镜像**的漏洞评估服务。它**不**扫描 S3 对象中的敏感数据。它不会生成有关 S3 中 PII 的任何查询结果，因此无法满足需求。

- **D. Macie 将查询结果发布到 CloudTrail；CloudTrail 跟踪复制结果。** Macie **不会**将查询结果发布*到* CloudTrail。CloudTrail 记录 API 活动（管理/数据事件） — 它是审计日志，不是服务查询结果的传递机制。虽然 CloudTrail 多区域跟踪可以将日志文件传递到单个 S3 存储桶，但该机制不能传递 Macie 查询结果。所述管道在技术上是不正确的。

## 参考架构

```
S3 存储桶（多个区域）
        │
        ▼
   Amazon Macie  （按区域）
        │  发布"Macie Finding"事件
        ▼
   EventBridge （源区域）
        │  规则，目标 = eu-west-2 中的事件总线
        ▼
   EventBridge （eu-west-2）  →  S3 / Lambda / SNS / Security Hub
```

## 参考资源

- [What is Amazon Macie?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)
- [Amazon EventBridge event schema for Macie findings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/findings-publish-event-schemas.html)
- [Sending and receiving events between AWS Regions (EventBridge cross-region)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-cross-region.html)
- [Amazon Inspector — what is scanned](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)

en.question: An application ingests data from an Amazon Kinesis data stream. The shards in the data stream are set for normal traffic. During tests for peak traffic, the application ingests data slowly. A developer needs to adjust the data stream to handle the peak traffic. What should the developer do to meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Install the Kinesis Producer Library (KPL) to ingest data into the data stream.
options.B: Switch to on-demand capacity mode for the data stream. Specify a partition key when writing data to the data stream.
options.C: Decrease the amount of time that data is kept in the data stream by using the DecreaseStreamRetentionPeriod API operation.
options.D: Increase the shard count in the data stream by using the UpdateShardCount API operation.

en.explanation:
## Scenario Analysis

The application reads from a Kinesis Data Stream that is currently in **provisioned capacity mode** ("shards in the data stream are set for normal traffic"). During peak traffic tests, ingestion slows because the existing shard count cannot sustain the higher write throughput (each shard supports 1 MB/s write and 1,000 records/s). The developer needs to scale to handle the **known/predictable peak** in the **most cost-effective** way.

## Correct Answer: D — Increase the shard count using UpdateShardCount

Each Kinesis shard provides a fixed throughput unit. The `UpdateShardCount` API scales a provisioned-mode stream to a target shard count by performing splits/merges, while the stream remains available for reads/writes. According to the AWS API reference, "Updating the shard count is an asynchronous operation" and Kinesis returns immediately, setting the stream status to UPDATING; you can continue reading and writing during scaling ([UpdateShardCount API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kinesis/latest/APIReference/API_UpdateShardCount.html)).

For **predictable** peak traffic (as in this scheduled test), AWS explicitly states that provisioned mode is the cheaper option. The AWS Cost Modeling whitepaper says provisioned capacity mode is more cost-effective than on-demand mode for given uniform ingestion rates, and that the number of shards can be dynamically modified using `UpdateShardCount` ([Cost optimization in analytics services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/cost-modeling-data-lakes/cost-optimization-in-analytics-services.html)). The Kinesis pricing page also notes that "Provisioned mode might be best if you have predictable application traffic, run applications whose traffic is consistent or ramps gradually, or can forecast capacity requirements to control costs" ([Kinesis Pricing](https://aws.amazon.com/kinesis/data-streams/pricing/)).

```bash
aws kinesis update-shard-count \
  --stream-name my-data-stream \
  --target-shard-count 4 \
  --scaling-type UNIFORM_SCALING
```

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**A. Install the Kinesis Producer Library (KPL)** — KPL improves producer-side efficiency through batching and aggregation, but it cannot exceed the **shard-level write limits** (1 MB/s, 1,000 records/s). If shards are saturated, KPL will still hit `ProvisionedThroughputExceeded` errors. It does not add capacity to the stream, so it doesn't solve the peak-throughput bottleneck.

**B. Switch to on-demand capacity mode** — On-demand mode does scale automatically, but it is **not the most cost-effective option** for predictable traffic. AWS documentation states on-demand mode is intended for "highly variable and unpredictable application traffic" ([Choose the right mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/how-do-i-size-a-stream.html)), and provisioned mode "might be best if you have predictable application traffic" ([Pricing](https://aws.amazon.com/kinesis/data-streams/pricing/)). Additionally, on-demand mode only scales to **double the peak write throughput observed in the previous 30 days**, and traffic that increases more than 2× within 15 minutes can still be throttled — so it would not even reliably handle a sudden test peak. The Cost Modeling whitepaper explicitly says "for a given uniform data ingestion rate, the on-demand mode can be many times more expensive than provisioned mode."

**C. Decrease the data retention period** — Retention controls how long records remain readable in the stream (24 hours default, up to 365 days). It has **no effect on ingestion throughput**, which is governed solely by shard count. This addresses storage cost, not the peak ingestion bottleneck described.

## Sources
- [UpdateShardCount API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kinesis/latest/APIReference/API_UpdateShardCount.html)
- [Choose the right mode to stream in](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/how-do-i-size-a-stream.html)
- [Amazon Kinesis Data Streams Pricing](https://aws.amazon.com/kinesis/data-streams/pricing/)
- [Cost optimization in analytics services (whitepaper)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/cost-modeling-data-lakes/cost-optimization-in-analytics-services.html)
- [Kinesis Data Streams FAQs](https://aws.amazon.com/kinesis/data-streams/faqs/)

zh.question: 一个应用程序从 Amazon Kinesis 数据流中摄取数据。数据流中的分片设置为应对正常流量。在峰值流量测试期间，应用程序摄取数据的速度变慢。开发人员需要调整数据流以应对峰值流量。开发人员应该如何以最具成本效益的方式满足此要求？

options.A: 安装 Kinesis Producer Library (KPL) 以将数据摄取到数据流中。
options.B: 将数据流切换到按需容量模式。向数据流写入数据时，指定分区键。
options.C: 使用 DecreaseStreamRetentionPeriod API 操作减少数据在数据流中保留的时间。
options.D: 使用 UpdateShardCount API 操作增加数据流中的分片数。

zh.explanation:
## 场景分析

该应用程序从一个处于**预配置容量模式**的 Kinesis Data Stream 读取数据（"数据流中的分片设置为处理正常流量"）。在峰值流量测试期间，由于现有分片数无法承载更高的写入吞吐量，摄取速度减慢（每个分片支持 1 MB/s 写入和 1,000 条记录/秒）。开发人员需要扩展以处理**已知/可预测的峰值**，并采用**最具成本效益**的方式。

## 正确答案：D — 使用 UpdateShardCount 增加分片数量

每个 Kinesis 分片提供一个固定的吞吐量单位。`UpdateShardCount` API 通过执行分片拆分/合并将预配置模式的流扩展到目标分片数，同时流保持读/写可用。根据 AWS API 参考，"更新分片数量是一个异步操作"，Kinesis 立即返回，将流状态设置为 UPDATING；在扩展期间可以继续读写 ([UpdateShardCount API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kinesis/latest/APIReference/API_UpdateShardCount.html))。

对于**可预测**的峰值流量（如本计划测试），AWS 明确指出预配置模式是成本更低的选项。AWS 成本建模白皮书指出，预配置容量模式对于给定的统一摄取速率比按需模式更具成本效益，并且分片数量可以使用 `UpdateShardCount` 动态修改 ([分析服务中的成本优化](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/cost-modeling-data-lakes/cost-optimization-in-analytics-services.html))。Kinesis 定价页面也指出"如果您有可预测的应用程序流量、运行流量一致或逐步增长的应用程序，或者可以预测容量需求以控制成本，则预配置模式可能最合适" ([Kinesis 定价](https://aws.amazon.com/kinesis/data-streams/pricing/))。

```bash
aws kinesis update-shard-count \
  --stream-name my-data-stream \
  --target-shard-count 4 \
  --scaling-type UNIFORM_SCALING
```

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

**A. 安装 Kinesis Producer Library (KPL)** — KPL 通过批处理和聚合提高生产者端效率，但无法超过**分片级写入限制**（1 MB/s，1,000 条记录/秒）。如果分片饱和，KPL 仍然会遇到 `ProvisionedThroughputExceeded` 错误。它不会向流添加容量，因此无法解决峰值吞吐量瓶颈。

**B. 切换到按需容量模式** — 按需模式会自动扩展，但对于可预测的流量**不是最具成本效益的选项**。AWS 文档指出按需模式用于"高度可变且不可预测的应用程序流量" ([选择正确的模式](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/how-do-i-size-a-stream.html))，而预配置模式"如果您有可预测的应用程序流量，可能最合适" ([定价](https://aws.amazon.com/kinesis/data-streams/pricing/))。此外，按需模式只能扩展到**前 30 天观测到的峰值写入吞吐量的两倍**，在 15 分钟内增加超过 2 倍的流量仍可能被限流 — 因此甚至无法可靠地处理突然的测试峰值。成本建模白皮书明确指出"对于给定的统一数据摄取速率，按需模式可能比预配置模式贵数倍"。

**C. 降低数据保留期** — 保留期控制记录在流中保持可读的时间（默认 24 小时，最多 365 天）。它对摄取吞吐量**没有影响**，吞吐量仅由分片数量控制。这解决的是存储成本问题，而不是所述的峰值摄取瓶颈。

## 来源
- [UpdateShardCount API 参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kinesis/latest/APIReference/API_UpdateShardCount.html)
- [选择正确的模式进行流处理](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/how-do-i-size-a-stream.html)
- [Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 定价](https://aws.amazon.com/kinesis/data-streams/pricing/)
- [分析服务中的成本优化（白皮书）](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/cost-modeling-data-lakes/cost-optimization-in-analytics-services.html)
- [Kinesis Data Streams 常见问题](https://aws.amazon.com/kinesis/data-streams/faqs/)

en.question: A developer is building an application that uses an AWS Lambda function to process data. The application requires minimum latency. The Lambda function must have predictable function start times. All setup activities for the execution environment must happen before invocation of the Lambda function. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Increase the memory of the Lambda function to the maximum amount. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to schedule invocations of the Lambda function every minute to keep the execution environment active.
options.B: Optimize the static initialization code that runs when a new execution environment is prepared for the first time. Decrease and compress the size of the Lambda function package and the imported libraries and dependencies.
options.C: Increase the reserved concurrency of the Lambda function to the maximum value for unreserved account concurrency. Run any setup activities manually before the initial invocation of the Lambda function.
options.D: Publish a new version of the Lambda function. Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function with the required minimum number of execution environments.

en.explanation:
# Lambda Provisioned Concurrency for Predictable Start Times

## Scenario
The application requires:
1. **Minimum latency**
2. **Predictable function start times** (no cold start variability)
3. **All setup activities completed before invocation**

These three requirements collectively point to a single Lambda feature: **Provisioned Concurrency**.

## Correct Answer: D

Publishing a new version of the Lambda function and configuring **provisioned concurrency** on it pre-initializes a specified number of execution environments so they are ready to respond immediately.

- If you need predictable function start times for your workload, provisioned concurrency is the recommended solution to ensure the lowest possible latency.
- When you use provisioned concurrency, Lambda initializes the execution environment when you configure the PC settings for a function. Lambda also ensures that initialized execution environments are always available in advance of invocations.
- First, the execution environment set-up happens during the provisioning process, rather during execution, which eliminates this issue. Second, by keeping functions initialized, which includes initialization actions and code dependencies, there is no unnecessary initialization in subsequent invocations. Once initialized, functions are hyper-ready to respond in double digit milliseconds of being invoked.

This perfectly matches the requirement that "all setup activities for the execution environment must happen before invocation."

Provisioned concurrency is configured on a **published version or alias** of the function, which is why the answer mentions publishing a new version first.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

### A. Increase memory + EventBridge ping every minute
- Pinging Lambda with EventBridge ("warming") is an unreliable workaround. In the serverless community, there are libraries and in-house mechanisms used to "warm" Lambda via pings. However, this doesn't eliminate all cold starts, and sometimes it doesn't help in production environments when we experience spikes in traffic and need all of our concurrent environments available to serve user requests.
- It does not guarantee predictable start times. Lambda may still recycle execution environments, and any concurrent invocation beyond the warmed instance triggers a cold start.
- Increasing memory only marginally reduces init time and doesn't eliminate cold starts.

### B. Optimize static initialization and shrink package
- This **reduces** cold-start duration but does **not eliminate** it. The function still incurs init time on first invocation of any new execution environment, so start times remain unpredictable.
- It also doesn't satisfy "all setup activities must happen before invocation" — init still runs *during* the cold start path on demand.

### C. Increase reserved concurrency to maximum + manual setup
- **Reserved concurrency** is not the same as provisioned concurrency. Reserved concurrency – This sets both the maximum and minimum number of concurrent instances allocated to your function. When a function has reserved concurrency, no other function can use that concurrency. Reserved concurrency is useful for ensuring that your most critical functions always have enough concurrency to handle incoming requests.
- Reserved concurrency only **caps/guarantees a slot count**; it does not pre-initialize execution environments, so cold starts still happen.
- "Running setup activities manually" is not how Lambda execution environments work — you cannot pre-bake the runtime environment by running scripts manually.

## Reference Documentation
- [Configuring provisioned concurrency for a function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)
- [Understanding the Lambda execution environment lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtime-environment.html)
- [New for AWS Lambda – Predictable start-up times with Provisioned Concurrency](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/new-for-aws-lambda-predictable-start-up-times-with-provisioned-concurrency/)
- [Reserved vs Provisioned Concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-concurrency.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在构建一个使用 AWS Lambda 函数处理数据的应用程序。该应用程序要求最低延迟。Lambda 函数必须具有可预测的启动时间。执行环境的所有设置活动必须在调用 Lambda 函数之前完成。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 Lambda 函数的内存增加到最大值。配置 Amazon EventBridge 规则，每分钟调度一次 Lambda 函数的调用，以保持执行环境处于活动状态。
options.B: 优化首次准备新执行环境时运行的静态初始化代码。减小并压缩 Lambda 函数包以及导入的库和依赖项的大小。
options.C: 将 Lambda 函数的预留并发数增加到非预留账户并发数的最大值。在首次调用 Lambda 函数之前，手动运行所有设置活动。
options.D: 发布新版本的 Lambda 函数。为 Lambda 函数配置预置并发，并设置所需的最小执行环境数。

zh.explanation:
# Lambda 预配并发以实现可预测的启动时间

## 场景
应用程序需要：
1. **最小延迟**
2. **可预测的函数启动时间**（无冷启动变异）
3. **所有设置活动在调用前完成**

这三项要求共同指向单一的 Lambda 功能：**Provisioned Concurrency**。

## 正确答案：D

发布 Lambda 函数的新版本并在其上配置**预配并发**会预先初始化指定数量的执行环境，使其准备好立即响应。

- 如果您需要工作负载的可预测函数启动时间，预配并发是确保最低可能延迟的推荐解决方案。
- 使用预配并发时，Lambda 在您为函数配置 PC 设置时初始化执行环境。Lambda 还确保初始化的执行环境在调用之前始终可用。
- 首先，执行环境设置在预配过程中发生，而不是在执行期间发生，这消除了此问题。其次，通过保持函数初始化（包括初始化操作和代码依赖），后续调用中不会有不必要的初始化。初始化后，函数在被调用后的两位数毫秒内处于超级就绪状态以响应。

这完全符合"所有执行环境的设置活动必须在调用前进行"的要求。

预配并发在函数的**已发布版本或别名**上配置，这就是为什么答案首先提到发布新版本。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

### A. 增加内存 + EventBridge 每分钟 ping
- 通过 EventBridge ("预热") ping Lambda 是一个不可靠的解决方案。在无服务器社区中，有库和内部机制用于通过 ping 来"预热"Lambda。但这并不能消除所有冷启动，有时在生产环境中当我们遇到流量激增并需要所有并发环境来服务用户请求时，它没有帮助。
- 它不保证可预测的启动时间。Lambda 可能仍然回收执行环境，任何超过预热实例的并发调用都会触发冷启动。
- 增加内存只会略微减少初始化时间，并不能消除冷启动。

### B. 优化静态初始化并缩小包大小
- 这**减少**了冷启动持续时间，但**不能消除**它。该函数仍在任何新执行环境的首次调用时产生初始化时间，因此启动时间保持不可预测。
- 它也不满足"所有设置活动必须在调用前进行"——初始化仍在按需冷启动路径期间运行。

### C. 将保留并发增加到最大 + 手动设置
- **Reserved concurrency** 与预配并发不同。保留并发——这设置分配给您的函数的最大和最小并发实例数。当函数有保留并发时，没有其他函数可以使用该并发。保留并发对于确保您最关键的函数始终有足够的并发来处理传入请求很有用。
- 保留并发只**限制/保证一个槽位计数**；它不预初始化执行环境，因此冷启动仍会发生。
- "手动运行设置活动"不是 Lambda 执行环境的工作方式——您无法通过运行脚本来预先烘焙运行时环境。

## 参考文档
- [为函数配置预配并发](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)
- [了解 Lambda 执行环境生命周期](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtime-environment.html)
- [AWS Lambda 新增功能——通过预配并发实现可预测的启动时间](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/new-for-aws-lambda-predictable-start-up-times-with-provisioned-concurrency/)
- [保留并发与预配并发](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-concurrency.html)

en.question: A company has implemented a pipeline in AWS CodePipeline. The company is using a single AWS account and does not use AWS Organizations. The company needs to test its AWS CloudFormation templates in its primary AWS Region and a disaster recovery Region. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: In the CodePipeline pipeline, implement an AWS CodeDeploy action for each Region to deploy and test the CloudFormation templates. Update CodePipeline and AWS CodeBuild with appropriate permissions.
options.B: Configure CodePipeline to deploy and test the CloudFormation templates. Use CloudFormation StackSets to start deployment across both Regions.
options.C: Configure CodePipeline to invoke AWS CodeBuild to deploy and test the CloudFormation templates in each Region. Update CodeBuild and CloudFormation with appropriate permissions.
options.D: Use the Snyk action in CodePipeline to deploy and test the CloudFormation templates in each Region.

en.explanation:
## Scenario Analysis

The company has a **single AWS account** (no AWS Organizations) and needs to deploy/test CloudFormation templates in two AWS Regions: a primary Region and a disaster recovery (DR) Region. The goal is **maximum operational efficiency** through CodePipeline.

## Correct Answer: B

**Configure CodePipeline to deploy and test the CloudFormation templates. Use CloudFormation StackSets to start deployment across both Regions.**

CloudFormation StackSets is purpose-built for this scenario. CodePipeline offers the ability to perform CloudFormation StackSets operations as part of your CI/CD process. You use a stack set to create stacks in AWS accounts across AWS Regions by using a single CloudFormation template.

CodePipeline has a native **`CloudFormationStackSet`** deploy action provider that integrates directly with StackSets. You integrate your pipeline with CloudFormation StackSets through two distinct action types that you use together: The CloudFormationStackSet action creates or updates a stack set or stack instances from the template stored in the pipeline source location. Each time a stack set is created or updated, it initiates a deployment of those changes to specified instances.

This means a single pipeline action can fan out to both the primary and DR Regions using one template — the most operationally efficient approach. Note that there are two ways to manage permissions for a stack set: self-managed and AWS-managed IAM roles. The self-managed permissions model works without AWS Organizations, which directly addresses the constraint that this company does **not** use AWS Organizations.

Example CodePipeline action configuration:
```yaml
Name: DeployStackSet
ActionTypeId:
  Category: Deploy
  Owner: AWS
  Provider: CloudFormationStackSet
  Version: '1'
Configuration:
  StackSetName: my-stackset
  TemplatePath: 'SourceArtifact::template.yaml'
  PermissionModel: SELF_MANAGED
  DeploymentTargets: '111111222222'
  Regions: 'us-east-1,us-west-2'
```

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**A. CodeDeploy action for each Region** — AWS CodeDeploy is for deploying **application code** to compute services (EC2, Lambda, ECS, on-prem). It does **not** deploy CloudFormation templates / infrastructure. CodeDeploy is the wrong service for provisioning infrastructure stacks. See [What is CodeDeploy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/welcome.html).

**C. CodeBuild to deploy/test in each Region** — While technically possible by scripting `aws cloudformation deploy` calls in a buildspec, this is **operationally inefficient**: you must write and maintain custom CLI scripts, manage cross-Region credentials, handle drift, and duplicate stages per Region. The native `CloudFormationStackSet` action eliminates all of that custom plumbing. CodeBuild is a build/test service, not an infrastructure deployer.

**D. Snyk action in CodePipeline** — [Snyk](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-Snyk.html) is a third-party **security/vulnerability scanning** integration in CodePipeline. It scans code/IaC for vulnerabilities; it does **not** deploy CloudFormation stacks to any Region. This option is functionally incorrect.

## References
- [CloudFormation StackSets deploy action reference – CodePipeline](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-StackSets.html)
- [Tutorial: Create a pipeline with CloudFormation StackSets deployment actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/tutorials-stackset-deployment.html)
- [Working with AWS CloudFormation StackSets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/what-is-cfnstacksets.html)

zh.question: 一家公司已在 AWS CodePipeline 中部署了一条流水线。该公司使用单个 AWS 账户，且未使用 AWS Organizations。该公司需要在其主 AWS 区域和灾难恢复区域中测试其 AWS CloudFormation 模板。哪种解决方案能够以最高的运维效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 CodePipeline 管道中，为每个区域实现一个 AWS CodeDeploy 操作，用于部署和测试 CloudFormation 模板。更新 CodePipeline 和 AWS CodeBuild，使其拥有相应的权限。
options.B: 配置 CodePipeline 以部署和测试 CloudFormation 模板。使用 CloudFormation StackSets 开始跨两个区域进行部署。
options.C: 配置 CodePipeline 以调用 AWS CodeBuild 在每个区域中部署和测试 CloudFormation 模板。更新 CodeBuild 和 CloudFormation 的相应权限。
options.D: 使用 CodePipeline 中的 Snyk 操作在每个区域中部署和测试 CloudFormation 模板。

zh.explanation:
## 场景分析

该公司有一个**单一 AWS 账户**（没有 AWS Organizations），需要在两个 AWS 区域（主区域和灾难恢复 (DR) 区域）中部署和测试 CloudFormation 模板。目标是通过 CodePipeline 实现**最大运营效率**。

## 正确答案：B

**配置 CodePipeline 来部署和测试 CloudFormation 模板。使用 CloudFormation StackSets 在两个区域启动部署。**

CloudFormation StackSets 是为此场景量身定制的。CodePipeline 提供了在 CI/CD 流程中执行 CloudFormation StackSets 操作的能力。您可以使用堆栈集通过使用单个 CloudFormation 模板在多个 AWS 区域的 AWS 账户中创建堆栈。

CodePipeline 具有本机 **`CloudFormationStackSet`** 部署操作提供程序，可直接与 StackSets 集成。您通过两个不同的操作类型将管道与 CloudFormation StackSets 集成，这两个操作类型可协同使用：CloudFormationStackSet 操作从存储在管道源位置的模板创建或更新堆栈集或堆栈实例。每次创建或更新堆栈集时，它都会将这些更改部署到指定的实例。

这意味着单个管道操作可以使用一个模板扩展到主区域和 DR 区域——这是运营效率最高的方法。请注意，有两种方式来管理堆栈集的权限：自管理和 AWS 托管 IAM 角色。自管理权限模型无需 AWS Organizations 即可工作，这直接解决了该公司**不**使用 AWS Organizations 的限制。

示例 CodePipeline 操作配置：
```yaml
Name: DeployStackSet
ActionTypeId:
  Category: Deploy
  Owner: AWS
  Provider: CloudFormationStackSet
  Version: '1'
Configuration:
  StackSetName: my-stackset
  TemplatePath: 'SourceArtifact::template.yaml'
  PermissionModel: SELF_MANAGED
  DeploymentTargets: '111111222222'
  Regions: 'us-east-1,us-west-2'
```

## 其他选项错误的原因

**A. 针对每个区域的 CodeDeploy 操作** — AWS CodeDeploy 用于将**应用程序代码**部署到计算服务（EC2、Lambda、ECS、本地部署）。它**不**部署 CloudFormation 模板/基础设施。CodeDeploy 是用于配置基础设施堆栈的错误服务。请参阅 [什么是 CodeDeploy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/welcome.html)。

**C. 在每个区域中使用 CodeBuild 进行部署/测试** — 虽然从技术上可以通过在 buildspec 中编写自定义 CLI 脚本调用 `aws cloudformation deploy` 来实现，但这在**运营效率上**很低下：您必须编写和维护自定义 CLI 脚本、管理跨区域凭证、处理漂移并为每个区域复制阶段。本机 `CloudFormationStackSet` 操作消除了所有这些自定义工作。CodeBuild 是构建/测试服务，而不是基础设施部署程序。

**D. CodePipeline 中的 Snyk 操作** — [Snyk](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-Snyk.html) 是 CodePipeline 中的第三方**安全/漏洞扫描**集成。它扫描代码/IaC 以查找漏洞；它**不**将 CloudFormation 堆栈部署到任何区域。此选项在功能上是不正确的。

## 参考资源
- [CloudFormation StackSets 部署操作参考 – CodePipeline](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-StackSets.html)
- [教程：使用 CloudFormation StackSets 部署操作创建管道](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/tutorials-stackset-deployment.html)
- [使用 AWS CloudFormation StackSets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/what-is-cfnstacksets.html)

en.question: A company has an Amazon API Gateway REST API that integrates with an AWS Lambda function. The API’s development stage references a development alias of the Lambda function named dev. A developer needs make a production alias of the Lambda function named prod available through the API. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Create a new method on the API. Name the method production. Configure the method to include a stage variable that points to the prod Lambda function alias.
options.B: Create a new method on the API. Name the method production. Configure an integration request on the API’s development stage that points to the prod Lambda function alias.
options.C: Deploy the API to a new stage named production. Configure the stage to include a stage variable that points to the prod Lambda function alias.
options.D: Deploy the API to a new stage named production. Configure an integration request on the API’s production stage that points to the prod Lambda function alias.

en.explanation:
# API Gateway Stages with Lambda Aliases

## Scenario
A REST API has a `development` stage that uses a stage variable referencing the Lambda `dev` alias. The developer now needs to expose the Lambda `prod` alias through the same API. The cleanest, most maintainable approach mirrors the pattern already in use for the dev stage.

## Correct Answer: C
**Deploy the API to a new stage named `production` and configure a stage variable that points to the `prod` Lambda alias.**

API Gateway stages are designed exactly for this use case — promoting the same API definition to different environments while pointing to different backends. Stage variables are name-value pairs that you can define as configuration attributes associated with a deployment stage of a REST API. They act like environment variables and can be used in your API setup and mapping templates.

A stage variable can be used in place of a Lambda function name, or version/alias, as shown in the following examples: `arn:aws:apigateway:<region>:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/arn:aws:lambda:<region>:<account_id>:function:${stageVariables.<function_variable_name>}/invocations`

The integration on the method is configured once (e.g., `myFunction:${stageVariables.lambdaAlias}`), and each stage simply sets its own value for `lambdaAlias` (`dev` for the development stage, `prod` for the production stage). This is the recommended AWS pattern for environment promotion.

Note: After creating the new stage, you must grant API Gateway permission to invoke the `prod` alias via `lambda:add-permission`, because permissions are not auto-added when stage variables are used.

```bash
aws lambda add-permission \
  --function-name arn:aws:lambda:REGION:ACCOUNT:function:MyFunction:prod \
  --source-arn arn:aws:execute-api:REGION:ACCOUNT:api-id/*/METHOD/RESOURCE \
  --principal apigateway.amazonaws.com \
  --statement-id <unique-id> \
  --action lambda:InvokeFunction
```

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Create a new method named `production` with a stage variable to `prod` alias** — Methods in API Gateway correspond to HTTP verbs (GET/POST/etc.) on a resource, not environments. Adding a "production" method does not separate dev/prod traffic; both methods would still be reachable from any stage the API is deployed to. Environment separation is achieved through **stages**, not methods.

- **B.
