Create a new method `production` with an integration request pointing to `prod` alias on the development stage** — This conflates environments (the production-bound integration would live inside the development stage) and again misuses methods as environments. The integration would also be statically bound rather than driven by stage variables.

- **D. Deploy to a new `production` stage but hard-code the integration request to the `prod` alias** — While creating a new stage is correct, hard-coding the alias in the integration request defeats the purpose of stage variables. The development stage already uses a stage variable, so each deployment of the API would overwrite the production stage’s integration (or vice versa) because the integration is defined at the method level and is shared across all stages of an API. Here we have demonstrated how to use API Gateway stage variables and lambda alias to release changes to your backend without impacting your frontend. Stage variables are the AWS-recommended mechanism precisely to avoid this problem.

## References
- [Set up stage variables for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-set-stage-variables-aws-console.html)
- [API Gateway stage variables reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/aws-api-gateway-stage-variables-reference.html)
- [Using API Gateway stage variables to manage Lambda functions (AWS Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/using-api-gateway-stage-variables-to-manage-lambda-functions/)

zh.question: 一家公司有一个 Amazon API Gateway REST API，它与一个 AWS Lambda 函数集成。该 API 的开发阶段引用了 Lambda 函数的开发别名 dev。开发人员需要通过该 API 提供 Lambda 函数的生产别名 prod。哪个解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 API 上创建一个新方法。将该方法命名为 production。配置该方法，使其包含一个指向 prod Lambda 函数别名的 stage 变量。
options.B: 在 API 上创建一个新方法。将该方法命名为 production。在 API 的开发阶段配置一个集成请求，指向 prod Lambda 函数别名。
options.C: 将 API 部署到名为 production 的新阶段。配置该阶段，使其包含一个指向 prod Lambda 函数别名的阶段变量。
options.D: 将 API 部署到名为 production 的新阶段。在 API 的生产阶段配置一个指向 prod Lambda 函数别名的集成请求。

zh.explanation:
# API Gateway Stages with Lambda Aliases

## 场景
REST API 有一个 `development` 阶段，该阶段使用引用 Lambda `dev` 别名的阶段变量。开发者现在需要通过同一 API 暴露 Lambda `prod` 别名。最干净、最可维护的方法是镜像已用于开发阶段的模式。

## 正确答案：C
**将 API 部署到名为 `production` 的新阶段，并配置一个指向 `prod` Lambda 别名的阶段变量。**

API Gateway 阶段正是为此用例设计的——在将同一 API 定义推广到不同环境时指向不同的后端。阶段变量是名称-值对，可以定义为 REST API 部署阶段的配置属性。它们的作用类似于环境变量，可用于 API 设置和映射模板中。

阶段变量可以代替 Lambda 函数名、版本或别名使用，如以下示例所示：`arn:aws:apigateway:<region>:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/arn:aws:lambda:<region>:<account_id>:function:${stageVariables.<function_variable_name>}/invocations`

方法上的集成只需配置一次（例如，`myFunction:${stageVariables.lambdaAlias}`），每个阶段只需为 `lambdaAlias` 设置自己的值（开发阶段为 `dev`，生产阶段为 `prod`）。这是 AWS 推荐的环境推广模式。

注意：创建新阶段后，必须通过 `lambda:add-permission` 授予 API Gateway 权限来调用 `prod` 别名，因为使用阶段变量时不会自动添加权限。

```bash
aws lambda add-permission \
  --function-name arn:aws:lambda:REGION:ACCOUNT:function:MyFunction:prod \
  --source-arn arn:aws:execute-api:REGION:ACCOUNT:api-id/*/METHOD/RESOURCE \
  --principal apigateway.amazonaws.com \
  --statement-id <unique-id> \
  --action lambda:InvokeFunction
```

## 其他选项为什么错误

- **A. 创建名为 `production` 的新方法，使用阶段变量指向 `prod` 别名** — API Gateway 中的方法对应于资源上的 HTTP 动词（GET/POST 等），不对应环境。添加"production"方法不会分离开发/生产流量；两个方法在 API 部署的任何阶段都仍然可访问。环境分离是通过**阶段**而非方法实现的。

- **B. 创建新方法 `production`，在开发阶段的集成请求中指向 `prod` 别名** — 这混淆了环境（生产绑定的集成会存在于开发阶段内）并再次误用方法作为环境。集成也会是静态绑定的，而不是由阶段变量驱动。

- **D. 部署到新的 `production` 阶段但在集成请求中硬编码 `prod` 别名** — 虽然创建新阶段是正确的，但在集成请求中硬编码别名违背了阶段变量的目的。开发阶段已使用阶段变量，因此 API 的每次部署都会覆盖生产阶段的集成（或反之），因为集成在方法级别定义且在 API 的所有阶段间共享。这里我们演示了如何使用 API Gateway 阶段变量和 Lambda 别名来发布后端更改，而不影响前端。阶段变量正是为了避免此问题而设立的 AWS 推荐机制。

## 参考资源
- [Set up stage variables for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-set-stage-variables-aws-console.html)
- [API Gateway stage variables reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/aws-api-gateway-stage-variables-reference.html)
- [Using API Gateway stage variables to manage Lambda functions (AWS Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/using-api-gateway-stage-variables-to-manage-lambda-functions/)

en.question: A developer is implementing a serverless application by using AWS CloudFormation to provision Amazon S3 web hosting. Amazon API Gateway, and AWS Lambda functions. The Lambda function source code is zipped and uploaded to an S3 bucket. The S3 object key of the zipped source code is specified in the Lambda resource in the CloudFormation template. The developer notices that there are no changes in the Lambda function every time the CloudFormation stack is updated. How can the developer resolve this issue?

options.A: Create a new Lambda function alias before updating the CloudFormation stack.
options.B: Change the S3 object key or the S3 version in the CloudFormation template before updating the CloudFormation stack.
options.C: Upload the zipped source code to another S3 bucket before updating the CioudFormation stack.
options.D: Associate a cade signing configuration with the Lambda function before updating the CloudFormation stack.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

The developer uses CloudFormation to deploy a Lambda function whose code is a zip file in an S3 bucket. The S3 object key is hard-coded in the `AWS::Lambda::Function` resource's `Code` property. After uploading new versions of the zip (overwriting the same key) and running a stack update, CloudFormation does **not** update the Lambda function code.

## Why This Happens

CloudFormation only updates a resource when it detects that one of the resource's properties has changed in the template. According to the official AWS CloudFormation documentation for `AWS::Lambda::Function Code`: [Changes to a deployment package in Amazon S3 or a container image in ECR are not detected automatically during stack updates. To update the function code, change the object key or version in the template.](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-properties-lambda-function-code.html)

In other words, CloudFormation does not look inside S3 to compare the contents of the zip — it only compares template property values. If `S3Bucket` and `S3Key` (and `S3ObjectVersion`) are unchanged, no update is performed on the Lambda resource even though the underlying object has been overwritten.

## Correct Answer: B

**Change the S3 object key or the S3 version in the CloudFormation template before updating the stack.** This causes the `Code` property to differ from the previously deployed value, which triggers CloudFormation to call `UpdateFunctionCode` and pull the new zip. Common patterns:
- Use a build-number/timestamp-based S3 key (e.g., `lambda/build-1234/app.zip`).
- Enable S3 versioning and pass a new `S3ObjectVersion` parameter on each deployment.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Create a new Lambda function alias before updating the stack.** Aliases are pointers to function versions; creating one does not cause CloudFormation to fetch new code from S3. The root cause — that the `Code` property is unchanged in the template — is not addressed. A community comment suggesting `$LATEST` is misleading because CloudFormation still won't re-read the same S3 object key.

- **C. Upload the zipped source code to another S3 bucket.** This only works if you also change the `S3Bucket` value in the template. Merely uploading to a different bucket without modifying the template doesn't trigger a CloudFormation diff. Even when changed, swapping buckets per deployment is not a standard practice — changing the object key/version is the documented approach.

- **D. Associate a code-signing configuration.** Code signing enforces that only signed packages can be deployed; it has no effect on whether CloudFormation detects changes in the `Code` property. The deployment would still be a no-op for an unchanged S3 key.

## Reference Template Snippet

```yaml
Resources:
  MyFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        S3Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
        S3Key: !Sub "lambda/${BuildId}/app.zip"   # change BuildId per deploy
        # or use S3ObjectVersion: !Ref ObjectVersion
```

## References
- [AWS::Lambda::Function Code – AWS CloudFormation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-properties-lambda-function-code.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在使用 AWS CloudFormation 实现一个无服务器应用程序，该 CloudFormation 会配置 Amazon S3 Web 托管、Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 函数。Lambda 函数的源代码被压缩并上传到 S3 存储桶。压缩后的源代码的 S3 对象键已在 CloudFormation 模板的 Lambda 资源中指定。开发人员注意到，每次更新 CloudFormation 堆栈时，Lambda 函数的内容都没有变化。开发人员该如何解决这个问题？

options.A: 在更新 CloudFormation 堆栈之前，创建一个新的 Lambda 函数别名。
options.B: 在更新 CloudFormation 堆栈之前，更改 CloudFormation 模板中的 S3 对象键或 S3 版本。
options.C: 在更新 CioudFormation 堆栈之前，将压缩后的源代码上传到另一个 S3 存储桶。
options.D: 在更新 CloudFormation 堆栈之前，将 CADE 签名配置与 Lambda 函数关联起来。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

开发人员使用 CloudFormation 部署一个 Lambda 函数，其代码是存储在 S3 存储桶中的 zip 文件。S3 对象密钥在 `AWS::Lambda::Function` 资源的 `Code` 属性中是硬编码的。上传 zip 文件的新版本（覆盖同一密钥）并运行堆栈更新后，CloudFormation **不会**更新 Lambda 函数代码。

## 发生原因

CloudFormation 仅在检测到模板中资源的某个属性已更改时才更新该资源。根据 `AWS::Lambda::Function Code` 的官方 AWS CloudFormation 文档：[在堆栈更新期间，不会自动检测 Amazon S3 中部署包或 ECR 中容器镜像的更改。要更新函数代码，请在模板中更改对象密钥或版本。](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-properties-lambda-function-code.html)

换句话说，CloudFormation 不会查看 S3 内部来比较 zip 的内容——它只比较模板属性值。如果 `S3Bucket`、`S3Key` 和 `S3ObjectVersion` 保持不变，即使底层对象已被覆盖，CloudFormation 也不会对 Lambda 资源执行任何更新。

## 正确答案：B

**在更新堆栈之前，更改 CloudFormation 模板中的 S3 对象密钥或 S3 版本。** 这会导致 `Code` 属性与之前部署的值不同，从而触发 CloudFormation 调用 `UpdateFunctionCode` 并获取新的 zip 文件。常见的模式：
- 使用基于构建号/时间戳的 S3 密钥（例如，`lambda/build-1234/app.zip`）。
- 启用 S3 版本控制，并在每次部署时传递新的 `S3ObjectVersion` 参数。

## 其他选项为什么错误

- **A. 在更新堆栈之前创建一个新的 Lambda 函数别名。** 别名是指向函数版本的指针；创建别名不会导致 CloudFormation 从 S3 获取新代码。根本原因——模板中 `Code` 属性未更改——没有得到解决。社区评论建议使用 `$LATEST` 是误导性的，因为 CloudFormation 仍然不会重新读取相同的 S3 对象密钥。

- **C. 将压缩的源代码上传到另一个 S3 存储桶。** 仅当您同时更改模板中的 `S3Bucket` 值时，这才有效。仅将文件上传到不同的存储桶而不修改模板不会触发 CloudFormation diff。即使进行了更改，每次部署时交换存储桶也不是标准做法——更改对象密钥/版本是建议的方法。

- **D. 关联代码签名配置。** 代码签名强制仅已签名的软件包可以部署；它对 CloudFormation 是否检测到 `Code` 属性中的更改没有任何影响。对于未更改的 S3 密钥，部署仍然是无操作的。

## 参考模板代码片段

```yaml
Resources:
  MyFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        S3Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
        S3Key: !Sub "lambda/${BuildId}/app.zip"   # 每次部署更改 BuildId
        # 或使用 S3ObjectVersion: !Ref ObjectVersion
```

## 参考资源
- [AWS::Lambda::Function Code – AWS CloudFormation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-properties-lambda-function-code.html)

en.question: A developer published a change to a new version of an AWS Lambda function. To test the change, the developer must route 50% of the traffic to the new version and 60% of the traffic to the current version. What is the MOST operationally efficient way to meet this requirement?

options.A: Create two Amazon Route 53 records that use a simple routing policy to route traffic to the different versions of the Lambda function. Create another Route 53 record that uses a weighted routing policy to route 50% of the traffic to each simple routing record. Test the Lambda function by using the weighted routing record.
options.B: Create an Amazon API Gateway API with a POST method that is integrated with the Lambda function. Add a stage variable that includes the version of the Lambda function. Add a canary release that will override the version variable 50% of the time. Deploy and test the Lambda function through the API Gateway stage.
options.C: Create a Lambda function alias. Set the weight to 50% for the current version and 50% for the new version. Set the event source mappings for the Lambda function to point to the alias.
options.D: Update the event source mappings for the Lambda function. In the mappings, set the weight to 50% for the current version and 50% for the new version.

en.explanation:
# Lambda Traffic Shifting Between Versions

## Scenario
A developer needs to split invocation traffic between two versions of a Lambda function (the question contains a typo — 50% + 60% = 110% — but the clear intent is a weighted traffic split between the **current** and the **new** version of a Lambda function). The question asks for the **most operationally efficient** approach.

> Note: The actual canonical scenario is 50/50 weighted traffic shifting, which is exactly what option C describes.

## Correct Answer: C — Lambda alias with weighted routing

AWS Lambda natively supports **alias traffic shifting** (also called weighted aliases or canary routing). You can point a Lambda alias to two function versions and configure the percentage of traffic that is routed to each version.

This is configured through the alias `routingConfig` / `AdditionalVersionWeights` property. For example:

```bash
aws lambda update-alias \
  --function-name my-function \
  --name my-alias \
  --function-version 1 \
  --routing-config '{"AdditionalVersionWeights" : {"2" : 0.5}}'
```

Lambda uses a simple probabilistic model to distribute the traffic between the two function versions. At low traffic levels, you might see a high variance between the configured and actual percentage of traffic on each version.

This is the most operationally efficient option because it is a **built-in Lambda feature** — no extra services (Route 53, API Gateway), no DNS records, and no custom routing layer are required. With the introduction of alias traffic shifting, it is now possible to trivially implement canary deployments of Lambda functions. By updating additional version weights on an alias, invocation traffic is routed to the new function versions.

Note: option C says "set event source mappings to point to the alias" — this is correct because event source mappings (and other invokers) should reference the alias ARN rather than a specific version, so the alias's weighted routing controls traffic distribution.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

### A. Route 53 weighted routing records ❌
Route 53 weighted routing operates at the **DNS level** and routes between IP endpoints/domains. Lambda functions are not invoked by DNS resolution — they are invoked via the Lambda service API (or through event source mappings, API Gateway, SDK calls, etc.). Route 53 cannot route traffic between Lambda function versions. This adds complexity and doesn't solve the problem.

### B. API Gateway canary release with stage variables ❌
While API Gateway *does* support canary deployments and stage variables to point to Lambda versions, this approach:
- Adds a new component (API Gateway) that wasn't in the original architecture.
- Only works for synchronous HTTP invocations — it doesn't help if Lambda is invoked from event source mappings (SQS, Kinesis, DynamoDB Streams), S3 events, EventBridge, etc.
- Is far less operationally efficient than the native Lambda feature designed for this exact use case.

### D. Update event source mappings with weights ❌
**Event source mappings do not support traffic weighting between function versions.** An event source mapping points to a single function/alias/version, not multiple versions with weights. The `weight` parameter described in option D does not exist for event source mappings. Weighted routing is a property of the **alias**, not the event source mapping. You can use a weighted alias to split traffic between two different versions of the same function. You can point an alias to a maximum of two Lambda function versions.

## Key AWS Documentation
- [Implement Lambda canary deployments using a weighted alias](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html)
- [Create an alias for a Lambda function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-aliases.html)
- [AWS Lambda Supports Traffic Shifting](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2017/11/aws-lambda-supports-traffic-shifting-and-phased-deployments-with-aws-codedeploy/)

zh.question: 一位开发人员发布了对 AWS Lambda 函数新版本的更改。为了测试此更改，开发人员必须将 50% 的流量路由到新版本，将 60% 的流量路由到当前版本。满足此要求的最高效运维方式是什么？

options.A: 创建两条 Amazon Route 53 记录，使用简单路由策略将流量路由到不同版本的 Lambda 函数。再创建一条 Route 53 记录，使用加权路由策略将 50% 的流量路由到每条简单路由记录。使用加权路由记录测试 Lambda 函数。
options.B: 创建一个包含 POST 方法的 Amazon API Gateway API，并将其与 Lambda 函数集成。添加一个阶段变量，其中包含 Lambda 函数的版本。添加一个金丝雀发布版本，该版本有 50% 的概率覆盖版本变量。通过 API Gateway 阶段部署并测试 Lambda 函数。
options.C: 创建一个 Lambda 函数别名。将当前版本和新版本的权重都设置为 50%。将 Lambda 函数的事件源映射设置为指向该别名。
options.D: 更新 Lambda 函数的事件源映射。在映射中，将当前版本的权重设置为 50%，新版本的权重设置为 50%。

zh.explanation:
# Lambda 版本之间的流量转移

## 场景
开发者需要在 Lambda 函数的两个版本之间分流调用流量（问题中有一个笔误 — 50% + 60% = 110% — 但明确的意图是在 Lambda 函数的**当前**版本和**新**版本之间进行加权流量分流）。问题要求**最具操作效率**的方法。

> 注意：实际规范场景是 50/50 加权流量转移，这正是选项 C 所描述的。

## 正确答案：C — Lambda 别名与加权路由

AWS Lambda 原生支持**别名流量转移**（也称为加权别名或金丝雀路由）。您可以将 Lambda 别名指向两个函数版本，并配置路由到每个版本的流量百分比。

这通过别名的 `routingConfig` / `AdditionalVersionWeights` 属性进行配置。例如：

```bash
aws lambda update-alias \
  --function-name my-function \
  --name my-alias \
  --function-version 1 \
  --routing-config '{"AdditionalVersionWeights" : {"2" : 0.5}}'
```

Lambda 使用简单的概率模型在两个函数版本之间分配流量。在低流量情况下，您可能会看到配置的百分比与每个版本上的实际流量百分比之间的高方差。

这是最具操作效率的选项，因为它是一个**内置的 Lambda 功能** — 不需要额外的服务（Route 53、API Gateway）、没有 DNS 记录，也不需要自定义路由层。随着别名流量转移的引入，现在可以轻松实现 Lambda 函数的金丝雀部署。通过更新别名上的额外版本权重，调用流量将被路由到新的函数版本。

注意：选项 C 说"设置事件源映射以指向别名" — 这是正确的，因为事件源映射（和其他调用程序）应该引用别名 ARN 而不是特定版本，以便别名的加权路由控制流量分配。

## 为什么其他选项是错误的

### A. Route 53 加权路由记录 ❌
Route 53 加权路由在 **DNS 级别**运行，在 IP 端点/域之间路由。Lambda 函数不通过 DNS 解析进行调用 — 它们通过 Lambda 服务 API 进行调用（或通过事件源映射、API Gateway、SDK 调用等）。Route 53 无法在 Lambda 函数版本之间路由流量。这会增加复杂性，也无法解决问题。

### B. API Gateway 金丝雀发布与阶段变量 ❌
虽然 API Gateway *确实*支持金丝雀部署和阶段变量以指向 Lambda 版本，但这种方法：
- 添加了原始架构中不存在的新组件（API Gateway）。
- 仅适用于同步 HTTP 调用 — 如果 Lambda 从事件源映射（SQS、Kinesis、DynamoDB Streams）、S3 事件、EventBridge 等进行调用，它无法帮助。
- 远不如专为这个确切用例设计的原生 Lambda 功能那样具有操作效率。

### D. 使用权重更新事件源映射 ❌
**事件源映射不支持函数版本之间的流量加权。** 事件源映射指向单个函数/别名/版本，而不是具有权重的多个版本。选项 D 中描述的 `weight` 参数对事件源映射不存在。加权路由是**别名**的属性，而不是事件源映射的属性。您可以使用加权别名在同一函数的两个不同版本之间分流。您可以将别名指向最多两个 Lambda 函数版本。

## 关键 AWS 文档
- [使用加权别名实现 Lambda 金丝雀部署](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html)
- [为 Lambda 函数创建别名](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-aliases.html)
- [AWS Lambda 支持流量转移](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2017/11/aws-lambda-supports-traffic-shifting-and-phased-deployments-with-aws-codedeploy/)

en.question: A developer is building an application that processes a stream of user-supplied data. The data stream must be consumed by multiple Amazon EC2 based processing applications in parallel and in real time. Each processor must be able to resume without losing data if there is a service interruption. The application architect plans to add other processors in the near future, and wants to minimize the amount of data duplication involved. Which solution will satisfy these requirements?

options.A: Publish the data to Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS).
options.B: Publish the data to Amazon Data Firehose.
options.C: Publish the data to Amazon EventBridge.
options.D: Publish the data to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer needs to stream user-supplied data to **multiple EC2-based processors in parallel and in real time**, where:
- Each processor must be able to **resume without losing data** after an interruption (durable, replayable).
- More processors will be added later, with **minimal data duplication**.

## Correct Answer: D – Amazon Kinesis Data Streams

Kinesis Data Streams is purpose-built for this scenario. A consumer is an application that processes all data from a Kinesis data stream. You can choose between shared fan-out and enhanced fan-out consumer types to read data from a Kinesis data stream. With enhanced fan-out, an enhanced fan-out consumer gets its own 2 MB/second allotment of read throughput, allowing multiple consumers to read data from the same stream in parallel, without contending for read throughput with other consumers.

This satisfies all three requirements:

1. **Real-time, parallel consumption** – Multiple independent EC2 consumer applications can each read the same stream concurrently. One of the main advantages of stream processing is that you can attach multiple unique applications, each consuming data from the same Kinesis data stream.
2. **Resume without data loss** – Each consumer maintains its own checkpoint (sequence number / position in shard, typically tracked via the KCL in DynamoDB). Records are retained in the stream (default 24 hours, up to 365 days), so a consumer that experiences an interruption can resume from its last checkpoint and replay records.
3. **Minimal data duplication when adding new processors** – The data is published **once** to the stream, and any new consumer simply registers and reads from the same stream. No need to re-publish or duplicate data per consumer. A higher fan-out limit lets customers attach many more independent, low-latency, high-throughput consumers to the same stream—unlocking parallel analytics, ML pipelines, compliance workflows, and multi-team architectures without creating extra streams or causing throughput contention.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. Amazon SQS** – Standard SQS queues are point-to-point: once a message is consumed and deleted, it is gone for other consumers. To support multiple parallel consumers each receiving the **same** messages, you would need either SNS fan-out to multiple SQS queues (one per consumer) — which **duplicates data** for every new processor added — or you'd lose the "all consumers see all messages" property. SQS also lacks ordered, replayable, position-based reads needed for stream-style "resume from where you left off" processing.

- **B. Amazon Data Firehose (Kinesis Data Firehose)** – Firehose is a **delivery** service, not a consumer-readable stream. It batches and delivers data to fixed destinations like S3, Redshift, OpenSearch, or Splunk. EC2 applications cannot subscribe to or pull records from Firehose in real time, and there is no shard/checkpoint model for parallel consumers to resume from.

- **C. Amazon EventBridge** – EventBridge routes events to targets via rules; it is event-driven, not a durable replayable stream. Consumers cannot rewind to a prior position or "resume without losing data" after a long outage in the same way Kinesis allows. While EventBridge supports archive/replay, it is not designed for high-throughput real-time stream processing by multiple long-running EC2 consumers, and the consumption model is push-to-target rather than checkpointed shard reads.

## References

- [Read data from Amazon Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/building-consumers.html)
- [Develop enhanced fan-out consumers with dedicated throughput](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/enhanced-consumers.html)
- [Kinesis Data Streams FAQs](https://aws.amazon.com/kinesis/data-streams/faqs/)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在构建一个应用程序，用于处理用户提供的数据流。该数据流必须被多个基于 Amazon EC2 的处理应用程序并行且实时地使用。如果服务中断，每个处理器都必须能够在不丢失数据的情况下恢复运行。应用程序架构师计划在不久的将来添加更多处理器，并希望最大限度地减少数据重复。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 将数据发布到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS)。
options.B: 将数据发布到 Amazon Data Firehose。
options.C: 将数据发布到 Amazon EventBridge。
options.D: 将数据发布到 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

一个开发者需要将用户提供的数据**实时地并行流式传输到多个基于EC2的处理器**，其中：
- 每个处理器必须能够在中断后**恢复而不丢失数据**（耐久、可重放）。
- 稍后将添加更多处理器，具有**最小数据重复**。

## 正确答案：D – Amazon Kinesis Data Streams

Kinesis Data Streams 为这个场景而设计。消费者是从 Kinesis 数据流处理所有数据的应用程序。您可以在共享扇出和增强扇出消费者类型之间选择，以从 Kinesis 数据流读取数据。使用增强扇出，增强扇出消费者获得自己的 2 MB/秒读取吞吐量分配，允许多个消费者从同一个流并行读取数据，而不会与其他消费者争用读取吞吐量。

这满足所有三个要求：

1. **实时、并行消费** – 多个独立的EC2消费者应用程序可以并发地各自读取同一个流。流处理的主要优势之一是您可以附加多个唯一的应用程序，每个应用程序都从同一个 Kinesis 数据流消费数据。
2. **恢复而不丢失数据** – 每个消费者维护自己的检查点（序列号/分片中的位置，通常通过 DynamoDB 中的 KCL 跟踪）。记录在流中保留（默认24小时，最多365天），所以经历中断的消费者可以从其最后一个检查点恢复并重放记录。
3. **添加新处理器时最小数据重复** – 数据**一次性**发布到流，任何新消费者只需注册并从同一个流读取。无需为每个消费者重新发布或复制数据。更高的扇出限制允许客户向同一个流附加更多独立、低延迟、高吞吐量的消费者——解锁并行分析、机器学习管道、合规性工作流和多团队架构，而无需创建额外的流或导致吞吐量争用。

## 为什么其他选项错误

- **A. Amazon SQS** – 标准 SQS 队列是点对点的：一旦消息被消费和删除，其他消费者就无法获取。要支持多个并行消费者各自接收**相同的**消息，您需要使用 SNS 扇出到多个 SQS 队列（每个消费者一个）——这**为每个新处理器复制数据** – 或者您会丢失"所有消费者看到所有消息"的属性。SQS 还缺乏有序、可重放、基于位置的读取，这些是流式"从您离开的地方恢复"处理所需的。

- **B. Amazon Data Firehose（Kinesis Data Firehose）** – Firehose 是一个**传输**服务，而不是消费者可读的流。它将数据批量传输到固定目标，如 S3、Redshift、OpenSearch 或 Splunk。EC2 应用程序无法实时订阅或从 Firehose 拉取记录，并且没有分片/检查点模型供并行消费者从中恢复。

- **C. Amazon EventBridge** – EventBridge 通过规则将事件路由到目标；它是事件驱动的，而不是耐久可重放的流。消费者无法回到之前的位置或在长时间中断后"恢复而不丢失数据"，就像 Kinesis 允许的方式一样。虽然 EventBridge 支持存档/重放，但它不是为多个长时间运行的EC2消费者的高吞吐量实时流处理而设计的，消费模型是推送到目标而不是检查点分片读取。

## 参考资源

- [从 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 读取数据](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/building-consumers.html)
- [使用专用吞吐量开发增强扇出消费者](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/enhanced-consumers.html)
- [Kinesis Data Streams 常见问题](https://aws.amazon.com/kinesis/data-streams/faqs/)

en.question: An application is experiencing performance issues based on increased demand. This increased demand is on read-only historical records pulled from an Amazon RDS-hosted database with custom views and queries. A developer must improve performance without changing the database structure. Which approach will improve performance and MINIMIZE management overhead?

options.A: Deploy Amazon DynamoDB, move all the data, and point to DynamoDB.
options.B: Deploy Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) and cache the data for the application.
options.C: Deploy Memcached on Amazon EC2 and cache the data for the application.
options.D: Deploy Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) on Amazon RDS to improve cache performance.

en.explanation:
# Caching Read-Heavy RDS Workloads with ElastiCache

## Scenario
An application uses an Amazon RDS database for read-only historical records served through custom views and queries. Read demand has grown and is hurting performance. The developer must improve performance **without changing the database structure** and with **minimum management overhead**.

## Correct Answer: B — Deploy Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) and cache the data

ElastiCache is a fully managed, in-memory caching service that fits perfectly in front of an RDS database for read-heavy workloads. ElastiCache is a fully managed, in-memory caching service that provides microsecond read and write latencies and helps accelerate application and database performance.

Because the data is **read-only historical records**, the cache hit ratio will be very high — exactly the workload that benefits the most. Read-heavy workloads with common database queries returning the same result set will benefit greatly by caching the query results. AWS specifically documents the RDS + ElastiCache pattern: You can save costs and improve performance by using ElastiCache with RDS versus running on RDS alone — saving up to 55% in cost and gaining up to 80x faster read performance using ElastiCache with RDS for MySQL versus RDS for MySQL alone.

Crucially, this approach **does not require any change to the database schema/structure** — the application simply checks the cache before falling back to RDS (cache-aside / lazy loading). Before the application sends the query to the database, it takes the SQL query as the key to ask the caching layer for data. If the cache doesn't contain data for the key, the SQL query is sent to the relational database. The result is then stored in the cache using the SQL query as the key. The next time the application wants to perform the query it asks the caching layer which now contains the cached table.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

- **A. Migrate to DynamoDB.** DynamoDB is a NoSQL key-value/document store. The application uses **custom views and SQL queries** on relational data — these would need to be redesigned. This violates the "without changing the database structure" requirement and entails huge migration overhead.

- **C. Memcached on EC2.** While Memcached can cache query results, hosting it on a self-managed EC2 instance shifts patching, HA, scaling, monitoring, and failure recovery to the developer. This **maximizes** management overhead, the opposite of what is asked. A single EC2 node is also a single point of failure. If caching with Memcached were desired, the managed choice would be ElastiCache for Memcached, not EC2.

- **D. DAX on RDS.** **DAX (DynamoDB Accelerator) only works with Amazon DynamoDB**, not with Amazon RDS. It is a write-through cache designed specifically for DynamoDB tables and cannot be placed in front of RDS. This option is technically impossible.

## Key Takeaway
For read-heavy RDS workloads where you cannot alter the schema and need minimal ops burden, the standard AWS pattern is **Amazon ElastiCache (Redis or Memcached, managed) as a cache-aside layer** in front of RDS.

## References
- [Creating an ElastiCache cache using RDS DB instance settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/creating-elasticache-cluster-with-RDS-settings.html)
- [Optimize cost and boost performance of RDS for MySQL using ElastiCache for Redis](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/optimize-cost-and-boost-performance-of-rds-for-mysql-using-amazon-elasticache-for-redis/)
- [Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)

zh.question: 由于需求增加，应用程序出现了性能问题。这种需求增加主要针对从 Amazon RDS 托管数据库中提取的只读历史记录，这些记录包含自定义视图和查询。开发人员必须在不更改数据库结构的情况下提高性能。哪种方法既能提高性能又能最大限度地减少管理开销？

options.A: 部署 Amazon DynamoDB，迁移所有数据，并指向 DynamoDB。
options.B: 部署 Amazon ElastiCache（Redis OSS）并缓存应用程序的数据。
options.C: 在 Amazon EC2 上部署 Memcached 并缓存应用程序的数据。
options.D: 在 Amazon RDS 上部署 Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 以提高缓存性能。

zh.explanation:
# 使用 ElastiCache 缓存读取繁重的 RDS 工作负载

## 场景
一个应用程序使用 Amazon RDS 数据库来提供只读的历史记录，通过自定义视图和查询进行处理。读取需求不断增长，正在影响性能。开发者必须在**不改变数据库结构**和**最少管理开销**的前提下改善性能。

## 正确答案：B — 部署 Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) 并缓存数据

ElastiCache 是一个完全托管的内存缓存服务，非常适合在 RDS 数据库前面放置，用于处理读取繁重的工作负载。ElastiCache 是一个完全托管的内存缓存服务，提供微秒级读写延迟，有助于加速应用和数据库性能。

因为数据是**只读的历史记录**，缓存命中率会非常高 — 这正是受益最多的工作负载类型。读取繁重的工作负载，返回相同结果集的常见数据库查询，通过缓存查询结果会获得巨大收益。 AWS 明确记录了 RDS + ElastiCache 的使用模式：相比单独运行 RDS，使用 ElastiCache 配合 RDS 可以节省成本并改善性能 — 相比单独使用 RDS for MySQL，与 ElastiCache 配合使用可节省高达 55% 的成本并获得高达 80 倍的读性能提升。

至关重要的是，这种方法**不需要对数据库架构/结构进行任何更改** — 应用程序只需在回退到 RDS 之前检查缓存即可（旁路缓存 / 懒加载）。在应用程序将查询发送到数据库之前，它以 SQL 查询作为键向缓存层请求数据。如果缓存不包含该键的数据，则 SQL 查询被发送到关系数据库。然后将结果以 SQL 查询为键存储在缓存中。下次应用程序执行该查询时，它询问缓存层，现在缓存层包含缓存的表。

## 为什么其他选项错误

- **A. 迁移到 DynamoDB。** DynamoDB 是 NoSQL 键值/文档存储。应用程序使用**自定义视图和 SQL 查询**在关系数据上运行 — 这些需要重新设计。这违反了"不改变数据库结构"的要求，并涉及巨大的迁移开销。

- **C. 在 EC2 上使用 Memcached。** 虽然 Memcached 可以缓存查询结果，但在自管理的 EC2 实例上托管会将补丁、高可用性、扩展、监控和故障恢复转移给开发者。这会**最大化**管理开销，与要求相反。单个 EC2 节点也是单点故障。如果需要使用 Memcached 进行缓存，托管选择应该是 ElastiCache for Memcached，而不是 EC2。

- **D. DAX on RDS。** **DAX (DynamoDB Accelerator) 仅适用于 Amazon DynamoDB**，不适用于 Amazon RDS。它是专为 DynamoDB 表设计的写穿缓存，无法放在 RDS 前面。这个选项在技术上是不可能的。

## 关键要点
对于读取繁重的 RDS 工作负载，在无法修改架构且需要最少运维负担的情况下，标准的 AWS 模式是**在 RDS 前面放置 Amazon ElastiCache (Redis 或 Memcached，托管)作为旁路缓存层**。

## 参考资源
- [使用 RDS DB 实例设置创建 ElastiCache 缓存](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/creating-elasticache-cluster-with-RDS-settings.html)
- [使用 ElastiCache for Redis 优化 RDS for MySQL 的成本并提升性能](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/optimize-cost-and-boost-performance-of-rds-for-mysql-using-amazon-elasticache-for-redis/)
- [Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)

en.question:
A developer is using AWS CloudFormation to deploy an AWS Lambda function. The developer needs to set the Lambda function's timeout value based on the environment parameter of the template. The template contains mappings of EnvironmentData for each environment's timeout value. The environment parameter and EnvironmentData mappings are as follows: 
Environment parameter: 
```yaml
Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      -dev
      -test
      -prod
    Description: The name of the deployment environment.
```
EnvironmentData mappings:
```yaml
Mappings:
  EnvironmentData:
    dev:
      Timeout: 30
    test:
      Timeout: 60
    prod:
      Timeout: 90
```
Which statement will meet these requirements?

options.A: Timeout: !GetAtt [EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]
options.B: Timeout: !FindInMap [EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]
options.C: Timeout: !Select [EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]
options.D: Timeout: !ForEach[EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]

en.explanation:
# CloudFormation: Retrieving values from Mappings

## Scenario
The developer has a CloudFormation `Mappings` section called `EnvironmentData` that holds a `Timeout` value for each environment (e.g., dev, test, prod). The developer needs the Lambda function's `Timeout` property to be set dynamically based on the value of the `Environment` parameter passed to the stack. The question is which intrinsic function correctly looks up a value in a Mappings block.

## Correct Answer: B — `Timeout: !FindInMap [EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]`

The intrinsic function Fn::FindInMap returns the value corresponding to keys in a two-level map that's declared in the Mappings section. The syntax is `{ "Fn::FindInMap" : [ "MapName", "TopLevelKey", "SecondLevelKey"] }`, which in YAML short form becomes `!FindInMap [MapName, TopLevelKey, SecondLevelKey]`.

In option B:
- `MapName` = `EnvironmentData` (the logical name of the mapping)
- `TopLevelKey` = `!Ref Environment` (resolves to the environment value, e.g., `prod`)
- `SecondLevelKey` = `Timeout` (the named value to retrieve)

This exactly matches the documented usage pattern, similar to the canonical AMI/Region example in the AWS docs.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. `!GetAtt [EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]`** — `Fn::GetAtt` returns an attribute of a *resource* declared in the `Resources` section (e.g., `!GetAtt myELB.DNSName`). It does **not** read from the `Mappings` section, and its syntax is `[logicalNameOfResource, attributeName]` — only two arguments, not three. `EnvironmentData` is a mapping, not a resource, so this would fail.

- **C. `!Select [EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]`** — `Fn::Select` returns a single object from a list of objects by index, with the syntax `!Select [index, listOfObjects]`. It cannot navigate a two-level map and the first argument must be a numeric index, not a map name.

- **D. `!ForEach[EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]`** — `Fn::ForEach` is a looping construct (requires the `AWS::LanguageExtensions` transform) used to iterate and replicate resources/properties across a list of values. It is not used to look up a single value from a Mappings block, and its parameter signature differs entirely (identifier, collection, output template).

## Reference
- [Fn::FindInMap - AWS CloudFormation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/intrinsic-function-reference-findinmap.html)
- [Mappings section structure](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/mappings-section-structure.html)
- [Intrinsic function reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/intrinsic-function-reference.html)

options.B: 超时：!FindInMap [EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]
options.C: 超时：!选择[EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]

zh.explanation:
# CloudFormation：从映射中检索值

## 场景
开发人员有一个 CloudFormation `Mappings` 部分称为 `EnvironmentData`，它为每个环境（例如 dev、test、prod）保存一个 `Timeout` 值。开发人员需要根据传递到堆栈的 `Environment` 参数值动态设置 Lambda 函数的 `Timeout` 属性。问题是哪个内置函数正确地在 Mappings 块中查找值。

## 正确答案：B — `Timeout: !FindInMap [EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]`

内置函数 Fn::FindInMap 返回与 Mappings 部分声明的两级映射中的键对应的值。语法是`{ "Fn::FindInMap" : [ "MapName", "TopLevelKey", "SecondLevelKey"] }`，以 YAML 简写形式为 `!FindInMap [MapName, TopLevelKey, SecondLevelKey]`。

在选项 B 中：
- `MapName` = `EnvironmentData`（映射的逻辑名称）
- `TopLevelKey` = `!Ref Environment`（解析为环境值，例如 `prod`）
- `SecondLevelKey` = `Timeout`（要检索的命名值）

这与文档使用模式完全匹配，类似于 AWS 文档中规范的 AMI/Region 示例。

## 其他选项为什么是错误的

- **A. `!GetAtt [EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]`** — `Fn::GetAtt` 返回在 `Resources` 部分声明的*资源*的属性（例如 `!GetAtt myELB.DNSName`）。它**不会**从 `Mappings` 部分读取，其语法是 `[logicalNameOfResource, attributeName]` — 仅两个参数，而非三个。`EnvironmentData` 是一个映射，不是资源，所以这会失败。

- **C. `!Select [EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]`** — `Fn::Select` 通过索引从对象列表中返回单个对象，语法为 `!Select [index, listOfObjects]`。它无法导航两级映射，第一个参数必须是数字索引而非映射名称。

- **D. `!ForEach[EnvironmentData, !Ref Environment, Timeout]`** — `Fn::ForEach` 是一个循环构造（需要 `AWS::LanguageExtensions` 转换），用于迭代和在值列表中复制资源/属性。它不用于从 Mappings 块查找单个值，其参数签名完全不同（标识符、集合、输出模板）。

## 参考资源
- [Fn::FindInMap - AWS CloudFormation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/intrinsic-function-reference-findinmap.html)
- [Mappings 部分结构](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/mappings-section-structure.html)
- [内置函数参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/intrinsic-function-reference.html)

en.question: A company’s AWS accounts are in an organization in AWS Organizations. An application in Account A uses environment variables that are stored as parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. A developer is creating a new application in Account B that needs to use the same environment variables. The application in Account B needs access to the parameters in Account A without duplicating the parameters into Account B. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure the application in Account B to use credentials for an IAM user in AccountA that has access to the parameters.
options.B: Create an assumable IAM role in Account A. Grant the role the permission to access the parameters.
options.C: Configure cross-account resource sharing for the parameters by using AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM).
options.D: Write a script that stores the parameter values in a private Amazon S3 bucket that both accounts can access.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

An application in **Account A** stores environment variables in **AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store**. A new application in **Account B** (same AWS Organization) needs to read those same parameters **without duplicating** them. We need the option with the **least operational overhead**.

## Correct Answer: C — Use AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) to share the parameters cross-account

Since **February 2024**, Parameter Store supports native cross-account sharing through AWS RAM. Parameter Store now allows you to share advanced-tier parameters with other AWS accounts, enabling you to maintain a single source of truth for configuration data by sharing parameters with other accounts that need access rather than manually duplicating and synchronizing data across accounts.

How it works: The sharing account creates the SSM parameter(s) in the advanced tier. The sharing account creates a resource share using AWS RAM, specifying the SSM parameter(s) and the consuming account(s). The consuming account(s) accept the resource share invitation to gain access to the shared SSM parameter(s).

Because the company already uses **AWS Organizations**, RAM sharing is even easier — invitations can be auto-accepted across the org, and you are free from setting up cross account roles and writing extra boilerplate code to temporarily assume the role of the account where the parameter is hosted, creating clear separation of concerns.

The consumer simply calls `ssm:GetParameter` using the **full ARN** of the shared parameter:

```
aws ssm get-parameter --name arn:aws:ssm:us-east-2:111111111111:parameter/MySharedParameter
```

This is the lowest-overhead option — no custom code, no role-assumption logic, no duplication, no synchronization job.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. IAM user credentials in Account A used by app in Account B** — This requires distributing **long-lived access keys** between accounts, which is an explicit AWS security anti-pattern. It also creates operational overhead (key rotation, secret distribution) and violates least privilege. AWS specifically recommends roles over users for cross-account access.

- **B. Assumable IAM role in Account A** — This is technically functional and was the historical answer before Feb 2024. However, it is **higher operational overhead** than RAM: the developer must add `sts:AssumeRole` logic in the application, manage trust policies, refresh temporary credentials, and handle role-chaining. The blog post explicitly contrasts RAM sharing as removing this exact overhead — see citation above.

- **D. Copy parameters into a private S3 bucket** — This **duplicates** the parameters (the requirement explicitly forbids this), requires a custom synchronization script (operational overhead), and loses Parameter Store features like versioning, KMS-integrated SecureString decryption, and hierarchical naming.

## References

- [Working with shared parameters in Parameter Store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/parameter-store-shared-parameters.html)
- [AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store now supports cross-account sharing (Feb 2024)](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2024/02/aws-systems-manager-parameter-store-cross-account-sharing/)
- [Introducing Parameter Store cross-account sharing — AWS Cloud Operations Blog](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/mt/introducing-parameter-store-cross-account-sharing/)

zh.question: 一家公司的 AWS 账户位于 AWS Organizations 的一个组织中。账户 A 中的一个应用程序使用存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中的环境变量作为参数。开发人员正在账户 B 中创建一个新应用程序，该应用程序需要使用相同的环境变量。账户 B 中的应用程序需要访问账户 A 中的参数，但又不想在账户 B 中复制这些参数。哪种解决方案能够以最小的运维开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置账户 B 中的应用程序，使其使用账户 A 中具有参数访问权限的 IAM 用户的凭据。
options.B: 在账户 A 中创建一个可承担的 IAM 角色。授予该角色访问参数的权限。
options.C: 使用 AWS 资源访问管理器 (AWS RAM) 配置参数的跨账户资源共享。
options.D: 编写一个脚本，将参数值存储在两个账户都可以访问的私有 Amazon S3 存储桶中。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

**账户 A** 中的应用程序在 **AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store** 中存储环境变量。**账户 B**（同一 AWS 组织内）中的新应用程序需要读取这些相同的参数，**不需要复制**它们。我们需要**操作开销最少**的选项。

## 正确答案：C — 使用 AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) 跨账户共享参数

自 **2024 年 2 月**起，Parameter Store 支持通过 AWS RAM 进行本地跨账户共享。Parameter Store 现在允许你与其他 AWS 账户共享高级层参数，使你能够通过与需要访问的其他账户共享参数来维护单一配置数据源，而不是手动跨账户复制和同步数据。

工作原理：共享账户在高级层创建 SSM 参数。共享账户使用 AWS RAM 创建资源共享，指定 SSM 参数和使用账户。使用账户接受资源共享邀请以获得对共享 SSM 参数的访问权限。

由于公司已经使用 **AWS 组织**，RAM 共享变得更加简单——邀请可以在整个组织中自动接受，而且你无需设置跨账户角色和编写额外的样板代码来临时假设托管参数的账户角色，实现了清晰的关注点分离。

消费者只需使用共享参数的**完整 ARN** 调用 `ssm:GetParameter`：

```
aws ssm get-parameter --name arn:aws:ssm:us-east-2:111111111111:parameter/MySharedParameter
```

这是开销最低的选项——无需自定义代码、无需角色假设逻辑、无需复制、无需同步作业。

## 其他选项为何错误

- **A. 账户 A 中的 IAM 用户凭证供账户 B 中的应用使用** — 这要求在账户之间分发**长期访问密钥**，这是明确的 AWS 安全反模式。它还会产生操作开销（密钥轮换、密钥分发），违反最小权限原则。AWS 特别建议对跨账户访问使用角色而非用户。

- **B. 账户 A 中可假设的 IAM 角色** — 这在技术上可行，是 2024 年 2 月之前的历史答案。但是，它的**操作开销高于** RAM：开发人员必须在应用程序中添加 `sts:AssumeRole` 逻辑、管理信任策略、刷新临时凭证，并处理角色链。博客文章明确对比了 RAM 共享如何消除这些开销——见上述引用。

- **D. 将参数复制到私有 S3 存储桶** — 这**复制**了参数（要求明确禁止），需要自定义同步脚本（操作开销），并失去 Parameter Store 的功能，如版本控制、KMS 集成的 SecureString 解密和分层命名。

## 参考资源

- [在 Parameter Store 中使用共享参数](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/parameter-store-shared-parameters.html)
- [AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 现在支持跨账户共享（2024 年 2 月）](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2024/02/aws-systems-manager-parameter-store-cross-account-sharing/)
- [推出 Parameter Store 跨账户共享 — AWS Cloud Operations 博客](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/mt/introducing-parameter-store-cross-account-sharing/)

en.question: In a move toward using microservices, a company’s management team has asked all development teams to build their services so that API requests depend only on that service’s data store. One team is building a Payments service which has its own database; the service needs data that originates in the Accounts database. Both are using Amazon DynamoDB. What approach will result in the simplest, decoupled, and reliable method to get near-real time updates from the Accounts database?

options.A: Use AWS Glue to perform frequent ETL updates from the Accounts database to the Payments database.
options.B: Use Amazon ElastiCache in Payments, with the cache updated by triggers in the Accounts database.
options.C: Use Amazon Data Firehose to deliver all changes from the Accounts database to the Payments database.
options.D: Use Amazon DynamoDB Streams to deliver all changes from the Accounts database to the Payments database.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A microservices design requires each service's API requests to depend only on its own data store. The **Payments** service (DynamoDB) needs data that originates in the **Accounts** service (DynamoDB), and the question asks for the **simplest, decoupled, and reliable** way to propagate near-real-time changes from Accounts to Payments.

## Correct Answer: D — Use Amazon DynamoDB Streams

DynamoDB Streams is purpose-built for this exact change-data-capture (CDC) pattern. DynamoDB Streams captures a time-ordered sequence of item-level modifications in any DynamoDB table and stores this information in a log for up to 24 hours, and applications can access this log and view the data items as they appeared before and after they were modified, in near-real time.

Typical microservices pattern: enable a stream on the Accounts table and attach an AWS Lambda function that writes the relevant changes into the Payments table. This is:

- **Simple** — native, managed integration; no custom polling/ETL infrastructure.
- **Decoupled** — the Accounts service does not call the Payments service; it just writes to its own table. If you have a microservices architecture, one service may need to update their state or perform some actions based on data changes within a different service — by hooking into the database events, you can avoid the latency and difficulty around partial failures that would occur if you were to perform all of these actions in the initial flow.
- **Reliable & near-real time** — in using DynamoDB Streams, it is guaranteed you won't receive duplicate records of write operations in your stream, and records within a shard will be strictly ordered according to the time it occurred.

This is also explicitly listed as a primary use case: event-driven microservices: react to data changes without polling; cross-region replication: sync tables across AWS regions; audit trails; materialized views.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**A. AWS Glue ETL (frequent batch updates)** — Glue is a batch ETL service. Even "frequent" Glue jobs run on schedules (minimum minutes), are heavyweight (Spark jobs spin up), and are not near-real-time. They add significant cost and operational complexity vs. a native stream + Lambda. Glue is meant for analytics-style ETL, not for keeping operational microservice databases in sync.

**B. ElastiCache updated by triggers in Accounts DB** — DynamoDB does not have native "triggers" that write to ElastiCache; you would have to build that pipeline anyway (likely via DynamoDB Streams). Worse, this **violates the stated requirement** that the Payments service's API "depend only on that service's data store" — putting the data in a shared cache instead of the Payments DynamoDB table introduces a new shared dependency and a cache-coherency problem. ElastiCache is also a cache, not a system of record.

**C. Amazon Data Firehose to deliver changes** — Firehose is a delivery service for streaming data into destinations like **S3, Redshift, OpenSearch, and Splunk**. Kinesis Firehose is a tool for buffering data and sending it to a downstream destination like S3, Redshift, or OpenSearch — it's very common to use Firehose to archive your data or to enable analytics queries with Amazon Athena. Firehose **cannot deliver directly into a DynamoDB table**, and it also can't read directly from a DynamoDB table — you would still need DynamoDB Streams (or Kinesis Data Streams from DynamoDB) as the source. So it's neither simpler nor sufficient.

## Reference Architecture

```
Accounts DynamoDB Table
        │  (Streams enabled, NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES)
        ▼
   DynamoDB Stream
        │
        ▼
   AWS Lambda  ──►  Payments DynamoDB Table
```

## Sources

- [Change data capture for DynamoDB Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Streams.html)
- [DynamoDB Streams Use Cases and Design Patterns (AWS Database Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/dynamodb-streams-use-cases-and-design-patterns/)
- [How to perform ordered data replication using DynamoDB Streams (AWS Database Blog)](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/how-to-perform-ordered-data-replication-between-applications-by-using-amazon-dynamodb-streams/)

zh.question: 为了推行微服务架构，一家公司的管理团队要求所有开发团队构建各自的服务，使其 API 请求仅依赖于该服务的数据存储。其中一个团队正在构建一个支付服务，该服务拥有自己的数据库；该服务需要从账户数据库中获取数据。这两个数据库都使用了 Amazon DynamoDB。哪种方法能够以最简单、解耦且可靠的方式从账户数据库获取近乎实时的更新？

options.A: 使用 AWS Glue 频繁地将 Accounts 数据库更新到 Payments 数据库。
options.B: 在 Payments 中使用 Amazon ElastiCache，缓存由 Accounts 数据库中的触发器更新。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Data Firehose 将账户数据库的所有更改传输到支付数据库。
options.D: 使用 Amazon DynamoDB Streams 将 Accounts 数据库中的所有更改传递到 Payments 数据库。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

微服务设计要求每个服务的 API 请求仅依赖于其自身的数据存储。**Payments** 服务（DynamoDB）需要源自 **Accounts** 服务（DynamoDB）的数据，问题要求找到**最简单、解耦、可靠**的方式，以近实时地将 Accounts 中的变更传播到 Payments。

## 正确答案：D — 使用 Amazon DynamoDB Streams

DynamoDB Streams 是为这种变更数据捕获（CDC）模式量身定制的。DynamoDB Streams 会捕获任何 DynamoDB 表中项目级修改的时间有序序列，并将此信息存储在日志中，保留长达 24 小时。应用程序可以实时访问此日志，并查看修改前后的数据项。

典型的微服务模式：在 Accounts 表上启用流，并附加一个 AWS Lambda 函数，将相关更改写入 Payments 表。这种方法具有以下优势：

- **简单** — 原生托管集成；无需自定义轮询/ETL 基础设施。
- **解耦** — Accounts 服务不调用 Payments 服务；它只写入自己的表。在微服务架构中，一个服务可能需要根据不同服务内的数据变更来更新其状态或执行某些操作。通过接入数据库事件，可以避免在初始流程中执行所有操作时会出现的延迟和部分故障的困难。
- **可靠且近实时** — 使用 DynamoDB Streams 时，保证不会在流中收到写操作的重复记录，分片内的记录将严格按照发生时间排序。

这也明确列为主要用例：事件驱动微服务：对数据变更做出反应而无需轮询；跨区域复制：跨 AWS 区域同步表；审计日志；物化视图。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

**A. AWS Glue ETL（频繁批量更新）** — Glue 是批处理 ETL 服务。即使"频繁"的 Glue 作业也是按计划运行（最少间隔分钟级），是重量级的（Spark 作业需要启动），不是近实时的。相比原生流 + Lambda，它增加了显著的成本和运维复杂性。Glue 用于分析类 ETL，不适合保持操作类微服务数据库同步。

**B. ElastiCache 由 Accounts 数据库触发器更新** — DynamoDB 没有本地"触发器"来写入 ElastiCache；无论如何都需要构建该管道（可能通过 DynamoDB Streams）。更糟的是，这**违反了陈述的需求**，即 Payments 服务的 API"仅依赖于该服务的数据存储"——将数据放在共享缓存中而不是 Payments DynamoDB 表中引入了新的共享依赖和缓存一致性问题。ElastiCache 也是缓存，不是数据源。

**C. Amazon Data Firehose 传递变更** — Firehose 是将流数据传递到 **S3、Redshift、OpenSearch 和 Splunk** 等目的地的服务。Kinesis Firehose 是一个工具，用于缓冲数据并将其发送到下游目的地（如 S3、Redshift 或 OpenSearch），通常用于使用 Amazon Athena 存档数据或启用分析查询。Firehose **无法直接将数据传递到 DynamoDB 表**，也无法直接从 DynamoDB 表读取——仍需将 DynamoDB Streams（或来自 DynamoDB 的 Kinesis Data Streams）作为源。因此它既不更简单，也不充分。

## 参考架构

```
Accounts DynamoDB 表
        │  （启用 Streams，NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES）
        ▼
   DynamoDB Stream
        │
        ▼
   AWS Lambda  ──►  Payments DynamoDB 表
```

## 来源

- [DynamoDB Streams 的变更数据捕获](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Streams.html)
- [DynamoDB Streams 用例和设计模式（AWS 数据库博客）](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/dynamodb-streams-use-cases-and-design-patterns/)
- [如何使用 Amazon DynamoDB Streams 执行有序数据复制（AWS 数据库博客）](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/how-to-perform-ordered-data-replication-between-applications-by-using-amazon-dynamodb-streams/)

en.question:
A developer compiles an AWS Lambda function and packages the result as a .zip file. The developer uses the Functions page on the Lambda console to attempt to upload the local packaged .zip file. When pushing the package ta Lambda, the console returns the following error:
```text
An error occurred (RequestEntityTooLargeException)
When calling the UpdateFunctionCode operation
```
 Which solutions can the developer use to publish the code? (Choose two.)

options.A: Upload the package to Amazon 3. Use the Functions page on the Lambda console to upload the package from the S3 location.
options.B: Create an AWS Support ticket to increase the maximum package size.
options.C: Use the update-function-code AWS CLI command. Pass the --publish parameter.
options.D: Repackage the Lambda function as a Docker container image. Upload the image to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR). Create a new Lambda function by using the Lambda console. Reference the image that is deployed to Amazon ECR.
options.E: Sign the .zip file digitally. Create a new Lambda function by using the Lambda console. Update the configuration of the new Lambda function to include the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the code signing configuration.

en.explanation:
# Lambda Deployment Package Size Limits

## Scenario
The developer compiled a Lambda function and packaged it as a .zip. When attempting to upload directly via the Lambda console, an error is returned. This is the classic Lambda console direct-upload size limit error: when you upload a deployment package or layer archive directly to Lambda, the size of the ZIP file is limited to 50 MB. To upload a larger file, store it in Amazon S3 and use the S3Bucket and S3Key parameters.

## Correct Answers: A and D

### A. Upload to S3, then reference from the Lambda console
This is the AWS-documented workaround. If your .zip file is less than 50MB, you can create or update a function by uploading the file directly from your local machine. For .zip files greater than 50MB, you must upload your package to an Amazon S3 bucket first. In the console, the developer chooses **Upload from → Amazon S3 location** and pastes the S3 URL of the .zip file.

### D. Repackage as a container image and push to ECR
Lambda supports container image deployment packages, which support up to **10 GB** of code and dependencies, far above the .zip limits. Lambda container images where the limit to the size of your code and dependencies is 10 GB. The developer builds a Docker image (e.g., from `public.ecr.aws/lambda/python:3.9`), pushes it to Amazon ECR, then creates a new Lambda function referencing that image.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

### B. Open a Support ticket to increase the maximum package size
Lambda deployment package size is a **hard limit** that cannot be raised via Support. Quotas such as package size quotas cannot currently be adjusted. AWS quotas page also notes most function configuration/deployment limits cannot be changed.

### C. Use `update-function-code` CLI with `--publish`
Using the AWS CLI to upload directly does **not** bypass the 50 MB direct-upload limit. When you upload a deployment package or layer archive directly to Lambda, the size of the ZIP file is limited to 50 MB. To upload a larger file, store it in Amazon S3 and use the S3Bucket and S3Key parameters. When you upload a file directly with the AWS CLI, AWS SDK, or otherwise, the binary ZIP file is converted to base64, which increases its size by about 30%. The `--publish` flag merely creates a new version; it doesn't address the size limit. To use the CLI for a large package, you'd need `--s3-bucket` and `--s3-key`, not `--zip-file`.

### E. Code signing the .zip
[Code signing for Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-codesigning.html) is a **security/integrity** feature that verifies trusted publishers. It has nothing to do with package size limits and would not allow the upload to succeed.

## Key Reference
- [Deploying Lambda functions as .zip file archives](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-function-zip.html)
- [Troubleshoot deployment issues in Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/troubleshooting-deployment.html)
- [Lambda quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html)
- [Create a Lambda function using a container image](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/images-create.html)

zh.question:
开发人员编译了一个 AWS Lambda 函数，并将结果打包成 .zip 文件。开发人员使用 Lambda 控制台上的“函数”页面尝试上传本地打包的 .zip 文件。将包推送到 Lambda 时，控制台返回以下错误：
```text
An error occurred (RequestEntityTooLargeException)
When calling the UpdateFunctionCode operation
```
开发人员可以使用哪些解决方案来发布代码？（选择两个。）

options.A: 将包上传到 Amazon 3. 使用 Lambda 控制台上的 Functions 页面从 S3 位置上传包。
options.B: 创建 AWS 支持工单，以增加最大软件包大小。
options.C: 使用 AWS CLI 命令 update-function-code，并传递 --publish 参数。
options.D: 将 Lambda 函数重新打包为 Docker 容器镜像。将该镜像上传到 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR)。使用 Lambda 控制台创建一个新的 Lambda 函数。引用已部署到 Amazon ECR 的镜像。
options.E: 对 .zip 文件进行数字签名。使用 Lambda 控制台创建一个新的 Lambda 函数。更新新 Lambda 函数的配置，使其包含代码签名配置的 Amazon 资源名称 (ARN)。

zh.explanation:
# Lambda 部署包大小限制

## 场景
开发人员编译了 Lambda 函数并将其打包为 .zip 文件。尝试通过 Lambda 控制台直接上传时，返回错误。这是经典的 Lambda 控制台直接上传大小限制错误：当你直接向 Lambda 上传部署包或层存档时，ZIP 文件的大小限制为 50 MB。要上传更大的文件，请将其存储在 Amazon S3 中，并使用 S3Bucket 和 S3Key 参数。

## 正确答案：A 和 D

### A. 上传到 S3，然后从 Lambda 控制台引用
这是 AWS 文档化的解决方案。如果 .zip 文件小于 50MB，可以通过从本地机器直接上传文件来创建或更新函数。对于大于 50MB 的 .zip 文件，必须先将包上传到 Amazon S3 存储桶。在控制台中，开发人员选择**上传来源 → Amazon S3 位置**，并粘贴 .zip 文件的 S3 URL。

### D. 重新打包为容器镜像并推送到 ECR
Lambda 支持容器镜像部署包，其支持的代码和依赖项大小可达 **10 GB**，远超 .zip 限制。Lambda 容器镜像的代码和依赖项大小限制为 10 GB。开发人员从 `public.ecr.aws/lambda/python:3.9` 等基础镜像构建 Docker 镜像，将其推送到 Amazon ECR，然后创建引用该镜像的新 Lambda 函数。

## 为什么其他选项错误

### B. 开启支持工单以提高最大包大小
Lambda 部署包大小是**硬限制**，无法通过支持工单提高。包大小配额等配额目前无法调整。AWS 配额页面也指出大多数函数配置/部署限制无法更改。

### C. 使用带 `--publish` 的 `update-function-code` CLI
使用 AWS CLI 直接上传**不会**绕过 50 MB 的直接上传限制。当你直接向 Lambda 上传部署包或层存档时，ZIP 文件的大小限制为 50 MB。要上传更大的文件，请将其存储在 Amazon S3 中，并使用 S3Bucket 和 S3Key 参数。当你通过 AWS CLI、AWS SDK 或其他方式直接上传文件时，二进制 ZIP 文件被转换为 base64，这会增加其大小约 30%。`--publish` 标志仅创建新版本，无法解决大小限制问题。要使用 CLI 上传大型包，需要 `--s3-bucket` 和 `--s3-key`，而非 `--zip-file`。

### E. 对 .zip 进行代码签名
[Lambda 代码签名](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-codesigning.html)是**安全/完整性**功能，用于验证受信任的发布者。它与包大小限制无关，无法使上传成功。

## 关键参考
- [将 Lambda 函数部署为 .zip 文件存档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-function-zip.html)
- [Lambda 部署问题故障排除](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/troubleshooting-deployment.html)
- [Lambda 配额](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html)
- [使用容器镜像创建 Lambda 函数](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/images-create.html)

en.question: A company runs an application on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. The application experiences variable loads throughout each day. The company needs to collect detailed metrics from the EC2 instances to right-size the instances. The company also wants to monitor custom application metrics to ensure the application is performing efficiently. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Install the AWS X-Ray agent on the instances. Configure the agent to collect the EC2 instance metrics and the custom application metrics.
options.B: Install the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the instances. Configure the agent to collect the EC2 instance metrics and the custom application metrics.
options.C: Install the AWS SDK in the application’s cade. Update the application to use the AWS SDK to collect and publish the EC2 instance metrics and the custom application metrics.
options.D: Configure AWS CloudTrail to capture and analyze the EC2 instance metrics and the custom application metrics.

en.explanation:
# EC2 Right-sizing with Detailed and Custom Metrics

## Scenario
A company runs an application on EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group with variable load. They need:
1. **Detailed EC2 instance metrics** (e.g., memory, disk usage — beyond what basic CloudWatch provides) to right-size the instances
2. **Custom application metrics** to monitor application performance

## Correct Answer: B — Install the Amazon CloudWatch agent

The CloudWatch agent is purpose-built for exactly this scenario. The CloudWatch agent is a software component that collects metrics, logs, and traces from Amazon EC2 instances, on-premises servers, and containerized applications, enabling you to monitor your infrastructure and applications more comprehensively than the basic monitoring provided by default.

Critically for **right-sizing**, the agent collects in-guest system-level metrics that the EC2 hypervisor does not expose by default. It collects more system-level metrics from Amazon EC2 instances across operating systems, including in-guest metrics in addition to the metrics for EC2 instances. The additional metrics that can be collected are listed in Metrics Collected by the CloudWatch Agent. This includes memory, disk usage, and process-level data — essential for determining if instances are over- or under-provisioned.

For **custom application metrics**, the same agent can ingest them via standard protocols: it can retrieve custom metrics from your applications or services using the StatsD and collectd protocols. StatsD is supported on both Linux servers and servers running Windows Server. collectd is supported only on Linux servers.

A single agent therefore satisfies both requirements without writing custom code.

## Why the other options are wrong

- **A. AWS X-Ray agent** — X-Ray is a distributed tracing service for analyzing request flows and latency between services. It does **not** collect EC2 host-level metrics (CPU, memory, disk) needed for right-sizing, nor does it publish arbitrary custom application metrics to CloudWatch. It produces traces and segments, not metrics.

- **C. AWS SDK with PutMetricData in application code** — While technically possible (if your use case doesn't support the CloudWatch agent, then use the PutMetricData API to push custom metrics to CloudWatch), this requires modifying the application code and writing custom logic to gather host-level metrics like memory and disk. It is far more operationally heavy than installing the CloudWatch agent, which handles host metrics out of the box and supports custom metrics via StatsD/collectd without code changes.

- **D. AWS CloudTrail** — CloudTrail captures **API call activity** for auditing/governance (who did what, when). It is not a metrics collection service and cannot capture EC2 OS-level performance metrics or application metrics.

## References
- [Collect metrics, logs, and traces using the CloudWatch agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Install-CloudWatch-Agent.html)
- [Push custom metrics to CloudWatch (AWS re:Post)](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/cloudwatch-push-custom-metrics)
- [amazon-cloudwatch-agent (GitHub)](https://github.com/aws/amazon-cloudwatch-agent)

zh.question: 一家公司在 Amazon EC2 实例的自动扩展组中运行一个应用程序。该应用程序每天的负载都会发生变化。该公司需要收集 EC2 实例的详细指标，以便合理调整实例大小。此外，该公司还希望监控自定义应用程序指标，以确保应用程序高效运行。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 在实例上安装 AWS X-Ray 代理。配置代理以收集 EC2 实例指标和自定义应用程序指标。
options.B: 在实例上安装 Amazon CloudWatch 代理。配置代理以收集 EC2 实例指标和自定义应用程序指标。
options.C: 在应用程序的 cade 中安装 AWS SDK。更新应用程序以使用 AWS SDK 收集和发布 EC2 实例指标和自定义应用程序指标。
options.D: 配置 AWS CloudTrail 以捕获和分析 EC2 实例指标和自定义应用程序指标。

zh.explanation:
# EC2 右调大小与详细和自定义指标

## 场景
一家公司在 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例上运行应用程序，负载可变。他们需要：
1. **详细的 EC2 实例指标**（例如内存、磁盘使用率——超越基本 CloudWatch 提供的范围）以调整实例大小
2. **自定义应用程序指标**以监控应用程序性能

## 正确答案：B — 安装 Amazon CloudWatch agent

CloudWatch agent 是为这个场景量身定制的。CloudWatch agent 是一个软件组件，可从 Amazon EC2 实例、本地服务器和容器化应用程序收集指标、日志和跟踪，使您能够比默认提供的基本监控更全面地监控基础设施和应用程序。

对于**右调大小**至关重要的是，该代理收集 EC2 hypervisor 默认不公开的来自实例内部的系统级指标。它从 Amazon EC2 实例跨操作系统收集更多系统级指标，包括实例内指标以及 EC2 实例的指标。可以收集的其他指标列在 CloudWatch Agent 收集的指标中。这包括内存、磁盘使用率和进程级数据——这些对于确定实例是否过度配置或配置不足至关重要。

对于**自定义应用程序指标**，同一代理可以通过标准协议摄取它们：它可以使用 StatsD 和 collectd 协议从您的应用程序或服务检索自定义指标。StatsD 在 Linux 服务器和运行 Windows Server 的服务器上都受支持。collectd 仅在 Linux 服务器上受支持。

因此，单个代理满足两项需求，无需编写自定义代码。

## 其他选项为什么是错误的

- **A. AWS X-Ray agent** — X-Ray 是一种分布式跟踪服务，用于分析请求流和服务之间的延迟。它**不**收集右调大小所需的 EC2 主机级指标（CPU、内存、磁盘），也不将任意自定义应用程序指标发布到 CloudWatch。它生成跟踪和段，而不是指标。

- **C. AWS SDK 在应用程序代码中使用 PutMetricData** — 虽然技术上可行（如果您的用例不支持 CloudWatch agent，则使用 PutMetricData API 将自定义指标推送到 CloudWatch），但这需要修改应用程序代码并编写自定义逻辑来收集内存和磁盘等主机级指标。相比之下，安装 CloudWatch agent 的操作成本要高得多，CloudWatch agent 可以开箱即用处理主机指标，并通过 StatsD/collectd 支持自定义指标，无需代码更改。

- **D. AWS CloudTrail** — CloudTrail 捕获 **API 调用活动**用于审计/管理（谁做了什么，何时）。它不是指标收集服务，无法捕获 EC2 OS 级性能指标或应用程序指标。

## 参考资源
- [使用 CloudWatch agent 收集指标、日志和跟踪](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Install-CloudWatch-Agent.html)
- [将自定义指标推送到 CloudWatch（AWS re:Post）](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/cloudwatch-push-custom-metrics)
- [amazon-cloudwatch-agent（GitHub）](https://github.com/aws/amazon-cloudwatch-agent)

en.question: A developer is creating an application that uses an Amazon DynamoDB table. The developer needs to develop code that reads all records that were added to the table during the previous day, creates HTML reports, and pushes the reports into third-party storage. The item size varies from 1 KB to 4 KB, and the index structure is defined with the date. The developer needs to minimize the read capacity that the application requires from the DynamoDB table. Which DynamoDB API operation should the developer use in the code to meet these requirements?

options.A: Query
options.B: Scan
options.C: BatchGetItem
options.D: GetItem

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A developer needs to read all DynamoDB items added during the **previous day**, generate HTML reports, and push them to third-party storage. The table has an **index defined with the date**, item sizes range 1–4 KB, and the goal is to **minimize read capacity (RCU)** consumed.

## Correct Answer: A. Query

Because an index already exists with the date, the developer can issue a `Query` against that index using the previous day's date as the partition key value. The Query operation finds items based on primary key values. You can query any table or secondary index that has a composite primary key (a partition key and a sort key). A Query operation will return all of the items from the table or index with the partition key value you provided.

Query is the most RCU-efficient option here because Query operations are generally more cost-effective because they consume capacity proportional to the number of items returned, while Scan operations, by necessity, read the entire table regardless of filter criteria, resulting in significantly higher capacity usage. AWS itself recommends this design: "For faster response times, design your tables and indexes so that your applications can use Query instead of Scan."

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**B. Scan** — A Scan reads every item in the table or index and then optionally applies a filter. With the DynamoDB Scan operation, you are charged for iterating over every item in your table, even if you are using a FilterExpression to reduce your result set. DynamoDB will still consume RCUs for every item in the table. This means scans can get expensive quickly, especially at large table sizes. This directly contradicts the requirement to *minimize* RCUs.

**C. BatchGetItem** — `BatchGetItem` requires you to supply the **exact primary keys** of up to 100 items per call. The developer does not know the individual primary keys of "all records added yesterday" — only the date. BatchGetItem cannot be used to range-select items by date; it is intended for retrieving a known list of items by key.

**D. GetItem** — `GetItem` returns a **single item** identified by its full primary key. It cannot return the *set* of all items added the previous day in one call, and looping GetItem per key would still require knowing each key in advance.

## Key Takeaway

When an attribute (like date) is part of an index's key schema and you need to retrieve a *range* of related items, **Query** is the canonical, RCU-minimizing API. Query operations typically require fewer RCUs because they retrieve a limited set of items by partition key. Filtering data after retrieval does not affect RCU consumption, as only the matched items read count towards capacity usage.

## References
- [Best practices for querying and scanning data – Amazon DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-query-scan.html)
- [Query – Amazon DynamoDB API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/APIReference/API_Query.html)
- [Scan – Amazon DynamoDB API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/APIReference/API_Scan.html)
- [BatchGetItem – Amazon DynamoDB API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/APIReference/API_BatchGetItem.html)

zh.question: 一位开发人员正在创建一个使用 Amazon DynamoDB 表的应用程序。该开发人员需要编写代码，读取前一天添加到表中的所有记录，生成 HTML 报告，并将这些报告推送到第三方存储。记录大小在 1 KB 到 4 KB 之间，索引结构按日期定义。开发人员需要尽可能减少应用程序对 DynamoDB 表的读取需求。为了满足这些要求，开发人员应该在代码中使用哪个 DynamoDB API 操作？

options.A: 查询
options.B: 扫描
options.C: BatchGetItem
options.D: 获取项目

zh.explanation:
## 场景

开发人员需要读取**前一天**添加的所有 DynamoDB 项目，生成 HTML 报告，并将其推送到第三方存储。该表具有**使用日期定义的索引**，项目大小范围为 1–4 KB，目标是**最小化消耗的读取容量 (RCU)**。

## 正确答案：A. Query

由于已存在使用日期定义的索引，开发人员可以针对该索引发出 `Query` 请求，使用前一天的日期作为分区键值。Query 操作根据主键值查找项目。您可以查询具有复合主键（分区键和排序键）的任何表或二级索引。Query 操作将返回表或索引中与您提供的分区键值匹配的所有项目。

在这种情况下，Query 是最有效的 RCU 选项，因为 Query 操作通常更具成本效益，因为它们消耗的容量与返回的项目数量成正比，而 Scan 操作必须读取整个表，无论过滤条件如何，导致容量使用量明显更高。 AWS 本身推荐这种设计："为了获得更快的响应时间，设计您的表和索引，以便应用程序可以使用 Query 而不是 Scan。"

## 为什么其他选项错误

**B. Scan** — Scan 读取表或索引中的每一项，然后可选地应用过滤条件。使用 DynamoDB Scan 操作时，即使您使用 FilterExpression 来缩减结果集，也需要为表中的每一项支付费用。DynamoDB 仍会为表中的每一项消耗 RCU。这意味着扫描可能会很快变得昂贵，尤其是在大型表中。 这直接与**最小化** RCU 的要求相矛盾。

**C. BatchGetItem** — `BatchGetItem` 要求您提供**精确的主键**，最多可处理 100 个项目。开发人员不知道"昨天添加的所有记录"的各个主键——只知道日期。BatchGetItem 无法用于按日期范围选择项目；它用于按键检索已知的项目列表。

**D. GetItem** — `GetItem` 返回由其完整主键标识的**单个项目**。它无法在一次调用中返回前一天添加的所有项目集合，而且对每个键循环使用 GetItem 仍需要提前知道每个键。

## 关键要点

当属性（如日期）是索引键架构的一部分，且您需要检索一*范围*相关项目时，**Query** 是规范的、最小化 RCU 的 API。Query 操作通常需要更少的 RCU，因为它们按分区键检索有限的项目集合。检索后过滤数据不会影响 RCU 消耗，因为只有匹配的项目读取数计入容量使用。

## 参考资源
- [查询和扫描数据的最佳实践 – Amazon DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-query-scan.html)
- [Query – Amazon DynamoDB API 参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/APIReference/API_Query.html)
- [Scan – Amazon DynamoDB API 参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/APIReference/API_Scan.html)
- [BatchGetItem – Amazon DynamoDB API 参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/APIReference/API_BatchGetItem.html)

en.question: A company is launching a feature that uses an HTTP API built with Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. An API Gateway endpoint performs several independent tasks that run in a Lambda function. The independent tasks can take up to 10 minutes in total to finish running. Users report that the endpoint sometimes returns an HTTP 504 status code. The Lambda function invocations are successful. Which solution will stop the endpoint from returning the HTTP 504 status cade?

options.A: Increase the Lambda function’s timeout value.
options.B: Increase the reserved concurrency of the Lambda function.
options.C: Increase the memory that is available to the Lambda function.
options.D: Refactor the Lambda function to start an AWS Step Functions state machine.

en.explanation:
## Scenario Analysis

The company has an HTTP API (API Gateway) that synchronously invokes a Lambda function. The Lambda performs several independent tasks taking up to **10 minutes** total. Users intermittently see HTTP 504 errors, but the Lambda invocations themselves succeed.

The HTTP 504 (Gateway Timeout) is being returned by **API Gateway**, not by Lambda. AWS API Gateway HTTP APIs maintain a hard limit of 30 seconds that cannot be increased. When an integration request takes longer than your configured API Gateway API maximum integration timeout parameter, API Gateway returns an HTTP 504 status code. Since the workload can run up to 10 minutes (600 seconds), it will always exceed the API Gateway integration timeout — no Lambda-side tuning can fix that.

## Correct Answer: D — Refactor the Lambda function to start an AWS Step Functions state machine

The correct architectural pattern for long-running work behind API Gateway is **asynchronous processing**. For operations that legitimately require more than 29 seconds (report generation, large data exports, ML inference), move to an async pattern. Have the API endpoint accept the request, write a job record, and immediately return an HTTP 202 Accepted with a job ID. A separate worker (with up to 15-minute timeout) processes the job. The client polls a status endpoint or receives a webhook notification when the job completes.

By refactoring the Lambda function to simply **start a Step Functions state machine execution** and return immediately, API Gateway gets a fast synchronous response (well within the 30-second HTTP API timeout), while Step Functions orchestrates the long-running, independent tasks asynchronously. Use Step Functions for multi-step long-running workflows. Step Functions Standard Workflows can run for up to 1 year — far more than the 10 minutes needed.

## Why the Other Options Are Wrong

**A. Increase the Lambda function's timeout value** — The Lambda timeout is not the problem. The question states *"The Lambda function invocations are successful"*, meaning Lambda is finishing its work. The 504 is coming from API Gateway, which has a hard **30-second integration timeout for HTTP APIs** that cannot be bypassed by raising the Lambda timeout. HTTP API Maximum integration timeout is 30 seconds — still a hard limit.

**B. Increase the reserved concurrency of the Lambda function** — Reserved concurrency controls how many parallel executions the function can run; it has nothing to do with how long a single invocation takes. The function is already completing successfully, so concurrency is not the bottleneck.

**C. Increase the memory available to the Lambda function** — More memory proportionally increases CPU and may speed up CPU-bound tasks, but it cannot reduce a 10-minute workload below the 30-second API Gateway HTTP API timeout. Even if it shaved off some seconds, the architecture is fundamentally incompatible with synchronous API Gateway invocation.

## Reference Architecture

```
Client → API Gateway (HTTP API) → Lambda (StartExecution) → returns 202 + executionArn
                                        ↓
                              Step Functions State Machine
                                  ├── Task 1
                                  ├── Task 2
                                  └── Task N  (up to 1 year)
Client → API Gateway → Lambda (DescribeExecution) → returns status/result
```

## References

- [Troubleshoot API Gateway HTTP 504 timeout errors](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/api-gateway-504-errors)
- [Increase the API Gateway integration timeout limit](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/api-gateway-timeout-limit)
- [API Gateway integration timeout limit announcement (June 2024)](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2024/06/amazon-api-gateway-integration-timeout-limit-29-seconds/)
- [AWS Step Functions — orchestration for long-running workflows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/welcome.html)

zh.question: 一家公司正在推出一项新功能，该功能使用基于 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 构建的 HTTP API。API Gateway 端点执行多个在 Lambda 函数中运行的独立任务。这些独立任务总共可能需要长达 10 分钟才能完成。用户报告称，该端点有时会返回 HTTP 504 状态码。Lambda 函数调用均成功。哪种解决方案可以阻止端点返回 HTTP 504 状态码？

options.A: 增加 Lambda 函数的超时值。
options.B: 增加 Lambda 函数的预留并发数。
options.C: 增加 Lambda 函数可用的内存。
options.D: 重构 Lambda 函数以启动 AWS Step Functions 状态机。

zh.explanation:
## 场景分析

该公司有一个 HTTP API（API Gateway），它同步调用一个 Lambda 函数。Lambda 执行多个独立任务，总耗时最多 **10 分钟**。用户间歇性地看到 HTTP 504 错误，但 Lambda 调用本身是成功的。

HTTP 504（网关超时）是由 **API Gateway** 返回的，而不是由 Lambda 返回的。AWS API Gateway HTTP API 维护 30 秒的硬限制，无法增加。 当集成请求花费的时间超过您配置的 API Gateway API 最大集成超时参数时，API Gateway 返回 HTTP 504 状态代码。 由于工作负载可能运行长达 10 分钟（600 秒），它总是会超过 API Gateway 集成超时——任何 Lambda 端调优都无法解决这个问题。

## 正确答案：D — 重构 Lambda 函数以启动 AWS Step Functions 状态机

长时间运行的工作在 API Gateway 后面的正确架构模式是 **异步处理**。对于合法上需要超过 29 秒的操作（报表生成、大数据导出、ML 推理），转向异步模式。让 API 端点接受请求，写入一条作业记录，并立即返回带有作业 ID 的 HTTP 202 Accepted。单独的工作进程（超时时间最长可达 15 分钟）处理该作业。客户端轮询状态端点或在作业完成时接收 webhook 通知。

通过重构 Lambda 函数以仅 **启动 Step Functions 状态机执行**并立即返回，API Gateway 获得一个快速同步响应（远在 30 秒 HTTP API 超时范围内），而 Step Functions 则异步编排长时间运行的独立任务。使用 Step Functions 处理多步骤长时间运行的工作流。 Step Functions Standard Workflows 可以运行长达 1 年——远超所需的 10 分钟。

## 为什么其他选项错误

**A. 增加 Lambda 函数的超时值** — Lambda 超时不是问题所在。问题陈述说 *"Lambda 函数调用是成功的"*，这意味着 Lambda 正在完成其工作。504 来自 API Gateway，它对 HTTP API 有 **30 秒集成超时硬限制**，无法通过提高 Lambda 超时来绕过。HTTP API 最大集成超时为 30 秒——仍是硬限制。

**B. 增加 Lambda 函数的预留并发** — 预留并发控制函数可以运行多少个并行执行；它与单个调用花费多长时间无关。该函数已经成功完成，所以并发不是瓶颈。

**C. 增加分配给 Lambda 函数的内存** — 更多内存会按比例增加 CPU，可能会加快 CPU 密集型任务，但无法将 10 分钟的工作负载缩短至 30 秒 API Gateway HTTP API 超时以下。即使它节省了一些秒数，该架构在根本上也与同步 API Gateway 调用不兼容。

## 参考架构

```
客户端 → API Gateway (HTTP API) → Lambda (StartExecution) → 返回 202 + executionArn
                                        ↓
                              Step Functions 状态机
                                  ├── 任务 1
                                  ├── 任务 2
                                  └── 任务 N  (最多 1 年)
客户端 → API Gateway → Lambda (DescribeExecution) → 返回状态/结果
```

## 参考资源

- [排查 API Gateway HTTP 504 超时错误](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/api-gateway-504-errors)
- [增加 API Gateway 集成超时限制](https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/api-gateway-timeout-limit)
- [API Gateway 集成超时限制公告（2024 年 6 月）](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2024/06/amazon-api-gateway-integration-timeout-limit-29-seconds/)
- [AWS Step Functions — 长时间运行工作流的编排](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/welcome.html)

en.question: A company has an application that uses an Amazon Cognito user pool for authentication. A developer needs to add a new REST API that will use the user pool to authenticate requests. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Create a new API key and a new usage plan. Associate the API key and the REST API with the usage plan.
options.B: Create a Cognito authorizer for the correct user pool. Reference the header that contains the Cognito token.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda token authorizer. Reference the authorization token in the event payload. Authenticate requests based on the token value.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda request authorizer. Reference the authorization header in the event payload. Authenticate requests by using the header value in a request to the Cognito API.

en.explanation:
# Cognito User Pool Authorizer for API Gateway REST API

## Scenario
A company already has an Amazon Cognito user pool used for authentication. A developer needs to add a new REST API in API Gateway that authenticates requests using **the same** Cognito user pool. The question asks for the solution with the **least development effort**.

## Correct Answer: B — Create a Cognito authorizer for the user pool and reference the header containing the Cognito token

API Gateway natively integrates with Amazon Cognito user pools through the built-in **COGNITO_USER_POOLS** authorizer type. As an alternative to using IAM roles and policies or Lambda authorizers, you can use an Amazon Cognito user pool to control who can access your API in Amazon API Gateway. To use an Amazon Cognito user pool with your API, you must first create an authorizer of the COGNITO_USER_POOLS type and then configure an API method to use that authorizer.

After deployment, the client must first sign the user in to the user pool, obtain an identity or access token for the user, and then call the API method with the token, which is typically set to the request's Authorization header. The API call succeeds only if the required token is supplied and valid.
